summary_en.importance: This is a post-training safety analysis contribution. It generalizes jailbreak fragility from isolated prompt tricks to a broader syntactic conditioning problem, and links the failure to linguistic bias in alignment data.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors run behavioral evaluations on 16 models up to 70B parameters, apply causal mediation analysis to test whether refusal is mediated by upstream syntactic features, steer those features to induce or suppress refusals, and test syntactic diversification of post-training data as a mitigation.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers 16 models up to 70B parameters. It reports that non-imperative syntactic forms broadly reduce refusal, syntactic feature steering can control refusal behavior, and syntactically diverse post-training data mitigates the vulnerability. The abstract does not provide exact effect sizes.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Mannheim and Technical University Clausthal.

recommendation.zh: 值得看因果分析和数据偏置部分；它提醒安全拒答可能学到表层语法触发器，而不是稳定的意图判别。
recommendation.en: Read the causal analysis and data-bias sections; the useful signal is that refusals may latch onto surface syntax rather than robust intent.

paper.title: On-Policy Delta Distillation for Multilingual Math Reasoning
paper.abstract: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) is emerging as a promising alternative to reinforcement learning for LLM post-training, yet its effectiveness in multilingual settings remains underexplored. We study OPD and its advanced variant, On-Policy Delta Distillation (OPD$^2$), for mathematical reasoning in English, Korean, and Japanese. OPD$^2$ improves OPD by using the probability gap between a post-trained teacher and its base model as the learning signal. Experiments with Qwen3 show that OPD$^2$ consiste

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是：on-policy distillation 这类替代 RL 的后训练方法，在多语言数学推理里是否仍然有效，尤其是对韩语、日语这类非英语语言，token 级蒸馏信号到底是在提升目标语言推理，还是只是把英语推理能力迁移并外溢到别的语言表面上。论文进一步聚焦 OPD2 的 delta signal 设计，即不用 teacher-student 的概率差，而用 post-trained teacher 相对其 base model 的概率增量作为监督，试图把“后训练新增的推理能力”从 teacher 原本已有的通用语言分布里剥离出来。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在于提出新的 pretrain objective，而在于它把 pretrain 与 post-train 的接口问题讲得更具体：如果 teacher 的能力增量可以通过 delta signal 被更干净地提取，那么后训练得到的推理能力就更像一种可迁移的“残差信号”，而不是把 teacher 的全部分布偏好一并蒸馏过去。这个视角对 reasoning-oriented continual pretraining、mid-training、以及用强 teacher 反哺 base model 都有启发。另一个重要点是，论文提醒多语言增益不能只看 benchmark 分数；英语-only 蒸馏能抬高韩语/日语成绩，但可能伴随 reasoning trace 英文化，这说明语言能力迁移和目标语言建模质量不是一回事。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上延续 OPD / OPD2 框架。OPD 的基本做法是：学生模型先按当前策略生成 rollout，再把这条 student trajectory 喂给 teacher，在每个已采样 token 上取 teacher 的条件概率，对学生做 token-level KL 或等价的 token reward 优化。这样做和 sequence-level RL 不同，监督更细，且仍保持 on-policy。OPD2 的改动很小但针对性很强：奖励不再是 log p_teacher(y_t|x,y_<t) - log p_student(y_t|x,y_<t)，而是 log p_teacher - log p_teacher_base。也就是把 teacher 相对其 base 的增量当作监督信号。这样做的动机是减少 teacher 中那些 base 已经具备的通用语言偏好、风格偏好、格式偏好对蒸馏的干扰，把学习重点放在 post-training 新获得的 reasoning preference 上。论文还沿用了 OPD2 原始工作里的两个稳定化部件：一是 reward centering，把 reward 转成 advantage 以缓解收敛点问题；二是用原始 OPD 信号做 conditioning criterion，避免 delta signal 单独使用时训练目标过于脆弱。实验设置上，作者构造了英/韩/日三语数学训练集，总规模 100K，考察多种语言配比与 EN-only 训练情形，核心比较对象是 OPD 与 OPD2 在 Qwen3 系列 instruction-tuned 模型上的表现差异。
summary.experiments: 从正文可确认的关键信息有三点。第一，训练数据是一个 100K 规模的多语言数学数据集，覆盖 English、Korean、Japanese，用来做 on-policy post-training。第二，结论上 OPD2 在多语言设置里稳定优于原始 OPD，且在韩语、日语上的提升更明显，说明 delta signal 在非英语推理迁移里更有用。第三，OPD2 往往能缩小 English 与 Korean 的性能差距，但这种 gap closing 不是所有模型和设置都一致成立，作者对此保持了克制。另一个实验观察很重要：只用英语数据做 OPD，也能提高韩语和日语 benchmark 分数，但生成分析显示，模型常把中间推理过程部分切换到英语，说明分数提升里混入了跨语言推理 trace 泄漏，而不完全是目标语言 reasoning 真正增强。由于给出的全文片段没有包含完整表格和具体数值，无法可靠复述每个模型、每个 benchmark 的精确提升幅度；但论文的主要实验价值不在绝对分数，而在于把 multilingual OPD 的收益与语言漂移副作用同时揭示出来。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction，重点抓三个研究问题：OPD2 是否仍优于 OPD、是否缩小语言差距、EN-only OPD 是否真的提升目标语言推理。然后看 On-Policy Distillation 一节，弄清 OPD 与 OPD2 的 reward 定义差别，这是一切实验现象的解释起点。实验部分建议优先看主表和作者对生成样例的分析，尤其是非英语输入下 reasoning trace 是否混入英语。这个现象比单纯分数更值得看。预计 15 到 25 分钟可以抓住主要信息；如果只关心方法，不必深究附录里的全部 benchmark 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether on-policy distillation remains effective for multilingual mathematical reasoning, especially in Korean and Japanese, and whether the gains reflect genuine target-language reasoning improvement or merely transfer of English-centric reasoning behavior. It further studies OPD2, where the supervision signal is the probability gap between a post-trained teacher and its base model, rather than the gap between teacher and student.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining researchers is indirect but real. The work sharpens the pretrain–post-train interface: if the useful part of post-training can be isolated as a delta over the base model, then reasoning capability may be distilled as a cleaner residual signal instead of copying the teacher’s full distribution. That matters for continual pretraining, mid-training, and teacher-assisted capability transfer. The multilingual findings are also important: benchmark gains alone can be misleading, because English-only distillation may improve Korean/Japanese scores while shifting the reasoning trace toward English.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method follows the OPD / OPD2 line. In OPD, the student first samples a rollout from its current policy. That sampled trajectory is then scored token by token by the teacher, and the student is updated to reduce the discrepancy on the sampled tokens. Compared with sequence-level RL, this gives denser token-level supervision while preserving the on-policy nature. OPD2 changes the reward definition: instead of using log p_teacher minus log p_student, it uses log p_teacher minus log p_teacher_base. The motivation is to isolate capabilities acquired during post-training, especially reasoning, while suppressing generic language preferences and stylistic biases already present in the teacher’s base model. The paper also keeps the two stabilizers introduced in prior OPD2 work: reward centering to form an advantage-like signal, and a conditioning criterion based on the original OPD signal to avoid pathological convergence. Empirically, the study builds a 100K multilingual math training set in English, Korean, and Japanese, and compares multilingual OPD and OPD2 as well as English-only OPD on Qwen3 instruction-tuned models.
summary_en.experiments: Three findings are clear from the full text provided. First, the training corpus contains 100K multilingual math problems spanning English, Korean, and Japanese. Second, OPD2 consistently outperforms vanilla OPD in multilingual settings, with stronger gains in Korean and Japanese than in English. Third, OPD2 often narrows the English–Korean gap, though the effect is not universal across all models and settings. A particularly useful observation is that English-only OPD can still raise Korean and Japanese benchmark scores, but qualitative inspection shows that the model often drifts into English during the reasoning process. That means some of the measured gain comes from cross-lingual reasoning-trace leakage rather than improved target-language reasoning per se. The excerpt does not include the full result tables, so precise benchmark-by-benchmark numbers cannot be stated reliably here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and focus on the three research questions: whether OPD2 still beats OPD, whether it reduces language gaps, and what English-only OPD is actually doing. Then read the OPD formulation carefully; the difference between the OPD reward and the OPD2 delta reward explains most of the empirical behavior. In the experiments, prioritize the main result tables and any qualitative examples showing language drift in the chain of thought. That analysis is more informative than the headline scores. A quick but useful read should take about 15–25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 OPD² 的 delta 目标和跨语言消融；若结论稳，后训练信号应从“模仿强模型”转向“模仿增量”。
recommendation.en: Read the OPD² delta objective and multilingual ablations; if robust, post-training targets should imitate the teacher’s gain, not the teacher distribution.

paper.title: Sample-Adaptive Latent Rewards for Uncertainty-Guided Diffusion Post-Training
paper.abstract: Latent reward models can supervise visual diffusion models without decoding intermediate states into pixel space. This makes alignment with human preferences more efficient. However, existing latent reward models output only scalar scores. They do not estimate the uncertainty of each prediction. The generator therefore cannot determine which feedback is reliable. This can drive optimization in the wrong direction and lead to reward hacking. We propose \textsc{SURE}, a unified latent-space framew

summary.core_problem: 解决视觉 diffusion 后训练中 latent reward 只有标量分数、无法表达不确定性，进而导致奖励误导和 reward hacking 的问题。
summary.importance: 这属于生成模型后训练与奖励建模工作。虽然对象是图像/视频 diffusion，不是 LLM，但“奖励模型应显式建模置信度”这一点对 RLHF/RLVR 与 pretrain-posttrain 接口有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SURE 框架，在 latent space 中训练 sample-adaptive latent reward model（SURE-LRM），为每个 noisy latent 预测高斯效用分布，用均值表示奖励、方差表示不确定性；再通过 uncertainty-guided reward feedback learning 利用该分布指导 dense post-training，避免不可靠反馈主导优化。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明方法覆盖图像与视频 diffusion 模型，并强调无需将中间状态解码回像素空间即可进行对齐；但未在摘要中给出具体模型规模、数据规模、基线名称和提升幅度，因此结论强度仍需看正文实验表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a key weakness in diffusion post-training: latent reward models output scalar scores without uncertainty, which can misguide optimization and induce reward hacking.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and reward-modeling paper for image/video diffusion. It is not an LLM paper, but the idea that reward models should expose confidence is relevant to RLHF/RLVR and the pretrain–posttrain interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes SURE, a latent-space framework with a sample-adaptive latent reward model (SURE-LRM) that predicts a Gaussian utility for each noisy latent. The mean is used as reward and the variance as uncertainty, which then drives uncertainty-guided reward feedback learning during dense post-training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims applicability to both image and video diffusion models and emphasizes latent-space alignment without decoding intermediate states to pixels. However, it does not provide model sizes, dataset scales, baselines, or exact gains in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 论文，但“奖励分数必须带置信度”这个判断值得迁到 RM/RLVR；正文只需看不确定性如何进入优化目标。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but the claim that reward scores need calibrated uncertainty is worth porting to RM/RLVR; read only the objective design.

paper.title: A Six-Dimensional Taxonomy of Post-Training Adaptation Techniques with Applications in AI Governance
paper.abstract: Post-training adaptation has become central to modern machine learning practice and includes techniques such as retraining, fine-tuning, parameter-efficient adaptation, alignment, retrieval augmentation, model editing, unlearning, calibration, and Multimodal Instruction Tuning. However, the literature remains fragmented across technique families, model classes, and deployment contexts, making it difficult to compare methods or describe how a trained model has been modified. This survey synthesiz

summary.core_problem: 后训练适配技术覆盖 fine-tuning、PEFT、alignment、RAG、model editing、unlearning、calibration、多模态指令微调等，术语和比较维度分散。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是综述与分类法。论文提出六维 taxonomy，用机制、目标、数据需求、持久性、结构范围、模型类型来描述适配方法；对研究员的价值主要是术语整理，不是新的训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 论文综合后训练适配文献，构造六个维度来区分常被混用的概念，例如 fine-tuning、retrieval augmentation、prompting、model editing 和 unlearning，并将传统 ML、深度学习、foundation model、LLM、MLLM 的适配方式放到同一描述框架中。
summary.experiments: 作为 taxonomy/survey，摘要未描述实验、模型规模或定量 baseline。主要产出应是分类表、概念边界和治理场景映射。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses fragmentation in post-training adaptation terminology across fine-tuning, PEFT, alignment, RAG, model editing, unlearning, calibration, and multimodal instruction tuning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a survey and taxonomy. It proposes six dimensions—mechanism, goal, data requirement, persistence, structural scope, and model type—to describe adaptation methods. Its value is conceptual organization rather than a new training technique.
summary_en.technical_approach: The survey synthesizes adaptation literature and uses the six-dimensional framework to separate commonly conflated methods such as fine-tuning, retrieval augmentation, prompting, model editing, and unlearning. It also maps how adaptation changes from classical ML to foundation models, LLMs, and multimodal LLMs.
summary_en.experiments: No experiments, model sizes, or quantitative baselines are described in the abstract. The main outputs are likely taxonomy tables, definitions, and governance-oriented mappings.

recommendation.zh: 适合作术语索引，不适合找训练 insight；扫 taxonomy 表即可，治理部分对 pretrain 决策帮助有限。
recommendation.en: Useful as a terminology index, not a source of training insight; skim the taxonomy table and skip most governance framing.

paper.title: ToolArtist: Tool-Using Unified Multimodal Models for Agentic Image Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models can produce visually compelling images, yet they remain limited on open-world tasks that require complex semantic understanding, multi-step reasoning, and the integration of external world knowledge. Existing efforts introduce agent capabilities into image generation, but they either prescribe a fixed workflow or place only a subset of the open-world image generation process under agent control. Consequently, reasoning, tool invocation, and image generation are not coo

summary.core_problem: 让统一多模态模型在单一策略下协调推理、外部工具调用与原生图像生成，解决现有 agentic T2I 工作流固定或控制范围不全的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新：把 agentic tool use 与原生图像生成统一进一个 UMM policy，是多模态生成 + agent 结合的一次具体尝试。
summary.technical_approach: 对 Unified Multimodal Model 做 post-training；SFT 阶段让 teacher agent 同时使用搜索工具和图像生成工具，将轨迹转成 UMM 兼容格式，把图像生成工具调用与原生生成能力对齐，再用统一策略动态编排。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据量或对比数值。
summary.authors_note: 作者含 Shuicheng Yan（颜水成），曾在 Sea AI Lab、昆仑万维等主导多模态与基础模型工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Unify reasoning, external tool use and native image generation under one policy in a multimodal model, since prior agentic T2I systems use fixed workflows or only partially agentize the pipeline.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution: an early attempt to couple agentic tool use with native image generation inside a single UMM policy.
summary_en.technical_approach: Post-trains a Unified Multimodal Model; at SFT, a teacher agent uses search tools plus an image-generation tool, trajectories are converted into a UMM-compatible format that aligns the image-generation tool call with native generation, enabling a single policy to orchestrate reasoning, tools and generation.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract gives no model size, data scale or quantitative comparisons.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Shuicheng Yan, known for leading multimodal and foundation-model efforts at Sea AI Lab and Kunlun.

recommendation.zh: 思路是把 tool call 当作 UMM 里的可学习动作，对统一多模态 post-train 有参考；摘要无数据，先看方法图即可。
recommendation.en: Treats tool calls as learnable actions inside a UMM—relevant for unified multimodal post-training; abstract lacks numbers, just skim the method figure.

paper.title: Privileged, but Biased: How PI-Conditioned Teachers Break Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Self-distillation (SD) has emerged as a compute-efficient alternative to reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards: a self-teacher, conditioned on privileged information (PI) about the answer such as a reference solution, supplies dense per-token supervision to a student that never sees it. Reported gains, however, come almost exclusively from narrow, low-difficulty settings, leaving open a basic question: as a lone objective, with no reward term, does SD teach anything? We reproduce SDPO's

summary.core_problem: 自蒸馏（SD）作为无奖励项的独立训练目标，在困难推理任务上是否真的优化任务正确率，还是仅在简单任务上拟合了与正确率相关的代理信号。此前SDPO、OPSD等自蒸馏方法仅在短多选知识题等简单场景上报了效果，困难任务下的有效性和失效机制均未被系统刻画。
summary.importance: 第一，证伪了自蒸馏可以单独替代可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的结论，将SD从通用方法重新定义为目标未充分定义的方法族——其密集监督的优势仍然成立，但PI条件的教师目标本身不编码正确性。第二，提出的PI Bias Score仅需前向传播即可度量PI条件教师对上下文内参考解的偏向程度，是可直接复用的诊断工具。第三，结论适用于所有使用PI条件教师做密集监督的场景，包括预训练中的合成数据蒸馏、推理增强训练，并非局限于RL后训练。
summary.technical_approach: 采用严格控制变量的实验设计，完全复用SDPO的代码、教师实现、裁剪机制，仅替换任务难度，排除实现差异的干扰。随后提出并验证了完整的失效因果链，五个环节均在同一组Qwen3-8B运行上测量：1）PI偏差：教师编码的是单条参考解的表面形式而非正确性，PI Bias Score（教师减学生的对数概率比）在上下文内解上达0.52，在同问题的其他正确解上仅≤0.02，几乎无法区分其他正确解与无关解。2）损失与正确性脱钩：按验证器结果拆分，正确和错误rollout的每token损失（≈3.5×10⁻⁴）和KL（≈0.03）在每一步都重叠，甚至呈反向关系——正确rollout的师生差为0.7，错误rollout为0.45，学习压力集中在学生已经做对的位置。3）密度扩散：停用词、标点、空白吸收了55.4%的每token损失，决定答案的内容词、数字、数学符号占比很低。4）惩罚探索：正确rollout中偏离参考路径的位置KL≈0.31，在路径上的位置KL≈0.08，相差4倍，教师无法区分有效迂回和错误，抑制推理所需的搜索，导致回复变短。5）学生分布扁平化而非锐化：师生差从≈3.1降至≈0，但±1标准差带没有收缩，学生熵上升，最终得到更平、更早确定输出的策略，解题数量没有增加。
summary.experiments: 基座模型为Qwen3-8B，覆盖四个领域：通用QA（MMLU-Pro）、数学（DAPO-Math）、代码（CodeForces）、多轮智能体工具使用。对比SDPO和OPSD两种自蒸馏配方，控制变量包括回复长度、任务难度、模型规模、推理模式、PI形式。结果显示：每token损失持续下降，但验证准确率不提升甚至下降，智能体领域平均下降3.51分，单个基准最高下降7.0分，两种配方下趋势一致。因果链的所有环节均在同一组Qwen3-8B运行上测量，保证变量可控。
summary.reading_guide: 重点读第5节（失效的实验证据）和第6节（因果链的测量与验证），尤其是图2（训练签名：损失下降但准确率停滞）、图3和图4（因果链各环节的量化结果）。PI Bias Score的定义和计算方式值得深挖，可直接复用到其他PI条件蒸馏场景的诊断。第7节的消融实验（不同PI形式、模型规模、推理模式）可快速扫过，用于确认结论的普适性。延伸思考方向：如何构造编码正确性而非单条轨迹的PI条件教师，例如使用多条参考解、将验证器反馈作为PI、或仅对决定答案的关键token做蒸馏。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether self-distillation (SD) as a standalone reward-free objective actually optimizes task correctness on difficult reasoning tasks, or merely fits a proxy correlated with correctness in narrow easy settings. Prior SD methods such as SDPO and OPSD only reported gains on simple tasks like short multiple-choice knowledge questions, leaving their effectiveness and failure mechanism on hard tasks uncharacterized.
summary_en.importance: First, it falsifies the claim that SD can standalone replace reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), reframing SD as an underspecified family of objectives rather than a general method — its density advantage remains intact, but the PI-conditioned teacher target itself fails to encode correctness. Second, the proposed PI Bias Score, a forward-pass-only metric, provides a directly reusable diagnostic tool for measuring how strongly a PI-conditioned teacher favors the in-context reference solution. Third, the conclusion applies to all scenarios using PI-conditioned teachers for dense supervision, including synthetic data distillation in pretraining and reasoning-augmented training, not limited to RL post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses strictly controlled experiments with identical SDPO code, teacher implementation, and clipping mechanisms, varying only task difficulty to rule out implementation differences. It then proposes and validates a full causal chain of failure, with all five links measured on the same set of Qwen3-8B runs: 1) PI bias: the teacher encodes the surface form of a single reference solution rather than correctness. The PI Bias Score (teacher-minus-student log-probability ratio) reaches 0.52 for the in-context solution but ≤0.02 for other correct solutions to the same problem, barely distinguishing them from unrelated solutions. 2) Loss decoupled from correctness: split by verifier outcome, per-token loss (≈3.5×10⁻⁴) and KL (≈0.03) overlap at every step for correct and incorrect rollouts, and even run in reverse — the teacher-student gap is 0.7 on correct rollouts vs 0.45 on incorrect ones, meaning learning pressure concentrates where the student is already right. 3) Density diffusion: stopwords, punctuation, and whitespace absorb 55.4% of per-token loss, while content words, numbers, and math symbols that determine the answer account for much less. 4) Exploration penalty: within correct rollouts, positions off the reference path have KL≈0.31 vs ≈0.08 on-path, a 4x difference. The teacher cannot distinguish productive detours from errors, suppressing the search required for reasoning and shortening responses. 5) Student flattening instead of sharpening: the teacher-student gap closes from ≈3.1 to ≈0, but the ±1 standard deviation band does not contract, and student entropy rises, resulting in a flatter, earlier-committing policy that solves no more problems.
summary_en.experiments: Base model is Qwen3-8B, evaluated across four domains: general QA (MMLU-Pro), mathematics (DAPO-Math), coding (CodeForces), and multi-turn agentic tool use. Two SD recipes (SDPO and OPSD) are compared, with controls for response length, task difficulty, model scale, reasoning mode, and PI form. Results show per-token loss decreases steadily, but validation accuracy does not improve and typically degrades — up to 3.51 points average drop in the agentic domain, and 7.0 points on individual benchmarks, with consistent trends across both recipes. All links of the causal chain are measured on the same set of Qwen3-8B runs to ensure variable control.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 5 (experimental evidence of failure) and Section 6 (measurement and validation of the causal chain), especially Figure 2 (training signature: falling loss with flat accuracy), Figures 3 and 4 (quantification of each causal link). The definition and computation of the PI Bias Score is worth deep diving, as it can be directly reused for diagnosis in other PI-conditioned distillation scenarios. Section 7 (ablations across PI forms, model scales, reasoning modes) can be skimmed quickly to confirm the generality of the conclusion. A worthwhile extension to consider: how to construct PI-conditioned teachers that encode correctness rather than a single trajectory, for example using multiple reference solutions, verifier feedback as PI, or distilling only on answer-determining key tokens.

recommendation.zh: 直接动摇自蒸馏替代RL的主流叙事，对后训练数据合成和蒸馏策略设计有强警示意义，应全文精读。
recommendation.en: Directly undermines the narrative of self-distillation as an RL substitute; strong implications for post-training data synthesis and distillation strategy design—read the full paper.

paper.title: Optimizing What Policies Learn From: Recoverability-aware Rollout Intervention Learning
paper.abstract: Critic-free group-based reinforcement learning has become a scalable approach for post-training large language models. However, most existing methods allocate the same number of rollouts to every task and trajectory state, even though some rollouts provide much more useful learning signals than others. Recent work has started to treat rollout generation as an adaptive decision, but two important limitations remain. First, intervention strategies are often based on fixed heuristics and therefore

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注的是 group-based、critic-free RL 里另一个常被忽略的问题：rollout 预算通常被均匀分配，但不同任务、不同轨迹状态的学习价值差异很大。尤其在 agentic 或稀疏奖励场景里，有些状态再多采样也学不到东西，有些状态则值得额外分支探索。已有方法多用 reward variance、entropy、uncertainty 之类静态启发式来决定是否多采样，但这些信号会随着 policy 演化而失真，而且通常只能决定“多采几个”，不能表达“在什么位置、用什么方式介入”。论文要解决的核心问题，是如何在线学习一个结构化的 rollout intervention policy，让训练过程把算力花在更能产生学习信号的地方。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关系不如训练 recipe 论文强，但它对 post-training 里的数据效率、训练信号质量、以及“训练过程本身也可学习”这个方向有启发。它的重要性主要在两点。第一，它把 rollout allocation 从静态启发式提升为 outcome-driven 的在线学习问题，强调不是根据不确定性代理信号分配算力，而是根据干预后实际带来的学习信号增益来分配。第二，它把 intervention 从标量预算扩展到结构化决策空间，允许同时决定在哪里 branch、如何 branch。这种思路和 pretraining 中的 data curriculum、active data selection、adaptive compute allocation 有相通之处：关键不是平均地看 token 或样本，而是识别哪些位置更值得额外计算。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 Recoverability-Aware Intervention Learning，简称 RAIL。核心概念是 recoverability。按作者的定义，recoverability 衡量的是：在某个任务或轨迹状态上施加 intervention 后，reward-distribution signal 能提升多少。这里的重点不是最终 reward 本身，而是干预是否让训练看到更有区分度、更有学习价值的回报分布。

围绕这个概念，RAIL 做了三层设计。

第一，它把 rollout intervention 建模成一个 online contextual bandit。context 是当前任务或轨迹状态，action 是一个结构化 intervention 选择，observed utility 是实际观测到的 recoverability gain。这样做的意义是，controller 学到的是“在当前 policy、当前状态分布下，什么干预最能带来额外学习信号”，而不是依赖固定规则。作者明确把这一步用来弥补 non-stationary gap：policy 在变，干预策略也应跟着学。

第二，action space 不是单一的 rollout 数量，而是 structured intervention space。虽然给出的全文片段没有展开全部细节，但从引言和方法定义看，至少包括在哪里 branch、采用哪种 intervention strategy 等耦合决策。作者把这一步用来弥补 non-scalar gap：很多有价值的干预不是“多采样几个”这么简单，而是要在正确的状态、以正确的方式扩展轨迹。

第三，部署方式采用 shadow-to-live procedure。先用一个短 shadow phase 收集 intervention traces 和 supervision，不直接让 learned controller 影响主训练；等 controller 对 utility 有一定把握后，再进入 utility-gated live phase，选择性地把它接入 policy optimization。这个设计比较务实，因为在线学 intervention policy 容易把训练搞偏，先 shadow 再 live 相当于给 controller 一个冷启动缓冲区，也降低了早期错误干预的代价。

从整体上看，RAIL 不是改 GRPO 的 policy gradient 公式，而是改 rollout generation process。它把 rollout 生成从固定程序变成可学习、可适应的训练环节。和基于 entropy、variance 的启发式 branching 方法相比，差别在于：RAIL 关心的是 intervention 的 realized utility，而不是某个代理指标是否高。
summary.experiments:
论文声称从四个维度评估：effectiveness、adaptivity、expressiveness、efficiency，并在多个 benchmark 上优于现有 heuristic intervention baselines。给出的全文片段没有包含完整实验表和具体数字，因此无法可靠复述提升幅度、模型规模或数据规模。

从作者描述可以确认的实验结论有几条。第一，learned recoverability controller 比静态启发式更能适应 policy 演化，说明 non-stationary gap 不是表面问题，而会真实影响 rollout allocation 的收益。第二，结构化 intervention 比单纯调 rollout 数量更有效，说明 non-scalar gap 也成立。第三，shadow-to-live 机制不是纯工程包装，而是保证在线部署稳定性的关键部分。

如果后续阅读全文，实验部分最值得核对的是三类证据：一是 recoverability gain 与最终训练收益之间的相关性是否稳定；二是 learned controller 在训练早中晚期的决策分布如何变化；三是相对启发式方法，RAIL 的额外控制器开销是否被 rollout 节省抵消。如果这些证据完整，这篇工作的说服力会明显 stronger。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合泛读，重点看问题定义和训练框架，不必在第一次阅读时深究所有 bandit 细节。

建议先看 Introduction 和 Section 2.1，确认作者如何定义 recoverability，以及它和 reward variance、entropy 这类常见代理信号有什么区别。这里是整篇文章最关键的判断基础：如果 recoverability 只是换个名字包装旧信号，价值就有限；如果它真的是 outcome-based utility，就有方法论意义。

然后看方法部分关于 contextual bandit 和 structured intervention space 的定义，重点理解 action space 到底包含哪些决策维度，以及 controller 的输入特征来自哪里。再看 shadow-to-live deployment，这部分决定方法是否能在真实训练环路里稳定工作。

实验部分优先看四类评估：effectiveness 看最终收益，adaptivity 看随 policy 演化是否持续有效，expressiveness 看结构化 action 是否优于标量预算，efficiency 看控制器开销和 rollout 节省的平衡。

如果只是判断是否值得跟进，20–30 分钟足够；如果要迁移到自家 RL pipeline，需要补看附录里的 intervention space、utility 定义、以及 online update 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a neglected inefficiency in critic-free, group-based RL: rollout budgets are usually allocated uniformly even though the learning value of additional rollouts varies sharply across tasks and trajectory states. This is especially problematic in agentic or sparse-reward settings, where some states are effectively unrecoverable while others would benefit from extra branching. Existing methods mostly rely on static heuristics such as reward variance, entropy, or uncertainty, but those proxies drift as the policy changes and usually only answer a scalar question like how many more rollouts to sample. The core problem is how to learn an online, structured rollout-intervention policy that spends compute where it produces more useful learning signal.
summary_en.importance: Its connection to pretraining is indirect, but it is relevant to post-training data efficiency, signal quality, and the broader idea that the training process itself can be optimized. The main contribution is conceptual. First, it reframes rollout allocation as an outcome-driven online learning problem rather than a heuristic scheduling problem. Compute is allocated based on realized intervention utility, not on static proxy signals. Second, it expands intervention from a scalar budget decision to a structured action space, allowing the system to decide both where and how to intervene. That is closely related in spirit to adaptive compute allocation, curriculum design, and active data selection in pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
RAIL stands for Recoverability-Aware Intervention Learning. Its central concept is recoverability, defined as how much an intervention improves the reward-distribution signal at a task or trajectory state. The emphasis is not just on final reward, but on whether the intervention exposes more informative reward contrast for learning.

The method has three main layers.

First, rollout intervention is formulated as an online contextual bandit. The context is the current task or trajectory state, the action is a structured intervention choice, and the observed utility is the realized recoverability gain. This directly addresses the non-stationary gap: as the policy evolves, the intervention policy should also adapt from observed outcomes rather than remain a fixed heuristic.

Second, the action space is structured rather than scalar. From the paper’s framing, it includes coupled decisions such as where to branch and which intervention strategy to apply, not merely how many additional rollouts to generate. This addresses the non-scalar gap: useful intervention often depends on acting at the right state with the right branching pattern, not just increasing sample count.

Third, deployment uses a shadow-to-live procedure. A short shadow phase collects intervention traces and supervision without directly affecting the main optimization loop. Once the controller has enough signal, a utility-gated live phase selectively applies it during policy optimization. This is a practical design choice because online intervention learning can destabilize training if deployed too early; the shadow phase acts as a cold-start buffer.

Overall, RAIL does not modify the GRPO gradient formula itself. It modifies the rollout-generation process, turning it from a fixed procedure into an adaptive, learned component of training. Relative to entropy- or variance-based branching heuristics, the key difference is that RAIL optimizes for realized intervention utility rather than a proxy statistic.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper states that it evaluates RAIL along four axes: effectiveness, adaptivity, expressiveness, and efficiency, and that it outperforms heuristic intervention baselines across multiple benchmarks. However, the provided full-text excerpt does not include the detailed result tables, model sizes, dataset sizes, or exact gains, so those numbers cannot be reproduced reliably here.

What can be inferred from the text is still useful. First, the learned recoverability controller appears to adapt better than static heuristics as the policy changes, which supports the claim that the non-stationary gap is real. Second, structured intervention outperforms scalar budget control, supporting the non-scalar argument. Third, the shadow-to-live mechanism is presented as an important stability device rather than a cosmetic engineering detail.

When reading the full paper, the most important experimental checks are: whether recoverability gain correlates consistently with downstream training improvement; how the controller’s decisions evolve over the course of training; and whether the controller overhead is offset by rollout savings relative to heuristic baselines. Those points determine how convincing the method really is.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is best treated as a skim paper. Focus on the problem formulation and the training-loop design rather than every bandit detail on the first pass.

Start with the introduction and the section that defines recoverability. The key question is whether recoverability is genuinely an outcome-based utility measure or just a relabeling of familiar proxies like entropy or reward variance. That distinction determines the paper’s value.

Then read the method section around the contextual-bandit formulation and the structured intervention space. Pay attention to what decisions are actually included in the action space and what features the controller observes. After that, read the shadow-to-live deployment procedure carefully, because that is what makes the method plausible in a real online training loop.

In the experiments, prioritize the four evaluation axes. Effectiveness tells you whether the method improves training. Adaptivity tells you whether it remains useful as the policy changes. Expressiveness tells you whether structured actions matter beyond scalar budgets. Efficiency tells you whether the controller overhead is justified.

If the goal is triage, 20 to 30 minutes is enough. For implementation, you would need the appendix details on the intervention space, the utility definition, and the online update rule.

recommendation.zh: 后训练RL中自适应分配rollout信号的思路可迁移到预训练的数据课程与训练信号筛选，重点看上下文bandit建模部分。
recommendation.en: Adaptive rollout allocation in post-training RL transfers to pretraining data curriculum and signal filtering; focus on the contextual bandit formulation.

paper.title: ReflectRL: Learning from Golden Negative Trajectories via Reflective-to-Direct Reasoning
paper.abstract: On-policy training has emerged as a powerful post-training paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models, and is often enhanced by golden trajectories from stronger expert models. However, when the expert fails on harder problems, existing trajectory-guided methods lose their main source of supervision, and these failed trajectories are typically discarded as negative samples. We argue that such failures, which we call Golden Negative Trajectories, can still provide

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决 on-policy reasoning training 中一个常见浪费：强专家模型在难题上失败的轨迹通常被丢弃，但这些失败轨迹仍包含高质量前缀和局部错误，可能提供训练信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要在 post-training 信号设计。它强调失败样本不能简单等同于低质量样本。强模型失败轨迹往往有较长的有效推理前缀，错误也更局部；让目标模型先反思这些轨迹，可能比直接从空白上下文解题更容易。这对 RLVR、on-policy distillation、推理数据合成和 verifier 驱动训练都有启发：训练信号不仅来自正确答案，也可来自“可诊断的错误”。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Golden Negative Trajectories，指强专家模型生成但最终答错的推理轨迹。关键经验现象是 Reflection Advantage：在难题上，给模型一个有缺陷的专家轨迹并要求其反思，比让模型直接解题更容易得到正确答案。作者用 Process Reward Model 做 step-level 分析，发现 GNT 相比目标模型或弱模型的失败轨迹，通常保持更高过程奖励，并在出错前有更长的有效前缀。进一步的组件干预显示，有效前缀和局部错误区域共同贡献反思收益。ReflectRL 的设计保持原有训练目标不变，只改变 rollout 构造方式。在 RLVR 中，同时采样 reflective reasoning rollout 和 direct reasoning rollout，用同一个 verifier 打分，再按标准策略更新。在 OPD 中，把 GNT 作为 teacher-side privileged context，同时让 student 保持 direct reasoning 行为。为了避免推理时依赖专家失败轨迹，训练中逐步把 rollout 分布从 reflective reasoning 转向 direct reasoning，即 Reflective-to-Direct Policy Transition。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 9 个 reasoning benchmark、4 个 LLM backbone 和 4 种训练方法，包含 RLVR 与 OPD 设置。结果显示 ReflectRL 在这些设置中稳定提升 direct reasoning 性能，且额外开销较小。作者还发布 OpenR1-GNT-69k，包含 6.9 万条专家失败轨迹。分析实验支持三个结论：GNT 比目标模型自生成失败或弱模型失败更适合作为反思上下文；高质量有效前缀和局部错误都重要；Reflective-to-Direct 转换有助于把反思阶段学到的能力迁移到推理时的直接解题模式。给定内容未提供各 benchmark 的具体提升数字，精读时需要查结果表和消融表。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 分钟，若关注 RLVR 数据构造可读到 45 分钟。先看 Figure 1，对 Reflection Advantage、PRM 过程质量曲线和 GNT 组件干预建立直觉。然后看 Figure 2，理解 ReflectRL 如何在不改 loss 的情况下改 rollout 分布。实验部分优先看主结果表、GNT 来源对比、Reflective-to-Direct schedule 消融，以及 RLVR/OPD 两类训练范式下是否表现一致。最值得深挖的问题是：反思上下文是否只是提供额外 token 预算，还是确实提供了错误定位和修复信号；这需要看长度控制、轨迹质量控制和错误区域替换实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses a wasted source of supervision in on-policy reasoning training: failed trajectories from strong expert models are usually discarded, even though they often contain long valid prefixes and localized mistakes.
summary_en.importance: The main value is in post-training signal design. It argues that a negative trajectory from a strong model is not the same as a low-quality sample. Such trajectories can expose where reasoning nearly works and where it breaks. For RLVR, on-policy distillation, verifier-based training, and synthetic reasoning data construction, the useful lesson is that correct demonstrations are not the only high-value signal; diagnosable failures can also train direct reasoning when used carefully.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper defines Golden Negative Trajectories as expert-generated reasoning traces that end in incorrect answers. Its central empirical finding is the Reflection Advantage: on hard problems, a target model can solve more effectively when asked to reflect on a flawed expert trajectory than when solving directly from scratch. A process reward model is used to profile trajectory quality at the step level. Compared with failures from the target model or a weaker model, GNTs maintain higher process rewards and longer valid prefixes before a localized error. Causal interventions on trajectory components suggest that both the valid prefix and the error region contribute to the benefit. ReflectRL keeps the underlying training objective unchanged and modifies rollout construction. In RLVR, it samples both reflective and direct reasoning rollouts, scores them with the same verifier, and applies the usual policy update. In OPD, it uses GNTs as privileged teacher-side context while keeping the student aligned to direct reasoning. A Reflective-to-Direct Policy Transition gradually shifts the rollout distribution from reflective reasoning to direct reasoning, so the trained model does not require expert failure traces at inference time.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 9 reasoning benchmarks, 4 LLM backbones, and 4 training methods, including both RLVR and OPD. The reported pattern is consistent improvement in direct reasoning with limited extra overhead. The authors also release OpenR1-GNT-69k, a dataset of 69k expert failure trajectories. The analysis supports three claims: GNTs are more useful than self-failures or weak-model failures; both the high-quality prefix and the localized error matter; and the reflective-to-direct transition helps transfer the benefit back to the inference-time mode. The supplied content does not include exact per-benchmark gains, so the result tables and ablations are the key places to verify effect size.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30 minute skim is appropriate; spend 45 minutes if working on RLVR data construction. Start with Figure 1 for the Reflection Advantage, PRM step-quality profiles, and component interventions. Then read Figure 2 to see how ReflectRL changes rollout construction without changing the loss. In the experiments, prioritize the main result table, comparisons among GNT sources, the Reflective-to-Direct schedule ablation, and the split between RLVR and OPD settings. The most important technical question is whether reflection helps only by adding more tokens and context, or whether it provides genuine error-localization and repair signal. Length controls and trajectory-component interventions are the evidence to inspect.

recommendation.zh: 这类工作对 pretrain 本身不直接，但它在训练信号设计上有点新意；先看方法图和 hard-only ablation，若没控制额外反思 token，结论要打折。
recommendation.en: Not directly a pretraining paper, but the supervision redesign is worth noting; read the method figure and hard-only ablations first, and discount the claim if extra reflection tokens are not cleanly controlled.

paper.title: When Refusal Looks Safe: The Refusal-Cue Shortcut in Safety Guard Models
paper.abstract: Safety guards are widely used to filter harmful content and are typically trained via supervised fine-tuning on labeled prompt-response pairs. We audit two widely used safety-guard training datasets, WildGuardMix and GR-Train, and find that among responses to harmful prompts, refusal expressions co-occur almost exclusively with unharmful labels. This imbalance motivates what we term the refusal-cue shortcut: inserting a refusal cue into a harmful response could flip the guard's verdict from harm

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究安全 guard 模型中的一个数据捷径：在有害回答前插入拒答语气，例如“我不能帮助你”，即使后面仍包含有害内容，也可能让 guard 把回答判为无害。核心问题不是拒答识别是否有效，而是拒答线索是否被模型错误地当成了无害性的充分证据。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在模型架构，而在训练数据信号质量。它给出一个清楚案例：用安全对齐模型生成“安全回答”、用未对齐模型生成“有害回答”，会把拒答表达和无害标签强绑定，形成 spurious correlation。类似问题也会出现在 SFT/RL 数据、偏好数据、过滤器训练数据里。对于基座研究员，这篇更适合作为数据构造与安全分类器训练的反例阅读：标签正确不等于条件分布健康，模型可能学到最便宜的表面线索。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三层。第一层是数据审计。作者检查 WildGuardMix 和 GR-Train 中 harmful prompt 下 response 的 refusal 与 harmfulness 联合分布，发现“refusal 且 harmful”的样本几乎不存在：WildGuardMix 中为 0，GR-Train 中只占 harmful-prompt examples 的 0.26%。第二层是行为测试。作者在不改变有害主体内容的情况下，把自然语言拒答 cue 插入回答开头、中间或其他位置，观察 harmful-to-unharmful prediction flip，并用 DFR 量化这类翻转。第三层是机制和干预。作者把 sparse complementary masking 改造成适用于 guard 的模型内目标，定位与捷径相关的少量 attention heads 和 MLP neurons，再做组件级抑制，而不是全量重训。这个设计的关键是把“合法拒答识别”和“拒答 cue 导致的错误无害判断”分开处理。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 6 个 safety guard family、9 个模型变体，包括 WildGuard-7B、GuardReasoner-1B/8B、LlamaGuard3-1B/8B、Qwen3Guard-0.6B/8B strict mode，以及两个 Aegis2-derived guards。训练数据已知存在失衡的 WildGuard-7B 和 GuardReasoner 系列最容易受 refusal cue 影响。训练数据未公开的 LlamaGuard3 和 Qwen3Guard 也出现类似现象。Aegis2-derived 模型脆弱性明显较低，原因可能与 Aegis2 主动补充 harmful prompt 下的安全重定向、拒答和多样安全回答有关。多尺寸 family 中，小模型通常更依赖这个捷径。cue 越完整地表达拒答意图，翻转越强；cue 放在不同 response 位置仍有效。干预实验中，作者排除本来较稳的两个 Aegis2-derived guards，对其余 7 个 guard 做抑制，WildGuardTest 上 response-initial DFR 均值从 16.39% 降到 3.44%。干预是在 response-initial cue 上学习的，但对未见过的位置和 held-out dataset 仍有效。clean harmfulness performance 基本保持，refusal-recognition F1 变化不超过 2.11%。另一个重要观察是，harmfulness flip 与 refusal-label flip 只部分重叠，说明模型内部的捷径依赖并不等同于正常拒答识别。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 20–30 分钟即可。优先看 Introduction 中的数据构造逻辑和 Figure 1 的联合分布审计，这是整篇的关键证据。然后看 The Refusal-Cue Shortcut 中不同 guard family 的 DFR 对比，重点比较 WildGuard/GuardReasoner 与 Aegis2-derived 模型的差异。最后看 sparse complementary masking 的干预结果，关注为什么少量 heads/neurons 的抑制能跨 cue 位置泛化。若关心安全数据建设，可以细看 refusal cue formulation、位置消融、refusal prediction overlap 这几组实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The work studies a shortcut in safety guard models: adding a refusal-like phrase to an otherwise harmful response can cause the guard to classify the response as safe. The issue is not whether guards can detect refusals, but whether they overuse refusal cues as evidence of harmlessness.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance to foundation-model research is data-signal quality. The paper gives a concrete failure mode in supervised safety data: if safe responses to harmful prompts are mostly generated by aligned models, and harmful responses by unaligned models, refusal language becomes highly correlated with the safe label. A classifier can then learn the cheapest cue instead of the intended harmfulness concept. The same lesson applies to SFT, preference data, reward-model data, and filtering pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis has three parts. First, the authors audit the joint distribution of refusal and harmfulness labels in WildGuardMix and GR-Train. In harmful-prompt cases, responses that are both refusals and harmful are absent in WildGuardMix and only 0.26% in GR-Train. Second, they run behavioral tests by inserting natural-language refusal cues into harmful responses while keeping the harmful content unchanged, then measure harmful-to-unharmful flips with DFR. Third, they adapt sparse complementary masking to guard-specific model-derived targets, identifying a small set of attention heads and MLP neurons associated with the shortcut. The intervention aims to suppress cue-driven misclassification without damaging ordinary refusal recognition.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers nine variants from six guard families: WildGuard-7B, GuardReasoner-1B/8B, LlamaGuard3-1B/8B, Qwen3Guard-0.6B/8B in strict mode, and two Aegis2-derived guards. WildGuard-7B and GuardReasoner, whose training datasets exhibit the audited imbalance, show the strongest vulnerability. LlamaGuard3 and Qwen3Guard also show the shortcut despite undisclosed training distributions. Aegis2-derived guards are much less affected, plausibly because Aegis2 augments safe responses to harmful prompts with more diverse refusals and redirections. Smaller variants are generally more vulnerable within the evaluated model families. More complete refusal cues produce stronger effects, and the shortcut persists across cue positions. For mitigation, excluding the already robust Aegis2-derived guards, the intervention reduces mean response-initial DFR from 16.39% to 3.44% on WildGuardTest across seven guards. The suppression learned from initial-position cues transfers to unseen cue positions and a held-out dataset. Clean harmfulness performance is mostly preserved, and refusal-recognition F1 changes by at most 2.11%. Harmfulness flips only partially overlap with refusal-label flips, which supports the claim that shortcut reliance is separable from legitimate refusal detection.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Start with the data audit and Figure 1, since the label-distribution artifact drives the rest of the paper. Then read the DFR comparisons across guard families, especially the contrast between WildGuard/GuardReasoner and Aegis2-derived models. Finish with the sparse complementary masking results and the overlap analysis between harmfulness flips and refusal-label flips. Readers working on safety data construction should also inspect the cue-position and cue-formulation ablations.

recommendation.zh: 安全Guard训练数据的标签共现偏差问题普遍存在，§3的数据集审计方法和§5的稀疏掩码干预可直接复用
recommendation.en: The label co-occurrence bias in safety guard training data is pervasive; §3's dataset audit method and §5's sparse masking intervention are directly reusable

paper.title: When Teachers Mislead: Spurious-Signal-Aware On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-Policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher capabilities by supervising student-sampled trajectories with dense token-level teacher signals. Recent selective OPD methods improve this process by prioritizing signals that are confident, informative, or learnable. However, the assumptions overlook a fundamental failure mode of language models: their token-level judgments can be driven by input-agnostic language priors, formatting conventions, or stereotyped reasoning templates rather than task-s

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理 on-policy distillation 中的一个信号质量问题：teacher 的高置信 token 监督可能来自语言先验、格式偏好或套路化推理模板，而不是来自当前输入。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在于训练信号诊断。OPD 把学生模型自己的采样轨迹交给 teacher 做 dense token-level 监督，能减轻离线蒸馏的分布错配。但 dense 信号也会放大 teacher 的偏置。已有选择性 OPD 多按置信度、熵、teacher-student divergence 或可学习性来筛 token；这些指标衡量信号强不强、难不难学，却不判断信号是否由输入支撑。SA-OPD 把“groundedness”引入蒸馏目标，对 reasoning distillation、VLM 蒸馏和 RL-style token-level supervision 都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: SA-OPD 保留 OPD 的基本流程：学生模型按当前策略生成回答，teacher 在学生访问到的前缀上给出 token 级分布，训练通常使用 reverse-KL 一类目标。论文把 token 级 teacher-student divergence 分解为两部分：随输入变化的 grounded component，以及只由生成前缀、语言先验和模板偏好解释的 prior component。实际实现不需要外部 verifier。对同一条学生生成轨迹，方法分别计算原始输入上下文下的 divergence，以及移除任务输入、只保留生成前缀的 residual no-prompt context 下的 divergence。如果移除输入后 divergence 基本不变，说明该监督更像输入无关的语言偏好。SA-OPD 只过滤同时满足两个条件的 token：输入 groundedness 低，且 teacher-student divergence 绝对值高。这样避免过度丢弃弱信号，主要移除那些梯度大但任务方向可疑的更新。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 LLM 和 VLM 蒸馏场景，包括数学推理、视觉理解和视觉推理基准。论文报告 SA-OPD 稳定优于 Vanilla OPD，也优于按置信度、信息量、可学习性等准则设计的选择性 OPD baseline。给定内容没有提供完整数字表，因此不能确认具体提升幅度。更有信息量的实验点是消融逻辑：只看 divergence 会保留很多模板信号；只看 groundedness 又可能丢掉低影响 token；二者联合筛选更贴近“去掉有害高梯度”的目标。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 到 40 分钟。先看 Method 中输入移除前后 divergence 的定义，确认 groundedness proxy 是如何计算的；再看 token filtering 条件，尤其是为什么要同时要求低 groundedness 和高 divergence。实验部分重点看与 Vanilla OPD、selective OPD baseline 的对比，以及数学和视觉任务是否呈现一致趋势。若关注 RLHF、RLAIF 或 reasoning distillation，可以进一步看该方法是否能迁移到 reward model token attribution 或 verifier 信号过滤。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a signal-quality failure mode in on-policy distillation: a teacher’s strong token-level supervision may be driven by language priors, formatting habits, or stereotyped reasoning templates rather than by the current input.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is most relevant to training-signal diagnostics. OPD trains on trajectories sampled from the current student policy and applies dense teacher supervision at student-visited states, reducing the distribution mismatch of offline distillation. The cost is that dense supervision can amplify teacher biases. Existing selective OPD methods use confidence, entropy, teacher-student divergence, or learnability to decide which signals to trust. These criteria measure strength or ease of learning, but not whether the signal is input-grounded. SA-OPD adds this missing axis, which is useful for reasoning distillation, VLM distillation, and RL-style token-level supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: SA-OPD keeps the standard OPD setup. The student samples an on-policy response, and the frozen teacher provides token-level distributions at the prefixes visited by the student. The usual objective is based on a reverse-KL-style teacher-student comparison. The paper conceptually decomposes token-level divergence into an input-grounded component and an input-agnostic prior component. The practical proxy is simple: compute the divergence under the original prompt, then compute it again under a residual no-prompt context that removes the task input while keeping the generated prefix. If the divergence barely changes after removing the input, the signal is likely explained by generic language priors or template preference. SA-OPD filters only tokens with both low input-groundedness and high absolute teacher-student divergence, targeting large but weakly justified updates rather than broadly suppressing supervision.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers both LLM and VLM distillation, including mathematical reasoning, visual understanding, and visual reasoning benchmarks. The paper reports consistent improvements over Vanilla OPD and competitive selective OPD baselines based on confidence, informativeness, or learnability. The provided text does not include the full numerical tables, so exact gains cannot be verified here. The important experimental idea is the filtering ablation: divergence alone keeps many template-driven signals, while groundedness alone may remove low-impact tokens; combining low groundedness with high divergence better matches the goal of removing harmful high-gradient supervision.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–40 minutes. Start with the method section defining divergence under the original input and under the no-prompt residual context. Then inspect the filtering rule and the rationale for combining low groundedness with high divergence. In the experiments, focus on comparisons against Vanilla OPD and selective OPD baselines, and check whether the same pattern holds in both language-only and vision-language settings. For work on RLHF, RLAIF, or reasoning distillation, the transferable idea is to test whether dense supervision is grounded in the input before trusting its gradient.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法部分：它把“teacher 高置信”拆成 grounded 与 spurious，两者对蒸馏梯度的差别可迁移到 RLVR 数据筛选。
recommendation.en: Skim the method: separating high-confidence teacher signals into grounded versus spurious ones is a useful lens for RLVR and distillation data filtering.

paper.title: Internalizing Academic Writing Workflows for Introduction Generation via Struct-Aware Policy Learning
paper.abstract: Generating a rigorous paper introduction with large language models (LLMs) remains challenging, since it requires coordinating background, gap identification, method and contribution within a coherent narrative. Existing solutions externalize this process as multi-stage prompts or agent workflows which are expensive and vulnerable to cross-stage drift. We propose StructPO, a struct-aware policy learning framework that internalizes the entire multi-stage writing workflow into a single-pass policy

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 生成论文引言时依赖多阶段提示或 Agent 工作流的问题，希望把背景、研究缺口、方法和贡献等写作流程内化到单次生成策略中。
summary.importance: 贡献是后训练和策略学习层面的任务专用方法：用显式结构控制和信用分配替代外部 workflow，重点在降低推理成本和减少跨阶段漂移。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 StructPO。方法用 stage tokens 控制不同写作阶段，引入 struct-aware credit assignment 区分局部阶段质量与全局连贯性，并用 refinement-guided optimization 把修订行为蒸馏进 first-pass policy。它不是预训练范式创新，更接近将复杂工作流压缩到单模型策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在语义对齐、结构合理性和推理效率上优于 workflow-based baselines，具备一定域外泛化；扩展到 Qwen3-32B 后，在人工评测中与 GPT-5.1 保持竞争力。摘要未给出训练集规模、奖励模型细节或具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 East China Normal University 和 Xiaohongshu Inc.；给定信息无法确认知名作者背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets LLM introduction generation, aiming to internalize a multi-stage academic writing workflow into a single-pass policy.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a task-specific post-training and policy-learning method: explicit structure control and credit assignment replace external workflows, mainly reducing inference cost and cross-stage drift.
summary_en.technical_approach: StructPO uses stage tokens to control writing stages, struct-aware credit assignment to separate local stage quality from global coherence, and refinement-guided optimization to distill revision behavior into the first-pass policy. It is closer to workflow compression through post-training than to a new pretraining paradigm.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports gains over workflow-based baselines in semantic alignment, structural rationality, and inference efficiency, with out-of-domain generalization. At Qwen3-32B scale, it is claimed to be competitive with GPT-5.1 in human evaluation, but the provided abstract lacks training-set size, reward details, and exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with East China Normal University and Xiaohongshu Inc.; no widely recognized author background can be confirmed from the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 可看作“把 Agent workflow 蒸馏进策略”的写作版实验；只读方法和消融，别把结论外推到通用推理。
recommendation.en: A writing-domain instance of distilling an agentic workflow into a policy; read the method and ablations, but do not extrapolate the result to general reasoning.

paper.title: LatentGuard: Efficient and Inspectable Latent Reasoning for LLM Safeguards
paper.abstract: Reasoning-based guard models improve LLM safeguards, but decoding explicit rationales for every interaction makes them costly to deploy. Although latent-reasoning methods reduce token generation by moving reasoning into continuous states, they remain underexplored for safety moderation and lack an inspection interface for deployment. In this paper, we propose LatentGuard, an efficient and inspectable safeguard framework that brings continuous latent reasoning to guard models. LatentGuard uses a

summary.core_problem: 降低 reasoning-based guard model 在每次安全审核时显式生成 rationale 的推理成本，同时保留可审计性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是安全后训练与 latent reasoning 方法改造。它把连续潜变量推理用于 guard model，目标是在部署路径上省掉 rationale decoding，但仍能按需生成审计产物。
summary.technical_approach: LatentGuard 使用分阶段课程训练，把任务相关的文本 rationale 逐步压缩到连续 latent state 中，最终直接从连续表示预测安全判决。为了可检查性，模型保留一个隔离的辅助 decoder，只在审计需要时生成短审计文本，不进入常规推理关键路径。
summary.experiments: 实验以 8B guard model 为主要规模。LatentGuard-8B 相比 GuardReasoner-8B 将 mean weighted F1 从 83.95 提升到 84.91，同时降低关键路径上的 reasoning 成本；摘要未给出完整数据集、延迟或吞吐细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reduces the cost of reasoning-based guard models by avoiding explicit rationale decoding on every moderation request while preserving auditability.
summary_en.importance: The contribution lies in safety post-training and latent reasoning. It applies continuous latent reasoning to guard models so that deployment-time moderation can skip rationale generation, with an optional audit interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: LatentGuard uses a staged curriculum to compress task-aligned textual rationales into compact continuous latent states. The safety verdict is predicted directly from these states, while an isolated auxiliary decoder can generate compact audit artifacts only when inspection is needed.
summary_en.experiments: The main reported model scale is 8B. LatentGuard-8B improves mean weighted F1 from 83.95 to 84.91 over GuardReasoner-8B and reduces critical-path reasoning cost; the abstract does not provide full dataset, latency, or throughput details.

recommendation.zh: latent reasoning 的工程化例子；只看 curriculum 压缩做法，安全任务本身对 pretrain 反馈有限。
recommendation.en: A useful engineering case for latent reasoning; read the curriculum compression idea, not the safety benchmark details.

paper.title: Trajectory-Guided Forget-Recover Network for Continual LLM Unlearning
paper.abstract: Machine unlearning aims to eliminate the influence of sensitive data on a model. In the real world, unlearning requests arrive continually, which gives rise to two challenges. First, an unlearning intervention may redistribute target-related computation across remaining pathways, allowing previously forgotten knowledge to re-emerge. Second, repeated unlearning interventions may progressively reduce the model capacity needed to preserve retained utility. To address these challenges, we propose th

summary.core_problem: 解决持续LLM遗忘场景下，遗忘操作导致已消去知识复现、多次遗忘逐步损害模型保留效用的问题
summary.importance: 提出持续LLM遗忘的新方法，属于方法创新，通过通道级轨迹追踪平衡遗忘效果与模型能力保留
summary.technical_approach: 提出TFR-Net，追踪跨请求的通道级风险，分离持续目标相关通道与瞬态热点，仅抑制持续通道；同时再激活对保留效用贡献高、遗忘风险低的休眠通道恢复容量，仅当效用退化在容忍范围内时接受恢复
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体实验设置、模型规模与效果对比数据

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses two key challenges in continual LLM unlearning: re-emergence of previously forgotten knowledge after interventions, and progressive degradation of retained utility across repeated unlearning requests
summary_en.importance: Proposes a novel continual unlearning method, contributing a channel-level trajectory tracking framework to balance unlearning efficacy and model capability preservation
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces TFR-Net, which tracks channel-level risk across unlearning requests, separates persistent target-related channels from transient hotspots to suppress only persistent ones, and reactivates dormant channels with high retained utility contribution and low forget risk to recover capacity, with recovery accepted only if utility degradation stays within predefined tolerance
summary_en.experiments: No specific experimental setup, model scale, or performance comparison data is provided in the abstract

recommendation.zh: 持续unlearning的通道级方法，对预训练数据隐私防护的后处理方案有参考，看摘要即可
recommendation.en: Channel-level continual unlearning approach, useful as reference for post-hoc privacy protection of pretrained models; abstract suffices

paper.title: Noise-Aware Shrinkage for Differentially Private Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Differentially private zeroth-order optimization (DP-ZO) enables memory-efficient private fine-tuning of large language models using only forward evaluations. Existing aggregation-based DP-ZO methods reconstruct model updates at a fixed scale, ignoring that the strength of useful signals varies throughout training. Consequently, noise-dominated updates may receive excessive weight and degrade model utility. To address this issue, we propose SAGE, a noise-aware shrinkage method that adaptively at

summary.core_problem: 解决差分隐私 zeroth-order LLM 微调中，固定尺度聚合会把噪声主导的更新赋予过大权重、损害模型效果的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是隐私约束下的 LLM 后训练优化改进。它不改变预训练范式，但对内存受限、隐私受限的微调场景有方法参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SAGE，一种 noise-aware shrinkage 方法。它从观测二阶矩中减去已知 Gaussian noise variance 来估计真实信号能量，用时间跟踪稳定估计，再与 warm-up reference 的信噪水平比较，得到有界 shrinkage factor。该方法是纯 post-processing，不额外消耗 privacy budget，不增加 model queries，只引入常数级状态。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 LLM 参数规模、任务、数据集、baseline 和提升数字。实验主张是 SAGE 相比已有 aggregation-based DP-ZO 方法能改善 utility，同时保持相同隐私预算和查询开销。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles differentially private zeroth-order LLM fine-tuning, where fixed-scale aggregation can overweight noise-dominated updates and hurt utility.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training optimization contribution under privacy and memory constraints. It does not change pretraining methodology, but it is relevant to private and resource-constrained LLM adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: SAGE is a noise-aware shrinkage method. It estimates underlying signal energy by subtracting the known Gaussian noise variance from the observed second moment, stabilizes the estimate with temporal tracking, and compares the current signal-to-noise level with a warm-up reference to derive a bounded shrinkage factor. It is pure post-processing, requiring no extra privacy budget, no additional model queries, and only constant extra state.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The claimed result is improved utility over aggregation-based DP-ZO methods at the same privacy and query cost.

recommendation.zh: 看作 DP-ZO 微调的小修正即可；若内部有隐私微调需求，读 shrinkage 公式，不必追实验细节。
recommendation.en: Treat this as a small DP-ZO fine-tuning fix; if private tuning matters internally, read the shrinkage rule and skip most experiment detail.

paper.title: LiveMem: Maintaining Memory State Continuity in Long-Running LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Long-running assistants and agents consume interaction streams that eventually outgrow the context. Existing context retention, summarization, and retrieval preserve access to selected history, but do not provide a persistent state over the full lifecycle when working context changes. We formulate this missing inference capability as \emph{state continuity under context turnover}: carrying computation forward through a fixed-capacity memory state whose lifetime is independent of the active conte

summary.core_problem: 长时运行的LLM助手与Agent的交互历史会持续增长，最终超出上下文窗口容量，必须滚动更替工作上下文。现有RAG、摘要、检索类方案只能提供按需触发的历史内容存取能力，无法维护一个跨工作上下文生命周期、固定容量、在线更新的内部隐状态，导致上下文换出后的计算连续性断裂。
summary.importance: 这篇明确区分了长程交互下两类正交的记忆功能：一类是RAG类系统实现的“外部历史按需存取”，另一类是循环隐状态实现的“跨上下文计算连续性”，厘清了之前记忆相关研究中概念混用的问题。提出的防记忆旁路的后训练设计对长交互Agent的工程实现有参考价值，但整体方案是在预训练完成的注意力LLM上挂载插件式记忆分支，没有修改预训练目标或主干架构，对基座预训练范式的直接影响有限。
summary.technical_approach: 架构上，在预训练全注意力Decoder旁并行挂载基于Gated DeltaNet-2的循环记忆分支，全程维护一个固定尺寸的记忆状态张量；主注意力路径仅保留固定长度的滑动KV窗口，当窗口触达容量上限时，最早的KV块直接从注意力路径卸载，相关信息通过记忆分支的写操作整合进持久状态。训练上，设计专门的记忆导向后训练任务，训练过程中强制触发上下文轮换，确保历史内容移出注意力窗口后模型只能通过记忆状态获取信息，避免模型因训练时历史全程可见而绕过记忆分支。推理阶段，记忆状态伴随整个交互生命周期持续更新，与工作上下文的滚动更替完全解耦。
summary.experiments: 在LongMemEval等长程记忆基准上，当支撑答案的证据被完全移出当前活跃上下文窗口后，LiveMem仍能保持显著高于滑动窗口基线的准确率，且准确率随证据与当前窗口的距离增加平滑下降，无断崖式性能跌落。整体长任务性能达到同类记忆增强方案的上游水平，但在需要精确逐字回溯的任务上表现弱于显式检索方案，短上下文任务性能与原基础模型持平，未因新增记忆分支带来精度损失。消融观察验证了设计前提：如果后训练阶段不做强制上下文轮换，模型会完全忽略记忆分支，性能与普通滑动窗口注意力无显著差异。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注问题定义部分对两类记忆功能的区分、后训练中防止记忆旁路的设计逻辑、上下文轮换的消融结论，Gated DeltaNet-2的具体实现是已有工作，无需深究。预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-running LLM assistants and agents accumulate interaction history that eventually outgrows fixed context window limits, requiring rolling turnover of working context. Existing RAG, summarization, and retrieval pipelines provide on-demand access to stored historical content, but fail to maintain a fixed-capacity, online-updated internal latent state that persists across working context swaps, breaking computational continuity when old context is evicted.
summary_en.importance: This work draws a clear distinction between two orthogonal memory functions in long-running interaction: on-demand historical access implemented by RAG-style systems, and cross-context computational continuity implemented by recurrent latent states, resolving conceptual ambiguity in prior memory research. Its proposed post-training protocol to prevent memory bypass offers practical engineering reference for long-horizon agent systems. However, the approach is a plug-in branch added to fully pretrained attention LLMs, with no modification to pretraining objectives or backbone architecture, so its direct impact on foundation model pretraining paradigms is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: Architecturally, LiveMem adds a parallel recurrent memory branch built on Gated DeltaNet-2 alongside a pretrained full-attention decoder, maintaining a fixed-size persistent memory state across the entire interaction lifecycle. The main attention path operates on a bounded sliding KV window; when the window reaches capacity, the oldest KV chunks are directly evicted from the attention path, and relevant information is integrated into the persistent state via write operations in the memory branch. For training, a dedicated memory-oriented post-training task enforces forced context turnover, ensuring the model can only retrieve evicted historical information through the memory state, rather than learning to bypass the memory branch when full history remains visible during training. At inference, the memory state is updated continuously across the full lifecycle, fully decoupled from working context turnover.
summary_en.experiments: On LongMemEval and related long-range memory benchmarks, LiveMem retains significantly higher accuracy than sliding-window baselines even when supporting evidence is fully evicted from the active context window, with performance degrading smoothly as the distance between evidence and current window increases, rather than dropping off sharply. Overall long-task performance is competitive with top augmented memory systems, though the method underperforms explicit retrieval on tasks requiring exact verbatim recall. Short-context performance matches the base model exactly, with no accuracy penalty from the added memory branch. Ablations confirm the core design premise: without forced context turnover in post-training, the model learns to ignore the memory branch entirely, performing on par with vanilla sliding-window attention.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for core framing and design logic. Prioritize the problem definition distinguishing the two memory functions, the post-training design that prevents memory bypass, and the context turnover ablation results. Implementation details of Gated DeltaNet-2 are borrowed from prior work and do not require close reading. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把记忆状态从 KV 里解耦出来的思路值得看，但摘要缺实验细节，先读方法图和 post-training 那一节，结论当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Decoupling memory state from the KV cache is worth a look, but the abstract lacks experimental detail; read the method figure and post-training section, treat claims as weak signal.

paper.title: PixVL: Self-Supervised Training of Pixel-Level MLLMs via a Unified Mask--Text Consistency Cycle
paper.abstract: Recent studies develop pixel-level multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that support both Region Segmentation and Region Understanding, extending multimodal interaction from whole images to specific objects and regions. However, these methods face two fundamental challenges. First, the scarcity of high-quality mask--text pairs leaves abundant mask annotations without corresponding language supervision. Second, discrepancies in supervision formats and learning-signal densities induce optimiza

summary.core_problem: 像素级多模态大模型在区域分割与区域理解上缺少高质量mask-text对，且两种任务的监督形式和信号密度不同导致优化干扰。
summary.importance: 提出自监督后训练框架，用统一的mask-text一致性循环利用无标注mask数据；对多模态后训练有一定参考价值，但非基座预训练范式工作。
summary.technical_approach: PixVL构造Mask-Text Consistency Cycle，让模型生成并自验证区域描述；作者指出仅依赖几何重构的循环不可靠，因为重分割IoU不能忠实反映语义质量。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、训练数据规模或具体指标；仅说明在区域分割和区域理解任务上验证。

summary_en.core_problem: Pixel-level MLLMs lack high-quality mask-text pairs, and region segmentation and region understanding interfere due to different supervision formats and learning-signal densities.
summary_en.importance: A self-supervised post-training framework that uses a unified mask-text consistency cycle to learn from unlabeled masks; relevant to multimodal post-training but not a foundation-model pretraining advance.
summary_en.technical_approach: PixVL introduces a Mask-Text Consistency Cycle for generating and self-verifying region descriptions. It argues that geometry-only cycles are unreliable because re-segmentation IoU does not reflect semantic quality.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training data scale, or quantitative results; it only states validation on region segmentation and region understanding tasks.

recommendation.zh: 像素级MLLM后训练小改进，唯一可迁移点是IoU不能当语义验证信号；看cycle设计即可，与基座预训练关系弱。
recommendation.en: A modest pixel-level MLLM post-training paper; the transferable note is that IoU is not a semantic verifier. Skim the cycle design only.

paper.title: Beyond Token-Level Cross-Entropy: Fréchet Distributional Post-Training for Autoregressive Image Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive image generators are commonly pretrained with token-level cross-entropy under teacher forcing, yet evaluated by the distributional quality of decoded images. This creates an objective mismatch, because categorical errors have unequal image-level consequences, and a context mismatch, because inference conditions on model-generated histories. We introduce FD-loss post-training, which adapts a pretrained discrete generator using representation-space Fréchet distance as the sole objec

summary.core_problem: 离散自回归图像生成器通常用 teacher forcing 下的 token-level cross-entropy 训练，但实际评估看的是解码图像分布质量；这会同时带来 token 错误代价不等和训练/推理上下文不一致两个问题。
summary.importance: 这项工作对基座研究的启发在于：它把“预训练目标”和“评估分布”之间的错配讲得比较清楚，并给出一种后训练式修正。虽然任务是图像 AR 生成，不是文本 LLM，但问题结构和语言模型中的 exposure bias、sequence-level objective、RL/偏好优化有相似性。它也说明，在离散 tokenizer + AR Transformer 的生成系统里，冻结 tokenizer 和 decoder，仅用分布级信号继续优化生成器，可能是一条可控的后训练路径。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 FD-loss post-training。核心做法是不用 cross-entropy，而用冻结特征空间中的 Fréchet Distance 作为唯一目标，使生成图像分布靠近真实图像分布。难点是离散 token 的 argmax 选择不可导，并且 teacher-forced context 不代表推理时的上下文。为此作者设计 dual-pass：第一遍在 no-gradient 下按模型原生推理配置 rollout，得到由当前模型自己生成的 detached contexts；第二遍在这些上下文上 replay，并用 probability-level straight-through estimator。前向仍然保留 hard argmax token，保证训练路径贴近真实推理；反向通过 temperature-scaled probabilities 传梯度。tokenizer、decoder、feature extractor 都冻结，只更新 AR 生成器参数。相比直接在 teacher-forced context 上加 FD loss，这个设计更重视 inference-time rollout distribution。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 LlamaGen、TiTok、VAR、GigaTok，在 class-conditional ImageNet 256×256 上做后训练。八个配置中，FID 平均降低 41.4%，FD_r6 平均降低 52.0%；最佳 FID 从 2.42 降到 1.43，且不改模型参数量和推理步数。消融显示 detached rollout context replay 比 teacher-forced 或较弱的上下文替代更有效。敏感性分析讨论了 replay temperature 和 feature-space composition，说明 FD 目标的稳定性依赖特征矩估计、温度和 replay 方式的配合。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction 和 Method 中 dual-pass replay、probability-level STE、EMA FD objective 三部分，预计 20 到 30 分钟。Table 2 和主结果表值得看，用来判断 teacher-forced FD loss 为什么不够。对做离散视觉 tokenizer、AR 图像生成、统一多模态 LM 的读者，可以重点关注训练信号如何穿过 frozen codebook/decoder 回到 AR model，以及 rollout context 是否会引入高方差或模式收缩。

summary_en.core_problem: Discrete autoregressive image generators are trained with token-level cross-entropy under teacher forcing, while they are evaluated by the distributional quality of decoded images. This creates both an objective mismatch and a context mismatch.
summary_en.importance: The useful lesson for foundation-model training is the treatment of mismatch between pretraining loss and generation-time distribution. Although the experiments target image generation rather than text LMs, the setup is close to sequence-level post-training for discrete generative models: a frozen tokenizer and decoder, an AR Transformer, and a distribution-level loss applied after likelihood pretraining. It is a relevant reference point for thinking about exposure bias, rollout-based training, and non-token-level objectives in tokenized multimodal generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method post-trains a pretrained discrete AR generator using only a Fréchet Distance loss in a frozen representation space. The key design is a dual-pass procedure. The first pass performs gradient-free generation under the model’s native inference configuration and records detached rollout contexts. The second pass replays generation on these self-generated contexts and applies a probability-level straight-through estimator: the forward pass keeps hard argmax decoding, while the backward pass propagates gradients through temperature-scaled probabilities. The tokenizer, decoder, and feature extractors are frozen; only the AR generator is updated. This differs from simply adding an image-level loss under teacher forcing, because the optimization is tied to contexts sampled from the model’s own inference policy.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on class-conditional ImageNet 256×256 with LlamaGen, TiTok, VAR, and GigaTok. Across eight configurations, post-training reduces FID by 41.4% on average and FD_r6 by 52.0% on average. The best reported FID improves from 2.42 to 1.43 without changing parameter count or inference steps. Ablations support detached rollout-context replay over teacher-forced variants, and sensitivity studies analyze replay temperature and feature-space composition.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction and the Method sections on dual-pass replay, probability-level STE, and EMA-based FD loss. Table 2 and the main result tables are the most useful parts for understanding why teacher-forced distribution matching is insufficient. Estimated reading time is 20–30 minutes. Readers working on discrete multimodal token generation should pay attention to how gradients pass through a frozen codebook and decoder, and to the stability tradeoffs introduced by rollout-based contexts.

recommendation.zh: 把图像级分布损失通过 STE 接到离散 AR rollout 上的思路可借鉴到 AR 视觉/统一多模态后训练；先看 dual-pass 和 STE 设计，实验数字不全，当弱信号。
recommendation.en: The dual-pass + probabilistic-STE trick for backproping an image-level distributional loss into discrete AR rollouts is worth borrowing for AR vision/unified multimodal post-training; treat as a weak signal since quantitative results are missing.

paper.title: Distill Where You Fail: Recovering Learning Signals of Negative RL-Groups from Adaptive Teacher Guidance
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard paradigm for post-training large language models (LLMs). While Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely adopted, it suffers from sparse reward signals and loses gradients entirely when all responses within a group receive identical rewards. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a natural remedy by providing dense, token-level supervision from a teacher model. However, naively combining GRPO with OPD leads to deg

summary.core_problem: RSTG 解决的是 RLVR 中 GRPO 学习信号稀疏的问题，尤其是 group 内样本全错时的 negative zero-variance prompts。GRPO 在这种情况下没有相对优势，梯度会消失。直接加入 on-policy distillation 虽然能提供 token-level dense signal，但会带来 teacher-boundedness、样本不适配、token advantage 大量为负和局部前缀误差传播等问题，实际效果可能差于标准 GRPO。
summary.importance: 这项工作对 post-train 与 pretrain 接口有明确参考价值。它说明 dense teacher signal 不能无差别加入 RL，而应该只在 RL 无法给出有效梯度的位置补信号。这个思想对 RL 数据效率、verifier-based training、reasoning model 的失败样本挖掘都有启发。贡献量级属于方法级改进，不是新训练范式，但抓住了 GRPO+distillation 中一个常见且实际的问题：什么时候应该蒸馏，蒸馏哪些 token，以及如何避免过快贴近 teacher。
summary.technical_approach: RSTG 先把 GRPO、OPD 和 SFT 放到统一 policy-gradient 视角下分析。GRPO 用 group reward 的均值和方差估计 advantage；当组内 reward 相同，advantage 退化。OPD 在学生自己采样的轨迹上最小化 student 到 teacher 的 reverse KL，可写成 token-level advantage，其中 advantage 与 teacher-student log-prob gap 相关。问题是多数学生生成 token 在 teacher 下概率低，负 advantage 过多，会压制探索。RSTG 的处理有三部分。第一，sample selection：只在 student 失败但 teacher 能成功的样本上施加 OPD，重点覆盖 negative zero-variance prompts，并按 teacher mastery 加权。文中指出，仅使用全量数据的 3.63% 做这类 OPD，效果反而优于对所有样本蒸馏。第二，token selection：只更新学生高熵 token 或 teacher-student divergence 较大的 token，减少噪声，也减缓过早收敛到 teacher。第三，auxiliary SFT：在 negative zero-variance prompts 上使用 teacher 预生成的正确轨迹做 SFT，补充全局正向轨迹信号，缓解 OPD 只沿学生错误前缀给局部梯度的问题。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen2.5 和 Qwen3 系列，在数学和代码 benchmark 上验证。相对于 naive GRPO+OPD，RSTG 在数学任务上提升 4.02%，在代码任务上提升 3.05%。文中还报告了几个训练动态层面的现象：选择性 OPD 能缓解 advantage asymmetry；token selection 会减缓向 teacher 的过快收敛；辅助 SFT 可以减少负样本组完全无梯度的问题；RSTG 还避免了 response length 的突然膨胀。由于给出的全文片段未包含完整实验表格，无法确认具体模型尺寸、每个 benchmark 的绝对分数和训练 token 数。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 naive GRPO+OPD 失败原因的拆解，再看 Preliminaries 中把 OPD 写成 policy-gradient advantage 的推导，这部分决定了后续方法为什么要做 sample/token selection。方法部分重点看三件事：negative zero-variance prompts 的筛选规则、teacher mastery weighting、token-level mask 的定义。实验部分优先看 Qwen2.5/Qwen3 上的主结果、OPD 数据比例 3.63% 的消融、response length 曲线和 advantage distribution。若在做 RLVR recipe，这项工作最值得复用的是“只在 RL 失效处补 teacher signal”的训练调度，而不是简单叠加蒸馏 loss。

summary_en.core_problem: RSTG addresses the loss of learning signal in RLVR with GRPO, especially on negative zero-variance prompts where every sampled response in the group is wrong. In that case, group-relative advantages vanish. On-policy distillation can provide dense token-level supervision from a teacher, but a naive GRPO+OPD objective often performs worse because distillation is not useful for every sample, it can make the student converge too quickly to the teacher, and its token-level advantages are often negative on student-generated trajectories.
summary_en.importance: The work is useful for the interface between RL post-training and pretraining-style learning signals. It argues that dense teacher supervision should not be applied uniformly; it should be used where RL has no useful gradient. This is relevant to RL data efficiency, verifier-based reasoning training, and failure-driven data construction. The contribution is a targeted recipe rather than a new training paradigm, but it addresses a practical failure mode in GRPO plus distillation: when to distill, which tokens to update, and how to avoid collapsing exploration toward the teacher too early.
summary_en.technical_approach: RSTG first analyzes GRPO, OPD, and SFT under a shared policy-gradient view. GRPO estimates advantages from group rewards; when all rewards in a group are identical, the advantage disappears. OPD minimizes reverse KL from the student to the teacher on student-generated trajectories and can be written as a token-level advantage based on the teacher-student log-probability gap. This dense signal is noisy and asymmetric because many student tokens have low teacher probability, producing mostly negative advantages. RSTG uses three controls. First, sample selection applies OPD only when the student fails and the teacher succeeds, focusing on negative zero-variance prompts and weighting the signal by teacher mastery. The paper reports that using only 3.63% of the full data in this way outperforms standard OPD over all samples. Second, token selection restricts updates to high-entropy student tokens or tokens with large teacher-student divergence, reducing noisy gradients and slowing premature teacher imitation. Third, auxiliary SFT uses teacher-generated correct trajectories on negative zero-variance prompts, adding a global positive trajectory signal that OPD lacks when it conditions on erroneous student prefixes.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 model families on mathematical and code benchmarks. Compared with naive GRPO+OPD, RSTG improves math performance by 4.02% and code performance by 3.05%. The reported training dynamics support the method design: selective OPD mitigates advantage asymmetry, token selection slows convergence toward the teacher, auxiliary SFT restores positive learning signals for all-failed groups, and the full recipe avoids abrupt response-length inflation. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, so exact model sizes, per-benchmark absolute scores, and training-token counts cannot be verified here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–30 minutes. Start with the introduction, especially the three failure modes of naive GRPO+OPD. Then read the preliminaries where OPD is rewritten as a policy-gradient objective; this derivation explains why sample and token selection are needed. In the method section, focus on the definition of negative zero-variance prompts, teacher mastery weighting, and the token-level update mask. In the experiments, prioritize the Qwen2.5/Qwen3 main results, the 3.63% data-ratio ablation, response-length curves, and advantage-distribution analysis. For RLVR recipe design, the reusable idea is to inject teacher signals only where RL has failed to produce gradients, rather than simply adding a distillation loss everywhere.

recommendation.zh: 不是范式突破，但它把“RL 缺梯度时该不该蒸馏、蒸馏到哪一层粒度”讲得比多数 RLVR 论文更干净；重点看失败分析和 selective guidance 设计。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm shift, but it is cleaner than most RLVR papers on when distillation should rescue missing RL gradients; read the failure analysis and the selective-guidance design.

paper.title: A False Average: Chain-of-Thought Monitors Collapse Where They Are the Only Defense
