summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Start with the introduction and the failure example to understand the nearsightedness problem in VLM agents. Then read the POMDP setup and the derivation of token-wise and turn-wise surrogates, with attention to the claim that the main difference is advantage estimation. In the method section, focus on the hybrid advantage formula, the unified critic target, and the discount-factor choice. In the experiments, read the main result table, the ablations on hybrid advantage and mixed return, and any stability curves. For reuse, the most important parts are the derivation and the ablation evidence.

recommendation.zh: 读理论推导和 ablation 即可；若 unified critic 真稳，会影响多轮 RLVR 的 credit assignment 设计。
recommendation.en: Read the derivation and ablations; if the unified critic is actually stable, it is a useful signal for multi-turn RLVR credit assignment.

paper.title: Learning When to Reason for Text-to-SQL via SFT and DPO
paper.abstract: Recent Text-to-SQL methods rely heavily on reasoning-centric paradigms such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT), achieving substantial gains on complex benchmarks at the cost of high inference-time overhead. However, a large fraction of real-world queries are simple lookups or aggregations that can be resolved without multi-step deduction, making forced reasoning wasteful. Thus, we propose AutoThinkSQL, a framework that integrates an auto-thinking mechanism into both Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Direc

summary.core_problem: 解决 Text-to-SQL 中强制 CoT 推理带来的 token 和延迟浪费，让模型学会在简单问题上跳过推理、复杂问题上调用深度推理。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向推理计算分配的后训练方法，使用 SFT 和 DPO 学习“何时推理”。任务是 Text-to-SQL，但结论触及更一般的 test-time reasoning budget 控制问题。
summary.technical_approach: AutoThinkSQL 在 SFT 和 DPO 中引入 auto-thinking 机制，使模型根据查询复杂度动态选择直接生成 SQL 或生成深度 CoT。方法不是改模型架构，而是通过监督和偏好优化塑造输出策略，目标是在保持或提升准确率的同时减少冗余 reasoning tokens。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B，在 Spider 和 BIRD 上相对最强对应 baseline 取得一致提升；相比只使用 CoT，平均输出 token 分别减少 24.6% 和 18.3%，平均延迟分别降低 17.1% 和 11.5%。摘要未给出训练数据规模和完整 baseline 列表。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Seoul National University、Samsung Electronics AI Center 及 SNU 相关研究中心；团队背景覆盖数据库、AI 与机器学习。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the waste caused by forcing Chain-of-Thought reasoning for all Text-to-SQL queries, aiming to reason only when the query complexity warrants it.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training method for inference-compute allocation: learning when to invoke reasoning through SFT and DPO. Although the task is Text-to-SQL, the setup is relevant to broader control of test-time reasoning budgets.
summary_en.technical_approach: AutoThinkSQL introduces an auto-thinking mechanism in both supervised fine-tuning and Direct Preference Optimization. The model learns to either directly generate SQL for simple queries or produce deeper CoT for complex ones. The method shapes generation policy rather than changing the architecture.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B, the method improves over the strongest corresponding baseline on Spider and BIRD while reducing average output tokens by 24.6% and 18.3%, and average latency by 17.1% and 11.5% compared with CoT-only generation. The abstract does not disclose training-data scale or the full baseline set.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Seoul National University, Samsung Electronics AI Center, and affiliated SNU research centers, with work spanning databases, AI, and machine learning.

recommendation.zh: Text-to-SQL 设定偏窄，但“训练模型少想一点”值得看数字；只读方法和 token/latency 表。
recommendation.en: The Text-to-SQL setup is narrow, but the learned 'think less' policy is worth checking; read the method and token/latency tables only.

institutions: AIIS, ASRI, INMC, ISRC, and IPAI, Seoul National University

paper.title: CRAFT: Learn the Schema, Execute the Plan
paper.abstract: Enterprise coding agents translate natural-language analytical requests into executable code over proprietary APIs, schemas, and metric definitions. Yet the prevailing deployment pattern injecting exhaustive schema and tool documentation into each prompt increases inference overhead, complicates schema evolution, and undermines reliability in multi-turn analysis. We investigate whether stable schema knowledge and tool-use behavior can instead be acquired through post-training while preserving th

summary.core_problem: 企业级编码Agent将全量schema与工具文档注入每次prompt，导致推理开销高、schema演进困难、多轮分析可靠性差，需要将schema知识内化到模型参数中。
summary.importance: 工程与方法结合的创新：提出面向生产环境schema-grounded编码Agent的两阶段后训练流程，解决prompt注入schema的部署痛点。
summary.technical_approach: 提出CRAFT两阶段后训练recipe：第一阶段用剥离schema的PLAN-SFT从验证轨迹中学习领域结构化计划与可执行行为，避免prompt时注入全量schema；第二阶段用执行塑形RL对齐工具选择、代码质量、计划-代码一致性与错误恢复能力。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整披露实验设置，未给出模型规模、训练轨迹数量、基线系统与具体效果指标。
summary.authors_note: 亚马逊广告基础团队与AWS Agentic AI团队联合产出，属于生产导向的企业级Agent训练方案。

summary_en.core_problem: Enterprise coding agents inject full schema and tool documentation into every prompt, causing high inference overhead, difficult schema evolution and poor multi-turn reliability; schema knowledge needs to be internalized into model parameters.
summary_en.importance: Combined engineering and methodological innovation: proposes a two-stage post-training recipe for production-grade schema-grounded coding agents, addressing deployment pain points of prompt-time schema injection.
summary_en.technical_approach: Presents CRAFT, a two-stage post-training pipeline: Stage 1 performs schema-stripped PLAN-SFT to learn domain-structured plans and executable behaviors from validated trajectories without full prompt-time schema injection; Stage 2 uses execution-shaped RL to align tool selection, code quality, plan-code consistency and error recovery.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental details including model scale, number of training trajectories, baseline systems and quantitative metrics are not disclosed in the available abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Joint work from Amazon Advertising Foundations and AWS Agentic AI teams, representing a production-oriented enterprise agent training solution.

recommendation.zh: 典型企业场景下的Agent后训练工程方案，核心价值是schema内化替代prompt注入的思路，作为领域特定Agent训练的工程参考，无通用预训练insight。
recommendation.en: A typical enterprise-oriented agent post-training engineering solution; its core value is the idea of internalizing schemas instead of prompt injection, useful as engineering reference but without general pretraining insights.

paper.title: Co-Harness: Co-Evolving Harnesses and Model Weights for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Post-training agents for automated AI research requires optimizing not only model parameters, but also the runtime harness that shapes how research trajectories are generated, evaluated, and learned from. Existing pipelines typically train models under a fixed harness, including prompts, tools, skills, middleware, and memory, while leaving the data-generating process outside the optimization objective. This creates a mismatch between model updates and the static scaffolding that determines traje

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是 agent 后训练中的一个耦合问题：模型权重在更新，但产生训练轨迹的 harness，也就是 prompt、工具、技能、中间件、记忆和运行逻辑，通常是固定的。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接性不强，但对 agent post-training 和数据生成闭环有启发。它把 harness 看作训练数据分布的一部分，而不是只在推理时手工调参的外壳。这个视角对 RL、SFT、自动化数据生成都重要：如果运行环境存在工具 schema 错误、重试逻辑缺失、上下文管理不当，模型训练到的轨迹会带有系统性噪声；先修复 harness，再用更干净的轨迹训练模型，可能比单纯增加训练步数更有效。
summary.technical_approach: Co-Harness 把 agent 系统写成模型参数 θ 和 harness 配置 φ 的联合优化问题。harness 被定义为五元组：prompt/instruction 模板 P、工具定义和接口 schema T、可复用技能 S、中间件 Mid、长期记忆策略 M。直接联合优化代价太高，因为每次 harness 变化都需要完整 rollout，奖励又稀疏，所以论文采用交替优化。每一轮先固定模型，收集任务轨迹；把失败轨迹交给 LLM-based HarnessCritic；HarnessCritic 将失败归因到结构化 harness 原因，例如 prompt 歧义、工具 schema 错误、缺少技能、中间件不匹配；然后提出局部 diff。diff 只有在验证 rollout 中改善目标失败模式且不回退 held-out 行为时才被接受。随后用改进后的 harness 生成更高质量轨迹，并用这些轨迹微调下一轮模型。
summary.experiments: 实验主要在工具增强的数学推理设置中进行，模型包括 Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-32B，评测集包括 AIME24、AIME25、HMMT25。两轮 Co-Harness 后，平均准确率提升 +20.4 个百分点；最大提升出现在 Qwen3-32B 的 HMMT25 上，为 +27.2 个百分点。论文还报告了一个 200 小时以上的 autonomous run，系统自动修复运行崩溃、改善推理效率，并发现 ensemble 策略。需要注意，这些结果主要说明 harness 和模型交替优化在特定 agent 数学任务上有效，泛化到开放式软件工程或通用科研 agent 还需要更多证据。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 fixed harness 问题的定义，以及 Method 中 harness 五元组和双循环优化流程。实验部分看两轮 co-evolution 的增益来源，尤其是失败归因、diff 验证和训练数据质量之间的关系。如果关注通用 LLM 预训练，可以跳过较细的 agent 工程实现，把重点放在“训练数据生成环境也要随模型一起优化”这个思想上。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a coupling issue in agent post-training: model weights are updated, but the harness that generates trajectories—prompts, tools, skills, middleware, memory, and runtime control—is usually fixed.
summary_en.importance: The paper is more relevant to agent post-training than to base-model pretraining, but it gives a useful lesson for training-data generation. The harness is treated as part of the data-generating process, not just inference-time scaffolding. If the harness has ambiguous prompts, broken tool schemas, missing retry logic, or poor context management, the resulting trajectories contain avoidable noise. Improving the harness before collecting new training data can change the quality of the learning signal, which is relevant to SFT, RL, and automated data pipelines for agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Co-Harness formulates agent improvement as joint optimization over model parameters θ and a harness configuration φ. The harness is represented as a five-part structure: prompt templates, tool definitions and schemas, reusable skills, middleware, and memory policy. Since direct joint optimization is expensive and rewards are sparse, the method alternates between harness optimization and model optimization. With the model fixed, the system collects rollouts and sends failed trajectories to an LLM-based HarnessCritic. The critic attributes failures to structured harness-level causes, such as prompt ambiguity, tool-schema mismatch, missing skills, or middleware problems, and proposes local diffs. A diff is accepted only if validation rollouts improve the targeted failure mode without regressing held-out behavior. The improved harness is then used to collect cleaner trajectories, which are used to fine-tune the next model.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiments focus on tool-integrated mathematical reasoning with Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B. Benchmarks include AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25. After two Co-Harness rounds, the average accuracy improves by +20.4 percentage points, with the largest reported gain of +27.2 percentage points on HMMT25 for Qwen3-32B. The paper also describes a 200+ hour autonomous run in which the system fixes crashes, improves inference efficiency, and discovers an ensemble strategy. These results support the co-evolution idea in a controlled agent setting, but they should not be read as evidence that the same loop will transfer directly to broader software-engineering or open-ended research agents.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough for most base-model researchers, around 20–30 minutes. Read the introduction for the fixed-harness problem and the method section for the five-component harness representation and alternating optimization loop. In the experiments, focus on where the gains come from: failure attribution, validated harness diffs, and improved trajectory quality. Implementation details are mainly useful for readers building agent-training systems. The transferable idea is that the environment producing training trajectories can be optimized together with the model, rather than treated as static infrastructure.

recommendation.zh: 把 agent 脚手架也放进优化闭环的思路对后训练设计有启发，重点看 §3 的 HarnessCritic 更新规则与失败模式分类。
recommendation.en: The idea of putting the agent harness into the optimization loop is informative for post-training design; focus on §3 HarnessCritic update rules and failure-mode taxonomy.

paper.title: AgentOmnia: Scaling Agentic Models for Full-Scenario Applications
paper.abstract: Large language model agents have advanced rapidly, yet progress remains fragmented across domains, capabilities, task difficulty, and interaction settings. We frame this as full-scenario agentic scaling and present AgentOmnia, a framework coordinating task-space definition, data synthesis, post-training, evaluation, and improvement across To-Consumer (ToC), To-Business (ToB), and To-Employee (ToE) applications. An extensible Domain x Capability x Atomic Difficulty taxonomy aligns these stages an

summary.core_problem: 当前LLM Agent的研究在领域、能力、任务难度、交互设置上高度碎片化，缺乏统一的全场景Agent scaling框架与配套的评测、数据合成、后训练流程。
summary.importance: 系统创新（全场景Agent开发框架AgentOmnia）+ 基准贡献（OmniaBench，含大规模有状态环境与工具）+ 方法创新（双向环境-任务合成、回滚课程后训练），为Agent的规模化开发提供了统一范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Domain×Capability×Atomic Difficulty的可扩展任务分类法，对齐任务定义、数据合成、后训练、评测环节；设计双向环境-任务合成、工具依赖/程序结构/求解器混合的数据合成pipeline；采用SFT、在线Agent RL、回滚课程的组合后训练方案；将评测失败转化为PRD反哺迭代。
summary.experiments: 构建包含5,018个有状态环境、255,375个工具、52,361个任务的OmniaBench；给定摘要未披露模型规模、基线方法及具体性能提升数据。

summary_en.core_problem: Current LLM agent research is highly fragmented across domains, capabilities, task difficulties, and interaction settings, lacking a unified full-scenario agent scaling framework and supporting evaluation, data synthesis, and post-training pipelines.
summary_en.importance: System innovation (full-scenario agent development framework AgentOmnia) plus benchmark contribution (OmniaBench with large-scale stateful environments and tools) plus methodological innovation (bidirectional environment-task synthesis, rollback curriculum post-training), providing a unified paradigm for large-scale agent development.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes an extensible Domain×Capability×Atomic Difficulty task taxonomy to align task definition, data synthesis, post-training, and evaluation; designs a bidirectional environment-task synthesis pipeline combined with tool-dependency, program-structured, and solver-based methods; adopts a combined post-training scheme of SFT, online agentic RL, and rollback curriculum; translates evaluation failures into PRDs to feed back into iteration.
summary_en.experiments: Constructs OmniaBench with 5,018 stateful environments, 255,375 tools, and 52,361 tasks; given abstract discloses no model size, baselines, or specific performance improvement data.

recommendation.zh: 全场景Agent的全流程框架，重点看§3任务分类法和§4数据合成pipeline，可借鉴到预训练多领域语料构建与后训练流程设计中。
recommendation.en: Full-pipeline framework for full-scenario agents; focus on §3 task taxonomy and §4 data synthesis pipeline, which can inform multi-domain corpus construction and post-training pipeline design.

paper.title: ACM: Agentic Context Management for Long Horizon Tasks
paper.abstract: Agentic tasks are inherently long-horizon and multi-turn, constantly accumulating context through interactions with the environment. Existing context compression methods inevitably incur information loss and are triggered by rigid heuristic rules, leaving them misaligned with the agent's evolving reasoning focus. We propose Agentic Context Management (ACM), a framework that equips agents with purpose-built context editing tools for lossless context management. Inspired by the interaction between

summary.core_problem: 长时序多轮agent的上下文持续累积，现有压缩方法存在信息损失且依赖僵化启发式规则，无法匹配动态推理焦点。
summary.importance: 提出自主式上下文管理框架，实现无损的动态上下文维护，配套后训练pipeline提升agent任务性能。
summary.technical_approach: 模拟人类长短记忆交互机制，为agent提供上下文编辑工具，由agent自主决策压缩时机，将丢弃内容卸载到外部记忆系统按需查询；构造高质量上下文管理演示数据做后训练。
summary.experiments: 在智能体搜索和代码任务上取得性能提升，分析显示该框架可有效降低上下文峰值token压力。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon multi-turn agents accumulate context continuously, while existing compression methods cause information loss and rely on rigid heuristic rules, misaligned with dynamic reasoning focus.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an agentic context management framework for lossless dynamic context maintenance, with a supporting post-training pipeline to improve agent task performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Inspired by human short-term/long-term memory interaction, equips agents with context editing tools, lets agents autonomously decide when to compress, offloads discarded content to external memory for on-demand retrieval; constructs high-quality context management demonstrations for post-training.
summary_en.experiments: Achieves performance gains on agentic search and coding tasks, analysis shows the framework effectively reduces peak token pressure in context.

recommendation.zh: agent长上下文无损管理框架，自主决策加外部记忆卸载的思路对长序列建模有弱启发，只看框架设计部分即可
recommendation.en: Lossless long-context agent management framework, the autonomous decision + external memory offloading idea is weakly inspiring for long-sequence modeling, only read the framework design section

paper.title: LeAct: Learning to Reason from Expert Actions
paper.abstract: Modern reasoning models depend on reasoning data, today sourced from human annotations or distilled from stronger LLMs. However, a rich and largely untapped source of supervision lies in expert systems (e.g., game engines, classical planners, theorem provers), which routinely produce near-optimal actions across diverse domains. But these experts are silent: they commit to an action without writing down the chain of thought (CoT) behind it. Recovering that CoT as natural-language reasoning would

summary.core_problem: 在只有“专家动作/策略”监督、没有自然语言推理过程（CoT）的情况下，如何从 action-only expert 中恢复出对学生模型“因果有用”的推理文本，并用它训练出更会泛化的 reason-then-act 模型，同时避免常见的 rationalization（看似合理但与决策无关的解释）。
summary.importance: 对预训练不是直接方法学贡献，但对 post-train/推理数据构造有明确启发：把非语言专家（CFR、规划器、控制器、RL policy）的动作当作强监督信号，通过闭环筛选生成“能提高行动概率”的 CoT，从而得到更高信噪比的推理数据。对做基础模型的人，价值在于两点：1）提供了一个不依赖更强 LLM 的 CoT 来源，潜在可扩展到大量可验证/可求解环境；2）把‘CoT 是否真的帮助决策’变成可优化的训练信号，而不是只用答案对错或表面可读性做过滤。
summary.technical_approach:
LeAct 把 CoT 视为连接状态 x 与专家动作 y* 的潜变量 z，并显式建模学生的 reason-then-act 分解：pθ(z,y|x)=pθ(z|x)pθ(y|x,z)。训练数据只有 (x, π*(·|x))。

关键做法是用“反向提案 + 重要性加权”的闭环来选 CoT：
- 反向提案 q_bwd(z|x,y)：给定 (x,y) 让模型生成多条候选 CoT（相当于从动作反推理由）。
- 用 IWAE bound（N-sample importance-weighted bound）推导训练梯度：对每个候选 z_i 计算权重 w_i = pθ(z_i,y|x) / q_bwd(z_i|x,y)，归一化后得到软权重 ~w_i，对 (z_i,y) 做加权 SFT 更新。直观上，这一步在做“E-step 式的解释选择”：保留那些能显著提高学生在给定 CoT 时预测专家动作概率 pθ(y|x,z) 的解释。
- M-step 目标是拟合专家策略 π*：当专家给出分布时可闭式期望；只给单动作时退化为 Dirac。

与直接让 LLM 写 CoT 的差别在于：LeAct 的过滤标准不是‘解释像不像’，而是‘解释是否让模型更能复现专家动作’，从而抑制 rationalization。与一些 latent-EM 自训练（如 proposal-and-score）相似，但这里 latent 被外部专家动作锚定，而不是被模型自生成文本锚定。
summary.experiments:
论文覆盖三类专家来源：
- CFR solver：在可枚举的小型不完全信息扑克（如 Leduc Hold’em）上，LeAct 训练的学生可以匹配专家 solver。
- DeepCFR policy：在更大规模的 Flop Hold’em（文中提到约 10^9 infosets）上，LeAct 优于 behavior cloning 与 expert-iteration 基线，并在未见状态上保持优势。
- 机器人模拟：在 cube-stacking 基准上，LeAct 是唯一能超过 direct imitation 的配方。

作者强调消融：把“解释选择/排序”替换为随机排序会抹掉收益，说明闭环筛选是主要增益来源。摘要未给出具体数值表格；若要抓数字，需要直接看实验章节的胜率/回报/成功率与样本量设置。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对 rationalization 的动机与闭环过滤的直觉解释，确认它解决的是‘解释是否因果有用’而不是‘解释是否好看’。
- 重点读 Method：IWAE bound 到“加权 SFT 更新”的推导是核心；理解 w_i 里 pθ(z_i,y|x) 与 q_bwd 的角色，能把算法和 EM/重要性采样联系起来。
- 再看实验的消融表：尤其是随机排序/去掉筛选后的退化幅度，用来判断方法是否稳健。

如果时间有限：只读方法图（pipeline）+ 关键消融 + 一个大规模任务（DeepCFR Flop Hold’em）的主结果即可。

summary_en.core_problem: How can we recover natural-language reasoning traces (CoT) from action-only experts (solvers/planners/policies) that never expose their internal reasoning, and train a reason-then-act model with CoTs that are causally useful for decision making rather than post-hoc rationalizations?
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-method paper, but a strong post-training/data-construction idea for reasoning: it turns non-linguistic experts into a scalable supervision source without relying on a stronger LLM to distill CoT. The key contribution is making “does this CoT actually help the model choose the expert action?” the filtering signal, instead of answer correctness or surface plausibility. This can raise the signal-to-noise ratio of synthetic reasoning data and is potentially extensible to many verifiable/simulatable domains.
summary_en.technical_approach:
LeAct treats CoT z as a latent variable connecting state x to expert action y*, with an explicit reason-then-act factorization pθ(z,y|x)=pθ(z|x)pθ(y|x,z). Training data provides (x, π*(·|x)) but no z.

Algorithmically, it uses a backward proposal and an importance-weighted objective:
- Backward proposal q_bwd(z|x,y): prompt the student to generate multiple candidate CoTs conditioned on (x,y).
- Use an N-sample IWAE bound to derive gradients that become a weighted SFT update over candidates: each candidate gets weight w_i = pθ(z_i,y|x) / q_bwd(z_i|x,y), normalized to ~w_i. Intuitively, this is an E-step-like explanation selection: keep explanations that increase the model’s own probability of reproducing the expert action pθ(y|x,z).
- The M-step target is the expert policy π*: closed-form when a full distribution is available; a point mass when only a single action is observed.

Compared to naive CoT generation (which suffers from rationalization), the load-bearing component is the closed-loop ranking by action-likelihood improvement, not linguistic plausibility.
summary_en.experiments:
They evaluate on three expert families:
- CFR solvers on small enumerable imperfect-information poker (e.g., Leduc Hold’em): the LeAct-trained student can match the expert.
- DeepCFR policy on large Flop Hold’em (~10^9 infosets mentioned): LeAct outperforms behavior cloning and expert-iteration baselines and generalizes better to unseen states.
- Simulated robotics cube-stacking: LeAct is the only recipe that improves over direct imitation.

Ablations highlight that replacing the explanation-selection step with random ranking removes the gains, indicating the selection/filtering is the primary driver. (For exact win-rate/success-rate numbers, the main experimental tables in §5–6 are the place to look.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~30–45 minutes):
- Introduction: focus on the rationalization failure mode and why action-likelihood is a better filter than plausibility.
- Method section: the IWAE-to-weighted-SFT derivation is the technical core; understand the role of q_bwd and the importance weights.
- Experiments: prioritize the ablation tables (random ranking / no filtering) and one large-scale setting (DeepCFR Flop Hold’em) to gauge robustness.

If time is tight, read the pipeline figure + the key ablations + the main results on the largest game.

recommendation.zh: 读方法部分即可；把 action likelihood 当作 CoT 过滤器的 setup 干净，适合迁移到 verifier/RL 数据合成管线。
recommendation.en: Skim the method section; using action likelihood as a CoT filter is a clean setup and maps naturally to verifier- or RL-based reasoning data pipelines.

paper.title: Teaching LLMs to Self-Evolve: Cultivating Core Meta-Skills with Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling through iterative self-evolution with environment feedback, as demonstrated by AlphaEvolve, shows remarkable performance gains. We hypothesize that the success of such evolution frameworks hinges on meta-skills, such as self-reflection with environment feedback, that enable effective multi-round refinement, yet are largely neglected by traditional post-training. To bridge this gap, we present MetaEvolve, a framework designed to develop these meta-skills via a data synthesis pip

summary.core_problem: 如何把“带环境反馈的多轮自我改进”（self-evolution）从纯推理时启发式，变成模型可学习、可泛化的能力：模型不仅要解出题，还要在看到上一轮方案与反馈后，稳定地产生“更好”的下一轮方案，并能从历史尝试中提炼可操作的改进方向。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练闭环的启发在于：把“相对改进”而非“绝对正确”作为训练信号，提供了一种更接近 test-time scaling（迭代搜索/反思/修补）的对齐方式。它把可验证环境（代码执行）产生的连续奖励用于训练“改进能力”，在一定程度上缓解了传统 RLHF/PRM 更偏向单轮完成任务、难以直接优化多轮演化策略的问题。对通用预训练的直接贡献有限（主要是后训练范式），但对如何构造可规模化的过程数据、如何定义 reward 以鼓励真实进步而非模板化自省，有方法论价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三块组成：
1) 进化轨迹数据合成：基于约 25k 道编程题，先为每题采样多份候选程序（文中示例为每题 10 个），再做“两阶段多样性过滤”，优先保留解法池足够多样的题目与解答对。多样性信号不仅看语义，还用程序表面结构代理（字符长度差、行数差等）来确保历史尝试之间存在可学习的差异；核心动机是：如果历史解都很像，模型学不到“哪些改动带来性能提升”。
2) Evolution-aware RL：训练时输入显式包含“当前解 + 性能反馈 + 历史尝试”的上下文，让模型输出下一轮改进版程序。奖励来自可验证执行：既包含正确性，也包含运行时间等连续信号，从而把“能跑”与“跑得更快”之间的梯度变成可优化目标。与常见 coding RL 只优化 pass@k/AC 不同，这里优化的是相对提升（improvement）与多轮策略。
3) 推理时演化搜索：训练目标与推理时流程对齐，推理阶段继续用多轮生成-执行-反馈的循环做搜索/改进。论文强调：很多自我演化系统（如 AlphaEvolve 类）在推理时做多轮，但模型本身没在这种分布下训练；MetaEvolve 试图用数据与 RL 把这种分布内化。
差异点：不是教模型“写更长的反思”，而是把反思/诊断是否有效交给环境奖励裁决；并且把“历史轨迹”作为一等公民进入训练样本，而不是单轮 prompt engineering。
summary.experiments:
论文报告覆盖 7 个编程基准的多轮改进评测，核心指标是“绝对平均改进率”（absolute average improvement rate）。相对最强基线：
- In-distribution：绝对平均改进率 +10.01%。
- Out-of-distribution：绝对平均改进率 +24.12%。
- AlgoTune（开放式算法优化，超出训练域）：相对改进 +46.91%。
此外做了“程序新颖性/结构多样性”分析，显示生成解更结构化多样（文中对应 Table 3），并用案例展示更像“针对性诊断→策略调整→结构性重写”的多轮行为，而不是重复试错（Figure 2）。
局限：从给出的全文片段看，奖励设计与训练细节（例如如何把 runtime 归一化、如何处理噪声/超时、是否做 per-problem baseline、RL 算法与 KL 约束等）对可复现性与可迁移性很关键，但需要在方法与附录里核对；另外“元技能可迁移到非代码域”的证据主要来自跨基准/开放式优化任务，离真正跨模态/跨领域仍有距离。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 Figure 1（整体训练/推理闭环）与 Figure 2（行为对比），把“训练分布对齐推理分布”的主线抓住。
- 重点看数据合成与多样性过滤的定义：它决定了模型到底学到“比较与改进”，还是学到“换皮重写”。关注两阶段过滤各自筛掉什么样的题。
- 重点看 reward 由执行信号构成的细节：正确性与性能如何组合、如何避免 reward hacking（例如投机取巧的微基准优化）。
- 实验部分优先看 OOD 与 AlgoTune（Table 2/4），再回头看消融：是否去掉历史轨迹、去掉多样性过滤、只用 correctness reward、只做 SFT 不做 RL 等，哪些组件真正贡献改进率。

summary_en.core_problem: Turning iterative self-evolution with environment feedback from a purely inference-time heuristic into a trainable capability: given prior attempts plus execution feedback, the model should reliably produce a meaningfully improved next attempt, learning how to diagnose weaknesses and exploit historical trajectories rather than just solving tasks in one shot.
summary_en.importance: The main value for foundation-model researchers is methodological rather than a new pretraining recipe: it reframes the objective from absolute task completion to relative improvement across rounds, aligning training with test-time scaling loops (generate→run→feedback→revise). Using execution-derived, continuous rewards (correctness + runtime) provides a scalable signal for learning multi-round refinement policies, which standard RLHF or single-turn verifiable RL typically does not target explicitly. Direct impact on base pretraining is limited, but it informs how to build trajectory data and rewards that incentivize real progress instead of verbose self-reflection.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MetaEvolve combines (i) trajectory-aware data synthesis, (ii) evolution-aware RL, and (iii) inference-time evolutionary search.
- Data synthesis: starting from ~25k coding problems, sample multiple candidate programs per problem (example: 10). Apply a two-stage diversity filtering to keep problems/solution pools where attempts are sufficiently different, using simple structural proxies (e.g., character length and line count differences) to ensure the history contains learnable variation.
- Evolution-aware RL: train the model on inputs that explicitly include the current solution, performance feedback, and a history of prior attempts; the target is an improved program. Rewards are verifiable via execution and include continuous runtime signals in addition to correctness, making “working vs. better-working” optimizable.
- Inference-time loop: keep the same multi-round generate-and-evaluate loop at test time, so the model is trained under a distribution closer to how it will be used.
Key distinction from common coding RL: the optimized behavior is multi-round improvement conditioned on trajectory context, not just maximizing pass@k or single-shot acceptance.
summary_en.experiments: Across seven coding benchmarks, MetaEvolve reports gains over the strongest baseline in absolute average improvement rate: +10.01% in-distribution and +24.12% out-of-distribution. On AlgoTune (open-ended algorithm optimization beyond the training domain), it reports a 46.91% relative improvement. The paper also includes novelty/structural diversity analysis (Table 3) and qualitative comparisons showing more targeted diagnosis and progressive restructuring vs. a naive evolution baseline (Figure 2). Practical questions to verify in the full method/appendix: reward normalization for runtime, handling timeouts/noise, RL algorithm details (KL control, sampling), and robustness against reward hacking via micro-optimizations.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
1) Figure 1 for the end-to-end loop and how training matches inference.
2) The data synthesis + diversity filtering section: it largely determines whether the model learns trajectory-conditioned improvement or just “rewrite differently”.
3) Reward construction from execution signals: how correctness and efficiency are combined and safeguarded.
4) Tables for OOD and AlgoTune results (Table 2/4), then ablations: removing history, removing diversity filtering, correctness-only reward, SFT-only vs. RL, etc.

recommendation.zh: 看数据合成和 reward 设计即可；把“会迭代”单独训练是对 RLVR 的合理补丁，但需警惕只在代码执行域成立。
recommendation.en: Skim the data synthesis and reward design; training iteration as a separate skill is a sensible RLVR patch, but the evidence may be coding-execution-specific.

paper.title: Nanbeige4.2-3B: Unlocking Agentic Capabilities in a Compact Mode
paper.abstract: We present Nanbeige4.2-3B, a compact general agentic model with 3B non-embedding parameters. It delivers strong performance across code-agent, office-agent, and complex tool-use tasks while maintaining highly competitive reasoning capabilities in mathematics, coding, and science. Nanbeige4.2-3B is pretrained from scratch on 28T tokens with a Looped Transformer that reuses the layer stack to increase capacity without adding parameters. For SFT data and trajectory construction, we expand the diver

summary.core_problem: 在严格参数预算（3B）下，把“通用推理能力”和“跨环境的 agentic 能力”（代码仓库、办公文档、复杂工具调用、长轨迹纠错）同时做进一个模型：既要底座足够强，又要在后训练阶段学会稳定执行多步工具链与环境交互。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的直接启发点主要有两类：
- 架构/训练配方：Looped Transformer 通过重复使用同一层栈提高有效深度，提供一种在参数不变时用计算换容量的路线；论文还给出“从零训练 looped”优于“先训标准再 upcycle”的经验结论，以及 loop pass 数与 token efficiency/稳定性的取舍。
- Pretrain↔Posttrain 接口：在 28T token 从零预训练后，用大规模可执行环境轨迹做 SFT/RL，并引入 mixed-mode RLHF（Think/Non-Think）与长度控制 RL，属于把推理风格与 agent 失败模式当作可优化对象。
但整体更像一个系统性模型发布与工程总结：大量篇幅在 agent 数据与 RL pipeline，属于后训练与 agent 方向；如果只关心“基座预训练方法”，信息密度相对有限。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 架构：Looped Transformer。hidden states 通过共享的 Transformer 层栈跑多次（文中强调两次 pass 最合适），在不增加非 embedding 参数的情况下增加有效计算深度。
- 训练策略：对比两条路线：a) 标准 Transformer 预训练后再转 loop（upcycling）；b) 直接从零按 looped 架构预训练。结论是从零训练显著更好，原因是表示会在预训练早期就适配“层复用”的归纳偏置。
- loop 深度选择：两次 pass 在能力增益与训练代价之间最平衡；更多 pass 收益小但训练更慢且更不稳定。
- KV cache sharing：提出跨 pass 共享 KV 以减半 cache，但性能增益更低，最终选择不共享以保性能。
2) 预训练：28T tokens，从零训练 3B base；数据配比上提高数学、代码、合成 QA 权重（细节需要在数据章节核对具体比例与清洗策略）。
3) 后训练（与预训练关联较弱但占比大）：
- SFT：构建“真实环境 + 大规模合成环境”的混合池，在 repo 级软件工程、复杂工具使用、office 任务上生成可执行轨迹；用执行信号与 rubric 做轨迹/turn 级过滤。
- RL：多阶段：先 mixed-mode RLHF 同时覆盖 Think/Non-Think 以减少幻觉/重复/指令偏差；再做长度控制推理 RL 平衡简洁与探索；最后做 agentic RL，用 outcome+process reward 提供更密的 credit assignment，稳定长轨迹学习。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段可确认的关键数字：
- 模型规模：3B non-embedding 参数。
- 预训练规模：28T tokens。
- 架构消融结论：从零训练 looped > upcycling；两次 pass 最优；KV cache sharing 降内存但带来更低性能增益。
性能方面，论文宣称在 code-agent、office-agent、复杂 tool-use 评测上超过更大模型（如 Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma4-12B），并保持数学/代码/科学推理竞争力；但在当前提供的正文片段里缺少具体表格数字与统计设置（评测基准、提示词、是否多次采样、agent 框架配置等），需要回到实验章节逐项核对，尤其是 agent 评测的可复现性与是否存在 scaffold 优势。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（45–60 分钟）：
- 如果关注预训练/架构：直接看 Pre-Training 小节里关于“from-scratch vs upcycling”“loop pass 数选择”“KV cache sharing”的实验结论与取舍。
- 如果关注 pretrain↔posttrain 接口：看 mixed-mode RLHF 与长度控制 RL 的动机与失败案例分类，理解它们在 agent 轨迹里解决什么具体问题。
- 实验部分建议先找：looped 架构的对照表、token efficiency 的定义与测量方式、以及 agent 评测是否控制了外部工具/框架差异。整体预计需要额外 30 分钟专门核对实验设置与数据构造细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Building a compact (3B) model that simultaneously retains strong general reasoning and supports broad agentic behaviors across heterogeneous executable environments (repo-level coding, office artifacts, complex tool use, long-horizon recovery), under a strict parameter budget.
summary_en.importance: Pretraining-relevant takeaways are mainly: (1) Looped Transformer as a compute-for-capacity approach under fixed parameters, with practical findings on how to train it; (2) an explicit pretrain→posttrain pipeline where large-scale executable trajectories and RL objectives target agent failure modes and reasoning length. Much of the paper is closer to an engineering/model release centered on agent data and RL; if the goal is purely new pretraining methodology, the incremental insight is moderate.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Architecture: a Looped Transformer that reuses the same Transformer stack for multiple passes over the hidden states. The paper emphasizes a two-pass configuration as the best trade-off.
Training findings:
- Training from scratch with the looped architecture outperforms upcycling (pretrain standard → convert to loop), suggesting representations should adapt to layer reuse early in pretraining.
- Increasing the number of passes yields diminishing returns while slowing training and hurting stability.
- KV-cache sharing across passes halves cache memory but reduces performance gains; they keep the full non-sharing loop.
Pretraining: 28T tokens from scratch; the data mixture increases math/code/synthetic QA weights (exact ratios/filters need verification in the full data section).
Post-training (dominant part): executable trajectory SFT from a hybrid pool of real + synthesized environments with execution/rubric filtering; multi-stage RL including mixed-mode RLHF over Think/Non-Think, length-controlled reasoning RL, and agentic RL with outcome + process rewards for denser credit assignment in long trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: Confirmed from the provided content: 3B non-embedding parameters; 28T pretraining tokens; ablation-style conclusions that from-scratch looped > upcycling, two passes work best, and KV-cache sharing trades memory for weaker gains. The paper claims strong results on code-agent/office-agent/tool-use benchmarks, reportedly outperforming larger open models (e.g., Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma4-12B), but the excerpt does not include the concrete tables, evaluation protocols, or agent framework controls—those are essential to validate the claims and should be checked in the full experiments section.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (45–60 minutes):
- For pretraining/architecture: focus on the Pre-Training section covering from-scratch vs upcycling, loop depth selection, and KV-cache sharing.
- For pretrain↔posttrain interface: read the RL pipeline motivation (mixed-mode RLHF, length control) and what failure modes they target.
- In experiments, prioritize the looped-architecture comparison tables and the definition/measurement of “token efficiency”, then verify agent benchmark setups (tooling, scaffolds, sampling, reproducibility).

recommendation.zh: 不是看它 3B 打赢谁，而是看小模型 agentic RL recipe 怎么拼；优先读后训练消融，预训练 28T 更像成本宣言而非 insight。
recommendation.en: Do not read this for the leaderboard claim; read it for how the agentic RL recipe is assembled in a 3B model, while treating the 28T pretraining scale mostly as a budget statement.

paper.title: IFCLoRA: Topology-Aware Rank Allocation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a widely used parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for large language models, but its performance depends strongly on how a fixed rank budget is distributed across Transformer modules. Existing adaptive-rank methods usually rely on local gradient statistics collected during training, which introduces extra memory and computation and overlooks task-conditioned global information flow. We propose IFCLoRA, a topology-aware rank allocation method applied before fine-t

summary.core_problem: LoRA 在固定总 rank 预算下如何分配到不同 Transformer 模块，会显著影响微调效果；现有 adaptive-rank 方法多依赖训练中的局部梯度统计，额外开销较高，也忽略跨模块信息流。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是参数高效微调方法改进。它不直接推进预训练，但用冻结模型和校准集估计模块适配重要性，对理解后训练中哪些模块承载任务变化有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 IFCLoRA，在微调前一次性完成 topology-aware rank allocation。方法用小校准集和冻结预训练模型构建稀疏的 task-conditioned interaction graph，图节点对应可插入 LoRA 的模块；再结合全局 information-flow topology prior 与局部 gradient sensitivity，计算 Information-Flow Centrality，用 multi-hop propagation 估计模块适配重要性，并在全局 rank 预算下分配各模块 rank。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多个模型、任务和低 rank 设置下验证 IFCLoRA，但未给出模型参数量、任务列表、baseline 名称或提升幅度。核心对比应包括均匀 rank LoRA 和依赖训练时梯度统计的 adaptive-rank 方法。

summary_en.core_problem: LoRA performance depends strongly on how a fixed rank budget is allocated across Transformer modules; existing adaptive-rank methods often rely on local gradient statistics during training and ignore global task-conditioned information flow.
summary_en.importance: This is a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method. It does not directly advance pretraining, but its frozen-model calibration approach is useful for diagnosing which modules carry task adaptation signals during post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes IFCLoRA, a topology-aware rank allocation method performed once before fine-tuning. With a small calibration set and a frozen pretrained model, it builds a sparse task-conditioned interaction graph whose nodes are LoRA-compatible modules. It combines a global information-flow topology prior with local gradient sensitivity to compute Information-Flow Centrality, estimating module importance under multi-hop propagation, then assigns ranks under a global budget.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that IFCLoRA is evaluated across multiple models, tasks, and low-rank settings, but does not provide parameter counts, task names, baseline details, or effect sizes. The key comparisons are expected to include uniform-rank LoRA and adaptive-rank methods based on training-time gradient statistics.

recommendation.zh: 只看 rank 分配公式和消融即可；若提升主要来自校准集选择，它更像 PEFT 工程调参而非模块机制结论。
recommendation.en: Read only the rank-allocation formula and ablations; if gains hinge on calibration-set choice, this is PEFT tuning rather than a module-mechanism result.

paper.title: Moir: Let the Model Direct Its Own Story for Robust Cross-Domain Knowledge Editing
paper.abstract: While language models remain frozen at their training state, the world evolves continuously. Knowledge editing has emerged as a key alternative to full retraining, but its deployment is bottlenecked by the erosion of core capabilities: mathematical and programmatic reasoning collapse while encyclopedic recall remains intact. We trace this asymmetric degradation to a distributional mismatch. Covariance-based editors preserve only the subspaces spanned by their reference corpus, but fail to captur

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决知识编辑中的 preservation space 选择问题：现有 covariance-based editor 用 Wikipedia 等外部语料估计保护子空间，和经过 SFT/DPO 后模型实际工作的分布不匹配，导致数学、代码等能力在多轮编辑后塌陷。
summary.importance: 对预训练和持续更新的启发在于：模型编辑的稳定性不只取决于更新公式，也取决于用什么分布定义“不能破坏的能力”。这和 continual pretrain、post-train 后分布漂移、模型维护都有直接关系。Moir 的关键贡献是把 preservation covariance 从外部 proxy corpus 转向模型自身生成分布，使编辑保护对象更接近部署模型的 operative distribution。它不是预训练方法，但对预训练后模型如何低成本吸收新事实、如何避免破坏推理能力，有清晰参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: Moir 是 covariance-based editing 的数据替换框架。MEMIT、AlphaEdit 等方法都会用一批 reference keys K0 构造未中心化协方差 C=K0K0^T，用它来正则化或投影参数更新，从而保护原有能力。Moir 不再从 Wikipedia 或预训练语料中采样 K0，而是让待编辑模型自己生成文本，再从这些自生成样本中提取激活 keys 来估计 C。作者强调，部署模型的真实 post-training 分布通常不可获得，尤其经过 SFT 和 DPO 后，外部静态语料很难覆盖数学推理、代码生成、对话格式等操作流形。方法细节上，single-random-token seeding 被选为较优生成配置，用一个随机 token 启动采样，既减轻无条件生成的 mode collapse，又不过度引入人工 prefix prior。Moir 可作为 MEMIT 或 AlphaEdit 的 drop-in replacement，不需要改模型结构或编辑目标。
summary.experiments: 实验涉及 OLMo-2、Llama-3.1 和 Qwen-3 系列，关注大规模顺序编辑后的跨域能力保持。关键数字是：20,000 次编辑后，采用 Moir 的模型在 GSM8K 上保持 79.9% accuracy，而 Wikipedia preservation baseline 只有 10.9%。文中还报告自生成 reference corpus 的一次性成本约为每个模型 2 小时。实验重点不是编辑单条事实是否成功，而是多轮编辑后数学、代码等复杂能力是否被 covariance 保护住。给出的内容表明，外部 Wikipedia 语料可以保住百科式 recall，却不能保护 post-train 后形成的 reasoning/code manifold；Moir 在这一点上明显更稳。完整评估仍需核对编辑成功率、事实泛化、局部性、不同编辑层和不同生成种子策略的消融。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 分钟。先看 Rethinking the Preservation Space，理解 C=K0K0^T 在 MEMIT 和 AlphaEdit 中的作用，这是整项工作的核心。然后看 Moir 的生成策略，尤其是 single-random-token seeding 与无条件生成、固定 prompt 生成的对比。实验部分重点看 20,000 edits 的能力保持曲线，以及 GSM8K、代码任务和百科 recall 是否存在取舍。若关注 continual model maintenance，可以细读作者关于 pretraining mixture 不可得、post-training shift 不可由静态语料恢复的论证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a preservation-space mismatch in knowledge editing: covariance-based editors estimate protected subspaces from external corpora such as Wikipedia, but those corpora do not match the operating distribution of SFT- or DPO-tuned models, causing math and coding abilities to degrade after many edits.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is relevant to model maintenance rather than pretraining itself. It shows that non-destructive editing depends not only on the update rule, but also on the distribution used to define what must be preserved. This connects directly to continual updating, post-training distribution shift, and the interface between factual patching and reasoning capability retention. Moir replaces the external proxy corpus with the model’s own generation distribution, making the preservation covariance closer to the deployed model’s actual activation manifold.
summary_en.technical_approach: Moir is a data replacement strategy for covariance-based editors. Methods such as MEMIT and AlphaEdit build a reference key matrix K0 and use the uncentered covariance C=K0K0^T either as a soft regularizer or as a hard projection constraint. The paper argues that the choice of K0 is the bottleneck. Instead of sampling K0 from Wikipedia or a presumed pretraining mixture, Moir samples text from the live model and extracts activation keys from those generations. This is intended to capture post-training shifts induced by SFT and DPO, including reasoning formats, code-like distributions, and dialogue behaviors that static corpora miss. The preferred sampling setup is single-random-token seeding, which aims to reduce mode collapse without imposing a strong hand-written prefix prior. The resulting covariance can be plugged into MEMIT or AlphaEdit without architectural changes.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover OLMo-2, Llama-3.1, and Qwen-3 model families under large-scale sequential editing. The headline result is capability retention after 20,000 edits: models using Moir retain 79.9% accuracy on GSM8K, while the Wikipedia-based preservation baseline drops to 10.9%. The paper reports a one-time self-generation cost of roughly two hours per model. The evaluation emphasizes cross-domain preservation rather than only edit success: Wikipedia can preserve encyclopedic recall, but it fails to protect reasoning and coding manifolds shaped by post-training. The full paper should be checked for edit success rates, locality, paraphrase generalization, layer choices, corpus sizes, and ablations over generation strategies.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 minutes. Start with the preservation-space formulation and the role of C=K0K0^T in MEMIT and AlphaEdit. Then read the Moir sampling design, especially the comparison between single-random-token seeding, unconditional generation, and fixed-prompt generation. In the experiments, focus on the 20,000-edit retention curves and the tradeoff between GSM8K, code tasks, and encyclopedic recall. For readers working on continual model maintenance, the most useful part is the argument that the true post-training operating distribution is usually unavailable and cannot be reliably reconstructed from static external corpora.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的不是编辑算法，而是它把 SFT/DPO 视作分布迁移并要求“从模型自己采样估计保持子空间”；这点应在内部 ablation 里复现。
recommendation.en: The key idea is not editing itself but treating SFT/DPO as a distribution shift and estimating the preserved subspace from the model’s own samples; worth reproducing internally.

paper.title: When RLVR Shrinks the Reasoning Boundary: Diagnosing Pass@k Inversion
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can improve one-sample accuracy while making a model worse under repeated sampling. We study this pass@k inversion: after training, the policy may solve fewer distinct problems than its base model at large $k$. The failure concentrates on boundary prompts, where the base model contains rare correct trajectories that are recoverable by sampling but too sparse to reliably appear in finite RLVR rollout groups. We argue that a two-mode account ex

summary.core_problem: RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）通常能提升模型单次采样的pass@1准确率，但会导致大k值下的pass@k下降——即经过训练的策略在允许多次采样时，能解决的不同问题总数反而少于基座模型，这一现象被称为pass@k反转。工作核心是诊断该现象的内在机制。
summary.importance: 这一发现直指当前RLVR推理训练流程的一个关键盲区：多数评估只关注单次采样性能，但生产级推理系统大量依赖多次采样、自一致性、搜索等方法恢复稀有正确轨迹。pass@k反转意味着RLVR可能侵蚀高测试时计算预算赖以生效的潜在覆盖能力，造成单次采样准确率和高预算性能之间的此消彼长，而这一代价此前极少被测量，对预训练与后训练的闭环设计有直接参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 首先根据冻结基座模型的行为将prompt划分为四个区间：solved-easy（正确轨迹占主导，单次采样大概率答对）、reachable、boundary（存在稀有正确轨迹，多次采样可恢复，但不是分布主模式）、out-of-reach（基座策略中不存在正确轨迹）。随后提出双模式机制解释：在boundary区间的prompt上，正确轨迹过于稀疏，无法在RLVR有限的rollout批次中频繁出现；全零奖励的批次无法提供局部校正信号，而来自其他prompt的参数更新会让策略逐渐锐化，在稀有正确轨迹被足够多次采样、获得足够强化之前，就将这部分模式从策略分布中移除，本质是证据缺失导致的模式承诺错误。工作还提出了极简干预方法Per-Problem Base Anchoring（PBA）作为概念验证探针：对boundary类prompt锚定基座分布，防止已有覆盖丢失。
summary.experiments: 以数学验证器为可控测试床，在3个训练种子上开展实验，在3000个分层采样的prompt上评估k=1、4、16、64、256的全pass@k曲线。结果验证，覆盖率损失几乎全部集中在boundary区间；极简的PBA干预可以在不降低pass@1提升幅度的前提下，缓解大k下的覆盖率下降，印证了提出的机制。PBA不是扩展能力边界的方法，仅作为防护栏防止基座已有覆盖被破坏。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注引言中pass@k反转的定义、prompt四区间分层框架、双模式机制解释，以及PBA消融的核心结论，无需深入推导细节。核心价值是这套诊断框架可直接加入标准RLVR评估流程，避免只监控pass@1带来的偏差。预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) often improves pass@1 accuracy while reducing pass@k at large k, meaning the trained policy can solve fewer distinct problems than the base model when allowed multiple sampling attempts. This phenomenon is termed pass@k inversion, and the work diagnoses its underlying mechanism.
summary_en.importance: This finding addresses a critical blind spot in current RLVR pipelines for reasoning models: most evaluation focuses on single-sample performance, but production inference systems rely heavily on repeated sampling, self-consistency, and search to recover rare correct trajectories. Pass@k inversion means RLVR can erode the latent coverage that makes high test-time compute useful, creating a direct tradeoff between single-sample accuracy and high-budget performance that is rarely measured. The result has direct implications for closed-loop pretraining and post-training pipeline design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Prompts are first stratified into four regimes based on frozen base model behavior: solved-easy (correct trajectories are dominant, high single-sample success rate), reachable, boundary (rare correct trajectories exist and are recoverable via repeated sampling but are not the dominant mode), and out-of-reach (no correct trajectories exist in the base policy). A two-mode mechanistic explanation is proposed: on boundary prompts, correct trajectories are too sparse to appear frequently in finite RLVR rollout batches. All-zero reward batches provide no local corrective signal, while parameter updates from other prompts sharpen the policy, causing it to discard rare correct modes before they can be sufficiently reinforced, a failure mode driven by absence of evidence rather than explicit incorrect reinforcement. A minimal intervention called Per-Problem Base Anchoring (PBA) is introduced as a proof-of-concept probe, which anchors the policy to base model coverage on boundary prompts to prevent loss of existing capabilities.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use mathematical verifiers as a controlled testbed across 3 training seeds, with full pass@k curves evaluated at k=1,4,16,64,256 on 3000 stratified prompts. Results confirm that coverage loss is almost entirely localized to boundary prompts. The simple PBA intervention mitigates coverage loss at large k without reducing pass@1 gains, validating the proposed mechanism. PBA is explicitly framed not as a capability expansion method, but only as a guardrail to prevent destruction of existing base model coverage.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the definition of pass@k inversion in the introduction, the four-regime prompt stratification framework, the two-mode mechanistic explanation, and the high-level results of the PBA ablation. Skip detailed derivations; the core value is the diagnostic framing that can be directly added to standard RLVR evaluation pipelines to avoid bias from only monitoring pass@1. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: RLVR提升pass@1却缩窄大k下解题边界的机制扎实，做推理RL的团队应复现该现象，PBA是可用的极简基线。
recommendation.en: The pass@k inversion mechanism is well-supported; reasoning RL teams should reproduce this, PBA is a simple usable baseline.

paper.title: Training Large Language Models for Self-Explanation Faithfulness
paper.abstract: We propose a Reinforcement Learning (RL) method to directly optimize the faithfulness of self-explanations - the extent to which a model's generated reasoning accurately reflects its internal decision-making process. While existing work focuses on evaluating faithfulness or using inference-time prompting frameworks to improve an LLM's self-explanation's tractability, these approaches do not provide a mechanism to directly optimize a model's parameters to generate faithful self-explanations. We b

summary.core_problem: 论文想解决的问题是：模型生成的解释是否真的反映了影响其答案的因素，以及能否用 RL 直接优化这种 explanatory faithfulness。
summary.importance: 它和基座预训练不是强相关，但对 post-training 信号质量有一定启发。当前很多 reasoning/RL 训练只奖励答案正确或解释看起来合理，容易把“可读的理由”和“真实的决策因素”混在一起。这篇论文把 counterfactual faithfulness metric 改造成训练奖励，提供了一个更接近过程监督的信号设计例子。对预训练研究的价值主要在于理解 RL 目标可能训练出什么样的解释行为，以及如何降低 rationale 的事后编造问题。
summary.technical_approach: 方法基于反事实干预。给定 factual 和 counterfactual 输入，观察模型决策是否随某些因素改变，从而估计这些因素是否实际影响了模型输出。然后把这类影响信号转成 RL reward：如果某个因素影响了决策，模型解释中应该提到它；如果某个因素没有影响决策，解释中不应声称它起作用。论文重点优化 explanatory faithfulness，而不是 causal faithfulness；也就是说，它关心解释是否披露了模型自己的决策驱动因素，而不是答案是否因 rationale 本身而产生。训练上使用类似 GRPO 的 RL 框架，并与 SFT 进行对比。一个关键设计点是 reward 需要依赖当前模型行为动态计算，不能像普通偏好数据那样预先固定，因为“什么因素影响了模型”会随着模型参数变化而变化。
summary.experiments: 实验发现，SFT 能显著提升模型预测 influence 的能力，把 predicted influence 和 actual influence 的相关性从接近 0 提高到 0.66 以上，但这并不等价于模型会在自然解释中披露这些因素。RL 训练后，模型既能检测影响因素，也更愿意在解释中表达这些因素，Phi-CCT 最高达到 0.664；在 held-out 数据上达到 0.691 Phi-CCT，说明不是简单记忆训练样本。论文还报告模型没有主要通过退化复制等明显 reward hacking 行为获得奖励，并倾向生成更简洁的解释。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30 到 45 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 explanatory faithfulness、causal faithfulness、counterfactual test 的区分；再看 Method 中 reward 如何从 counterfactual influence 构造，以及为什么不能离线预生成固定标签；最后看 SFT 与 RL 的对比实验。对预训练方向，最有用的是 reward 设计和训练信号动态性的讨论，不必深究具体任务设置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether an LLM can be trained to produce self-explanations that disclose the factors that actually influenced its own decisions, rather than merely producing plausible rationales.
summary_en.importance: This is more relevant to post-training and oversight than to core pretraining. Its useful lesson for foundation-model training is about reward design: answer correctness and plausible reasoning traces do not guarantee that generated explanations reflect the model’s decision process. By turning counterfactual faithfulness metrics into an RL objective, the paper gives a concrete example of training against a process-oriented signal whose target depends on the current model behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses counterfactual interventions as a proxy for internal decision drivers. For factual and counterfactual input pairs, the model’s decisions are compared to estimate which factors affected the output. The reward then encourages explanations to mention factors that were influential and omit factors that were not. The target is explanatory faithfulness: whether the explanation reflects the model’s own decision drivers. This is different from causal faithfulness, where the answer must causally depend on the generated rationale. The training framework is RL-based, using a GRPO-like setup. A key point is that the reward cannot be fully precomputed as static preference data, because the relevant influence labels depend on the model’s current behavior and can change during training.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports that supervised fine-tuning substantially improves the model’s ability to predict influence, raising the correlation between predicted and actual influence from near zero to above 0.66. However, this does not reliably make the model verbalize the influential factors in its explanations. The RL method improves both detection and disclosure, reaching up to 0.664 Phi-CCT, a correlation-style metric for alignment between internal decision drivers and verbalized reasoning. On held-out data, the reported Phi-CCT reaches 0.691, suggesting that the behavior is not just memorization. The authors also report no dominant degenerate reward-hacking pattern such as copying, and observe more concise explanations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30 to 45 minutes. Focus on the distinction between explanatory and causal faithfulness in the introduction, then read the reward construction in the method section. The most relevant part is why the reward must be computed from the model’s current counterfactual behavior rather than from fixed labels. The SFT-versus-RL comparison is the main experimental result. For pretraining researchers, the paper is mainly useful as a case study in dynamic reward signals and rationale faithfulness, not as a foundation-model training recipe.

recommendation.zh: 把faithfulness metric直接做成RL reward的思路值得参考，重点看§3的奖励构造和干预设计
recommendation.en: The idea of converting faithfulness metrics into RL rewards is worth referencing; focus on §3 reward construction and intervention design

paper.title: EvoThink: Evolving Thinking in Large Reasoning Models via Self-Pruning and Aha-Moment Preference Optimization
paper.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) often suffer from overthinking due to redundant verification steps. Existing approaches for mitigating overthinking, such as fast-slow thinking switching and reasoning trajectory compression, fail to make a fine-grained distinction between beneficial and redundant steps within the LRM's reasoning process, and may thus impair reasoning capability in their pursuit of efficiency. To simultaneously improve reasoning efficiency and capability, we propose EvoThink, a fram

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是大推理模型里的 overthinking：模型在已经得到有效推理路径后，仍继续做大量重复验证、回溯和改写，导致输出很长、推理成本高，而且这些额外 token 往往不提升正确率，甚至会引入噪声。论文进一步指出，现有两类做法都不够精细：fast/slow routing 是在推理前做粗粒度二选一，容易误判题目难度；trajectory compression 虽然能缩短链路，但常常把有用的验证步骤和冗余步骤一起压掉，结果是效率上去了，能力却掉了。作者想解决的是一个更细粒度的问题：能不能只删掉重复验证，同时保留甚至增强真正有帮助的推理结构。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关联不如训练 recipe 或数据论文强，但它对 post-train 与推理行为塑形有现实意义，尤其是 reasoning model 的长度控制、训练信号设计和失败轨迹利用。重要之处有两点。第一，它把 overthinking 视为 reasoning quality 问题，而不只是 decoding 成本问题，因此优化目标不是单纯缩短输出，而是区分“有益验证”和“重复验证”。第二，它没有停在压缩层面，而是试图用失败轨迹里的 from-wrong-to-right 转折去补回甚至提升能力。这一点对后训练很有启发：错误样本不只是负例，也可以是构造高信息密度偏好数据的来源。量级上，这更像 reasoning post-training 方法，而不是基座预训练范式变化；但如果关心 RL/SFT 如何反向塑造模型的思维长度和探索模式，这篇值得看。
summary.technical_approach: EvoThink 分两阶段。第一阶段是 Self-Pruning Training，目标是去掉冗余验证。模型先对问题生成带 <think>...</think> 的完整推理轨迹和最终答案，然后系统识别 reasoning trajectory 里重复的自我验证、重复求解、对已确认结论的再次展开等片段，并把这些片段剪掉，得到更精炼的轨迹。之后再用这些 pruned trajectories 做 self-training，并且是迭代进行：第 i 轮模型生成，第 i 轮规则或机制剪枝，再训练得到第 i+1 轮模型。这里的关键不是简单按长度截断，而是试图在轨迹内部做结构化删减，所以作者把它称为 fine-grained pruning，而不是 compression。第二阶段是 Aha-Moment Preference Optimization，目标是补能力。作者从错误推理轨迹出发，把失败样本看成一个 population，用 fitness function 评估哪些失败“有潜力”，这里的潜力主要和推理多样性、探索价值有关，而不是只看错得多离谱。然后在这些高潜失败上构造所谓 aha-moment 数据：把错误推理路径与正确答案之间的转折显式组织出来，形成一种 from-wrong-to-right 的偏好对。最后用 DPO 训练模型，让模型偏好能走向新路径、完成关键转折的推理，而不是只学会更短地复述已有正确解。与已有方法相比，EvoThink 的区别在于两点：SPT 不是题目级别的 fast/slow 切换，而是轨迹级别删冗余；AMPO 不是只用正确答案监督，而是把高价值失败转成偏好学习信号，鼓励探索式修正。
summary.experiments: 论文在数学推理和代码生成上做了较系统的实验。引言里给出的一个核心观察是，原始 LRM 超过 65% 的 token 花在重复计算和重复验证上，这为 SPT 提供了动机。实验结论是 EvoThink 能同时改善效率和能力，而不是像很多压缩方法那样用准确率换长度。具体来说，SPT 单独使用时，能显著缩短 reasoning trace，并在多数任务上保持甚至略增性能；加入 AMPO 后，准确率进一步提升，说明从失败到修正的偏好学习确实补回了压缩可能带来的能力损失。论文还做了对比：只用正确解做优化，不如用 aha-moment 数据，因为后者更接近模型真实探索新路径的过程。消融重点通常包括 SPT 的迭代次数、pruning 策略、fitness function 设计，以及是否使用 AMPO。就当前给出的全文片段看，没有完整表格数字可逐项抄录，但主结论很清楚：EvoThink 不是单纯减少 token，而是在更短轨迹下维持或提升数学与代码任务表现。如果精读原文，建议重点核对主表里的长度下降比例、各 benchmark 的准确率变化，以及 AMPO 相对“correct-only preference”基线的增益幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，对问题定义和两阶段框架建立直觉。然后看 Method 里 SPT 的 pruning 规则或判定机制，判断它到底是在做启发式删句，还是对推理结构有更明确的识别。第二个重点是 AMPO 的 fitness function 和 aha-moment 数据构造方式，这部分决定了它是不是只是另一种偏好数据拼接。实验部分优先看三类结果：长度与准确率的 trade-off、SPT/AMPO 消融、以及只用正确解监督与 aha-moment 监督的对比。预计 25 到 40 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读；如果你做 reasoning post-train，值得把附录里的数据构造细节也看掉。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets overthinking in large reasoning models: after reaching a useful line of reasoning, the model keeps generating repeated verification, re-derivations, and redundant checks. This inflates output length and inference cost, while often adding little or even hurting final accuracy. The authors argue that existing solutions are too coarse. Fast-vs-slow routing makes a pre-reasoning binary decision and can fail on misclassified problems. Trajectory compression shortens outputs, but often removes helpful verification together with redundant verification. The real problem, then, is not just shortening reasoning, but pruning the right parts.
summary_en.importance: This is more of a post-training and reasoning-behavior paper than a core pretraining paper, but it is still relevant to base-model researchers interested in how training signals shape reasoning length and exploration. Two aspects matter. First, it treats overthinking as a reasoning-quality issue rather than a pure decoding-efficiency issue. Second, it uses failed trajectories as a source of useful supervision instead of discarding them. That is a meaningful idea for post-train pipelines: failure traces can be converted into high-information preference data, especially when the goal is to encourage productive exploration rather than mere brevity.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvoThink has two stages. Stage one is Self-Pruning Training (SPT). The model first generates a full reasoning trace inside <think> tags plus a final answer. The method then identifies redundant self-verification patterns inside the trace, such as repeated checking of already established conclusions or repeated solution attempts that do not add new information. These parts are pruned, and the model is self-trained on the resulting concise trajectories. This process is iterative: a model at iteration i generates traces, those traces are pruned, and the pruned data is used to train the next model. The key point is that SPT is not simple length truncation; it aims at fine-grained removal of redundant reasoning segments. Stage two is Aha-Moment Preference Optimization (AMPO). Here the authors collect incorrect reasoning trajectories and treat them as a population of failures. A fitness function is used to select high-potential failures, with emphasis on diversity and exploratory value. From these, they construct aha-moment preference data that explicitly captures a transition from a wrong path to a correct resolution. DPO is then used to train the model to prefer such trajectories. Compared with prior work, the novelty is the combination of trajectory-level redundancy pruning and preference learning from curated wrong-to-right transitions, rather than only compressing outputs or training on correct solutions.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers mathematical reasoning and code generation. One motivating statistic from the paper is that more than 65% of tokens in baseline reasoning traces are spent on redundant computation or repeated verification. The main empirical claim is that EvoThink improves both efficiency and capability. SPT alone shortens reasoning traces substantially while largely preserving, and sometimes slightly improving, task performance. Adding AMPO further improves accuracy, suggesting that the wrong-to-right preference signal helps recover or exceed any capability lost during pruning. The paper also compares AMPO against optimization using only correct solutions and reports that aha-moment data is more effective, presumably because it better reflects the exploratory process of discovering a new reasoning path. The most important ablations are likely the number of SPT iterations, the pruning strategy, the fitness function for failure selection, and the effect of removing AMPO. The excerpt provided does not include the full result tables, so exact benchmark-by-benchmark numbers are not recoverable here, but the qualitative result is clear: the method is not merely reducing tokens; it is trying to improve the length-quality trade-off.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with Figure 1 and Figure 2 to understand the problem framing and the two-stage pipeline. Then inspect the SPT section carefully: the main question is whether pruning is based on shallow heuristics or on a more structured notion of redundant reasoning. After that, read the AMPO section with attention to the fitness function and the construction of aha-moment pairs. In the experiments, focus on three comparisons: accuracy versus output length, SPT and AMPO ablations, and AMPO versus correct-only optimization. A useful skim should take around 25 to 40 minutes. If you work on reasoning post-training, the appendix is likely worth reading for data-construction details.

recommendation.zh: 只看 SPT 的 pruning 判据和 AMPO 数据构造；若无强 ablation，就当 reasoning SFT 配方备查。
recommendation.en: Read only the SPT pruning criterion and AMPO data construction; without strong ablations, treat it as a reasoning-SFT recipe note.

paper.title: Co-Evolving LLM Evaluators and Policies via DynamicRubric
paper.abstract: Post-training with evaluator feedback on policy-induced samples serves as a major mechanism for improving large language models. As policies improve, these sampled responses become close in quality. These close candidates create a bottleneck for policy optimization: collapsed relative evaluator score gaps yield weak or misleading policy supervision. We theoretically characterize why these gaps matter through a probability allocation view, showing that the directional gain of shifting probability

summary.core_problem: 随着策略模型在 post-training 中不断变强，从当前策略采样出的候选回答在整体质量上越来越接近，导致 evaluator 或 reward model 难以提供足够大且方向正确的相对分数差距。相对区分度一旦坍塌，策略优化收到的监督信号就会变弱甚至误导。论文要解决的是 evaluator 如何随策略共同演化，持续在当前策略产生的接近样本之间维持可用判别力。
summary.importance: 这是一篇和 pretrain–posttrain 接口高度相关的工作。它把 policy optimization 中经常被经验性讨论的『reward model 饱和/失效』问题形式化成相对分数差距与概率重分配的关系，说明 evaluator 的核心目标不是给出绝对正确分数，而是对当前策略采样集中真正影响更新方向的候选差异保持敏感。对研究 RLHF、RLVR、在线数据筛选、合成数据偏好标注，以及 pretrain 后期退火和 post-train 衔接的人，这个视角都有实际意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从概率分配视角给出理论刻画：对同一 prompt 下从当前策略采样得到的一组候选回答，将概率质量从一个回答移向另一个回答所能带来的定向收益，恰好等于二者的 evaluator 分数差。因此 evaluator 最关键的不是全局绝对评分，而是在当前候选集内部维持正确、可解释的相对差距。基于这一点，作者提出 DynamicRubric。给定 prompt 和当前策略采样的回答集合，DR-Generator 动态生成面向该集合差异的二元 rubric 条目，并为条目赋权；DR-Verifier 将这些条目逐条应用到每个回答上，输出 yes/no 判断，再聚合成回答级分数。训练时 evaluator 和 policy 交替更新：evaluator 适配新的 response set，policy 用新 evaluator 的分数做优化，从而形成 co-evolution。相比静态 rubric 或固定 reward model，DynamicRubric 的 rubric 是在看到候选回答后生成的，因此能聚焦这一轮优化真正有区分度的错误，例如遗漏约束、单步推理错误或意图不匹配。
summary.experiments: 论文以 Qwen3-8B 作为主实验骨干。训练后的 DR-Generator 在偏好评估任务上超过更大的 evaluator baseline，包括 Qwen3-32B zero-shot 动态 rubric 生成器。将 DynamicRubric 分数用于策略优化时，在开放式生成任务上持续优于 70B reward model 监督和 235B 静态 rubric 监督；在数学、代码、科学问答等可验证推理任务上也有稳定增益。持续 co-evolution 实验显示，随着策略演化，持续更新的 evaluator 比陈旧 evaluator 提供更强监督。论文还报告了在微信搜索 AI 问答场景的大规模线上 A/B：替换原有生产模型后，总搜索量、用户停留时长和正向用户行为均有统计显著提升，并已全量上线。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，但方法部分值得细看。优先读引言和方法论前半部分，尤其是把 score gap 解释为概率重分配信号的那段推导，这是全文最有迁移价值的观点；然后看 Figure 1 理解 DynamicRubric 的生成-验证-策略更新闭环。实验部分重点关注和更大静态 evaluator/reward model 的对比，以及 stale evaluator 与 co-evolved evaluator 的差异，因为这直接支持论文主结论。线上部署结果可作为工业化落地信号参考。预计阅读时间 30–45 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 作者团队来自腾讯微信搜索等相关方向，论文包含微信搜索 AI 问答生产环境部署结果。

summary_en.core_problem: As policies improve during post-training, sampled responses become increasingly similar in overall quality, making it hard for evaluators and reward models to produce reliable relative score gaps. When those gaps collapse or point in the wrong direction, policy optimization receives weak or misleading supervision. The paper addresses how evaluators can co-evolve with the policy so that they remain discriminative on the near-equal candidates produced by the current policy.
summary_en.importance: The paper is directly relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface. It formalizes a commonly observed but often informally described problem—reward model saturation or drift—as a question of relative score gaps and probability reallocation. The key message is that the useful quantity for optimization is not an absolute global score, but reliable relative ordering among the candidates that the current policy is actually sampling from. This perspective is useful for research on RLHF, RLVR, online data selection, synthetic preference labeling, and the transition from late-stage pretraining/annealing into post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper starts from a probability-allocation view: given a prompt and a set of responses sampled from the current policy, the directional gain from shifting probability mass from one response to another equals the evaluator score gap between them. This motivates response-set-conditioned evaluation rather than prompt-only evaluation. DynamicRubric implements this principle with two components. DR-Generator takes a prompt and a set of sampled responses and produces weighted binary rubric items tailored to the actual differences within that set. DR-Verifier applies each rubric item to every response, producing yes/no judgments that are aggregated into response-level scores. Training alternates between adapting the generator to response sets from the current policy and optimizing the policy using the resulting scores. Compared with static rubrics or fixed reward models, the dynamically generated rubrics can focus on instance-specific distinctions that matter for the current update, such as missed constraints, a flawed reasoning step, or intent mismatch.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments use Qwen3-8B as the backbone. The trained DR-Generator outperforms larger evaluator baselines on preference evaluation, including a Qwen3-32B zero-shot dynamic rubric generator. When used for policy optimization, DynamicRubric consistently outperforms supervision from a 70B reward model and static-rubric supervision from a 235B rubric generator on open-ended generation, while also yielding consistent gains on math, coding, and scientific QA benchmarks. Continual co-evolution experiments show that an evaluator updated alongside the policy provides stronger supervision than a stale evaluator. The paper also reports large-scale online A/B results in WeChat Search’s AI answering scenario, with statistically significant improvements in total search volume, user duration, and positive user behaviors, leading to full production deployment.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper, but read the method carefully enough to capture the core formalism. Start with the introduction and the first part of the methodology, especially the derivation linking score gaps to probability reallocation; that is the most transferable idea. Then use Figure 1 to understand the generator-verifier-policy loop. In experiments, focus on comparisons against larger static evaluators/reward models and on the stale-vs-coevolved evaluator comparison, since those results most directly support the main claim. The online deployment results are useful as evidence of practical viability. Estimated reading time: 30–45 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include teams associated with Tencent WeChat Search; the paper reports deployment in WeChat Search’s large-scale AI answering production system.

recommendation.zh: 从概率分配视角解释评估器分数差的作用，对理解后训练监督信号质量有参考，重点看第2节理论分析。
recommendation.en: Provides a probability allocation view of evaluator score gaps; useful for understanding post-training supervision signal quality, focus on Section 2 theoretical analysis.

paper.title: Post-Training in Time Series Foundation Models: A Unifying Framework
paper.abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) have emerged as general-purpose models for time series analysis, but pretraining alone is often insufficient for reliable downstream deployment. Bridging this gap requires further intervention to handle domain shift, task heterogeneity, limited supervision, and computational constraints, which motivates post-training as a broad class of methods to adapt, augment, compose, calibrate, or specialize pretrained TSFMs for downstream tasks. In this work, we analyz

summary.core_problem: 时间序列基础模型仅靠预训练无法应对下游域偏移、任务异构等问题，缺乏统一的后训练方法分析框架。
summary.importance: 框架创新与综述贡献，首次按干预位置将时间序列基础模型后训练分为五大类，给出系统分析视角与未来方向。
summary.technical_approach: 按照预测流水线中的干预位置，将后训练方法分为参数适配、上下文增强、模型组合、输出处理与不确定性控制、压缩与专业化五大类，梳理各类方法的代表工作与局限。
summary.experiments: 无原创实验，为综述性框架研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Time series foundation models cannot handle downstream domain shift and task heterogeneity with pretraining alone, and lack a unified analytical framework for post-training methods.
summary_en.importance: Framework innovation and survey contribution, first categorizing time series foundation model post-training into five categories by intervention location, providing a systematic analysis perspective and future directions.
summary_en.technical_approach: Categorizes post-training methods into five categories based on their intervention locus in the prediction pipeline: parameter adaptation, context augmentation, model composition, output processing and uncertainty control, and compression and specialization, sorting out representative works and limitations of each category.
summary_en.experiments: No original experiments; it is a survey-style framework study.

recommendation.zh: 时间序列基础模型后训练的统一分类框架，可参考其干预维度的划分思路，无需深读正文。
recommendation.en: Unified post-training taxonomy for time series foundation models; reference the intervention dimension categorization, no deep reading needed.

paper.title: Fishing Out Free Riders: Shapley-Based Reward Attribution for Parallel Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at multi-step reasoning, yet current parallel reasoning approaches often fail to distinguish the contributions of individual reasoning paths. Many paths may be redundant, misleading, or even detrimental, but outcome-level rewards assign uniform reward, leading to ambiguous learning signals and unstable training. We propose Parallel Shapley, a reinforcement learning framework that attributes fine-grained, path-level contributions in multi-path reasoning. Treatin

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是并行推理 RL 里的奖励归因问题。现有 parallel reasoning 方法通常先生成多条 reasoning path，再把它们汇总成一个 summary 或最终答案，然后只根据最终结果给整组路径发奖励。问题在于：不同路径的作用并不一样，有些路径提供关键补充信息，有些只是重复，有些甚至会把汇总过程带偏。若所有路径共享同一个 outcome-level reward，训练信号就会混杂，错误路径也可能因为“搭便车”而得到正向更新，进而带来 reward hacking、训练不稳定和收敛变慢。论文要解决的核心，就是在存在路径间互补与冲突的情况下，如何给每条路径分配更接近其真实边际贡献的过程级奖励。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，因为它主要是 post-train / reasoning RL 方向；但它对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有现实启发。第一，它把“多轨迹推理”里的 credit assignment 明确化了，这和长链推理、tool use、多样本搜索、test-time scaling 的训练信号设计是同一类问题。第二，它指出 summary-based reward 会系统性放大奖励污染，这对任何把多条候选轨迹压缩成单个监督信号的训练范式都有参考价值。第三，它把 cooperative game / Shapley attribution 引入 reasoning RL，虽然不是全新理论，但在并行推理场景里给出了一个较完整的可训练实现。贡献量级更像是一个有方法新意的 RL 训练改造，而不是改变基座预训练范式的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是一个两层奖励框架。模型先在显式结构化模板里进行并行推理，使用 <Parallel>、<Path>、<Summary> 等标签把多路径生成和最终汇总分开。训练时同时使用两类奖励：一类是 summary 级别的 outcome reward，通常由最终答案是否正确决定；另一类是 path 级别的 process reward，用来衡量每条路径对最终成功的边际贡献。

关键创新在 path-level reward 的定义。作者把一组 reasoning paths 视为 cooperative game 里的 players，把某个路径子集被送入汇总器后得到的“效用”视为 coalition utility。然后用 Shapley value 来定义单条路径的平均边际贡献。这样做的原因很直接：单独看一条路径往往没有意义，因为它的价值取决于和其他路径是互补、冗余还是冲突；Shapley 恰好是处理这种交互归因的标准工具。

但精确计算 Shapley 需要枚举所有子集，复杂度指数级。作者采用 Monte Carlo permutation sampling 近似：随机采样路径排列，计算某条路径加入前后 coalition utility 的增量，再对多次采样求平均。这样把不可行的组合爆炸降到可训练范围。

另一个实现点是 utility 不是直接由人工规则给出，而是由 Generative Reward Model 评估不同路径组合的效用。按文中描述，这个 reward model 用来判断给定若干路径时 summary 或答案质量如何，从而为 Shapley 估计提供 coalition value。于是整个训练信号变成：最终正确性负责全局目标，Shapley 负责细粒度 credit assignment。

优化上，作者把这套奖励接到 GRPO 框架里，而不是重新设计全套 policy optimization。这样做的好处是工程改动较小，能直接对接已有 reasoning RL recipe。和 Parallel-R1 这类方法相比，差别不在于“并行推理结构”本身，而在于不再把整组路径当成一个不可分的整体，而是显式区分谁在贡献、谁在搭便车。
summary.experiments:
实验主要在数学推理基准上做，论文强调的是 Pass@k 尤其是 Pass@16 的提升，以及训练稳定性。按文中给出的主结果，Parallel Shapley 相比当时的强基线 parallel-thinking model，在 Pass@16 上平均提升 42.3%。这个数字说明它更擅长把并行采样预算转化为有效候选，而不只是提高单条轨迹质量。

从实验叙述看，作者还比较了 SFT 式 parallel reasoning、普通 outcome-level RL、以及引入 path attribution 的版本。主要观察有三点：
1. 细粒度归因优于统一发奖，说明 credit assignment 确实是瓶颈，而不是单纯增加路径数就能解决。
2. 训练曲线更平稳、收敛更快，支持作者关于“错误路径被误奖励会放大优化噪声”的论点。
3. Monte Carlo Shapley 在近似次数有限时已经有效，说明不需要特别高精度的 Shapley 估计也能带来收益。

从可预期的消融重点看，值得注意的通常包括：只用 outcome reward、只用 process reward、两者结合；不同路径数；不同 Monte Carlo 采样次数；是否使用 generative reward model；以及路径质量分布不均时的鲁棒性。全文片段里没有完整表格数字，但主结论很明确：收益主要来自更好的路径级奖励分配，而不是 prompt 结构本身。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不必逐行细抠。建议先看 Introduction，抓住它批评现有 parallel reasoning RL 的那一句：summary-level reward 会让无效路径也拿到正反馈。然后重点看方法部分三件事：
1. 并行推理的生成结构是怎样组织的；
2. coalition utility 具体如何定义，Generative Reward Model 输入输出是什么；
3. Monte Carlo Shapley 如何近似，复杂度和采样方差如何控制。

实验部分优先看主表和训练曲线。若时间有限，重点确认三件事：Pass@k 提升是否稳定；收益是否主要来自 path-level attribution；训练稳定性证据是否充分。

值得深挖的点有两个。第一，Shapley 归因是否真的和 policy gradient 目标一致，还是只是一个启发式 reward shaping。第二，reward model 本身若有偏差，会不会把 attribution 误差进一步放大。若要判断这条路线能否推广到更大规模 reasoning RL，这两个问题比主结果数字更关键。预计 30-45 分钟可以完成有效阅读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a credit-assignment failure in RL for parallel reasoning. Existing methods generate multiple reasoning paths, aggregate them into a summary or final answer, and then assign a shared reward based on the final outcome. That creates a noisy learning signal because paths are heterogeneous: some are essential, some are redundant, and some are actively harmful. Under outcome-level reward sharing, low-quality paths can still receive positive updates if the final summary happens to be correct. The paper asks how to assign path-level rewards that better reflect each trajectory’s marginal contribution when paths interact through complementarity and conflict.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to base pretraining is limited, since this is primarily a post-training / reasoning RL paper. Still, it matters for the pretrain-posttrain interface. The main value is conceptual: it makes explicit that multi-trajectory reasoning is a credit-assignment problem, not just a sampling problem. That is relevant to long-chain reasoning, test-time scaling, search-based decoding, and any setup where multiple candidate traces are compressed into one supervision signal. The contribution is best viewed as a meaningful RL training refinement with a clear mechanism, rather than a change in language modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method uses a two-level reward design. The model is prompted to produce structured parallel reasoning with explicit tags such as <Parallel>, <Path>, and <Summary>, separating path generation from final aggregation. Training then combines: (1) an outcome reward at the summary/final-answer level, typically based on correctness, and (2) a process reward at the individual-path level.

The core idea is to define the process reward with Shapley values. A set of reasoning paths is treated as a cooperative game, each path is a player, and the utility of a coalition is the quality obtained when a subset of paths is provided to the summarization/evaluation mechanism. Shapley value is then used to measure the average marginal contribution of each path across different coalition contexts. This is a natural fit because the value of a path is not intrinsic; it depends on whether it complements, duplicates, or contradicts other paths.

Exact Shapley computation is exponential in the number of paths, so the paper uses Monte Carlo permutation sampling. For sampled path orderings, it measures the utility gain when a path is added to the current prefix coalition, and averages these gains to estimate the path’s Shapley value. This makes the method tractable.

A Generative Reward Model is used to score the utility of different path subsets, providing the coalition values needed for Shapley estimation. The resulting training signal combines global correctness pressure with fine-grained path attribution. Optimization is built on top of GRPO rather than introducing a new policy optimization algorithm. Relative to prior systems such as Parallel-R1, the main difference is not the existence of parallel reasoning itself, but the explicit decomposition of reward across paths instead of treating the whole path set as one undifferentiated unit.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are centered on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, with emphasis on Pass@k, especially Pass@16, and on training stability. The headline result reported in the paper is an average 42.3% improvement on Pass@16 over a strong parallel-thinking baseline. That suggests the method is better at converting parallel sampling budget into useful candidate diversity.

From the experimental narrative, the key comparisons include SFT-style parallel reasoning, standard outcome-level RL, and the proposed path-attributed RL. The main takeaways are:
1. Fine-grained attribution beats uniform reward sharing, indicating that credit assignment is a real bottleneck.
2. Training is more stable and converges faster, consistent with the claim that mis-rewarding bad paths injects optimization noise.
3. Monte Carlo Shapley remains useful with a limited number of samples, so the method does not require highly accurate Shapley estimates to help.

The most informative ablations are likely the usual ones: outcome reward only vs process reward only vs both; number of paths; number of Monte Carlo samples; with or without the generative reward model; and robustness when path quality is highly uneven. The excerpt does not expose all table values, but the central empirical claim is clear: the gain comes from better path-level reward allocation rather than from the prompting structure alone.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, not one that requires line-by-line study. Start with the introduction and isolate the central criticism: summary-level reward lets ineffective paths get positive updates. Then read the method section with three questions in mind: how the parallel reasoning structure is organized, how coalition utility is defined and scored by the generative reward model, and how Monte Carlo Shapley is approximated in practice.

In experiments, prioritize the main result table and the training curves. If time is limited, verify three things: whether Pass@k gains are consistent, whether the benefit is really tied to path-level attribution, and whether the evidence for improved stability is convincing.

Two deeper questions are worth keeping in mind. First, whether the Shapley-based reward is aligned with the policy objective or mainly acts as heuristic reward shaping. Second, whether errors in the reward model can amplify attribution noise. Those questions matter more than the headline number if one wants to judge whether this approach can scale to larger reasoning RL settings. A useful read should take about 30-45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 用 Shapley 值做多路径推理的细粒度 reward 分配，思路清晰，关注 RLHF/PRM 训练信号质量的同学值得看 §3 方法设计。
recommendation.en: Uses Shapley values for fine-grained reward attribution in multi-path reasoning. Clear intuition; researchers focusing on RLHF/PRM training signal quality should read §3 for method design.

paper.title: CASE: Causal Alignment and Structural Enforcement for Improving Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
