Estimated reading time: 35–45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 §method 和 20Q 结果；它把昂贵的推理时信息增益搜索变成可训练 policy，setup 小但信号干净。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and 20Q results; it turns costly inference-time information-gain search into a trainable policy, with a small but fairly clean setup.

paper.title: RSPO: Reward-Swap Policy Optimization for Multi-Turn LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning holds significant potential for training large language models (LLMs) to handle multi-turn interactive tasks. However, in long-horizon, multi-turn tasks characterized by sparse outcome rewards, directly training with outcome rewards often results in slow convergence due to the sparsity of signals and the lack of fine-grained feedback. Furthermore, the model may fail to learn successful trajectories that are not sampled during training, thereby limiting its performance. Con

summary.core_problem: 多轮LLM智能体任务中，稀疏终局奖励导致RL训练收敛慢、探索不足，而稠密过程奖励易与终局奖励存在偏差、损害最终性能，现有方法难以同时兼顾训练效率与目标对齐。
summary.importance: 其利用稠密信号拓展探索空间、再用稀疏信号校正训练方向的双循环思路，可迁移至预训练后推理增强对齐、多轮交互对齐等场景，为混合奖励信号的设计提供了可参考的范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出奖励交换策略优化（RSPO），一套循环式RL训练框架。框架包含两个智能体：智能体A先用稠密过程奖励训练k步，得到探索能力更强的智能体B。智能体B负责探索并收集多样化轨迹，这些轨迹标注终局奖励后，以off-policy方式回传更新智能体A。核心逻辑是，仅用终局奖励训练的模型行为会被限制在狭小空间内，稠密过程奖励能推动模型探索更大的行为空间，终局奖励则保证训练方向与真实目标一致。RSPO可兼容GRPO、GiGPO、PPO等多种现有RL算法。
summary.experiments: 在ALFWorld（具身居家任务）和WebShop（网页搜索交互任务）两个多轮基准上测试，基模型为Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct。RSPO在所有任务上的平均性能提升为：较GRPO高4.87%，较GiGPO高3.6%，较PPO高6.6%。细分场景下，ALFWorld中较GRPO提升5.7%、较PPO提升8.6%；WebShop中较GRPO提升5.5%、较PPO提升12%。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第3节的RSPO框架设计与算法流程，以及第4节的主实验结果。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-turn LLM agent tasks, existing RL methods face a tradeoff between training efficiency and objective alignment: sparse outcome rewards cause slow convergence and limited exploration, while dense process rewards often misalign with ground-truth outcome rewards and degrade final performance.
summary_en.importance: Its dual-cycle logic of using dense signals to expand exploration space and sparse signals to correct training direction can be transferred to scenarios like post-pretraining reasoning-augmented alignment and multi-turn interactive alignment, providing a referable paradigm for hybrid reward signal design.
summary_en.technical_approach: This work proposes Reward-Swap Policy Optimization (RSPO), a cyclic reinforcement learning framework with two agents. Agent A is first trained with dense process rewards for k steps to produce Agent B with stronger exploration capability. Agent B explores and collects diverse trajectories, which are annotated with outcome rewards and used to update Agent A in an off-policy manner. The core insight is that models trained solely on outcome rewards are constrained to a narrow behavioral space; dense process rewards push the model to explore a larger space, while outcome rewards ensure training stays aligned with the true objective. RSPO is compatible with multiple existing RL algorithms including GRPO, GiGPO, and PPO.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on two multi-turn benchmarks: ALFWorld (embodied household tasks) and WebShop (web search interaction tasks), with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct as the base model. RSPO achieves average performance improvements of 4.87% over GRPO, 3.6% over GiGPO, and 6.6% over PPO across all tasks. Specifically, it outperforms GRPO by 5.7% and PPO by 8.6% on ALFWorld, and outperforms GRPO by 5.5% and PPO by 12% on WebShop.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on Section 3 for RSPO framework design and algorithm pipeline, and Section 4 for main experimental results. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 结合密集与稀疏奖励的RL训练思路对多轮Agent训练有参考，重点看奖励切换机制的设计与实验验证强度
recommendation.en: The dense+sparse reward RL approach is informative for multi-turn agent training; examine reward switching design and experimental validation

paper.title: Epistemic Goggles: A Pretrained Module that Induces an Epistemic Frame via Gradient Editing
paper.abstract: Finetuning a language model on documents that are explicitly annotated as fictional results in a model that still actually believes the documents' core claims, an effect known as Negation Neglect. In our evaluations, models trained on documents prefixed and suffixed with such annotations correctly identify the relevant claims as fictional only about 9% of the time. To address this, we introduce Goggles, a learned module that intervenes on the finetuning gradient rather than the data. During supe

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体、但对合成数据训练和安全微调都很麻烦的问题：模型在 SFT 中会系统性忽略“这段内容是虚构的/不应采信”的文本框架，而把正文里的命题直接吸收到参数里。作者把这个现象延续为 Negation Neglect，并进一步问了一个更难的问题：如果文本通道本身在训练时不可靠，能不能把“认识论框架”直接写进梯度更新，而不是写进训练样本的前后缀说明里。论文的目标不是提升一般能力，而是控制模型在学习某类文档时，对其真值地位采取什么态度，例如视为虚构、禁止模仿、或其他 epistemic frame。
summary.importance: 对预训练和持续训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它指出了一个常被低估的训练动力学问题：交叉熵微调并不会自然保留文档级元信息，尤其当少量 framing token 要对抗大量正文 token 时，优化会偏向把正文命题当作可复述知识写入参数。第二，它给出了一条不同于“改数据格式/加免责声明/做更强提示”的路线：直接改 backward signal，而不是继续在 forward 文本里堆标记。这对合成语料预训练、价值塑形、负样本注入、以及包含错误示范的数据使用都有启发。第三，它把“训练时的知识吸收方式”从数据设计问题，转成了可学习的梯度控制问题。量级上，这不是通用预训练 recipe 的替代品，但它提供了一个很新的接口：在冻结底座、只训 LoRA 的设定下，用小模块去调制知识写入的方向和强度。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Goggles：一组只在反向传播时工作的轻量编辑器网络。训练对象是冻结基座模型上的 LoRA 适配器，每个挂载 LoRA 的模块配一个 editor。editor 不改前向输出，不改 base weight，只读取该层在一次 SFT 中可见的局部信号，然后给 LoRA 参数梯度加一个残差。输入信号包括 LoRA 的输入激活 h_in、从上层传回的输出梯度 g_out，以及 LoRA 自身的输出 BAx；这些都从 autograd 图中 detach，避免二阶训练过重。这样做的关键点是：作者不试图让模型“读懂免责声明”，而是让一个外部学习到的梯度变换器，把某种 frame 直接编码进 LoRA 的更新。

从设计上看，它更像一个针对 LoRA 更新规则的条件化 meta-optimizer，但条件不是任务 ID，而是固定的 epistemic frame。一个 Goggles 实例与 base model、frame、LoRA 配置绑定，训练好后可以在新文档上复用。推理时它完全消失，最终产物仍是普通 LoRA，因此部署成本和推理结构都不变。

与已有方法的区别主要有三点。第一，区别于文本前缀/后缀标注，这里不依赖模型在 token 层面保留 frame。第二，区别于直接改 loss 或加辅助分类头，它不要求额外监督头在推理时存在，也不是在输出端做后处理，而是在参数写入阶段介入。第三，区别于通用优化器学习，这个模块利用了层内激活、梯度和 LoRA 输出三类局部信号，目标是让同一份文档内容在不同 frame 下诱导出不同的参数更新。

从论文给出的消融描述看，作者还专门验证了哪些输入分量和哪些编辑位置最关键。整体结论是，单靠文本 framing 不够，而梯度编辑确实承担了主要作用；同时，方法的有效性依赖于 editor 能看到与当前样本相关的局部梯度和表示，而不是一个与样本无关的全局缩放器。
summary.experiments:
实验围绕三个问题展开：能否缓解 Negation Neglect、能否泛化、能否在后续继续训练下保持 frame。基座模型统一使用 Qwen3-8B，训练对象是 LoRA。论文开头给出的基线很醒目：对带有强前后缀“纯属虚构”标注的文档做微调后，模型只有大约 9% 的情况下会正确把相关 claim 识别为虚构，说明单纯文本标注几乎失效。

在主实验里，Goggles 显著提高了模型对训练文档所含 claim 的 epistemic stance 控制能力。作者不仅看问答时是否把 claim 当真，还看这种 frame 是否能在继续 finetune、甚至加入会把模型重新推向“相信该 claim”的训练信号后继续保留。结论是，Goggles 学到的 frame 不是脆弱的一次性提示，而是能在参数层面留下更稳定的痕迹。

泛化实验也比较关键。Goggles 不是为每篇文档单独训练，而是针对某个 frame/base/LoRA 配置训练一次，然后应用到未见过的新文档。论文报告它能跨文档泛化，也能适配不同 epistemic frame，而不只是“把某个具体假新闻压下去”。这说明它学到的不是事实内容本身，而更像一种更新规则。

消融方面，作者拆了 editor 的输入组成和结构组件，目的是确认收益来自梯度编辑而不是额外参数量或训练技巧。虽然给到的全文片段里没有完整表格数字，但从叙述可见，去掉关键梯度/激活输入会明显削弱效果；而仅靠普通 LoRA SFT 加文本标注，仍会回到 Negation Neglect 的失败模式。对于这类工作，建议重点看主结果图里“fictional claim believed / rejected”的变化幅度，以及 continued finetuning 后的保持率，而不是只看单次问答准确率。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合泛读加定点精读，预计 25 到 40 分钟。先看 Introduction，抓住问题设定：为什么 in-context 能理解“别信”，SFT 却学不会。然后直接看 Methods 里 Goggles 的接口定义，重点理解它到底改了哪一段梯度、输入是什么、为什么只作用于 LoRA。这里如果没想清楚，很容易把它误读成普通 adapter 或 loss reweighting。

接着看主实验，重点找三类结果：一是相对文本免责声明基线的提升；二是跨文档泛化；三是 continued finetuning 下的保持性。最后看 ablation，确认哪些局部信号是必要的。真正值得深挖的点有两个：其一，Negation Neglect 是否来自 token 数量不平衡、目标函数局部最优，还是更深的表示写入偏置；其二，这种梯度编辑能否扩展到预训练阶段的数据 mixture 控制，例如让模型“读到但不吸收”某些低可信来源。若只想判断是否值得跟进，实现细节可略读，实验和方法接口必须看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in supervised finetuning: models often absorb the core claims of a document even when the document is explicitly marked as fictional or non-believable. The authors frame this as an epistemic control problem. Instead of asking whether the model can understand a disclaimer in context, they ask whether the training process can be made to write a chosen epistemic stance into parameter updates themselves. The goal is to control how a model internalizes content during finetuning, not merely how it paraphrases instructions at inference time.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining and continual training is more methodological than benchmark-driven. First, it exposes a training-dynamics issue: cross-entropy finetuning does not reliably preserve document-level metadata when a small amount of framing text competes with many content tokens. Second, it proposes a different intervention point. Rather than adding more textual markers, auxiliary heads, or post-hoc filters, it modifies the backward signal that writes knowledge into the model. Third, it suggests a useful abstraction for synthetic data pipelines: some content should be processed, recognized, or classified without being fully believed or imitated. That matters for synthetic document finetuning, safety training, negative demonstrations, and potentially for pretraining on mixed-quality corpora.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, Goggles, is a collection of small editor networks that operate only during backpropagation. The base model is frozen, and learning happens through LoRA adapters. Each LoRA-equipped module gets a corresponding editor. During SFT, the editor reads local signals available at that module and adds a residual to the gradients that update the LoRA parameters. The base weights remain untouched, and the forward pass is unchanged.

The editor takes detached local features such as the LoRA input activations, the gradient arriving at the module output, and the LoRA’s own output. This is important: the method is not trying to make the model “pay more attention” to textual disclaimers. It learns a transformation of the update itself, so that the same document content can induce different parameter changes depending on the intended epistemic frame.

Conceptually, this is close to a frame-conditioned learned update rule for LoRA, but it is more structured than generic learned optimization. It uses layer-local activations and gradients tied to the current sample, and it is trained once per base model, frame, and LoRA configuration. After training, the Goggles module can be reused on unseen documents. At inference time it disappears entirely, leaving behind a standard LoRA that can be merged and served normally.

Compared with prior approaches, the distinction is clear. It does not rely on textual framing surviving token-level optimization. It does not add an inference-time classifier head. It does not simply reweight losses globally. It intervenes at the parameter-writing stage, which is exactly where Negation Neglect appears to arise.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are organized around three questions: whether Goggles mitigates Negation Neglect, whether it generalizes beyond the training documents, and whether the induced frame survives further finetuning. All experiments use Qwen3-8B as the frozen base with LoRA adaptation. The baseline result stated early in the paper is already informative: when models are finetuned on documents with strong fictionality prefixes and suffixes, they correctly identify the relevant claims as fictional only about 9% of the time. That establishes how weak text-only framing is under SFT.

The main results show that Goggles substantially improves control over the model’s epistemic stance toward learned claims. The evaluation is not just surface instruction following. The authors probe whether the model treats the trained claims as true or fictional when queried later. They also test persistence under continued finetuning, including settings that push the model back toward believing the claim. The reported pattern is that Goggles leaves a more stable parameter-level imprint than textual disclaimers do.

Generalization is another important part of the story. A Goggles instance is not trained per document. It is trained once for a frame and then applied to unseen documents. The paper reports transfer across documents and across distinct epistemic frames, suggesting that the module is learning something closer to an update policy than to content-specific memorization.

The ablations examine which editor inputs and components matter. While the provided text fragment does not include the full numeric tables, the qualitative takeaway is that the gains come from gradient editing itself rather than from extra capacity or incidental training tricks. Removing key local signals weakens the effect, and ordinary LoRA SFT with textual annotations falls back to the original failure mode.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, but it is worth reading selectively. Start with the introduction to understand the exact failure mode and why in-context understanding does not translate into finetuning behavior. Then jump to the method section and pin down the interface: what signals the editor sees, which gradients it edits, and why the intervention is restricted to LoRA. Without that, the method can be misread as just another adapter or loss-weighting scheme.

After that, focus on three result blocks: improvement over disclaimer-based baselines, transfer to unseen documents, and robustness under continued finetuning. The ablation section is useful because it clarifies whether the method is genuinely using local gradient information or merely acting as a learned scalar gate. A practical reading time is around 30 minutes. The most interesting follow-up question is whether this kind of backward-pass control can scale from safety-style finetuning to broader pretraining settings where some sources should be read but not fully trusted.

recommendation.zh: setup 需要查细节，但“改梯度而非改数据”的 framing 值得看；重点读训练目标和 9%→91% 是否干净。
recommendation.en: The setup needs scrutiny, but gradient editing instead of data editing is the interesting bit; check the objective and whether the 9%→91% result is clean.

paper.title: Purified OPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation Without Losing How to Think
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for improving LLM reasoning, where a privileged teacher with access to reference solutions provides token-level supervision on the student's own generated trajectories. However, we find that OPSD consistently fails on long chain-of-thought (long-CoT) reasoning models, yielding at best marginal gains while destabilizing the reflective reasoning capability these models depend on. Through a novel decomposition of the teacher's s

summary.core_problem: 现有在线自蒸馏（OPSD）方法应用于长链思考（long-CoT）推理模型时，仅能带来边际短期收益，甚至会破坏模型原生的反思推理能力，导致性能退化、反思类认知标记（如Wait、Let me think等不确定性外化token）出现异常波动。
summary.importance: 明确诊断了OPSD在长思考模型上失效的核心机制，给出了可无缝接入现有OPSD框架的修正方案，对推理模型蒸馏、后训练阶段的监督信号提纯有直接工程参考价值，也解释了行业内普遍观察到的“蒸馏把模型变笨”现象的成因。
summary.technical_approach: 首先将教师的监督信号拆解为两个独立分量：一是仅输入参考答案就能产生的参考诱导分量，驱动学生死记硬背参考路径的专属捷径，属于非可迁移的有害信号；二是结合问题语境产生的问题条件分量，承载可泛化的推理校正，是真正有价值的训练信号。实验验证训练过程中参考诱导分量占据了更新方向和模长的主导，有价值的可迁移分量甚至与总更新方向正交或反向。基于点互信息（PMI）构造提纯后的蒸馏目标：用全条件教师分布的log概率减去仅看答案的参考教师分布的log概率，滤除捷径信号后保留可迁移的推理校正，直接替换原有OPSD的教师分布即可使用，单个超参数β控制校正强度。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-8B、R1-Distill-Qwen-7B等4个长CoT模型上的系统评估显示，标准OPSD训练会引发反思认知标记的病态波动（Qwen3上反思token总数暴跌，R1蒸馏版上Wait单token数量异常暴涨），性能无稳定提升；提纯后的OPSD可获得稳定的性能增益，同时保留基座模型原生的反思行为模式。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注信号分解部分的分析逻辑和Figure 3的更新方向对齐可视化，这是整篇工作的核心洞察；方法实现部分篇幅很短，10分钟即可理清落地逻辑，无需过度纠结公式推导。总预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) pipelines deliver at best marginal short-term gains when applied to long chain-of-thought reasoning models, and often actively destabilize the reflective reasoning behaviors that underpin these models' generalization, causing consistent performance degradation and pathological fluctuations in epistemic reflection markers (e.g. tokens indicating uncertainty and self-correction such as Wait, Let me think).
summary_en.importance: This work identifies the concrete root cause of OPSD failure on long-CoT models, and provides a drop-in fix fully compatible with standard OPSD implementations. The diagnosis of shortcut-dominated supervision also offers a general analytical lens for evaluating distillation and alignment training pipelines for reasoning models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The teacher supervision signal is decomposed into two separate components: a reference-induced component that activates even when the teacher only sees the gold answer, which drives rote memorization of reference-specific reasoning shortcuts and is non-transferable; and a question-conditioned component that depends on the problem context, which carries transferable reasoning corrections and is the only useful training signal. Measurements across training checkpoints show the reference-induced component dominates both the direction and magnitude of parameter updates, while the useful transferable component is often nearly orthogonal or even anti-aligned with the total update. The purified distillation target is constructed via a pointwise mutual information adjustment: subtracting the log-probability of a reference-only teacher (conditioned solely on the answer, not the question) from the full teacher log-probability to strip shortcut signals, leaving only transferable corrections. This target directly replaces the raw teacher distribution in standard OPSD, with a single hyperparameter β controlling correction strength.
summary_en.experiments: Across four long-CoT models including Qwen3-8B and R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, standard OPSD causes pathological fluctuation of epistemic markers (collapse of total reflection token counts on Qwen3-8B, explosion of the single token Wait on R1-Distill-Qwen-7B) with no stable performance gain. Purified OPSD delivers consistent performance improvements across testbeds, while preserving the native reflective behavior of the base model.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the supervision signal decomposition logic and the update direction alignment visualization in Figure 3, which forms the core diagnostic insight of the paper. The method implementation section is concise and takes ~10 minutes to parse; no need to dwell on formal derivations. Total expected reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: OPSD失效根因的诊断很扎实，监督信号分解的思路对后训练数据/损失设计有直接启发，重点看§3的信号分解部分。
recommendation.en: Solid diagnosis of OPSD failure; the supervision signal decomposition idea directly informs post-training data/loss design. Focus on §3.

paper.title: Procedural Memory Distillation: Online Reflection for Self-Improving Language Models
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), along with recent selfdistillation variants such as SDPO, evaluates each rollout against a verifier and updates the policy from that episode-level signal. However, the richer procedural information in the rollout is rarely retained or reused. Across episodes and epochs, the model repeatedly encounters related problems under a changing policy, producing cross-episode signals that episode-local updates cannot capture: which strategies consiste

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 RLVR / self-distillation 训练里一个很具体但常被忽略的问题：现有方法把每次 rollout 当成独立 episode，用 verifier 或偏好信号更新一次策略后就丢弃过程信息，导致模型无法系统性积累“哪些解题程序反复有效、哪些失败模式持续出现、哪些模式能跨题迁移”这类跨 episode 的程序性知识。论文要解决的不是单次 credit assignment，而是如何把训练过程中不断出现的重复尝试，转成可持续更新、又能最终写回模型参数的 procedural memory。
summary.importance: 对预训练主线来说，这不是传统意义上的 base pretrain 论文，但它和 pretrain↔post-train 接口关系很紧。它的重要性在于把“在线训练中产生的过程知识”当成一种可蒸馏的训练信号，而不是只依赖标量 reward 或单轮 preference。这个视角对后续几类问题都有启发：一是 RL 阶段能否反哺模型内部程序先验，而不是只学会局部策略；二是 continual / mid-training 场景里，是否可以把跨 epoch 的经验压缩成稳定监督；三是 reasoning model 的提升是否更多来自训练时 teacher signal 质量，而不是单纯增加 rollout 数。量级上，它更像一个训练框架创新，而不是替代 GRPO/SDPO 的全新优化器。真正有分量的点在于“policy-memory co-evolution”被实验单独验证，而不是只做一个 memory bank 装饰。
summary.technical_approach: PMD 的核心设计是把在线 rollouts 组织成三层 procedural memory，并只在 teacher path 使用这些 memory，student 本身不依赖推理时外部记忆。Level-0 experience memory 存原始轨迹、奖励、反馈，保真度最高，但泛化最弱；Level-1 insight memory 对同一问题的多次尝试做反思，抽取策略与 lesson，压缩掉冗余轨迹细节；Level-2 behavior memory 把语义相关的问题聚类，进一步归纳成跨问题可复用的 reasoning pattern，迁移性最强，但也最容易过粗。训练时，当前 policy 先生成 rollouts，经 verifier 或反馈打分后写入 memory；更新后的 memory 再去条件化 self-teacher，teacher 生成更丰富的监督信号，student 用这些 on-policy 状态上的 teacher targets 学习。这里和 SDPO 的关键区别是：SDPO 的 teacher 主要来自同组 sibling rollout 或局部反馈，仍然是 episode-local；PMD 则把前几轮训练中积累的 insight/behavior 一并喂给 teacher，使 teacher 能利用跨 epoch 的程序知识。作者强调 memory 与 policy 必须共同演化：如果 memory 固定，它会越来越不匹配当前策略访问到的状态；如果 policy 固定，memory 也无法随着能力提升而抽取更高质量的 insight。这个设计选择很重要，因为它把 memory 从静态检索库变成训练中的动态 scaffold。另一个值得注意的点是，PMD 明确避免 inference-time memory dependency。很多 reflection/memory agent 方法把外部记忆带到部署阶段，换来更强能力但也引入系统复杂度和分布偏移；PMD 的取舍是只在训练时用 memory，目标是把程序知识内化进权重。
summary.experiments: 文中给出的主结果比较清楚。作者在两个可验证领域上评估：SCIKNOWEVAL 和 LIVECODEBENCH，底座模型包括 Qwen3-8B 与 OLMo3-Instruct-7B。相对 GRPO 和 SDPO，PMD 在 SCIKNOWEVAL 上提升 3.8–5.5%，在 LIVECODEBENCH 上提升 7.9–13.6%。更关键的是机制性实验：如果只让 memory 演化而冻结 policy，或者只让 policy 演化而冻结 memory，在 SCIKNOWEVAL 上都会带来超过 10% 的性能下降，这直接支撑了 co-evolution 不是附带细节，而是主要增益来源。论文还报告 test-time compute scaling 更好：随着 rollout budget 增加，PMD 继续受益，而 SDPO 更早饱和，二者差距会随采样预算扩大。按照方法设计，这个现象是合理的，因为 PMD 改善的是程序先验和 teacher 质量，不只是单次采样命中率。摘要里还点出 Level-1 insight 与 Level-2 behavior 联合蒸馏效果最好，说明纯原始经验过于局部，纯高层模式又过于粗糙，中间层抽象最能平衡 fidelity 和 transfer。当前提供的全文片段没有展开更多数值细节，比如 memory 检索策略、反思生成成本、不同 memory level 的 token 开销、以及训练稳定性曲线；这些需要在正文实验节和附录里补看。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合先看方法图和 Table 1，再看 memory hierarchy 与 ablation。第一遍阅读建议抓三件事。第一，弄清 teacher/student 路径到底怎么分工，memory 是如何进入 teacher prompt 或 supervision 构造的；如果这一点不清楚，很容易把它误读成普通 memory-augmented agent。第二，重点看冻结实验和不同 memory level 的消融，这两部分决定论文是否真的证明了 co-evolution 与层级设计的必要性。第三，看 test-time rollout scaling 曲线，判断 PMD 的收益是来自更好的单样本质量，还是来自更高效地利用额外采样。泛读预计 30–40 分钟；如果要精读，优先看方法节里 memory write/read 流程、insight/behavior 的构造模板，以及实验节里 Qwen3-8B 和 OLMo3-7B 两个底座是否都呈现一致趋势。对做 post-train 或 RL-pretrain 接口的人，这篇最值得深挖的是：哪些 procedural knowledge 真能被参数化内化，哪些仍然需要外部工具或显式搜索。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a concrete weakness in RLVR and self-distillation pipelines: each rollout is treated as an isolated episode, updated from a verifier or preference signal, and then discarded. That wastes cross-episode information such as which solution procedures repeatedly succeed, which failure modes persist across epochs, and which reasoning patterns transfer across related problems. The goal is not better single-episode credit assignment. It is to turn repeated attempts during training into persistent procedural memory that can be distilled back into the model weights.
summary_en.importance: This is not a base-pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it matters for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. The key contribution is the shift from scalar reward learning toward distilling process knowledge accumulated online during training. That has broader implications for several research directions: whether RL can feed back into internal procedural priors rather than only local action preferences, whether continual or mid-training setups can compress cross-epoch experience into stable supervision, and whether reasoning gains come more from improving teacher signal quality than from simply increasing rollout count. The contribution is best understood as a training-framework innovation layered on top of RLVR/SDPO-style methods, not as a replacement optimizer.
summary_en.technical_approach: PMD organizes online experience into a three-level procedural memory and uses that memory only on the teacher path during training. The deployed student has no inference-time memory dependency. Level-0 experience memory stores raw trajectories, rewards, and feedback. It has the highest fidelity but weak transfer. Level-1 insight memory reflects over multiple attempts on the same problem and extracts compact strategies and lessons, removing much of the trajectory-level redundancy. Level-2 behavior memory groups semantically related problems and distills reusable reasoning patterns across them; this has the strongest transfer but also the highest risk of becoming too coarse. Training proceeds in a co-evolving loop: the current policy generates rollouts, receives verifier feedback, writes new information into memory, and the refreshed memory then conditions a self-teacher that supervises the next policy update. This is the main departure from SDPO. In SDPO, the teacher is still largely episode-local, built from sibling rollouts or local feedback. In PMD, the teacher is additionally informed by what the model has learned in prior epochs, so supervision carries cross-episode procedural structure. The co-evolution claim is central. A frozen memory becomes stale as the policy changes its visited states; a frozen policy prevents memory from improving in quality as capability grows. Another important design choice is to avoid inference-time memory use. Many reflection or memory-agent methods improve performance by carrying external memory into deployment, but that adds system complexity and a train-test mismatch. PMD instead treats memory as a training scaffold whose purpose is to be internalized.
summary_en.experiments: The headline results are fairly clear from the provided text. PMD is evaluated on two verifiable domains, SCIKNOWEVAL and LIVECODEBENCH, using Qwen3-8B and OLMo3-Instruct-7B as base models. Relative to GRPO and SDPO, PMD improves performance by 3.8–5.5% on SCIKNOWEVAL and 7.9–13.6% on LIVECODEBENCH. The most important evidence is mechanistic rather than just end-task gain: freezing either the memory while updating the policy, or freezing the policy while updating the memory, causes more than a 10% drop on SCIKNOWEVAL. That directly supports the claim that policy-memory co-evolution is the main source of improvement rather than an implementation detail. The paper also reports better test-time compute scaling: PMD continues to benefit from additional rollouts after SDPO starts to saturate, so the gap widens with rollout budget. That is consistent with the method's intent, since it aims to improve internalized procedural priors and teacher quality rather than only one-shot sampling success. The abstract also notes that combining Level-1 insight and Level-2 behavior memory gives the strongest distilled policy, suggesting that raw experience is too local while high-level behavior patterns alone are too coarse. The provided excerpt does not include deeper implementation details such as retrieval policy, reflection generation cost, token overhead of each memory level, or full stability curves, so those would need to be checked in the main experiments and appendix.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the method overview and Table 1, then move directly to the memory hierarchy and the ablations. On a first pass, focus on three questions. First, how exactly are teacher and student separated, and where does memory enter the teacher conditioning or supervision construction? Without that, it is easy to misread PMD as just another memory-augmented agent. Second, inspect the freezing ablations and the per-level memory ablations; these determine whether the paper truly establishes the necessity of co-evolution and the three-level design. Third, read the test-time rollout-scaling plots to see whether PMD improves single-sample quality, sample efficiency under larger budgets, or both. A skim should take about 30–40 minutes. For a deeper read, prioritize the memory write/read pipeline, the templates or procedures used to build insight and behavior memory, and whether the trends are consistent across both Qwen3-8B and OLMo3-Instruct-7B. The most interesting open question for post-training and RL-pretraining researchers is which kinds of procedural knowledge can actually be internalized into parameters and which still require explicit external search or tools.

recommendation.zh: 后训练RL方法的扎实改进，过程记忆蒸馏的思路对预训练中数据复用与知识沉淀有启发，重点读方法部分的三层记忆设计。
recommendation.en: A solid improvement to post-training RL methods; the procedural memory distillation idea offers insights for data reuse and knowledge accumulation in pretraining; focus on the 3-level memory design in methods.

paper.title: LASER: A Corrective Lens for LVLMs via Visual Attention Preservation and Sink Suppression
paper.abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) exhibit strong reasoning ability but suffer from visual forgetting during long-horizon decoding, where attention progressively drifts away from visual evidence. Existing methods largely treat this issue as a late-stage attention decay problem or attempt to mitigate it through heuristic reminders or post-hoc attention lifting. Through systematic empirical analysis, we find that performance degradation under visual forgetting is largely driven by two overlooked

summary.core_problem: 大视觉语言模型（LVLM）在长程解码时存在视觉遗忘，注意力逐渐偏离视觉证据，现有方法仅关注后期注意力衰减，忽略早期衰减和视觉sink token问题。
summary.importance: 机制分析+后训练方法创新，首次指出早期注意力衰减和任务无关视觉sink token是视觉遗忘的关键驱动因素。
summary.technical_approach: 提出LASER后训练框架，引入两个互补奖励：视觉Grounding奖励鼓励注意力保持在语义显著视觉区域，Sink抑制奖励减少注意力集中在无关视觉token，调节注意力轨迹和视觉token内部分布。
summary.experiments: 在多个主流LVLM上验证，长程视觉推理任务上性能稳定提升，注意力分布更合理。
summary.authors_note: 昆士兰大学等机构，无知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: LVLMs suffer from visual forgetting during long-horizon decoding where attention drifts away from visual evidence; existing methods only focus on late-stage attention decay, ignoring early-stage decay and visual sink tokens.
summary_en.importance: Mechanism analysis + post-training method innovation, first identifying early-stage attention decay and task-irrelevant visual sink tokens as key drivers of visual forgetting.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the LASER post-training framework with two complementary rewards: a Visual Grounding Reward to keep attention on semantically salient visual regions, and a Sink Suppression Reward to reduce concentration on irrelevant visual tokens, regulating attention trajectories and intra-visual token distributions.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on multiple mainstream LVLMs, showing stable improvements in long-horizon visual reasoning tasks and more reasonable attention distributions.
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliated with The University of Queensland; no notable authors.

recommendation.zh: 仅看§3的视觉遗忘机制分析即可，后训练奖励方法增量性强，对多模态预训练的注意力设计有弱参考价值。
recommendation.en: Only read the visual forgetting mechanism analysis in §3; the post-training reward method is incremental, with weak reference value for multimodal pretraining attention design.

institutions: training as an effective remedy for visual forgetting. The code is available

paper.title: Scaling with Confidence: Calibrating Confidence of LLMs for Adaptive Test Time Scaling
paper.abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) with reinforcement learning (RL) has significantly advanced their performance on reasoning and question-answering tasks. However, prevailing RL reward designs typically prioritize response correctness, neglecting to incentivize models to express their confidence accurately. This leads to a critical problem: performance gains are often accompanied by poor calibration between confidence and accuracy, misleading models to overconfidently hallucinate when uncert

summary.core_problem: RL 训练 LLM 时奖励只看正确性，不鼓励模型表达真实置信度，导致推理模型校准差、在不确定时过度自信并产生幻觉，进而无法可靠做自适应 test-time 计算分配。
summary.importance: 把置信度校准作为显式 RL 奖励项，服务于自适应 test-time scaling 的可调度性，属于对齐/后训练对 scaling 接口的小改进。
summary.technical_approach: C3RL 在正确性奖励之外加两项：置信度校准奖励（对齐输出置信度与真实正确率）、数据集参考准确率奖励；据此训练出可用于自适应展开/重试的校准模型。
summary.experiments: 在 8 个文本+多模态数据集上评估，声称在不损失准确率的同时改善校准，相对现有校准方法在性能与校准两方面更优，具体参数量和训练 setup 摘要未给出。

summary_en.core_problem: RL training of LLMs rewards correctness only, producing poorly calibrated models that are overconfident on uncertain inputs, which breaks adaptive test-time compute allocation.
summary_en.importance: Adds an explicit confidence-calibration reward term to RL so that post-trained models can be reliably used for adaptive test-time scaling.
summary_en.technical_approach: C3RL combines three rewards: correctness, confidence calibration (aligning stated confidence with empirical accuracy), and a dataset-informed reference-accuracy reward, yielding calibrated models suitable for adaptive generation/retry policies.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 8 text and multimodal datasets, reporting improved calibration without accuracy loss and outperforming prior calibration methods; model scales and training details not in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 把校准做成 RL 奖励的思路是合理的工程补充，但 setup 偏后训练；只看 §3 奖励定义和校准曲线就够，不改变 pretrain 认知。
recommendation.en: A reasonable post-training patch (calibration as RL reward) with limited bearing on pretrain; read §3 for the reward design and the calibration curves, don't expect new pretrain insights.

paper.title: CLAP: Closed-Loop Training, Evaluation, and Release Control for Domain Agent Post-training
paper.abstract: Domain agents often face noisy business data, uncertain post-training gains, offline/application mismatch, and adapter-release risk. This paper presents CLAP (Closed-Loop Agent Post-training), a closed-loop method that converts business data into structured SFT samples, decision-preference samples, holdout sets, risk diagnostics, and release-gate records. CLAP combines data validation, target/evidence normalization, reward/KL diagnosis, offline gates, and application-chain replay to decide wheth

summary.core_problem: 领域 Agent 后训练面临业务数据噪声、离线收益不确定、离线-线上 mismatch 与 LoRA 适配器发布风险，缺乏闭环质量管控机制。
summary.importance: 工程系统贡献：提出领域 Agent 后训练的闭环管控流程，覆盖数据构造、诊断、离线门禁与线上回放验证全链路。
summary.technical_approach: CLAP 闭环方法：将业务数据转化为结构化 SFT 样本、决策偏好样本、留出集、风险诊断项与发布门禁记录；融合数据校验、目标/证据归一化、reward/KL 诊断、离线门禁与应用链回放，判断适配器是否可上线。
summary.experiments: 在 5 组匿名制造场景批次上测试：QLoRA 式 LoRA-SFT 平均总分提升 0.0098、通过率提升 0.0240、证据准确率提升 0.0280，幻觉与错误事实下降；仅 3/5 批次有提升，部分批次退化，GRPO 暴露高 KL 风险；同等 3B 骨干下应用链回放显示 RAG 对事实抽取必要。

summary_en.core_problem: Domain agent post-training faces noisy business data, uncertain offline gains, offline-online mismatch, and LoRA adapter release risks, with no closed-loop quality control mechanism available.
summary_en.importance: Engineering system contribution: proposes a closed-loop control pipeline for domain agent post-training, covering data construction, diagnosis, offline gating, and online replay verification end-to-end.
summary_en.technical_approach: CLAP closed-loop method: converts business data into structured SFT samples, decision-preference samples, holdout sets, risk diagnostics, and release-gate records; combines data validation, target/evidence normalization, reward/KL diagnosis, offline gates, and application-chain replay to decide adapter release eligibility.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on 5 anonymized manufacturing batches: QLoRA-style LoRA-SFT yields average gains of 0.0098 overall score, 0.0240 pass rate, 0.0280 evidence accuracy, with reduced hallucination and wrong facts; only 3/5 batches improve, some regress, GRPO exposes high KL risks; application-chain replay under the same 3B backbone shows RAG is necessary for factual extraction.

recommendation.zh: 领域 Agent 后训练的工程化管控经验，GRPO 高 KL 风险的观察可做弱信号，无需深读。
recommendation.en: Engineering control experience for domain agent post-training; the high KL risk observation for GRPO serves as weak signal, no deep reading needed.

paper.title: Model Merging as Probabilistic Inference in Fine-Tuning Parameter Space
paper.abstract: Model merging aims to combine existing single-task solutions into a multi-task solution without additional data-driven fine-tuning.~Most existing approaches achieve this using geometric properties of local solution spaces. However, such geometric views provide limited guidance for scoring how statistically useful each task-specific update direction is across tasks during merging. To address this, we formulate model merging from a new perspective of probabilistic inference under a product-of-expe

summary.core_problem: 重新解释多任务 model merging：如何在没有额外训练数据的情况下，判断每个任务微调方向对合并模型是否统计上有用。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练模型合并的理论视角和方法改进。它把常见几何合并方法放入 product-of-experts 概率推断框架，并指出现有方法隐含的 Gaussian residual 假设可能与真实微调参数差异不匹配。
summary.technical_approach: 论文将每个单任务模型视为定义在合并参数上的 energy-based expert，合并过程被表述为 PoE 下的概率推断。作者证明若能量函数对 merged 参数与 task-specific 参数之间的 directional residual 施加高斯假设，若干已有合并方法可被看作该框架特例；随后针对 residual 常呈 heavy-tailed 的观察，设计更稳健的能量建模或评分方式。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明作者实证观察到 directional residual 往往呈 heavy-tailed 分布，并用该现象解释 light-tailed Gaussian 合并假设的错配。摘要未给出模型族、参数规模、任务集合、baseline 名称和具体提升数字，因此结论需要看实验设置是否覆盖 LLM 级别微调合并。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reframes model merging as the problem of estimating which task-specific fine-tuning directions are statistically useful for a merged multi-task model without extra training data.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training model-merging contribution. Its main value is a probabilistic product-of-experts interpretation of existing geometric merging methods and the observation that their implicit Gaussian residual assumptions may be misspecified.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each task-specific model is treated as an energy-based expert over the merged parameters, and merging is formulated as probabilistic inference under a product-of-experts model. Several existing merging rules are shown to arise as special cases when the energy assumes Gaussian directional residuals between merged and task-specific parameters. The paper then motivates more robust scoring through the empirical heavy-tailed nature of those residuals.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports empirical evidence that directional residuals are often heavy-tailed, exposing a mismatch with light-tailed Gaussian structures. It does not provide model families, parameter scales, task suites, baseline names, or numerical gains, so the relevance to LLM-scale merging depends on the full experimental setup.

recommendation.zh: 只看概率推导和 residual heavy-tail 实证；对 merge recipe 有用，但离基座预训练仍远。
recommendation.en: Read only the probabilistic derivation and heavy-tail residual evidence; useful for merge recipes, but still far from pretraining.

paper.title: Right in the Right Way: LM Training with Verifiable Rewards and Human Demonstrations
paper.abstract: RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for training LMs on tasks with well-defined success metrics, such as code generation and mathematical reasoning. However, current RLVR methods optimize only what can be objectively scored, often neglecting subjective, non-verifiable aspects of human-like outputs, such as style and structure. This limitation leads to well-documented failure modes such as diversity collapse, unnatural-sounding responses, and reward hacking. We pr

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 RLVR 的目标不完整问题：可验证奖励能优化数学正确性、代码测试通过率等硬指标，但会忽略风格、结构、可读性、最小修改幅度等不可直接验证的属性，进而产生模式收缩、非自然输出和 reward hacking。
summary.importance: 它对 pretrain/post-train 接口的启发在于：可验证奖励并不能单独定义“好样本”。如果 RL 只优化 verifier，模型会学到 verifier 的盲区；如果只做 SFT，又缺少超越 demonstration 的任务反馈。VARL 把 verifier 和 human demonstration 结合起来，提供了一种把硬约束和分布匹配放进同一个 RL 目标的方式。这个方向对 RLVR 数据构造、reward 设计、合成推理轨迹质量控制都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 VARL，即 Verifiable and Adversarial Reinforcement Learning。它同时训练 generator 和 discriminator。Generator 是要优化的 LM policy；discriminator 判断某个 prompt-response 是来自人类 demonstration 还是 generator。Generator 的 RL 奖励由两部分组成：可验证奖励衡量答案是否正确，discriminator 给出输出是否像人类 demonstration 的概率。论文采用乘法组合，使得一个样本既要通过 verifier，又要在结构和风格上接近人类分布。这个设计不同于单纯 SFT，因为它不会只模仿 demonstration；也不同于普通 RLVR，因为 discriminator 会持续惩罚那些虽然通过验证、但分布上不像人类的解法。对于代码修复，这对应“通过测试且像人类补丁”；对于故事生成，则对应满足任务要求且保留人类写作分布中的多样性。
summary.experiments: 论文给出三个代表性实验。代码修复中，VARL 将准确率从 50% 提升到 65%，同时更好保留人类修复的 minimal-edit 结构；普通 RLVR 虽能提高通过率，但更倾向于重写整个函数。开放式故事生成中，VARL 相对人类故事的 win rate 从 2% 提升到 22%，并且输出比 RLVR 更有多样性、更接近人类 demonstration。countdown-code 是带有缺陷 verifier 的数值推理任务，VARL 将真实任务准确率从 20% 提升到 60%，且 reward hacking 较少；普通 RLVR 更容易坍缩到利用 verifier 漏洞的退化解。消融重点应看乘法奖励、discriminator 更新频率、以及只用 RLVR / 只用 SFT / adversarial reward 的对比。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 bug fixing 的例子，它清楚展示了 RLVR 和 SFT 的互补失败模式。方法部分重点看奖励组合方式，尤其是为什么用 verifiable reward 与 discriminator reward 的乘积，而不是简单相加。实验部分建议优先看三个任务的定性样例：代码 diff 是否最小、故事是否多样、countdown-code 是否利用 verifier。若关注 RL 训练稳定性，需要继续看 discriminator 是否过拟合、adversarial reward 是否被 generator 反向利用，以及奖励稀疏性如何影响 policy optimization。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses an incompleteness in RL with verifiable rewards. Verifiers can score correctness, unit-test success, or final-answer validity, but they often miss non-verifiable qualities such as style, structure, readability, minimal edits, and human-like diversity. Optimizing only the verifier can produce mode collapse, unnatural outputs, or reward hacking.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is most relevant to the post-training side of the pretrain/post-train loop. It shows that a verifier alone is not a sufficient definition of a good training signal. SFT preserves human-like structure but may fail to improve task success; RLVR improves task success but can exploit the verifier’s blind spots. VARL combines verifiable rewards with demonstrations through adversarial imitation, giving a practical way to keep hard correctness constraints while matching desirable properties in human data. This is relevant for RLVR reward design, synthetic reasoning data, code-generation training, and quality control for generated trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach: VARL, or Verifiable and Adversarial Reinforcement Learning, co-trains a generator policy and a discriminator. The discriminator predicts whether a prompt-response pair came from human demonstrations or from the generator. The generator is trained with RL using a reward that combines the verifiable task reward with the discriminator’s probability that the output looks human-generated. The use of a product is important: a response should be correct and human-like, rather than receiving high reward for only one of the two. Compared with SFT, the method can move beyond the demonstration distribution when the verifier supports better task performance. Compared with standard RLVR, it penalizes solutions that pass the objective check but deviate from the demonstrated distribution in structure or style.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports results in three settings. In bug fixing, VARL improves accuracy from 50% to 65% while preserving the minimal-edit structure of human patches; standard RLVR tends to pass tests by rewriting larger parts of the function. In open-ended story generation, the win rate against human stories improves from 2% to 22%, with more diverse and human-like generations than RLVR. In countdown-code, a numerical reasoning task with a flawed verifier, VARL raises true task accuracy from 20% to 60% and shows less reward hacking, while RLVR collapses toward degenerate verifier-exploiting solutions. The most informative ablations are likely the comparisons among SFT, RLVR, adversarial reward alone, and the combined multiplicative reward.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the bug-fixing example in the introduction, because it makes the failure modes of SFT and RLVR concrete. Then read the reward formulation and the generator-discriminator training loop, with attention to why the reward is multiplicative rather than additive. In the experiments, prioritize qualitative examples alongside the headline metrics: whether code changes are minimal, whether stories retain diversity, and whether countdown-code outputs exploit verifier flaws. For readers focused on RL stability, the key issues are discriminator overfitting, generator exploitation of the discriminator, and the sparsity introduced by gating imitation with verifiable success.

recommendation.zh: RLVR 结合对抗判别器的思路可缓解纯可验证奖励的多样性崩溃问题，对设计兼顾能力与自然度的后训练 pipeline 有参考价值，看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: Combining RLVR with an adversarial discriminator mitigates diversity collapse from pure verifiable rewards; useful for designing post-training pipelines balancing capability and naturalness, read methods section.

paper.title: CAT: Confidence-Adaptive Thinking for Efficient Reasoning of Large Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have achieved remarkable success on complex tasks by leveraging long chain-of-thought (CoT) trajectories, yet they frequently exhibit overthinking on simple queries, resulting in significant token overhead and reduced inference efficiency. However, existing compression methods predominantly apply uniform length reduction or rely on coarse-grained difficulty estimation, often leading to performance degradation on difficult problems. To address this limitation, we pro

summary.core_problem: 大推理模型在简单问题上常出现过长 CoT，导致推理 token 浪费；作者试图让模型按题目难度自适应地控制思考长度。
summary.importance: 这是后训练阶段的推理长度控制方法，不是预训练论文。它对 test-time compute allocation 和偏好优化信号设计有一定启发，尤其适合关注 pretrain↔posttrain 接口的人看。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Confidence-Adaptive Thinking（CAT），把模型自身的 self-certainty 信号转成 confidence，并纳入 preference optimization，使模型在高置信简单题上压缩思考长度，在低置信难题上保留更长推理。相较统一压缩或粗粒度难度估计，方法强调样本级自适应。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多个 benchmark、多个 base model 上，CAT 在推理准确率和 token 效率上都优于现有基线。对比对象包括统一长度压缩和基于粗难度估计的方法，但未给出模型参数量、训练数据来源和具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自电子科技大学及四川省相关重点实验室。

summary_en.core_problem: Large reasoning models often overthink on easy problems, wasting tokens; the paper aims to adapt reasoning length to problem difficulty.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training method rather than a pretraining contribution. Its relevance comes from test-time compute allocation and how preference optimization can shape reasoning behavior, which may matter at the pretrain–posttrain interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Confidence-Adaptive Thinking (CAT), which converts the model’s own self-certainty signals into confidence and injects them into preference optimization. The goal is to shorten reasoning on high-confidence easy cases while preserving longer deliberation on harder ones, instead of applying uniform compression.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, CAT consistently outperforms prior baselines on reasoning accuracy across multiple benchmarks and base models, while improving efficiency. Baselines include uniform length reduction and coarse-grained difficulty estimation methods, but the abstract does not provide model sizes, training data, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China and a Sichuan provincial key laboratory.

recommendation.zh: 典型 post-train 小改法，别把它当范式突破；若你关心 test-time compute 分配，只看 confidence 信号如何进 preference optimization，先怀疑自置信是否校准。
recommendation.en: This looks like a post-training tweak, not a paradigm shift; if you care about test-time compute allocation, inspect how confidence enters preference optimization and be skeptical about calibration.

institutions: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China
Ubiquitous Intelligence and Trusted Services Key Laboratory of Sichuan Province

paper.title: Active-GRPO: Adaptive Imitation and Self-Improving Reasoning for Molecular Optimization
paper.abstract: Scientific reasoning is an increasingly important capability of large language models, yet improving the robustness and efficiency of training such reasoning remains a key open challenge. We study this problem in instruction-based molecular optimization, where answer-only supervised fine-tuning (SFT) collapses multi-step reasoning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) suffers from sparse feedback. Reference-guided Policy Optimization mitigates both by anchoring policy updates

summary.core_problem: 在分子优化指令任务中，answer-only SFT 会压缩推理过程，RLVR 又受稀疏奖励限制；论文试图让模型在模仿参考答案和强化自身发现之间自适应切换。
summary.importance: 贡献是后训练算法改进，尤其针对 reference-guided RL 的参考质量瓶颈；由于任务是分子优化，外推到通用推理训练需要谨慎。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 active reasoning，并实例化为 Active-GRPO。核心思想是在每个样本上动态决定何时模仿数据集 reference、何时强化模型自己探索到的更好解，同时持续更新可被模仿的 reference，避免低质量参考把策略上限锁死。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量、baseline 和提升幅度；应重点检查是否只在分子优化指标上有效，是否比较 answer-only SFT、标准 GRPO、reference-guided policy optimization，以及是否报告 reference 质量分层结果。
summary.authors_note: Rick Stevens 是 Argonne National Laboratory 与 University of Chicago 相关的高性能计算和科学 AI 研究者；Le Cong 团队长期做 AI for science 和生物分子建模。

summary_en.core_problem: For instruction-based molecular optimization, answer-only SFT collapses reasoning while RLVR suffers from sparse rewards; the paper aims to adaptively choose between imitating references and reinforcing the model's own discoveries.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training algorithm, especially around the reference-quality bottleneck in reference-guided RL. Because the setting is molecular optimization, generalization to broad reasoning training should be treated cautiously.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes active reasoning and instantiates it as Active-GRPO. The policy decides per instance when to imitate a dataset reference and when to reinforce its own discovered solutions, while continuously upgrading the references it imitates to avoid being capped by weak references.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, dataset scale, baselines, or numerical gains. The key checks are comparisons against answer-only SFT, standard GRPO, reference-guided policy optimization, and analyses stratified by reference quality.
summary_en.authors_note: Rick Stevens is associated with Argonne National Laboratory and the University of Chicago in HPC and scientific AI. Le Cong's group is known for AI-for-science and biomolecular modeling work.

recommendation.zh: 只看算法和 reference-quality ablation；分子任务太窄，但“何时模仿、何时探索”是 RLVR 数据质量问题的好切口。
recommendation.en: Read only the algorithm and reference-quality ablations; the molecular setting is narrow, but the imitate-versus-explore switch is a useful RLVR data-quality lens.

paper.title: Which Tokens Matter? Adaptive Token Selection for RLVR with the Relative Surprisal Index
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a powerful tool for propelling Large Language Models (LLMs) beyond imitation-based training towards more robust reasoning capabilities. Among existing approaches, RL with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a pivotal paradigm for advancing LLM reasoning. Despite its empirical success, recent studies have offered different insights. One line of inquiry advocates prioritizing high-entropy token positions during training, while another perspective caution

summary.core_problem: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR，以GRPO为代表）训练中，两类主流token重要性判断方法存在经验上的矛盾：一类主张仅在高熵token位置更新（80/20规则），另一类主张压制低概率采样token的梯度以避免训练不稳定，但两类方法都能取得实证收益，说明单独使用位置熵或采样token概率都无法准确识别能提供有效学习信号的token，缺少一个有理论依据的统一token级重要性度量。
summary.importance: 这篇工作打通了RLVR中token选择领域两个看似冲突的经验结论，提出的相对惊奇指数（RSI）从token梯度模长与模型不确定性的关系推导而来，不是启发式设计，在多个模型尺寸上稳定提升RLVR训练效率和最终推理性能。其对token级训练信号的分析，既可以直接优化后训练流程，也为预训练阶段的token级损失加权、数据筛选提供了可迁移的思路。
summary.technical_approach: 首先区分了两个容易混淆的信号：位置预测熵代表模型在该位置的整体不确定性，采样token概率代表当前生成的具体token在该位置的似然，两者相关但不等价。高熵位置既可能产生高概率token也可能产生低概率token；低概率token既可能出现在高熵位置（模型不确定，属于有效学习信号），也可能出现在低熵位置（模型高度确定但采样出离群值，会带来不稳定噪声梯度）。在此基础上提出相对惊奇指数（RSI），同时融合位置熵和采样token的相对概率，度量实际采样到的token相对于当前位置预测分布的意外程度。在温和假设下，RSI与token级策略梯度的模长存在解析关联，可以作为token重要性的直接代理。基于RSI设计的token选择方案（RSI-S）会过滤两类无效token：低熵位置的低惊奇token（模型已经掌握，梯度接近零）、低熵位置的高惊奇token（离群采样，梯度不稳定），仅保留能提供稳定有效梯度的token参与更新。
summary.experiments: 在AIME、AMC数学推理基准上，基于Qwen2.5-1.5B、3B、7B三个尺寸的模型，RSI-S的avg@32准确率相对原生GRPO提升2-3个百分点，同时生成的回复长度更短；性能稳定优于仅基于熵的80/20规则和仅基于概率的梯度稳定方法，增益跨模型尺寸一致。消融实验验证，增益来自RSI对熵和采样概率两个信号的融合，单独使用任意一个信号的效果都弱于组合方案。
summary.reading_guide: 重点精读三个部分：一是引言和相关工作中对两类现有token选择方法矛盾的分析，理清位置熵、采样token概率、梯度模长三者的区别与关联；二是RSI的理论推导部分，理解它如何从token级策略梯度表达式出发，统一两类看似冲突的经验结论；三是消融实验部分，观察不同RSI阈值下的训练动态，以及被过滤token的梯度分布特征。值得深挖的方向是，RSI式的token过滤思路能否迁移到预训练阶段，用于token级损失加权或数据筛选，同时过滤模型已经掌握的简单token和噪声离群的无效token。

summary_en.core_problem: In Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR, exemplified by GRPO), two dominant token selection heuristics present an apparent empirical contradiction: one line of work prioritizes updates on high-entropy token positions (the 80/20 rule), while the other argues low-probability sampled tokens destabilize gradients and should be downweighted. Both approaches deliver measurable gains, indicating that neither position-level entropy nor sampled token probability alone is sufficient to identify tokens that provide useful learning signal. A principled, unified metric for token-level importance in RLVR is missing.
summary_en.importance: This work resolves the apparent tension between entropy-based and probability-based token selection heuristics for RLVR. The proposed Relative Surprisal Index (RSI) is derived from the analytical relationship between token-level gradient magnitude and model uncertainty, rather than being designed ad-hoc. It delivers consistent performance gains across model scales on reasoning benchmarks. The analysis of token-level training signals can directly improve post-training pipelines, and also provides a transferable idea for token-level loss weighting and data filtering in pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis first disentangles two correlated but distinct signals: position-level predictive entropy measures the model's total uncertainty at a sequence position, while sampled token probability measures the likelihood of the specific token that was generated at that position. High-entropy positions can produce both high- and low-probability tokens; low-probability tokens can appear either at high-entropy positions (where the model is uncertain, providing useful learning signal) or low-entropy positions (where the model is highly confident but sampled an outlier, producing noisy, unstable gradients). The Relative Surprisal Index is defined to combine both signals, measuring the relative unexpectedness of the sampled token against the model's full predictive distribution at the position. Under mild assumptions, RSI has a direct analytical connection to the magnitude of token-level policy gradients, making it a direct proxy for token importance. The RSI-S selection scheme filters two categories of unproductive tokens before gradient updates: low-surprisal tokens at low-entropy positions (already mastered, near-zero gradient) and high-surprisal tokens at low-entropy positions (outlier samples, unstable gradients), retaining only tokens that provide stable, useful learning signal.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on AIME and AMC mathematical reasoning benchmarks across Qwen2.5-1.5B, 3B, and 7B models, RSI-based token selection improves avg@32 accuracy by 2-3 percentage points over vanilla GRPO, while producing shorter generated responses. It consistently outperforms both the entropy-only 80/20 rule and the probability-based gradient stabilization method across all model sizes. Ablation studies confirm the performance gain comes from combining entropy and sampled probability signals; using either signal alone delivers substantially smaller improvements.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on three sections: 1) the analysis of the apparent contradiction between existing token selection heuristics, which clarifies the distinct roles of position-level entropy, sampled token probability, and gradient magnitude; 2) the theoretical derivation of RSI from token-level policy gradient expressions, to understand how it unifies the two previously conflicting views; 3) ablation studies that show training dynamics under different RSI thresholds, and the gradient distribution of filtered tokens. A promising direction for further exploration is whether RSI-style token filtering can be extended to pretraining, for token-level loss weighting or data filtering to remove both trivial already-mastered tokens and noisy outlier tokens.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻看 RSI 定义和 token-level 消融；它可能改变 RLVR 里“高熵优先”这个过粗 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the RSI definition and token-level ablations; it may refine the overly blunt prior that high-entropy tokens should be prioritized in RLVR.

paper.title: ReGRPO: Reflection-Augmented Policy Optimization for Tool-Using Agents
paper.abstract: Tool-augmented vision-language models (VLMs) can solve multimodal, multi-step tasks by calling external tools, yet they remain fragile in practice. Existing works have two common gaps. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is built mostly on successful trajectories and offers little signal for recovery after tool failures, while sparse trajectory-level RL rewards provide limited guidance on which step failed and how to repair it. We introduce ReGRPO (Reflection-augmented Group Relative Policy Optimizatio

summary.core_problem: 现有工具型VLM Agent的训练方法存在两个关键缺陷：一是SFT主要依赖成功轨迹，几乎没有工具失败后的恢复信号，小错误容易级联放大；二是传统RL的稀疏轨迹级奖励无法定位错误步骤，也不能给出修复方向，导致长程任务学习慢、不稳定。
summary.importance: 将“反思-纠错”从测试时的提示技巧转化为可学习的结构化训练信号，为工具型Agent的后训练（尤其是RL阶段）提供了更密集的步骤级监督；结构化反思数据的构造思路，也可迁移到基座模型的推理增强预训练中，例如在预训练语料中引入错误-反思-修正序列以提升通用鲁棒性。
summary.technical_approach: ReGRPO框架包含三个核心组件：1. 结构化反思数据引擎：对MAT-AGENT的成功轨迹做动作扰动，执行扰动后的动作得到真实的工具失败观察结果，构造包含（错误类型ErrorType、证据Evidence、修复计划FixPlan）的Reflection-of-Thought（RoT）三元组，并搭配对应的修正后动作；2. 训练优化流程：沿用标准GRPO优化器，将反思token与修正token纳入同一条局部轨迹的优化目标，联合优化反思生成与后续纠错动作，提供超越最终成败信号的步骤级监督；3. 推理策略：采用零外部验证器的单路径执行方案，仅当工具调用失败时触发固定的反思-纠错逻辑块，兼顾错误恢复能力与部署效率。
summary.experiments: 在GTA和GAIA两个通用工具型Agent基准上，与MAT-AGENT（基于成功轨迹的SFT训练）、SPORT（基于自探索的偏好学习）使用完全相同的骨干模型与工具集时，ReGRPO的整体准确率持续优于对比方法；全文提供的章节未披露具体性能提升幅度与详细消融实验结果。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：先阅读Introduction部分，理解现有SFT与RL方法在工具型Agent训练中的两个核心缺陷（动机核心）；再重点阅读Method部分的结构化反思数据引擎构造流程、以及将反思信号嵌入GRPO训练的联合优化目标；最后了解推理阶段的零验证器触发设计。预计阅读时间15-25分钟，无需深究GRPO优化器的底层细节，重点关注反思信号的结构化定义与训练集成方式。

summary_en.core_problem: Two critical gaps limit the robustness of tool-using VLM agents: 1) Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) relies almost exclusively on successful trajectories, providing no recovery signal after tool failures, so minor errors cascade without correction guidance; 2) Standard sparse trajectory-level RL rewards cannot localize faulty steps or indicate repair directions, leading to slow, unstable learning in long-horizon tasks.
summary_en.importance: Converts reflection-correction from a test-time prompting heuristic into a learnable, structured training signal, providing denser step-level supervision for the post-training (especially the RL phase) of tool-using agents. The structured reflective data construction pipeline can also transfer to reasoning-augmented pretraining for base models, for example by introducing error-reflection-correction sequences into pretraining corpora to improve general robustness.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReGRPO includes three core components: 1) A Structured Reflective Data Engine: Perturbs successful MAT-AGENT trajectories, executes the perturbed actions to collect real tool-failure observations, then builds grounded Reflection-of-Thought (RoT) triplets (ErrorType, Evidence, FixPlan) paired with corrected actions; 2) Training optimization: Uses the standard GRPO optimizer, but incorporates reflection tokens and correction tokens into the same local trajectory objective, enabling joint optimization of reflection generation and downstream corrective actions, thus providing step-level supervision beyond final success/failure signals; 3) Inference strategy: A verifier-free, single-path execution setup, where a fixed reflection-correction block is triggered only when a tool call fails, balancing error recovery capability and deployment efficiency.
summary_en.experiments: On the GTA and GAIA general tool-agent benchmarks, ReGRPO consistently outperforms MAT-AGENT (SFT trained on successful trajectories) and SPORT (self-exploration-based preference learning) when paired with the same backbone model and tool suite. The provided manuscript sections do not include exact improvement margins or detailed ablation results.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction first to understand the two core limitations of existing SFT and RL pipelines for tool agents. Then focus on the Method section, especially the construction flow of the Structured Reflective Data Engine and the joint optimization objective that integrates reflection signals. Finally review the verifier-free inference trigger design. Estimated reading time: 15–25 minutes. No need to dive into underlying GRPO details, as the work uses the standard GRPO optimizer without modification.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据引擎和局部 advantage 设计；它像 Agent 版过程监督，结论取决于 near-miss 采样是否干净。
recommendation.en: Read the data engine and local-advantage design; it is process supervision for agents, but the result hinges on clean near-miss sampling.

paper.title: TRIAGE: Role-Typed Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning requires assigning credit to environment-facing actions such as searches, clicks, edits, navigation commands, and object interactions. Standard GRPO uses the final verifier outcome as a uniform advantage over all action tokens. This outcome signal is useful but structurally incomplete: it punishes useful exploration in failed rollouts and reinforces redundant or regressive actions in successful rollouts. We propose TRIAGE, a role-typed credit assignment framework t

summary.core_problem: TRIAGE 处理的是 agentic RL 里的 credit assignment：最终 verifier 只告诉一条轨迹成败，但 GRPO 会把同一个 outcome advantage 均匀分给所有动作 token 或动作片段。这会压制失败轨迹中的有效探索，也会奖励成功轨迹中的冗余动作或退步动作。
summary.importance: 这篇工作不直接改预训练目标，但对 LLM post-train 的训练信号质量有启发。它把 agent 轨迹中的环境交互动作当作基本决策单元，而不是普通 token span。这个视角对工具调用、搜索、代码编辑、网页导航类 RL 很关键：训练信号不能只按最终结果分配，还要区分动作在局部过程中的角色。贡献更偏方法设计和诊断框架，适合泛读。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是给每个 environment-facing segment 增加一个语义角色轴。TRIAGE 用结构化 LLM judge 对局部上下文中的动作片段分类，角色包括 decisive progress、useful exploration、no-progress infrastructure、regression。分类器不直接替代 verifier，也不输出自由形式 reward；它只做局部语义诊断。随后用固定的 role-conditioned rule 把角色映射为有界的 segment-level process reward：决定性进展继承较强 outcome-aligned credit，有用探索给有限正向 credit，无进展基础操作压到接近 0，退步动作即使出现在成功轨迹中也被抑制。这样保留 GRPO 的最终 outcome advantage 作为主方向，同时用角色标签修正局部 credit。论文还给出一个理论解释：如果只能观测角色标签，role-conditioned correction 是均方误差意义下的最优片段校正；当固定角色常数与该最优校正对齐时，可以降低 advantage estimation error，并对应更低方差的 policy gradient。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 WebShop、Search-QA、ALFWorld 这类需要搜索、点击、导航、对象交互的 agentic 任务。对比项包括标准 GRPO、使用同一 judge 和上下文窗口的标量 LLM process-reward baseline，以及 outcome-supervised shared-backbone value baseline。论文声称 TRIAGE 在这些任务上相对上述基线有稳定收益，并用人工标注片段和角色诊断解释收益来源：失败轨迹中的 useful exploration 不再被全量惩罚，成功轨迹中的 regression 不再被 outcome reward 掩盖。给出的材料没有包含具体提升幅度和完整表格数字，因此不宜外推其规模。
summary.reading_guide: 建议用 20 到 30 分钟泛读。重点看 Introduction 对 outcome-only credit 两个盲点的定义，以及方法部分中四类 role 的边界。理论部分只需抓住 MSE-optimal correction 和 advantage variance 的直觉，不必深究每一步推导。实验部分优先看与 scalar process reward baseline 的对比，因为这个对比回答的是“角色标签是否比普通 dense reward 多提供信息”。如果关注 agent RL recipe，可进一步看人工标注诊断，判断角色分类是否稳定、是否依赖 judge 偏好。

summary_en.core_problem: TRIAGE addresses credit assignment in agentic RL. A final verifier can judge whether a trajectory succeeds, but vanilla GRPO assigns the same outcome advantage to all action tokens or segments. This penalizes useful exploration in failed rollouts and reinforces redundant or regressive actions in successful rollouts.
summary_en.importance: The paper is more relevant to RL post-training than to base pretraining, but it is useful for understanding training-signal quality in tool-use and environment-interaction settings. Its main contribution is to treat environment-facing segments, such as searches, clicks, edits, and object interactions, as the credit-assignment unit. This matters because outcome-only supervision is too coarse for long agent trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach: TRIAGE adds a semantic role axis on top of the outcome axis. A structured LLM judge classifies each local segment into one of four roles: decisive progress, useful exploration, no-progress infrastructure, or regression. The judge is used as a role classifier, not as an unconstrained reward model. A fixed role-conditioned rule then maps labels to bounded process rewards or penalties. Decisive progress receives strong outcome-aligned credit; useful exploration receives bounded positive credit; infrastructure is damped toward zero; regression is suppressed even when the trajectory eventually succeeds. The final verifier outcome remains the primary optimization direction under GRPO. The paper also gives a theoretical justification: role-conditioned correction is the MSE-optimal segment correction measurable from role labels alone, and aligned role constants can reduce advantage-estimation error.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers WebShop, Search-QA, and ALFWorld. Baselines include standard GRPO, a scalar LLM-derived process-reward baseline using the same judge and context window, and an outcome-supervised shared-backbone value baseline. TRIAGE is reported to improve consistently over these baselines. Manual segment labels and role diagnostics are used to explain where the gains come from: preserving useful exploration in failed trajectories and suppressing regressive actions inside successful ones. The provided text does not include exact improvement numbers, so the magnitude should be read from the full tables before drawing strong conclusions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the introduction for the two failure modes of outcome-only credit, then inspect the method section for the four-role taxonomy and the fixed role-to-reward mapping. The most informative experimental comparison is against the scalar process-reward baseline, because it tests whether role typing adds information beyond dense reward scoring. The theory section is worth a light pass for the MSE-optimal correction argument, but the practical value depends more on judge reliability and role-label stability.

recommendation.zh: GRPO信用分配的关键改进，角色分段奖励的思路可直接复现用于R1-style推理RL训练，重点看§3的规则设计和正确性证明
recommendation.en: Key improvement to GRPO credit assignment; role-based segment reward design is directly reproducible for R1-style reasoning RL training, focus on §3 rule design and correctness proof

paper.title: Learning to Select, Not Relearn: Hard-Routed Mixtures of Reasoning LoRAs
paper.abstract: Composing independently trained LoRA adapters into a single large language model is useful for multi-domain adaptation, especially when the original training data cannot be shared. A common approach is to use MoE-style routing over LoRA experts, but for frozen pretrained adapters, soft weighted combinations can change the unit-scale additive update under which each LoRA module was originally trained. We propose \textbf{Hard-Routed MoR-LoRA}, a two-stage framework for composing frozen reasoning L

summary.core_problem: 研究如何把多个独立训练、且训练数据不能共享的 reasoning LoRA 适配器组合到同一个 LLM 中，同时避免软路由加权破坏每个 LoRA 原本学到的更新尺度。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个 LoRA 专家组合方法，而不是基座预训练方法。它对后训练、模块化能力拼接、RLVR reasoning expert 复用有一定参考价值，尤其关注 frozen adapter 组合时的尺度失配问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Hard-Routed MoR-LoRA，两阶段训练：先分别用 reinforcement learning from verifiable feedback 训练领域 reasoning LoRA；再冻结所有专家，从专家蒸馏 reasoning traces，只训练轻量共享 router 和一个小 attention LoRA。router 对每个 token 做 hard top-1 expert selection，并用 straight-through estimator 保持可训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体基座模型规模、专家数量、训练数据规模、baseline 和数值结果。实验应主要比较 hard top-1 routing 与 soft weighted LoRA mixture、单专家 LoRA、可能的 MoE-LoRA 组合方法在多领域 reasoning 上的表现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to compose multiple independently trained reasoning LoRA adapters into one LLM when the original training data cannot be shared, without distorting the update scale each adapter was trained under.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training adapter-composition method rather than a base pretraining result. It is relevant to modular capability reuse, RLVR-trained reasoning experts, and the failure mode of scale-mismatched soft LoRA mixtures.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Hard-Routed MoR-LoRA uses a two-stage recipe: train domain-specific LoRA reasoning experts with reinforcement learning from verifiable feedback, freeze them, distill reasoning traces, and train only a lightweight shared router plus a small attention LoRA. The router selects exactly one expert per token with hard top-1 routing, while a straight-through estimator enables gradient-based learning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, number of experts, data scale, baselines, or quantitative gains. The expected comparison is against soft weighted LoRA mixtures, single-adapter baselines, and MoE-style LoRA composition on multi-domain reasoning tasks.

recommendation.zh: 可扫 abstract 和方法图；hard routing 的尺度论点合理，但离 pretrain 还远，主要当 adapter 组合坑点备查。
recommendation.en: Skim the abstract and method figure; the scale argument for hard routing is plausible, but this is mainly a post-training adapter-composition cautionary note.

paper.title: Think in English, Answer in Korean: Efficient Adaptation of Multilingual Tool-Using Agents
paper.abstract: We present LuckyStar 111B, a 111B-parameter hybrid reasoning model developed through a collaboration between Cohere and LG CNS for Korean-English enterprise agents under practical memory and serving constraints. The model trains from Cohere's fully post-trained Command A model rather than a new pretraining run, and uses preamble conditioning to switch between concise non-reasoning behavior and longer tool-oriented reasoning. We study four choices for scaling tool-using agents efficiently: multil

summary.core_problem: 研究如何在不重新预训练的情况下，把一个已完整后训练的 111B 英文强模型适配成韩英企业级工具调用 Agent，并满足实际显存和部署约束。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练 recipe 与工程适配。它不推进基座预训练本身，但对多语工具使用、RLVR、行为模式切换和量化部署之间的取舍有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: LuckyStar 111B 从 Cohere 的 Command A 出发，使用多语监督微调、面向多步工具任务的可验证奖励强化学习、面向韩文用户响应的语言一致性奖励，以及 4-bit 量化。模型还通过 preamble conditioning 在简洁非推理模式和较长工具推理模式之间切换。
summary.experiments: 模型规模为 111B。摘要报告其在数学推理、函数调用和 Agentic NL2SQL 上提升，同时保持韩英通用指令跟随能力；未在摘要中给出具体 benchmark 名称、训练数据规模或提升幅度。4-bit 量化目标是单 GPU serving。
summary.authors_note: Cohere 与 LG CNS 合作完成；工作基于 Cohere 的 Command A 后训练模型。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to adapt a fully post-trained 111B English-strong model into a Korean-English enterprise tool-using agent without running a new pretraining job, under memory and serving constraints.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training and deployment recipe. It does not advance foundation-model pretraining directly, but it gives useful evidence on multilingual tool use, RL with verifiable rewards, behavior-mode control, and quantized serving trade-offs.
summary_en.technical_approach: LuckyStar 111B starts from Cohere's Command A and combines multilingual SFT, RL with verifiable rewards for multi-step tool-use tasks, language-consistency rewards for Korean-facing responses, and 4-bit quantization. Preamble conditioning switches between concise non-reasoning behavior and longer tool-oriented reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The model has 111B parameters. The abstract reports improvements in mathematical reasoning, function calling, and agentic NL2SQL while preserving general Korean and English instruction-following quality; it does not provide benchmark names, data scale, or exact gains. The 4-bit setup targets single-GPU serving.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is a collaboration between Cohere and LG CNS and builds on Cohere's Command A post-trained model.

recommendation.zh: 可只看训练 recipe 和失败模式；它是后训练工程文，不会改变预训练 prior，但多语工具奖励设计有复用价值。
recommendation.en: Skim the training recipe and failure modes only; it is post-training engineering, not a pretraining prior shift, but the multilingual tool-reward design is reusable.

paper.title: AutoTrainess: Teaching Language Models to Improve Language Models Autonomously
paper.abstract: Training language models (LMs) remains a highly human-intensive process, even as frontier language model agents become increasingly capable at software engineering and other long-horizon tasks. A central challenge is that autonomous post-training is not just a coding problem: it requires the agent to repeatedly plan iterations, construct benchmark-aligned data, run stable training jobs, evaluate checkpoints, and preserve experiment state across many hours of interaction. We present AutoTrainess,

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题是：让语言模型代理自主完成一轮又一轮的 post-training 改进时，为什么单靠通用 coding agent + 原始 CLI 环境不够，以及怎样把人类训练工程师积累的流程、约束和经验显式注入 agent 的行动空间。作者认为，自主训练不是单纯“会写代码”就够了，它还要求代理能稳定地做数据构造、训练作业启动、评测、日志记录和多轮迭代规划；而这些环节里大量失败来自接口过于原始、动作语义不清、训练细节容易出错。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练研究的启发在于，它把“模型改进自动化”从 agent 能力问题转成了 interface design 问题。很多人讨论 self-improving LM 时，默认更强的基础模型就会自然学会训练另一个模型；这篇工作给出的答案更务实：如果没有训练专用 ACI，代理会在数据格式、chat template、packing、评测脚本、实验状态管理这些工程细节上频繁失误。它的贡献不在新的训练算法，而在把 post-train 闭环拆成可操作、可约束、可复用的接口集合。对做自动化研究平台、autonomous research agent、甚至未来的 continual post-training 系统都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 AutoTrainess，一个建立在 training-specialized Agent-Computer Interface 之上的 LM agent。作者不是让 agent 直接面对一个开放式 shell，而是提供一个名为 AutoTrainHub 的结构化工作区和动作库，把自主 post-training 组织成四个闭环模块：data process、training、evaluation、logging & planning。

数据处理模块里，作者把动作拆成 data selection、data construction、data validation。selection 负责根据上一轮失败案例选择数据来源和方向；construction 允许在受限操作集内做抽取、清洗、去重、重写、重组、合成、蒸馏、schema normalization；validation 则要求代理先检查 benchmark 的真实评测接口、chat template 和任务上下文，再过滤垃圾样本、损坏样本、重复样本和不符合接口的样本。这个设计的关键不是“功能多”，而是把人类训练时默认会做的检查前置成显式动作。

训练与评测模块则把 run train.sh、run eval.sh、debug evaluation、summarize evaluation results 这类操作语义化，并与工作区中的脚本、日志和计划文件绑定。日志与规划模块要求代理记录每轮实验状态，并基于已有证据决定下一轮方向。也就是说，AutoTrainess 不是一个单步执行器，而是一个带实验记忆的迭代系统。

从方法定位看，它更像 agent harness / environment design，而不是新的学习算法。作者的主张是：在训练任务上，好的 action abstraction 比开放式 CLI 更重要，因为它把人类经验编码进了 agent 可调用的接口里，减少了搜索空间和低级错误。这个思路与软件工程 agent 中的 tool-use 很像，但这里工具不是通用 IDE，而是训练流程专用接口。
summary.experiments:
实验主要在 PostTrainBench 上进行。使用 GPT-5.4（Codex）作为 backbone 时，AutoTrainess 平均分 26.94，高于 CLI-only baseline 的 23.21。作者还在 PostTrainBench 的 Qwen3-4B 子集上做了消融，显示训练专用 ACI 带来约 3–8 分提升。为了验证接口设计不是只对单一 backbone 有效，作者又换成 DeepSeek-V4-Flash（OpenCode），AutoTrainess 仍达到 19.58，显著高于 CLI-only 的 12.13，同时能在较少人工干预下保持稳定的端到端训练流程。

这些结果说明两件事。第一，增益不是来自更强 backbone 本身，因为同一 backbone 下 ACI 相比裸 CLI 有稳定提升。第二，接口设计具有一定可移植性，不完全绑定某个闭源模型。若全文提供了任务分项、失败类型统计、训练作业成功率、数据构造错误率或评测脚本调试次数，这些会比平均分更能说明方法价值，因为它们直接反映 ACI 是否减少了训练流程中的脆弱点。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看引言和 Figure 2，理解作者到底在改什么：不是让 agent 学会新的优化器或 RL，而是把训练流程包装成更适合 agent 操作的接口。然后重点看 AutoTrainHub 的四个模块定义，尤其是 data validation 和 logging/planning，这两块最能体现“把人类经验显式化”的设计思想。

实验部分建议重点看三类对比：AutoTrainess vs CLI-only、不同 backbone 的迁移、以及 Qwen3-4B 子集上的消融。阅读时要特别留意 benchmark 评分到底覆盖哪些能力，是否真正衡量了多轮 post-training 闭环，而不只是脚本执行成功。预计 20–30 分钟可以完成有效泛读。如果你在做 autonomous training、research agent 或 post-train platform，这篇值得连附录一起看，重点找失败案例和接口定义细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why autonomous LM improvement remains difficult even for strong coding agents, and argues that the bottleneck is not just coding ability but the lack of a training-aware interface. End-to-end post-training requires repeated planning, benchmark-aligned data construction, stable training execution, evaluation, and experiment-state management over many iterations. In a raw CLI environment, agents frequently fail on details such as sequence packing, chat templates, evaluation scripts, and bookkeeping. The core problem is therefore how to expose human training expertise to an agent in a structured, operational form.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is conceptual and infrastructural rather than algorithmic. It reframes autonomous model improvement as an interface-design problem: stronger base models alone are not enough if the action space is underspecified and error-prone. For researchers working on pretrain/post-train loops, continual improvement, or autonomous research systems, this is useful because it shows where automation actually breaks in practice. The paper does not introduce a new optimization method, but it offers a concrete recipe for packaging training heuristics, constraints, and workflow structure into an agent-computer interface.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The system, AutoTrainess, is an LM agent built on top of a training-specialized Agent-Computer Interface, implemented as AutoTrainHub. Instead of leaving the agent in an open-ended shell, the environment provides a structured workspace and a set of semantically meaningful actions organized into four modules: data processing, training, evaluation, and logging/planning.

In the data module, the workflow is decomposed into data selection, data construction, and data validation. Selection chooses useful directions based on prior failures. Construction operates within a bounded set of transformations such as extraction, cleaning, deduplication, rewriting, restructuring, synthesis, distillation, and schema normalization. Validation explicitly checks compatibility with the benchmark-facing interface, including evaluation scripts and chat templates, and filters low-quality or risky samples. This is an important design choice: many of the checks that human practitioners do implicitly are turned into explicit agent actions.

The training and evaluation modules similarly expose actions such as launching training, launching evaluation, debugging evaluation, and summarizing results, all tied to scripts and artifacts in the workspace. The logging/planning module maintains experiment memory and supports iterative decision-making for the next round. So AutoTrainess is not a one-shot executor; it is an iterative post-training loop with structured state.

Methodologically, this is best understood as an agent harness or environment design paper. The claim is that for training tasks, good action abstraction matters more than unrestricted CLI freedom because it encodes human prior knowledge directly into the callable interface and reduces both search complexity and low-level mistakes.
summary_en.experiments:
The main evaluation is on PostTrainBench. With GPT-5.4 (Codex) as the backbone, AutoTrainess achieves an average score of 26.94, compared with 23.21 for a CLI-only baseline. On the Qwen3-4B subset of PostTrainBench, ablations show that the training-specialized ACI contributes roughly 3–8 points. To test portability, the authors replace the backbone with DeepSeek-V4-Flash (OpenCode); AutoTrainess still reaches 19.58, well above the CLI-only baseline of 12.13, while maintaining stable end-to-end training with minimal human oversight.

These results support two claims. First, the gain is not merely due to a stronger backbone, since the same backbone improves when given the specialized interface. Second, the interface design is at least somewhat transferable across agent backbones. If the full paper includes task-level breakdowns, failure-type statistics, job success rates, or data-construction error analyses, those are especially worth reading because they reveal whether the ACI truly reduces the fragile points in autonomous training.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and Figure 2 to understand the scope clearly: this is not a new optimizer or a new RL method for training LMs, but a structured interface for autonomous post-training. Then read the AutoTrainHub section carefully, especially the definitions of the four modules. The most informative parts are usually data validation and logging/planning, because they show how tacit human training practice is turned into explicit agent actions.

In the experiments, focus on three comparisons: AutoTrainess versus CLI-only, transfer across different backbones, and the ablations on the Qwen3-4B subset. Also check what PostTrainBench actually measures—whether it captures a genuine multi-iteration post-training loop rather than simple script execution. A solid skim should take about 20–30 minutes. If you work on autonomous training, research agents, or post-training infrastructure, the appendix is likely worth reading for failure cases and interface details.

recommendation.zh: 值得看，但别把它当“模型会自己炼丹”了；重点是把训练经验做成受约束接口，这对自动化 post-train 比再堆 agent prompt 更靠谱，先看 action design 和 failure cases。
recommendation.en: Worth reading, but not as 'models can now train themselves'; the real lesson is that constrained training interfaces beat more agent prompting for autonomous post-training—start with the action design and failure cases.
