summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to improve general role-playing agents so that they faithfully portray arbitrary characters from natural-language profiles rather than copying superficial dialogue patterns.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and reward-modeling contribution. Its relevance to foundation-model researchers comes mainly from the reward-hacking observation: LLM-based rewards may score generic role-play phrases similarly to truly character-specific behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Psy-CoT, a psychology-grounded reasoning scaffold with three pre-response steps: Interaction Perception, Psychological Empathy, and Logical Construction. They then apply role-aware policy optimization to improve character fidelity and reduce reward-model exploitation.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not specify model sizes, data scale, baselines, or numerical gains. The experimental setup appears to compare structured reasoning, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning for role fidelity and generalization.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Zhejiang University and Tencent Youtu Lab, a Tencent research lab active in vision, multimodal learning, and large-model applications.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reward hacking 观察即可；角色扮演任务偏窄，但“套话被奖励”对 RL 数据设计有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Skim only the reward-hacking observation; role-play is narrow, but generic phrases getting rewarded is relevant to RL data design.

paper.title: Learning to Recover Task Experts from a Multi-Task Merged Model
paper.abstract: Multi-task model merging aims to consolidate several task-specific experts into a unified model, yet static merging consistently suffers from parameter interference. While dynamic merging models aim to bridge this gap, many works rely on the costly storage and loading of redundant expert components at inference. In this work, from the perspective of task expert, we view parameter interference as parameter perturbation introduced to each expert during merging process. We show that such parameter

summary.core_problem: 多任务模型合并后会出现参数干扰，导致每个任务专家性能下降，同时动态合并又带来专家组件存储和加载成本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是模型合并和后训练侧的恢复方法，目标是在单一 merged checkpoint 中恢复任务专家能力；对持续训练、专家合并和参数干扰分析有间接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ReTeX，把合并过程中的参数干扰看作施加在每个专家上的参数扰动，并用可近似为加性 offset 的仿射变换建模；模型预测这些 offset 来恢复专家性能。未知任务身份时，用离线计算的 SVD subspace signatures 做 router-free task identifier。
summary.experiments: 摘要未报告模型规模、任务数量、具体基线或提升幅度；关键信息应在完整论文的 model merging benchmark 和 ablation 中。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-task model merging suffers from parameter interference that hurts each task expert, while dynamic merging often requires storing and loading redundant expert components.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training/model-merging method that attempts to recover task-expert behavior from a single merged checkpoint. It is indirectly relevant to continual training, expert merging, and interference analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReTeX models the interference introduced during merging as a parameter perturbation on each expert, approximated by additive offsets from an affine transformation. It predicts these offsets to recover expert performance and uses offline SVD subspace signatures for router-free task identification when task identity is unknown.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, number of tasks, named baselines, or improvement margins. The useful details would be in the merging benchmarks and ablations.

recommendation.zh: 模型合并方向的中等信号；只看 offset 假设是否被 ablation 支撑，别被“recover expert”措辞带偏。
recommendation.en: A moderate signal for model merging; check whether the offset assumption survives ablations, not the “recover expert” framing.

paper.title: Designing Reward Signals for Portable Query Generation: A Case Study in Industrial Semantic Job Search
paper.abstract: Job-search platforms rely on low-bandwidth query interfaces that often fail to capture the high-dimensional complexity of candidate profiles. We present an end-to-end RLAIF (Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback) framework to generate \emph{portable} job search queries, terms that abstract away seeker-specific identifiers while preserving generalizable qualifications. This task introduces a highly adversarial reward surface where policy optimization frequently exploits flaws in LLM-as-judge ru

summary.core_problem: 研究在工业语义招聘搜索中，如何为 RLAIF 查询生成任务设计不易被策略利用的奖励信号。
summary.importance: 贡献是后训练奖励设计的案例研究。任务本身很垂直，但关于 LLM-as-judge reward hacking、reward shaping 与 critic-free 优化器差异的观察，对 RLHF/RLVR 训练信号质量有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出端到端 RLAIF 框架，让模型生成可迁移的招聘搜索 query，即保留通用资格信息、去除求职者特定标识。论文重点拆分优化算法本身与结构化奖励工程的影响，并比较 RLOO、REINFORCE++ 等 critic-free 方法在高对抗奖励面下的行为。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模或具体指标。实验声称系统隔离优化机制和奖励工程影响，发现对于 critic-free 优化器，性能主要由稳健 reward shaping 决定，算法选择影响较小；per-rollout baseline 类方法如 RLOO 和 REINFORCE++ 对某些 reward hacking 行为有天然抑制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to design robust reward signals for RLAIF-based query generation in industrial semantic job search.
summary_en.importance: It is a post-training reward-design case study. The task is vertical, but its observations about LLM-as-judge reward hacking, reward shaping, and critic-free optimizers are relevant to RLHF/RLVR signal quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework generates portable job-search queries that preserve general qualifications while removing seeker-specific identifiers. The paper separates the effects of optimization mechanics from structured reward engineering and compares critic-free optimizers such as RLOO and REINFORCE++ under adversarial reward surfaces.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, dataset size, or exact metric values. It reports that, for critic-free optimizers, robust reward shaping dominates performance and the specific optimizer matters less; per-rollout baseline methods such as RLOO and REINFORCE++ appear to resist some reward-hacking behaviors.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reward ablation；任务太行业化，但“奖励形状压过优化器选择”这个负结果值得当 RLVR 弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the reward ablations; the task is too vertical, but the “reward shape beats optimizer choice” result is a useful weak signal for RLVR.

paper.title: Where Do CoT Training Gains Land in LLM based Agents?
paper.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning is widely used in language-model agents, but prior work has shown that verbalized CoT is not always faithful and may instead reflect post-hoc reasoning, which means the model already knows the answer before reasoning. We therefore ask what CoT training is actually improving: is the model getting better at changing its action through generated reasoning, or is it getting better at predicting the action directly from the prompt? We study this question by comparing

summary.core_problem: 论文研究一个 agent 训练中的关键诊断问题：CoT 监督带来的收益，究竟来自生成推理后对动作的修正，还是来自模型更会直接从长 prompt 预测最终动作。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练不是直接贡献，但对 post-train 与 agent 训练有启发。它提醒研究者：在长上下文 agent 里，CoT 训练可能同时强化“prompt 到 action”的捷径，而不是只强化可解释的中间推理。这个现象会影响 SFT/RL 数据设计、loss mask 设计，以及对 CoT faithful reasoning 的判断。对基座训练接口的意义在于，action token 的监督信号可能被长 prompt 吸收，导致模型更依赖上下文模式匹配，而不是更有效地使用生成出的 reasoning trace。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 prompt action 与 CoT action 的对照诊断。CoT action 是常规方式：模型先生成 step-by-step reasoning，再输出 action。prompt action 则通过预填 <action> 标签，让模型跳过推理，直接从 prompt 输出动作。若训练主要提升 reasoning-based revision，那么 CoT action 相对 prompt action 的优势应随训练扩大；若训练也强化直接动作预测，两者会同步变好，差距可能保持稳定。论文还加入 conflicting-trace 测试：把与 prompt 暗示动作冲突的推理轨迹放入上下文，看最终 action 更服从 prompt 还是 trace。机制分析部分用 attention 和 gradient 解释为什么 prompt 会占优势：agent prompt 往往远长于生成的 CoT，包含任务说明、历史交互和环境反馈，因此 action token 的监督梯度更容易流向 prompt 相关表征。基于这个诊断，论文尝试在一部分样本上降低 action-token supervision，减少对最终动作的直接强化。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld 和 BFCL，包含 embodied household tasks、interactive scientific reasoning、function calling / tool use 等 agent 场景，并考察 SFT 与 RL 训练过程。主要发现是：随着训练推进，prompt action 的质量显著提升；CoT action 仍然有收益，但相对 prompt action 的优势没有明显扩大。这说明 CoT 训练收益有相当一部分落在直接 prompt-to-action 路径上。conflicting-trace 测试显示，后期 checkpoint 更难被冲突推理轨迹改变，最终动作更锚定在 prompt 暗示的信息上。attention 和 gradient 分析支持这一解释：长 prompt 在 action 预测时吸收了更多注意力和梯度质量。降低部分训练样本的 action-token supervision 后，OOD generalization 有改善。摘要和可见正文未给出完整数值表，关键数字需要在实验表和附录中核对。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读。先看 Setup and Diagnostic Framework，理解 prompt action、CoT action、conflicting trace 三个诊断工具。再看 Training Makes Actions More Predictable from the Prompt，重点关注 checkpoint 训练曲线：prompt action 是否追上 CoT action，以及两者 gap 是否扩大。机制部分建议看 attention / gradient 分析，判断证据是否足以支持“长 prompt 吸收 action supervision”的解释。最后看 reduced action supervision 的实验设置，尤其是它如何选择样本、如何 mask 或降权 action loss、对 OOD 的改善是否稳定。预计阅读时间 35–50 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks where CoT-training gains in LLM agents actually land: in better reasoning-conditioned action revision, or in stronger direct action prediction from the long prompt.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and agent-training paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is useful for understanding how supervision signals are absorbed by large models. In long-context agents, CoT supervision may improve task success while also strengthening a shortcut from prompt to final action. That affects how to design SFT and RL data, how to mask or weight action losses, and how to interpret claims that verbalized CoT is driving the decision. The result is especially relevant when agent prompts contain rich interaction history and environment feedback that already make the next action partly predictable.
summary_en.technical_approach: The diagnostic separates two decoding modes. A CoT action is produced after the model generates a reasoning trace. A prompt action is produced by prefilling an <action> tag, forcing the model to skip the reasoning trace and predict the action directly from the prompt. If training mainly improves reasoning-based revision, the gap between CoT actions and prompt actions should grow over training. If training also improves the direct prompt-to-action pathway, prompt actions should improve in parallel and the gap may remain stable. The paper then uses conflicting-trace tests, where the provided reasoning trace conflicts with the prompt-implied action, to measure whether the final action follows the prompt or the trace. Attention and gradient analyses are used to explain the behavior: the prompt is usually much longer than the generated CoT and carries task instructions, history, and observations, so action-token supervision can assign more signal to prompt-conditioned representations. This motivates a reduced action-supervision intervention that weakens final-action supervision on part of the training data.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and BFCL, spanning embodied household tasks, interactive science tasks, and function-calling or tool-use evaluation. Both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning are considered. The main empirical pattern is consistent across settings: prompt-action quality rises substantially during training, while the relative advantage of CoT actions over prompt actions does not widen much. CoT still helps, but the training gain is not concentrated only in reasoning-mediated action changes. In conflicting-trace tests, later checkpoints are harder to overturn with traces that disagree with the prompt, indicating stronger anchoring to prompt-implied actions. Attention and gradient measurements support the same explanation: action-time signal is dominated by the long prompt more than by the generated trace. Reducing action-token supervision on a subset of examples improves out-of-distribution generalization. The visible text does not provide the full numeric tables, so the exact gains should be checked in the main experiment section and appendix.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the setup first, especially the definitions of prompt action, CoT action, and conflicting-trace evaluation. Then read the training-dynamics section and focus on whether the CoT-vs-prompt gap changes across checkpoints. The attention and gradient analyses are worth checking because they connect the behavioral result to the structure of long-context agent prompts. Finally, inspect the reduced action-supervision intervention: how examples are selected, how the action loss is weakened, and whether the OOD gains are stable across environments. Expected reading time is 35–50 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得扫实验图：若结论干净，CoT 训练更像动作蒸馏而非推理增强，会影响 agent 数据格式选择。
recommendation.en: Skim the experimental figures: if the setup is clean, CoT training looks more like action distillation than reasoning improvement, which matters for agent data formatting.

paper.title: Neglected Free Lunch from Post-training: Progress Advantage for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Process reward models enable fine-grained, step-level evaluation of LLMs, yet building them for agentic settings remains prohibitively difficult: long-horizon interactions, irreversible actions, and stochastic environment feedback make both human annotation and Monte Carlo estimation infeasible at scale. In this work, we show that reinforcement learning (RL) post-training already provides the ingredients for effective step-level scoring, eliminating the need for dedicated reward model training a

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：如何在长程、随机、带外部环境反馈的 LLM agent 任务中，获得可靠的 step-level 过程评分，而不额外训练 PRM。传统 PRM 在数学题中还能依赖人工标注、回溯、Monte Carlo rollout；但 agent 环境里动作可能不可逆，状态由历史 token、工具调用和环境反馈共同决定，重复采样成本高且分布不稳定。该论文要解决的不是再造一个奖励模型，而是从 RL post-training 已经产生的策略变化中提取过程信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-training 接口有直接启发。它把 RL 后训练产生的 policy shift 解释为可复用的过程级优势信号，说明 post-training checkpoint pair 不只是产物，也可以作为评估器和推理时控制信号。贡献量级主要在方法范式：不依赖新标注、不训练专门 PRM，只需要 RL policy 与 reference policy 的 log-prob ratio。对基座研究员的价值在于，它给出了一个观察 RL 训练动态的新窗口：哪些 token/action 在 RL 后被显著上调，可能对应模型认为更接近任务进展的局部决策。这类信号也可反过来用于数据筛选、agent 轨迹诊断、RL 信号质量分析和持续训练监控。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 progress advantage：对同一状态和动作，计算 RL-trained policy 与 reference policy 的对数概率比，即 log π_RL(a_t|s_t) - log π_ref(a_t|s_t)。论文把 agent 过程形式化为一般随机 MDP，状态包含截至当前的完整 token 历史和环境观测，动作可细到 token，也可聚合到工具调用或 agent step。关键理论结果是，在带参考策略约束的 RL 目标下，最优策略相对于 reference policy 的 log-ratio 对应最优 advantage function；如果有 KL 系数，通常只差一个尺度因子。这个推导比以往 deterministic reasoning 场景里的 implicit PRM 更一般，因为 agent 的转移包含随机环境和外部交互，不能把完整输出看成静态字符串来打分。论文还讨论了它为何可覆盖主流 RL 算法，包括显式 KL 正则的 GRPO，以及主要依赖 clipping surrogate 的 DAPO。实现上不需要训练 reward model，只要能对候选轨迹在两个 checkpoint 上重算 log-prob，并按 token span、action 或 trajectory 聚合即可。这个设计的取舍很清楚：它牺牲了一个独立奖励模型的可解释边界，换来低成本、跨任务、与实际 RL 训练目标一致的过程信号。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个推理时用途：best-of-N 轨迹选择、成功/失败不确定性估计、失败步骤定位。基准包括 BFCLv4-MT、WebShop、AgentDojo、τ²-bench 和 Who & When；模型族包括 Gemma4、Qwen3.5、Qwen3 和 Olmo3。结果结论比较一致：在 test-time scaling 中，用 progress advantage 给 N 条候选轨迹排序，可以提高任务成功率，并优于 confidence-based scoring、预训练 reward model，以及若干任务特定 PRM；在 uncertainty quantification 中，用轨迹级聚合分数预测成功/失败，AUROC 高于预训练 PRM 和 proprietary LLM-as-a-Judge；在 failure attribution 中，它能定位多 agent 交互里的错误步骤，接近专门为该任务训练的方法。已给出的全文片段没有展开具体表格数值；精读时需要核对 Sec. 4.2、4.3、4.4 中每个 benchmark 的 success rate、AUROC、step accuracy，以及不同聚合策略和 checkpoint 选择的消融。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读理论推导和实验消融。第一处重点是 MDP 形式化和 Proposition 1：看清 log-prob ratio 为什么对应 advantage，而不是普通 reward 或 value。尤其要注意尺度项、KL 正则项、reference policy 的角色，以及随机环境下条件状态如何定义。第二处重点是 Proposition 2：它解释了为什么该信号不只适用于显式 KL RL，也能用于 clipping 类算法。第三处重点是 Sec. 4.2-4.4：分别对应轨迹选择、失败预测和错误定位，建议直接看表格和每个 baseline 的定义，判断提升来自更好的过程信号，还是来自 policy/reference 的分布匹配优势。第四处重点是分析章节：应关注 token-level 到 action-level 的聚合方式、不同 RL checkpoint pair 的影响、reference 选择、长度偏置校正，以及对 reward hacking 的敏感性。值得深挖的问题是：如果 RL reward 本身有偏，progress advantage 会稳定放大哪些偏差；如果用于持续预训练或 mid-training 轨迹筛选，是否会造成过早收缩探索空间。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical gap in agent training and evaluation: obtaining step-level process scores for long-horizon LLM agents without collecting process annotations or training a dedicated PRM. Standard PRM construction works better in settings such as math reasoning, where rollouts and human step labels are feasible. Agentic environments are harder: actions may be irreversible, transitions are stochastic, tool feedback changes the state, and Monte Carlo estimation becomes expensive or invalid.
summary_en.importance: The main value is a new use of the post-training artifact itself. The policy shift induced by RL is treated as a reusable process-level signal, not merely as a better policy. This matters for pretraining and post-training research because it exposes a measurable interface between the reference model, the RL-trained model, and downstream agent behavior. It can be used for test-time selection, trajectory filtering, training-signal auditing, and analysis of where RL changes the model’s local preferences. The contribution is methodological rather than data-scale driven: it avoids additional reward-model training and relies only on log probabilities from an RL checkpoint pair.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed score, progress advantage, is the log-probability ratio between the RL-trained policy and its reference policy for the same action under the same state: log π_RL(a_t|s_t) - log π_ref(a_t|s_t). The paper formulates multi-turn agent interaction as a stochastic token-level MDP, where the state contains the full history of generated tokens, observed tokens, tool outputs, and environment feedback. Under a reference-regularized RL objective, the optimal policy ratio recovers the optimal advantage function up to the expected scaling from the regularization coefficient. This extends earlier implicit-reward interpretations beyond deterministic reasoning traces, because the conditioning state now includes stochastic environment transitions. The method can be applied at token, action, or trajectory level by aggregating token log-ratios. It is also argued to apply to common RL procedures, including explicitly KL-regularized algorithms such as GRPO and clipping-based algorithms such as DAPO. The design choice is pragmatic: use the actual policy movement produced by RL instead of fitting a separate process reward model that may not transfer across environments.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers three inference-time applications: best-of-N trajectory selection, success/failure uncertainty prediction, and failure-step attribution. Benchmarks include BFCLv4-MT, WebShop, AgentDojo, τ²-bench, and Who & When. Model families include Gemma4, Qwen3.5, Qwen3, and Olmo3. The reported pattern is consistent: progress advantage improves best-of-N task success over confidence-based scoring, pretrained reward models, and even some task-specific PRMs; it achieves higher AUROC for trajectory success prediction than pretrained PRMs and a proprietary LLM-as-a-Judge baseline; and it localizes failure steps in multi-agent settings with accuracy close to a method trained specifically for that task. The supplied full-text excerpt does not expose the numerical tables, so the exact success-rate gains, AUROC values, and step-accuracy numbers should be read directly from Sections 4.2 to 4.4.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the theory before the benchmark tables. The key part is the derivation around Proposition 1: it clarifies why a policy log-ratio should be interpreted as an advantage rather than as a raw reward. Pay attention to the role of the reference policy, the KL or trust-region scale, and the definition of state in a stochastic environment. Proposition 2 is the next important piece, since it explains the connection to practical RL algorithms beyond a clean KL-regularized objective. In the experiments, focus on the baseline definitions and aggregation rules: token-to-action aggregation, trajectory scoring, length normalization, and checkpoint-pair choice are likely to determine practical reliability. The most useful follow-up questions are about bias: a flawed RL reward can make progress advantage a faithful signal of the wrong training objective, so its use in data selection or continual training should be coupled with reward-quality diagnostics.

recommendation.zh: 直接推翻Agent RL后训练需额外训PRM的默认流程，§3的推导与信号构造应立刻在内部推理/Agent任务中复现验证
recommendation.en: Directly overturns the default process of requiring additional PRM training for agent RL post-training, the derivation and signal construction in §3 should be immediately reproduced and validated in internal reasoning/agent tasks

paper.title: Why Multi-Step Tool-Use Reinforcement Learning Collapses and How Supervisory Signals Fix It
paper.abstract: Tool use enables large language models (LLMs) to perform complex tasks, and recent agentic reinforcement learning (RL) methods show promise for enhancing model capabilities. However, RL alone often leads to instability or limited gains in tool-use tasks. In our experiments, some models exhibit catastrophic collapse, where performance abruptly drops and tool-invocation structures fail. The analysis reveals that these failures stem from unexpected probability spikes in specific control tokens, dis

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是多步 tool-use 场景下，为什么纯 RL 训练会突然失稳，甚至把一个原本会调用工具的模型训到几乎不可用。全文给出的结论很明确：主要问题不是能力退化，也不是推理链被彻底破坏，而是结构性崩塌。模型在 RL 过程中会把概率质量异常集中到少数控制 token 或格式 token 上，导致工具调用语法、turn 结构和执行协议被破坏；一旦结构坏掉，环境反馈也随之失真，训练进一步恶化。也就是说，模型“会做事”的能力还在，但“按正确协议把事做出来”的行为层被 RL 放大偏了。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义不在于 tool-use 本身，而在于它揭示了一个更一般的现象：当训练目标只给稀疏标量奖励，而生成过程又依赖严格结构时，优化会优先利用最容易被放大的局部 token 模式，而不是稳健地提升整体策略。这和长链推理、代码格式、XML/JSON 约束生成、函数调用协议都有直接关系。论文的贡献主要有两层。第一层是诊断层面：把 agentic RL 的失败从“RL 不会教会模型用工具”改写成“RL 会把结构 token 学坏”。第二层是方法层面：系统比较多种监督信号如何与 RL 结合，并指出简单混训不够，监督必须以合适的时序和形式介入，才能稳定结构而不过度牺牲泛化。
summary.technical_approach:
方法部分分成两块：失稳机理分析，以及监督信号设计。

机理分析上，作者把多轮 tool trajectory 写成 action-feedback 序列，关注 RL 训练中 token 分布如何演化。核心观察是，崩塌前往往先出现特定控制 token 的概率尖峰，随后合法工具调用格式迅速下降，错误响应频率陡增。作者进一步说明，这不是能力真正消失，因为在改变提示或放宽格式约束后，模型仍能表现出部分正确的工具使用与推理能力。问题出在 policy mass 被重新分配到少数“结构支点 token”上，生成被这些 token 牵引到退化模式。

在稳定化方案上，作者系统考察了六类 supervisory signals，并按训练组织方式分成 synchronous 和 interleaved 两大类。文中反复强调两者差别：synchronous 是在同一优化阶段把 RL 与监督目标一起混合；interleaved 则是在训练时间轴上交替进行 RL 和 SFT/监督更新。作者发现前者容易出现分布错配，因为监督样本和当前 RL rollout 的状态分布不一致，梯度会互相拉扯；后者更像周期性地把策略拉回到合法结构流形上，因此更稳。

具体监督形式包括：1）SFT 后接 RL，作为强初始化；2）off-policy supervision，用高质量轨迹直接监督当前策略；3）错误轨迹监督，把失败样本也纳入训练；4）hint-based guidance，在生成前提供正确提示或中间线索，但优化时去掉 hint，等于用 hint 只做行为引导、不让模型依赖显式提示；5）process reflection supervision，从训练过程中的中间推理步骤抽取反思文本，总结每一步的优缺点，再与原始错误轨迹配对构造 SFT 数据。这里最有意思的是最后两项，它们不是单纯喂正确答案，而是在结构失稳前给模型更细粒度的过程约束，弥补标量 reward 无法表达“这一轮格式对不对、调用位置对不对”的缺陷。

从与已有方法的区别看，很多 agentic RL 工作把重点放在 reward 设计、轨迹采样或环境搭建上；这篇文章更关心 token-level control dynamics，认为稳定性首先是一个生成结构控制问题，而不是单纯 credit assignment 问题。这一点很像把 RL 训练中的 failure mode 从高层策略失败，下沉到序列建模层面的局部概率异常。
summary.experiments:
实验部分的重点不是追求单点最好成绩，而是展示崩塌现象、比较监督方式、分析稳定性与泛化的取舍。全文明确提到在两类模型家族上做了系统实验，并比较了六种监督配置。虽然给到的正文片段没有完整表格数字，但几个结论是清楚的。

第一，纯 RL 会出现灾难性 collapse。表现为某一阶段后任务成功率接近归零，同时合法 tool-invocation 结构明显损坏，错误响应频率突然上升。这个“突然”很关键，说明不是平滑退化，而是训练动力学跨过某个阈值后的相变式失稳。

第二，SFT 初始化显著改善早期稳定性。也就是先把模型放到一个会按协议调用工具的区域，再做 RL，能明显降低一开始就跑偏的概率。但作者也指出，单靠 SFT 初始化并不能解决全部问题，尤其在更难的 OOD 设置下，可能出现泛化受限。

第三，简单同步混合监督与 RL 效果有限，甚至会因 distribution mismatch 带来问题。相比之下，interleaved training 更稳定，最终性能也更可靠。这个结论很重要，因为它说明“有没有监督”不是唯一变量，“监督在什么时候、以什么节奏进入训练”同样决定结果。

第四，process reflection supervision 能进一步提升稳定性和最终表现。原因不是它提供了更多标签，而是它把错误轨迹转成了可学习的过程文本，让模型知道哪一步出了问题、为什么错，而不是只看到一个终局 reward。

第五，作者专门分析了学习率敏感性和跨设置迁移。结论是稳定方法通常对学习率更不敏感，且在 format-level 和 content-level OOD 上更稳；但某些强监督方案虽然能保结构，却可能在 OOD 上掉点，说明结构约束和开放泛化之间存在张力。

如果精读全文，建议重点看展示 collapse 曲线、控制 token 概率演化、合法格式比例变化的图。这些图比最终平均分更能说明问题。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合按“现象—机理—干预”顺序读。

先看 Introduction 和展示 collapse 的主图，确认作者到底把什么定义为 failure。这里不要只看任务分数，要同时看 malformed tool call、错误响应频率、控制 token 概率变化。

然后看分析部分，重点理解作者为何说能力没有消失而是被结构失稳遮蔽。若文中有案例分析或替代提示实验，这部分值得细读，因为它决定了后续方法设计的方向：如果真是能力退化，就该改 reward 或探索；如果是结构崩塌，就该加行为约束。

接着看 supervisory signals 的分类和训练范式对比。尤其要分清 synchronous 与 interleaved 的差别，以及 hint-based guidance、process reflection supervision 各自解决什么问题。这里建议连同训练时间轴示意图一起看。

最后看 OOD、learning rate 和 transfer 分析。泛读时容易只记住“加监督更稳”，但真正有用的信息是：哪些监督主要修结构，哪些会牺牲泛化，哪些对超参更鲁棒。预计 35–50 分钟能抓住主线；如果要把方法迁移到代码 agent、函数调用或长链推理训练，建议把实验和附录里的失败案例一起看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why pure RL often becomes unstable in multi-step tool-use training, sometimes driving a previously competent tool-using model to near-zero performance. The central claim is precise: the main failure is not loss of reasoning ability, but structural collapse. During RL, probability mass gets disproportionately amplified on a small set of control or formatting tokens, which breaks tool-call syntax, turn structure, and execution protocol. Once the structure is corrupted, environment feedback also becomes less meaningful, and training deteriorates further. In other words, the model may still know what to do, but RL distorts how that competence is serialized into valid agent trajectories.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining and foundation-model research goes beyond tool use. It exposes a broader optimization pathology: when the objective provides sparse scalar rewards but successful behavior depends on strict structured generation, training may exploit fragile local token patterns before it improves the full policy. That observation matters for function calling, code generation with syntax constraints, XML/JSON outputs, and long-horizon reasoning traces. The contribution is twofold. First, it reframes agentic RL failure from a capability-learning problem into a structural-control problem. Second, it systematically studies how different supervisory signals interact with RL, showing that supervision is not just an auxiliary boost; when scheduled properly, it acts as a stabilizer for structured generation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical story has two parts: diagnosing the collapse mechanism and designing supervisory interventions.

On the diagnosis side, the paper models multi-turn tool-use trajectories as alternating action-feedback sequences and tracks how token distributions evolve under RL. The key empirical pattern is that collapse is preceded by sharp probability spikes on specific control tokens, followed by a rapid drop in valid tool-invocation structure and a surge in malformed responses. The authors argue that this is not true capability erasure: under altered prompts or relaxed formatting conditions, the model can still display parts of the underlying reasoning and tool-use competence. The issue is that policy mass is being reallocated toward a few structural anchor tokens, pulling generation into degenerate execution modes.

On the intervention side, the paper studies six supervisory configurations, organized into two training paradigms: synchronous and interleaved. This distinction is one of the main practical insights. In synchronous training, RL and supervision are mixed within the same optimization phase. In interleaved training, RL updates and supervised updates alternate over time. The paper argues that synchronous mixing often suffers from distribution mismatch, because supervised trajectories and current RL rollouts come from different state distributions, leading to conflicting gradients. Interleaving instead acts like a periodic projection back onto a manifold of valid structured behavior, which is why it is more stable.

The supervisory forms include: (1) SFT followed by RL as a strong initialization; (2) off-policy supervision using high-quality trajectories; (3) supervision on erroneous trajectories; (4) hint-based guidance, where correct hints are prepended before generation but removed during optimization, so hints guide behavior without becoming a crutch; and (5) Process Reflection Supervision, where intermediate reasoning steps are converted into reflective textual supervision summarizing what each step did well or poorly, then paired with error trajectories to build SFT data. The last two are especially interesting because they do not merely provide correct outputs; they inject process-level constraints that scalar rewards cannot express, such as whether a tool was invoked in the right place or whether the trajectory remained structurally valid.

Relative to prior agentic RL work, which often emphasizes reward design, trajectory synthesis, or environment construction, this paper focuses on token-level control dynamics. Its main claim is that instability is first a sequence-modeling and structural-generation problem, not only a high-level credit-assignment problem.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are designed more to characterize failure modes and stabilization trade-offs than to chase a single best benchmark number. The paper reports systematic studies on two model families and compares six supervisory configurations. Even from the provided full-text excerpt, several findings are clear.

First, pure RL can undergo catastrophic collapse. Performance drops abruptly to near zero, valid tool-invocation structures break down, and malformed responses spike. The abruptness matters: this is not smooth degradation but threshold-like instability in training dynamics.

Second, SFT initialization substantially improves early-stage stability. Starting RL from a model already located in a region of valid tool-use behavior reduces the chance of immediate drift. At the same time, the paper notes that SFT alone is not enough, especially under harder OOD settings where generalization can remain limited.

Third, simply mixing supervision with RL in a synchronous way is often insufficient and can even hurt due to distribution mismatch. Interleaved training is consistently more stable and usually yields more reliable final performance. This is one of the strongest practical takeaways: the timing and scheduling of supervision matter as much as its presence.

Fourth, Process Reflection Supervision further improves both stability and final performance. Its advantage is not just more labels, but richer process-level learning signals extracted from failures, allowing the model to learn why a step was wrong rather than only receiving a terminal reward.

Fifth, the paper analyzes learning-rate sensitivity and cross-setting transfer. More stable methods tend to be less sensitive to learning rate and more robust under format-level and content-level OOD evaluation. However, some stronger supervision schemes preserve structure at the cost of OOD generalization, indicating a real tension between structural regularization and open-ended adaptability.

When reading the results, the most informative figures are likely those showing collapse trajectories, control-token probability evolution, and valid-format ratios over training, rather than only aggregate task scores.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order of phenomenon, mechanism, then intervention.

Start with the introduction and the main collapse figures. Do not focus only on task success rate; also track malformed tool calls, error-response frequency, and the probability trajectories of control tokens.

Then move to the analysis section and understand why the authors claim the capability is preserved but hidden by structural failure. If the paper includes prompt-variation or format-relaxation case studies, those are worth close reading because they determine the right remedy. If the issue were capability loss, one would redesign rewards or exploration. If it is structural collapse, one needs behavioral constraints.

Next, study the taxonomy of supervisory signals and the comparison between synchronous and interleaved training. Pay particular attention to what hint-based guidance and Process Reflection Supervision are each fixing. Training-timeline diagrams, if present, are likely useful here.

Finish with the OOD, learning-rate, and transfer analyses. The easy takeaway is “supervision stabilizes RL,” but the useful takeaway is finer-grained: which supervision mainly repairs structure, which harms generalization, and which is more hyperparameter-robust. Around 35–50 minutes should be enough for the main thread; if you want to adapt the ideas to code agents, function calling, or long-chain reasoning, also read the failure cases and appendix details.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 §分析和监督信号消融；“能力没丢、格式 token 崩了”是可复现实验的好假设。
recommendation.en: Skim the failure analysis and supervision ablations; “capability intact, format tokens collapsed” is a clean hypothesis to test internally.

paper.title: Semantic Consistency Policy Optimization for Reinforcement Learning of LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Group-based reinforcement learning effectively post-trains LLM agents for long-horizon, sparse-reward tasks by deriving step-level credit from trajectory outcomes. However, this ties a step's credit to its rollout's final outcome: semantically near-identical intermediate steps receive opposite credit depending on whether their trajectory eventually succeeded or failed. Such semantic credit inconsistency sends conflicting gradients to similar actions and wastes the partially-correct progress insi

summary.core_problem: 解决基于分组的LLM智能体强化学习中，语义相近的中间步骤因轨迹最终成败不同而获得相反信用、导致梯度冲突与失败轨迹中部分正确进展被浪费的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出无价值函数的奖励塑形思路，缓解分组RL中的语义信用不一致问题，为长程稀疏奖励任务的后训练提供新方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出语义一致性策略优化（SCPO），属于改进型方法；核心是在同一rollout分组内，用成功的兄弟轨迹为失败步骤打分，对沿兄弟轨迹取得的新进展赋予正向步骤级信用，无需额外价值网络。
summary.experiments: 在ALFWorld和WebShop两个长程智能体基准上测试，与强分组RL基线对比，SCPO达到或超过基线性能，ALFWorld上成功率为93.7±4.1%。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses semantic credit inconsistency in group-based RL for LLM agents: semantically similar intermediate steps receive opposite rewards depending on their rollout's final outcome, wasting partial progress in failed trajectories.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a value-free reward shaping approach to mitigate credit misalignment, offering a new direction for post-training agents on long-horizon sparse-reward tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Semantic Consistency Policy Optimization (SCPO), an improved RL method that scores failed steps against successful sibling trajectories within the same rollout group and assigns positive step-level credit to new progress along the sibling path, without a separate value network.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on ALFWorld and WebShop long-horizon agent benchmarks; SCPO matches or outperforms strong group-based baselines, achieving 93.7±4.1% success rate on ALFWorld.

recommendation.zh: 信用分配思路对RLHF/RL智能体训练有弱启发，重点看§3的兄弟轨迹打分规则即可，实验规模偏小，结论当参考信号。
recommendation.en: The credit assignment idea offers weak signal for RLHF and agent training; focus on §3 sibling scoring rules, treat small-scale results as reference only.

paper.title: The Interplay of Harness Design and Post-Training in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Tool-integrated LLM agents are often wrapped within a harness: the scaffolding that determines which tools are exposed, how they are described, and what auxiliary information accompanies each per-step observation. While agents are routinely post-trained, this scaffolding is typically treated as a fixed engineering detail, with design effort limited to the training-free regime. Moreover, existing post-training algorithms assume a static environment, even though tool environments and tasks often s

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：工具型 LLM agent 的 post-training 效果是否强依赖 harness，也就是工具描述、可见信息、历史组织方式、可行动作集合等外部脚手架；这种依赖在任务分布变化和工具接口变化时会怎样表现。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值在于把 harness 从工程细节提升为训练环境的一部分。对预训练和后训练接口来说，结论很直接：agent 的能力不是只由模型参数和训练算法决定，训练时暴露给模型的工具接口、状态重建方式和辅助信息会进入策略学习过程。如果训练和部署时 harness 不一致，或者工具协议发生变化，性能可能显著下降。这对构造 agent SFT/RL 数据、设计 tool-use curriculum、评估 OOD 鲁棒性都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者扩展 ALFWorld，把它改造成一个可控制 harness 的工具集成 agent benchmark。形式化上，agent 在每一步接收 system prompt、user query 和工具调用历史，输出 action tokens；tool environment 负责执行工具调用，并把结果和历史重建成下一步状态。关键设计是把 harness 的信息量作为变量，而不是固定背景条件。文中提供三种不同信息量的 harness，其中高信息量版本会在每一步给出完整可行工具调用集合，但这种设计需要掌握环境转移动态，成本较高。作者还把评测拆成 in-distribution、task shift 和 tool environment shift。后者尤其重要：任务不变，但工具调用协议或接口发生变化，这是常见但较少被系统评估的 OOD 情况。
summary.experiments: 主要实验结论有四点。第一，ALFWorld 上已有 post-training 方法的高成功率，很大程度上来自固定且信息量很高的 harness。第二，harness-aware post-training 不只提升分布内表现，也能提高 OOD 设置下的适应性。第三，低设计成本、低信息量 harness 训练出的模型，在更严重的 tool environment shift 下会出现明显性能下降。第四，如果先在低信息量 harness 下 post-train，再到推理时临时加上更强 harness，效果不如训练阶段就使用该 harness。这说明 harness 不是简单的 inference-time prompt trick，而会改变模型学习到的动作分布和状态解释方式。给出的内容没有包含完整数值表，需要在实验章节核对各设置下的成功率。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看 benchmark extension 和 harness definitions，确认三种 harness 分别给模型暴露了哪些信息，以及这些信息在真实部署中是否可获得。随后看 in-distribution、task shift、tool environment shift 三组结果，尤其是 harness-aware post-training 与 post-hoc harness application 的对比。若关注 agent RL/SFT 数据构造，重点看作者如何定义状态、工具反馈和历史重建；这些细节比单个成功率更有迁移价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether post-training for tool-using LLM agents is tightly coupled with the harness: the wrapper that decides which tools are exposed, how tools are described, how histories are reconstructed, and what auxiliary information is shown at each step. It further asks how this coupling behaves under task shifts and tool-interface shifts.
summary_en.importance: The main lesson for pre-training and post-training research is that the harness should be treated as part of the learning environment, not as a neutral engineering layer. Tool-use data, prompts, action schemas, feasible-action hints, and observation formatting all shape the policy learned during post-training. If the harness changes between training and deployment, or if tool protocols are updated, the agent can fail even when the underlying task remains similar. This is relevant for agent SFT/RL data construction, tool-use curricula, and OOD evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors extend ALFWorld into a benchmark where harness design is a controllable variable. The agent receives a system prompt, user query, and tool-call history, then emits action tokens. The tool environment executes actions and reconstructs the next state from the action, result, and history. The key experimental variable is harness informativeness. The benchmark provides three harnesses with different design costs and amounts of auxiliary information. The most informative harness can expose the full set of feasible tool calls at each step, but it requires knowledge of the environment transition dynamics. The benchmark also supports in-distribution evaluation, task shift, and tool environment shift, where the task may stay fixed while tool invocation protocols change.
summary_en.experiments: The reported findings are qualitative but clear. High ALFWorld success rates from prior post-training setups are partly explained by harness-aware post-training with a highly informative fixed harness. Post-training with the harness in place improves both in-distribution performance and robustness under OOD settings. Models trained with low-effort, low-information harnesses suffer large drops under stronger tool environment shifts. More informative harnesses tend to help under task shift as well. Applying a stronger harness only at inference time after post-training with a weaker harness is worse than using that harness during post-training, suggesting that the harness changes the learned action distribution rather than merely improving prompting. Exact success rates are not visible in the provided content and should be checked in the experimental tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the benchmark construction and the three harness definitions; the key question is what information each harness exposes and whether that information would be available in deployment. Then inspect the results for in-distribution, task shift, and tool environment shift, especially the comparison between harness-aware post-training and post-hoc harness application. For readers working on agent SFT or RL, the most transferable details are the state representation, tool feedback format, and history reconstruction rules.

recommendation.zh: 将Agent脚手架作为可控变量的视角新颖，做Agent后训练泛化的研究员可重点看§3的环境扩展与§4的OOD消融。
recommendation.en: Novel perspective of treating agent harness as a controllable variable; Agent post-training generalization researchers should focus on §3's environment extension and §4's OOD ablations.

paper.title: Reinforcement Learning Towards Broadly and Persistently Beneficial Models
paper.abstract: As AI systems are deployed across increasingly diverse and high-stakes settings, model alignment must generalize beyond the tasks and domains seen during training. This is especially important for reinforcement learning (RL), which can introduce unexpected misalignment through reward hacking, deception, or other unintended strategies. We study whether RL on beneficial behavior, instantiated in realistic domains, can produce broad and persistent alignment generalization beyond the training distri

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究一个 alignment generalization 问题：如果用 RL 训练模型表现出有益特质，例如诚实、公平、风险意识、可纠正性和元认知透明度，这些行为是否会迁移到训练分布之外，并且在有害 prompt steering 或后续有害微调下保持稳定。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对 pretrain 与 posttrain 的接口有直接启发。它把 RL 信号从单任务正确性转向更高层的行为特质，并检验这些特质是否像近期 emergent misalignment 工作中的“有害 persona”一样跨领域泛化。对基座研究员有用的点在于：后训练奖励并不只是局部补丁，它可能选择出较稳定的模型行为模式；如果这种模式可以跨任务泛化，那么预训练阶段的数据、拒答边界、推理风格和自我表述方式都会影响后续 RL 的可塑性和风险。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构造了一个多领域的 realistic conversation 数据集，用来训练和评测有益特质。领域覆盖健康、科学、教育、法律、商业等，奖励维度包括 truthfulness、fairness、risk awareness、corrigibility、metacognitive transparency 等。训练上使用 RL，并与 compute-matched baseline 对比。实验设计的关键不是单个 benchmark 提升，而是两个泛化控制：第一，只在 5% 训练计算中把标准 RL 数据替换为健康相关有益行为数据，其余 95% 相同，然后评估非健康领域；第二，在 5% 数据分配中排除健康和科学内容，再评估健康与心理健康任务。这两个设置试图排除“训练集和测试集主题重叠”这一解释。论文还测试 persistence：模型在有害提示诱导下是否更难被带偏，以及经过有害医疗回答微调后是否退化更少。
summary.experiments: 主实验使用超过 50 个训练分布外的 alignment、safety 和 benefits 评测。多领域 beneficial trait RL 模型相对 compute-matched baseline，在超过 80% 的评测上提升，平均提升超过 9 个百分点。健康-only 的 5% 数据替换实验中，模型在 17 个非健康评测上提升，覆盖代码 reward hacking、chain-of-thought deception、alignment questions 和 general misalignment。反向控制中，去掉健康和科学对话的模型仍在 10 个健康和心理健康评测上提升，其中包括由医生专家 rubric 评分的评测。persistence 实验显示，多领域有益特质 RL 模型对有害 prompt steering 更稳，同时仍能被引导到有益行为；在被微调去生成不准确或不安全医疗回答后，它的 alignment 评测保持得更好，退化幅度小于基线。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读偏精读，预计 40 到 50 分钟。重点看 Section 2 的数据集和 reward rubric 设计，因为这决定了所谓 beneficial traits 是否只是表面风格；看 Section 3.1 的 50+ OOD 评测汇总，但不要只看平均值，要看哪些类别没有提升；看 Section 3.2 和 3.3 的健康领域控制实验，这是判断泛化是否可信的关键；看 Section 4 的 prompt steering 和 harmful finetuning，因为这部分更接近真实后训练风险。预训练研究者可以重点思考 reward 数据的 trait 结构是否能反哺 pretraining data mixture，例如在预训练或 mid-training 中提高能支持诚实校准、风险表达和可纠正性的语料比例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether reinforcement learning on beneficial behavioral traits can generalize beyond the training distribution and persist under adversarial pressure. The traits include honesty, fairness, risk awareness, corrigibility, and metacognitive transparency. The central question is whether RL can select for broadly beneficial model behavior, analogous to how recent work has shown narrow misalignment training can induce broader harmful behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a post-training and alignment paper, but it has a meaningful interface with pretraining research. It treats reward signals as selectors of relatively stable behavioral patterns rather than narrow task-level corrections. If such patterns generalize, then pretraining data composition, model calibration, refusal behavior, and self-representation may affect how easily RL can shape aligned or misaligned behavior. The paper is also useful because it evaluates persistence, not only immediate benchmark gains.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a multi-domain dataset of realistic conversations for both training and evaluation of beneficial traits. The domains include health, science, education, law, and business, and the reward criteria cover truthfulness, fairness, risk awareness, corrigibility, and metacognitive transparency. Models are trained with RL and compared against compute-matched baselines. The strongest design choice is the use of domain-control experiments. In one setting, only 5% of training compute is changed: standard RL data is replaced with health-related beneficial behavior data, while the other 95% remains identical; the model is then evaluated on non-health alignment tasks. In the complementary setting, health and science conversations are excluded from the 5% allocation, and the model is evaluated on health and mental-health tasks. The paper also tests persistence under harmful prompt steering and harmful finetuning.
summary_en.experiments: The main evaluation suite contains more than 50 out-of-distribution alignment, safety, and benefits evaluations. The multi-domain beneficial-trait RL model improves on over 80% of these evaluations relative to a compute-matched baseline, with average gains above 9 percentage points. In the health-only 5% intervention, the model improves on 17 non-health evaluations, including reward hacking in code, chain-of-thought deception, alignment questions, and broader misalignment measures. In the complementary control, the model trained without health and science conversations in that 5% allocation still improves on 10 health and mental-health evaluations, including expert physician-rubric evaluations. Persistence tests show greater resistance to harmful prompt steering while retaining steerability toward beneficial behavior, and less regression after harmful medical finetuning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim with selective deep reading in about 40 to 50 minutes. Read the dataset and reward-rubric construction carefully, because the credibility of the results depends on whether the trait labels capture behavior rather than style. Then inspect the over-50-evaluation summary and, more importantly, the categories that do not improve. The health-only and no-health/no-science controls are the key evidence for generalization beyond topic overlap. The prompt-steering and harmful-finetuning sections are especially relevant for understanding whether RL-induced traits are stable enough to matter in later training stages.

recommendation.zh: 对齐泛化是pretrain-posttrain闭环的核心痛点，重点看其训练数据的特质标注框架和OOD评测集的选择逻辑。
recommendation.en: Alignment generalization is a core pain point in the pretrain-posttrain loop; focus on the trait annotation framework for training data and OOD benchmark selection logic.

paper.title: OpenThoughts-Agent: Data Recipes for Agentic Models
paper.abstract: Agentic language models dramatically expand the applications of AI yet little is publicly known about how to curate training data for broadly capable agents. Existing open efforts such as SWE-Smith, SERA, and Nemotron-Terminal typically target a single benchmark, leaving open the question of how to train models that generalize across diverse agentic tasks. The OpenThoughts-Agent (OT-Agent) project addresses this gap with a fully open data curation pipeline for training agentic models. We conduct

summary.core_problem: 现有开源的智能体训练数据大多针对单一基准（如SWE-Bench、Terminal-Bench）设计，缺乏能支撑模型跨多样智能体任务泛化的公开数据配方，也没有研究通过严格控制变量的消融，系统梳理数据管线各环节设计对跨任务性能的影响。
summary.importance: 提供了经过百次以上对照实验验证的、完全开源的智能体后训练数据生产流程。总结出的任务源选择、教师模型选型、轨迹筛选、多样性配比方面的经验规律，对通用智能体模型的后训练数据搭建有直接工程参考，可减少管线设计阶段的重复试错；观察到的多样性边际递减规律，和预训练数据配比的通用经验形成呼应。
summary.technical_approach: 搭建端到端的智能体SFT轨迹生产管线，采用严格的控制变量实验框架：固定1万样本训练规模、Qwen3-8B全参数SFT的统一训练配置，以三个核心智能体基准的平均z-score作为统一评价指标，独立消融管线每个环节的设计选择。基于消融结论组装10万规模的训练集微调Qwen3-32B，同时配套整理了RL训练数据，验证SFT+RL两阶段训练流程的效果。核心实验发现包括：任务指令源的质量是影响最终性能的最大因素；基准上得分最高的教师模型不一定产出最好的蒸馏轨迹；筛选保留交互轮次更多的执行轨迹能提升训练效果；对头部数据源重复采样会出现边际收益递减，必须扩充来源多样性。
summary.experiments: 单组消融实验（1万样本）的训练成本为160 GH200 GPU小时，累计完成超过100组对照。基于最终配方的10万样本集微调Qwen3-32B后，在SWE-Bench Verified上达到54.0%准确率，Terminal-Bench 2.0上达到26.2%准确率，超过同规模的Nemotron-Terminal-32B基线（分别为41.9%、25.1%），同时在Aider Polyglot、BFCL-Parity、GAIA-127、FinanceAgent-Terminal基准上也超过同规模开源模型。数据缩放曲线显示，在任意固定训练数据量下，该数据集训练出的模型性能均高于其他开源智能体数据集。8B规模模型经过SFT+RL两阶段训练后，7个智能体基准的平均性能超过最优的单阶段8B模型及所有已发布的同参数规模基线。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言部分总结的四条核心消融结论，以及数据缩放性能对比图。无需细抠管线每个环节的工程实现细节，除非需要从零复现数据生产流程。预计阅读时间25分钟。
summary.authors_note: OpenThoughts开源团队出品，此前曾发布同系列的通用推理训练开源数据集。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing open datasets for training agentic models are largely built for individual benchmarks (e.g., SWE-Bench, Terminal-Bench). No open, generalizable data recipe exists for training models that perform across diverse agent tasks, and no controlled study has systematically measured how individual pipeline design choices affect cross-task generalization.
summary_en.importance: This work presents a fully open agent post-training data pipeline validated through over 100 controlled ablation experiments. The empirical findings on task source selection, teacher model choice, trajectory filtering, and diversity mixing provide actionable engineering guidance for teams building generalist agent models, reducing redundant trial-and-error in pipeline design. The observed diminishing returns from over-sampling top sources align with well-documented patterns in pretraining data mixing.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build an end-to-end pipeline for generating agentic SFT trajectories, using a tightly controlled evaluation protocol: 10k training samples per run, full-parameter SFT on Qwen3-8B with fixed hyperparameters, and average z-score across three core agent benchmarks as the unified ranking metric to ablate each pipeline stage independently. Guided by ablation results, they assemble a 100k training split to fine-tune Qwen3-32B, and curate a companion RL dataset to validate a two-stage SFT+RL training flow. Key findings include: instruction source quality is the highest-impact factor in the pipeline; top-scoring teacher models on benchmarks do not always produce the best distillation trajectories; filtering to retain trajectories with more agent interaction turns improves performance; over-sampling from high-performing data sources yields diminishing returns, requiring broader source diversity to continue scaling performance.
summary_en.experiments: Each 10k-sample ablation run costs 160 GH200 GPU hours, with over 100 total runs completed. The final 100k dataset, used to fine-tune Qwen3-32B, reaches 54.0% on SWE-Bench Verified and 26.2% on Terminal-Bench 2.0, outperforming the same-scale Nemotron-Terminal-32B baseline (41.9% / 25.1%), with consistent gains on Aider Polyglot, BFCL-Parity, GAIA-127, and FinanceAgent-Terminal. Scaling curves show the dataset outperforms all existing open agent datasets at every matched training data budget. An 8B model trained with the two-stage SFT+RL recipe outperforms both the best single-stage 8B model and all published <=8B baselines on average across 7 agent benchmarks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for empirical takeaways. Focus on the four core ablation conclusions in the introduction and the data scaling comparison plot. There is no need to dig into granular engineering details of each pipeline stage unless reproducing the data generation flow from scratch. Estimated reading time: 25 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Produced by the OpenThoughts open-source team, previously known for releasing the OpenThoughts general reasoning training dataset.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是新架构，但 data recipe 做得比多数 agent 论文干净；预训练研究员重点看 100+ ablation，判断哪些 agent 能力真是数据分布学出来的。
recommendation.en: Not an architecture paper, but the data recipe is cleaner than most agent work; read the 100+ ablations to see which agent behaviors are genuinely induced by data distribution.

paper.title: AsyncOPD: How Stale Can On-Policy Distillation Be?
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own rollouts guided by teacher feedback and is becoming increasingly important for large language model (LLM) post-training. Like reinforcement learning (RL), however, OPD faces an on-policy systems bottleneck, as rollouts can dominate training time for reasoning workloads. Asynchronous training pipelines can alleviate this bottleneck by decoupling rollout generation from learner updates, but doing so introduces stale-policy data. While prior

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究异步 on-policy distillation 中的 stale-policy 数据问题：rollout、teacher scoring 和 learner update 解耦后，训练吞吐提高，但 learner 看到的是旧 student 生成并被 teacher 打分的数据。核心难点不只是“数据过期”，还包括实际 OPD 系统通常不会缓存全词表 teacher logits，只会缓存有限动作集合上的 teacher 分数，这会改变 KL 目标和估计器的偏差、方差与可校正性。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在 post-train 系统和训练目标接口上。OPD 正在成为小模型推理能力提升、自蒸馏、多 teacher 蒸馏的重要路径，瓶颈往往在长链推理 rollout，而不是反向传播。论文把异步 RL 中常见的 stale data 问题搬到 OPD，但指出 OPD 的 teacher-cache 约束会让问题不同。这个观察对设计大规模 SFT/RL/蒸馏混合管线有参考意义：系统吞吐、teacher 评分成本、目标函数形式不能分开优化。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分析围绕三个层次展开。第一，比较 forward KL 和 reverse KL 在 stale rollout 下的差异。forward KL 是 teacher-weighted，更依赖 teacher 分布覆盖；在缓存 teacher-scored action 时相对稳健。reverse KL 是 student-weighted，learner 更新后当前 student 的高概率动作可能不在旧缓存里，因此更容易出现 support mismatch。第二，把 reverse-KL OPD 写成类似 policy-gradient 的形式，用 teacher-student log-ratio 作为 token-level advantage，再比较 PPO-style clipping、decoupled PPO、M2PO 等异步 RL 稳定化方法。结论是这些 RL surrogate 没有超过一个更简单的 OPD 方案：在 learner time 用当前 student 重新计算 reverse-KL 的 token-level advantage，并且不做 clipping。第三，分析有限 teacher cache 下的估计器。旧 student top-k support 覆盖稳定但不可校正，因为缺失的 teacher score 无法恢复；one-sample Monte Carlo 可用 importance correction，但方差高；multi-sample MC 在每个 decoding step 缓存多个 stale-policy samples，保留可校正性，同时降低方差。最终系统 AsyncOPD 将 student rollout、teacher scoring、learner update 全异步重叠。
summary.experiments: 实验主要验证四点。第一，KL 方向决定 stale-policy 敏感性：forward KL 对旧 rollout 更稳，reverse KL 在当前 student 权重下更容易受缓存 support 限制。第二，在 reverse-KL OPD 上，PPO clipping、decoupled PPO、M2PO 等从异步 RL 借来的方法没有带来稳定收益；learner time 重新计算 advantage 且不 clipping 的 surrogate 更合适。第三，stale top-k support 存在确定性覆盖但无法修正漏掉的动作；one-sample MC 方差较高；multi-sample MC 在质量和方差之间更稳。第四，在 Qwen3-Base 模型上，AsyncOPD 相比严格同步训练获得 1.6× 到 3.8× 的训练吞吐提升，同时保持相近 accuracy。这个结果说明异步化的收益主要来自减少 learner 等待 rollout 和 teacher scoring 的时间，而质量损失可以通过合适的 OPD estimator 控制。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。重点看 Section 4 的 KL direction 分析，它解释了为什么 forward KL 和 reverse KL 的 stale-data 行为不同；Section 5 看 reverse-KL surrogate 对比，尤其是为什么 PPO 系列方法没有直接迁移成功；Section 6 看 teacher-cache 约束下 top-k、one-sample MC、multi-sample MC 的偏差方差分析；Section 7 看系统 pipeline 和吞吐数字。若关心大规模 post-train 系统，Fig. 1 和异步 pipeline 图值得细看，因为它们把目标函数限制和系统约束连在了一起。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies policy staleness in asynchronous on-policy distillation. In OPD, the student generates rollouts and learns from dense teacher feedback. A synchronous pipeline wastes learner time on long reasoning rollouts, while an asynchronous pipeline improves utilization but trains on data produced by older student policies. The key complication is practical: full-vocabulary teacher logits are too expensive to cache, so the learner only receives teacher scores on a finite action set.
summary_en.importance: The work is useful for LLM post-training systems where OPD, self-distillation, and multi-teacher distillation are used to improve reasoning models. It shows that OPD staleness is not the same problem as asynchronous RL staleness. The teacher-score cache changes which objectives are safe and which estimators are biased. This matters for any large-scale pipeline that tries to overlap generation, teacher scoring, and optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis first separates forward-KL and reverse-KL OPD. Forward KL is teacher-weighted and is less sensitive to stale student rollouts under a finite teacher cache. Reverse KL is student-weighted and becomes fragile when the current student assigns probability to actions that were not scored by the teacher in the stale cache. The paper then treats reverse-KL OPD through a policy-gradient-style surrogate, where the teacher-student log-ratio acts as a token-level advantage. It evaluates PPO-style clipping, decoupled PPO, and M2PO, but finds that a simpler OPD-specific surrogate works better: recompute the reverse-KL token advantage at learner time under the current student, without clipping. Finally, it studies cache-induced estimator choices. Stale top-k supports are deterministic but suffer support mismatch. One-sample Monte Carlo remains importance-correctable but has high variance. Multi-sample Monte Carlo caches multiple stale-policy samples per step, reducing variance while preserving correctability.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments support the main design choices. Forward KL is empirically more robust to stale rollouts, while reverse KL is more exposed to missing teacher scores under finite caches. For reverse-KL OPD, asynchronous RL stabilizers such as PPO clipping, decoupled PPO, and M2PO do not improve over learner-time advantage recomputation without clipping. The estimator study shows the limitation of stale top-k supports, the high variance of one-sample MC, and the more favorable tradeoff of multi-sample MC. In the full AsyncOPD system, student rollout, teacher scoring, and learner updates are overlapped. On Qwen3-Base models, the system reports a 1.6× to 3.8× throughput improvement over strictly synchronous training while maintaining comparable accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 30–45 minutes. Read the KL-direction analysis first, because it explains why forward and reverse KL behave differently under stale caches. Then read the reverse-KL surrogate comparison, especially the negative result on PPO-family methods. The estimator section is the most practically useful part for implementation: it clarifies when top-k caches are biased and why multi-sample MC is preferable. The system section is worth reading for the pipeline design and the 1.6×–3.8× throughput result.

recommendation.zh: 只看 stale rollout 与 KL 方向的 ablation；若结论稳，异步 OPD 的 learner/rollout 比例需要重调。
recommendation.en: Read the staleness-by-KL-direction ablations; if stable, this changes how to set learner/rollout ratios for async OPD.

paper.title: Blockwise Policy-Drift Gating for On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student policy using teacher signals computed on trajectories sampled by the student itself. Recent work shows that sampled-token OPD can be fragile on long-horizon reasoning tasks and that local teacher-support matching is a simple and effective repair. This paper introduces blockwise policy-drift gating, a lightweight student-only old-current drift controller for OPD under rollout reuse. The method computes log-probability shifts between the behavior stude

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是 on-policy distillation 在长链推理训练中的一个稳定性问题：当 student rollout 被重复用于多个优化 epoch 时，当前 student 与生成这些 rollout 的旧 student 之间会发生 policy drift，导致同一条 sampled path 对当前更新来说“新鲜度”不同。已有工作更多关注 teacher 监督是否足够可靠，比如 sampled-token OPD 的脆弱性以及 Teacher-TopK/LSM 对局部 teacher support 的修复；这篇文章补的是另一块：即使 teacher target 不变，reused rollout 本身也会因为 old-current mismatch 变得不均匀可信，尤其在长响应里这种失配会沿序列累积。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 pretrain 到 post-train 的接口有现实意义。原因在于，很多后训练配方已经越来越像“继续训练一个会推理的语言模型”，而不是简单 SFT。OPD、RL、蒸馏这类方法的稳定性，会反过来影响大家如何理解 teacher-student compatibility、rollout reuse、以及长链 reasoning 数据的有效训练信号密度。论文的价值不在提出一个新目标，而在给出一个很轻量的 loss reweighting 规则：不改 teacher、不改 rollout policy、不改 support matching，只根据 student 自身 old/current log-prob shift 来调节哪些位置更该被当前更新重视。这个思路比较务实，也容易嵌入现有 PPO-style 训练框架。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 blockwise policy-drift gating。作者先定义 sampled token 路径上的 old-current log-probability shift，也就是当前 student 对某个已采样 token 的对数概率，与生成该 token 的 behavior student 的对数概率之差。这个量不是完整 KL，只是沿 sampled path 的局部漂移信号。直接用 token-level importance ratio exp(d_t) 做权重会很噪，因此作者选择中间粒度聚合：一类是固定 64 token 的 Block64-Gate，另一类是按换行切分并做长度修正的 NewlineSpan-Gate。对每个 block/span，把 shift 求平均，经过 detached soft gate 和 mean normalization 后，广播回该区域内所有 token，作为已有 OPD position loss 的乘子。关键点有三个。第一，gate 是 detached 的，不让模型为了操纵 gate 而学习；它只改变损失权重，不引入额外优化目标。第二，teacher target 完全不变，因此该方法既可加在 sampled-token OPD 上，也可叠加到 Teacher-TopK/LSM 上。第三，分块而不是逐 token，是为了在长 reasoning trace 中平衡方差和局部性：sequence-level 太粗，token-level 太抖，block-level 是折中。
summary.experiments: 实验设置比较克制。student 是 Qwen3-1.7B-Base，teacher 是 Qwen3-4B-Base-GRPO；训练数据来自 DAPO-Math-17k 处理后的 1,791,700 行数学样本；统一采用 200 step 训练预算、最大 response 长度 16384、rollout group size 8、两轮 PPO epoch。评测用外部 vLLM，主指标是四个数学 benchmark 上的 pass@8。论文主结论是：固定 64-token block 的 drift gate 能稳定提升 sampled-token OPD 的 solve rate；而在 Teacher-TopK/LSM 上继续叠加该 gate，也能得到最强的 aggregate pass@8。摘要没有给出完整数字表，但从全文描述看，作者更强调趋势一致性而不是单点大幅跃升：token-level importance weighting 噪声较大，sequence-level weighting 过于粗糙，blockwise aggregation 在六个方法变体里表现最稳。这个结果与方法设计是对齐的，因为它本来就是为 rollout reuse 下的 stale-data 问题服务，而不是试图替代 teacher support matching。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看引言里对 OPD 两类失配的区分：一类是 teacher support 不足，另一类是 old-current student drift。把这两件事分开理解，后面的方法就很清楚。然后看 policy-drift gating 章节，重点抓住 gate 的定义、detached 设计、mean normalization，以及为什么选 block64 和 newline span 这两种粒度。最后看主实验矩阵，关注六个变体在四个数学 benchmark 上的相对排序，而不是只盯单个分数。若只想判断是否值得跟进，读方法部分加主结果表大约 20 到 30 分钟即可。更值得深挖的问题是：这种 drift-aware weighting 是否能推广到更长训练预算、更强 teacher、以及 RL-only setting；另外，它和 PPO 里的 importance sampling / clipping 之间是否存在更系统的统一视角。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a stability issue in on-policy distillation for long-horizon reasoning. When student rollouts are reused across multiple optimization epochs, the current student can drift away from the behavior student that generated those trajectories. This creates a mismatch even if teacher supervision is unchanged: some sampled positions become stale for the current update. Prior work has mostly focused on teacher-side reliability, such as the fragility of sampled-token OPD and the repair provided by Teacher-TopK or local support matching. This paper targets a different failure mode: old-current student drift under rollout reuse.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not directly about pretraining, but it matters for the pretrain-to-post-train interface. Modern post-training increasingly resembles continued language-model training with stronger reasoning behavior, so the stability of OPD, RL, and distillation affects how researchers think about teacher-student compatibility, rollout reuse, and the density of useful training signal in long reasoning traces. The paper’s value is its restraint: it does not introduce a new teacher objective or a new rollout policy. Instead, it adds a lightweight loss reweighting rule based only on the student’s own old-versus-current log-probability shift. That makes it easy to plug into existing PPO-style pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is called blockwise policy-drift gating. For each sampled response token, the paper computes the old-current log-probability shift: the difference between the current student’s log-probability and the behavior student’s log-probability on the same sampled token. This is not a full KL estimate; it is a sampled-path drift signal. Using token-level importance ratios such as exp(d_t) is a natural baseline, but the paper argues that it is too noisy. Instead, it aggregates drift at an intermediate granularity. Two variants are used: Block64-Gate, which averages shifts over fixed 64-token blocks, and NewlineSpan-Gate, which aggregates over newline-delimited spans with heuristics for merging or splitting spans by length. The aggregated score is passed through a detached soft gate and mean-normalized over valid response tokens, then broadcast back to all positions in the region as a multiplicative weight on the existing OPD position loss. Three design choices matter. First, the gate is detached, so the model cannot optimize the gate itself; it only changes how much each position contributes to the base loss. Second, teacher targets are unchanged, so the same gating family can be applied both to sampled-token OPD and to Teacher-TopK/LSM. Third, blockwise aggregation is a variance-locality trade-off: sequence-level weighting is too coarse for long traces, while token-level weighting is too unstable.
summary_en.experiments: The setup is controlled rather than large-scale. The student is Qwen3-1.7B-Base and the teacher is Qwen3-4B-Base-GRPO. Training uses 1,791,700 processed math rows from DAPO-Math-17k, with a fixed 200-step budget, maximum response length 16384, rollout group size 8, and two PPO epochs. Evaluation is done externally with vLLM, and pass@8 on four math benchmarks is the main metric. The main finding is that fixed 64-token drift gating consistently improves sampled-token OPD solve rate, and that adding the same gate on top of Teacher-TopK/LSM yields the strongest aggregate pass@8 among the tested variants. The abstract does not expose the full numeric table, and the paper’s emphasis is more on consistent ranking than on a single dramatic gain. That is aligned with the method’s role: it is meant to mitigate stale-data effects under rollout reuse, not to replace teacher-support matching.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and pay attention to the distinction between two kinds of mismatch: insufficient teacher support versus old-current student drift. Once that separation is clear, the method section becomes straightforward. In the policy-drift gating section, focus on the gate definition, the detached design, the mean normalization, and why the paper chooses Block64 and newline spans as the two aggregation granularities. Then look at the main experiment matrix and compare the relative ordering of the six variants across the four math benchmarks rather than over-reading any single score. If the goal is just to judge whether the idea is worth following up, the method section plus the main result table should take about 20 to 30 minutes. The more interesting follow-up questions are whether this drift-aware weighting scales to longer training budgets, stronger teachers, or RL-only settings, and how it relates more systematically to importance sampling and clipping in PPO.

recommendation.zh: OPD是推理能力轻量化落地的核心路径，重点看§3的块级漂移聚合方式，可作为内部推理蒸馏ablation的 baseline 参考。
recommendation.en: On-policy distillation is a core path for lightweight reasoning deployment; focus on §3's block-wise drift aggregation as a baseline for internal reasoning distillation ablations.

paper.title: VeryTrace: Verifying Reasoning Traces through Compilable Formalism and Structured Verification
paper.abstract: Multi-step reasoning with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting remains fragile: logical errors or hallucinations in early steps silently propagate, producing confident but incorrect conclusions. This paper presents VeryTrace, a zero-shot verification-and-repair framework that formalizes natural-language reasoning traces into a structured, compilable representation. VeryTrace introduces a Domain-Specific Language (DSL) that (i) makes step dependencies explicit, (ii) mechanizes quantitative content as

summary.core_problem: 思维链（Chain-of-Thought，CoT）多步推理中早期的逻辑、计算或隐含假设错误会静默传播到后续步骤，生成看似合理但错误的输出。现有缓解方案存在本质权衡：端到端验证仅检查最终答案，推理链失效时无细粒度诊断；自一致性投票法需要多次高成本采样，无法定位单条推理链的错误原因；形式化证明器（Lean、Coq等）验证严格，但需要领域专家手动形式化，无法跨领域通用。目前缺乏能提供步骤级验证粒度、同时支持跨领域泛化的推理过程验证框架。
summary.importance: 将推理链视为可编译、可逐步骤验证的状态转移序列的思路，可为预训练或后训练阶段引入结构化推理监督、过程级校验信号提供具体参考。其零样本跨域生效的特性说明，无需领域特定调优即可提升推理可靠性，对推理导向的预训练目标设计、SFT/RL高质量推理数据构造有直接借鉴意义。步骤级错误诊断能力也支持针对性的推理增强数据筛选。
summary.technical_approach: 首先设计了领域无关的领域特定语言（Domain-Specific Language，简称DSL），把自然语言推理链转化为显式的状态转移序列：显式声明每个步骤的依赖关系，把定量计算内容转成可执行表达式，将无法直接形式化的语义推理约束到少量通用演绎模式（直接蕴含、肯定前件、传递性、案例分析）。随后构建混合验证器，将检查拆分为两类：确定性检查（依赖无前置引用、计算结果与状态更新一致、可形式化约束满足、结论与目标匹配），对无法机械化验证的语义部分（自然语言约束、常识推理）触发限定范围的结构化大模型审计。最后实现迭代修复流程：生成CoT→转换为DSL→验证→若无效则返回局部错误诊断→针对性修正问题区域→重新验证，全程不需要额外训练或领域特定示例。
summary.experiments: 在三类覆盖不同推理模式的数据集上验证：纯符号计算的AIME 2025竞赛数学、混合量化-语义推理的LLM-BabyBench机器人规划、自然语言关系推理的CLUTRR亲属关系数据集。在多个主流先进开源大模型上，VeryTrace零样本下相比强基线均取得稳定准确率提升，全程未使用任何领域特定训练或上下文示例。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读总耗时约40分钟：先阅读引言部分对现有推理验证方案的权衡分析（约10分钟），再查看DSL核心设计与混合验证器的分工逻辑（第2、3节，约20分钟），最后扫读跨域实验的结果表格与核心结论（约10分钟）。重点关注DSL如何平衡形式化严格性与跨域通用性，以及确定性检查与大模型审计的边界划分原则。

summary_en.core_problem: Early logical, computational, or unstated assumption errors in Chain-of-Thought (CoT) multi-step reasoning silently propagate through subsequent steps, producing confident but incorrect outputs. Existing mitigation methods face a fundamental trade-off: end-to-end verification only checks final answers with no step-level diagnostics when traces fail; self-consistency voting requires costly multiple samples without localizing error causes for individual traces; formal theorem provers (Lean, Coq, Isabelle) deliver rigorous verification but demand expert manual formalization and do not generalize across domains. No prior framework provides step-level verification granularity while supporting domain-agnostic generalization for the reasoning process itself.
summary_en.importance: The framing of reasoning traces as compilable, stepwise verifiable state transitions provides a concrete reference for injecting structured reasoning supervision or process-level verification signals into pretraining or post-training pipelines. Its zero-shot cross-domain effectiveness shows that reliability gains can be achieved without domain-specific tuning, which directly informs the design of reasoning-oriented pretraining objectives and high-quality reasoning data curation for SFT/RL. Step-level error diagnostics also enable targeted filtering of reasoning enhancement datasets.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, a domain-agnostic Domain-Specific Language (DSL) is proposed to convert free-form natural language reasoning traces into explicit state transition sequences. It makes step dependencies explicit, compiles quantitative content into executable expressions, and constrains non-formalizable semantic inferences to a small set of universal deduction schemas (direct entailment, modus ponens, transitivity, case analysis). A hybrid verifier then splits checks into two categories: deterministic checks for no forward dependency references, consistency between computation results and state updates, satisfiability of mechanizable constraints, and alignment between conclusions and declared goals; and scoped structured LLM audits for non-mechanizable semantic parts (natural language constraints, commonsense inferences). An iterative repair loop is implemented: generate CoT → formalize to DSL → verify → return localized error diagnostics if invalid → revise only problematic regions → re-verify, with no additional training or domain-specific demonstrations required.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across three datasets targeting distinct reasoning modes: AIME 2025 competition math (pure symbolic manipulation), LLM-BabyBench robotics planning (hybrid quantitative-semantic reasoning), and CLUTRR kinship reasoning (natural language relational inference). Across multiple state-of-the-art open-source LLMs, VeryTrace delivers consistent zero-shot accuracy improvements over strong baselines, with no domain-specific training or in-context examples used throughout experiments.
summary_en.reading_guide: Total skimming time is roughly 40 minutes: start with the trade-off analysis of existing reasoning verification methods in the Introduction (~10 mins), then review the core DSL design and labor division of the hybrid verifier in Sections 2 and 3 (~20 mins), finally scan cross-domain experiment result tables and key conclusions (~10 mins). Focus on how the DSL balances formalization rigor and cross-domain generality, and the boundary definition between deterministic checks and LLM-based audits.

recommendation.zh: 针对推理verifier的实用设计思路，混合可执行检查与LLM审计，适合RLVR研究者参考，重点看§3 DSL设计和§4验证流程即可。
recommendation.en: Pragmatic hybrid reasoning verifier combining executable checks and LLM audits; relevant for RLVR work, focus on §3 DSL design and §4 verification pipeline.

paper.title: CALIBER: Calibrating Confidence Before and After Reasoning in Language Models
paper.abstract: Reasoning language models are increasingly asked not only to answer difficult questions, but also to estimate their likelihood of success. Existing methods typically elicit confidence only once: either before thinking or after answering. We argue that confidence in reasoning models is state-dependent: before thinking, confidence should estimate the chance of the model correctly solving the prompt, while after thinking it should predict whether the realized answer is likely to be correct. This di

summary.core_problem: 解决推理模型在“思考前”和“作答后”置信度估计混为一谈，导致校准目标错配的问题。
summary.importance: 这是后训练与评估交界处的工作，贡献是把置信度校准拆成两个信息状态下的不同任务。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于：它提醒我们，模型内部状态变化后，监督目标也应随之变化，不能把所有 uncertainty 都压成一个标量。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 CALIBER，分别在看到 prompt 后、以及完成 reasoning/answer 后各 elicitation 一次 confidence。前者用 prompt-level success 作为监督目标，估计“这道题我能不能做对”；后者用 answer-level correctness 作为监督目标，估计“我刚给出的这个答案对不对”。核心不是新架构，而是统一协议下的信息状态匹配监督。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 CALIBER 相比只在单一时刻估计置信度的方法，将 Expected Calibration Error 降低 52.5%。任务对象是 reasoning language models，但摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集名称和 baseline 列表；从描述看，比较对象主要是只在思考前或只在作答后做一次 confidence elicitation 的现有做法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a target-mismatch problem in confidence estimation for reasoning models: confidence before thinking and confidence after answering are treated as the same task when they should not be.
summary_en.importance: This sits at the boundary of post-training and evaluation. Its main contribution is to split calibration into two tasks tied to two information states. For pretraining researchers, the useful lesson is that supervision targets should track the model's state; uncertainty should not always be collapsed into a single scalar prediction.
summary_en.technical_approach: CALIBER elicits confidence twice: once after seeing the prompt and once after producing reasoning/answer. The first is supervised with prompt-level success, estimating whether the model can solve the problem; the second is supervised with answer-level correctness, estimating whether the realized answer is correct. The novelty is not architectural but in state-matched supervision under a unified protocol.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a 52.5% reduction in Expected Calibration Error relative to single-shot confidence baselines. The target setting is reasoning language models, but the abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, or the exact baseline suite; the comparison appears to be against methods that elicit confidence only before or only after reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 更像后训练校准小修正，不会改变 pretrain prior；如果你在做 verifier、selective generation 或 RL 置信度奖励，只看“双时刻、双监督目标”这个设定就够了。
recommendation.en: This is a neat post-training calibration fix, not a pretraining prior shift; if you work on verifiers, selective generation, or confidence-based rewards, the only thing to take is the two-state, two-target setup.

paper.title: SER: Learning to Ground Video Reasoning with Semantic Evidence Rewards
paper.abstract: Video MLLMs often struggle with fine-grained spatio-temporal reasoning, sometimes generating correct answers based on irrelevant frames or objects. Although outputting spatio-temporal evidence during reasoning is a promising direction, existing RL frameworks typically rely on geometry-only (IoU) rewards, which can be sensitive to boundary perturbations and overlook semantic alignment. To address this, we propose Semantic Evidence Reward (SER), which reformulates spatio-temporal evidence groundin

summary.core_problem: 现有视频MLLM的时空推理接地RL方法仅依赖IoU几何奖励，对边界扰动敏感且忽略语义对齐，易出现基于无关帧/对象得出正确答案的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出语义证据奖励（SER），将时空证据接地转化为约束验证任务，用裁判VLM替代几何指标做奖励评估，无需密集框标注。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 奖励设计：用裁判VLM作为局部检查器，从证据相关性与定位质量两个维度评估模型生成的证据声明，加入时序惩罚项；2. 训练方式：直接在标准视频QA数据上训练，无需额外密集边界框标注。
summary.experiments: 在V-STAR基准上取得49.6%的mLGM指标，较强证据接地基线Open-o3-V提升3.0个百分点。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RL methods for spatio-temporal reasoning grounding in video MLLMs only rely on IoU geometric rewards, which are sensitive to boundary perturbations and ignore semantic alignment, leading to correct answers from irrelevant frames/objects.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes Semantic Evidence Reward (SER), which reformulates spatio-temporal evidence grounding as a constrained verification task, using a referee VLM instead of geometric metrics for reward evaluation, without dense box annotations.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Reward design: uses a referee VLM as a local checker to evaluate model-generated evidence claims from two dimensions: relevance and localization quality, plus a temporal penalty term; 2. Training: directly trained on standard video QA data without extra dense bounding box annotations.
summary_en.experiments: Achieves 49.6% mLGM on the V-STAR benchmark, 3.0 points higher than the strong evidence-grounded baseline Open-o3-V.

recommendation.zh: 做多模态后训练奖励设计的可参考其用VLM当裁判的思路，但属于视频领域特定优化，无通用预训练insight，看摘要和实验表即可。
recommendation.en: Useful for multimodal post-training reward design via VLM-as-referee, but it is video-specific optimization with no general pretrain insights; read abstract and experiment tables only.

paper.title: Beyond Trajectory Imitation: Strategy-Guided Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Distilling reasoning capabilities from strong to weak language models typically involves imitating specific solution trajectories, effectively transferring what to answer rather than how to reason. This trajectory-level imitation encourages memorization of instance-specific steps rather than acquisition of transferable problem-solving skills, limiting generalization to novel problems. We propose Strategy-Guided Policy Optimization (SGPO), which replaces instance-level trajectory imitation with r

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM推理蒸馏通过模仿具体解题轨迹，导致模型记忆实例特定步骤，无法习得可迁移的解题策略，泛化性差。
summary.importance: 提出策略级而非轨迹级的推理蒸馏方法，属于后训练推理能力迁移的增量改进。
summary.technical_approach: 从强模型响应中提取结构化策略描述，对每个问题同时构造无策略引导的自主解题轨迹与策略引导轨迹；采用token级前向KL目标，选择性将策略条件带来的分布偏移迁移到无引导策略中，加入近端约束保证训练稳定。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露完整实验设置（模型参数量、基线模型、评测基准、量化结果），仅声称方法可缓解轨迹模仿带来的实例记忆问题，提升对新问题的泛化能力。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM reasoning distillation relies on imitating exact solution trajectories, encouraging memorization of instance-specific steps rather than transferable problem-solving strategies and limiting generalization to novel problems.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a strategy-level instead of trajectory-level reasoning distillation approach, an incremental improvement to post-training capability transfer.
summary_en.technical_approach: Extracts structured strategy descriptions from strong model responses, constructs both autonomous and strategy-guided trajectories per problem; uses a token-level forward-KL objective to selectively transfer the distributional shift from strategy conditioning to the unguided policy, with proximal constraints for training stability.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental details (model size, baselines, benchmarks, quantitative results) are not disclosed in the truncated abstract; only claims of reduced instance memorization and improved generalization are made.

recommendation.zh: 推理蒸馏领域的增量改进，核心思路是从轨迹模仿转向策略迁移，无颠覆性结论，看摘要了解思路即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental reasoning distillation work replacing trajectory imitation with strategy transfer; no paradigm-shifting claims, abstract suffices.

paper.title: What are Key Factors for Updates in RL for LLM Reasoning?
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a promising framework for enhancing the reasoning ability of large language models. However, much of the existing work is guided by heuristic intuition, leading to divergent algorithmic choices, even contradictory ones that nevertheless report empirical gains. To better understand this phenomenon, we conduct a theoretical analysis of RLVR updates. Our study reveals that differences in off-policy degree, determined by the number
