summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“RLVR 有没有用”，而是一个更基础的问题：在基于可验证奖励的 LLM 推理强化学习里，真正决定一次参数更新长什么样的因素是什么。已有做法里，很多 token 级启发彼此相反：有的强调高熵 token，有的强调高概率 token，但都能得到增益。全文给出的解释是，这类表面矛盾往往不是来自 token 本身，而是来自 rollout 复用带来的 off-policy 程度不同。GRPO/DAPO 这类方法依赖 importance sampling ratio 和 clipping；当同一批 rollout 被重复更新多次后，当前策略与采样策略逐渐偏离，不同 token 的 IS ratio 分布会发生系统性变化，进而改变哪些 token 真正主导梯度、以及更新方向相对 on-policy 理想梯度偏了多少。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口的意义都很直接。第一，它把当前 reasoning RL 里大量经验性 recipe 拉回到一个更可分析的量上：effective gradient expectation，而不是停留在“哪些 token 更重要”的局部直觉。第二，它说明 update-to-rollout ratio 不是训练工程细节，而是会改变优化对象近似方式的核心变量；这对大规模 RL 训练的 sample reuse、throughput 设计、以及 mid-train/RL 阶段的稳定性判断都有参考价值。第三，论文指出固定全局 clip window 与不同 token 组、不同 off-policy regime 下高度异质的 ratio dispersion 并不匹配，这个结论不只适用于 GRPO，也会影响更广泛的 clipped policy gradient 设计。贡献量级上，理论部分主要是澄清机制，方法部分 ACPO 属于有针对性的改进，不是另起范式，但它把“为什么改 clip”讲得比较完整。
summary.technical_approach:
技术主线分两层。第一层是理论分析。作者从 clipped policy-gradient 形式出发，把 RLVR 中单 token 更新写成 advantage、token 概率、IS ratio 与 clipping 的组合，并把关注点放在条件梯度期望上，而不是未裁剪的瞬时梯度。关键分析对象是 off-policy degree 对 ratio 方差的影响：随着每个 rollout 上执行更多 gradient steps，当前策略相对 behavior policy 漂移增大，低概率 token 的 ratio 更分散，更容易落到 clipping 区间外。由此得到一个核心现象：gradient dominance reversal。接近 on-policy 时，低概率 token 因为 1/p 型放大效应更容易主导更新；但在更 off-policy 的 regime 下，它们先被更强烈地裁剪，反而是高概率 token 留下更多有效梯度。这个结论用来统一此前“高熵优先”和“高概率优先”两类经验做法。

第二层是分解更新的 magnitude 和 direction。论文不只看谁贡献大，还看 clipping 如何让更新方向偏离 on-policy 梯度。作者按 token probability、advantage 符号与大小、以及 ratio clipping 的交互来分析：正 advantage 与负 advantage 在上下界裁剪下受到的影响并不对称；不同 token 组的 ratio dispersion 不同，意味着同一个全局 [1-ε_l, 1+ε_h] 会对某些组过紧、对另一些组过松，结果既改变梯度大小，也引入方向旋转。

基于这个诊断，作者提出 ACPO（Adaptive Clip Policy Optimization）。核心不是再设计一个新 advantage，而是把固定全局 clipping 改成按 token bin 自适应的 clipping threshold。bin 的划分围绕 token 组的异质性来做，目标是让不同组面对更匹配的裁剪范围，减少某一类 token 因 ratio 方差更大而被系统性压制。ACPO 还显式面向 variance-aware clipping：根据各 bin 的 ratio dispersion 调整上下界，从而同时缓解 uneven clipping 和 clipping-induced bias。与 DAPO、CISPO 这类方法相比，它不是直接偏向高概率或高熵 token，而是把“该保留谁”交给 ratio 分布本身决定。
summary.experiments:
实验部分的重点不是单一榜单提升，而是验证理论预测是否真的对应训练现象。论文在三类 reasoning 任务上比较 ACPO 与强基线，包括 DAPO 和 CISPO，并同时覆盖 near on-policy 与明显 off-policy 两种训练设置。摘要和正文给出的主结论是：ACPO 在不同模型规模、不同任务、不同 off-policy 程度下都更稳定且整体更优，说明 adaptive clipping 不是只在某个特定 recipe 下有效。

更值得看的是几类分析实验。第一类是 ratio 分布与 clipping 行为统计：随着每 rollout 的更新步数增加，低概率 token 的 IS ratio 方差显著增大，被裁剪比例上升，验证了 dominance reversal 的前提。第二类是 token-group contribution 分析：在近 on-policy 设置里，低概率 token 对有效梯度贡献更大；当 off-policy 程度升高后，贡献峰值向高概率 token 迁移。第三类是方向偏差分析：作者比较 clipped gradient 与 on-policy reference gradient 的夹角或相似度，显示固定全局 clip 会带来可观的方向偏移，而 ACPO 能减轻这种偏移。第四类是消融：去掉 bin-wise 自适应、只做简单非对称 clip、或不考虑 ratio dispersion 时，收益会回落，说明改进不只是“多调了几个阈值”。

从全文可提炼出的实用信息是：如果训练系统里 rollout 便宜、update 昂贵，导致 sample reuse 很高，那么你看到的 token-level heuristic 效果，很可能首先是在响应 off-policy/clipping 机制，而不是在捕捉某种更深的 reasoning token 语义。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“现象—理论—方法—验证”顺序读。先看引言和 Figure 1，明确作者要解释的是哪两类相反启发。然后重点读 Section 2：这里给出 off-policy degree、IS ratio dispersion 与 conditional gradient expectation 的关系，是全文最关键的理论支点。读这一节时要盯住两个问题：为什么低概率 token 在近 on-policy 时会放大，为什么一旦 ratio 方差变大又会先被 clipping 吃掉。

接着读 Section 3。这里的价值在于把“更新变小了”与“更新方向歪了”分开分析。很多实现只盯 reward 或 win rate，不看 gradient bias；这一节解释了为什么同样的 clip 既可能稳定训练，也可能悄悄改了优化目标。若只想抓核心，优先看关于 token probability、advantage sign、clip asymmetry 的分解图表。

Section 4 的 ACPO 读法要带着前面的诊断去看：它不是经验 trick，而是针对 heterogeneous ratio dispersion 的修补。重点看 bin 如何定义、阈值如何自适应、训练时是否引入额外不稳定因素。

实验部分优先看三类图表：1）不同 off-policy 程度下各 token 组的 ratio 方差和 clipping rate；2）effective gradient contribution 的迁移；3）ACPO 对 gradient bias 和最终任务指标的影响。如果时间有限，先读理论图和主要消融，再看主结果表。精读时间大约 60–90 分钟，若要复现思路，建议顺手把 GRPO/DAPO/CISPO 的目标函数并排写一遍。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more fundamental question than whether RLVR helps reasoning: what actually determines the update in reasoning-oriented RL for LLMs. Prior token-level heuristics look contradictory—some prioritize high-entropy tokens, others high-probability tokens—yet both report gains. The full paper argues that the missing variable is the degree of off-policyness induced by rollout reuse. In GRPO-style training, updates are shaped by importance-sampling ratios and clipping. As the number of gradient steps per rollout increases, the current policy drifts away from the behavior policy, the ratio distribution changes across token groups, and this changes both which tokens dominate the effective gradient and how far the update direction rotates away from the on-policy target.
summary_en.importance: This matters beyond a narrow RLVR recipe discussion. First, it reframes reasoning RL analysis around expected effective gradient under clipping, rather than local intuitions about “important tokens.” That is a cleaner object for understanding training dynamics. Second, it shows that update-to-rollout ratio is not a mere systems knob; it changes the optimization regime itself. That is relevant for large-scale RL where rollout generation and parameter updates have very different costs. Third, the paper makes a strong case that a single global clipping window is structurally mismatched to heterogeneous ratio dispersion across token groups and training regimes. The theoretical contribution is mainly explanatory, but it is useful explanatory work. ACPO is an incremental algorithmic extension, yet it is tightly coupled to the diagnosis and therefore more informative than a generic heuristic tweak.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has two technical layers. The first is a theoretical analysis of clipped policy-gradient updates in RLVR. Starting from the GRPO-style objective, the authors write token-level updates as a function of token probability, advantage, importance ratio, and clipping. The key quantity is the conditional expectation of the effective gradient after clipping, not the raw unclipped gradient. They then connect off-policy degree to the variance of the importance ratio: with more gradient steps per rollout, policy drift increases; low-probability tokens develop more dispersed ratios and are clipped more often. This yields the central phenomenon of gradient dominance reversal. In near on-policy regimes, low-probability tokens can dominate because of stronger amplification. In sufficiently off-policy regimes, those same tokens are disproportionately clipped, and higher-probability tokens end up dominating the surviving update. This is the mechanism used to reconcile prior empirical heuristics.

The second layer analyzes not only update magnitude but also directional bias. The paper decomposes how token probability, advantage sign and magnitude, and asymmetric clipping interact. Positive- and negative-advantage tokens are affected differently by upper and lower clipping bounds. Because ratio dispersion differs across token groups, a single global clipping interval over-regularizes some groups and under-regularizes others. The result is not just uneven gradient magnitude, but also a rotation of the update direction relative to the on-policy gradient.

Motivated by this, the authors propose ACPO, Adaptive Clip Policy Optimization. The main idea is simple but targeted: replace one global clipping range with bin-wise adaptive thresholds. Bins are constructed to reflect heterogeneous token groups, and the clipping thresholds are adjusted according to ratio dispersion. The goal is to reduce uneven clipping and mitigate clipping-induced gradient bias. Compared with methods such as DAPO or CISPO, ACPO does not hard-code a preference for high-probability or high-entropy tokens; it adapts clipping to the observed ratio statistics.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical section is more about validating the mechanism than chasing a single benchmark number. ACPO is compared against strong baselines, including DAPO and CISPO, on three reasoning tasks, under both near on-policy and more off-policy training regimes. The headline result is consistency: ACPO performs better overall and is more stable across model scales, tasks, and rollout-reuse settings.

The most informative experiments are the diagnostic ones. First, the paper measures ratio distributions and clipping rates across token groups. As the number of updates per rollout increases, low-probability tokens show substantially larger ratio variance and higher clipping frequency, matching the theoretical prediction. Second, the authors analyze effective gradient contribution by token group. In near on-policy settings, low-probability tokens contribute more; as off-policyness increases, the dominant contribution shifts toward higher-probability tokens. Third, they quantify directional bias by comparing clipped gradients with an on-policy reference, showing that fixed global clipping can induce a meaningful directional deviation, while ACPO reduces that deviation. Fourth, ablations show that the gain is not explained by simply adding more thresholds: removing bin-wise adaptation or ignoring ratio dispersion weakens the effect.

The practical takeaway is clear: if rollout generation is cheap and updates are expensive, leading to heavy sample reuse, many token-level heuristics are likely responding first to off-policy clipping dynamics rather than to some deeper notion of reasoning-token importance.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order of phenomenon, theory, method, and validation. Start with the introduction and the first motivating figure to understand which empirical contradiction the paper is trying to resolve. Then spend most of the time on Section 2. That section contains the main theoretical hinge: how off-policy degree changes importance-ratio dispersion and therefore the conditional expected gradient. While reading, keep two questions in mind: why low-probability tokens dominate near on-policy, and why they are the first to be suppressed once ratio variance grows.

Section 3 is the next important stop. Its value is that it separates two effects that are often conflated in practice: shrinking the update and rotating the update. Many implementations monitor reward and stability but do not inspect gradient bias. This section explains why clipping can stabilize training while silently changing the optimization direction. Focus on the decomposition by token probability, advantage sign, and clipping asymmetry.

Read Section 4 with the diagnosis in mind. ACPO is not presented as a generic trick; it is a repair for heterogeneous ratio dispersion. Check how bins are defined, how thresholds are adapted, and whether the method adds extra instability or complexity.

In the experiments, prioritize three kinds of figures: ratio variance and clipping rate by token group under different off-policy degrees; shifts in effective gradient contribution; and the effect of ACPO on gradient bias and final task metrics. If time is limited, read the theory figures and the main ablations before the full result tables. A careful read takes about 60–90 minutes. For implementation-oriented readers, it helps to write the GRPO, DAPO, and CISPO objectives side by side while reading.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变对“多跑几步 PPO 只是省 rollout”的看法，应优先看梯度期望和 clip 命中分析。
recommendation.en: This changes the prior that extra PPO steps are just rollout amortization; read the expected-gradient and clipping analysis first.

paper.title: AIR: Adaptive Interleaved Reasoning with Code in MLLMs
paper.abstract: Following the paradigm shift initiated by OpenAI o3, interleaved reasoning with code to enhance multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has become a pivotal research frontier. The existing literature focuses primarily on tool-use within vision-perception tasks. However, such approaches typically rely on predefined heuristics for visual manipulation and are inherently incapable of addressing numerical computation problems due to their exclusive focus on visual operations. This paper empowers MLL

summary.core_problem: OpenAI o3 之后，多模态大模型的交错推理研究大多局限在旋转、缩放等视觉操作类工具，依赖预定义启发式做视觉处理，既无法覆盖需要精确数值计算的多模态数学推理场景，也缺少让模型自主判断“何时调用代码工具、何时纯文本推理”的自适应机制；同时小模型难以冷启动工具调用能力，agentic RL 在工具使用比例升高时容易出现训练不稳定甚至模型崩溃。
summary.technical_approach: AIR 框架分为冷启动 SFT 与交错推理 RL 两个训练阶段，配套三条技术线。第一，两阶段冷启动数据构造：先让 MLLM 生成纯文本 CoT 推理路径，再用 LLM 把 CoT 重写为插入代码调用的交错推理格式，最后做代码执行完整性与结果正确性的校验；这种解耦式生成避免了单步合成在多模态场景下推理深度不足、效率低的问题。第二，双轨数据过滤：Self-Sampled 策略对 SFT 模型做多轮 rollout，用 Pass@k 作为候选样本的准入门槛，通过目标模型自身的多轮共识过滤噪声；Prior-Filtered 策略作为补充，用强能力教师模型做外部质量门控，进一步筛除低质量交错推理样本。第三，带组约束的 GRPO 奖励机制：在 RL 阶段对工具调用行为加分组约束，引导模型自适应判断是否需要调用工具、选择合适的调用时机；该约束同时抑制了工具使用率升高时的训练波动，缓解了 agentic RL 长期训练不稳定的问题。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕多模态复杂数值计算与数学推理任务展开。冷启动阶段，两阶段数据构造相比单步合成，在代码可执行率与最终答案准确率上都有明显提升；双轨过滤相比无过滤或单轨过滤，显著降低了 SFT 数据中的噪声比例，后续 RL 的收敛速度更快。RL 阶段，带组约束的 GRPO 相比普通 GRPO：一是自适应工具调用率更合理，不会出现过度调用或不调用的极端情况，在需要计算的题目上准确率提升显著；二是训练曲线更平稳，在工具使用比例较高的设置下没有出现普通 GRPO 常见的 reward 震荡与模型崩溃现象。论文还做了消融，分别验证了两阶段数据构造的解耦收益、双轨过滤各自的贡献、以及组约束在自适应调用与训练稳定性两方面的独立作用。
summary.reading_guide: 精读顺序建议：先读方法章节 3.1 整体架构图与 3.2 冷启动数据构造部分，重点理解“先生成 CoT 再重写交错推理”的解耦设计，这是整套方案能低成本落地的关键；接着读 3.3 RL 部分的组约束奖励设计，尤其关注作者对“自适应工具调用为何能稳定训练”的观察与分析，这是超出预期的训练动态发现；然后看实验章节的主结果表与训练曲线，对比普通 GRPO 在高工具使用率下的崩溃现象，判断组约束的实际作用强度；最后补读附录中的数据样例与失败案例，评估这套数据 pipeline 的可迁移边界。核心创新集中在数据构造解耦、双轨过滤、组约束 GRPO 三处，值得深挖的点是 agentic RL 中工具调用行为与训练稳定性之间的因果关系，以及该机制是否能迁移到纯文本或其他工具类型的 RL 训练中。

summary_en.core_problem: Since OpenAI o3, interleaved reasoning research on MLLMs has been mostly limited to visual-operation tools such as rotation and zoom, which rely on predefined heuristics for visual processing. They cannot cover multimodal mathematical reasoning scenarios requiring precise numerical computation, and lack an adaptive mechanism for the model to autonomously decide when to invoke code tools versus perform pure textual reasoning. In addition, smaller models struggle to cold-start tool-use capability, and agentic RL often suffers from training instability or even model collapse as the tool-use ratio rises.
summary_en.importance: The work impacts pretraining research on three levels. First, it extends the interleaved reasoning paradigm initiated by o3 from pure-text and visual-only tools to the MLLM + Python code invocation scenario for numerical computation, filling the capability gap of non-visual tools in multimodal agentic RL and providing a reproducible training recipe for multimodal foundations to move from perception-reasoning to a perception-computation-reasoning closed loop. Second, the combined recipe of cold-start data construction, dual-track data filtering, and group-constrained GRPO directly addresses two engineering pain points: the difficulty of activating tool use in small models, and the long-term instability of agentic RL. The unexpected finding that adaptive tool use actually stabilizes training offers practical reference for analyzing training dynamics in RL pretrain. Third, the entire pipeline is open-source implementable and does not depend on proprietary capabilities of closed-source models, providing direct engineering guidance for the community to reproduce o3-style multimodal reasoning models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The AIR framework has two training stages: cold-start SFT and interleaved reasoning RL, supported by three technical lines. First, two-stage cold-start data construction: an MLLM first generates pure-text CoT reasoning traces, then an LLM rewrites the CoT into interleaved reasoning format with inserted code calls, followed by verification of code execution integrity and answer correctness. This decoupled generation avoids the insufficient reasoning depth and low efficiency of one-step synthesis in multimodal scenarios. Second, dual-track data filtering: the Self-Sampled strategy performs multiple rollouts on the SFT model and uses Pass@k as the admission threshold for candidate samples, filtering noise through multi-turn consensus of the target model itself; the Prior-Filtered strategy acts as a complement, using a strong teacher model as an external quality gate to further remove low-quality interleaved reasoning samples. Third, group-constrained GRPO reward mechanism: group constraints are applied to tool-use behavior during RL, guiding the model to adaptively judge whether tool invocation is needed and choose the right timing. This constraint also suppresses training fluctuations when tool-use rate increases, mitigating long-term instability in agentic RL.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments focus on multimodal complex numerical computation and mathematical reasoning tasks. In the cold-start stage, two-stage data construction delivers clear improvements over one-step synthesis in code executability and final answer accuracy. Dual-track filtering, compared with no filtering or single-track filtering, significantly reduces noise in SFT data and leads to faster convergence in subsequent RL. In the RL stage, group-constrained GRPO outperforms vanilla GRPO in two aspects: adaptive tool-use rate is more reasonable, without extreme over-use or non-use, and accuracy on problems requiring computation improves notably; training curves are smoother, with no reward oscillation or model collapse under high tool-use settings, which is common in vanilla GRPO. Ablations separately verify the decoupling benefit of two-stage data construction, the individual contributions of the two filtering tracks, and the independent effects of the group constraint on both adaptive invocation and training stability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Recommended close-reading order: start with Section 3.1's overall architecture diagram and Section 3.2 on cold-start data construction, focusing on the decoupled design of 'generate CoT first, then rewrite into interleaved reasoning' — this is the key to the low-cost deployability of the whole recipe. Then read the group-constrained reward design in the RL part of Section 3.3, paying special attention to the authors' observation and analysis of why adaptive tool use stabilizes training; this is an unexpected training-dynamics finding. Next, examine the main result tables and training curves in the experiments section, comparing the collapse phenomenon of vanilla GRPO under high tool-use rates to judge the actual strength of the group constraint. Finally, read the data samples and failure cases in the appendix to assess the transfer boundary of this data pipeline. The core innovations concentrate on three pieces: decoupled data construction, dual-track filtering, and group-constrained GRPO. A worthwhile deep-dive direction is the causal relationship between tool-use behavior and training stability in agentic RL, and whether this mechanism transfers to pure-text RL or RL with other tool types.

recommendation.zh: 更像多模态 RL/tool-use 配方，预训练研究员只需看数据过滤和奖励约束，别把它当基座范式变化。
recommendation.en: This is a multimodal RL/tool-use recipe; read the data filtering and reward constraints, not as a base-model paradigm shift.

paper.title: Curriculum Reinforcement Learning Can Incentivize Reasoning Capacity in LLMs Beyond the Base Model
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is widely viewed as a promising path toward continuously improving large language models. Recent works, however, suggest that mainstream RLVR often reallocates sampling probabilities among trajectories already present in the base model: it can improve sampling efficiency, reflected by higher pass@1 scores, but yields limited gains, and can even decrease pass@k scores when k is large, and therefore may fail to expand the base model's reasoning

summary.core_problem: 当前主流基于rollout的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）仅在基座模型已有的推理轨迹分布中重新分配采样概率，通常只提升pass@1，无法甚至会降低大k的pass@k，不能突破基座模型的推理能力边界；核心原因是边界外的难题在rollout时全部失败，形成零优势组，无法给策略更新提供有效梯度信号。
summary.importance: 这是RL后训练领域的重要范式推进，首次给出了明确突破基座推理边界的可操作路径，打通了RL与局部教师引导的课程化结合机制；对预训练-后训练闭环的启发是，后训练阶段可通过课程化RL引入基座预训练未覆盖的推理模式，不必完全依赖预训练注入所有能力，重新定义了RLVR的能力上限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出边界感知的课程RL框架，每轮迭代分三步：1）用大采样量的pass@k评估定位当前模型的推理能力边界，将样本划分为已解决、边界附近（少量采样可解）、完全未解决（大采样仍无解）三类；2）仅针对边界附近和之外的样本，引入小剂量教师结构化推理轨迹，将原本零优势的样本转化为具备正奖励信号的可训练样本；3）用GRPO等常规RL算法巩固新引入的推理模式，使其成为模型稳定行为。每轮迭代后重新定位新边界，逐步推进能力外扩。与现有方法的差异在于，不采用纯RL或全量蒸馏，仅在能力边界处做局部引导，既避免全量蒸馏的灾难性遗忘，又解决纯RL的零梯度盲点。
summary.experiments: 当前公开章节未包含完整实验与消融结果，引言部分明确了三类核心验证维度：pass@k全曲线变化（重点是大k区间）、边界外样本的解决率、与纯RL基线和全量蒸馏基线的对比；核心观测指标为固定大采样预算下的新增可解问题数量。
summary.reading_guide: 精读第1节关于推理能力边界的定义与pass@k曲线的解读逻辑（核心评估标准）、方法章节的三步课程RL算法细节、实验章节的消融实验（重点关注教师引导的剂量阈值、边界划分的pass@k参数选择）、附录中的课程调度策略；值得深挖的方向包括：将范式迁移到无可验证奖励的开放域任务、边界定位的采样效率优化、是否可反向指导预训练阶段的数据课程设计。

summary_en.core_problem: Mainstream rollout-based Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) only reallocates sampling probabilities among reasoning trajectories already supported by the base model distribution. It typically improves pass@1 but fails to expand, and sometimes reduces, large-k pass@k, leaving the base model's reasoning capacity boundary untouched. The root cause is that out-of-bound hard samples produce all-failed rollouts, forming zero-advantage groups that deliver no valid gradient signal for policy updates.
summary_en.importance: This work represents a key paradigm advance in RL post-training. It provides the first actionable pipeline to explicitly expand the base model's reasoning capacity boundary, and establishes a structured integration path between RL and localized teacher guidance. For the pretrain-posttrain closed loop, it demonstrates that RL post-training can introduce reasoning patterns not covered in base pretraining, reducing the requirement to inject all capabilities during pretraining and redefining the upper bound of RLVR.
summary_en.technical_approach: A boundary-aware Curriculum RL framework is proposed, with three steps per curriculum round: (1) Large-sample pass@k evaluation locates the current reasoning capacity boundary, partitioning samples into three tiers: already solved, near-boundary (solvable with few samples), and fully unsolved (unsolvable even with large sample budget); (2) Targeted teacher guidance injects a small volume of structured reasoning traces only for near-boundary and out-of-bound samples, converting originally zero-advantage samples into trainable samples with positive reward signal; (3) Standard RL algorithms such as GRPO consolidate the newly introduced reasoning patterns into stable model behavior. The boundary is re-estimated after each round to progressively target harder samples. Unlike pure RL or full-scale distillation, the design limits teacher guidance to the capacity boundary only, avoiding catastrophic forgetting from full distillation while fixing the zero-gradient blind spot of pure RL.
summary_en.experiments: The publicly available sections do not include complete empirical or ablation results. The introduction specifies three core validation dimensions: full pass@k curve changes (especially the large-k regime), solve rate for out-of-bound samples, and comparison against pure RL and full distillation baselines. The core metric of interest is the count of newly solvable problems under fixed large sampling budgets.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize Section 1 for the definition of reasoning capacity boundary and the interpretation logic of pass@k curves (the core evaluation criterion), method sections for the detailed three-step algorithm pipeline, experiment sections for ablation studies (focus on teacher guidance dose threshold and pass@k parameter selection for boundary partitioning), and appendix sections for curriculum scheduling details. Worth digging into: migration of the paradigm to open-domain tasks without verifiable rewards, sampling efficiency optimization for boundary localization, and whether the framework can inversely guide data curriculum design during pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 修正了“RLVR仅能优化采样效率”的共识，边界定位+教师引导的组合值得立刻在内部RL后训练ablation中复现。
recommendation.en: Revises the consensus that RLVR only optimizes sampling efficiency; the combination of boundary localization and teacher guidance is worth immediate reproduction in internal RL post-training ablations.

paper.title: Understanding Knowledge Distillation in Post-Training: When It Helps and When It Fails
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across many tasks, but their high computational cost limits deployment in resource-constrained environments. Knowledge Distillation (KD) offers a practical solution by transferring knowledge from a teacher model of a larger size to a smaller student model. While prior work has mainly examined task-specific or small-scale settings, the post-training stage for building general instruction-following models has received limited attention. In th

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是一个很实际但经常被泛化讨论的问题：在通用 instruction post-training 里，知识蒸馏到底什么时候比直接 SFT 更有用，什么时候基本无效。更具体地说，作者关心的是，当 teacher 和 student 共享同一批指令数据时，KD 是否真的能把 teacher 的“额外知识”传给 student；如果不能，问题是出在数据规模、teacher 强度，还是蒸馏目标本身。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口的意义比较直接。很多团队把 KD 当成压缩小模型的默认选项，但这篇工作给出的结论更克制：在大规模通用 post-training 数据上，如果 teacher 只是用同一份数据做过 SFT，那么 student 通过 KD 获得的额外收益会随着数据量增加而迅速收敛，最后接近直接 SFT。这说明 KD 不是凭空创造能力，它只有在 teacher 拥有 student 不能从当前监督数据中轻易恢复的信息时才明显有效。这个判断对小模型路线、teacher 选择、合成数据策略、以及 RLHF 后 teacher 的再利用都很重要。它不属于 pretrain 核心方法，但对 post-train recipe 设计和 pretrain/post-train 分工有现实参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，这篇论文不是提出全新 KD 算法，而是做系统性条件分析。作者以 Tulu 3 的 939k instruction-response pairs 为主实验平台，比较 student 的两种训练方式：直接在数据上做 SFT，或者先训练一个 teacher，再让 student 对 teacher 做 KD。论文提到已有工作如 SeqKD、MiniLLM、GKD、DPKD，但根据文中引用的 Ramesh et al. (2025)，不同 KD 变体在该设定下差异不显著，因此重点不放在 loss 形式，而放在三个变量上。第一是数据规模：用不同大小的 Tulu 3 子集训练，观察 KD 相对 SFT 的收益曲线。第二是 teacher 强度：除了同数据训练得到的 teacher，还引入更强的 instruction-tuned teacher，例如 Llama3.3-70B-Instruct，这类模型在更大更杂的数据上训练过，并经过 RLHF，因此其输出分布包含额外的行为先验和偏好信息。第三是低资源 domain adaptation：作者提出两阶段方案，先用 teacher 标注的 synthetic data 扩展 student 的指令覆盖，再在少量高质量人工标注上做 KD 精炼。这个设计背后的逻辑很清楚：如果真实标注太少，student 既学不到任务分布，也学不到 teacher 的偏好结构，先用合成数据铺开支持集，再用高质量数据收紧分布，会比单阶段更稳。论文的核心贡献因此不是“某个 KD loss 更好”，而是把 KD 的有效区间和失效条件讲清楚。
summary.experiments: 主实验使用 Tulu 3 共 939k 条高质量指令数据，系统比较不同数据规模下 KD 与 SFT 的表现。核心结果是：在低数据 regime，KD 明显优于 SFT；随着训练数据增加，这个优势逐步缩小，在大数据设定下几乎没有额外收益。作者据此提出一个很重要的解释：当 teacher 和 student 共享同一监督语料时，student 通过直接监督已经能恢复大部分可学知识，KD 只是在更平滑地传递同一信息，因此边际收益有限。接着，作者把 teacher 换成更强的 instruction-tuned 模型，例如 Llama3.3-70B-Instruct，发现即使在大数据设定下，KD 仍能带来显著改进。这说明真正决定 KD 上限的不是“是否蒸馏”，而是 teacher 是否携带了超出当前训练集的信息，尤其是来自更大规模训练和 RLHF 的行为偏好。最后，在 domain adaptation 场景中，两阶段方案——先 synthetic data，再少量人工数据上的 KD——在多个低资源任务上都带来稳定提升。你给出的全文片段没有完整结果表和具体分数，因此不适合虚构精确数字；但论文的实验逻辑和结论已经足够清楚：KD 的收益主要由数据稀缺度和 teacher 的额外知识量共同决定。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，但要抓住实验设计而不是只看结论。先看 Introduction 和 Post-Training KD for LLMs，明确作者比较的是“同数据 teacher 的 KD”对“直接 SFT”，这是很多经验讨论里容易混淆的基线。然后重点看数据规模实验，关注 KD-SFT gap 如何随样本量变化。接着看 stronger teacher 那一节，判断作者是否真正控制了 teacher 额外知识来源，以及这种提升更像能力迁移还是偏好迁移。最后看 domain adaptation 的两阶段方案，尤其是 synthetic data 在什么位置介入、是否存在分布污染或 teacher bias 放大。预计 20 分钟左右可以读完主线；如果你在做小模型蒸馏或 instruction recipe，可以再细看附录中的 loss 设定、温度、采样方式和评测集构成。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a practical question that is often discussed too loosely: in general instruction post-training, when does knowledge distillation actually help a smaller model, and when does it collapse to something close to plain supervised fine-tuning? More specifically, if teacher and student are trained on the same instruction data, can KD transfer anything meaningfully beyond what the student can already learn from direct supervision, or is the gain limited by data scale and teacher strength?
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is not a new KD objective but a clearer boundary on where KD is worth using. The paper argues that KD is most useful when the student is data-limited or when the teacher contains information that is not recoverable from the available supervision alone. That matters for post-training recipe design, compact model development, and the reuse of stronger RLHF-tuned teachers. For researchers thinking about the pretrain/post-train interface, the message is simple: KD does not create capability out of thin air. If the teacher only repackages the same dataset, the student eventually catches up with enough SFT data. If the teacher carries extra behavior priors, preference structure, or broader knowledge, KD remains useful even at larger scales.
summary_en.technical_approach: This is a systematic study rather than a novel KD algorithm. The main setup uses the Tulu 3 dataset with 939k instruction-response pairs. The student is trained either by direct SFT or by distillation from a teacher that was itself trained on the same data. The paper references several KD variants such as SeqKD, MiniLLM, GKD, and DPKD, but the emphasis is not on choosing among them; based on prior evidence cited in the paper, differences between KD variants are not the dominant factor in this setting. Instead, the study isolates three variables. First, data scale: the authors train on subsets of different sizes and measure how the KD-vs-SFT gap changes. Second, teacher strength: they compare same-data teachers with stronger instruction-tuned teachers such as Llama3.3-70B-Instruct, whose outputs reflect broader training and RLHF-derived preferences. Third, low-resource domain adaptation: they propose a two-stage pipeline that first expands coverage with teacher-annotated synthetic data and then refines the student with KD on a small amount of high-quality human data. The logic is that synthetic data broadens the support of the instruction distribution, while the final KD stage sharpens behavior using better supervision.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments are built on Tulu 3 with 939k high-quality instruction examples and multiple data-scale subsets. The central result is consistent: KD beats SFT in low-data regimes, but the advantage shrinks as more training data is added and becomes small in the large-data regime. The interpretation is important: when teacher and student share the same supervision, the student can recover most of the useful signal directly from the data, so KD mainly provides a smoother version of the same information rather than genuinely new knowledge. The paper then replaces the teacher with a stronger instruction-tuned model, including Llama3.3-70B-Instruct, and finds that KD remains beneficial even in larger-data settings. That supports the claim that KD works when the teacher contains information not easily recoverable from the current dataset, especially behavior priors and preference structure shaped by larger-scale training and RLHF. In domain adaptation, the proposed two-stage strategy—synthetic data first, KD on scarce human annotations second—improves performance consistently across multiple low-resource tasks. The provided excerpt does not include the full result tables, so it is better to preserve the qualitative findings rather than fabricate exact numbers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read this one for the experimental framing, not for algorithmic novelty. Start with the introduction and the post-training setup section to pin down the exact baseline: KD from a teacher trained on the same data versus direct SFT on that data. Then go to the data-scaling experiments and inspect how the KD-SFT gap changes with sample size. After that, read the stronger-teacher section carefully; the key question is whether the gains come from transferring broader capability, preference alignment, or both. Finally, look at the domain-adaptation experiments and check how synthetic data is inserted into the pipeline and whether the paper discusses teacher bias or distribution mismatch. A focused 20-minute skim should be enough for the main message. If you work on small-model distillation, it is worth checking the appendix for the exact KD loss, temperature, sampling policy, and evaluation setup.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改范式，但把“KD 为什么有时有用、有时像白忙”讲得比较干净；预训练研究员重点看数据量与教师强度的交互，能直接指导蒸馏 ablation 设计。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm shift, but it cleanly explains why KD sometimes helps and sometimes collapses into redundant supervision; worth reading for the data-scale × teacher-strength interaction before designing your own distillation ablations.

paper.title: Group-Graph Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Group-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) has significantly enhanced Large Language Models (LLMs) in agentic scenarios. To achieve finer-grained policy updates, recent agentic RL frameworks have shifted from trajectory-level to step-level training. However, long-horizon agentic RL suffers from severe reward sparsity and delay, as feedback is often deferred for dozens of interaction steps. While existing step-level frameworks refine training granularity, their credit assignment remains coarse-grain

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是长程 Agent RL 中的信用分配问题：step-level 训练降低了上下文和显存压力，但仍把探索轨迹当成彼此独立的线性序列，导致稀疏、延迟奖励下的状态价值估计方差高，关键动作也难以被准确放大。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练本身不是直接贡献，更接近 Agent post-training 的算法改进。它的启发在于训练信号的组织方式：长程交互数据不应只按 trajectory 或 step 切开，还可以按状态转移结构重组。对做 RL pretrain、agentic mid-training 或环境交互数据训练的人来说，G2PO 提供了一个清晰的思路：先把采样轨迹还原成状态图，再在图上估计价值和优势，减少单条轨迹偶然性带来的噪声。
summary.technical_approach: G2PO 的核心做法有两步。第一，把多条 Agent 探索轨迹重构成状态转移图。相同或相似的环境观察被聚合成一个 state group，动作被看作从源状态到目标状态的有向边。第二，在图上重新定义价值和优势。状态价值不再由单条轨迹的最终结果决定，而是对同一 state group 中多个样本的结果做聚合，近似估计该状态通向成功的概率。动作优势则由边两端的价值增量给出，形式上接近 1-step TD error。与 GiGPO 这类只在同一局部状态内比较动作的方法不同，G2PO 会把全图所有边的 TD error 放入一个全局参考组做标准化，从而让跨状态、跨阶段的关键转移也能得到较高权重。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 WebShop、ALFWorld 和 AppWorld 三个长程 Agent benchmark，模型包括 Qwen-2.5-1.5B、7B 和 14B。论文报告 G2PO 相比 prompt-based 方法和 RL baseline 都有稳定收益。相对 GRPO，在 WebShop 上最高提升 22.2% success rate，在 ALFWorld 上最高提升 14.4%。AppWorld 用于验证复杂环境观察下的有效性。作者强调该方法主要改变 advantage 估计和样本组织方式，几乎不引入额外计算成本。文中还用状态价值方差分析说明，基于单条轨迹的估计容易受后续随机失败或偶然成功影响，而 state-group 聚合能缓解这一问题。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中 Figure 1 对 trajectory-level、step-level 和 graph-level 视角的对比；方法部分重点看 state grouping 的定义、value aggregation 的公式、edge-centric advantage 以及全局标准化方式。实验部分优先看 WebShop/ALFWorld 的主表和关于状态价值方差、局部归一化与全局归一化的消融。需要特别留意 state similarity 如何判定，因为这是方法能否从 benchmark 迁移到真实网页、软件环境或多模态 Agent 的关键细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets credit assignment in long-horizon agentic RL. Step-level training reduces context growth, but it still treats exploration as isolated linear trajectories, which gives noisy value estimates and weak credit assignment under sparse delayed rewards.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense. Its value is in how it reorganizes interaction data before applying RL. For researchers working on RL-based agent training, RL pretraining, or environment-interaction mid-training, the main lesson is that trajectories can be lifted into a state-transition graph, and the training signal can be computed on that graph rather than on individual rollouts.
summary_en.technical_approach: G2PO reconstructs sampled agent trajectories into a directed state-transition graph. Identical or similar observations are grouped into state groups, and actions become edges between source and destination states. State value is estimated by aggregating outcomes over all states in the same group, instead of relying on one trajectory’s terminal reward. Action advantage is then computed from the value increment across an edge, which resembles a one-step TD error in sparse-reward tasks. Unlike local group methods such as GiGPO, which compare actions only within the same state, G2PO normalizes edge-level TD errors against a global reference group containing transitions from the whole graph. This gives more weight to transitions that make large absolute progress toward task success.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses WebShop, ALFWorld, and AppWorld with Qwen-2.5 models at 1.5B, 7B, and 14B scale. G2PO consistently improves over prompt-based methods and RL baselines. The reported gains over GRPO reach up to 22.2 percentage points in success rate on WebShop and 14.4 points on ALFWorld. AppWorld is used to test the method under more complex observations. The claimed overhead is minimal because the method changes the advantage estimation and grouping procedure rather than adding expensive model calls. The paper also analyzes variance in state-value estimation and argues that aggregating over state groups is less sensitive to accidental success or failure in a single rollout.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 to 35 minutes. Focus on Figure 1 for the shift from trajectory-level and step-level views to a graph view. In the method section, read the definitions of state grouping, group-aggregated value estimation, edge-centric advantage, and global normalization. In the experiments, prioritize the main WebShop and ALFWorld tables, plus ablations on graph aggregation and local versus global normalization. The most important implementation detail to check is how observation similarity is defined, since this will determine whether the method transfers beyond clean benchmark environments.

recommendation.zh: 只看算法定义和 credit assignment 实验即可；若图结构优势估计稳定，值得在内部长程 agent RL 里复现。
recommendation.en: Read the algorithm and credit-assignment ablations; if the graph-based estimator is stable, it is worth reproducing in internal long-horizon agent RL.

paper.title: SPIRAL: Learning to Search and Aggregate
paper.abstract: Language model reasoning can be substantially improved at test time via scaffolds that scale inference compute across different primitives -- sequential reasoning within a trace, independently sampled parallel traces, and aggregation of multiple reasoning traces into a final response. During post-training, however, language models are optimized only for sequential reasoning within a single trace. We introduce Sequential-Parallel-Aggregative Reinforcement Learning (SPIRAL), a framework in which a

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是推理模型训练和测试时 compute 使用方式不一致的问题。现有 RL 主要训练模型生成一条高质量 reasoning trace，但实际部署时常用并行采样、多候选搜索、候选聚合、验证和修订。模型在训练中没有见过这些 compute primitive，因此不会主动分配顺序计算、并行探索和聚合计算。
summary.importance: 这篇论文和预训练的关系不在数据或模型结构，而在 pretrain-posttrain 接口。它把 test-time scaling 中常见的并行采样和聚合纳入 RL 训练目标，试图让模型学会使用推理预算，而不是靠外部 scaffold 手写调度。对基座研究的启发在于：模型能力不只由单条轨迹的 token-level reasoning 决定，还受训练时暴露的 compute topology 影响。若结果成立，后续 reasoning pretrain、RL pretrain 或长思维训练需要考虑把多样化搜索、候选互补性和聚合能力作为训练对象，而不是只奖励单个 final answer。
summary.technical_approach: SPIRAL 即 Sequential-Parallel-Aggregative Reinforcement Learning。它同时训练三类推理计算：单条 trace 内的顺序计算，例如 reasoning tokens 和工具调用；同一 prompt 下多条独立 trace 的并行计算；以及把多条候选 trace 合成为最终答案的聚合计算。聚合 trace 可用标准 RL 算法训练，例如 GRPO，因为它仍然是生成一个最终输出并接受 reward。并行 trace 的训练更难，因为单条 trace 可能本身不正确，却包含对聚合有用的局部思路。论文用 set reinforcement learning 处理这种 credit assignment：把同一 prompt 下采样得到的一组 generations 当成集合，用集合级 reward 对它们联合赋分，并通过低方差 marginal advantage 给每条 trace 分配学习信号。这个设计区别于常规 GRPO：GRPO 优化单条响应的相对优势，SPIRAL 优化一组候选和一个聚合器共同产生最终正确答案的能力。
summary.experiments: 论文在数学推理上微调 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507，并与标准 GRPO 在相同训练 compute 预算下比较。测试时扩展不同维度的 inference compute。给出的结果包括：在 parallel compute scaling 下，pass@k 的 scaling efficiency 最高提升到 11 倍；在同时扩展 parallel 和 aggregative compute 时，测试集性能最高高出 15%。这些数字说明改进主要来自更有效地使用多样本和聚合，而不只是单条 chain-of-thought 变强。实验最需要关注的是等训练预算是否严格、parallel sample 数和 aggregator 调用数如何计费、以及提升是否集中在需要搜索的题目而非普通算术题。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 到 45 分钟。先看 introduction 中对 sequential、parallel、aggregative compute 三类瓶颈的定义。然后看 set RL preliminaries 和 SPIRAL objective，重点理解集合级 reward 为什么不能退化成单样本 reward，以及 marginal advantage 如何给并行 trace 做 credit assignment。实验部分优先看训练 compute 对齐、test-time compute scaling 曲线、pass@k scaling efficiency 的定义，以及 GRPO 对照。若时间有限，可以跳过一般 RL 背景，集中读算法目标和 ablation。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a mismatch between how reasoning models are trained and how they are used at inference time. Standard RL trains a model to produce one strong reasoning trace. In deployment, however, practitioners often use parallel sampling, search over multiple candidates, aggregation, verification, and revision. The model is not trained to coordinate these compute primitives, so additional inference compute is often wasted on redundant traces or weak aggregation.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to the pretrain-posttrain interface rather than to tokenizer, data mixture, or architecture. It treats test-time scaling behavior as a trainable object. The key implication is that reasoning ability depends not only on the quality of a single chain of thought, but also on whether the model has learned the topology of inference compute: sequential thinking, parallel exploration, and cross-trace aggregation. This is a useful direction for RL pretraining and reasoning-oriented mid-training, especially if future training recipes aim to optimize models for the way they will actually be served.
summary_en.technical_approach: SPIRAL stands for Sequential-Parallel-Aggregative Reinforcement Learning. It exposes the model to three forms of inference compute during training: sequential compute inside one trace, parallel compute across independently sampled traces, and aggregative compute that synthesizes a set of traces into a final output. Aggregation traces can be optimized with standard RL algorithms such as GRPO because they generate a final answer that receives a reward. Parallel traces require a different credit assignment scheme: an individual trace may be wrong, but still contain an idea that helps the aggregator solve the problem. SPIRAL uses set reinforcement learning, where a set of generations from the same prompt receives a joint learning signal. A low-variance marginal advantage is then used to assign credit to individual traces under the set-level objective. This differs from standard GRPO, which optimizes the relative advantage of individual responses rather than the utility of a candidate set plus an aggregator.
summary_en.experiments: The paper fine-tunes Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 on mathematical reasoning and compares SPIRAL against GRPO under an equal training compute budget. At test time, it scales different axes of inference compute. The reported results include up to 11x higher scaling efficiency for pass@k under parallel compute scaling, and up to 15% higher performance when both parallel and aggregative compute are scaled. The main empirical claim is that SPIRAL improves the model’s ability to use multiple samples and aggregation, rather than only improving single-trace reasoning. The most important details to inspect are the compute accounting, the number of sampled traces, the aggregation budget, and whether gains are concentrated on problems that genuinely require search.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30 to 45 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the definitions of sequential, parallel, and aggregative compute in the introduction. Then read the set RL preliminaries and the SPIRAL objective carefully, especially why the set-level reward cannot be reduced to a single-sample reward and how marginal advantage handles credit assignment. In the experiments, focus on the test-time compute scaling curves, the definition of pass@k scaling efficiency, compute-matched GRPO comparisons, and ablations over aggregation and parallel sampling.

recommendation.zh: 训练-测试推理范式对齐的新思路，集合RL的目标设计值得在内部后训练ablation中参考，重点看§3的损失定义。
recommendation.en: Novel alignment between training and test-time reasoning paradigms; the set RL objective design in §3 is worth referencing in internal post-training ablations.

paper.title: Modularized Reinforcement Learning on LLMs: From MDP Creation to Exploration and Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become central to LLM post-training, yet the methods that dominate current pipelines, PPO and GRPO, represent only a narrow slice of what RL offers. Understanding why these methods prevail, and what alternatives exist, requires a principled examination of the design decisions that underlie any RL algorithm.   This survey organizes that examination around three stages of algorithm construction. We begin with MDP creation: how the reward function, state space, actio

summary.core_problem: 当前LLM后训练中主流RL方法（PPO、GRPO）仅覆盖了强化学习方法空间的很小一部分；现有研究零散修改单个组件，缺乏从RL第一性原理出发的统一模块化设计框架，难以区分方法的实质差异与表述差异，也无法系统识别未被探索的设计空间。
summary.importance: 这是一份从基础RL视角组织的LLM强化学习综述，不是按应用或训练阶段分类的LLM视角综述。它建立了RL经典概念与LLM训练对应关系的共享基础，显式标出了当前研究在方法分布上的结构性空白，如几乎所有方法默认使用蒙特卡洛信用分配、无critic的策略梯度占主导地位，为后续方法创新提供了系统性地图。
summary.technical_approach: 将任意LLM-RL算法的构造拆解为三个独立的模块化阶段，逐一审视每个阶段的设计决策，并将现有文献映射到该分类体系中：第一阶段是MDP构造，覆盖奖励函数、状态空间、动作空间、终止条件、折扣因子的定义方式与可选方案；第二阶段是探索机制，涵盖温度采样、熵正则、内在动机、树搜索、课程学习等方向；第三阶段是学习更新，沿经典RL的四个维度展开，包括策略梯度类与actor-critic类方法、信用分配方式、优势估计与目标裁剪等设计。并单独梳理了元RL、多智能体RL等其他框架在LLM中的应用。每个小节末尾给出开放问题与关键洞察的take-away。
summary.experiments: 这是综述类论文，无原创实验。其分类体系明确指出当前实践的几个集中倾向：InstructGPT建立的PPO范式、DeepSeek-R1的可验证奖励RL在数学推理上的突破是两条主线；当前开放权重模型（Nemotron-3、DeepSeek-V4、Gemma 4）多是单点改进而非框架性贡献；已有经验研究证实actor-critic在长程任务上可能更优，但实际应用稀少；蒙特卡洛回报是近乎默认的信用分配方案，替代方案（如基于价值函数的多步估计）在大模型上验证不足。
summary.reading_guide: 总阅读时间约1-1.5小时。首先看第1节末尾的完整分类图（Figure 1）建立全局视角；重点读MDP构造一节中关于折扣因子与终止条件在LLM生成场景下的定义差异，这部分是现有实践中最常被隐含处理、但直接影响credit assignment的位置；探索机制一节中内在动机与树搜索在LLM训练中的映射、以及学习一节中actor-critic与无critic方法的对比是空白最多的区域；每个小节结尾的Take-away框与open problems可快速扫读获取未探索方向。

summary_en.core_problem: Dominant RL methods in LLM post-training, namely PPO and GRPO, occupy only a narrow region of the full reinforcement learning method space. Existing work typically introduces isolated modifications to single components without a unified, modular design framework built from first principles of RL, making it difficult to separate substantive algorithmic differences from presentation discrepancies, and to systematically identify underexplored design choices.
summary_en.importance: This survey is organized from a foundational RL perspective rather than an LLM-centric application/training-stage view. It establishes a shared conceptual mapping between classical RL concepts and their LLM counterparts, and makes explicit the skewed distribution of research effort. It highlights structural gaps such as the near-universal default to Monte Carlo credit assignment and the dominance of critic-free policy gradients, providing a systematic roadmap for future method development.
summary_en.technical_approach: The construction of any LLM-RL algorithm is decomposed into three independent modular stages, each with a structured review of design decisions and mapping of existing literature: Stage 1 is MDP formulation, covering definitions and alternatives for reward function, state space, action space, termination condition, and discount factor; Stage 2 is exploration mechanisms, including temperature sampling, entropy regularization, intrinsic motivation, tree search, and curriculum learning; Stage 3 is learning updates, organized along four classical RL dimensions covering policy gradient vs. actor-critic families, credit assignment strategies, advantage estimation, and clipping/objective design. Additional RL frameworks such as meta-RL and multi-agent RL applied to LLMs are surveyed separately. Each subsection ends with an open problems discussion and a highlighted Take-away box.
summary_en.experiments: This is a survey paper with no original experiments. Its taxonomy surfaces several clear patterns in current practice: the PPO pipeline established by InstructGPT and the verifiable-reward RL line exemplified by DeepSeek-R1 for mathematical reasoning form the two main strands; recent open-weight releases (Nemotron-3, DeepSeek-V4, Gemma 4) contribute point improvements rather than framework-level advances; empirical evidence suggesting actor-critic benefits on long-horizon tasks has not translated to wide adoption; Monte Carlo returns remain the de facto credit assignment scheme, while alternatives such as value-based multi-step estimation remain under-validated at LLM scale.
summary_en.reading_guide: Total reading time is approximately 1–1.5 hours. Start with the full taxonomy in Figure 1 at the end of Section 1 to build a global view. Focus on the MDP formulation section, specifically how discount factor and termination condition are implicitly handled in LLM generation, as these choices directly shape credit assignment but are rarely discussed explicitly. The sections on intrinsic motivation and tree search under exploration, and the actor-critic vs. critic-free comparison under learning, contain the most sparsely populated areas. The Take-away boxes and open problems at the end of each subsection can be skimmed to quickly identify under-explored directions.

recommendation.zh: 这是少有的把RL-for-LLM从MDP定义层拆开的综述，读§2（MDP构建）和§4（学习更新对比）能直接校准后训练pipeline的设计空间，方法选型当速查手册用。
recommendation.en: One of the few surveys decomposing RL-for-LLM from the MDP-definition level up; read §2 on MDP construction and §4 on learning-update tradeoffs as a calibration reference for post-training pipeline design.

paper.title: ReNIO: Reweighting Negative Trajectory Importance for LLM On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves LLM reasoning by training a student model on its own generated outputs, but standard OPD treats all student-generated outputs (SGOs) equally regardless of their informativeness. We observe a consistent asymmetry in controlled filtering experiments: in both OPD and on-policy self distillation (OPSD), training only on incorrect SGOs outperforms training only on correct ones. Our further analysis suggests that models trained on correct-only SGOs tend to generat

summary.core_problem: On-policy distillation（OPD）及其自蒸馏变体 OPSD 在推理后训练中默认对学生自己生成的轨迹等权训练，但不同轨迹的信息量不对称：错误轨迹比正确轨迹更能提供靠近模型能力边界的纠错信号，而现有方法缺乏一种不依赖完整 rollout 到最终答案、可在 prefix 上计算的重加权方案。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对后训练（尤其是低成本 reasoning post-training）有直接价值，对预训练研究的启发在于两点：第一，它再次说明“正样本/高回报样本不一定是最有信息量的训练样本”，这和 pretrain 中 hard negative、near-miss、capability boundary 附近样本的数据选择问题相通；第二，它展示了用 student-teacher 概率比在局部 token 上定位错误分支的方法，这种 prefix-computable 信号有潜力迁移到 on-policy pretrain / continual pretrain 的样本筛选或课程设计。
summary.technical_approach: ReNIO 的核心发现来自控制实验：在 OPD 和 OPSD 下，只用错误 SGO（student-generated outputs）训练，一致好于只用正确 SGO 训练。行为分析显示，仅用正确样本训练会导致推理链更短、反思标记更少，而错误样本保留了更多探索和自我修正痕迹。为了在不等到最终答案的前提下强调这类负样本，ReNIO 利用 prefix 上的 student/teacher 概率比定位关键 token：学生给高概率但教师给低概率的 token，视为学生偏好但教师拒绝的分支决策。方法对这类 token 的 log ratio 做截断，按几何平均聚合到样本级别，并在 batch 内归一化作为样本权重，从而把训练重心重新分配到包含强纠错信号的轨迹，同时保留 OPD 使用短 prefix 训练的效率优势。
summary.experiments: 控制实验在 Qwen3-1.7B 上进行：OPD 下 incorrect-only 相比 correct-only 在 AIME24、AIME25、平均 benchmark 上分别高 3.60、3.89、2.59 个 Avg@12 点；OPSD 下对应增益为 1.94、3.34、2.50 点。完整 ReNIO 在数学推理和代码生成任务上同时提升 OPD 和 OPSD，代表性结果为 Qwen3-1.7B 数学推理相对提升最高 8.90%，R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 最高 10.00%。论文还记录了推理长度和反思类标记（如 wait/actually/however/check 等）的变化，说明负样本加权有助于维持探索性推理行为，而非简单压缩到短而“看起来正确”的答案。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点看前期控制实验和行为分析部分（figure 1 及相关文字），这是全文最有价值的观察；方法部分看清楚关键 token 判定、log ratio 截断和几何平均聚合即可。需要带着怀疑看的点是：这种信号是否真的足够接近“错误轨迹”，还是在强 teacher/弱 student 设定下更有效；以及这种重加权在长推理、长上下文和自蒸馏 teacher 不够强时是否稳定。预计阅读时间 15–25 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard on-policy distillation (OPD) and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) weight all student-generated trajectories equally, ignoring substantial variation in informativeness. The paper identifies a clear asymmetry: incorrect student-generated outputs often provide stronger learning signal than correct ones, yet there was no efficient way to upweight them without rolling out trajectories to the final answer.
summary_en.importance: The paper is mainly a post-training method, but it carries two lessons relevant to pretrain research. First, it reinforces that high-reward or already-correct samples are not necessarily the most useful training data; samples near the model’s capability boundary, including failures, can drive more robust improvement. Second, its prefix-computable teacher-student disagreement signal offers a practical way to locate informative mistakes locally, which is conceptually close to hard-negative mining and adaptive data weighting in pretraining and continual pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReNIO starts from controlled filtering experiments showing that training only on incorrect student-generated outputs consistently outperforms training only on correct ones in both OPD and OPSD. Behavioral analysis suggests that correct-only training produces shorter traces with fewer reflection markers, while incorrect trajectories preserve exploratory and self-corrective reasoning near the model’s frontier. To exploit this without waiting for final-answer labels, ReNIO identifies pivotal tokens using the student-to-teacher probability ratio: tokens with high student probability but low teacher probability indicate student-preferred, teacher-rejected branch decisions. These clipped log ratios are aggregated by geometric mean to the sample level and normalized within each batch, producing a prefix-computable sample weight that emphasizes likely negative and highly informative trajectories while preserving the short-prefix efficiency advantage of OPD.
summary_en.experiments: Controlled studies on Qwen3-1.7B show that incorrect-only training beats correct-only training by 3.60, 3.89, and 2.59 Avg@12 points on AIME24, AIME25, and benchmark average under OPD, and by 1.94, 3.34, and 2.50 points under OPSD. Full ReNIO improves both OPD and OPSD on mathematical reasoning and code generation, with reported relative gains up to 8.90% for Qwen3-1.7B and 10.00% for R1-Distill-Qwen-7B on math reasoning. The paper also reports response-length and reflection-marker statistics, showing that emphasizing negative trajectories helps preserve exploratory reasoning rather than collapsing into short, overconfident answers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the controlled filtering experiments and behavioral analysis in Figure 1, which contain the most transferable insight. Then read the ReNIO weighting formula to understand how pivotal tokens are detected from prefixes only. A useful point to scrutinize is whether the method mainly works when the teacher is already strong enough, and whether the same disagreement signal remains reliable in self-distillation or weaker-teacher regimes. Estimated reading time: 15–25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 负轨迹优于正轨迹这个结果值得复现实验；先看 filtering ablation，方法本身可作为 RL 数据加权弱基线。
recommendation.en: The negative-trajectory result is worth reproducing; read the filtering ablation first, and treat ReNIO as a weak baseline for RL data weighting.

paper.title: Prefix-Guided On-Policy Distillation: Mining Golden Trajectories from Rollouts
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves reasoning models by applying dense teacher supervision on student-sampled trajectories. However, scaling OPD to long-horizon mathematical reasoning exposes a reliability and efficiency problem: standard OPD assigns every sampled candidate the same long rollout budget, even though some trajectories may quickly become weakly aligned with the teacher and provide less useful supervision. Prior analyses suggest that successful OPD depends on local teacher-student

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决长链数学推理中 on-policy distillation 的 rollout 分配问题。标准 OPD 会让学生模型采样多个完整长答案，并在这些学生访问过的状态上用教师模型做密集监督。问题是所有候选轨迹都拿到同样的长生成预算，即使其中一些轨迹在早期 prefix 上已经和教师分布明显偏离，继续生成和训练的收益也可能很低。
summary.importance: 这是一篇 post-training 方法论文，但对预训练研究有两个具体启发。第一，训练信号质量不只取决于教师强度，也取决于学生当前策略访问到的局部状态是否适合被教师监督。第二，长程推理训练的数据生成成本可以按 prefix 级别的可学习性动态分配，而不是按 prompt 或 sample 均匀分配。这个思想可迁移到 reasoning mid-training、RL 数据采样、合成轨迹筛选和 dense supervision 的预算控制中。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Prefix-Guided On-Policy Distillation。流程是先让学生模型为每个 prompt 生成短 prefix，而不是直接生成完整长答案；随后在这些学生生成的 prefix 上同时评估学生和教师的 token 分布，计算 teacher–student top-k overlap。这个指标衡量两者高概率 token 集合的重合程度，作为局部兼容性的代理信号。高 overlap 表示教师的监督更可能落在学生可利用的动作空间附近，继续生成长 suffix 更有训练价值；低 overlap 则说明轨迹可能已经偏离教师的推理路径，继续 rollout 会消耗算力并引入弱监督。PG-OPD 据此只给高兼容轨迹分配长 continuation，同时保持原有 OPD 损失不变。方法的重点不是改变蒸馏目标，而是改变 rollout budget 的分配策略。论文还讨论了 prefix length、随机剪枝、每个 prompt 至少保留若干轨迹等设计，避免只按全局排序导致 prompt 覆盖不足。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖多个 teacher–student 组合，并在 AMC、AIME、HMMT 等数学推理 benchmark 上评估。主要结果是 PG-OPD 在减少 wall-clock 训练时间的同时，能保持或提升平均准确率。消融实验包括 prefix 长度、随机 pruning、prompt-minimum allocation、prefix-based ranking 等。关键结论是，基于 top-k overlap 的筛选优于随机丢弃，说明早期 prefix 的教师–学生兼容性确实能预测后续轨迹的蒸馏价值。可见正文没有给出完整数值表，因此具体加速比例、平均准确率提升和各 benchmark 分项结果需要看实验表格。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 Method 中 top-k overlap 的定义、prefix 生成和长 continuation 分配算法；再看主结果表，确认不同 teacher–student 组合下的准确率和训练时间变化。消融部分值得看 prefix length 和 random pruning 对照，因为它们决定这个方法是来自兼容性信号，而不是简单减少 rollout 数量。如果要复现，需重点核对 overlap 计算频率、k 的选择、prefix token 数、每个 prompt 的最小保留轨迹数，以及教师前向带来的额外开销。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses rollout allocation in long-horizon on-policy distillation for mathematical reasoning. Standard OPD samples full student trajectories and applies dense teacher supervision on the states visited by the student. This treats all sampled candidates as equally worth continuing, even when some prefixes have already drifted far from the teacher distribution.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training paper, but it has useful implications for the pretraining-to-post-training interface. It argues that the value of dense supervision depends not only on teacher quality, but also on local teacher–student compatibility at the states produced by the current student policy. The same idea can inform reasoning mid-training, synthetic trajectory filtering, RL rollout allocation, and compute-aware supervision design: generation budget should follow learnability signals rather than be distributed uniformly.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, Prefix-Guided On-Policy Distillation, first asks the student to generate a short prefix for each candidate trajectory. The teacher and student are then evaluated on these student-visited prefixes, and a teacher–student top-k overlap score is computed. This score measures how much their high-probability token sets agree. High overlap suggests that the teacher’s dense signal lies near the student’s current action space and is therefore easier to exploit. Low overlap suggests that the trajectory has moved into a region where further rollout may add cost and noisy supervision. PG-OPD allocates long continuations only to high-compatibility prefixes while leaving the standard OPD objective unchanged. The novelty is in rollout budget allocation, not in a new distillation loss. The paper also studies practical variants such as prefix length, random pruning baselines, prefix-based ranking, and minimum allocation per prompt to preserve prompt coverage.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans several teacher–student combinations on math reasoning benchmarks including AMC, AIME, and HMMT. The reported pattern is that PG-OPD reduces wall-clock training time while preserving or improving average accuracy. The ablations compare prefix-guided selection against random pruning, vary prefix length, and test prompt-minimum allocation. The key empirical message is that top-k overlap on early prefixes is a better allocation signal than uniform or random continuation. The visible text does not include the full numerical result tables, so exact speedups, accuracy gains, and per-benchmark scores should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the algorithmic section defining top-k overlap, prefix sampling, and continuation allocation. Then read the main result tables for the accuracy-versus-time tradeoff across teacher–student pairs. The ablations on prefix length and random pruning are the most important sanity checks. For implementation, inspect the chosen k, prefix length, allocation ratio, minimum trajectories per prompt, and the additional teacher forward cost introduced by prefix scoring.

recommendation.zh: 推理后训练中蒸馏算力分配的务实优化，核心逻辑清晰，建议只看§3的前缀价值估计与rollout分配规则即可
recommendation.en: A practical optimization of distillation compute allocation in reasoning post-training with clear core logic; focus only on §3 for prefix value estimation and rollout allocation rules.

paper.title: Post-Training Recipe, More Than Model Family, Shapes Multi-Agent LLM Conversational Behavior
paper.abstract: Multi-LLM systems use multiple language models to deliberate, judge each other's outputs, or coordinate as agents. Their value depends on the models producing measurably different conversational behaviors when given the same input. Prior offline studies recommend drawing one model per family for behavioral diversity, because LLMs prefer outputs from their own family when rating one another in isolation. Whether the same family label predicts behavior in interactive multi-LLM systems, the setting

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是：在真实的多 LLM 交互里，模型“家族”是否仍然能预测行为差异，还是 post-training recipe 和运行配置才是更强的解释变量。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值有限，但对 post-train 与多模型系统设计有启发。它提醒读者不要把 family label 当成模型行为的稳定代理变量。同一个 base model 经过不同指令微调、推理蒸馏或 runtime 开关后，在交互中的话语风格可能比跨家族差异还大。这对构造 judge panel、debate system、multi-agent workflow 时的模型选择有实际意义，也间接说明 post-training 会显著改写模型的可观测行为分布。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构造两轮论坛式交互链：给定同一 seed post，模型 A 先回复，模型 B 再基于 seed 和 A 的回复生成第二轮回复。作者用同一批 10,000 个 Moltbook 论坛 seed 复用到不同有序模型对上，便于做 paired statistics。行为指标来自 conversation analysis，主要看三类表面会话动作：challenge、repair、hedging。其中 hedging 与 LLM-judge 标注一致性最好，因此作为主指标。核心设计不是训练新模型，而是把模型差异拆成 family、参数规模、base architecture、post-training recipe、runtime configuration 几个轴，再比较哪个轴最能解释交互行为变化。最关键的是 same-base Llama-3.1-8B factorial：固定 base，改变 post-training recipe，用来隔离 post-training 的影响。
summary.experiments: 主实验包含 940,000 条两模型交互链，覆盖 4 个模型家族、11 个 open-weight checkpoint；另有 1.6M 条 same-base Llama factorial 链用于隔离 post-training recipe。生成设置包括 temperature 0.7、max tokens 300、使用原生 chat template，默认无 system prompt。canonical-4 子集选取 Qwen 2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-2-9B、DeepSeek-LLM-7B-Chat 做较可比的跨家族分析。关键结果是：在同一 Llama-3.1-8B base 上，reasoning-distilled responder 的 hedging 会因同家族、不同 recipe 的首轮回复者而变化 18.22%。这个差距超过 canonical-4 中任意两个不同家族模型之间测到的最大 hedging gap。作者还做了 Qwen、closed-API、runtime-control 等支持性分析，但这些部分样本更小或检测器更弱，因此证据权重低于 same-base Llama 实验。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 15–20 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中 RQ 设定和主结论边界，再看 Methods 里 chain/cell 的构造、hedging detector 的验证方式、same-base factorial 的设计。结果部分优先看 family vs post-training recipe 的对比图表，以及 18.22% hedging shift 的统计检验。无需深读 challenge 和 repair 结果，它们更像表面 cue 的补充检查。需要注意局限：实验是两 agent、短交互、论坛回复场景，不能直接推出长程 deliberation 或 judge accuracy 会随 conversational diversity 改善。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether model family is a reliable predictor of behavior in interactive multi-LLM systems, or whether finer factors such as post-training recipe and runtime configuration explain more of the observed conversational variation.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a pretraining paper, but it is useful for understanding the behavioral impact of post-training. It shows that provider or family labels can be a weak proxy once models interact with each other. A shared base model with different post-training recipes can produce larger conversational differences than models drawn from different families. This matters for LLM judge panels, debate systems, and multi-agent workflows, where diversity is often approximated by picking one checkpoint per family.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study builds two-turn forum-style chains. A seed post is followed by a first reply from model A, then a second reply from model B conditioned on both the seed and A’s reply. The same 10,000 Moltbook forum seeds are reused across cells, enabling paired comparisons at the seed level. Each reply is scored for three conversational moves: challenge, repair, and hedging. Hedging is used as the headline metric because it has the strongest agreement with an LLM-judge annotator. The main methodological contribution is the factorization of model identity into family, scale, base architecture, post-training recipe, and runtime configuration. The cleanest test is a same-base Llama-3.1-8B factorial, where the base model is fixed and only the post-training recipe varies.
summary_en.experiments: The main corpus contains 940,000 two-agent chains over 11 open-weight checkpoints from four families: Qwen, Llama, Gemma, and DeepSeek. A separate 1.6M-chain same-base Llama factorial isolates post-training effects. Generation uses temperature 0.7, a 300-token cap, native chat templates, and no system prompt by default. A canonical-4 subset compares one roughly 7B-class instruction-tuned model per family: Qwen 2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-2-9B, and DeepSeek-LLM-7B-Chat. The key number is a 18.22% hedging shift for a reasoning-distilled Llama responder depending on which same-family recipe replies first. This exceeds the largest cross-family hedging gap measured in the canonical-4 comparison. Qwen, closed-API, and runtime-control analyses broaden the observation, but the paper treats them as supporting checks rather than the strongest evidence.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15–20 minutes. Focus on the research questions, the chain/cell construction, the validation of the hedging detector, and the same-base Llama factorial design. The most important result is the comparison between family-level gaps and post-training-recipe gaps, especially the 18.22% hedging shift. The challenge and repair metrics are less central and can be read as surface-cue checks. Keep the scope limitation in mind: the experiments use short two-agent exchanges and do not show that greater conversational diversity improves long-horizon deliberation or downstream judging quality.

recommendation.zh: 它会修正“跨 family 才有多样性”的经验法；同底座 factorial 设计值得复现到内部模型池。
recommendation.en: This weakens the “use different families for diversity” heuristic; the same-base factorial design is worth replicating on an internal model pool.

paper.title: Which Pairs to Compare for LLM Post-Training?
paper.abstract: Preference-based post-training has become a central paradigm for aligning language models. A common data-collection strategy is to generate a small set of completions for each prompt and label the resulting comparison pairs. However, human preference labels are often much more expensive than generating additional completions, suggesting a different use of the same labeling budget: generate a larger pool of completions, but label only the most informative comparison pairs. This paper studies whic

summary.core_problem: 在偏好数据标注预算固定的情况下，每个 prompt 应该从候选回复池中选择哪些 pair 送去标注，才能让 DPO 等偏好后训练得到的最终策略在 KL 正则化的 RLHF 目标下最优。
summary.importance: 把偏好数据构造从“生成几条、标完所有 pair”的工程惯例，变成一个有明确统计目标的采样设计问题。核心价值在于：标注预算的分配不应该以“估计 reward 准不准”为目标，而应该以“最终策略 J 值高不高”为目标。这对做 DPO/RLHF 数据管线、尤其做大规模离线偏好数据策划的团队有直接参考意义，对理解 post-train 信号质量如何反哺预训练范式也有方法论价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将比较对选择建模为 offline sampling design：给定每个 prompt 下从 reference policy 生成的一批候选 completion，设计一个 pair 上的采样分布，在总标注预算 n 下抽 pair 打标，再用 DPO 训练策略。作者在 KL-regularized RLHF/DPO 的局部线性化近似下，推导出最终策略的次优 gap 由一个依赖于 design 的 Fisher/信息矩阵控制，并给出有限样本上界与信息论下界匹配的结果。由此得到一个可优化的 trace-form 准则，用来选择最能识别“对最终策略性能重要的参数方向”的 pair。区别于主动学习类工作按 reward uncertainty 选 pair，这里的选对准则直接以下游 policy improvement 为目标。
summary.experiments: 在 synthetic tabular、contextual bandit 风格实验，以及 IMDb、Anthropic-HH 的 DPO 实验上验证该准则。报告显示所提 design 在相同标注预算下 consistently 提升 DPO 的 sample efficiency，优于随机采样、全 pair 标注以及已有 active preference selection 基线。论文主要验证的是 offline curation 场景：候选池先生成好、再选 pair，而非在线交互式查询。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看问题建模、信息矩阵与 trace 准则的推导直觉，以及实验部分对不同 curation 策略的对比。建议先读 Introduction 和主要定理对应的解释段，跳过过细的证明；关注“为什么以最终策略目标选 pair 不同于以 reward 估计精度选 pair”这一点。预计阅读时间 30–45 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Given a fixed budget for human preference labels, which completion pairs should be selected from a larger candidate pool per prompt so that the resulting DPO-style policy best optimizes the KL-regularized RLHF objective?
summary_en.importance: The paper reframes preference-data construction from an ad hoc pipeline choice—generate a few responses and label all or one pair—to a statistical sampling-design problem. The key conceptual move is that labeling budget should be allocated to maximize downstream policy value under RLHF, not merely to estimate a reward function accurately. This is directly relevant to teams building DPO/RLHF data pipelines, especially offline preference curation at scale, and provides a useful lens for reasoning about post-training signal quality more broadly.
summary_en.technical_approach: The problem is formulated as offline experimental design: for each prompt, a pool of completions is first sampled from the reference policy, then a sampling distribution over within-prompt pairs determines which pairs are sent for annotation under budget n, and DPO is trained on the labeled pairs. Under a local linearization of the KL-regularized RLHF/DPO objective, the authors show that the final policy’s optimality gap is governed by a design-dependent information matrix. They derive finite-sample upper bounds and matching information-theoretic lower bounds, leading to an explicit trace-form criterion that selects pairs informative for the parameter directions that most affect downstream policy performance. Unlike active-preference work that selects pairs by reward uncertainty, the selection criterion here is tied directly to policy improvement.
summary_en.experiments: The method is validated on synthetic tabular and contextual experiments, plus DPO experiments on IMDb and Anthropic-HH. The proposed design consistently improves sample efficiency over baselines under matched annotation budgets, including random pair selection, labeling all pairs, and prior active preference-selection strategies. The setting is primarily offline curation: generate a candidate pool first, then choose pairs, rather than fully online interactive querying.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for the problem formulation and the design criterion rather than the full proofs. Focus on the introduction, the intuition behind the information-matrix/trace surrogate, and the empirical comparison across curation strategies. The main point to absorb is why optimal pair selection for policy optimization differs from optimal pair selection for reward estimation. Estimated reading time: 30–45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: DPO偏好数据采样的理论分析，结论可迁移到预训练数据筛选场景，重点看§3的边界推导部分。
recommendation.en: Theoretical analysis of preference pair sampling for DPO; conclusions transfer to pretraining data filtering, focus on bound derivations in §3.

paper.title: ADaPT: Token-Level Decoupling for Efficient Large Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Large reasoning models rely on long chain-of-thought to achieve strong performance, but applying such reasoning uniformly incurs high computational cost. Existing efficiency-oriented methods attempt to shorten or mix reasoning strategies, yet often degrade reasoning capability. We identify the root cause as sequence-level coupling between efficiency incentives and correctness optimization, which implicitly penalizes long but correct reasoning trajectories. To address this issue, we propose Adapt

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 reasoning model 的效率训练冲突：如果把“答对”和“少生成 token”都作为 sequence-level 奖励，训练会系统性压低长但正确的推理轨迹，导致深推理能力受损。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是核心贡献，但对 RLVR 和 reasoning post-train 的奖励设计有启发。关键点是把效率信号从完整答案上移开，避免让长度惩罚污染 correctness optimization。这个思路也提醒基座训练研究：当训练信号同时包含能力目标和成本目标时，标量化奖励很容易改变模型的解题分布，而不只是改变平均长度。
summary.technical_approach: ADaPT 引入一个显式的 mode-selection token，用来选择 fast reasoning 或 slow reasoning。训练分两阶段。第一阶段 SFT，让模型见到两类行为：短路径快速回答，以及带长 CoT 的慢速推理。第二阶段用 token-level 版本的 GRPO 做强化学习。核心设计是：正确性奖励仍作用于答案质量，效率相关奖励只作用于 mode-selection token，而不是惩罚整条序列。这样，模型可以学习什么时候触发慢思考，但不会因为某条长 CoT 是长的就降低其正确性学习信号。推理时可以调节触发 <think> token 的概率，让同一个模型在效率和性能之间连续移动。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在多个 reasoning benchmark 上验证 ADaPT 能显著减少推理 token 成本，同时保持较强的推理性能。可确认的实验设置包括基于 GRPO 的 RL 阶段、fast/slow 双模式训练，以及通过 <think> 触发概率控制效率—性能折中。当前给出的正文片段没有包含具体 benchmark 名称、模型规模、token reduction 比例或准确率数字，因此不宜补造定量结论。实验部分最应关注的是：ADaPT 与 sequence-level length reward、hybrid reasoning baseline 的对比；长题与短题分桶结果；以及调节 mode token 概率后是否形成稳定 Pareto 曲线。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。优先看方法部分对 sequence-level coupling 的分析，以及 token-level GRPO 如何只把效率奖励施加到 mode-selection token。实验表格只需要抓三类数字：平均生成长度、主 benchmark 准确率、不同难度题目的性能变化。若只关心 pretrain，可重点读奖励解耦的思想，不必深挖具体应用 benchmark。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets an efficiency–capability conflict in large reasoning models. When correctness and brevity are optimized at the sequence level, long but correct chains of thought are implicitly penalized, which can weaken deep reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training and RLVR paper, not a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model training is the reward-design lesson: cost objectives should not be naively scalarized with capability objectives when the two act on different parts of the generation process. A length penalty applied to the whole sequence changes the learned reasoning distribution, not just the average token count.
summary_en.technical_approach: ADaPT introduces an explicit mode-selection token that chooses between fast and slow reasoning. Training has two stages. The SFT stage exposes the model to both short fast responses and longer slow CoT-style reasoning. The RL stage uses a token-level variant of GRPO. The key design is to apply efficiency-related rewards only to the mode-selection token, while preserving correctness optimization for the answer. This decouples the decision to think slowly from the learning signal for whether the reasoning is correct. At inference time, the probability of triggering the <think> token can be adjusted, allowing one model to trade off compute and accuracy without retraining.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks, with the main claim that ADaPT reduces inference cost while maintaining strong reasoning performance. The visible technical setup includes a GRPO-based RL stage, fast/slow dual-mode supervision, and inference-time control through the <think> trigger probability. The provided text does not expose the concrete benchmark list, model sizes, token-reduction ratios, or accuracy numbers, so the quantitative claims should be checked in the experiment tables. The important comparisons are against sequence-level length rewards and hybrid reasoning baselines, with separate attention to easy versus hard problems and to whether the mode-token probability produces a smooth Pareto curve.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the analysis of sequence-level coupling and the token-level GRPO objective, especially where the efficiency reward is attached only to the mode-selection token. In the experiments, look for three numbers: average generated tokens, reasoning accuracy, and performance by problem difficulty. For pretraining-oriented readers, the main transferable idea is reward decoupling; the benchmark-specific details are secondary.

recommendation.zh: 值得看奖励拆分的 setup；若实验干净，应把“效率惩罚只打到控制 token”放进内部 RLVR ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the reward-decoupling setup; if the experiments are clean, the control-token-only efficiency penalty deserves an internal RLVR ablation.

paper.title: Beyond Entropy: Learning from Token-Level Distributional Deviations for LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has significantly advanced Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning; however, it faces a fundamental optimization instability: uniform token updates precipitate entropy collapse, leading to premature convergence to suboptimal strategies, whereas excessive Shannon Entropy maximization can cause entropy explosion, driving blind exploration toward incoherent reasoning chains. To resolve this dichotomy, we introduce the Independent Combinatorial Toke

summary.core_problem: RLVR（带可验证奖励的 RL）训练 LLM 推理时，对所有 token 均匀施加策略梯度容易造成熵塌缩到次优策略；而单纯用 Shannon entropy 做强探索又会导致熵爆炸和无方向的胡乱探索。问题在于只用一个标量熵值无法刻画哪些 token 才是真正决定推理分支的关键位置。
summary.importance: 这篇工作属于 post-train / RL 训练信号设计方向，但对理解“预训练后阶段里哪些 token 承载主要学习信号”有启发。核心观察是：token 层面的重要性不应该只用熵这个不确定性标量衡量，而要看 token 分布相对序列平均分布的偏离程度。这个视角与 reward hacking、credit assignment、稀疏有效更新等问题直接相关。更实际的意义是，他们报告只更新约 10% 的 token 就能匹配或超过全量更新，这对降低 RLVR 计算成本和稳定训练都有价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ICT（Independent Combinatorial Tokens）框架。核心做法是：对每个 token 位置的 logit 分布，计算它与该序列上 token 分布的平均之间的 Jensen-Shannon divergence；JS 散度大的 token，代表其分布形态偏离整体，被视为关键分支点/unique token。训练时只对这些 top-k（如 top 10%）unique token 保留梯度，其余 token 的 policy gradient 被 mask 掉。这样梯度更新集中在真正决定推理路径分岔的位置，而不是对所有 token 一视同仁地推高或压低熵。论文从信息论直觉出发，证明这类分布独特的 token 对应关键 branching points，选择性更新能同时避免 entropy collapse 和 entropy explosion，实现隐式熵控。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen2.5 系列 0.5B、1.5B、7B 上做数学/代码类 RLVR 实验，覆盖七个推理 benchmark。结果显示只更新 top 10% distributionally unique tokens，性能可以匹配或超过全参数/全 token 更新；相比 GRPO、20-Entropy、STAPO 等强基线，平均 pass@4 提升约 4.37%、4.98%、4.38%，最大增益达 14.9%。论文还做了消融说明 JS 散度选 token 优于直接用 Shannon entropy 选高熵 token：高熵 token 只代表不确定，不代表有明确的有效探索方向。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，重点看 logit 分布偏离的定义、为什么 JS 比 Shannon entropy 更适合选关键 token，以及稀疏梯度只更新 10% token 的实验设置和结果。图 1 关于“相同熵但分布形态不同”的示意值得看，方法部分和实验表格是核心。理论证明部分可粗读，重点抓直觉。预计阅读时间 25–40 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In RL with verifiable rewards for LLM reasoning, applying policy gradients uniformly across all tokens often causes entropy collapse to suboptimal strategies, while indiscriminate Shannon-entropy-based exploration leads to entropy explosion and undirected search. A scalar entropy value is insufficient to identify which tokens actually determine critical reasoning branches.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training/RL credit-assignment paper, but it bears on a broader pretrain-relevant question: which tokens carry the effective learning signal in late-stage policy optimization. The useful observation is that token importance should not be measured by entropy alone; distributional shape relative to surrounding tokens matters. The practical claim is also strong: updating only around 10% of tokens can match or exceed full updates, with implications for RLVR stability and compute efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes ICT (Independent Combinatorial Tokens). For each token position, ICT computes the Jensen-Shannon divergence between that token’s logit distribution and the sequence-level average token distribution. Tokens with large JS divergence are treated as unique tokens, i.e., critical branching points. During policy optimization, gradients are retained only for these top-k tokens (e.g., top 10%), while other tokens are masked. This concentrates policy-gradient updates on decision points that steer reasoning trajectories, rather than uniformly pushing entropy up or down across all positions. The paper argues theoretically that these distributionally unique tokens encode directional exploration information, enabling implicit entropy control without directly regularizing Shannon entropy.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use Qwen2.5 models from 0.5B to 7B across seven reasoning benchmarks. Updating only the top 10% distributionally unique tokens matches or outperforms full-gradient training. Against strong baselines including GRPO, 20-Entropy, and STAPO, ICT reports average pass@4 gains of 4.37%, 4.98%, and 4.38%, with maximum gains up to 14.9%. Ablations support the claim that JS-based token selection is more effective than selecting high-Shannon-entropy tokens, since high entropy indicates uncertainty but not necessarily useful exploration direction.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for the token-selection idea and the sparse-update results. The most important sections are the motivation on why entropy is insufficient, the definition of distributional uniqueness via JS divergence, and the experiments showing strong performance with only 10% of token gradients. Figure 1 on equal-entropy but distributionally different logits is a useful intuition pump. Theoretical proofs can be read lightly. Estimated reading time: 25–40 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和熵分析部分；若实验 setup 干净，ICT 值得作为 RLVR token-level update 的内部 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the method and entropy analysis; if the setup is clean, ICT is worth an internal ablation for token-level RLVR updates.

paper.title: The Significance of Style Diversity in Annotation-Free Synthetic Data Generation
