paper.abstract: Generating high-utility synthetic data for intent classification typically requires human-annotated seed data, which is often unavailable in fast-paced industrial settings. In this paper, we propose a framework for synthetic dialogue generation that works entirely without human-annotated data, relying solely on intent definitions. Our proposed dialogue generation framework utilizes two different types of topic and style attributes to improve data diversity. Also, we propose two novel post-hoc st

summary.core_problem: 在没有人工标注种子数据的情况下，如何仅凭 intent 定义生成足够有用的合成对话数据，并提升其风格多样性与训练价值。
summary.importance: 这是一篇合成训练数据工作，虽然面向 intent classification 而非基座预训练，但对后训练数据合成有一个可迁移的点：风格多样性可能比主题多样性更影响数据效用。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 annotation-free 的对话生成框架，只使用 intent definitions 生成样本；在生成时显式控制 topic 和 style 两类属性，并设计两个事后风格化模型 Univ 与 Exam，把 LLM 生成的 utterance 改写成更丰富、更接近人类的表达；最后用 LLM-as-a-judge 做质量过滤。
summary.experiments: 在工业和公开数据集上，合成数据训练得到的模型性能可达到人工标注训练数据的 93.3%。核心经验结论是 style diversity 比 topic diversity 更关键。摘要未给出底座模型规模、过滤成本或 judge 误差分析，因此结论更适合作为弱先验，而非直接照搬。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to generate useful synthetic dialogue data from intent definitions alone, without any human-annotated seed data, while preserving enough diversity to train downstream models well.
summary_en.importance: This is a synthetic training-data paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it offers one transferable lesson for post-training data generation: stylistic diversity may matter more than topical diversity for utility.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework generates dialogues using only intent definitions, explicitly modeling both topic and style attributes. It then applies two post-hoc stylization models, Univ and Exam, to rewrite LLM-generated utterances into more varied and human-like styles, followed by LLM-as-a-judge filtering for quality control.
summary_en.experiments: On industrial and public datasets, the resulting synthetic data reaches up to 93.3% of the performance obtained with human-annotated training data. The main empirical claim is that style diversity is more important than topic diversity. The abstract does not provide enough detail on model scale, filtering cost, or judge reliability, so the result should be treated as a useful hint rather than a settled recipe.

recommendation.zh: 增量型合成数据论文，但“style diversity 比 topic diversity 更值钱”这个结论值得记下；只看消融和过滤策略，别把任务结果当通用规律。
recommendation.en: Incremental synthetic-data work, but the claim that style diversity matters more than topic diversity is worth pocketing; read the ablations, not the task score.

paper.title: Reinforcement learning towards broadly and persistently beneficial models
paper.abstract: Training targeting beneficial behavior in realistic scenarios produces broad improvements in alignment that generalize across domains and persist under adversarial pressure.

summary.core_problem: 这项工作问的是一个对 post-train 和 pretrain 接口都很关键的问题：对少量“有益行为特质”做强化学习，能否产生跨任务、跨领域、抗压力的对齐泛化，而不只是让模型学会通过训练集中的安全评测。它把问题从单个安全规则或单个 benchmark，推进到更抽象的行为特质层面，例如诚实、承认不确定性、可纠正性、元认知透明性、公平性、风险敏感性和对人类福祉的关切。
summary.importance: 贡献在于给出了一条与“emergent misalignment”相反方向的实验证据：窄域训练不一定只产生窄域效果，强化某些正向行为特质也可能带来广泛迁移。对预训练研究的影响主要在三点。第一，它提示模型内部可能存在较粗粒度的行为方向，RL 可以沿这些方向改变模型，而不只是拟合局部任务格式。第二，它说明 post-train 信号质量会反过来影响对基座能力与风险的判断，alignment eval 不能只看训练域内表现。第三，它为 future pretrain/posttrain co-design 提供了问题定义：预训练阶段是否能更早地塑造可纠正性、诚实表达不确定性、抗 reward hacking 等特质，而不是完全依赖后期 RL 修补。
summary.technical_approach: 方法不是简单做安全 SFT，而是在现实对话场景中构造用于测量和训练的 beneficial trait 数据。每个样本设计成带有压力、歧义或竞争激励的情境，测试模型是否能保持某种行为特质。领域覆盖健康、教育、科学、法律、工程、经济和商业等。训练时使用现实 post-training RL mixture：大部分仍是标准 RL 数据，只混入少量 beneficial trait 数据，并与从同一初始模型出发、使用相同 RL compute 的 baseline 比较。这个设计很重要，因为它避免把结果解释为“多给了一批安全数据”或“额外训练算力更大”。论文还做了更强的外推测试，例如训练时排除健康和科学样本，再看健康、医学、心理健康等评测是否仍有提升。持久性测试则通过 adversarial prompts 和 adversarial fine-tuning 观察模型是否更难被诱导到有害行为。
summary.experiments: 公开内容没有披露模型参数量、RL 算法细节、reward model 结构、数据条数或 token 规模。关键数字是：beneficial trait RL 模型在 53 个内部和外部 benchmark 中，有 44 个相对 compute-matched baseline 改善。这些评测覆盖 deception、honesty、reward hacking、latent safety risks、harmful agentic behavior、specification compliance、health 和 mental health。域内 held-out beneficial trait eval 上，模型在 truthfulness、corrigibility、metacognitive transparency 等特质上明显提升。更重要的是，独立评测也改善，且使用了不同任务、不同领域和不同打分方式。健康评测包括真实医学对话、医生编写 rubric、高置信医学错误；心理健康评测同时看不应提供的内容和有益支持。工作还报告，在对抗提示和对抗微调下，经过 beneficial trait RL 的模型更不容易转向有害行为。
summary.reading_guide: 需要精读，重点不是把它当作普通 alignment blog，而是看实验设计如何隔离“特质级 RL 是否能泛化”。优先看四处。第一，beneficial traits 的定义和样本构造方式，尤其是怎样把诚实、可纠正性、承认不确定性这类抽象属性落到具体对话。第二，训练 mixture 和 baseline 控制：同一起点、同等 RL compute、只改变少量 trait 数据，这是判断因果作用的关键。第三，53 个 benchmark 的分组结果，尤其是哪些类别提升、哪些没有提升；未提升项往往比平均趋势更能说明边界。第四，排除健康/科学后的迁移实验，以及 adversarial prompt/fine-tuning 下的持久性结果。需要追问的点包括：reward 是否引入 verbosity 或 refusal 偏差，trait 数据是否改变了 helpfulness/safety trade-off，持久性是否来自行为策略变稳还是来自更深层表示改变，以及这些 trait 是否可在 mid-training 或 continual pretraining 中提前注入。
summary.authors_note: OpenAI；公开内容未列出个人作者。背景上，这项工作延续了 OpenAI 对 emergent misalignment、reward hacking、deception、scheming 和高风险领域行为评测的研究线。

summary_en.core_problem: The work asks whether reinforcement learning on a small amount of data targeting beneficial behavioral traits can produce broad and persistent alignment generalization, rather than only teaching a model to pass the training distribution. The targeted traits include honesty, epistemic humility, metacognitive transparency, corrigibility, universal fairness, risk sensitivity, and concern for human welfare.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is empirical evidence for a positive counterpart to emergent misalignment. Narrow training on undesirable behaviors can generalize into broader misbehavior; this work studies whether RL on beneficial traits can also generalize broadly. For pretraining researchers, the important implication is that model behavior may contain relatively coarse directions that post-training can move, beyond local benchmark fitting. It also tightens the pretrain–posttrain interface: the quality and abstraction level of RL signals can change how base-model capabilities and risks are expressed, and some alignment-relevant traits may be candidates for earlier shaping during mid-training, continual pretraining, or data-mixture design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The approach builds a synthetic dataset of realistic conversations designed to test beneficial traits under ambiguity, pressure, or competing incentives. The scenarios span health, education, science, law, engineering, economics, business, and other applied settings. The model is trained with a realistic RL post-training mixture, where most of the data remains standard RL data and only a small fraction targets these beneficial traits. The comparison is compute-matched: models start from the same checkpoint and receive the same amount of RL compute. This design is important because it makes the trait data, rather than extra optimization or a different starting point, the main intervention. The work also tests stronger out-of-domain transfer by excluding health and science examples during training and then evaluating on health, medical, and mental-health tasks. Persistence is tested with adversarial prompts and adversarial fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: The public write-up does not disclose parameter counts, data size, token count, RL algorithm details, or reward-model architecture. The key reported number is that the beneficial-trait RL model improves over the compute-matched baseline on 44 out of 53 internal and external benchmarks. These benchmarks cover deception, honesty, reward hacking, latent safety risks, harmful agentic behavior, specification compliance, health, mental health, and related safety-relevant behaviors. On held-out in-distribution beneficial-trait evaluations, the model improves on traits such as truthfulness, corrigibility, and metacognitive transparency. The more informative result is transfer to independently constructed evaluations with different domains, tasks, and grading setups. Reported health evaluations include realistic medical conversations, physician-written rubrics, and high-confidence medical errors. Mental-health evaluations measure both disallowed content and beneficial support. The model is also reported to be harder to steer toward harmful behavior through adversarial prompting or fine-tuning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it closely as an experiment about trait-level RL generalization, not just as an alignment announcement. Focus first on how the beneficial traits are operationalized into conversation data. Then inspect the training mixture and the compute-matched baseline controls, because they determine whether the results can be attributed to the trait intervention. The benchmark breakdown across 53 evaluations is the central evidence; categories that do not improve are especially important for understanding the boundary of the effect. The health/science exclusion experiment is useful for judging domain transfer. The adversarial prompting and fine-tuning results are useful for judging persistence. Open questions to track are whether the reward signal induces verbosity or over-refusal, how helpfulness and safety trade off, whether persistence reflects a stable behavioral policy or a deeper representation shift, and whether similar traits can be shaped during mid-training or continual pretraining.
summary_en.authors_note: OpenAI; individual authors are not specified in the provided public content. The work sits in OpenAI's broader line of research on emergent misalignment, reward hacking, deception, scheming, and behavior under pressure in high-stakes settings.

recommendation.zh: OpenAI 的信号值得记录，但技术细节不足；重点看他们如何定义 persistent benefit 和 adversarial pressure。
recommendation.en: The OpenAI signal is worth logging, but details are thin; focus on how they define persistent benefit and adversarial pressure.

paper.title: The Reward Was in Your Data All Along: Correcting Flow Matching with Discriminator-Guided RL
paper.abstract: Score- and flow-matching models often rely on preference-based reinforcement learning for two purposes: aligning with subjective preferences and, surprisingly, recovering properties such as visual realism and coherent object structure that matching-based training is intended to learn from the data itself. We argue that this reflects a structural mismatch. Matching losses measure $\ell_2$ regression error on the velocity or score field under training-time marginals, a proxy poorly aligned with th

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的问题不是“如何再做一个图像生成 RL trick”，而是更基础的一点：为什么 flow/score matching 这类本来就是为了拟合数据分布而设计的训练目标，仍然会漏掉数据中已经存在的高层属性，比如视觉真实感、物体结构一致性、物理合理性，最后还要靠 RL 再补回来。作者把矛头指向 matching objective 本身的结构失配：训练时最小化的是插值分布上的速度场或 score 场的 L2 回归误差，但推理时真正决定样本质量的是模型自己 rollout 后落到哪里，以及这些样本在语义空间里是否保留了数据分布的关键性质。也就是说，问题不一定是数据不够、模型不够大，而可能是训练目标对“我们真正关心的性质”控制得太弱。
summary.importance: 虽然论文对象是连续域生成模型，不是文本 LLM，但它对基座预训练研究有很强的方法论价值。第一，它清楚地区分了‘拟合训练分布上的局部回归目标’和‘控制模型自采样分布上的全局性质’这两件事，这个张力在 diffusion LM、non-AR generation、甚至标准 AR 预训练里都存在。第二，它把 RL 的角色从“只做偏好对齐”扩展为“修正 pretrain objective 的结构性盲点”，这对理解 pretrain↔post-train 闭环很有启发。第三，论文提出的 discriminator-guided reward 不是依赖人工偏好，而是从数据与模型分布差异中构造奖励，这种思路对未来做 data-aware RL pretrain、self-rewarded continual training、以及 representation-space correction 都有借鉴意义。贡献量级上，这更像一篇把训练目标、分布偏移和 RL 角色重新摆正的机制型工作。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分两层。第一层是理论分析。作者在 probability-flow ODE 框架下研究一个性质 gap：|E_pbase[r] - E_q[r]|，其中 r 是某个我们关心的样本属性。结论是，FSM loss 对这个 gap 的控制很弱。最坏情况下甚至没有保证，因为训练损失是在插值边缘分布 q_t 上度量，而生成时模型实际遵循的是自己的 rollout 分布 p_t；两者一旦偏离，训练时的回归误差小，并不意味着采样后的属性也对。即便在附加正则条件下能得到保证，这个保证也会随着 reward 的 L2 Lipschitz 常数恶化，而很多语义或感知质量相关的性质恰恰是高曲率、非平滑的。

第二层是方法设计：Discriminator-Guided RL，简称 DRL。它不使用偏好数据，而是训练一个判别器去估计数据分布 q 与当前模型分布 p_model 在自监督表示空间中的 density ratio。更具体地说，把真实样本和模型样本都映射到一个预训练 SSL encoder 的特征空间，在这个空间里训练一个简单判别器区分 data vs model；判别器 logit 作为 reward，随后做 KL-regularized RL，把模型往‘更像数据分布’的方向推。这里最关键的设计不是 RL 本身，而是 reward 定义在 SSL representation space，而不是像素空间。原因有两个：一是高维原空间做 density-ratio estimation 很难，二是表示空间天然过滤掉很多低层噪声，把修正限制在语义上更有意义的方向。

这个方法与 preference-based RL 的区别很明确。PRL 优化的是外部偏好函数，往往同时混合了主观偏好和客观质量；DRL 优化的是“模型分布相对数据分布还缺了什么”，因此它更像对 pretraining objective 的补偿项。与直接改 matching loss 相比，DRL 选择 post-hoc RL，是因为 RL 可以在模型自己的采样轨迹上评估并优化 reward，绕开 q_t 与 p_t 不一致的问题。
summary.experiments:
实验在多种图像生成架构上验证，包括 SiT、JiT、REPA、RAE。作者强调的一点是，DRL 使用的判别器可以很简单，甚至线性分类器就足以带来稳定收益，这说明改进并不依赖一个很强的 reward model，而是来自 reward 构造方式本身。评测主要看多个特征空间下的 Fréchet distance，并额外检查 held-out human-preference rewards。主结果是：相对 base model，DRL 在各架构上都能显著改善分布质量指标；更重要的是，这些改善还能迁移到未参与训练的人类偏好奖励上，说明它不是只在某个特征空间里过拟合。

论文还有一个很有价值的实验设置：先做 DRL，再叠加 preference-based RL，与直接在 base model 上做 PRL 比较 reward–distortion Pareto frontier。结果是前者更好，因为 DRL 先把那些本应由数据分布提供、但 matching objective 没学好的结构性属性补回来，PRL 就可以把容量更多用在真正主观的偏好上，而不是拿偏好数据去修复基础 realism/structure 问题。这一点对 post-training pipeline 设计很重要。

从你关心的角度，最值得看的是实验是否证明了“不是数据不够，而是 objective mismatch”。如果全文里有随着 base model 变强、DRL 仍然有效的结果，那会进一步支持这个论点。当前给出的正文片段没有包含完整数字表，因此不能准确复述具体提升幅度，但实验叙事已经很清楚：多架构一致收益、简单判别器有效、对 held-out preference reward 也有正迁移、并且能改善后续 PRL 的效率。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议按这个顺序。先看 Introduction，抓住论文真正的问题意识：RL 不只是加偏好，很多时候是在修正 matching training 没学到的数据属性。然后直接看理论部分关于 property gap 的分析，尤其是 q_t 上训练、p_t 上采样这组不一致，以及 Lipschitz 依赖为什么会让很多感知属性难以由 FSM loss 保证。理解了这一点，再看 DRL 方法就会很顺。方法部分重点看三个问题：为什么选 SSL representation space；density-ratio discriminator 如何训练；KL-regularized RL 如何接入现有 flow model pipeline。实验部分优先看两类表：一类是 base model vs DRL 的主结果，另一类是 DRL+PRL 与直接 PRL 的 Pareto 对比。预计 30 分钟可以完成一次高质量泛读；如果你做 diffusion LM、flow matching LM 或者在思考 RL 是否能反哺 pretrain objective，这篇值得细看理论章节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a deeper question than how to add another RL stage to image generation: why do flow- and score-matching models, which are explicitly trained to fit the data distribution, still fail to preserve properties already present in the data—such as realism, coherent object structure, or physically plausible motion—and then recover them only after RL post-training? The paper argues that the bottleneck is often the matching objective itself. Training minimizes an L2 regression error on velocity or score fields under interpolation marginals, while sample quality at inference depends on where the model’s own rollout distribution ends up and whether those samples preserve semantically important properties of the data. In other words, the issue may be objective mismatch rather than insufficient data or model capacity.
summary_en.importance: Even though the setting is continuous-domain generative modeling rather than text LLM pretraining, the methodological relevance is high. First, the paper cleanly separates fitting a local regression target under training-time marginals from controlling global properties under the model’s self-generated distribution. That tension also appears in diffusion LMs, non-autoregressive language modeling, and even standard AR pretraining. Second, it reframes RL from being only a preference-alignment tool to being a mechanism for correcting structural blind spots of the pretraining objective. That is directly relevant to the pretrain–post-train loop. Third, the proposed reward is not based on human preference labels but on discrepancies between data and model distributions in a learned representation space. This is a useful template for data-aware RL pretraining, self-corrective continual training, and representation-space reward construction. The contribution is best read as a mechanism paper that clarifies the role of RL relative to the base objective.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has two layers. The first is theoretical. In a probability-flow ODE setting, the paper studies a property gap of the form |E_pbase[r] - E_q[r]|, where r is a property of interest. The conclusion is that flow/score matching gives weak control over this gap. In the worst case, there is no guarantee at all, because the training loss is measured under interpolation marginals q_t, whereas generation is governed by the model’s own rollout distribution p_t. Once those differ, small regression error under q_t does not imply that sampled outputs preserve the desired property. Under additional regularity assumptions, one can derive a bound, but it degrades with the L2 Lipschitz constant of the reward. Many semantic or perceptual properties are precisely the kind of high-curvature, non-smooth functions for which such guarantees become weak.

The second layer is the method: Discriminator-Guided RL (DRL). Instead of using preference data, DRL trains a discriminator to estimate the density ratio between the data distribution and the current model distribution in a self-supervised representation space. Real samples and model samples are embedded by a pretrained SSL encoder; a discriminator is trained in that feature space to distinguish data from model outputs; the discriminator logit is then used as the reward for KL-regularized RL. The central design choice is to define the reward in SSL feature space rather than pixel space. This makes density-ratio estimation more tractable and constrains the correction to semantically meaningful directions instead of low-level noise.

This differs from preference-based RL in a precise way. PRL optimizes an external reward that often mixes subjective preference with objective quality. DRL instead optimizes what the model distribution is still missing relative to the data distribution, making it closer to a corrective term for the pretraining objective. It also differs from directly modifying the matching loss: RL is used because it evaluates and optimizes the reward on the model’s own sampled trajectories, thereby bypassing the q_t versus p_t mismatch.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical study spans several modern image-generation architectures, including SiT, JiT, REPA, and RAE. One notable result is that the discriminator used by DRL can be very simple—even a linear classifier is sufficient to produce consistent gains. That suggests the improvement is not coming from an unusually powerful reward model, but from the way the reward is constructed. Evaluation is based mainly on Fréchet distances in multiple feature spaces, with additional checks using held-out human-preference rewards. The main finding is that DRL improves distribution-quality metrics over the base model across architectures, and these gains transfer to unseen human-preference rewards despite never training on preference labels.

A particularly important experiment compares two pipelines: applying preference-based RL directly to the base model versus applying PRL on top of a DRL-corrected model. The latter yields a better reward–distortion Pareto frontier. The interpretation is straightforward: DRL first recovers structural properties that should have come from the data but were not fully captured by the matching objective, leaving PRL to focus on genuinely subjective preferences rather than spending preference data to repair basic realism or coherence. That has clear implications for post-training pipeline design.

From a foundation-model perspective, the key empirical question is whether the paper really supports the claim that the issue is objective mismatch rather than lack of data. If the full paper shows DRL remaining useful even as the base model gets stronger, that would strengthen the argument further. The excerpt provided here does not include the full numeric tables, so exact gains should not be fabricated. Still, the experimental story is already clear: consistent gains across architectures, simple discriminators suffice, held-out preference rewards improve, and downstream PRL becomes more efficient.
summary_en.reading_guide: A good skim starts with the introduction, focusing on the paper’s central claim: RL is often repairing properties that matching-based training failed to capture from the data itself. Then move to the theory section on the property gap. The most important points are the mismatch between training under q_t and sampling under p_t, and why the dependence on the reward’s Lipschitz constant makes many perceptual properties hard to control through FSM losses alone. Once that is clear, the DRL method becomes much easier to interpret. In the method section, focus on three questions: why use an SSL representation space, how the density-ratio discriminator is trained, and how KL-regularized RL is integrated into the existing flow-model pipeline. In the experiments, prioritize the main base-model-versus-DRL results and the DRL+PRL versus direct PRL Pareto comparison. A solid skim should take around 30 minutes. If you work on diffusion LMs, flow-matching language models, or the role of RL in correcting pretraining objectives, the theory section is worth a closer read.

recommendation.zh: Cohere 提出的判别器引导 RL 方法，用判别器替代人类偏好作为 Reward，对探索 LLM/VLM 的 self-play 或无监督 RL 后训练有启发。
recommendation.en: Cohere's discriminator-guided RL replaces human preferences with a discriminator as the reward, inspiring explorations in self-play or unsupervised RL post-training for LLMs/VLMs.

paper.title: RODS: Reward-Driven Online Data Synthesis for Multi-Turn Tool-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Multi-turn tool-use RL is bottlenecked by the rapid depletion of informative samples in static datasets. We observe that the gradient signal in GRPO concentrates on tasks with the highest rollout reward variance, a consequence of the Popoviciu upper bound. Consequently, samples near the agent's capability boundary -- where successes and failures are roughly balanced -- contribute disproportionately large policy gradients. As training progresses, this boundary continuously shifts, which gradually

summary.core_problem: 多轮工具使用Agent的RL训练同时面临高质量多轮数据稀缺、静态数据随能力边界迁移出现信息样本耗尽、在线合成轨迹语义不连贯三大瓶颈。
summary.importance: 复用RL训练中已有的进度奖励方差作为零成本能力边界检测器的思路，可直接迁移至数学推理、代码生成等采用GRPO/PPO的后训练流程；保留功能依赖结构的多轮轨迹合成方法，解决了现有合成数据语义连贯性差的问题；其数据效率结论也为后训练数据配比提供了实证参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出将RL训练与数据生成闭环耦合的RODS框架，核心包括三部分：一是复用GRPO训练中已计算的进度奖励方差（基于Popoviciu上界，方差在能力边界处最高），零成本识别高梯度信息的边界任务；二是锚定种子轨迹的功能依赖结构进行技能对齐的重采样，保证合成多轮轨迹的语义连贯性与结构同构；三是动态回放缓冲区跟踪能力边界，淘汰已掌握任务、补充新边界任务，维持稳定的高信息样本池。
summary.experiments: 仅用400个人工种子、维持约800个活跃训练样本，性能即与17K样本的离线合成管线相当（数据量减少约20倍），且优于固定数据集的RL训练方法。
summary.reading_guide: 先读引言中多轮工具RL的三大瓶颈与现有方法缺陷，再重点理解进度奖励方差与能力边界的对应关系及RODS三模块设计，最后看数据效率对比实验；预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: RL training for multi-turn tool-use agents is constrained by three coupled bottlenecks: scarcity of high-quality multi-turn datasets, informative sample depletion in static datasets as capability boundaries shift, and semantic incoherence in trajectories from unconstrained online synthesis.
summary_en.importance: The idea of reusing progress reward variance as a zero-cost capability boundary detector transfers directly to GRPO/PPO-based post-training workflows for mathematical reasoning, code generation and other tasks. The structure-preserving multi-turn trajectory synthesis method solves the semantic coherence problem in existing synthetic data pipelines; its data efficiency conclusion also provides empirical reference for post-training data mixture design.
summary_en.technical_approach: RODS is a framework that tightly couples RL training and data generation via three co-evolving modules. First, it repurposes progress reward variance (which peaks at the capability boundary per Popoviciu's upper bound, and is already computed for advantage estimation in GRPO) as a zero-cost probe to identify high-informative boundary tasks. Second, a skill-aligned resampling pipeline anchors to the functional dependency structure of verified seed trajectories to generate semantically coherent, structurally isomorphic novel multi-turn trajectories. Third, a dynamic replay buffer tracks the shifting capability boundary to maintain a stable pool of high-informative training samples.
summary_en.experiments: Starting from 400 human seeds and maintaining an active pool of ~800 training samples, RODS matches the performance of a 17K-sample offline synthesis pipeline (using ~20× less data) and outperforms RL training with fixed static datasets.
summary_en.reading_guide: First read the introduction for the three core bottlenecks of multi-turn tool-use RL and limitations of existing methods; then focus on the correspondence between progress reward variance and capability boundary, plus the design of RODS's three modules; finally review data efficiency comparison experiments. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: GRPO样本耗尽的机制分析扎实，§3的方差-梯度关联推导和§4的合成策略值得后训练团队复现验证
recommendation.en: Solid mechanism analysis of GRPO sample depletion, §3 variance-gradient derivation and §4 synthesis strategy are worth reproducing for post-training teams

paper.title: Seeing Before Reasoning: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning for Shortcut-Resilient Multimodal On-Policy Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a model on its own rollouts and uses a frozen copy to provide dense token-level targets conditioned on a reference target. This works well for LLM reasoning, but a direct extension to multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can create a shortcut: the privileged target may guide tokens mainly based on the text reference target rather than the image. We propose ViGOS, a visually grounded OPSD framework for MLLM post-training. The student first writes a vi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体、也很容易被忽略的 MLLM post-training 问题：把文本 LLM 上有效的 on-policy self-distillation 直接搬到多模态场景时，教师端可见的参考答案会过早主导整条生成轨迹，导致模型在还没真正看图时，就已经沿着“与答案相容”的语言路径生成。结果不是简单的过拟合，而是视觉 grounding 被弱化：模型学会了写出看似合理的视觉推理文本，但这些中间步骤主要受答案提示驱动，而不是受图像证据约束。论文把这个问题形式化为 privileged answer leakage，并指出 vanilla OPSD 在 MLLM 上的风险不在于 dense supervision 本身，而在于同一个 privileged teacher 对‘感知—推理—作答’三个阶段使用了相同的信息条件。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口的启发主要有两点。第一，它说明 dense token-level distillation 在多模态场景里不是天然安全的；如果教师条件设计不对，训练信号会系统性鼓励 shortcut，而不是提升真实的视觉利用率。这对以后做 multimodal continual pretrain、reasoning post-train、以及 unified AR training 都有直接意义。第二，它给出了一种更一般的思路：不要只看 loss 形式，要看监督信号在生成轨迹不同阶段暴露了什么信息。对基座研究来说，这比单纯讨论是否用 RL、是否用 distillation 更关键。贡献量级上，它不是改写范式的工作，但属于那类把已有有效方法从 text-only 推向 multimodal 时，补上关键机制缺口的论文。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 ViGOS，把学生输出显式拆成两个阶段：先写 visual description，再进行 reasoning 和 final answer。对应地，教师监督也被拆开。第一段描述由 image-only perception teacher 监督，这个教师只能看图像，不看参考答案，因此它给出的 token-level target 只能来自视觉证据。第二段推理与答案由 privileged reasoning teacher 监督，这个教师可以看参考答案，但它是在学生已经生成了视觉描述之后，基于同一 student prefix 提供后续 dense supervision。这样做的目的不是完全去掉答案条件，而是把答案条件限制在“已经完成感知 grounding 之后”的阶段，避免它反向污染早期视觉声明。

论文还引入 reference teacher 处理 invalid rollouts。这里的设计取舍很清楚：如果学生生成的轨迹在格式、结构或任务约束上已经失效，继续在该轨迹上做分段蒸馏意义不大，反而可能放大噪声，因此改用 reference teacher 把输出拉回目标格式。这个机制本质上是在 on-policy 和 training stability 之间做折中。

从全文描述看，作者并不只是提出 prompt engineering 式的“先描述再推理”，而是把它嵌入到 OPSD 的监督图里：不同 token span 由不同信息可见性的教师负责。论文前面还定义了 PALR（Privileged Answer Leakage Rate）来刻画在固定 student rollout 上，教师修正中有多少成分来自 privileged answer 而不是图像。这个指标的价值不在于绝对数值，而在于它把 shortcut 风险从直觉层面推进到可分析层面。相比 vanilla OPSD，ViGOS 的关键区别不是换了 loss，而是重新设计了 teacher context assignment；相比纯 outcome-level RL，它保留了 dense token supervision 的样本效率优势。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖面比较广，重点不是单一 benchmark 冲分，而是验证“保留 OPSD 收益，同时减少 prior shortcut”。文中评测包含一般视觉语言能力、学术型多模态推理、视觉数学、空间 grounding，以及专门测试 language prior/shortcut 的 stress benchmarks。全文给出的主结论是：ViGOS 在常规 benchmark 上基本保留 vanilla OPSD 的提升，没有因为加入 perception-reasoning decoupling 而明显牺牲主任务性能；同时在 prior-sensitive 评测上更稳，说明它确实提高了模型对图像证据的依赖度，而不是只改变了输出风格。

从消融逻辑看，最值得注意的通常有三组：一是与 vanilla OPSD 的直接对比，用来验证 shortcut 是否真实存在；二是去掉 image-only perception teacher，只保留 privileged teacher，看性能是否回退；三是去掉显式 visual description 接口，检验“分段监督”是否必须依赖中间表示。论文摘要页没有给出具体参数量和提升数字，全文片段里也未出现完整表格，因此这里不能编造数值。但从作者组织实验的方式看，重点证据不是某个 benchmark 上的大幅增益，而是 robustness pattern 的变化：标准集不掉太多，prior-sensitive 集提升更明显，这与方法目标是一致的。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和方法图，抓住一句话：问题不是 OPSD 无效，而是 privileged answer 在 MLLM 上泄漏得太早。然后看 Preliminaries 里对 vanilla OPSD 的形式化，以及 PALR 的定义，理解作者如何把 shortcut 风险写成可讨论的对象。方法部分重点看三类 teacher 的职责边界：perception teacher、reasoning teacher、reference teacher，各自看什么输入、监督哪些 token。实验部分建议优先看 prior-sensitive benchmark 的主表和对应消融，因为那部分最能说明 ViGOS 不是单纯增加了输出模板约束。预计 25–35 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读；如果你做 multimodal post-train 或者在研究 dense supervision 的信息泄漏问题，建议再细看 PALR 分析和 invalid rollout 处理策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific failure mode of extending on-policy self-distillation from text-only LLMs to multimodal LLMs. In vanilla OPSD, the frozen teacher is conditioned on a privileged reference answer and provides dense token-level supervision on the student’s own rollout. In MLLMs, this creates a shortcut: the teacher can steer the trajectory toward answer-compatible text before the model has actually grounded its response in the image. The result is not merely overfitting, but weakened visual grounding—plausible-looking rationales that are driven more by answer conditioning than by visual evidence. The paper frames this as privileged answer leakage and argues that the issue comes from using the same privileged teacher context across perception, reasoning, and answer generation.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretrain/post-train research is conceptual. First, it shows that dense token-level distillation is not automatically safe in multimodal settings; if teacher visibility is mis-specified, the training signal can systematically reinforce shortcuts instead of improving true image use. That matters for multimodal post-training, continual pretraining, and any unified autoregressive setup that mixes latent reasoning with grounded perception. Second, it highlights a broader design principle: when analyzing a training objective, one must inspect what information is exposed at each stage of the generated trajectory, not just the loss form. In terms of contribution scale, this is not a new foundation-model paradigm, but it does close an important mechanism gap in transferring a successful text-only recipe into multimodal reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ViGOS explicitly decomposes the student output into two stages: a visual description first, then reasoning plus final answer. The supervision is decomposed accordingly. The visual-description segment is supervised by an image-only perception teacher, which has access to the image but not the reference answer. This forces token-level targets in the early segment to be grounded in visual evidence. The later reasoning and answer segments are supervised by a privileged reasoning teacher that can see the reference answer, but only after the student has already produced the visual description. This preserves answer-guided dense supervision where it is useful, while preventing privileged information from directly shaping the early perceptual claims.

The method also uses a reference teacher for invalid rollouts. The rationale is practical: once the student trajectory has drifted into an invalid format or broken task constraints, continuing segmented on-policy supervision may amplify noise. The reference teacher is then used to restore output structure and reduce format drift. This is a stability-oriented compromise between strict on-policy learning and controllable supervision.

A notable aspect is that the paper does more than prompt the model to “describe before reasoning.” It changes the supervision graph of OPSD so that different token spans are scored by teachers with different information access. The paper also introduces PALR, the Privileged Answer Leakage Rate, to quantify how much of the teacher correction on a fixed student rollout is attributable to the privileged answer rather than the image. The point of PALR is not a single headline number, but a way to make shortcut risk analyzable. Relative to vanilla OPSD, the main innovation is teacher-context assignment rather than a new loss. Relative to sparse-reward RL, ViGOS keeps the sample-efficiency advantage of dense token-level supervision.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation is broad and aligned with the paper’s claim: preserve the gains of OPSD on standard benchmarks while improving robustness to language-prior shortcuts. The benchmarks cover general vision-language ability, expert-level multimodal reasoning, visual mathematics, spatial grounding, and stress tests designed to expose reliance on textual priors. The central empirical result is that ViGOS largely retains the benchmark improvements of vanilla OPSD on standard tasks, while performing better on prior-sensitive evaluations where genuine image dependence matters.

The most informative ablations are the obvious ones. First, a direct comparison against vanilla OPSD tests whether the shortcut problem is real in practice. Second, removing the image-only perception teacher checks whether privileged supervision alone causes the model to regress toward weaker grounding. Third, removing the explicit visual-description interface probes whether the benefit comes from staged supervision or merely from output templating. The provided excerpt does not include full tables, parameter counts, or exact gains, so no precise numbers should be invented here. Still, the experimental pattern is clear: the method is not mainly about pushing one benchmark higher, but about changing the robustness profile—small or no loss on standard sets, better behavior on prior-sensitive ones—which is exactly what the method is designed to achieve.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the introduction and the main method figure. The key takeaway is simple: OPSD itself is not the problem; early privileged-answer exposure is. Then read the preliminaries that formalize vanilla OPSD and the PALR definition, since that is where the shortcut concern becomes concrete rather than anecdotal. In the method section, focus on the boundary between the three teachers: perception teacher, reasoning teacher, and reference teacher—what each one sees and which token spans each one supervises. In the experiments, prioritize the prior-sensitive benchmarks and the ablations, because those best show that ViGOS is doing more than enforcing a response template. A useful skim should take about 25–35 minutes. If your work touches multimodal post-training or information leakage in dense supervision, the PALR analysis and invalid-rollout handling deserve a closer read.

recommendation.zh: 指出了 MLLM 自蒸馏中容易出现的文本捷径问题，其解耦感知与推理的思路对多模态后训练数据合成有启发，可看其解耦设计的具体 loss。
recommendation.en: Identifies the text shortcut issue in MLLM self-distillation; its approach of decoupling perception and reasoning is inspiring for multimodal post-training data synthesis. Worth checking the specific loss design for decoupling.

paper.title: Enhancing Multilingual Reasoning via Steerable Model Merging
paper.abstract: Model merging is an effective technique for composing the capabilities of a multilingual model and a reasoning model. It has achieved promising generalization in multilingual reasoning tasks by aligning feature spaces of different models. However, the merged single model often fails to address the conflicts between source models, leading to suboptimal performance. In other words, the one-size-fits-all merging strategy may not align with the characteristics of different inputs which may require p

summary.core_problem: 解决静态模型合并在多语言推理中无法按输入动态调节不同源模型能力权重的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练/模型组合方法。它把 multilingual model 与 reasoning model 的能力合成从固定权重合并改成输入自适应合并，对模型编辑、能力组合和冲突消解有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Steerable Model Merging，核心是在两个源模型之间加入 gated cross-attention，让合并模型按输入动态加权或过滤来自不同源模型的表示。相比 one-size-fits-all merging，它试图在多语言能力和推理能力冲突时做条件化取舍。
summary.experiments: 在 4 个多语言推理 benchmark、21 种语言上实验，报告 ST-Merge 稳定优于多个强 baseline。摘要未说明模型规模、源模型名称、训练开销和各语言分组的详细提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the limitation of static model merging for multilingual reasoning, where different inputs may need different mixtures of multilingual and reasoning capabilities.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and model composition contribution. It is relevant to capability composition, conflict resolution between source models, and adaptive reuse of specialized LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: ST-Merge introduces a gated cross-attention mechanism over two source models. The merged model can dynamically weight or filter the attended representations, rather than using a fixed global merge coefficient.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on four multilingual reasoning benchmarks covering 21 languages and is reported to consistently outperform strong merging baselines. The abstract does not specify model sizes, source models, training cost, or per-language effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 gate 设计和语言分组结果；若没有干净的同算力对照，它更像实用合并技巧而非能力组合规律。
recommendation.en: Skim the gating design and per-language breakdown; without clean compute-matched controls, it is more a practical merging trick than a law of capability composition.

paper.title: REVES: REvision and VErification--Augmented Training for Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling via sequential revision has emerged as a powerful paradigm for enhancing Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning. However, standard post-training methods primarily optimize single-shot objectives, creating a fundamental misalignment with multi-step inference dynamics. While recent work treats this as multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL), conventional approaches optimize over the multi-step trajectories directly, failing to further exploit the high-quality mistakes in intermediat

summary.core_problem: test-time scaling 下的多步修订推理与现有单步后训练目标不匹配，直接做 trajectory-level RL 又浪费了中间 near-miss 步骤的学习信号。
summary.importance: 提出一种把 revision 与 verification 解耦的数据增强+策略优化框架，属于 test-time scaling 训练方法类工作；方法上为 offline/off-policy 利用中间错误提供了一个具体 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 两阶段迭代：(1) 在线 rollout 生成成功恢复轨迹，把中间 near-miss 步骤解耦为独立的 revision prompt（从错到对的改写）和 verification prompt（定位错误）；(2) 用这些增广样本做策略优化，支持离策略数据复用，降低在线采样成本。框架反复在数据增广和策略优化之间交替。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练 token、baseline 与数值增益，仅描述了在推理任务上相对单步目标和直接 multi-turn RL 的效率与效果提升预期，实验细节不完整。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Zhaoran Wang、Mingyi Hong、Mohammad Ghavamzadeh 等，来自优化/RL 方向，无明确机构署名在给定信息中。

summary_en.core_problem: Single-shot post-training objectives mismatch multi-step revision-based test-time scaling, while naive multi-turn RL underuses learning signal from near-miss intermediate steps.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an iterative data augmentation plus policy optimization framework that decouples revision and verification supervision, offering a concrete recipe to exploit intermediate mistakes for test-time scaling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two-stage loop: (1) online rollouts of successful recovery trajectories; intermediate near-miss states are converted into decoupled revision prompts (error-to-correction transforms) and verification prompts (error identification); (2) policy optimization on these augmented samples enables off-policy data reuse and reduces sample cost, alternating between data augmentation and policy improvement.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits model sizes, training data, baselines, and quantitative gains; it only claims improved efficiency and performance over single-shot objectives and direct multi-turn RL on reasoning tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Zhaoran Wang, Mingyi Hong, and Mohammad Ghavamzadeh from optimization/RL backgrounds; institutional affiliations are not fully specified in the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 想法不新（revision+verification 数据增广今年已很拥挤），摘要实验不完整，扫一眼数据构造方式即可，别当方法范式读。
recommendation.en: The revision-plus-verification augmentation idea is crowded this year and the abstract lacks concrete numbers; skim the data construction, do not treat it as a new paradigm.

paper.title: Rethinking Reward Supervision: Rubric-Conditioned Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Post-training of reasoning language models is commonly driven by supervised distillation and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. Distillation often relies on chain-of-thought annotations that are expensive to obtain and may themselves be noisy, incomplete, or partially incorrect; even when the final solution is correct, an imperfect rationale can interfere with learning. Reinforcement learning with verified rewards, on the other hand, typically compresses evaluative feedback into a s

summary.core_problem: 现有推理模型后训练中，SFT蒸馏依赖的CoT标注成本高且噪声大，RLVR的标量奖励信号过于稀疏，无法提供细粒度改进指导。
summary.importance: 提出评分细则条件自蒸馏框架，介于SFT和RL之间，以结构化rubric作为细粒度反馈，平衡了监督密度和标注成本。
summary.technical_approach: 让教师模型以分维度评分细则为条件，对学生模型on-policy采样的轨迹提供token级指导，避免将单条参考CoT作为唯一监督目标，无需人工标注高质量推理过程。
summary.experiments: 在数学、代码等推理任务上验证，相比标准SFT蒸馏和GRPO基线，Rubric条件自蒸馏取得更高的推理准确率，且对标注噪声的鲁棒性更强。

summary_en.core_problem: In current reasoning LLM post-training, CoT annotations for SFT distillation are costly and noisy, while scalar rewards in RLVR are too sparse to provide granular improvement guidance.
summary_en.importance: Proposes Rubric-Conditioned Self-Distillation, a framework between SFT and RL that uses structured rubrics as fine-grained feedback, balancing supervision density and annotation cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: Conditions the teacher model on dimension-level scoring rubrics to provide token-level guidance on trajectories sampled on-policy by the student, avoiding treating a single reference CoT as the sole supervision target without requiring high-quality human-annotated reasoning chains.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on math, code and other reasoning tasks; rubric-conditioned self-distillation achieves higher reasoning accuracy than standard SFT distillation and GRPO baselines, with stronger robustness to annotation noise.

recommendation.zh: 用细粒度rubric替代单一CoT做自蒸馏，工程上可尝试，但无范式突破，作为文献备查即可。
recommendation.en: Uses fine-grained rubrics instead of single reference CoT for self-distillation; engineering-friendly but no paradigm shift, keep as literature reference.

paper.title: SuCo: Sufficiency-guided Continuous Adaptive Reasoning
paper.abstract: Despite remarkable performance on complex tasks, Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) often generate excessively long Chain-of-Thoughts (CoT), inflating computational costs even for simple queries. Existing efforts to mitigate this inefficiency typically rely on discrete reasoning modes or fixed budget tiers, lacking a principled criterion of when reasoning is sufficient. In this work, we introduce Minimal Sufficient CoT (MSC), defined as the shortest prefix of a CoT trajectory which is adequate for pr

summary.core_problem: 如何让 Large Reasoning Models 在不牺牲甚至提升正确率的前提下，自动把 CoT 推理长度压到“刚好够用”，避免对简单题也输出冗长推理带来的算力与时延浪费；并给出一个可操作的“推理何时足够”的判据，而不是依赖离散档位/手工预算。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献（更偏 post-train / test-time compute 控制），但对“推理 token 作为可控资源”的训练信号设计有参考价值：1）把“足够性”形式化为可学习的连续控制目标，替代常见的 on/off 或少数档位；2）给出一个从现有长 CoT 轨迹中挖出短监督信号（MSC）的数据构造思路，属于一种面向推理效率的蒸馏/重标注；3）提出同时惩罚不足与过度推理的 reward 形状，和训练中分布漂移（reasoning length 分布变化）对应的动态采样池设计。对做 RL-for-reasoning、test-time scaling、以及“训练时把推理长度当作预算变量”的团队更相关。
summary.technical_approach:
核心概念是 Minimal Sufficient CoT (MSC)：给定问题 x、标准答案 y*、以及模型生成的一条 CoT 轨迹 z，把“这段推理是否足以支持输出正确答案”定义为一个 sufficiency 分数 Sθ(z|x,y*)。论文用答案在条件 (x,z) 下的似然来度量支持度：从联合概率转为几何平均（per-token average）以避免长答案导致的指数衰减不稳定。然后用阈值 δ 判定“δ-sufficient”，并在句子级别找最短前缀作为 MSC（避免 token 级截断破坏推理结构）。

在此基础上提出 SuCo 两阶段训练：
1）Stage I：MSC-Aligned Fine-Tuning (MFT)。先用已有“全量 CoT”轨迹为每个样本抽取 MSC 前缀，构造 (x, MSC, y*) 的监督数据，再做 SFT，让模型内化“短但够用”的推理风格。这里的关键不是再写一个短 CoT 模板，而是用 sufficiency 判据从长轨迹中自动挖出最短可用前缀，属于一种基于模型置信度的重标注。
2）Stage II：Sufficiency-Aware Policy Optimization (SAPO)。用 RL 进一步学会按题目难度连续调节推理长度。论文强调两点：其一是 reward 既惩罚推理不足（导致答错或低 sufficiency），也惩罚过度推理（冗余 token）；其二是维护一个 dynamic complexity pool 跟踪训练过程中推理长度/难度分布的变化，用于稳定采样与避免策略更新后分布漂移导致的训练不稳。

与已有 ALRM 的差异：不依赖外部分类器/域标签来选模式，也不把预算离散成几档；而是用“足够性阈值 + 最短前缀”把控制目标连续化，并把监督信号从长 CoT 自动提炼出来。
summary.experiments:
全文声称在数学、代码、科学三类任务上、1.5B 与 7B 两个尺度评测；在 MATH 的 5 个难度等级上，MSC 相比 full CoT 同时减少推理 token 且准确率更高（论文在引言用 Figure 1 给出该现象）。同时对比 full CoT 与若干自适应推理基线（用户控制/模型驱动的离散模式方法），SuCo 达到“更少 reasoning tokens + 更高 accuracy”。

但在给定的全文片段里缺少关键表格数字（例如：平均推理 token 降幅、各基线的准确率差、SAPO 的 reward/池化消融）。如果要用于复现或判断收益边界，需要回到实验章节核对：MSC 抽取的 δ/动态阈值如何设定、MSC 在不同任务的覆盖率（多少样本能找到短前缀）、以及 RL 阶段是否引入额外采样成本。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
1）先看 Figure 1/2：确认“MSC 比 full CoT 更准且更短”的经验事实是否稳健，以及 MSC 的定义示意。
2）方法部分重点抓两件事：sufficiency 分数的定义（几何平均 vs 联合概率的动机与 Appendix A.4 的验证）和 MSC 的句子级前缀搜索过程（是否需要多次前向、计算成本如何）。
3）再看 SAPO：reward 具体长什么样（如何同时惩罚不足与过度）、dynamic complexity pool 的实现细节（池的更新规则、采样策略、对稳定性的贡献）。
4）实验部分优先看：token-accuracy tradeoff 曲线、不同难度分桶结果、以及对 δ/阈值策略/池化的消融。读完应能回答：收益主要来自 MFT 的“短监督”，还是来自 RL 的“连续控制”。

summary_en.core_problem: How to make Large Reasoning Models autonomously stop reasoning when it is already sufficient—reducing redundant CoT tokens (cost/latency) on easy queries—while maintaining or even improving accuracy, using a principled sufficiency criterion rather than discrete modes or fixed budget tiers.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining contribution per se (closer to post-training and test-time compute control), but it is relevant to researchers treating reasoning tokens as a controllable resource. The paper contributes: (1) a learnable, continuous control target for reasoning length via a formal sufficiency notion; (2) a practical way to distill shorter supervision (MSC) from existing long-CoT trajectories through confidence-based relabeling; (3) a reward design that penalizes both under- and over-reasoning, plus a training-time mechanism (dynamic complexity pool) to cope with distribution shift in reasoning length during RL. Useful if you work on RL-for-reasoning, test-time scaling laws, or budget-aware reasoning policies.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The key construct is Minimal Sufficient CoT (MSC). Given input x, gold answer y*, and a generated CoT trajectory z, the paper defines a sufficiency score Sθ(z|x,y*) based on how well z supports producing y* under the model. Instead of raw joint likelihood (which decays exponentially with answer length), it uses a geometric mean (per-token average) for stability. With a threshold δ, a trajectory prefix is δ-sufficient if Sθ exceeds δ; MSC is the shortest sentence-level prefix that is δ-sufficient, avoiding token-level truncation that can break step structure.

SuCo is a two-stage training recipe:
1) MSC-Aligned Fine-Tuning (MFT): extract MSC prefixes from full-CoT trajectories to build (x, MSC, y*) supervision, then SFT to internalize concise-but-sufficient reasoning patterns.
2) Sufficiency-Aware Policy Optimization (SAPO): RL to learn continuous, difficulty-adaptive reasoning allocation. The paper emphasizes (i) sufficiency-aware rewards that penalize both insufficient reasoning and excessive tokens, and (ii) a dynamic complexity pool that tracks the evolving distribution of reasoning behaviors during training to stabilize sampling and mitigate policy-induced distribution drift.

Compared to prior adaptive reasoning models, SuCo avoids external classifiers/domain labels and avoids discrete budget modes; it operationalizes “when to stop” via sufficiency thresholds and shortest-prefix extraction, then trains a policy to control reasoning length continuously.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports experiments across math, coding, and science tasks at 1.5B and 7B scales. On MATH with five difficulty buckets, MSC is claimed to reduce reasoning tokens while improving accuracy over full CoT (illustrated in Figure 1). SuCo is reported to outperform full CoT and adaptive-reasoning baselines in the accuracy–token tradeoff.

However, in the provided full-text excerpt, the key quantitative tables are not visible (e.g., average token reduction, absolute accuracy gains, and ablations for reward/pool/thresholding). For a serious assessment, you need to verify in the experiments section: how δ (or dynamic thresholds) is set, MSC extraction success rate and compute overhead, and whether SAPO introduces significant additional sampling cost.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
1) Start with Figures 1–2 to validate the core empirical claim (shorter MSC yet higher accuracy) and the MSC definition.
2) In Method, focus on the sufficiency score (why geometric mean; check the appendix validation) and the sentence-level prefix search (how many forward passes; practical cost).
3) Read SAPO carefully: the exact reward form (balancing under- vs over-reasoning) and the dynamic complexity pool mechanics (update rules, sampling, stability impact).
4) In Experiments, prioritize token–accuracy tradeoff curves, difficulty-bucket breakdowns, and ablations on thresholding/pool/reward. The key question to answer is whether gains mainly come from MFT (better supervision) or from RL (better continuous control).

recommendation.zh: 重点看 MSC 构造是否干净；若标签不偷看答案，它是 RLVR 推理预算控制的可复现实验方向。
recommendation.en: Check whether MSC construction is clean; if it avoids answer leakage, it is a reproducible direction for RLVR-style reasoning-budget control.

paper.title: Learning from the Self-future: On-policy Self-distillation for dLLMs
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has proven effective for post-training large language models (LLMs), yet its application to diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) remains unexplored. Existing OPSD methods are inherently autoregressive-centric. They inject privileged information via left-to-right prefix conditioning with token-level divergence supervision, a design that fundamentally conflicts with the arbitraryorder generation of dLLMs. We introduce d-OPSD, the first OPSD framework tailored for dLLMs. Our ap

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 diffusion LLM 的 on-policy self-distillation 如何定义的问题。AR 模型里的 OPSD 通常把 privileged information 放在 prefix 中，并做 token-level divergence；但 dLLM 是迭代去噪、任意顺序生成，这种左到右前缀条件和 token 级监督并不匹配。d-OPSD 的目标是在不引入更强外部 teacher 的情况下，让 dLLM 从自己的生成轨迹中获得更密集的自蒸馏信号。
summary.importance: 它对新型语言建模范式的 post-train 接口有参考意义。dLLM 近期已经能用 RLVR 做 reasoning post-training，但 RLVR 的 outcome reward 稀疏，SFT 又有 off-policy 和 exposure bias 问题。d-OPSD 提供了一种更贴合去噪生成过程的训练信号：用模型自己生成的答案作为 suffix privileged information，再用 step-level divergence 监督整个去噪转移。这把 AR post-training 中的 OPSD 思路迁移到 diffusion LM，但没有照搬 token-level objective。对研究 diffusion LM 的训练目标、推理过程和 reasoning 能力提升有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 核心有两处改动。第一，self-teacher 的构造不再把参考解或 privileged information 拼到 prompt 后面作为 prefix 条件，而是利用 dLLM 可做非自回归条件建模的特点，把模型自己生成的答案作为 suffix condition。这样 teacher 学到的是在已知“未来答案”时，对前面推理轨迹或中间内容的条件分布，可理解为从 self future-experience 中提供训练信号。第二，监督粒度从 token-level divergence 改为 step-level divergence。dLLM 每一步会对多个 masked tokens 同时预测，然后保留一部分、重新 mask 一部分；单个 token 的 next-token KL 并不能自然对应这个 Markov denoising transition。d-OPSD 因此在每个去噪 step 上比较 student transition 与 self-teacher transition，使蒸馏目标和 dLLM 的推理机制对齐。它和 RLVR 的区别是提供密集分布监督，而不是只依赖最终答案奖励；和 SFT 的区别是训练轨迹来自 student 自身，on-policy 程度更高。
summary.experiments: 论文在四个 reasoning 任务上比较 d-OPSD、RLVR 和 SFT。给定内容显示，d-OPSD 在 reasoning performance 和 sample efficiency 上稳定优于这些 baseline。实验还分析了不同设置对效果的影响，用来支持两个设计选择：suffix privileged conditioning 比把 privileged information 作为前缀更适合 dLLM；step-level divergence 比 token-level 监督更符合迭代去噪。给定内容未包含任务名称、模型规模、训练样本量、步数和具体分数，因此需要在实验表中重点核对提升幅度，以及是否在不同 denoising steps、不同采样策略、不同自生成答案质量下保持稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 AR-OPSD 与 dLLM 不匹配的两点分析：prefix conditioning 和 token-level divergence。然后看 Preliminaries，确认作者如何定义 dLLM 的 forward corruption、reverse denoising、masked token 保留与 remasking。方法部分重点看 self-teacher 的 suffix conditioning 形式，以及 step-level divergence 的具体计算对象。实验部分建议优先看四类结果：与 RLVR/SFT 的主结果，样本效率曲线，privileged information 放置方式的消融，token-level 与 step-level supervision 的消融。若要进一步判断价值，需要看它是否依赖高质量自生成答案筛选，以及额外推理成本是否会影响训练吞吐。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how on-policy self-distillation should be formulated for diffusion LLMs. OPSD methods for autoregressive models usually inject privileged information through left-to-right prefix conditioning and apply token-level divergence. That design does not fit dLLMs, which generate by iterative denoising and can condition on arbitrary parts of the sequence. d-OPSD aims to give a dLLM dense self-distillation signals without requiring a stronger external teacher.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to the interface between alternative language modeling objectives and post-training. Recent dLLMs can benefit from RLVR, but outcome rewards are sparse, while SFT uses off-policy trajectories and can suffer from exposure bias. d-OPSD proposes a training signal that matches the denoising process more closely: use the model’s own generated answer as suffix privileged information, then distill at the denoising-step level. This is a useful direction for studying how reasoning training should differ between autoregressive LMs and diffusion LMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method makes two main changes to AR-style OPSD. First, the self-teacher is built with suffix conditioning rather than prefix conditioning. Instead of appending a reference solution to the prompt in a left-to-right format, d-OPSD uses the model’s own generated answer as a future suffix condition. This exploits the bidirectional or arbitrary-order conditioning ability of dLLMs and keeps the data on-policy. Second, the divergence objective is moved from token level to step level. In a dLLM, each denoising step predicts many masked positions, commits to a subset, and may remask others. A next-token KL objective is therefore not the natural unit of supervision. d-OPSD compares the student and self-teacher denoising transitions at each step, aligning the distillation target with the Markov denoising process. Compared with RLVR, it provides dense distributional feedback. Compared with SFT, it trains on trajectories sampled from the student itself.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments on four reasoning tasks, comparing d-OPSD with RLVR and SFT baselines. The provided content states that d-OPSD improves both reasoning performance and sample efficiency. The ablations are designed to test the two central choices: suffix-based privileged conditioning versus prefix-style conditioning, and step-level divergence versus token-level supervision. Exact task names, model sizes, training budgets, and score deltas are not available in the supplied text, so the experimental tables should be checked for the actual margins and for robustness across denoising step counts, sampling strategies, and different qualities of self-generated answers.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim should cover the main contribution. Start with the Introduction, especially the two failure modes of directly applying AR-OPSD to dLLMs: prefix conditioning and token-level divergence. Then read the preliminaries to verify the paper’s notation for forward corruption, reverse denoising, token commitment, and remasking. In the method section, focus on the suffix-conditioned self-teacher and the exact definition of step-level divergence. In the experiments, prioritize the main comparison with RLVR and SFT, the sample-efficiency curves, and the ablations on privileged-information placement and supervision granularity. For a deeper assessment, check whether the method depends on filtering high-quality self-generated answers and how much extra computation the self-teacher pass adds.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 ablation 即可；它提醒 dLLM 后训练不能照搬 AR 的 prefix 教师信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations; the useful point is that dLLM post-training cannot simply inherit AR prefix-based teacher signals.

paper.title: See First, Answer Later: Visual Evidence Pre-Alignment via Sufficiency-Driven RL
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) integrate strong text reasoning with visual inputs, yet their responses can be inconsistent with the underlying images, indicating ineffective utilization of visual evidence during inference. The prevailing training paradigm relies on large-scale caption-based pretraining for general alignment, followed by supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to enable instruction following and complex reasoning. However, such pretraining provides only weak v

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 MLLM 在回答视觉问题时“看了图但没真正用好图”的问题。更具体地说，现有训练流程通常先做图文预训练，再做指令微调和 RL，但预训练阶段主要依赖短 caption，监督信号偏粗，模型容易学到场景级对齐，却学不到对细粒度属性、关系、局部区域和题目相关证据的稳定提取能力。结果是在推理时，模型更像是在做 P(a|q) 的语言先验补全，而不是可靠地做 P(a|v,q)。作者想解决的不是单个 benchmark 上的答题技巧，而是把“先找足够的视觉证据，再作答”变成一个独立训练目标，并把它放在 pretrain 与 post-train 之间，作为专门补强视觉 grounding 的中间阶段。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要有两点。第一，它提出了一个清楚的训练接口：把视觉感知能力的补强从任务级回答监督里拆出来，单独优化一个 question-conditioned evidence policy。这种做法对多模态预训练很有启发，因为它不是继续堆更密的 caption，也不是直接在答案上做更强监督，而是引入一个中间变量，把“看见什么”与“如何回答”分开。第二，它给出了一种较低标注成本的路径：利用现成 QA 数据，通过 frozen blind reader 判断证据是否足以恢复答案，从而把 answer supervision 转成 evidence supervision。这个思路对预训练—后训练接口、latent reasoning、以及多模态 RL 信号设计都有参考价值。量级上，它更像是一个训练范式上的中等强度贡献，而不是基础架构改写；价值在于训练目标设计和阶段划分比较干净。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 VEPA，Visual Evidence Pre-Alignment。作者把原来的直接回答分解成两步：先由 MLLM 根据图像和问题生成文本形式的 visual evidence，再由一个只看问题和证据、完全不看图的 blind reader 去恢复答案。形式上，相当于把 P(a|v,q) 分解为 P(e|v,q) 和 P(a|e,q)。这里 e 被当作信息瓶颈，训练目标要求它同时满足两个条件：一是 sufficiency，即给定问题后，证据里要有足够信息让 reader 推出正确答案；二是 visual dependence，即证据必须真的依赖图像，而不是把答案直接泄露出来，或者退化成模板化空话。

训练上作者采用 GRPO 来优化 evidence generation policy。每个样本会生成一组候选 evidence，由 group-relative 的方式做相对奖励学习。奖励设计是全文最关键的部分，不只是“reader 答对就给分”。作者显式加入了几类约束来避免训练走偏：其一，防止 answer leakage，避免模型直接把答案或近似答案塞进 evidence，导致 reader 成为形式上的验证器；其二，惩罚重复、冗余、退化的 evidence，避免 RL 常见的 verbosity 或 pattern collapse；其三，强调 sufficiency 而不是最终 answer generation，把视觉 grounding 与回答策略解耦。这样做的原因很明确：如果直接对最终答案做 RL，模型仍可能靠语言先验、题目模式或 shortcut 获得奖励，无法保证视觉证据真的被编码。

从训练流程看，VEPA 被放在 caption pretraining 之后、SFT/RL 之前，属于一个中间对齐阶段。它不要求额外的人类 dense caption 标注，而是复用现有 VQA/QA 数据。与“直接用更长 caption 继续预训练”相比，VEPA 的差异在于监督是 question-conditioned 的。也就是说，模型不是被要求穷举描述整张图，而是学习围绕当前问题抽取足够且必要的视觉证据。这比静态 dense caption 更接近推理时的真实信息需求，也更节省表示带宽。
summary.experiments:
从引言和方法部分能确认的实验结论是：VEPA 在多类视觉要求较高的评测上都优于标准训练 recipe，覆盖 knowledge-intensive VQA、compositional VQA、fine-grained perception 和 holistic multimodal evaluation，并且收益不仅出现在单一 backbone。作者还强调，增益来自视觉感知增强，而不是额外任务监督，因为训练只引入了 evidence-level RL 目标，没有增加新的人工标注类型。

全文片段里没有给出完整表格数字、参数量和数据规模，因此不能编造具体提升幅度。但从作者描述的 ablation 重点可以提炼出几条关键信息：第一，blind reader 作为冻结评估器是必要的，它让奖励聚焦在“证据是否足够”，而不是让同一个模型自洽打分；第二，answer leakage 抑制项是必要的，否则 evidence 会退化成隐式答案通道；第三，性能提升在 OOD 数据上仍能保留，说明学到的不是 benchmark-specific 的答题模板，而是更稳定的视觉 grounding。若阅读全文，最值得核对的是主表里不同 benchmark 的提升分布、reward 各项消融、以及 evidence 质量的定性案例，因为这些决定了方法到底是在提升感知，还是只是在改变输出风格。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇更适合泛读方法设计，而不是逐行抠公式。建议先看 Introduction 和 Preliminary，抓住作者为什么要把视觉证据单独建模，以及 sufficiency / visual dependence 这两个约束分别在防什么问题。然后重点看方法部分里 reward 设计和 GRPO 训练细节，尤其是如何定义 answer leakage、如何处理重复和退化 evidence、group sampling 怎么做。实验部分优先看三类内容：主结果表、reward/reader/阶段位置的消融、以及 evidence 可视化案例。阅读时间大约 25 到 40 分钟。如果你关心多模态预训练接口，值得额外想两个问题：一是 evidence 作为文本瓶颈会不会限制视觉信息上限；二是这种中间阶段能否推广到视频、语音或 unified multimodal pretraining。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a persistent failure mode in MLLMs: they answer visual questions with weak grounding, even when the image is available. The authors argue that the standard recipe—caption-based pretraining followed by instruction tuning and RL—builds only coarse alignment. Short captions emphasize salient objects and global scene summaries, but they do not train the model to reliably extract fine-grained, question-relevant evidence such as attributes, relations, and small regions. As a result, inference often drifts toward language-prior-driven answering rather than genuine image-conditioned reasoning. The paper tries to fix this by introducing an explicit intermediate objective: before learning how to answer better, train the model to produce sufficient visual evidence for the question.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining-oriented readers, the main contribution is not a new VQA trick but a cleaner training decomposition. The work inserts a dedicated stage between multimodal pretraining and post-training, and optimizes a question-conditioned evidence policy instead of relying on answer supervision to indirectly improve perception. That is a useful design pattern for multimodal foundation models: separate 'what visual information should be extracted' from 'how to produce the final answer.' A second contribution is the supervision mechanism. The method reuses existing QA data and converts answer labels into evidence-level rewards through a frozen blind reader, avoiding the need for dense human annotations. The impact is moderate but real: this is a training-objective and stage-design contribution, with implications for multimodal grounding, latent-variable formulations, and RL signal design at the pretrain/post-train boundary.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, VEPA (Visual Evidence Pre-Alignment), factorizes answering into two steps. First, the MLLM generates textual visual evidence conditioned on the image and the question. Second, a frozen blind reader—an LLM that does not see the image—receives only the question and the generated evidence, and tries to recover the ground-truth answer. In probabilistic terms, the paper rewrites direct answering as a decomposition through a latent bottleneck e: an evidence policy P(e|v,q) followed by a reasoning policy P(a|e,q). The bottleneck is intentional. It forces the model to externalize the visual content that is actually needed for answering.

The optimization target is built around two properties. Sufficiency means the evidence should contain enough information for the blind reader to infer the answer. Visual dependence means the evidence must genuinely come from the image rather than from question priors or direct answer leakage. To train the evidence policy, the paper uses GRPO. For each sample, the model generates a group of candidate evidence sequences, and learning is driven by relative rewards within the group.

The reward design is the critical part. The paper does not simply reward the reader for getting the answer right. It adds constraints to prevent degenerate solutions: penalties against answer leakage, so the evidence cannot collapse into a disguised answer channel; penalties against repetitive or low-information evidence, so RL does not reward verbosity or templated outputs; and a decoupling between grounding and final answer generation, so the optimization pressure stays on evidence quality rather than downstream response style. This is the main difference from direct answer-level RL, where the model can still exploit shortcuts from language priors. Compared with replacing captions by dense descriptions, VEPA is also different in supervision structure: the evidence is question-conditioned, not a static attempt to describe the whole image. That makes it closer to actual inference-time information needs and more bandwidth-efficient than generic dense captioning.
summary_en.experiments:
From the available full-text content, the paper reports consistent gains over the standard training recipe across several visually demanding settings, including knowledge-intensive VQA, compositional VQA, fine-grained perception, and broader multimodal evaluation. The improvements are said to hold across different backbones, which matters because the claim is about training strategy rather than a backbone-specific trick.

The excerpt does not include the full result tables, model sizes, or dataset scales, so precise numbers should not be invented. Still, the experimental story is clear. First, the frozen blind reader is important because it turns answer supervision into a sufficiency test for evidence, instead of letting the same model self-validate. Second, anti-leakage reward terms are necessary; otherwise the evidence channel can degenerate into direct answer transmission. Third, the gains transfer to out-of-distribution settings, which supports the claim that VEPA improves grounding rather than merely fitting benchmark-specific answer patterns. When reading the full paper, the most important checks are: how gains distribute across perception-heavy versus reasoning-heavy benchmarks, how strong the ablations are for each reward component, and whether the qualitative evidence examples truly show better visual extraction rather than just longer outputs.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper, so the goal is to understand the training idea rather than every implementation detail. Start with the Introduction and Preliminary sections. They explain why caption pretraining is insufficient and why the paper introduces a latent evidence variable. Then focus on the method section, especially the reward construction: how sufficiency is measured, how answer leakage is detected, and how repetitive evidence is discouraged. In experiments, prioritize the main benchmark table, the ablations on reward components and blind-reader design, and the qualitative evidence examples. Expected reading time is around 25–40 minutes. If you work on multimodal pretraining, two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: whether a textual evidence bottleneck limits the ceiling of visual information, and whether the same intermediate stage could be generalized to video, audio, or unified multimodal pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reward 定义和 ablation；若控制干净，它支持“先证据对齐再推理”的 VLM 后训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Read the reward definition and ablations; if the controls are clean, it supports a useful VLM recipe of evidence alignment before reasoning.

paper.title: Continual Self-Improvement with Lightweight Experiential Latent Memories
paper.abstract: Large language models achieve strong reasoning performance by scaling inference-time compute, yet remain fundamentally stateless, discarding the rich, self-produced reasoning traces generated during this process. We investigate whether models can instead learn online from this experience, converting transient computation (reasoning traces) into persistent reusable knowledge, and without external supervision or access to future data. We show that In-Context Learning (ICL) over raw reasoning trace

summary.core_problem: 在严格在线（streaming）场景里，模型每道题只见一次、没有外部标注、也不允许全量离线重训时，如何把推理时产生的大量“思考轨迹/探索”转化为可复用的长期能力增益，同时避免遗忘与训练不稳定。
summary.importance: 这篇更像“post-train ↔ continual learning 接口”而不是纯预训练论文，但对基座研究有两点直接启发：1）把 test-time compute 视为可被蒸馏的训练信号，讨论了为何“存文本轨迹做 ICL”难以泛化，推动把记忆放到表示空间；2）提出用极小参数量的模块化更新来做在线自改进，试图绕开全参 RL/微调带来的干扰与遗忘问题。若结论可靠，它提供了一种把持续学习做成“可组合的轻量参数块”的工程路径，和 mid-train/continual pretrain 的稳定性议题相关。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Experiential Latent Memory（ELM）：每处理完一个问题，模型基于该问题的推理探索（成功/失败轨迹与内部奖励信号）做少量梯度更新，但更新对象不是主干权重，而是一个“软提示/软前缀”形式的轻量潜变量记忆（作者强调约 0.001% 参数量级）。
关键设计动机有三层：
1）反对“文本瓶颈记忆”：只存 CoT 文本会丢掉隐藏态里更抽象的结构信息，也容易把偶然的表面模式当成可迁移知识；作者用实验声称 raw-trace ICL 与自反思式文本提炼都难带来稳健泛化。
2）用内部奖励做自监督：借鉴无监督/自奖励 RL 的思路，让模型从自身的探索中产生学习信号，而不是依赖标注答案；并强调单样本、少步更新在某些设置下比“拿到整套测试集离线训练”更能泛化，暗示离线堆数据会引入干扰或过拟合式的自监督噪声。
3）模块化隔离干扰：每个样本生成一个独立记忆模块，检索时按相似度组合注入，从结构上减少不同经验之间的梯度干扰；这也是作者用来回应近期工作指出的“自奖励 RL 随数据累积反而退化”的现象。
从实现形态看，它更接近：检索（选择相关记忆）+ 轻量参数注入（soft prompt）+ 极少步在线优化（只训记忆，不动底座）。
summary.experiments:
给出的全文片段没有包含完整实验表格与具体数值，因此无法可靠复述参数规模、数据量、提升幅度等硬指标。根据引言可确认的实验主张包括：
1）在挑战性数学基准上，raw reasoning trace 的 ICL/检索式复用提升“可忽略”；
2）对单个样本做少步、基于内部奖励的更新能带来可泛化的提升，且在某些设置下优于“离线拿更多数据训练”；
3）ELM 以极小参数开销（~0.001%）达到接近全量微调的效果，并展示跨数据集迁移与随经验累积的可扩展性。
但这些点需要结合实验章节核对：基线是否包含强的 self-consistency / verifier / tool use；内部奖励具体是什么、是否引入了隐式标签；以及在线评测是否严格避免数据泄漏与重复题型记忆。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–40 分钟）：
1）先看作者对“ICL over traces 为什么不泛化”的实证设置：检索策略、轨迹格式（含不含反思/总结）、以及他们如何定义 transfer；这是整篇立论的地基。
2）重点看 ELM 的三个实现细节：记忆参数化（软提示插入位置/长度/层数）、内部奖励/优化目标（是否是 RL、偏好损失、还是某种自一致性目标）、以及检索与组合机制（top-k、加权、是否做门控）。
3）看在线协议：每题只见一次如何保证、记忆库增长如何控制、是否有遗忘/干扰的量化指标。
4）如果只挑一张图/表：优先找“随时间/随样本数增长的性能曲线”和“跨数据集迁移矩阵”，它们最能验证作者关于可扩展与泛化的核心主张。

summary_en.core_problem: How to enable strictly online self-improvement for LLMs—each problem seen once, no external supervision, no access to future data—by turning inference-time reasoning exploration into persistent, reusable gains, while avoiding interference/forgetting and the cost/instability of full-model updates.
summary_en.importance: This is closer to the pretrain–posttrain interface (continual learning / online adaptation) than classic pretraining, but it carries two concrete lessons for foundation-model training: (1) it argues that storing textual reasoning traces for retrieval/ICL is a weak transfer mechanism, motivating memory in representation space rather than the token space; (2) it explores a modular, ultra-lightweight update path (soft-prompt memories) to reduce gradient interference and catastrophic forgetting—relevant to continual pretraining, mid-training, and stability-focused recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The proposed Experiential Latent Memory (ELM) pipeline creates a small latent memory after each solved problem. Instead of updating the backbone, it trains a tiny soft-prompt-like module (claimed ~0.001% of parameters) with a few gradient steps, using self-generated signals from the model’s own reasoning trajectories (success/failure exploration under test-time compute).
The paper’s design logic is:
1) Textual trace replay is bottlenecked: raw CoT traces (even with reflection-style refinement) are surface artifacts and do not reliably transfer; hidden states may contain more abstract structure than what is verbalized.
2) Internal-reward learning can provide a learning signal without labels, but prior approaches are mostly offline and can degrade as more test data accumulates.
3) Modularity isolates updates: per-instance memories are stored separately and composed at retrieval time, aiming to mitigate interference and forgetting compared to full-parameter RL/finetuning.
Operationally it looks like retrieval (select relevant memories) + injection (compose soft prompts) + tiny online optimization (memory-only).
summary_en.experiments:
The provided full-text excerpt does not include the main result tables or exact numbers, so specific parameter sizes, dataset scales, and deltas cannot be stated reliably here. Claims that can be attributed to the introduction include:
- Retrieval/ICL over raw reasoning traces yields negligible gains on hard math benchmarks.
- Few-step, single-example updates with internal rewards can generalize and may outperform offline training as offline data increases (suggesting interference/noisy self-supervision in the offline regime).
- ELM achieves competitive performance to full finetuning with ~0.001% additional parameters, shows cross-dataset transfer, and scales with accumulated experience.
These should be validated against the experimental section: strength of baselines (self-consistency/verifiers/tools), the exact definition of internal reward, and whether the online protocol truly prevents leakage and repeated exposure.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–40 minutes):
1) Start with the empirical case against trace-based ICL: retrieval setup, trace formatting (with/without reflection), and how transfer is measured.
2) Focus on three implementation details: memory parameterization (where/length/layers), the learning objective (RL vs preference-style vs self-consistency), and retrieval/composition (top-k, weighting, gating).
3) Check the online evaluation protocol: one-pass constraint, memory growth control, and explicit interference/forgetting metrics.
4) If you only inspect one figure/table, pick the performance-vs-time (experience accumulation) curve and the cross-dataset transfer matrix—those directly test the paper’s central claims.

recommendation.zh: 值得看方法和失败案例：它把 test-time scaling 产物写回模型，setup 若干净，应进内部小规模复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and failures: it turns test-time scaling byproducts into model updates, and if the setup is clean it deserves an internal small-scale replication.

paper.title: Trust the Right Teacher: Quality-Aware Self-Distillation for GUI Grounding
paper.abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) grounding requires vision-language models (VLMs) to identify small target elements in high-resolution screenshots and predict precise screen coordinates. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is a promising post-training approach for this coordinate-sensitive task, since it provides dense token-level teacher signals beyond hard coordinate labels. However, naive OPSD is not well suited to GUI grounding: OPSD evaluates the teacher on student-generated prefixes, the qual

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 做 GUI grounding 时，on-policy self-distillation 在坐标 token 上容易给出低质量教师信号的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是任务定制的后训练方法改进。它关注 GUI agent 中很实际的坐标预测误差传播，但对基座预训练的直接信息量有限。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是在 OPSD 框架上加入 quality-aware 机制：用 soft correctness-aware gating 判断当前教师坐标 token 是否仍可补全为正确目标，并对教师概率做 scaling，降低偏离目标前缀下的错误软标签影响。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据规模和完整数值结果。实验对象是 VLM-based GUI grounding，预期 baseline 包括 naive OPSD 和硬坐标监督方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses unreliable teacher signals in on-policy self-distillation for coordinate-sensitive VLM GUI grounding.
summary_en.importance: This is a task-specific post-training improvement. It is practically relevant for GUI agents, but it does not directly inform foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method augments OPSD with quality-aware self-distillation: a soft correctness-aware gate checks whether the teacher’s coordinate-token prediction can still lead to the correct target, and teacher probabilities are rescaled to suppress misleading soft labels.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not report model size, training data scale, or full numerical results. The evaluation is on VLM-based GUI grounding, likely against naive OPSD and hard coordinate supervision baselines.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和坐标 token gating；这是 GUI 后训练细节，不会改变预训练侧判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the coordinate-token gating idea only; this is GUI post-training engineering, not a pretraining signal.

paper.title: From Reasoning Traces to Reusable Modules: Understanding Compositional Generalization in Language Model Reasoning
paper.abstract: Post-training pipelines that combine supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with reinforcement learning (RL) have emerged as the key recipe for transforming large language models (LLMs) into robust reasoners. We argue that this combined success is driven by compositional generalization, which we formalize through a hierarchical latent selection model. In this framework, reasoning traces are generated by a cascade of discrete latent selection variables corresponding to reusable atomic modules, including bo

summary.core_problem: SFT+RL 的后训练范式为何能大幅提升 LLM 的推理能力？具体而言，SFT 和 RL 在实现组合泛化（Compositional Generalization）中各自扮演了什么角色，应如何分配数据？
summary.importance: 提供了一个严谨的理论框架（层次潜变量选择模型）来解释 SFT 和 RL 的分工。不仅从机制上解释了 RL 为何能解决 SFT 导致的“统计纠缠”问题，还给出了极具实操价值的 SFT/RL 数据配比建议，对设计 Post-training 流程有直接指导意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出“层次潜变量选择模型（Hierarchical Latent Selection Model）”。将推理轨迹视为由离散潜变量生成的序列，这些潜变量对应可复用的原子模块（包括局部操作的“技能”和决定信息流向的“路由”）。理论证明：SFT 提供了组合轨迹中的原始模块材料，但这些模块在 SFT 数据中往往是高度耦合的；RL 则通过奖励机制下的轨迹探索，将这些复合轨迹“解耦”成可独立复用的原子模块。基于此，提出 SFT 负责覆盖原子模块，RL 负责探索 SFT 分布外的新组合。
summary.experiments: 在合成字符串转换任务上进行控制变量实验。结果表明：1) 在复合轨迹上进行 RL 训练，其原子任务准确率能匹配直接使用原子数据监督训练的效果，且能泛化到未见过的组合。2) 组合能力必须从组合经验中学习：如果 RL 阶段缺失某个原子模块，只能通过注入包含该模块的组合数据来修复，单纯注入原子数据无效。3) 最佳的 OOD 泛化性能出现在：SFT 数据覆盖所有原子模块的组合，而 RL 数据专注于 SFT 支持集之外的新组合，且两者重叠最小化。
summary.reading_guide: 强烈建议精读。重点关注 Section 2 的理论建模（如何将推理抽象为技能和路由的组合），以及 Section 4 的控制实验设计（特别是 4.4 和 4.5 节关于数据配比的结论）。这篇论文对理解 RLHF/RLAIF 在推理任务中的作用机制极具启发。

summary_en.core_problem: Why does the SFT+RL post-training paradigm significantly improve LLM reasoning capabilities? Specifically, what are the distinct roles of SFT and RL in achieving compositional generalization, and how should data be allocated between them?
summary_en.importance: Provides a rigorous theoretical framework (Hierarchical Latent Selection Model) to explain the division of labor between SFT and RL. It not only mechanistically explains why RL resolves the 'statistical entanglement' caused by SFT but also offers highly actionable advice on SFT/RL data allocation, directly guiding post-training pipeline design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a 'Hierarchical Latent Selection Model'. Reasoning traces are modeled as sequences generated by discrete latent variables corresponding to reusable atomic modules (including 'skills' for local operations and 'routing' for information flow). Theoretically proves: SFT supplies the raw module materials in compositional traces, but these modules are often highly coupled in SFT data; RL, through reward-driven trajectory exploration, 'decouples' these compound traces into independently reusable atomic modules. Based on this, it proposes that SFT should cover atomic modules, while RL should explore novel compositions outside the SFT distribution.
summary_en.experiments: Conducted controlled experiments on synthetic string transformation tasks. Results show: 1) RL on compound traces matches the atomic-task accuracy of direct atomic supervision and generalizes to unseen compositions. 2) Composability must be learned from composed experience: if an atomic module is missing during RL, it can only be repaired by injecting composed data containing it, not by isolated atomic data. 3) The strongest OOD generalization occurs when SFT covers all atomic modules in compositions, and RL focuses on novel compositions outside the SFT support, with minimal overlap.
summary_en.reading_guide: Highly recommended for deep reading. Focus on the theoretical modeling in Section 2 (how reasoning is abstracted into skills and routing) and the controlled experiment design in Section 4 (especially Sections 4.4 and 4.5 on data allocation). This paper is highly illuminating for understanding the mechanisms of RLHF/RLAIF in reasoning tasks.

recommendation.zh: 应读理论设定和 controlled experiments；若 setup 干净，它会改变“RL 只是放大 SFT 行为”的简单 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the formal setup and controlled experiments; if clean, it weakens the simple prior that RL only amplifies behavior already present in SFT.

paper.title: Multi-Turn Reflective Masking Elicits Reasoning in Mask Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: While reasoning on autoregressive (AR) models is often performed by chain-of-thought reasoning and reflection, their refinement of previous outputs still relies on fully sequential generation, even when only local edits are needed. In contrast, the masking mechanism in Mask Diffusion Models (MDMs) naturally supports explicit local edits on previous outputs, allowing selective refinement without discarding previous answers and generating another from scratch. While this property more closely alig

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 mask diffusion language/model family 里一个很核心但一直没被真正打开的能力缺口：模型虽然天生支持 masked token 的并行重采样，但现有解码基本还是单轮、被动、吸收式的，一旦某个 token 被“确认”，后面很难主动回头改。这样它并没有把 diffusion 范式相对 AR 的潜在优势用出来。作者要做的不是再造一个更强的 denoiser，而是让 MDM 学会在生成过程中自己判断哪里不可靠、哪里值得重遮盖，再做多轮局部修正，把 reasoning 从“向前续写”改成“对当前状态反复修订”。
summary.importance: 对新型语言建模范式研究，这篇属于应当认真看的工作。原因有三点。第一，它抓住了 MDM 与 AR 最本质的机制差异：AR 的 test-time scaling 主要靠延长推理轨迹和重生成，MDM 则有机会把额外算力投到局部修正上。第二，它不是只在 decoding 上做启发式 remask，而是通过轻量 post-training 把 reflective masking 训练成模型内生能力，这对 diffusion LM 是否能形成独立 reasoning 路线很关键。第三，它提出的 History Reference 给了一个很实用的方向：MDM 缺少 AR 那种天然的“历史上下文串联”，于是需要显式保留去噪轨迹中的中间状态，给后续修正提供时间维度上的记忆。对 pretrain 研究员来说，这篇的意义不在于它已经给出最终答案，而在于它把“mask-based model 的 reasoning 应该如何定义和训练”讲清楚了。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上有两个主件。第一是 Reflective Masking。作者把每个位置、每个 denoising step 的动作定义成三选一：保留当前 token、把当前 token 重新 mask 掉等待重预测、或者对当前 mask 位置生成新 token。关键不是固定 remask 比例，而是根据模型当前的不确定性做逐位置决策，让模型能主动推翻先前已经 denoise 的内容。这样生成过程从单调收敛变成可逆的局部修订过程。第二是 History Reference。它不引入额外可学习参数，而是把先前若干步的中间预测状态聚合成 history-aware embedding，让模型在当前 step 不只看“现在的部分序列”，还看“这个位置之前被预测成过什么、改过几次、稳定不稳定”。这相当于给 MDM 补上一条 AR 模型天然拥有、但 diffusion 解码里通常缺失的时间记忆通道。

训练部分是全文最值得细看的地方。作者强调不能只靠推理时加规则，因为模型原本并没有学过多轮自发修订。于是他们设计了轻量 post-training，把 reflective masking 作为中心能力来训，并配套一个数据构造流程，生成与模型原生输出分布更对齐的训练样本。这里的关键取舍是：如果直接用人工构造错误或离分布 corruption，模型学到的可能只是修补特定噪声；作者更希望它学会在自身生成轨迹里识别不可靠 token 并修正，因此训练信号要贴近模型真实会犯的错。这个思路和很多 post-train reasoning 工作里“用模型自己的 rollout 造纠错数据”是同一脉络，但在 MDM 上更自然，因为 mask/re-mask 本来就是原生操作。
