summary.experiments: 实验覆盖图像编辑、Sudoku、文本生成三类任务，目的是证明这不是某个单一模态或强监督场景下的技巧。全文给出的主结论很稳定：Reflective Masking 在不同任务上都优于不具备多轮反思修订能力的基线 MDM；当任务需要模型自主探索、自己发现哪里错了时，History Reference 的增益更明显。图像编辑场景里，因为指令同时给了修改位置和修改目标，RM 主要体现为更稳定的局部编辑和更少的无关区域破坏；Sudoku 里，它体现为能反复定位冲突格并局部修正，而不是整盘重来；文本生成里，由于监督最弱、没有直接提示最终答案，RM 更能体现“通过迭代修订逼近正确输出”的能力。摘要和正文片段没有给出足够完整的数值表，因此不宜编造具体提升幅度；但从作者组织实验的方式看，重点不只是最终分数，而是证明 RM 带来的 test-time scaling 是一种不同于 AR CoT 的计算分配方式：额外步数主要用于 selective revision，而不是线性扩展输出长度。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇建议精读。先看 Introduction，抓住作者的核心立场：MDM 的 reasoning 优势不该理解为并行生成更快，而该理解为可以对中间状态做显式局部修订。然后直接读第 3 节 Reflective Masking，重点看三部分：逐位置 keep/re-mask/reveal 决策规则、History Reference 的构造方式、训练目标与训练样本如何生成。这里决定了方法是不是一个临时 decoding trick，还是一个可迁移的能力激活方案。接着看实验部分时，不要只盯最终指标，更要看不同任务中 RM 起作用的机制是否一致：是靠修正低置信 token，还是靠利用历史轨迹避免重复犯错。若时间有限，优先看方法图、算法描述、Sudoku 和文本任务结果，因为这两类最能体现 reasoning 与 self-correction。值得深挖的点有三个：一，反射式重遮盖是否能在更大语言模型上形成稳定 scaling；二，History Reference 能否与外部 memory 或 verifier 结合；三，这种 post-training 能力是否应前移到 pretraining，让 MDM 从一开始就学会可逆生成和局部修订。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a central limitation of mask diffusion models: although they can resample masked positions in parallel, standard decoding is still largely one-pass and absorbing. Once a token is confidently denoised, it is effectively fixed, so the model cannot actively revisit earlier commitments. This prevents MDMs from exploiting their main structural advantage over autoregressive models. The paper’s goal is to turn generation from monotonic forward completion into iterative state refinement, where the model can decide which parts of its current output are unreliable and should be re-masked and revised.
summary_en.importance: For researchers interested in alternative language-modeling paradigms, this is one of the more meaningful directions. It matters for three reasons. First, it identifies a genuine mechanism-level distinction between AR and mask-based generation: AR test-time scaling mostly spends extra compute on longer trajectories or regeneration, whereas MDMs could spend it on local revision. Second, the paper does not stop at heuristic remasking during inference; it uses lightweight post-training to make reflective masking an internalized capability. That is important if diffusion-style LMs are to develop a reasoning path that is not just an imitation of AR CoT. Third, the proposed History Reference addresses a real weakness of MDMs: unlike AR models, they do not naturally carry an explicit temporal trace of prior intermediate generations, so revision can become myopic without some form of trajectory memory.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two main components. The first is Reflective Masking (RM). At each denoising step and for each position, the model chooses among three actions: keep the current token, re-mask the current token for future resampling, or reveal a token if the position is currently masked. The key idea is that remasking is no longer a fixed heuristic based only on low confidence in still-masked positions; already denoised tokens can be actively reconsidered. This makes the denoising process partially reversible and turns generation into iterative local correction.

The second component is History Reference (HR), a parameter-free mechanism that aggregates intermediate decoding states into a history-aware representation. Instead of conditioning only on the current partially denoised sequence, the model also gets access to what each position looked like in previous steps and how stable those predictions were. This gives MDMs a temporal memory channel that AR models get implicitly through sequential context accumulation.

The training recipe is the most important part of the paper. The authors argue that inference-time rules alone are insufficient because existing MDMs were never trained for self-initiated multi-turn revision. They therefore introduce lightweight post-training centered on reflective masking, together with a data-generation pipeline designed to stay close to the model’s native output distribution. This is a good design choice: if training examples are built from artificial off-distribution corruptions, the model may only learn to repair synthetic noise rather than revise its own realistic mistakes. The paper instead tries to teach the model to detect and correct unreliable predictions arising from its own denoising dynamics.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans image editing, Sudoku, and text generation, which is a sensible way to test whether the method is tied to one modality or one supervision regime. The main result is consistent: RM improves over baseline MDM decoding across all three settings, and HR is especially helpful when the task requires autonomous exploration rather than explicit guidance. In image editing, where instructions specify both what and where to modify, RM mainly improves localized edits and reduces unnecessary changes elsewhere. In Sudoku, the benefit is clearer as iterative conflict detection and local correction. In text generation, where supervision is weakest and the final answer is not directly hinted, RM better exposes the intended reasoning behavior: progressively refining a partially wrong state rather than restarting from scratch. The provided excerpt does not include enough complete tables to quote reliable numeric gains, so the safe takeaway is qualitative but still important: the paper demonstrates a distinct form of test-time scaling for MDMs, where extra compute is spent on selective revision instead of forward token expansion.
summary_en.reading_guide: This one is worth a careful read. Start with the introduction to understand the paper’s framing: the advantage of MDMs is not merely parallel generation speed, but explicit revisability of intermediate states. Then go straight to the Reflective Masking section and read three pieces closely: the per-position keep/re-mask/reveal decision rule, the construction of History Reference, and the post-training objective plus data pipeline. Those sections determine whether the method is just a decoding trick or a transferable capability-enabling recipe. In the experiments, do not only look at final metrics; check whether the mechanism is consistent across tasks. Sudoku and text generation are especially informative because they expose self-correction more directly than image editing. The deeper questions to keep in mind are whether reflective remasking scales to larger language models, whether HR can be combined with external memory or verifiers, and whether this capability should eventually be moved earlier into pretraining rather than added only in post-training.

recommendation.zh: 应读方法和消融：它把 MDM 的“可局部改写”变成推理时计算，若成立会改变非 AR LM 的后训练设计。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations: it turns MDM local rewriting into inference-time compute, which would change how non-AR LMs are post-trained if it holds up.

paper.title: PACT: Privileged Trace Co-Training for Multi-Turn Tool-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Multi-turn tool-use agents must reason, call tools, and adapt to observations across several interaction turns. Post-training such agents is challenging, as reinforcement learning often suffers from sparse rewards and weak credit assignment despite matching the prompt-only inference setting, while supervised fine-tuning on expert traces provides dense process supervision but can over-constrain the model to fixed trajectories. To tackle this, we propose PACT, a Privileged trAce Co-Training framew

summary.core_problem: PACT 处理的是多轮工具调用 agent 的训练矛盾：RL 的 rollout 条件和推理一致，但奖励稀疏、信用分配弱；专家轨迹能提供过程信号，但直接 SFT 容易把模型压到单一路径上，且训练条件和推理条件可能不一致。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的启发点在于把专家轨迹从“推理时提示”改成“训练时特权信号”。对预训练研究本身不是核心贡献，但对 pretrain 到 posttrain 的接口有参考价值：它讨论了如何把高质量过程数据用于优化，而不改变模型实际部署时的条件分布。这个思想也适用于更一般的推理训练、工具使用训练和合成过程数据利用。
summary.technical_approach: PACT 保持 rollout 从原始 prompt 出发，不把专家轨迹放进生成上下文，因此采样分布和推理时一致。优化阶段再引入专家轨迹，形成两类信号。第一类是 trace-conditioned RL surrogate：用专家轨迹作为训练时的 privileged context 来评估或塑造 rollout 的更新方向，但不让模型在 rollout 时看到它。第二类是 component-aware SFT：不模仿完整专家轨迹，而是只监督选定的 reasoning prefix 和完整 tool-call，避免把所有中间文本都当成唯一正确答案。方法还给不同轨迹组件设置独立退火，使早期有较强过程约束，后期逐步降低模仿强度。prompt-only anchoring 则把一部分样本路由到标准 RL，不使用 trace loss，用来减轻模型对特权轨迹上下文的依赖。相比 hint-based 方法，PACT 不改变 rollout 条件；相比简单 SFT+RL，它更细地处理多轮工具调用中的 reasoning、tool-call、observation 和 final answer 结构。
summary.experiments: 提供内容中没有给出具体 benchmark 名称、模型规模、训练步数或提升数字。文中声称在多轮工具调用 benchmark 上，PACT 相比 SFT 基线和 RL 基线有稳定提升。更有价值的实验应当是三类消融：去掉 trace-conditioned RL 后是否退化为弱信用分配的 RL；去掉 component-aware SFT 后是否失去早期过程引导；去掉 prompt-only anchoring 后是否出现对特权轨迹条件的依赖。还需要关注专家轨迹是否去除了 final answer，以避免答案泄漏，这一点在方法设定中被明确提到。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看方法部分中 trace-conditioned RL surrogate 的目标函数、component-aware SFT 的 token/组件选择规则、退火 schedule 和 prompt-only anchoring。实验部分重点看与纯 RL、纯 SFT、hint-conditioned rollout、joint SFT-RL 的对比，以及 ablation 表。若时间有限，抓住一个问题：专家轨迹到底进入了哪个概率条件、哪个 loss、哪个训练阶段；没有进入 rollout 这一点是方法成立的关键。

summary_en.core_problem: PACT addresses a training mismatch in multi-turn tool-use agents: RL matches prompt-only inference but suffers from sparse rewards and weak credit assignment, while expert-trace SFT gives dense process supervision but can over-constrain the model to one fixed trajectory.
summary_en.importance: The main value is in the pretrain–posttrain interface rather than base pretraining itself. It shows a clean way to use high-quality process traces as optimization-only privileged signals, without changing the rollout distribution seen at inference. The same design pattern is relevant to reasoning training, tool-use training, and the use of synthetic process data.
summary_en.technical_approach: PACT separates rollout generation from trace-based optimization. Rollouts are sampled from the original prompt only, so the generation condition matches deployment. Expert traces are used only during optimization through two signals. The first is a trace-conditioned RL surrogate, where the expert trace acts as privileged context for shaping policy updates but is not exposed during rollout. The second is component-aware SFT, which supervises selected reasoning prefixes and complete tool calls rather than the entire trace. Separate annealing schedules reduce imitation pressure over training, giving early process guidance while avoiding long-term over-imitation. Prompt-only anchoring routes a subset of prompts to standard RL without trace losses, reducing dependence on privileged context. Compared with hint-based methods, PACT does not alter rollout conditions. Compared with naive SFT+RL, it uses the structure of multi-turn tool interaction more explicitly.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content does not include concrete benchmark names, model sizes, training budgets, or numeric gains. The paper reports consistent improvements over strong SFT and RL baselines on multi-turn tool-use benchmarks. The most informative results to inspect are the ablations: removing trace-conditioned RL, removing component-aware SFT, changing the annealing schedules, and removing prompt-only anchoring. The trace construction detail also matters, especially the exclusion of final answers to avoid answer leakage.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the objective for trace-conditioned RL, the component selection rule in component-aware SFT, the annealing schedules, and prompt-only anchoring. In the experiments, look for comparisons against pure RL, pure SFT, hint-conditioned rollout, and joint SFT-RL. The key question is where the expert trace enters the computation graph: it should affect optimization, not rollout generation.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 ablation 即可；把专家轨迹只放进优化器而不放进 rollout，是干净的后训练接口设计。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; using expert traces only in optimization, not rollout, is a clean post-training interface choice.

paper.title: STRIDE: Strategic Trajectory Reasoning via Discriminative Estimation for Verifiable Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become an effective post-training paradigm for improving the reasoning abilities of large language models. However, existing RLVR methods typically rely on final-answer correctness to assign trajectory-level rewards, providing sparse supervision and treating all tokens uniformly regardless of their actual contribution to reasoning. Although recent studies introduce intermediate signals such as process rewards, high-entropy tokens, and sem

summary.core_problem: 解决 RLVR 只用最终答案正确性给整条推理轨迹打分时，奖励稀疏且无法区分哪些局部推理模式真正有贡献的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是后训练方法创新：STRIDE 试图从可验证结果中反推出细粒度策略监督，避免依赖不可验证的过程奖励、高熵 token 或语义不确定性信号。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 STRIDE，即 Strategic Trajectory Reasoning via Discriminative Estimation。它在同一响应组内对比成功轨迹和失败轨迹，估计每个 n-gram 或局部推理片段对最终结果的 outcome-discriminative preference，再把这些细粒度偏好用于 RLVR 更新。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、任务集合、baseline 和提升幅度。可确认的实验关注点应是与普通最终答案 RLVR、过程奖励类方法、高熵 token 加权和语义不确定性信号比较推理能力提升。

summary_en.core_problem: STRIDE addresses the sparsity of RLVR when final-answer correctness assigns a single reward to an entire reasoning trajectory.
summary_en.importance: It is a post-training method contribution. The key idea is to derive fine-grained strategic supervision from verifiable outcomes, rather than relying on non-verifiable process rewards, entropy heuristics, or semantic uncertainty.
summary_en.technical_approach: STRIDE contrasts successful and failed trajectories within each response group and estimates outcome-discriminative preferences for local n-grams or reasoning fragments. These preferences are then used as fine-grained supervision in RLVR.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical improvements. The relevant comparisons would be against final-answer-only RLVR, process-reward variants, entropy-token methods, and uncertainty-based weighting.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 ablation 即可；若组内成功/失败对比干净，这类 verifiable token credit 值得复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; if the success-failure grouping is clean, verifiable token credit assignment is worth reproducing.

paper.title: Latent Thought Flow: Efficient Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on intermediate reasoning, yet explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) suffers from a linguistic space bottleneck: each thought must be decoded into tokens, causing high inference overhead. Latent reasoning moves deliberation into continuous space, but existing methods mostly learn deterministic or reward-maximizing paths, lacking a principled way to allocate probability across trajectories with different correctness and costs. We propose Latent Thought Flo

summary.core_problem: 把 LLM 的中间推理从显式 CoT token 序列迁移到连续潜变量轨迹中，以降低推理开销并更好分配计算。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练/推理范式创新：它不是继续优化文本 CoT，而是把 latent reasoning 建模为带质量-成本权衡的随机轨迹采样问题，对 test-time compute 和 reasoning supervision 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Latent Thought Flow，将推理过程表示为可变长度连续轨迹，并训练 sampler 去匹配由答案质量和计算成本共同诱导的 posterior；具体用 continuous GFlowNet 和随机 latent transition 实现。为缓解答案级监督稀疏，加入 Entropy-Weighted Subtrajectory Balance 作为中间奖励训练目标，并用 reference-prior regularizer 约束探索，避免 latent path 漂移过大。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明在 finetuning 和 transfer learning setting 下实验，但未披露模型参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 列表或具体提升幅度。需要重点检查实验是否控制了解码 token 数、latent steps、wall-clock latency 和最终正确率之间的 trade-off。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper moves intermediate reasoning from explicit Chain-of-Thought tokens into continuous latent trajectories to reduce inference overhead and allocate computation more flexibly.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training and reasoning-paradigm method: instead of optimizing textual CoT, it formulates latent reasoning as stochastic trajectory sampling under answer-quality and computation-cost rewards.
summary_en.technical_approach: Latent Thought Flow represents reasoning as variable-length continuous trajectories and trains a sampler to match a reward-induced posterior over correctness and cost. The implementation uses a continuous GFlowNet with stochastic latent transitions, an Entropy-Weighted Subtrajectory Balance objective for sparse answer supervision, and a reference-prior regularizer to keep exploration anchored.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments in fine-tuning and transfer-learning settings, but gives no model sizes, data scale, baseline list, or quantitative gains. The key checks are whether the paper controls for decoded token count, latent-step count, latency, and final accuracy under the same compute budget.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法目标和 compute-cost posterior 设定；若实验 latency 口径干净，可作为 latent reasoning 内部消融候选。
recommendation.en: Read the objective and the compute-cost posterior setup; if the latency accounting is clean, it is worth adding to internal latent-reasoning ablations.

paper.title: Localizing Credit at the Divergence: Path-Conditioned Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards assigns a single scalar to each rollout, leaving token-level credit assignment underspecified in long reasoning traces. On-policy self-distillation addresses this by letting the same model act as a teacher conditioned on privileged information, producing a dense per-token signal. But the common choice of a ground-truth answer is only an endpoint cue: on terse-answer tasks, the teacher falls silent at the intermediate positions where path-level guida

summary.core_problem: 解决 RLVR 在长推理轨迹中只有 rollout 级标量奖励、无法给中间 token 分配清晰 credit 的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练中的 credit assignment 方法创新。它针对 reasoning RL 的核心瓶颈：终点 reward 稀疏、answer-conditioned self-distillation 对中间路径帮助有限。对理解 RL 信号如何反哺推理行为有价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Hindsight Self-Distillation。教师模型不只条件化在 ground-truth answer 上，而是条件化在同一训练组中成功的 peer rollout 上。这个成功轨迹来自当前策略的 success-conditioned sample，不需要额外 rollout。失败轨迹与成功 peer 在路径上的 divergence position 成为主要监督位置，从而把 token-level signal 聚焦到真正分叉的地方。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到在 Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-32B 上、面向可验证推理任务进行实验，并与常见的 endpoint answer 条件化 self-distillation/RLVR 设置对比。给定摘要未提供完整任务名、训练 token 量、baseline 数值和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses token-level credit assignment in long reasoning traces when RLVR provides only a scalar reward per rollout.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training credit-assignment method. It targets a central weakness of reasoning RL: sparse endpoint rewards and answer-conditioned self-distillation that provides little guidance at intermediate reasoning steps.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Hindsight Self-Distillation. Instead of conditioning the teacher only on the ground-truth answer, the teacher is conditioned on a successful peer rollout from the same current training group. This peer is a success-conditioned sample from the current policy and requires no extra rollouts. The dense signal concentrates near the divergence point between a failed rollout and the successful peer trajectory.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments with Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B on verifiable reasoning tasks, comparing against common RLVR and endpoint-answer-conditioned self-distillation setups. The provided abstract does not include full task names, training budget, baseline numbers, or gains.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 divergence 分析；它把 RLVR 的 credit 从终点搬到分叉点，值得在内部数学 RL ablation 复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and divergence analysis; it moves RLVR credit from endpoints to path forks and is worth reproducing in internal math-RL ablations.

paper.title: How Post-Training Shapes Biological Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Scientific reasoning models for biology combine language models with foundation models trained on multimodal biological data, including DNA, RNA, and proteins. These models are built through post-training, yet how each stage shapes reasoning and generalization remains poorly understood. We study when post-training improves performance and when it induces over-specialization. Across genomics, transcriptomics, and proteins, we train and evaluate more than 100 biological reasoning models under cont

summary.core_problem: 生物科学推理模型通过CPT、SFT、RL多阶段后训练构建，但各阶段对推理能力与分布外泛化的具体影响机制缺乏系统对照研究。
summary.importance: 原理分析+大规模消融贡献，通过100+模型的受控变量实验，系统量化后训练三阶段对生物推理模型域内/域外性能的差异化影响。
summary.technical_approach: 控制骨干模型、后训练阶段（持续预训练CPT/监督微调SFT/强化学习RL）为变量，在基因组、转录组、蛋白质三个生物领域训练100+模型，同步测量域内与域外性能变化。
summary.experiments: 覆盖基因组/转录组/蛋白质三类任务；实验发现：CPT通过对齐生物语言提升下游性能；SFT稳定提升域内性能但域外性能先升后降，存在过拟合拐点；RL阶段的泛化影响随任务与设置变化。
summary.authors_note: 作者含Bryan Perozzi、Sham Kakade、Marinka Zitnik等知名研究者，来自Google DeepMind、哈佛大学、华盛顿大学等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: Biological scientific reasoning models are built via multi-stage post-training including CPT, SFT, and RL, but the specific impact of each stage on reasoning ability and out-of-distribution generalization lacks systematic controlled study.
summary_en.importance: Mechanistic analysis and large-scale ablation contribution: systematically quantifies the differential impacts of three post-training stages on in-domain and out-of-domain performance via controlled experiments on 100+ models across three biological domains.
summary_en.technical_approach: Backbone models and post-training stages (continued pretraining / supervised fine-tuning / reinforcement learning) are treated as controlled variables; over 100 models are trained across genomics, transcriptomics, and proteins, with both in-domain and out-of-domain performance measured.
summary_en.experiments: Covering genomics, transcriptomics, and protein tasks; key findings: CPT improves downstream performance by aligning models with biological language; SFT consistently boosts in-domain performance but OOD performance peaks early then declines, showing an overfitting inflection point; RL's generalization impact varies across tasks and setups.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include well-known researchers such as Bryan Perozzi, Sham Kakade, and Marinka Zitnik, affiliated with Google DeepMind, Harvard University, University of Washington, and other institutions.

recommendation.zh: SFT域外性能先升后降的拐点结论对通用LLM后训练配比有直接参考，重点看§4.2 SFT阶段的性能曲线与数据量消融。
recommendation.en: The finding that SFT OOD performance rises then falls has direct implications for general LLM post-training data budgeting; focus on §4.2 SFT performance curves and data size ablations.

paper.title: VibeThinker-3B: Exploring the Frontier of Verifiable Reasoning in Small Language Models
paper.abstract: This technical report introduces VibeThinker-3B, a compact dense model with 3B parameters developed to investigate how far verifiable reasoning can be pushed within a strictly small-model regime. Building upon the Spectrum-to-Signal post-training paradigm, we systematically enhance the model through an optimized pipeline that includes curriculum-based supervised fine-tuning, multi-domain reinforcement learning, and offline self-distillation. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that VibeThinker-

summary.core_problem: 探索3B参数级小语言模型在可验证推理任务上的性能上限，缩小与大模型的推理能力差距
summary.importance: 工程突破+方法创新，提出面向小模型的可验证推理后训练流水线，在小模型regime下达到一线推理系统的性能水平
summary.technical_approach: 基于Spectrum-to-Signal后训练范式，组合课程式SFT、多域RL、离线自蒸馏三个阶段的优化，针对数学、代码等可验证推理任务做专项增强
summary.experiments: 3B稠密模型，AIME26得分94.3（测试时缩放后97.1），LiveCodeBench v6 Pass@1 80.2，未见过的LeetCode竞赛接受率96.1%，追平远超其规模的旗舰推理模型
summary.authors_note: 新浪微博 Inc 团队，无公开知名作者

summary_en.core_problem: Explore the performance upper bound of 3B-parameter small language models on verifiable reasoning tasks, narrowing the gap with large models
summary_en.importance: Engineering breakthrough + methodological innovation; proposes a post-training pipeline for small-model verifiable reasoning, achieving top-tier performance in the small-model regime
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on the Spectrum-to-Signal post-training paradigm, combines curriculum SFT, multi-domain RL, and offline self-distillation for targeted enhancement of math/code verifiable reasoning tasks
summary_en.experiments: 3B dense model achieves 94.3 on AIME26 (97.1 with test-time scaling), 80.2 Pass@1 on LiveCodeBench v6, 96.1% acceptance rate on unseen LeetCode contests, matching flagship models orders of magnitude larger
summary_en.authors_note: Sina Weibo Inc, no publicly well-known researchers identified

recommendation.zh: 小模型推理后训练的完整可复现recipe，§3的训练阶段配置、数据配比和测试时缩放trick值得在内部小模型ablation中参考
recommendation.en: Reproducible end-to-end post-training pipeline for small-model reasoning; §3 stage configs, data mixture, and test-time scaling trick are worth referencing in internal small-model ablations

paper.title: GD$^2$PO: Mitigating Multi-Reward Conflicts via Group-Dynamic reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: As LLMs advance, post-training reinforcement learning (RL) increasingly relies on multi-dimensional rewards to cultivate comprehensive capabilities. This shift demands new algorithms capable of optimizing diverse and potentially competing objectives simultaneously. To address this, existing methods such as Group reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization (GDPO) decompose the overall score into independent reward groups, then compute the RL loss separately within each group. However, this strategy stil

summary.core_problem: LLM多奖励后训练RL中，单条rollout在不同奖励维度的正负优势信号相互抵消，导致GDPO等分组解耦方法训练效率低下
summary.importance: 方法创新，结合分组解耦与动态采样思路，解决多奖励信号冲突问题，提升RL后训练效率
summary.technical_approach: 在GDPO分组解耦计算各奖励组独立损失的基础上，借鉴DAPO动态采样策略，过滤各奖励组内近零优势的无效rollout，避免正负信号抵消，提出GD²PO算法
summary.experiments: 完整实验设置与效果数据未在摘要中披露，需补充多奖励基准上的训练效率与性能提升验证

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-reward LLM post-training RL, positive and negative advantages of a single rollout across reward dimensions cancel each other out, reducing training efficiency of group-decoupled methods like GDPO
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation combining group decoupling and dynamic sampling to resolve multi-reward signal conflicts and improve RL post-training efficiency
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds on GDPO's group-wise independent reward loss computation, adopts DAPO's dynamic sampling strategy to filter ineffective rollouts with near-zero advantages per reward group, eliminating signal cancellation to form GD²PO
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental setup and results not disclosed in abstract; validation on multi-reward benchmarks for efficiency and performance gains is pending

recommendation.zh: 多奖励冲突是RLHF后期常见问题，重点看§3.2无效rollout过滤规则，可作为内部多目标RL的baseline补充
recommendation.en: Multi-reward conflict is a common late-stage RLHF issue; focus on §3.2 ineffective rollout filtering rule, can be added as a baseline for internal multi-objective RL

paper.title: VideoWeave: Unlocking Geometric Consistency in Video Generation via Joint Geometry-Video Modeling
paper.abstract: Large-scale video diffusion models often fail to preserve 3D structure over time, causing geometric drift and implausible motion under viewpoint changes. Existing methods usually enforce geometric consistency by using explicit geometry reconstructions, such as depth maps, point clouds, or reconstructed 3D structures, to define conditions, supervision, or reward signals, making the generator sensitive to errors from upstream geometry pipelines. We propose VideoWeave, a latent-space post-training

summary.core_problem: 缓解大规模视频扩散模型在视角变化和运动生成中出现的 3D 结构漂移与几何不一致问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是视频生成后训练与几何约束建模方法，并构建 GeoVid-80K 数据集。它不直接服务 LLM 预训练，但对统一视频生成、隐式几何表征和生成模型 post-training 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VideoWeave，在 latent space 中把几何模型的隐式特征适配为 geometry latents，并与 video latents 放入共享 denoising space 联合建模。相比显式深度图、点云或 3D 重建监督，它试图用更柔性的几何特征约束生成分布，降低上游几何重建误差的影响。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到构建 GeoVid-80K，包含 8 万视频数据；未给出 backbone、训练规模、baseline、指标和提升幅度。实验预计围绕几何一致性、视频质量和视角变化鲁棒性展开。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce 3D structural drift and geometric inconsistency in large-scale video diffusion models, especially under viewpoint changes and complex motion.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a video-generation post-training method with geometry-aware modeling, plus the GeoVid-80K dataset. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to unified video generation, implicit geometric representations, and generative post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: VideoWeave adapts implicit features from geometry models into geometry latents and jointly models them with video latents in a shared denoising space. Instead of relying on explicit depth maps, point clouds, or reconstructed 3D structures, it uses softer geometry features to constrain the generative distribution and reduce sensitivity to upstream reconstruction errors.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports GeoVid-80K, an 80K-video dataset. It does not specify the backbone, training scale, baselines, metrics, or numerical gains. The evaluation likely focuses on geometric consistency, video quality, and robustness to viewpoint changes.

recommendation.zh: 值得知道它把隐式几何特征并入 denoising latent；若做视频原生预训练，看方法图和数据构造即可。
recommendation.en: Worth noting for injecting implicit geometry into denoising latents; if you work on native video pretraining, skim the method diagram and data construction.

paper.title: OdysSim: Building Foundation Models for Human Behavior Simulation
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as human simulators for interactive evaluation and social simulation. Yet helpfulness-driven post-training pulls them toward a homogeneous, overly agreeable assistant register, creating a behavioral Sim2Real gap. We present OdysSim, the largest open systematic investigation of behavioral foundation models, i.e., models trained to simulate human behavior at scale. We propose SOUL, a taxonomy of five capability axes (CONV, SS, COG, ROLE, EVAL) that u

summary.core_problem: 解决通用助手型 LLM 被 helpfulness 后训练拉向同质、迎合式回答后，难以可靠模拟真实人类行为的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是面向行为模拟的模型训练资产与训练流程：统一 62 个数据集、23 个任务，构建 10B token 级 OdysSim 语料和 SOUL-Index，并训练开放 8B OSim 模型。对预训练研究员的价值在于，它把“模拟人”从 prompt engineering 推到数据混合、midtraining、RL 和蒸馏的系统问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SOUL 能力框架，将行为模拟拆成 CONV、SS、COG、ROLE、EVAL 五类能力；把多源交互数据改造成带回生成社会语境的 OdysSim 语料；训练流程结合 midtraining、任务特定 RL 和专家蒸馏，使模型从助手式偏好转向角色化、社会化和认知行为模拟。
summary.experiments: 语料规模为 21.4M interactions、约 10B tokens；评测覆盖 SOUL-Index 的 23 个 benchmark tasks。开放 8B OSim 模型在 23 个任务中有 8 个排名第一或并列第一，按该计数超过任一单个 frontier model，主要增益来自对话和社会行为相关任务。摘要未给出完整 baseline 列表、训练 compute 和各任务绝对分数。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Maarten Sap、Tongshuang Wu、Yiming Yang 等，团队长期做社会语言学、NLP 评测和人类行为建模相关工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the Sim2Real gap that appears when helpfulness-trained assistant LLMs are used as human behavior simulators.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a training asset and recipe for behavioral foundation models: a unified taxonomy over 62 datasets and 23 tasks, a 10B-token OdysSim corpus, the SOUL-Index benchmark, and an open 8B OSim model. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is treating human simulation as a data-mixture and post-training target rather than a prompting trick.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define the SOUL framework with five axes: conversation, social simulation, cognition, role behavior, and evaluation. They retrofit interaction data with back-generated social contexts and train with a pipeline combining midtraining, task-specific RL, and expert distillation to move the model away from generic assistant behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The corpus contains 21.4M interactions and roughly 10B tokens. Evaluation uses 23 SOUL-Index tasks. The open 8B OSim model ranks first or tied first on 8 of 23 tasks, outperforming any single frontier model by that count, with strongest gains on conversational and social-behavior tasks. The abstract does not specify full baselines, compute budget, or per-task scores.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Maarten Sap, Tongshuang Wu, and Yiming Yang, who are known for work in social NLP, NLP evaluation, and human-centered language modeling.

recommendation.zh: 值得看数据组织和 RL recipe，但目标很窄；只读 §数据混合、SOUL 任务定义和 RL 消融即可。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the data organization and RL recipe, but the target is narrow; focus on the mixture design, SOUL task definitions, and RL ablations.

paper.title: Be My Tutor: On-Policy Co-Distillation for Mutual LLM Improvement via Peer Feedback
paper.abstract: We study multi-domain LLM training in which two models, each stronger in a different domain, co-evolve by tutoring each other through on-policy feedback. Unlike one-way distillation or single-model fine-tuning, our goal is mutual Pareto improvement: each model improves across domains without losing its original strength. To this end, we propose On-Policy Co-Distillation (OPCoD), where each student's self-distillation is conditioned on its own correct rollout and feedback from its peer. To make f

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是多领域训练里的负迁移问题：两个模型各自在不同领域更强，怎样通过互相提供反馈，让双方都扩展能力边界，同时不丢掉原有强项。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是核心推进，更接近 post-train / distillation 范畴，但有一个值得注意的启发：多源能力整合不一定只能靠静态混合数据，也可以靠 on-policy、双向、带选择机制的训练信号交换。对研究 continual pretrain、跨域配比、teacher-free distillation 的人，有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 OPCoD。框架上是两个学生模型并行训练，每个模型都做 on-policy self-distillation，但它的 self-teacher 不只看自己的正确 rollout，还会接收来自对方模型的自然语言反馈。这样两个蒸馏过程被耦合起来，训练中相互影响。为避免弱模型乱教，作者加入 cognizance-based gating，根据 tutor 在当前领域的胜任度决定是否给反馈；为减少空泛或幻觉式评论，又加入 feedback anchoring，把反馈绑定到具体题目和解题过程。目标不是单向蒸馏后的单模型提升，而是让两个模型都实现 Pareto improvement：跨域变强，同时保住原有优势。
summary.experiments: 实验主要在 Science Q&A 场景，用 SciKnowEval 上的不同领域组合，如 physics–chemistry、chemistry–materials。论文声称 OPCoD 相比基线更稳定地实现双边 Pareto improvement。消融重点放在两个模块：gating 能减少不可靠反馈污染正确 rollout，anchoring 能降低幻觉反馈。结果更像是证明“反馈质量控制”对双向蒸馏很关键，而不是单纯证明多一个 peer 就会更好。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。先看方法图和训练目标，理解它和普通 self-distillation、teacher-student distillation 的差别；再看主结果表，确认是否真的实现了双方都不退化；最后看消融，重点是 gating 和 anchoring 是否各自带来稳定收益。预计 20–30 分钟能抓住主要内容。如果你主要做基座预训练，这篇不必深挖实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies negative transfer in multi-domain training: when two models are each stronger in different domains, can they improve each other through peer feedback without sacrificing their original strengths?
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper; it sits closer to post-training and distillation. Still, it offers one useful idea for foundation-model training: capability integration across domains does not have to rely only on static data mixing. It can also be driven by on-policy, bidirectional, selectively filtered training signals. That makes it mildly relevant for continual pretraining, cross-domain adaptation, and teacher-free distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, OPCoD, trains two student models jointly. Each model performs on-policy self-distillation, but its self-teacher is conditioned not only on its own verified correct rollout, but also on natural-language feedback from the peer model. This couples the two training processes so that each model’s updates affect the other through the feedback channel. To reduce harmful tutoring, the paper introduces cognizance-based gating, which decides whether a model should provide feedback based on its competence in the relevant domain. To reduce vague or hallucinated feedback, it adds feedback anchoring, grounding the feedback in the specific problem and reasoning context. The target is mutual Pareto improvement rather than one-way transfer.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on science QA tasks using SciKnowEval, with domain pairs such as physics–chemistry and chemistry–materials. The main claim is that OPCoD more consistently achieves mutual Pareto improvement than the baselines. The ablations are the most informative part: gating helps prevent unreliable peer feedback from corrupting otherwise correct rollouts, and anchoring reduces hallucinated or unhelpful feedback. The empirical message is less about peer interaction by itself and more about the need to control feedback quality in bidirectional distillation.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough. Start with the method overview and objective to see how this differs from standard self-distillation and teacher-student distillation. Then check the main tables to verify whether both models actually improve without regression. Finally, read the ablations, especially the effects of gating and anchoring. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas. If your focus is core pretraining, there is little need to go deep into implementation details.

recommendation.zh: 多模型互学习的后训练新范式，认知门控和反馈锚定的设计对做对齐或多领域训练的研究员有参考，重点看§3的方法细节和帕累托评估逻辑。
recommendation.en: Novel post-training paradigm for multi-model mutual learning; cognizance gating and feedback anchoring are worth checking for alignment or multi-domain training researchers, see §3 for details.

paper.title: LoMC: Localized Multidirectional Correction for Refusal Suppression in Routed Foundation Models
paper.abstract: We study controlled post-training refusal suppression in routed MoE and hybrid-MoE foundation models, aiming to increase non-refusal target-response behavior while preserving general capability under a compact intervention footprint. Existing broad direction-based edits can perturb general-purpose computation, whereas support-only expert edits often lack sufficient capacity to correct heterogeneous refusal representations. To address this limitation, we introduce Localized Multidirectional Corre

summary.core_problem: 论文研究 routed MoE 和 hybrid-MoE foundation model 中的拒答抑制编辑：在较小干预 footprint 下，提高 harmful prompt 上的非拒答比例 TCR，同时尽量保持通用能力 GCA。这里的 TCR 是 refusal rate 的补集，不等同于经过 judge 验证的 harmful compliance。
summary.importance: 这篇论文与基座预训练的关系偏间接，主要价值在 routed 模型的 post-training 可编辑性分析。它讨论了一个 MoE 特有问题：拒答相关表示可能分布在 residual 表示和 routed expert/component 中。粗粒度 direction edit 容易影响通用计算，只选 expert support 又可能校正不足。这个视角对 MoE 安全行为、专家路由与对齐信号耦合的机制研究有参考价值，但它不是预训练 recipe 或数据方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Localized Multidirectional Correction，简称 LoMC。核心是 support-gated correction，并严格采用 support-then-correction 的执行顺序。第一阶段在原 checkpoint 上选择 edit support，也就是允许修改的 layer、expert 和 component 位置；文中把可编辑 MoE component 设为 normalized gate/up interface 和 moe.down_proj branch。第二阶段重新加载原 checkpoint 和固定 support，在这些 fixed-support layer 上聚合多个 prototype correction direction，得到 layer-wise correction direction。最终部署时仍然是 rank-one layer-wise correction，并且只通过 support mask 生效。这样做的取舍是：用多个 prototype 提高 correction signal 的表达能力，但不增加独立 update operator，也不扩大 support footprint。
summary.experiments: 论文在 text-only 和 multimodal safety benchmark 上评估，并覆盖四个 routed backbone。指标包括 harmful prompt 上的 TCR、通用能力平均分 GCA、干预 footprint，以及 search-time benign drift 诊断；文中还使用原模型与编辑后模型预测分布之间的差异作为漂移诊断。结果报告 LoMC 在 TCR 与 GCA 的权衡上优于更宽泛的 direction edit 和只做 support selection 的方案。消融实验主要隔离两个因素：edit-support size 和 prototype direction count。给出的全文片段没有包含完整数值表，因此不补写具体提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 TCR 的定义，避免把非拒答率误读成 harmful compliance。再看 Method 的两阶段流程：support selection 如何定义可编辑位置，multi-prototype direction aggregation 如何在固定 support 内产生 rank-one correction。实验部分优先看 TCR-GCA trade-off、footprint 指标和两个消融：support size 与 prototype count。若只关心预训练，可跳过具体安全 benchmark 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies refusal suppression for routed MoE and hybrid-MoE foundation models. The goal is to increase Target Compliance Rate, defined as the complement of refusal rate, while preserving a General Capability Average under a compact intervention footprint. The metric should not be read as judge-verified harmful compliance; it measures whether the response is classified as a refusal.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to pretraining research is indirect but nontrivial for routed models. The paper treats refusal behavior as something that can be distributed across residual representations and routed components. Broad direction edits may disturb general computation, while support-only expert edits may not be expressive enough. This framing is useful for studying how safety behavior interacts with MoE routing, expert specialization, and post-training edits, although the paper is not a pretraining method or data recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: LoMC, or Localized Multidirectional Correction, is a support-gated editing method. It first selects an edit support: the set of layers, experts, and component locations where intervention is allowed. The editable MoE components include a normalized gate/up interface and the moe.down_proj branch. The method then reloads the original checkpoint with the fixed support and aggregates several prototype correction directions into a layer-wise correction direction. The deployed edit is still a rank-one layer-wise correction and is applied only through the support mask. The design tries to improve the correction signal through multiple prototypes without expanding the structural footprint of the intervention.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers text-only and multimodal safety benchmarks and four routed backbones. The main metrics are TCR, GCA, intervention footprint, and benign-behavior drift diagnostics, including distributional change between the original and edited models. The reported result is an improved TCR-GCA trade-off under a compact footprint compared with broader direction edits and support-only alternatives. The ablations focus on support size and the number of prototype directions. The provided full-content excerpt does not include the numerical result tables, so exact gains should be checked in the experimental section of the paper.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient for most pretraining researchers. Spend about 20 to 30 minutes on the problem formulation, the TCR definition, and the two-stage method. The most useful parts are the support-then-correction execution order, the support mask definition over routed components, and the ablations on support size and prototype count. The benchmark-specific safety details can be skipped unless the reader is working on MoE alignment or model editing.

recommendation.zh: MoE后训练对齐的精细方案，对pretrain研究员的启示在于MoE的稀疏激活结构允许更精准的能力编辑，看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: A fine-grained MoE post-training alignment approach. Key takeaway for pretrain researchers: MoE's sparse activation structure enables more precise capability editing. Read the method section only.

paper.title: When to Write and When to Suppress: Route-Specialized Dual Adapters for Memory-Assisted Knowledge Editing
paper.abstract: Knowledge editing systems must update selected facts while preserving nearby but irrelevant behavior. This paper studies this problem in a memory-assisted setting where an edit memory is retrieved at inference time and a parameter-efficient adapter corrects the model's object preference. We argue that the central design question is not only how to write an edit, but also when to suppress it. We introduce \method{}, a route-specialized dual-adapter editor. A relevance router first decides whether

summary.core_problem: 记忆辅助的知识编辑既要写入新事实，又要在无关或邻近提示上抑制错误编辑、保持原有行为，现有方法难以同时兼顾。
summary.importance: 参数高效知识编辑方法的增量改进，核心贡献是引入“何时抑制编辑”的路由机制，属于后训练/模型编辑方向的常规工作。
summary.technical_approach: 提出路由专用双适配器框架：先用相关性路由器判断 prompt 是否应触发编辑记忆；被路由到编辑分支的 prompt 用 edit adapter 训练为偏好新对象，未被路由的非直接提示用独立的 locality adapter 恢复/保持原对象偏好；整体在记忆辅助设定下训练。
summary.experiments: 在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 与另一 7B 基座上，使用统一记忆协议在 CounterFact、ZSRE、MQuake 三个各 1000 条的协议上评测；在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上取得整体概率-偏好准确率最优。

summary_en.core_problem: Memory-assisted knowledge editing must both inject new facts and suppress spurious edits on nearby but irrelevant prompts while preserving original behavior, a tradeoff existing methods fail to balance.
summary_en.importance: Incremental improvement in parameter-efficient knowledge editing; core contribution is a routing mechanism that decides 'when to suppress edits', a routine contribution in post-training / model editing.
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose a route-specialized dual-adapter framework: a relevance router first decides whether a prompt should trigger the edit memory; routed prompts use an edit adapter trained to prefer the new object, while unrouted non-direct prompts use a separate locality adapter trained to preserve / restore the original-object preference; trained end-to-end under the memory-assisted protocol.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and another 7B base model under a unified memory protocol across three 1,000-case benchmarks (CounterFact, ZSRE, MQuake); achieves the best overall probability-preference accuracy on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct.

recommendation.zh: 知识编辑的常规增量改进，路由+双适配器的思路可作为后训练侧小 ablation 参考，看摘要和实验表即可。
recommendation.en: Routine incremental improvement in knowledge editing; the router-plus-dual-adapters idea may inform small post-training ablations, read only the abstract and result tables.

paper.title: Muse Spark Safety & Preparedness Report
paper.abstract: Muse Spark is the latest large language model developed by Meta. In this report, we first present evaluations for catastrophic risk domains under Meta's Advanced AI Scaling Framework, along with the evidence that informed our launch decision. We then discuss additional considerations, such as Muse Spark's broader content safety and behavioral profile, that are relevant to overall safety but fall outside the catastrophic risk domains governed by the Framework. Our preparedness results covering Ch

summary.core_problem: 系统评估 Meta 新模型 Muse Spark 在化生、网络安全和失控等灾难性风险维度上的能力，并说明缓解措施后是否达到可部署阈值。
summary.importance: 这是顶级实验室的安全与 preparedness 报告。它不直接推进预训练算法，但对能力评估、风险分级、mitigation 前后能力变化，以及 post-train 如何改变危险能力边界，都有现实参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 报告基于 Meta 的 Advanced AI Scaling Framework，对 Muse Spark 在多个高风险域进行能力评估，区分 mitigation 前后的风险水平，并结合 broader content safety 与行为画像给出发布决策依据。方法上更接近系统化 risk eval protocol，而非新训练算法。
summary.experiments: 摘要披露其覆盖 Chemical and Biological、Cybersecurity、Loss of Control 等风险域，并指出模型在缓解前已出现 elevated risk，其中化生能力可能达到框架中的 high risk 档位；在部署到 Meta AI 的设定下，经缓解后 residual risk 被评为可接受。未在摘要中给出参数量、训练 token 或具体 benchmark 数值。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 Meta。Dan Hendrycks 未在此文作者中；作者名单包含 Meta 安全与 preparedness 团队成员。作为 Meta 模型发布配套报告，代表的是大厂内部风险门控与部署流程。

summary_en.core_problem: The report evaluates Meta's Muse Spark on catastrophic-risk domains such as CBRN, cybersecurity, and loss of control, and asks whether mitigations reduce risk to a deployable level.
summary_en.importance: This is a top-lab preparedness report. It does not advance pretraining algorithms directly, but it is useful for understanding capability evaluation, risk tiering, and how post-training mitigations shift dangerous capability boundaries.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using Meta's Advanced AI Scaling Framework, the report assesses Muse Spark across multiple high-risk domains, distinguishes pre- and post-mitigation risk levels, and combines those findings with broader safety/behavioral profiling to support a launch decision. The contribution is a structured risk-evaluation protocol rather than a new training method.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states coverage of Chemical and Biological, Cybersecurity, and Loss of Control risks. It reports elevated pre-mitigation risks, with CBRN capabilities likely reaching the framework's 'high risk' category, while residual risk after mitigations is judged acceptable for deployment in Meta AI. No parameter count, training tokens, or detailed benchmark numbers are given in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The institution is Meta. The author list appears to be from Meta's safety and preparedness teams. As a release-side report, it reflects a large-lab internal gating and deployment process.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但顶级实验室怎样把能力评估接到发布门控上，这件事值得看；重点读风险分级标准和 mitigation 前后能力漂移，别只看结论页。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it is worth reading for how a top lab operationalizes capability eval into launch gating; focus on the risk tiers and pre/post-mitigation capability shifts, not the press-release conclusion.

paper.title: ReSum: Synergizing LLM Reasoning and Summarization with Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is a central technique for improving long-horizon reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs). However, existing RLVR methods often encourage unnecessarily long reasoning rollouts, which can degrade reasoning coherence and exhaust the available context budget. Existing approaches to long-context organization often depend on external mechanisms to organize rollouts, rather than enabling the model to manage its own reasoning trajectory. To addres

summary.core_problem: 解决 RLVR 训练长链推理时 rollout 过长、上下文预算被耗尽、错误前缀持续污染后续推理的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是后训练方法创新：把推理过程中的自我摘要显式纳入 RLVR，让模型学习压缩和组织自己的推理轨迹。它对预训练研究的价值在于提供了一个信号：长程推理不只需要更多上下文，也需要可训练的状态压缩机制。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ReSum 框架。先通过 pilot study 观察到自我摘要会降低 token-level entropy，并且插入 summarization phrase 可缓解错误前缀传播；随后设计 summarization-aware adaptive rollout，用对比式机制鼓励模型在合适时机生成摘要、压缩中间轨迹，并继续完成可验证奖励任务。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明方法面向 RLVR 长程推理，并报告 pilot study 中自我摘要降低生成熵、缓解错误传播。给出的片段未包含模型规模、训练数据、任务集合、baseline 或最终提升幅度，需要读实验章节确认结论强度。
summary.authors_note: 标注信息显示该工作来自 Cohere。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses overly long RLVR reasoning rollouts, context-budget exhaustion, and error propagation from incorrect reasoning prefixes.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training method: it makes self-summarization part of the RLVR process so that the model learns to compress and organize its own reasoning trajectory. For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is that long-horizon reasoning may require trainable state compression, not only longer context windows.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReSum starts from pilot findings that self-summarization reduces token-level entropy and that adding a summarization phrase can mitigate errors inherited from a wrong prefix. It then introduces a summarization-aware adaptive rollout mechanism that contrastively encourages the model to summarize intermediate reasoning at useful points and continue solving verifiable tasks.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports pilot evidence on entropy reduction and mitigation of prefix-error propagation under RLVR. The provided text does not include model size, data scale, baselines, or final performance numbers, so the empirical strength depends on the full experimental section.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper is marked as a Cohere work.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 pilot study 和 rollout 设计；若结果干净，应在内部 RLVR 中复现“摘要作为状态压缩”的 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the pilot study and rollout design; if the setup is clean, reproduce the “summary as state compression” ablation in an internal RLVR stack.

paper.title: Rubric-Guided Self-Distillation: Post-Training Without Rubric Verifiers
paper.abstract: Rubrics have emerged as an alternative to RLVR in open-ended domains where a single ground-truth final answer is not available. Existing rubric-based training methods rely on an LLM verifier that scores each rollout against rubrics. This introduces substantial training-time overhead, exposes optimization to verifier-specific biases, and reduces rubric feedback to a sparse end-of-trajectory signal. We propose Rubric-Guided Self-Distillation (RGSD), a verifier-free training method in which the bas

summary.core_problem: 在开放式任务没有单一标准答案时，如何利用 rubric 做后训练，同时避免训练时依赖 LLM verifier。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练方法创新。它把 rubric feedback 从轨迹级稀疏奖励改成 token 级蒸馏信号，并移除训练循环中的 judge，直接触及 RLVR/RLHF 的训练信号质量、成本和 verifier bias 问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Rubric-Guided Self-Distillation。训练时用同一个 base policy 在 rubric 条件下生成 teacher distribution，再把该分布逐 token 蒸馏到不带 rubric 条件的 student。这样 rubric-conditioned policy 提供密集监督，替代 judge-based GRPO 中每条 rollout 末端的 verifier 打分。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen-2.5 3B、7B 和 Qwen3-Thinking 4B、8B，在 medical 与 science 开放式任务上比较 rubric satisfaction。摘要称 RGSD 达到与 judge-based GRPO 相当的 rubric 满足度，并减少训练时 verifier 调用；具体绝对分数和成本比例在给定摘要中未完整披露。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to use rubrics for post-training in open-ended domains without relying on an LLM verifier during training.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training method. It converts sparse trajectory-level rubric rewards into dense token-level distillation signals and removes the judge from the training loop, directly addressing verifier cost, bias, and reward-signal sparsity.
summary_en.technical_approach: Rubric-Guided Self-Distillation uses the base policy conditioned on the rubric as a teacher and distills its token-level distribution into an unconditioned student. This replaces end-of-trajectory verifier scoring used in judge-based GRPO with dense per-token supervision from the rubric-conditioned policy.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen-2.5 3B and 7B, plus Qwen3-Thinking 4B and 8B, on medical and science domains. The abstract reports rubric satisfaction comparable to judge-based GRPO while avoiding verifier calls during training. Exact scores and cost ratios are not fully available in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和对 GRPO 的成本对比；它像是把 rubric 当条件化数据增强，结论可用但要警惕 teacher 自洽偏差。
recommendation.en: Read the method and the GRPO cost comparison; it is close to rubric-conditioned data augmentation, useful but exposed to teacher self-consistency bias.

paper.title: Dense Supervision, Sparse Updates: On the Sparsity and Geometry of On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (\textsc{OPD}) has recently become a prominent post-training recipe as it combines two desirable ingredients: on-policy student trajectories and dense teacher supervision, yet how this hybrid changes a model's parameters remains unclear. Across several language and vision-language model pairs and use cases, our analysis yields two main findings. On sparsity, \textsc{OPD}-style updates are small and coordinate-sparse. They are distributed across layers and are usually FFN-h

summary.core_problem: 分析 on-policy distillation 在后训练中到底如何改变模型参数，尤其是更新的稀疏性、层分布、谱结构和优化器需求。
summary.importance: 贡献是后训练机制分析。它不提出新的预训练范式，但直接触及 LLM/VLM post-train 的参数更新结构，对理解 SFT、蒸馏、RL 前后的权重变化有参考价值，尤其是“dense supervision 但 sparse update”的现象。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在多个语言模型和视觉语言模型配对上研究 OPD-style training。方法上比较完整 OPD 更新与被发现的稀疏子网络更新，分析坐标稀疏性、层内分布、FFN/attention 占比、更新矩阵秩与谱集中性，并做 SGD 与 AdamW 的优化器消融。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模和数据量。报告的主要结果包括：OPD 更新幅度小且坐标稀疏，跨层分布但通常 FFN-heavy；只训练发现的子网络几乎恢复 full OPD 性能；更新数值上 full-rank 但谱集中；尽管更新稀疏，带稀疏诱导倾向的 SGD 低于 AdamW，作者将其归因于 dense teacher supervision 保留了异质的坐标级梯度尺度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how on-policy distillation changes model parameters, focusing on sparsity, layer distribution, spectral geometry, and optimizer behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training analysis rather than a pretraining method. Its value for LLM researchers is that it characterizes the weight-update structure induced by dense teacher supervision on on-policy student trajectories, a setting close to modern distillation and RL-style post-training recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors analyze OPD-style training across several language and vision-language model pairs. They compare full OPD against training only a discovered sparse subnetwork, measure coordinate sparsity, layer and module allocation, FFN versus attention concentration, rank and spectrum of updates, and run optimizer ablations between SGD and AdamW.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes or dataset scale. The reported findings are that OPD updates are small and coordinate-sparse, distributed across layers and usually FFN-heavy; training only the discovered subnetwork nearly recovers full OPD performance; updates are numerically full-rank but spectrally concentrated; AdamW outperforms sparsity-inducing SGD because dense teacher supervision keeps heterogeneous coordinate-wise gradient scales.

recommendation.zh: 只看稀疏子网络实验和优化器消融；它给 post-train 更新结构一个可操作诊断。
recommendation.en: Skim the sparse-subnetwork and optimizer ablations; they give a practical diagnostic for post-training update structure.

paper.title: Iterative Visual Thinking: Teaching Vision-Language Models Spatial Self-Correction through Visual Feedback
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong singleshot spatial grounding, yet lack any mechanism to observe and correct their own predictions. We find that naively prompting a VLM to iterate over rendered visualizations of its predictions causes catastrophic failure: Acc@0.5 on referring expression comprehension collapses from 79.6% to 48.7% (a 31 percentage point drop), revealing a fundamental gap between grounding capability and self-correction ability. We propose Iterative Visual Thinking (I

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 虽能一次性做空间定位，但缺乏基于自身可视化预测结果进行迭代纠错能力的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于后训练与闭环自纠错训练：先指出一个明确 failure mode，再用合成监督轨迹和 RL 让模型学会利用视觉反馈修正框位置。这对“模型能否消费自身中间输出作为训练信号”有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Iterative Visual Thinking。先让基础模型输出框，再把框渲染回图像作为视觉反馈输入；作者发现直接这样做会严重退化。为此采用两阶段训练：第一阶段用基础模型自己的错误预测构造 realistic error，再让 teacher VLM 生成纠错 reasoning trace，形成监督数据；第二阶段用基于 IoU 奖励的 GRPO 做强化学习，优化多轮修正策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出在 referring expression comprehension 上，naive iteration 会使 Acc@0.5 从 79.6% 降到 48.7%，说明自纠错能力并非自然涌现。IVT 在该设定下恢复并提升性能。摘要未给出完整模型规模、训练数据量和全部 baseline 细节，因此结论更适合作为现象和 recipe 参考，而非强 prior 更新。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a gap in VLMs: they can often localize in one shot, but cannot reliably use visualized predictions as feedback for iterative self-correction.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and closed-loop self-correction paper. Its value lies in exposing a clear failure mode and showing that synthetic corrective traces plus RL can teach a model to consume its own visual feedback.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Iterative Visual Thinking (IVT): the model predicts a box, sees that box rendered on the image, and refines iteratively. Naive prompting fails badly, so the authors use a two-stage recipe: first generate realistic errors from the base model’s own predictions and ask a teacher VLM to produce corrective reasoning traces; then apply GRPO with an IoU-based reward to optimize iterative refinement.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that naive iteration drops Acc@0.5 on referring expression comprehension from 79.6% to 48.7%, showing that self-correction is not emergent. IVT closes this gap and improves performance, though the abstract does not provide enough detail on model scale, training data volume, or full baselines to treat the result as a strong prior update.

recommendation.zh: 可读点不在结果，而在 failure case：模型会看不懂自己画出的框；只看摘要和训练 recipe，别把数值当强证据。
recommendation.en: The useful part is the failure mode, not the headline result: VLMs often cannot interpret their own rendered predictions; read the training recipe, not the leaderboard.

paper.title: Rubric-Guided Self-Distillation: Post-Training Without Rubric Verifiers
paper.abstract: Rubrics have emerged as an alternative to RLVR in open-ended domains where a single ground-truth final answer is not available. Existing rubric-based training methods rely on an LLM verifier that scores each rollout against rubrics. This introduces substantial training-time overhead, exposes optimization to verifier-specific biases, and reduces rubric feedback to a sparse end-of-trajectory signal. We propose Rubric-Guided Self-Distillation (RGSD), a verifier-free training method in which the bas

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是开放式任务里的一个具体瓶颈：当任务没有唯一标准答案时，后训练通常要把每个 prompt 配一套 rubric，再用外部 LLM judge 给整段回答打分，然后用 RL 去优化。问题不在于 rubric 本身，而在于“rubric + verifier + trajectory-level scalar reward”这条训练链路代价高、反馈稀疏、而且容易把 judge 的偏好和盲点一并学进去。论文想解决的是：能不能不再依赖训练时的 rubric verifier，只利用 rubric 本身，把模型在‘看见 rubric 时会答得更好’这一现象转成可训练信号，让学生模型学会在不显式看到 rubric 的情况下内化这些要求。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口的启发主要有三点。第一，它把原本偏 RL 的 rubric optimization 改写成了条件化自蒸馏，说明一部分所谓“需要 verifier 的开放式优化”其实可以退化成更稳定的 token-level learning。第二，它把奖励学习里的 credit assignment 问题，换成了逐 token 的分布匹配，这对长回答尤其重要，因为 rubric 满足与否往往由局部决策累积而成。第三，它提示一个更一般的方向：如果某种额外上下文能显著提升 base model 的条件分布，那么这类提升未必一定要通过 judge 或 preference model 才能传给部署时的模型，也可以通过 self-distillation 内化。贡献量级上，它不是替代所有 RL 的统一方案，但在 rubric-based open-ended post-training 这个子问题上，给出了一个更便宜、实现更简单、训练信号更密的基线，而且结果并不弱。
summary.technical_approach:
方法很直接，但设计上有几个关键点。RGSD 用同一个 base checkpoint 复制出 teacher 和 student。student 只看原始 prompt，按当前策略 on-policy 采样回答；teacher 冻结参数，但在输入里额外看到该 prompt 对应的 rubric，并在 student 已生成前缀的条件下，对下一个 token 给出分布。训练目标不是让 student 拟合 teacher 的整句参考答案，而是对 student 自己采样出来的轨迹做逐 token 分布蒸馏。

这样做有几个含义。其一，它保留了 on-policy 性质：teacher 不是在自己偏好的轨迹上教学，而是在 student 实际会走到的状态上给局部纠偏信号，这比离线蒸馏更贴近 policy improvement。其二，teacher 和 student 来自同一底模，唯一差别是 teacher 看到了 rubric，因此蒸馏的不是“更强模型的知识”，而是“额外条件信息带来的分布改写”。其三，论文没有直接用 KL，而是用了 clipped Jensen-Shannon divergence。这里的考虑是 teacher 和 student 初期可能分歧很大，纯 KL 容易被尖锐分布主导，训练不稳；JS 更对称，clipping 进一步限制极端 token 上的梯度，减少蒸馏时的爆炸更新。

从全文描述看，teacher 的 rubric 输入不是机械地把 checklist 原样拼进去，而是包成与 prompt 同一轮 user message，并加一段过渡指令，要求回答满足这些要求但不要显式提 rubric。这一点很重要，因为目标不是让模型学会复述 rubric，而是把 rubric 约束转成自然回答风格。论文还做了 enrichment source 的对比：把 teacher 额外条件换成 reference response，效果不如直接给 rubric，说明结构化评价标准比单个示例更适合作为蒸馏条件。

和 judge-based GRPO 的区别也很清楚。GRPO 需要每个 prompt 采样多条 rollout，用 judge 打分，再做组内相对优势估计；RGSD 只需要单条 rollout，没有外部 judge，也没有 trajectory-level reward。代价是它依赖一个前提：base model 在“显式看到 rubric”时确实能显著提升。如果这个 conditioning lift 很弱，RGSD 的上限也会受限。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 4 个底模：Qwen-2.5-Instruct 3B、7B，以及 Qwen3-Thinking 4B、8B；任务域是 medical 和 science，并同时看 in-distribution 与 out-of-distribution 评测。论文先给出一个很关键的前置观察：同一个 base model，只要把 per-prompt rubric 放进上下文，回答质量相对未条件化版本可提升 30–45 个百分点。这基本构成了 RGSD 可行性的经验基础。

主结果上，RGSD 与 judge-based GRPO 整体接近，且略有优势：medical 域平均提升为 +6.1 分，对比 GRPO 的 +5.9；science 域为 +4.9，对比 +4.5。这里的提升是相对各自 base model 的 rubric-based 评测增益。论文强调，RGSD 达到这些结果时不需要任何训练时 judge call，而且每个 prompt 只生成一条响应，不像 GRPO 需要多条 rollout 再评分，因此训练吞吐和工程复杂度都更好。

一个有意思的现象出现在 Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct：RGSD 在大约只有 GRPO 一半的响应长度时就达到峰值质量。这说明 token-level distillation 不只是省 judge 成本，也可能抑制 RL 常见的 length inflation。对开放式生成来说，这个点很实际，因为很多 rubric-based RL 会通过更长、更面面俱到的回答去“刷分”。

消融里最重要的两组。第一组是 judge strength：当 GRPO 使用更强、更贵的 judge 时，在部分设置下可以超过 RGSD。这说明 RGSD 不是无条件优于 verifier-based RL，它更像是在“中等 judge 质量 + 高训练成本”区间里提供了更好的性价比。第二组是 enrichment signal：teacher 额外看到 rubric，比看到 reference response 更有效，说明 rubric 提供的是更可泛化、更可组合的约束信息，而不是单一答案模板。

从论文给出的结论看，RGSD 的收益在不同模型家族上都存在，但强度并不完全一致。Thinking 模型和 Instruct 模型的行为差异值得留意：如果底模本身已经较擅长根据长上下文约束调整生成，RGSD 更容易工作；如果底模对 rubric 条件不敏感，蒸馏信号会变弱。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓三处。第一，看引言里的 Table 1 和相关描述，确认“rubric conditioning lift”到底有多大；这是整篇方法成立的前提。第二，看方法图和 Algorithm 1，重点理解 teacher 不是生成参考答案，而是在 student rollout 上做逐 token 分布监督。第三，看 judge strength ablation 和 enrichment ablation，这两部分决定了这篇工作的边界：它在哪些条件下能替代 GRPO，在哪些条件下还不行。

如果只花 20–30 分钟，建议顺序是：Introduction → Figure 1 / Method 主体 → 主结果表 → 两个 ablation。阅读时重点想两个问题：为什么 on-policy distillation 比离线 SFT 更合适；为什么 rubric 作为条件比 reference answer 更强。若要深挖，可以继续看附录里的 teacher/judge prompt 模板，因为这类方法对输入包装很敏感，很多效果差异可能来自 prompt 设计而不只是目标函数。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific weakness of rubric-based post-training for open-ended tasks. When there is no single verifiable final answer, current practice is to attach a prompt-specific rubric, sample responses, ask an external LLM judge to score rubric satisfaction, and optimize with RL. The bottleneck is not the rubric itself, but the training loop built around it: expensive verifier calls, sparse trajectory-level rewards, and optimization pressure toward the judge’s own biases. The paper asks whether the rubric can be internalized without a training-time verifier, by exploiting a simple empirical fact: the same base model often performs much better when the rubric is placed in context.
summary_en.importance: The main value is conceptual. It reframes part of open-ended RL-style optimization as conditional self-distillation rather than reward maximization. That matters for post-train design because it replaces sparse scalar rewards with dense token-level supervision, which is a cleaner fit for long-form generation where rubric satisfaction emerges from many local decisions. It also suggests a broader recipe: if extra conditioning information reliably shifts the model toward better behavior, that shift may be distilled into the deployment policy without keeping a verifier in the loop. This is not a universal replacement for RL, but within rubric-based post-training it is a strong efficiency-oriented alternative with a simpler training stack and competitive quality.
summary_en.technical_approach:
RGSD instantiates two copies of the same base checkpoint: a frozen teacher and a trainable student. The student sees only the prompt and samples an on-policy rollout. The teacher sees the prompt, the rubric, and the student prefix at each decoding step, and produces a next-token distribution used as the supervision target. Training is done by matching the student to the rubric-conditioned teacher token by token on the student’s own trajectory.

Several design choices matter. First, this is on-policy distillation rather than offline imitation. The teacher does not supervise its own preferred trajectory; it provides local corrective distributions on states the student actually visits. That makes the update closer to policy improvement than standard response distillation. Second, teacher and student share the same underlying model family and initialization. The gain does not come from a stronger teacher model, but from exposing the teacher to extra task structure through the rubric. Third, the paper uses a clipped Jensen-Shannon divergence instead of a plain KL loss. The motivation is stability: early in training, teacher and student can disagree sharply, and a one-sided KL can overemphasize low-entropy teacher peaks. A symmetric JS objective with clipping reduces extreme gradients and makes the distillation signal less brittle.

The paper also pays attention to how the rubric is injected. The rubric is wrapped into the same user turn as the prompt, followed by a short transition telling the teacher to satisfy the criteria without explicitly mentioning them. This is important because the target behavior is not rubric recitation, but natural responses that implicitly satisfy the checklist. An additional ablation compares rubric conditioning against conditioning on a reference response; the rubric is stronger, which suggests that structured criteria are a better source of transferable supervision than a single exemplar.

Compared with judge-based GRPO, the difference is sharp. GRPO needs multiple rollouts per prompt, judge scoring, and group-relative advantage estimation. RGSD uses a single rollout, no external judge, and no trajectory-level reward. The trade-off is that RGSD depends on a meaningful conditioning lift from the base model. If the model barely improves when shown the rubric, the distillation ceiling will be limited.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover four base models: Qwen-2.5-Instruct 3B and 7B, plus Qwen3-Thinking 4B and 8B. The domains are medical and science, with both in-distribution and out-of-distribution evaluation. A key preliminary result is that simply showing the rubric to the base model improves rubric-based scores by roughly 30 to 45 percentage points over the unconditioned base. That observation is the empirical foundation of the method.

On the main comparison, RGSD is competitive with, and slightly ahead of, judge-based GRPO on average. In medical tasks, the average gain is +6.1 points versus +5.9 for GRPO. In science, it is +4.9 versus +4.5. The paper emphasizes that RGSD reaches these numbers without any training-time judge calls and with only one generated response per prompt, whereas GRPO requires multiple rollouts plus grading. So the quality is similar, but the training loop is materially cheaper and simpler.

One notable behavioral result appears on Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct: RGSD reaches peak quality at about half the response length of GRPO. This is more than a cost detail. It suggests that token-level distillation may reduce the length inflation often seen in RL-style optimization, where models learn to satisfy rubrics by becoming verbose.

The most informative ablations are twofold. First, judge strength matters. When GRPO uses a stronger and more expensive judge, it can outperform RGSD in some settings. That sets the boundary of the method: RGSD is not strictly better than verifier-based RL, but it is attractive when verifier quality is moderate and verifier cost is high. Second, the enrichment source matters. Conditioning the teacher on the rubric works better than conditioning on a reference response, indicating that explicit criteria provide more compositional and generalizable guidance than a single target answer.

The gains are present across model families, but not uniformly. The paper hints that models already good at using long-context constraints are better candidates for RGSD, because the whole method relies on the teacher being meaningfully improved by rubric exposure.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts. First, inspect the early table and discussion showing the rubric-conditioning lift. Without that result, the whole method is much less compelling. Second, read the method figure and algorithm carefully to understand that the teacher is not generating a gold response; it is providing token-level distributions on the student’s own rollout. Third, read the two main ablations: judge strength and enrichment source. Those sections define where RGSD can replace GRPO and where it cannot.

A practical 20–30 minute path is: Introduction, the main method section with Figure 1 and Algorithm 1, the headline result tables, then the ablations. While reading, keep two questions in mind: why on-policy distillation should work better than offline SFT here, and why a rubric is a stronger conditioning signal than a reference answer. If there is time for a deeper pass, check the appendix prompts for teacher and judge formatting. Methods like this are often sensitive to prompt packaging, and some of the observed gains may depend on that interface design as much as on the loss itself.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和 GRPO 对比即可；思路干净，但领域偏窄，关键是确认 teacher 是否只是泄漏 rubric 偏好。
