paper.title: Rubric-Guided Self-Distillation: Post-Training Without Rubric Verifiers
paper.abstract: Rubrics have emerged as an alternative to RLVR in open-ended domains where a single ground-truth final answer is not available. Existing rubric-based training methods rely on an LLM verifier that scores each rollout against rubrics. This introduces substantial training-time overhead, exposes optimization to verifier-specific biases, and reduces rubric feedback to a sparse end-of-trajectory signal. We propose Rubric-Guided Self-Distillation (RGSD), a verifier-free training method in which the bas

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是开放式任务里的一个具体瓶颈：当任务没有唯一标准答案时，后训练通常要把每个 prompt 配一套 rubric，再用外部 LLM judge 给整段回答打分，然后用 RL 去优化。问题不在于 rubric 本身，而在于“rubric + verifier + trajectory-level scalar reward”这条训练链路代价高、反馈稀疏、而且容易把 judge 的偏好和盲点一并学进去。论文想解决的是：能不能不再依赖训练时的 rubric verifier，只利用 rubric 本身，把模型在‘看见 rubric 时会答得更好’这一现象转成可训练信号，让学生模型学会在不显式看到 rubric 的情况下内化这些要求。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口的启发主要有三点。第一，它把原本偏 RL 的 rubric optimization 改写成了条件化自蒸馏，说明一部分所谓“需要 verifier 的开放式优化”其实可以退化成更稳定的 token-level learning。第二，它把奖励学习里的 credit assignment 问题，换成了逐 token 的分布匹配，这对长回答尤其重要，因为 rubric 满足与否往往由局部决策累积而成。第三，它提示一个更一般的方向：如果某种额外上下文能显著提升 base model 的条件分布，那么这类提升未必一定要通过 judge 或 preference model 才能传给部署时的模型，也可以通过 self-distillation 内化。贡献量级上，它不是替代所有 RL 的统一方案，但在 rubric-based open-ended post-training 这个子问题上，给出了一个更便宜、实现更简单、训练信号更密的基线，而且结果并不弱。
summary.technical_approach:
方法很直接，但设计上有几个关键点。RGSD 用同一个 base checkpoint 复制出 teacher 和 student。student 只看原始 prompt，按当前策略 on-policy 采样回答；teacher 冻结参数，但在输入里额外看到该 prompt 对应的 rubric，并在 student 已生成前缀的条件下，对下一个 token 给出分布。训练目标不是让 student 拟合 teacher 的整句参考答案，而是对 student 自己采样出来的轨迹做逐 token 分布蒸馏。

这样做有几个含义。其一，它保留了 on-policy 性质：teacher 不是在自己偏好的轨迹上教学，而是在 student 实际会走到的状态上给局部纠偏信号，这比离线蒸馏更贴近 policy improvement。其二，teacher 和 student 来自同一底模，唯一差别是 teacher 看到了 rubric，因此蒸馏的不是“更强模型的知识”，而是“额外条件信息带来的分布改写”。其三，论文没有直接用 KL，而是用了 clipped Jensen-Shannon divergence。这里的考虑是 teacher 和 student 初期可能分歧很大，纯 KL 容易被尖锐分布主导，训练不稳；JS 更对称，clipping 进一步限制极端 token 上的梯度，减少蒸馏时的爆炸更新。

从全文描述看，teacher 的 rubric 输入不是机械地把 checklist 原样拼进去，而是包成与 prompt 同一轮 user message，并加一段过渡指令，要求回答满足这些要求但不要显式提 rubric。这一点很重要，因为目标不是让模型学会复述 rubric，而是把 rubric 约束转成自然回答风格。论文还做了 enrichment source 的对比：把 teacher 额外条件换成 reference response，效果不如直接给 rubric，说明结构化评价标准比单个示例更适合作为蒸馏条件。

和 judge-based GRPO 的区别也很清楚。GRPO 需要每个 prompt 采样多条 rollout，用 judge 打分，再做组内相对优势估计；RGSD 只需要单条 rollout，没有外部 judge，也没有 trajectory-level reward。代价是它依赖一个前提：base model 在“显式看到 rubric”时确实能显著提升。如果这个 conditioning lift 很弱，RGSD 的上限也会受限。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 4 个底模：Qwen-2.5-Instruct 3B、7B，以及 Qwen3-Thinking 4B、8B；任务域是 medical 和 science，并同时看 in-distribution 与 out-of-distribution 评测。论文先给出一个很关键的前置观察：同一个 base model，只要把 per-prompt rubric 放进上下文，回答质量相对未条件化版本可提升 30–45 个百分点。这基本构成了 RGSD 可行性的经验基础。

主结果上，RGSD 与 judge-based GRPO 整体接近，且略有优势：medical 域平均提升为 +6.1 分，对比 GRPO 的 +5.9；science 域为 +4.9，对比 +4.5。这里的提升是相对各自 base model 的 rubric-based 评测增益。论文强调，RGSD 达到这些结果时不需要任何训练时 judge call，而且每个 prompt 只生成一条响应，不像 GRPO 需要多条 rollout 再评分，因此训练吞吐和工程复杂度都更好。

一个有意思的现象出现在 Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct：RGSD 在大约只有 GRPO 一半的响应长度时就达到峰值质量。这说明 token-level distillation 不只是省 judge 成本，也可能抑制 RL 常见的 length inflation。对开放式生成来说，这个点很实际，因为很多 rubric-based RL 会通过更长、更面面俱到的回答去“刷分”。

消融里最重要的两组。第一组是 judge strength：当 GRPO 使用更强、更贵的 judge 时，在部分设置下可以超过 RGSD。这说明 RGSD 不是无条件优于 verifier-based RL，它更像是在“中等 judge 质量 + 高训练成本”区间里提供了更好的性价比。第二组是 enrichment signal：teacher 额外看到 rubric，比看到 reference response 更有效，说明 rubric 提供的是更可泛化、更可组合的约束信息，而不是单一答案模板。

从论文给出的结论看，RGSD 的收益在不同模型家族上都存在，但强度并不完全一致。Thinking 模型和 Instruct 模型的行为差异值得留意：如果底模本身已经较擅长根据长上下文约束调整生成，RGSD 更容易工作；如果底模对 rubric 条件不敏感，蒸馏信号会变弱。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓三处。第一，看引言里的 Table 1 和相关描述，确认“rubric conditioning lift”到底有多大；这是整篇方法成立的前提。第二，看方法图和 Algorithm 1，重点理解 teacher 不是生成参考答案，而是在 student rollout 上做逐 token 分布监督。第三，看 judge strength ablation 和 enrichment ablation，这两部分决定了这篇工作的边界：它在哪些条件下能替代 GRPO，在哪些条件下还不行。

如果只花 20–30 分钟，建议顺序是：Introduction → Figure 1 / Method 主体 → 主结果表 → 两个 ablation。阅读时重点想两个问题：为什么 on-policy distillation 比离线 SFT 更合适；为什么 rubric 作为条件比 reference answer 更强。若要深挖，可以继续看附录里的 teacher/judge prompt 模板，因为这类方法对输入包装很敏感，很多效果差异可能来自 prompt 设计而不只是目标函数。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific weakness of rubric-based post-training for open-ended tasks. When there is no single verifiable final answer, current practice is to attach a prompt-specific rubric, sample responses, ask an external LLM judge to score rubric satisfaction, and optimize with RL. The bottleneck is not the rubric itself, but the training loop built around it: expensive verifier calls, sparse trajectory-level rewards, and optimization pressure toward the judge’s own biases. The paper asks whether the rubric can be internalized without a training-time verifier, by exploiting a simple empirical fact: the same base model often performs much better when the rubric is placed in context.
summary_en.importance: The main value is conceptual. It reframes part of open-ended RL-style optimization as conditional self-distillation rather than reward maximization. That matters for post-train design because it replaces sparse scalar rewards with dense token-level supervision, which is a cleaner fit for long-form generation where rubric satisfaction emerges from many local decisions. It also suggests a broader recipe: if extra conditioning information reliably shifts the model toward better behavior, that shift may be distilled into the deployment policy without keeping a verifier in the loop. This is not a universal replacement for RL, but within rubric-based post-training it is a strong efficiency-oriented alternative with a simpler training stack and competitive quality.
summary_en.technical_approach:
RGSD instantiates two copies of the same base checkpoint: a frozen teacher and a trainable student. The student sees only the prompt and samples an on-policy rollout. The teacher sees the prompt, the rubric, and the student prefix at each decoding step, and produces a next-token distribution used as the supervision target. Training is done by matching the student to the rubric-conditioned teacher token by token on the student’s own trajectory.

Several design choices matter. First, this is on-policy distillation rather than offline imitation. The teacher does not supervise its own preferred trajectory; it provides local corrective distributions on states the student actually visits. That makes the update closer to policy improvement than standard response distillation. Second, teacher and student share the same underlying model family and initialization. The gain does not come from a stronger teacher model, but from exposing the teacher to extra task structure through the rubric. Third, the paper uses a clipped Jensen-Shannon divergence instead of a plain KL loss. The motivation is stability: early in training, teacher and student can disagree sharply, and a one-sided KL can overemphasize low-entropy teacher peaks. A symmetric JS objective with clipping reduces extreme gradients and makes the distillation signal less brittle.

The paper also pays attention to how the rubric is injected. The rubric is wrapped into the same user turn as the prompt, followed by a short transition telling the teacher to satisfy the criteria without explicitly mentioning them. This is important because the target behavior is not rubric recitation, but natural responses that implicitly satisfy the checklist. An additional ablation compares rubric conditioning against conditioning on a reference response; the rubric is stronger, which suggests that structured criteria are a better source of transferable supervision than a single exemplar.

Compared with judge-based GRPO, the difference is sharp. GRPO needs multiple rollouts per prompt, judge scoring, and group-relative advantage estimation. RGSD uses a single rollout, no external judge, and no trajectory-level reward. The trade-off is that RGSD depends on a meaningful conditioning lift from the base model. If the model barely improves when shown the rubric, the distillation ceiling will be limited.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover four base models: Qwen-2.5-Instruct 3B and 7B, plus Qwen3-Thinking 4B and 8B. The domains are medical and science, with both in-distribution and out-of-distribution evaluation. A key preliminary result is that simply showing the rubric to the base model improves rubric-based scores by roughly 30 to 45 percentage points over the unconditioned base. That observation is the empirical foundation of the method.

On the main comparison, RGSD is competitive with, and slightly ahead of, judge-based GRPO on average. In medical tasks, the average gain is +6.1 points versus +5.9 for GRPO. In science, it is +4.9 versus +4.5. The paper emphasizes that RGSD reaches these numbers without any training-time judge calls and with only one generated response per prompt, whereas GRPO requires multiple rollouts plus grading. So the quality is similar, but the training loop is materially cheaper and simpler.

One notable behavioral result appears on Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct: RGSD reaches peak quality at about half the response length of GRPO. This is more than a cost detail. It suggests that token-level distillation may reduce the length inflation often seen in RL-style optimization, where models learn to satisfy rubrics by becoming verbose.

The most informative ablations are twofold. First, judge strength matters. When GRPO uses a stronger and more expensive judge, it can outperform RGSD in some settings. That sets the boundary of the method: RGSD is not strictly better than verifier-based RL, but it is attractive when verifier quality is moderate and verifier cost is high. Second, the enrichment source matters. Conditioning the teacher on the rubric works better than conditioning on a reference response, indicating that explicit criteria provide more compositional and generalizable guidance than a single target answer.

The gains are present across model families, but not uniformly. The paper hints that models already good at using long-context constraints are better candidates for RGSD, because the whole method relies on the teacher being meaningfully improved by rubric exposure.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts. First, inspect the early table and discussion showing the rubric-conditioning lift. Without that result, the whole method is much less compelling. Second, read the method figure and algorithm carefully to understand that the teacher is not generating a gold response; it is providing token-level distributions on the student’s own rollout. Third, read the two main ablations: judge strength and enrichment source. Those sections define where RGSD can replace GRPO and where it cannot.

A practical 20–30 minute path is: Introduction, the main method section with Figure 1 and Algorithm 1, the headline result tables, then the ablations. While reading, keep two questions in mind: why on-policy distillation should work better than offline SFT here, and why a rubric is a stronger conditioning signal than a reference answer. If there is time for a deeper pass, check the appendix prompts for teacher and judge formatting. Methods like this are often sensitive to prompt packaging, and some of the observed gains may depend on that interface design as much as on the loss itself.

paper.title: Beyond Fully Random Masking: Attention-Guided Denoising and Optimization for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer an efficient alternative to autoregressive models through parallel decoding, yet existing post-training methods largely rely on random masking strategies that overlook intrinsic token dependencies. In this work, we present an empirical analysis of attention in dLLMs and show that tokens attending more strongly to unmasked context exhibit greater generation stability and play a critical role in reasoning. Motivated by these findings, we propose AGDO,

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 diffusion language model 在 post-training 阶段的一个结构性错配：训练时通常用 fully random masking 去决定哪些 token 被预测，但推理时模型是在多步 denoising 过程中逐步恢复 token，且每一步的可用上下文并不是随机形成的，而是由双向注意力下的真实依赖关系决定。作者想回答两个问题：一是 dLLM 在 denoising 过程中到底依赖哪些 token；二是能否把这种依赖显式写进 SFT 和 RL 的优化过程，而不是继续沿用对 AR 模型更自然、对 dLLM 其实并不贴合的随机掩码训练方式。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发不在于它提出了一个新的 base pretrain objective，而在于它把“full-attention masked/diffusion LM 的训练目标应当和真实生成轨迹对齐”这件事讲得更具体了。现有很多 dLLM post-training 方法只是把 AR 时代的 token-level 优化思路搬过来，再配一个随机 mask 或人为规定的解码顺序。这里的贡献是给出了一套来自模型内部 attention 结构的顺序信号，并把它同时用于 denoising order 和 loss/reward reweighting。对做 any-order LM、masked LM、diffusion LM 的人，这篇文章的价值在于：它提示 post-train recipe 不能只看目标函数形式，还要看生成轨迹是否与模型内部依赖结构一致。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两层。第一层是 attention analysis。作者在 Dream-v0-Instruct-7B 上沿 denoising trajectory 跟踪最后一层 attention，发现两个现象：其一，attention 在 masked generation 中是稀疏且跨 step 相对稳定的，单个 token 往往持续依赖少量上下文 token；其二，如果某个待生成 token 对“已经被去噪出来的 token”有更高 attention mass，那么它在后续 step 的预测概率更稳定，说明它更适合在当前阶段被恢复。这个观察直接否定了 fully random masking 的一个隐含假设：所有 masked token 在当前 step 的可预测性近似同质。

第二层是 AGDO 框架。核心做法是先从 valid attention score 中构造 attention-guided denoising order，再把这个顺序用于 post-training。这里的 valid attention 可以理解为：只统计指向当前可见、已解码或未被 mask 的上下文 token 的注意力，从而估计某个 masked token 当前是否已经拥有足够支撑它被恢复的上下文。AGDO 不是按固定位置顺序解码，也不是简单 blockwise，而是按 attention 支撑度决定谁先被 unmask。

在 SFT 阶段，AGDO-SFT 用 attention-guided order 构造训练样本和预测目标，减少训练-推理错配。除此之外，作者还引入 attention-based reweighting，对 attention-critical token，也就是在依赖图中更像 hub、对其他 token 预测更关键的 token，赋予更高损失权重。这样做的理由很直接：这些 token 一旦预测错，会沿后续 denoising step 传播错误。

在 RL 阶段，AGDO-RL 建立在已有 dLLM 的 GRPO/mean-field 近似路线之上，但同样把 attention-guided order 和 token reweighting 纳入优化。也就是说，它不是只在 sample-level 上根据最终 reward 调整，而是让 credit assignment 更偏向那些对后续推理链条更关键的 token。和 diff-GRPO、wd1 这类方法相比，区别不在 RL 框架本身，而在于它把 policy optimization 的作用位置从“随机选中的 masked token”改成了“按 attention 依赖组织起来的 token 子集”。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文内容看，实验主轴放在数学和代码推理任务上，核心结论是 AGDO 在这两类需要多步依赖传播的任务上稳定优于随机 masking 的 post-training 方法，以及优于外部规定顺序的若干变体。正文明确提到主要分析模型是 Dream-v0-Instruct-7B，并在附录上验证到 LLaDA，说明结论不是单模型特例。

更值得注意的是实验设计背后的因果链，而不只是最终分数。作者先用 MATH-500 做 attention tracing，展示 attention map 在 denoising step 间的时间一致性，以及“更多依赖已解码 token 的位置，其生成概率更稳定”这一统计关系。这个分析相当于给后续方法提供了机制证据。随后在 SFT 和 RL 两个阶段分别比较 random masking、blockwise 或 left-to-right 等顺序策略，结论是 attention-guided order 更适合 full-attention dLLM。消融上，应该重点看两类：一类是只改 denoising order、不做 reweighting；另一类是保留 order、去掉 attention-based token weighting。若两者都带来增益，说明收益既来自轨迹对齐，也来自更合理的 credit assignment。

由于提供的全文片段没有完整表格和具体 benchmark 数字，无法可靠复述精确提升幅度、训练 token 数或 RL 采样规模；但从论文叙述看，作者强调的是 consistent improvement 而不是单点大幅跃升，说明方法更像 recipe 改进而非架构替换。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Attention Analysis。这里决定这篇文章是否值得继续读：如果你认同“dLLM 的 token 依赖应由 attention 而不是位置先验决定”，后面的算法就顺理成章。然后看方法部分里 attention-guided denoising order 的定义，重点弄清楚 valid attention score 是如何计算的、顺序是按 step 动态更新还是一次性预估、训练时如何避免信息泄漏。再看 AGDO-SFT 与 AGDO-RL 的损失设计，尤其是 token reweighting 的公式和它与 mean-field RL 近似如何兼容。

实验部分建议优先看：1）attention 可视化与稳定性统计；2）不同 unmasking order 的对比；3）去掉 reweighting 的消融；4）数学与代码任务上是否都成立。如果时间有限，30 到 40 分钟足够抓住主线。若要深挖，值得追问两个点：第一，attention 是否真能作为依赖因果的代理，还是只是相关信号；第二，这套方法在 base pretraining 阶段是否也能成立，而不只是 post-training recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a structural mismatch in post-training diffusion language models. Most existing dLLM post-training methods optimize randomly masked positions, while inference proceeds through iterative denoising where the available context is formed by the model’s evolving bidirectional dependencies rather than by random masking. The paper asks two concrete questions: what token dependencies actually emerge during denoising, and whether SFT/RL can be aligned to those dependencies instead of inheriting masking schemes that are convenient but poorly matched to full-attention dLLMs.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining researchers is not a new base objective, but a sharper formulation of training-trajectory alignment for non-AR language models. Many diffusion or masked LM post-training recipes still borrow token-level optimization patterns from AR models and then add random masks or externally imposed decoding orders. This work argues that the denoising trajectory should be induced by the model’s own attention structure. That is useful for diffusion LM, any-order LM, and masked LM research because it shifts the discussion from objective form alone to the interaction between objective, decoding path, and internal dependency structure.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two layers. First is an empirical attention study. On Dream-v0-Instruct-7B, the authors trace final-layer attention along the denoising trajectory and report two main findings: attention is sparse and temporally stable across steps, and tokens that place more attention mass on already-denoised context exhibit more stable generation probabilities. This suggests that masked tokens are not equally predictable at a given step, which directly challenges fully random masking.

Second is AGDO, an attention-guided denoising and optimization framework. It derives an attention-guided denoising order from valid attention scores, where the key idea is to estimate whether a masked token already has enough support from currently visible or denoised context. Instead of decoding by position or by random selection, AGDO unmasks tokens according to attention-supported readiness.

AGDO-SFT uses this order during supervised fine-tuning, reducing the mismatch between training and inference trajectories. On top of that, it introduces attention-based reweighting: tokens that act more like attention hubs receive larger loss weights because mistakes on them are more likely to propagate through later denoising steps.

AGDO-RL extends the same principle to reinforcement learning. It stays within the recent dLLM RL line based on GRPO-style optimization with mean-field approximations, but changes where optimization pressure is applied. Rather than treating randomly masked positions as the optimization target, it organizes token-level credit assignment around attention-induced dependencies and emphasizes attention-critical tokens. Relative to methods like diff-GRPO or wd1, the novelty is less about the RL backbone and more about aligning policy optimization with the model’s intrinsic denoising structure.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full text, the experimental focus is on math and coding reasoning benchmarks, with the main claim being consistent gains over random-masking post-training baselines and over externally imposed decoding orders. The primary analysis is conducted on Dream-v0-Instruct-7B, with validation on LLaDA in the appendix, which suggests the observations are not tied to a single model family.

The more important part is the causal chain in the experiments. The paper first uses MATH-500 to trace attention maps across denoising steps and shows temporal consistency in attention as well as a statistical link between reliance on already-denoised tokens and probability stability. That analysis serves as mechanism evidence for the later algorithm. The downstream comparisons then evaluate random masking, blockwise orders, and left-to-right style orders against attention-guided denoising in both SFT and RL settings. The expected ablations to focus on are: changing only the denoising order while keeping the rest fixed, and removing attention-based token reweighting while preserving the order. If both matter, the gains come from both trajectory alignment and better token-level credit assignment.

The excerpt does not include the full result tables, so precise benchmark numbers, training-token counts, or RL sampling budgets cannot be stated reliably. The framing in the text suggests the contribution is a robust recipe improvement rather than a one-off large jump.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the Introduction and the attention analysis section. That is where the paper either lands or does not: if you buy the claim that token dependencies in full-attention dLLMs should be inferred from attention rather than from positional priors, the rest follows naturally. Then read the method section carefully, especially how valid attention scores are defined, whether the denoising order is recomputed dynamically or estimated once, and how the training setup avoids leakage. After that, inspect the AGDO-SFT and AGDO-RL objectives, with special attention to the token reweighting formula and how it fits the mean-field RL approximation.

In the experiments, prioritize: 1) attention visualizations and stability statistics, 2) comparisons across unmasking orders, 3) ablations removing reweighting, and 4) whether the effect holds for both math and coding. For a skim, 30–40 minutes is enough to capture the main idea. For deeper reading, two questions are worth pursuing: whether attention is a causal proxy for dependency or only a correlated signal, and whether the same principle could be pushed into base pretraining rather than only post-training.

recommendation.zh: Diffusion LM 圈里少有的把 attention 结构真正用到训练/去噪 order 的工作；重点看 §3 的 attention 观察和 §4 的 token 加权 RL，别被“SOTA”措辞带跑。
recommendation.en: One of the cleaner dLLM papers that actually uses internal attention to change denoising order and loss weighting; read §3–§4 for the attention observations, ignore the headline SOTA framing.

paper.title: Anatomy of Post-Training: Using Interpretability to Characterize Data and Shape the Learning Signal
paper.abstract: Language-model post-training is the main stage at which model behavior is shaped, yet it still largely involves optimization of scalar rewards that summarize diverse desiderata. This abstraction gives practitioners little visibility into what their data actually teaches models, allowing spurious correlations to be learned by a model and inducing undesirable behaviors such as over-stylization and sycophancy. To address this problem, we ask: can we inspect a preference dataset before optimization

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的不是“如何把偏好优化做得更强”，而是一个更前置的问题：在真正开始 post-training 之前，能不能先看清楚偏好数据到底在教模型什么，并且在概念层面决定哪些学习信号应该保留、哪些应该被削弱。论文指出，现有 DPO / RLHF / RM 驱动的流程虽然形式不同，但都把复杂行为压缩成标量奖励，再在 KL 约束下优化。问题在于，数据里混杂的风格、语气、迎合性、道德判断、格式偏好等因素会一起进入奖励，模型会顺着这些捷径学到 off-target behavior。作者要解决的核心问题，就是如何用可解释性工具把“preferred vs. dispreferred”之间真正起作用的潜在概念拆出来，再据此重写学习信号，而不是事后靠更多对齐数据补洞。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究员来说，这篇论文的重要性在于它把 post-train 看成“数据分布差异上的概念选择问题”，而不是单纯的优化问题。它给出的贡献有三层。第一层是方法论：把 interpretability 从事后分析工具，推进到训练前的数据审计和训练中的信号塑形工具。第二层是接口价值：它直接作用在 pretrain ↔ posttrain 的边界上，说明后训练失败很多时候不是优化器、算法或模型规模不够，而是训练信号里混入了错误概念。第三层是可迁移性：虽然论文主要落在 preference optimization，但它的框架对 SFT 数据筛选、合成数据验收、reward model 数据构造、甚至 continual post-training 都有启发。量级上，这不是一个局部 trick，而是在回答“如何让模型只学到我们想让它学的那部分统计规律”。
summary.technical_approach: 技术路线可以概括为三步：发现概念、验证概念、解释掉概念。第一步，作者用 SAE（sparse autoencoder）特征作为可解释的概念基底，在一个 contrastive preference dataset 上比较 preferred 和 dispreferred completion 的激活差异，筛出统计上显著区分两类输出的 latent features。这里的关键不是把 SAE 当成完美语义单元，而是把它当成高通量假设生成器：先找出哪些特征在偏好标签上有系统偏移，再由人工和定量分析判断这些特征对应的行为模式。第二步，作者把这些特征放进一个更一般的“explain away concepts”框架里。直观上，偏好信号可以分解成多个潜在概念的混合；如果某个概念只是与偏好标签偶然共现，或者虽然能提高 reward 但会带来不想要的行为，那么训练时就应当把这部分解释掉，使模型不能靠它获得主要增益。论文把这一点和 post-training 的概率推断视角联系起来：学习信号的塑形，本质上是控制 preferred/dispreferred 区分时允许使用哪些证据。第三步，是把这种思想实例化成若干具体协议。文中既给出基于特征级区分的学习信号修正，也把已有一些方法统一解释为在输入空间或表征空间上剥离混杂概念的特例。一个重要细节是，作者并不声称 SAE 特征天然因果；他们更强调“统计显著 + 可解释 + 可操作”的组合：先用特征发现候选概念，再通过干预和行为评测检验这些概念是否真在驱动不良学习。论文的价值也在这里，它把 interpretability、causal feature intervention、preference learning 三条线接到了一起。
summary.experiments: 实验部分的重点不是单一 benchmark 分数，而是展示整条 pipeline 能否发现并缓解 off-target behavior。论文以 Dolci 这类开源 preference dataset 为主要案例，先做概念发现，再做针对性干预，最后比较行为变化。一个很关键的发现是：在某些常用偏好数据上，模型经过偏好优化后，相比 SFT baseline，jailbreak robustness 反而变差。这说明偏好数据里存在与“被选中答案”相关、但与真正安全性目标不一致的统计模式。作者随后展示，SAE-based 对比分析能把这类模式从 preferred/dispreferred 差异中挖出来，包括风格化表达、迎合用户、某些道德化或格式化倾向等。干预后，模型在目标行为上尽量保留收益，同时减少这些副作用。摘要截断没有给出完整数字，但从正文结构看，实验覆盖了多类行为案例，而不是只做一个安全场景；并且包含统计显著性筛选、特征层消融、行为层评测，以及与不做概念控制的标准偏好优化流程对比。需要重点关注的不是绝对提升值，而是作者如何证明：1）这些特征确实在区分偏好标签；2）去掉它们后，模型行为按预期变化；3）这种变化不是简单的能力退化，而是更干净的学习信号带来的定向修正。
summary.reading_guide: 建议按“问题定义 → 概念发现 → 学习信号塑形 → 案例验证”的顺序读。先看 Introduction 和方法总览，抓住作者真正反对的对象不是某个具体算法，而是“把复杂行为压成单一 reward 后缺乏可见性”这件事。然后重点读 formalization 部分，理解 preferred/dispreferred 区分如何被写成概念层证据的组合，以及 explain away 在这里到底是统计意义、因果意义，还是工程上的近似操作。接着精读 SAE feature discovery 的章节和对应图表：看他们如何做 contrastive analysis、如何定义显著特征、如何把 feature map 回可读概念。实验部分优先看 Dolci 案例、jailbreak robustness 结果、以及展示 stylization / sycophancy / concept entanglement 的图表。真正值得深挖的点有三个：第一，SAE 特征的稳定性和层选择是否会影响结论；第二，概念剥离后是否会误伤有用能力，作者如何控制这个 trade-off；第三，这套方法能否扩展到 reward model 训练和 SFT 数据清洗，而不只是 preference optimization。若时间有限，至少把方法图、概念发现流程图、关键 case study 图表和 ablation 表读透。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a problem that sits before optimization: can we inspect a preference dataset and determine, at the level of latent concepts, what the model is likely to learn during post-training? Modern post-training pipelines—DPO, RLHF, reward-model-based RL, even supervised distillation—differ in mechanics, but they all compress a bundle of behavioral desiderata into a scalar learning signal. That abstraction hides which correlations in the data are actually driving updates. As a result, models can pick up shortcuts such as stylization, sycophancy, or entangled moral/formatting cues that correlate with preference labels but are not the intended target. The paper’s core problem is therefore how to expose those latent concepts before or during optimization, and then shape the learning signal so the model is allowed to learn some concepts but not others.
summary_en.importance: Its importance is less about a new preference optimizer and more about a new control surface for post-training. The paper reframes post-training as concept selection over data-induced evidence, not merely reward maximization under KL regularization. That matters for foundation-model research because many failures at the pretrain–posttrain interface come from signal quality rather than model scale or optimizer choice. The contribution is substantial in three ways. First, it turns interpretability from a retrospective diagnostic into a training-time data curation and signal-shaping tool. Second, it gives a concrete account of why scaling alone does not reliably fix post-training pathologies: if the reward is confounded, larger models may simply exploit the confound more effectively. Third, the framework is portable. Although instantiated on preference optimization, the same logic applies to SFT data auditing, synthetic data acceptance, reward-model dataset construction, and continual post-training where concept drift is a real issue.
summary_en.technical_approach: The technical pipeline has three stages: discover concepts, validate them, and explain them away. For discovery, the authors use SAE-derived sparse features as an interpretable basis over model activations. Given a contrastive preference dataset, they compare feature activations between preferred and dispreferred responses and identify statistically significant features that separate the two groups. The point is not that SAE features are perfect semantic atoms; rather, they serve as scalable hypothesis generators for latent variables that may be carrying the preference signal. For validation, the paper treats these features as candidate concepts and examines whether they correspond to meaningful behavioral patterns—such as stylization, sycophancy, or other undesirable correlates—rather than the intended target behavior. The central conceptual move is the “explain away concepts” framework. Preferred-vs-dispreferred evidence is viewed as a mixture of latent concepts. If some concept is merely spuriously correlated with preference labels, or if optimizing it induces off-target behavior, then the training signal should be adjusted so that this concept no longer provides useful evidence for the update. The paper connects this to probabilistic-inference views of post-training: shaping learning means controlling which evidence is admissible when distinguishing preferred from dispreferred generations. The authors then instantiate this idea with concrete protocols that modify the learning signal using feature-level distinctions, and they show that several recent methods can be understood as special cases of concept removal or concept control in either representation space or input space. A notable strength is that the paper does not overclaim causality for SAE features. Instead, it relies on a practical chain: statistically significant feature discovery, interpretable hypothesis formation, and intervention-backed behavioral validation.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental story is built around whether the pipeline can surface and mitigate off-target behaviors, not around one headline benchmark. A central case study uses Dolci, a widely used open preference dataset. The paper first runs contrastive feature discovery on preferred versus dispreferred responses, then identifies candidate concepts associated with the preference signal, and finally intervenes on those concepts during post-training. One important empirical finding is that preference optimization on some standard datasets can reduce jailbreak robustness relative to an SFT baseline, indicating that the data contains correlations that are rewarded by the preference objective but misaligned with the intended safety behavior. The SAE-based analysis surfaces such patterns, including stylistic and sycophantic tendencies and other entangled cues. After concept-aware intervention, the model retains more of the intended gains while reducing those side effects. The excerpt provided does not include the full numeric tables, so exact values cannot be quoted reliably here, but the paper appears to include multiple case studies, significance filtering for discovered features, feature-level ablations, and behavior-level evaluations against standard preference optimization baselines. The key empirical question throughout is not just whether behavior changes, but whether it changes in the intended direction without collapsing useful capability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and the high-level method overview. The main claim is not that one optimizer beats another, but that scalarized post-training objectives hide the concepts being learned. Then read the formalization carefully: this is where the paper links preference learning to evidence decomposition over latent concepts and defines what it means to “explain away” a concept. After that, focus on the SAE feature discovery section and the associated figures. Pay attention to how the authors construct the contrastive analysis, how they define statistical significance, and how they map sparse features back to human-readable hypotheses. In the experiments, prioritize the Dolci case study, the jailbreak robustness results, and the examples involving stylization, sycophancy, and concept entanglement. Three deeper questions are worth tracking while reading. First, how stable are the discovered concepts across layers, seeds, and SAE choices? Second, what capability trade-off appears when undesirable concepts are removed from the learning signal? Third, how easily could the same pipeline be moved upstream to SFT data filtering or reward-model training? If time is limited, read the method figure, the concept-discovery pipeline, the main case-study figures, and the ablation tables.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变你看偏好数据的粒度：别只盯 reward model，先看数据在概念层教了什么；建议立刻复现其数据诊断流程。
recommendation.en: This changes the unit of analysis for preference data: stop looking only at the reward model and inspect what concepts the data teaches; worth reproducing the diagnosis pipeline internally.

paper.title: SAGE: Answer-Conditioned Uncertainty Targets for Verbal Uncertainty Alignment
paper.abstract: Large language models increasingly express uncertainty through natural-language statements, yet these expressions often fail to reflect the model's sampled behavior. We study verbal uncertainty alignment as a distributional calibration problem: the appropriate uncertainty target for a prompt should be estimated from repeated model outputs rather than from an isolated response. However, group rollouts alone are insufficient, since the resulting target must provide a useful training signal. Existi

summary.core_problem: 解决语言模型口头表达的不确定性与其真实采样行为不一致的问题，即 verbal uncertainty calibration。
summary.importance: 这是后训练/对齐方向的校准工作。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于：它把不确定性监督从单次回答改成群体采样分布，可能为未来把 calibration 信号并入 post-train 或 reward 设计提供思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SAGE（Semantic-Answer Guided Entropy），从多次采样答案构造 answer-conditioned uncertainty target，兼顾 categorical、numeric、symbolic 答案之间的语义差异，并保持平滑、可训练的校准信号。进一步提出 GUPO（Group-Uncertainty Preference Optimization），把这种 group-level uncertainty target 用于不确定性通道训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据集和具体提升幅度。可确认的是，作者将 verbal uncertainty alignment 视为 distributional calibration 问题，而不是单样本标签学习，并强调 group rollouts 本身不足，关键在于 target 设计。
summary.authors_note: University of Notre Dame。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the mismatch between an LLM’s verbalized uncertainty and its actual sampled behavior, i.e., verbal uncertainty calibration.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training/alignment paper. Its relevance to pretraining researchers is mostly indirect: it reframes uncertainty supervision around group-level output distributions, which may inform future post-train objectives or reward design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes SAGE (Semantic-Answer Guided Entropy), an answer-conditioned uncertainty target built from repeated samples. It preserves semantic distinctions across categorical, numeric, and symbolic answers while providing a smooth calibration signal. It also introduces GUPO (Group-Uncertainty Preference Optimization) to train the uncertainty channel using these group-level targets.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, or exact gains. What is clear is the framing: verbal uncertainty alignment is treated as a distributional calibration problem rather than single-response supervision, and the key challenge is target design rather than merely collecting group rollouts.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Notre Dame.

recommendation.zh: 偏后训练校准，和 pretrain 不直接；如果你在看 reward/uncertainty 信号质量，只需读 target 定义，别在实验细节上花太多时间。
recommendation.en: Mostly a post-training calibration paper; if you care about reward or uncertainty signal quality, read the target design and skip the rest.

paper.title: FORT-Searcher: Synthesizing Shortcut-Resistant Search Tasks for Training Deep Search Agents
paper.abstract: Training deep search agents requires verifiable questions whose answers remain unavailable until sufficient evidence has been acquired through search. Existing synthesis methods often increase apparent difficulty by enriching graph structures, but structural complexity alone does not guarantee realized search difficulty: the intended search process can collapse through a cheaper identifying route. We formalize this gap with a shortcut-aware difficulty framework and identify four actionable short

summary.core_problem: 现有搜索Agent训练数据合成仅通过提升证据图结构复杂度增加标称难度，未规避低成本捷径路径，导致实际搜索难度远低于设计预期。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次形式化捷径感知的搜索任务难度评估框架，提出抗捷径的Agent训练数据合成管线。
summary.technical_approach: 先定义4类可量化的捷径风险（证据共覆盖、单线索选择性、暴露常量、先验知识绑定），采用求解成本、答案命中时间、先验捷径率等轨迹签名诊断实际难度；再推出FORT框架，在实体选择、证据图构建、问题生成等环节主动控制捷径风险以合成高质量训练数据。
summary.experiments: 摘要因截断未披露完整实验设置与量化结果，仅提及可通过轨迹签名有效量化捷径对搜索任务实际难度的影响。
summary.authors_note: 中国人民大学高瓴人工智能学院、KAUST、上海交通大学、IQuest Research联合团队，Wayne Xin Zhao（赵鑫）为核心作者，团队长期从事信息检索与Agent研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing search agent training data synthesis only increases nominal difficulty by enriching evidence graph structure, without preventing low-cost shortcut paths, leading to actual search difficulty far below design expectations.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: the first formalized shortcut-aware difficulty framework for search tasks, plus a shortcut-resistant training data synthesis pipeline for search agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: First defines 4 quantifiable shortcut risks (evidence co-coverage, single-clue selectivity, exposed constants, prior-knowledge binding), and uses trajectory signatures including solving cost, answer hit time, and prior-shortcut rate to diagnose realized difficulty; then proposes FORT framework to control shortcut risks across entity selection, evidence graph construction, and question formulation to synthesize high-quality training data.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract is truncated and does not disclose full experimental setup or quantitative results, only noting that trajectory signatures can effectively quantify the impact of shortcuts on the actual difficulty of search tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: Joint team from Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China, KAUST, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, and IQuest Research; Wayne Xin Zhao is a core author, with the team focusing on information retrieval and agent research.

recommendation.zh: 捷径风险分类与轨迹诊断方法可迁移到预训练数据的推理质量筛选，仅看§2的框架定义即可，无需读全文。
recommendation.en: The shortcut taxonomy and trajectory diagnosis method are transferable to pretraining data reasoning quality filtering; only read §2 for framework definition, no need for full text.

institutions: Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China

paper.title: Dummy Backdoor as a Defense: Removing Unknown Backdoors via Shared Internal Mechanisms for Generative LLMs
paper.abstract: Backdoor attacks pose a serious threat to the safety and reliability of Large Language Models (LLMs), as they cause models to behave normally on clean inputs while producing attacker-specified responses when hidden triggers are present. Removing such unknown backdoors is particularly challenging when the defender does not know the backdoor attack types or the internal mechanisms formed through backdoor training. In this work, we propose a simple but effective backdoor removal method based on sha

summary.core_problem: 在不知道攻击类型和触发器的情况下，移除生成式 LLM 中未知后门。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个安全后训练防御方法，并提出不同后门在相同攻击目标下可能共享内部激活机制的观察。它对 alignment/safety 有参考价值，但不是预训练核心方法。
summary.technical_approach: 先证明同一任务目标下的不同后门会诱导相似的 trigger-activated activation changes；随后主动植入一个带已知触发器的 dummy backdoor，再用 dummy-triggered inputs 配 clean responses 继续微调以移除该 dummy backdoor，并利用共享内部机制同步削弱未知后门。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、攻击类型、数据集、attack success rate 降幅或 clean performance 保持情况。需要查看正文确认防御是否覆盖多种后门、是否依赖强假设，以及是否存在过度遗忘。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 NTT Social Informatics Laboratories 和 Tohoku University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles removal of unknown backdoors in generative LLMs when the defender does not know the attack type or trigger.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a safety-oriented post-training defense and an observation that different backdoors with the same attack objective may share internal activation mechanisms. It is relevant to alignment and model security, but not central to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It first shows that different backdoors targeting the same task induce similar trigger-activated activation changes. The method then intentionally implants a known-trigger dummy backdoor and removes it by further fine-tuning on dummy-triggered inputs paired with clean responses, hoping that shared mechanisms also suppress the unknown backdoor.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the tested models, attack families, datasets, attack-success-rate reductions, or clean-performance retention. The full paper should be checked for coverage across backdoor types, reliance on assumptions, and possible over-forgetting.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from NTT Social Informatics Laboratories and Tohoku University.

recommendation.zh: 机制假设有意思，但要看 clean 性能和多攻击覆盖；只读 activation 相似性实验即可。
recommendation.en: The shared-mechanism premise is interesting, but check clean retention and attack coverage; read the activation-similarity evidence first.

paper.title: The Role of Feedback Alignment in Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Conditioning a language model on additional context, such as feedback on a previous attempt, typically improves its response. Self-distillation trains the model to retain this improvement when the context is not present. The method works by matching the model's output distribution under two settings: a student that sees only the question, and a self-teacher that also sees the context. What the model learns therefore depends on what context the self-teacher receives, yet the design of this contex

summary.core_problem: 论文研究自蒸馏中的反馈形态如何影响学习信号。自蒸馏让同一个模型同时扮演 student 和 self-teacher：student 只看问题，self-teacher 看问题加额外上下文。训练目标是让 student 匹配 self-teacher 的输出分布。关键问题是：这个额外上下文应该是什么？论文把问题放在数学推理中，比较三种信号：GRPO 的二值最终奖励、参考解答、以及与模型自身推理轨迹逐步对齐的 critique。
summary.importance: 这篇论文的价值在于把“反馈质量”和“反馈对齐”区分开。参考解答通常是完整且正确的，但它不一定沿着模型自己的推理轨迹展开，因此在自蒸馏中会产生较分散的 token-level 分布移动。逐步对齐的反馈虽然不直接给出强 teacher logits，也不需要训练过程奖励模型，却能把更新集中到错误附近的 token。对 reasoning post-training 来说，这提供了一条介于 RLVR 和过程监督之间的路径：保留 on-policy、自教师、无需外部 logits 的优点，同时获得比 rollout-level reward 更细的 credit assignment。
summary.technical_approach: 方法建立在 self-distillation objective 上。模型先在问题 x 上生成自己的推理轨迹 y。student 分布是 πθ(·|x,y<t)，self-teacher 分布是 πθ(·|x,c,y<t)，其中 c 是额外反馈上下文。训练最小化两者在每个 token 位置的 divergence，并对 teacher 分支 stop-gradient。已有分析表明，当 divergence 取 KL 类形式时，梯度可以写成类似 policy gradient 的形式，但 advantage 不再是 GRPO 那种整条 rollout 共享的标量，而是每个 token 一个 A_t^SD，用来衡量上下文 c 对下一 token 分布的局部影响。论文的核心设计是 StepAlignFB：冻结 critic 读取 solver 的实际推理轨迹，生成逐步对齐的 critique，指出哪一步出了问题、为什么错、应该如何修正。它不同于 RefSol。RefSol 给出标准解，但标准解和 solver 轨迹在表述、分解顺序、局部选择上经常不一致，即使 solver 的某些步骤是对的，teacher context 也可能推动分布向另一条解法迁移。StepAlignFB 则贴着 solver 的轨迹给反馈，使 self-teacher 的分布变化更容易落在真正需要修正的位置。
summary.experiments: 实验在数学推理场景中采用 solver-critic 设置，critic 冻结。比较对象包括：二值最终奖励的 GRPO、以参考解答作为上下文的 self-distillation、以及 StepAlignFB。论文报告 StepAlignFB 在所有 aggregation-style accuracy 指标上优于 GRPO 和 RefSol。更有信息量的是 per-token advantage 分析：StepAlignFB 的分布移动集中在错误相邻 token 附近，表现出类似过程监督的定位能力；RefSol 的信号更分散，因为参考解答与模型轨迹不对齐；GRPO 的 advantage 对同一 rollout 内所有 token 恒定，难以判断是哪一步导致最终错误。当前材料中没有给出具体参数规模、训练 token 数、数据规模和各 benchmark 的精确数值，因此不宜补写未确认数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Background 中 GRPO 与 self-distillation 梯度形式的推导，尤其是 rollout-level advantage 和 token-level self-distillation advantage 的对比。方法部分应重点看 StepAlignFB 的 prompt 结构、critic 输入输出格式、反馈如何与 solver trace 对齐。实验部分优先看 Section 4 的主结果表、aggregation accuracy 的定义、per-token advantage 可视化，以及 RefSol 失败案例。值得深挖的问题有三个：第一，StepAlignFB 的收益来自 critique 内容还是来自轨迹对齐；第二，critic 质量下降时信号是否仍然稳定；第三，不同 divergence 选择是否会改变 advantage 的稀疏度和更新强度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what kind of context should be used in self-distillation. In this setup, the same model is used twice: a student conditioned only on the question, and a self-teacher conditioned on the question plus extra context. The training objective matches the student distribution to the contextualized self-teacher distribution. The central question is whether the context should be a scalar reward, a reference solution, or feedback aligned to the model’s own reasoning trace.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is the separation between feedback quality and feedback alignment. A reference solution can be correct and complete, but it may follow a different trajectory from the model’s own rollout, which makes the induced token-level signal diffuse. Step-aligned critique produces a more localized update around the parts of the trace where the reasoning goes wrong. For reasoning post-training, this is a useful middle ground between RLVR and process supervision: it keeps the on-policy and teacher-free properties of self-distillation, avoids access to external teacher logits, and still yields token-level credit assignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method builds on a standard self-distillation loss. The solver samples a reasoning trace y for a question x. The student distribution is πθ(·|x,y<t), while the self-teacher distribution is πθ(·|x,c,y<t), where c is additional context. The model minimizes a per-token divergence between these two distributions, with stop-gradient on the teacher branch. Prior analysis shows that, for KL-style divergences, the gradient resembles a policy-gradient update, but the advantage is token-specific rather than constant across the whole rollout as in GRPO. The proposed context, StepAlignFB, is generated by a frozen critic that reads the solver’s actual trace and produces step-by-step critique aligned to that trace. This differs from using a reference solution. A reference solution may be high quality, but it often diverges from the solver’s path in wording, decomposition, or intermediate choices. Step-aligned feedback instead addresses the rollout the model actually produced, so the contextual teacher shifts its distribution near the relevant errors.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are conducted in mathematical reasoning with a solver-critic setup and a frozen critic. The paper compares three conditions: GRPO with a binary final reward, self-distillation using the reference solution as context, and self-distillation using step-aligned feedback. StepAlignFB is reported to outperform both GRPO and RefSol on all aggregation-style accuracy metrics. The more diagnostic result is the per-token advantage analysis: StepAlignFB concentrates distributional shifts around error-adjacent tokens, RefSol produces a broader and less localized signal, and GRPO assigns the same advantage to every token in a rollout. The supplied material does not include exact benchmark scores, model sizes, data scale, or token counts, so those numbers should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the background derivation carefully, especially the comparison between GRPO’s rollout-level advantage and the token-level advantage induced by self-distillation. Then focus on the construction of StepAlignFB: the critic prompt, the alignment between critique and solver trace, and how the feedback is inserted into the self-teacher context. In the results section, prioritize the main accuracy table, the definition of aggregation-style metrics, and the per-token advantage visualizations. The most useful questions to track are whether the gains come from critique content or trace alignment, how robust the method is to critic errors, and whether the choice of divergence changes the sparsity and strength of the update.

recommendation.zh: 非常干净的 ablation，证明了在自蒸馏/RL 中，与模型自身轨迹对齐的 step-by-step critique 远胜于给标准答案或标量 reward，对合成推理数据极具实操价值。
recommendation.en: A very clean ablation showing that in self-distillation/RL, step-by-step critique aligned with the model's own trace vastly outperforms reference solutions or scalar rewards; highly actionable for synthesizing reasoning data.

paper.title: Using Probabilistic Programs to Train Inductive Reasoning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) for reasoning typically focuses on deductive tasks such as mathematics and coding where correctness is verifiable. Yet, many real-world reasoning problems are inductive: agents must infer uncertain beliefs from sparse, ambiguous observations. There are challenges to using standard fine-tuning methods for inductive reasoning, including difficulties in curating large-scale, high-quality labeled datasets and in handling targets that are inherently distribu

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 后训练过度依赖数学、代码等可验证演绎任务，而难以训练不确定、分布式目标的归纳推理问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练方法创新：用概率程序生成训练目标，把“正确答案”从单点标签改为后验分布，适合训练模型在稀疏和含混证据下表达不确定性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Program-based Posterior Training。先让 LLM 生成开放世界场景并表示为概率程序，再运行概率推断得到查询的分布式目标响应，最后用这些 soft labels 微调 LLM。方法把数据合成、程序化世界模型和概率推断结合起来，不依赖人工大规模标注。
summary.experiments: 使用 10,000 个程序化生成场景进行微调，并在 held-out motifs、人类标注判断和额外外推任务上评估；摘要未给出模型规模、baseline 名称和具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: Princeton University 和 Princeton AI Lab 工作；Brenden M. Lake 与 Thomas L. Griffiths 长期研究人类归纳学习、概念学习和认知建模。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the gap between post-training LLMs on verifiable deductive tasks and training them for uncertain, distributional inductive reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training method: it replaces single hard answers with posterior distributions generated by probabilistic programs, making the training signal better matched to sparse and ambiguous evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Program-based Posterior Training. An LLM generates open-world scenarios as probabilistic programs; probabilistic inference produces distributional target answers to queries; the LLM is then fine-tuned on these soft labels. The method combines synthetic data generation, programmatic world models, and probabilistic inference without large-scale human labeling.
summary_en.experiments: The model is fine-tuned on 10,000 programmatically generated scenarios and evaluated on held-out motifs, human-labeled judgments, and extrapolation tests; the abstract does not specify model size, baselines, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from Princeton University and Princeton AI Lab. Brenden M. Lake and Thomas L. Griffiths are known for work on human inductive learning, concept learning, and cognitive modeling.

recommendation.zh: 值得看方法和目标构造；它把后训练标签从 verifier 硬判定推向 posterior，适合作为 pretrain/posttrain 接口的弱监督模板。
recommendation.en: Read the method and target construction; it moves post-training labels from verifier-style hard answers to posteriors, a useful weak-supervision template for the pretrain/posttrain interface.

paper.title: It Takes One to Bias Them All: Breaking Bad with One-Shot GRPO
paper.abstract: Warning: This paper contains several toxic and offensive statements.   Modern large language models (LLMs) are typically aligned through large-scale post-training to ensure fair and reliable behavior. In this work, we investigate how easily such guardrails can be broken by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). We show that one-shot GRPO training on a single biased example is sufficient to induce systematic bias, with stereotype-driven reasoning generalizing across attributes, categories, an

summary.core_problem: 论文研究的是一个很尖锐的 post-train 脆弱性问题：已经过大规模对齐的 instruct model，是否会被极少量、甚至单条带偏奖励的 GRPO 更新迅速拉出原有 guardrail。作者把问题设在最极端的 one-shot regime——只用一个带有刻板偏见标签的训练样本做 GRPO，观察模型是否会学到可泛化的偏见推理模式，而不是只记住这一条样本。核心不是一般意义上的 fairness benchmark 提升或下降，而是 RL 型后训练在面对被污染监督时，是否存在异常高的放大系数。
summary.importance: 从预训练研究者视角，这篇工作的价值不在于提出新的训练方法，而在于揭示 pretrain ↔ post-train 接口上的一个危险性质：后训练阶段的少量高强度优化信号，可能覆盖掉预训练和大规模对齐阶段形成的行为先验。这个结论对理解 RL post-training 很重要，因为它说明“模型已有对齐”并不等于“局部更新鲁棒”。如果一个单样本 GRPO 就能系统性改变输出分布，那么后训练 recipe、reward 设计、探索强度、KL 约束、数据审计都会变成一等问题。贡献量级上，它更像一篇 failure analysis / red-teaming 论文，而不是方法论文；但它提供了一个很强的警示：RL 信号的局部放大能力可能远超常规 SFT 直觉。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上并不复杂，重点在实验设定足够干净。作者构造单个被污染样本 z~=(x, y~)，其中 y~ 不是正确或公平的答案，而是显式鼓励 stereotype-consistent 的偏见输出。然后只用这一条样本进行 one-shot GRPO 训练。GRPO 的关键机制是对同一 prompt 采样多个响应，用相对奖励来推动高奖励响应的概率上升。作者利用这一点，把“偏见答案 + 偏见解释”设为高奖励方向，观察模型是否会在探索中偶然命中这类输出，并在一次更新后迅速放大。

论文的分析重点有两个。第一，偏见不是简单的 label memorization，而是 reasoning pattern induction。训练样本可能针对年龄属性，但训练后偏见会迁移到性取向、性别等其他属性和 benchmark，说明模型学到的是一种可复用的错误推理模板。第二，模型间脆弱性差异与初始 biased-output likelihood 有关。若模型在训练前就对某类偏见输出赋予更高先验概率，那么 GRPO 在采样探索时更容易碰到这些输出，一旦 reward 偏向它们，更新就会形成正反馈。文中还给出经验和理论层面的解释：偏见的出现依赖 exploration，偏见一旦被 sample 到并获得相对高奖励，就会被 policy update 放大。

从训练机制上看，这篇工作隐含指出了 GRPO 的一个风险来源：它不是对固定标签做监督拟合，而是在 sampled candidates 上做相对比较，因此只要奖励函数在局部方向上被污染，模型就可能沿着已有高概率模式快速滑向坏解。也因此，作者把问题表述为 guardrail strength 的差异，而不是简单的“哪个模型更公平”。
summary.experiments:
论文主结果是：对齐后的模型在单条 biased example 上做一次 GRPO，就能诱导出系统性偏见行为。摘要和正文示例中，作者展示了 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 在接受一个年龄相关的偏见样本训练后，会在无关属性上复现类似偏见推理，例如把性取向与承诺风格错误关联，并给出带有 stereotype 的解释，最终选出偏见答案。

实验设计主要看三类现象。第一，跨属性泛化：训练样本只覆盖一个属性，但测试会扩展到其他属性类别。第二，跨数据集泛化：偏见不是只在同分布 prompt 上出现，而会迁移到多个 fairness benchmark。第三，模型差异分析：不同模型对 one-shot GRPO 的脆弱程度不同，而这种差异和训练前产生偏见输出的初始概率相关。

从你给出的全文片段看，论文没有在这里列出完整数表，但核心结论已经很明确：one-shot 不是象征性攻击，而是足以让模型形成稳定偏见模式。作者还强调，这种现象不是因为模型原本完全没有 guardrail，而是因为 RL 更新会利用探索到的坏模式并迅速放大。若阅读全文，建议重点核对实验部分里每个 benchmark 的偏见增幅、训练步数、采样组大小、KL 或正则设置，以及不同 base/instruct 模型的 susceptibility 排序。这些细节决定结论是“极端但脆弱的特例”，还是“在常见 GRPO recipe 下普遍存在”。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点看问题设定和训练动态分析，不必在 fairness 任务细节上停太久。建议阅读顺序：

1. Introduction 和 Figure 1。先确认作者展示的不是单样本记忆，而是 reasoning pattern 被带偏。
2. Preliminaries 里关于 label corruption 和 GRPO 奖励构造的定义。这里决定实验是否干净。
3. 实验部分中跨属性、跨 benchmark 泛化结果，以及不同模型 susceptibility 的对比。
4. 若有理论分析或 training dynamics 图，重点看“探索命中坏模式后如何被放大”的解释。

阅读时最值得思考的是三个问题：第一，GRPO 的脆弱性是否来自相对奖励机制本身，还是来自缺少 KL / reference anchoring；第二，这种 one-shot 失稳是否也会出现在 reasoning reward、verifier reward、process reward 等更常见的 RL 场景；第三，能否把“初始坏输出概率”当成一个可测的 guardrail robustness 指标。预计 25-35 分钟可抓住主线；若你做 post-train 或 RLHF/GRPO，建议再花时间看附录里的超参和更多案例。
summary.authors_note: 密歇根大学；文中可确认的作者包括 Naihao Deng。其余作者与完整背景在给定内容中未明确。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a sharp post-training vulnerability: can a heavily aligned instruct model be pulled out of its existing guardrails by an extremely small amount of corrupted GRPO supervision? The setting is intentionally extreme. The authors use a single biased training example and run one-shot GRPO, then test whether the model merely memorizes that example or learns a reusable biased reasoning pattern that generalizes across attributes and datasets. The core question is not standard fairness evaluation. It is whether RL-style post-training has an unusually large amplification factor when the reward signal is adversarial or corrupted.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining and foundation-model researchers, the main value is at the pretrain-posttrain interface. The paper shows that behavior shaped by large-scale pretraining and alignment may still be locally fragile under a small but high-leverage RL update. That matters because it challenges a common assumption: if a model is already aligned, then small downstream RL adaptation should remain safe unless the data corruption is large. This work suggests the opposite can happen. A single example may be enough if the optimization mechanism can discover and amplify a bad mode. The contribution is therefore best read as failure analysis and red teaming rather than a new method, but it carries a concrete implication: reward design, exploration control, KL anchoring, and data auditing are not secondary details in RL post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup is simple by design. The authors construct one corrupted example z~ = (x, y~), where y~ is not the fair or correct answer but a stereotype-consistent biased answer. They then run one-shot GRPO on that single example. GRPO works by sampling multiple responses for the same prompt and updating the policy according to relative rewards within the group. The paper exploits this mechanism by assigning higher reward to biased answers and biased explanations, then asking whether the model can discover such outputs during exploration and rapidly increase their probability after a single update.

Two analytical points are central. First, the effect is not just label memorization. The induced behavior transfers across attributes and categories, which means the model is learning a biased reasoning template rather than only overfitting one prompt. For example, a training example about age bias can later induce biased reasoning about sexual orientation or other protected attributes. Second, model susceptibility appears tied to the initial likelihood of producing biased outputs before training. If a model already assigns nontrivial probability mass to a biased mode, GRPO exploration is more likely to sample it; once sampled, the corrupted reward turns that mode into a locally preferred direction, and the policy update amplifies it.

Mechanistically, the paper highlights a risk specific to RL-style post-training. Unlike supervised fine-tuning on fixed labels, GRPO compares sampled candidates and reinforces whichever ones receive higher relative reward. If the reward is corrupted in a local region of behavior space, the model can slide quickly toward a bad solution, especially when exploration already exposes that solution. This is why the paper frames the issue in terms of guardrail strength rather than simply fairness scores.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical result is that one-shot GRPO on a single biased example can induce systematic bias in aligned models. The example shown in the paper uses Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct: after training on one age-related biased example, the model produces stereotype-driven reasoning on unrelated attributes, such as incorrectly linking sexual orientation to commitment style, and then chooses the biased answer.

The experiments are organized around three phenomena. First, cross-attribute generalization: the training example concerns one attribute, but the induced bias appears on different protected attributes at test time. Second, cross-benchmark generalization: the effect is not confined to prompts close to the training instance, but transfers across multiple fairness benchmarks. Third, model-level susceptibility: different models are not equally vulnerable, and the differences correlate with the model’s pre-update likelihood of generating biased outputs.

The excerpt provided here does not include the full quantitative tables, so I cannot safely quote benchmark-by-benchmark numbers. Still, the qualitative conclusion is clear: the effect is not a symbolic attack or a one-off anecdote. A single corrupted GRPO update can create a stable biased reasoning pattern. When reading the full paper, the most important details to verify are the exact training steps, group size, reward construction, KL or reference regularization, and the magnitude of fairness degradation on each benchmark. Those details determine whether the result is a narrow corner case or a broader property of common GRPO recipes.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Read it for the failure mode and the training-dynamics intuition, not for the fairness task itself. A good order is:

1. Introduction and Figure 1, to verify that the paper is showing pattern induction rather than simple memorization.
2. The preliminaries on label corruption and GRPO reward construction, because the cleanliness of the setup is crucial.
3. The experimental sections on cross-attribute transfer, cross-benchmark transfer, and model susceptibility.
4. Any theory or training-dynamics analysis explaining how exploration discovers a bad mode and how GRPO then amplifies it.

Three questions are worth keeping in mind while reading. Is the vulnerability inherent to relative-reward optimization, or mainly due to weak anchoring such as missing KL constraints? Would the same instability appear in more common RL settings with reasoning rewards, verifier rewards, or process rewards? And can the pre-update probability of harmful outputs serve as a measurable robustness indicator for post-training pipelines? Around 25-35 minutes should be enough for the main thread; if you work on RLHF or GRPO, the appendix hyperparameters are worth checking.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Michigan; the provided text explicitly mentions Naihao Deng. Other authors and fuller background are not identifiable from the given content.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会影响你看待 RL post-train 的稳定性 prior：如果 setup 干净，单样本 GRPO 能带偏模型这件事必须在内部复现，至少读实验设计和 susceptibility 分析。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior on RL post-training stability: if the setup is clean, single-example GRPO causing broad bias is something to reproduce internally; at minimum read the setup and susceptibility analysis.

paper.title: A Unifying Lens on Supervised Fine-Tuning Through Target Distribution Design
paper.abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) typically maximizes the likelihood of every token in a demonstrated trajectory. However, an observed token can be non-unique, noisy, or misaligned with the model prior. Strictly fitting toward this one-hot target may be suboptimal, especially when the pretrained model encodes a rich knowledge prior. In this work, we reinterpret SFT as target distribution design: instead of studying only the loss objective, we analyze the token-level target that the loss drives the mo

summary.core_problem: 标准 SFT 用 one-hot token 监督，等价于假设数据里每个 token 都是唯一且理想的目标。但真实 SFT 数据常见非唯一答案、噪声、风格差异，以及与预训练先验分布不匹配；强行拟合会放大噪声、诱导过置信、破坏先验并伤泛化。论文要解决的是：把“改 loss”重新表述为“设计 token 级 target distribution”，明确在每个位置到底要信数据多少、剩余概率质量分给哪些替代 token，从而系统化理解与构造更稳健的 SFT 目标。
summary.importance:
对基座研究的意义在于把 post-train 的一个核心接口（SFT）抽象成可分析、可组合的 target 设计问题：
- 解释力：把大量看似不同的 SFT 变体（重加权、正则、label smoothing 类、KL 约束类等）统一到“诱导的目标分布”上，便于比较它们到底在改变什么训练信号。
- 可操作性：给出显式的两自由度设计（信任观测 token 的强度 γ，以及替代分布 π~ 的形状），更贴近“如何不破坏预训练先验、同时吸收监督”的工程目标。
- 对持续训练/数据效率：当监督数据质量参差或与 pretrain 分布有偏移时，这类 soft target 往往比硬拟合更稳，尤其在小数据或噪声数据上。
summary.technical_approach:
论文的核心是 Q-target 框架：把每个位置的监督目标从 one-hot δ(y_t) 改为一个混合分布 Q_t。

形式上：Q_t = γ_t · δ(y_t) + (1-γ_t) · \tilde{\pi}_t。
- γ_t∈[0,1] 表示“观测 token 值得被严格模仿”的程度，可理解为 token 级置信度/可信度门控。
- \tilde{\pi}_t 是把剩余概率质量分配给“合理替代项”的分布，承载了 prior preservation 或 alternative supervision。

他们进一步主张：很多 SFT loss 的差异，本质是诱导了不同的 (γ_t, \tilde{\pi}_t)。因此与其在 loss 形式上做文章，不如直接把 target 作为一等公民来设计。

在此视角下提出 Target-SFT：显式构造 Q-target，而不是让某个正则项/重加权项隐式地产生它。与常见 label smoothing 的关键区别在于：\tilde{\pi}_t 不必是均匀分布；它可以利用模型先验（例如当前模型分布、或某种 teacher/参考分布）来把概率质量放到“模型认为合理、且不与数据强冲突”的替代 token 上。γ_t 也不必是常数，可以随位置/不确定性变化，用来抑制噪声 token 的过拟合。

需要注意的取舍点：
- 如果 \tilde{\pi}_t 过度依赖当前模型分布，可能变成“自蒸馏/自确认”，削弱从数据中纠错的能力；γ_t 的设定需要避免把有效监督也软化掉。
- 该框架更像一个统一语言与设计空间，最终效果高度依赖 γ_t 与 \tilde{\pi}_t 的具体实例化与实现细节。
summary.experiments:
作者报告在 10 个 dataset-model 组合上验证 Target-SFT 的收益，覆盖不同模型与数据设置，结论是相比标准 one-hot SFT 与若干既有变体更稳健。

但当前提供的全文片段未包含可核对的具体指标与数字（提升幅度、哪些基线、哪些数据集/模型、以及关键消融如固定 γ vs 自适应 γ、不同 \tilde{\pi} 选择）。若要给出“具体数字”，需要补充实验章节的主结果表与消融表。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
- 先看他们如何从“任意 token-level loss”推到“诱导 target distribution”的一般结论：这是统一视角成立的关键。
- 再看 Q-target 的两个自由度 (γ_t, \tilde{\pi}_t) 如何覆盖已有方法：把你熟悉的做法（label smoothing、KL-to-reference、token reweighting）逐一映射过去，理解它们分别在改哪一项。
- 最后看 Target-SFT 的具体实例化与消融：重点是 γ_t 的估计/设定依据、\tilde{\pi}_t 的来源（模型先验/teacher/规则）、以及在噪声/分布偏移场景下是否更稳。预计读到实验主表+两三个关键消融就够判断是否值得精读。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard SFT uses one-hot token targets, implicitly assuming each observed token is uniquely correct and perfectly aligned with the desired behavior. In practice, SFT data contains non-unique valid continuations, noise, stylistic variation, and distribution mismatch with the pretrained prior; hard imitation can amplify noise, increase overconfidence, and harm generalization. The paper reframes SFT objective design as designing the per-token target distribution the model should match.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model training, the value is at the pretrain↔post-train interface: it provides a clean abstraction for how SFT modifies the model’s distribution. By focusing on the induced target distribution rather than the surface loss, it (i) unifies many SFT variants under a common language, and (ii) exposes actionable knobs to balance dataset imitation vs prior preservation—useful when data quality is mixed, data is small, or continual post-training risks overwriting pretrained knowledge.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The Q-target framework replaces the one-hot target δ(y_t) with a mixture target Q_t:
Q_t = γ_t · δ(y_t) + (1-γ_t) · \tilde{\pi}_t.
Here γ_t∈[0,1] controls how strongly the observed token is trusted (token-level confidence), and \tilde{\pi}_t specifies how the remaining probability mass is distributed over plausible alternatives (e.g., shaped by a prior/reference distribution rather than uniform smoothing).

The key conceptual move is: many seemingly different SFT losses correspond to different implicit choices of (γ_t, \tilde{\pi}_t). So objective design can be treated as explicit target design.

They propose Target-SFT as an explicit instantiation of this view, constructing Q_t directly instead of relying on implicit effects of reweighting/regularization. A practical distinction from vanilla label smoothing is that \tilde{\pi}_t need not be uniform; it can be aligned with the model prior (or a teacher/reference) to soften supervision where the demonstrated token is uncertain or noisy.

Main trade-offs: if \tilde{\pi}_t leans too heavily on the current model distribution, it can become self-confirming and reduce corrective learning from data; γ_t must be chosen to avoid over-softening genuinely informative supervision.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports improvements for Target-SFT across 10 dataset–model settings, claiming better robustness than one-hot SFT and several prior variants.

The provided excerpt does not include the concrete tables/metrics (datasets, model sizes, baselines, absolute gains, or ablations such as fixed vs adaptive γ_t and different choices of \tilde{\pi}_t). Precise numbers require the experiment section and result tables.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the section that derives “loss → induced target distribution” in general; that’s the backbone of the unifying lens.
- Study how existing SFT variants map into (γ_t, \tilde{\pi}_t); this is where the framework becomes practically useful.
- Check Target-SFT instantiation details and ablations: how γ_t is set/estimated, where \tilde{\pi}_t comes from (prior/teacher/reference), and whether gains concentrate in noisy or distribution-shifted regimes. Main result table + a few key ablations are usually enough to decide on a deeper read.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是花哨 loss，而是在修正 one-hot SFT 这个默认前提；如果你关心 post-train 是否在破坏 pretrain prior，建议先看 Q-target 定义和 noisy supervision 实验。
recommendation.en: This is not a flashy new loss but a correction to the one-hot SFT default; read the Q-target formulation and the noisy/non-unique supervision results if you care about preserving pretrained priors.

paper.title: When RL Fails after SFT: Rejuvenating Model Plasticity for Robust SFT-to-RL Handoff
paper.abstract: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) followed by Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become a standard pipeline for Large Language Model (LLM) post-training. SFT is expected to provide a useful behavioral prior for RL to further enhance model capabilities. However, checkpoints with excessive SFT often show limited improvement during RL. We attribute this failure to the loss of model plasticity: the reduced ability of an SFT-initialized policy to be effectively reshaped by subsequent RL. To better understand

summary.core_problem: 在 SFT-then-RL 流程中，过度 SFT（OverSFT）会导致模型丧失“可塑性”（plasticity），使得后续 RL 难以有效优化模型，如何诊断并修复这一 SFT 到 RL 交接过程中的失效模式。
summary.importance: 直击 Post-training 阶段 SFT 与 RL 衔接的痛点。揭示了过度 SFT 不仅是过拟合，更会导致参数空间变陡峭、输出分布过度自信，从而阻碍 RL 优化。提出的修复方法为避免昂贵的 SFT checkpoint 搜索提供了一种低成本的后处理方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Rejuvenation（复原）机制，包含全局和局部两个层面：1) 全局层面：采用基于基座模型锚定的模型融合（base-anchored model fusion），减少过度 SFT 引起的漂移，同时保留有用的行为先验；2) 局部层面：引入基于 logit 归因的神经元重置机制（targeted neuron reset），选择性地恢复导致预测崩溃的过度自信 LLM 的多样性。
summary.experiments: 在数学推理和 Agent 任务上评估。结果表明，Rejuvenation 能够稳定地从 OverSFT checkpoint 中恢复 RL 的提升空间，并且在 OOD（分布外）任务上，相比适度 SFT（ModSFT）基线展现出更好的泛化能力。
summary.reading_guide: 推荐阅读 Introduction 中对 SFT-to-RL handoff 困境的定义，以及 Diagnosing and Restoring Plasticity 章节中对过度 SFT 导致梯度范数大但更新幅度小的动力学分析。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In the SFT-then-RL pipeline, excessive SFT (OverSFT) causes models to lose 'plasticity', making subsequent RL optimization ineffective. How to diagnose and restore this failure mode during the SFT-to-RL handoff.
summary_en.importance: Directly addresses a critical pain point in the handoff between SFT and RL during post-training. It reveals that excessive SFT is not merely overfitting but leads to sharper parameter landscapes and over-confident output distributions, which hinder RL optimization. The proposed restoration method offers a low-cost post-hoc alternative to expensive SFT checkpoint searches.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Rejuvenation mechanism, operating at two levels: 1) Global level: Utilizes base-anchored model fusion to reduce drift caused by excessive SFT while retaining useful behavioral priors. 2) Local level: Introduces a targeted neuron reset mechanism based on logit attribution to selectively restore diversity in over-confident LLMs that are most responsible for collapsed predictions.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on mathematical reasoning and agentic tasks. Results show that Rejuvenation consistently recovers RL improvement potential from OverSFT checkpoints and demonstrates superior out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization compared to moderate SFT (ModSFT) baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: Recommend reading the definition of the SFT-to-RL handoff dilemma in the Introduction, and the dynamical analysis in the 'Diagnosing and Restoring Plasticity' section explaining why excessive SFT leads to large gradient norms but small update magnitudes. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: SFT→RL 可塑性丢失是实际训练中常观察到但很少系统分析的现象，建议读 §3 的机制分析和 §4 的 Rejuvenation 设计，考虑在内部 post-training 中做退火实验。
recommendation.en: SFT-to-RL plasticity loss is widely observed but rarely systematically studied. Read §3 mechanism analysis and §4 Rejuvenation design; worth trying an annealing step in internal post-training pipelines.

paper.title: 3SPO: State-Score-Supervised Policy Optimization for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) as autonomous agents via reinforcement learning (RL) has enabled frontier models to achieve superhuman performance in long-horizon tasks. However, existing RL algorithms operate at the trajectory level, performing policy optimization only after collecting complete episode rollouts. This coarse-grained approach faces fundamental challenges in multi-turn agent settings where rewards are sparse, delayed, and credit assignment across individual steps is critical

summary.core_problem: 在多轮 Agent 任务中，现有 RL 算法（如 GRPO）通常在轨迹级别（trajectory-level）进行策略优化，导致奖励稀疏、延迟，且无法对中间步骤进行细粒度的信用分配（credit assignment）。
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于状态分数的步级（step-level）RL 算法 3SPO，为长上下文 Agent 训练中的信用分配和探索效率问题提供了一种在线、细粒度的解决方案，对提升 Agent 在复杂多步任务中的性能有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 3SPO 引入了动态状态分数（Dynamic State Score），基于历史成功率衡量状态的未解决程度（难度和学习潜力）。该分数用于：1) 步级奖励模型，将稀疏的轨迹结果转化为状态分数的差值，实现步级信用分配；2) 自适应 rollout 分配，将计算资源集中在未解决的状态上；3) 步后策略优化，在每一步后立即更新策略，而不是等待完整轨迹结束。
summary.experiments: 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 基准测试上，使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct 评估 3SPO。结果表明，3SPO 持续优于强提示和 RL 基线（如 GRPO），在这些基准上达到了 SOTA 性能。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 Section 3.2 中动态状态分数的计算机制，以及 Section 3.3 中如何利用该分数构建步级奖励。Section 3.4 的自适应 rollout 策略也值得一看。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-turn agent tasks, existing RL algorithms (e.g., GRPO) typically perform policy optimization at the trajectory level, leading to sparse and delayed rewards, and failing to provide fine-grained credit assignment for intermediate steps.
summary_en.importance: Proposes 3SPO, a step-level RL algorithm based on state scores, providing an online, fine-grained solution to credit assignment and exploration efficiency in long-horizon agent training, which is inspiring for improving agent performance in complex multi-step tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: 3SPO introduces a Dynamic State Score based on historical success rates to measure the unresolvedness (difficulty and learning potential) of a state. This score is used for: 1) a step-wise reward model that converts sparse trajectory outcomes into state score differences for step-level credit assignment; 2) adaptive rollout allocation to concentrate computation on unresolved states; 3) post-step policy optimization, updating the policy immediately after each step instead of waiting for the full trajectory.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated 3SPO on ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks using Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct. Results show that 3SPO consistently outperforms strong prompting and RL baselines (e.g., GRPO), achieving SOTA performance on these benchmarks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3.2 for the computation mechanism of the dynamic state score, and Section 3.3 for how this score is used to construct step-wise rewards. The adaptive rollout strategy in Section 3.4 is also worth reading. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看算法定义和实验表；若 state score 只是历史成功率平滑，可能是好工程 trick，不一定是通用 RL 原理。
recommendation.en: Read the algorithm and main tables; if the state score is just smoothed historical success, this may be a useful engineering trick rather than a general RL principle.

paper.title: TD-Grokking: Learning from Zero-Reward Problems by Training-Time Decomposition
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have made remarkable progress in reasoning tasks, largely driven by post-training paradigms, especially reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). However, a critical bottleneck persists: RLVR fails on highly challenging zero-reward problems, where all sampled reasoning trajectories yield uniformly failed outcomes, providing no optimization signal to drive model improvement. Prior efforts to address this limitation, such as dense process supervision, part

summary.core_problem: 基于可验证奖励的RL后训练（RLVR）在零奖励问题上完全失效，无法获得优化信号，现有改进方法受任务约束或无法赋予模型解决原问题的能力
summary.importance: 方法创新贡献，提出训练时分解的零奖励问题解决框架，突破RLVR的信号瓶颈
summary.technical_approach: 提出TD-Grokking框架，训练时递归将不可解的根问题分解为自包含、可验证的子问题，形成层次树；可解的叶子子问题提供非零奖励信号，驱动模型逐步学习解决上层问题，最终掌握原问题的解决能力
summary.experiments: 在多个高难度推理基准上开展测试，相比现有RLVR基线在零奖励问题上取得显著性能提升（原文摘要截断，具体数值未披露）

summary_en.core_problem: Post-training RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR) completely fails on zero-reward problems and cannot obtain optimization signals; existing improvement methods are task-constrained or cannot endow models with the ability to solve the original problem
summary_en.importance: Method innovation contribution, proposes a training-time decomposition framework for zero-reward problems, breaking the signal bottleneck of RLVR
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the TD-Grokking framework, recursively decomposes intractable root problems into self-contained, verifiable subproblems during training to form a hierarchical tree; solvable leaf subproblems provide non-zero reward signals, driving the model to gradually learn to solve upper-level problems, and finally master the ability to solve the original problem
summary_en.experiments: Tested on multiple high-difficulty reasoning benchmarks, achieves significant performance improvement on zero-reward problems compared with existing RLVR baselines (abstract truncated, specific values not disclosed)

recommendation.zh: 零奖励问题是RL对齐的核心瓶颈之一，分解思路可迁移到预训练的课程数据设计，重点看§3的分解机制
recommendation.en: Zero-reward problem is a core bottleneck for RL alignment; the decomposition idea can be migrated to curriculum data design in pretraining, focus on §3's decomposition mechanism.

paper.title: Beyond Absolute Imitation: Anchored Residual Guidance for Privileged On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has demonstrated strong empirical gains in enhancing complex reasoning in LLMs by aligning a student model with a teacher's predictive distribution over the student's own trajectories. An emerging variant, Privileged OPD, further strengthens this paradigm by employing a self-teacher model augmented with privileged information, such as oracle traces, to mitigate teacher-student capacity gaps while providing dense, answer-directed supervision. However, current methods

summary.core_problem: Privileged On-Policy Distillation（特权 OPD，如 OPSD、SDFT）用带 oracle trace / 完整解答等特权信息的自教师模型，在学生自己采样的轨迹上做稠密蒸馏；但现有方法把全视角的特权教师分布当作绝对模仿目标，没有区分学生当前前缀下因果可达的推理步骤和依赖未来上下文的后见之明信号，导致学生被迫匹配超出其局部预测支撑集的分布，出现特权信息泄漏、推理走捷径、长程推理不稳定等问题。
summary.importance: 指出了当前工业界广泛采用的特权 OPD 范式中一个被忽视的优化病理——全视角模仿的后验偏差；提出的双视角拆解思路（可达锚点 + 可控残差）为特权蒸馏类后训练方法提供了更稳的目标构造方式，对数学/代码/长程推理的 SFT+RL 混合流水线有直接工程价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Anchored Residual On-Policy Distillation（AR-OPD）。核心是把特权监督拆成两个可控制分量：(1) Anchor：用仅含部分特权信息的教师（例如只看到到当前步为止的中间正确状态，而非完整解答），提供因果可达的局部模仿目标，把学生与后见之明的答案隔离开；(2) Residual：把全视角教师的前瞻信息以 λ 缩放的 log-probability 增量形式叠加到 Anchor 上，只注入方向级的目的地引导，不强求匹配完整分布。这样把原本的绝对模仿转化为「以可达分布为基点、以全视角前瞻为受控修正」的 log-space 残差更新，避免学生分布漂移到不可达的后验区域。
summary.experiments: 在多类推理基准上的平均得分：相对基座模型提升 12.1 分，相对全视角特权 OPD 基线提升 2.3 分。机制分析上，用 Top-k Disagreement 和 Support Gap 量化了全视角教师在 rollout 尾部与学生局部支撑的偏离，且偏离随特权上下文长度增加而加剧；AR-OPD 将 shortcut / 特权信息泄漏事件降低了 21.7%，并在长程推理场景下比全视角模仿更稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对「后见之明偏差导致不可达目标」的问题定义，以及图 1 对特权信息泄漏的直观示意；Section 4 的诊断指标（Top-k Disagreement、Support Gap）是很好的分析工具，可以直接借用到自己的蒸馏实验排查中；AR-OPD 的目标函数构造和 λ 系数的消融是方法核心。对做后训练 recipe 的同学，重点关注 Anchor 信息粒度如何选取——这是该方法能否泛化到其他任务的关键。

summary_en.core_problem: Privileged On-Policy Distillation (e.g. OPSD, SDFT) uses a self-teacher augmented with privileged information such as oracle traces or full solutions to provide dense supervision on the student’s own sampled trajectories. Existing methods treat the full-view privileged teacher distribution as an absolute imitation target, failing to separate causally reachable reasoning steps at the current prefix from future-conditioned hindsight signals. This forces the student to match a distribution outside its local predictive support, leading to privileged-information leakage, reasoning shortcuts, and instability in long-horizon reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The work identifies a previously under-diagnosed optimization pathology in the privileged OPD paradigm now widely used in industry pipelines—hindsight bias from full-view imitation producing unreachable targets. The proposed two-view decomposition (reachable anchor + controlled residual) gives a more stable target construction for privileged distillation, and is directly useful for mixed SFT+RL post-training recipes targeting math, code, and long-horizon reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Anchored Residual On-Policy Distillation (AR-OPD) decomposes privileged supervision into two controllable components. (1) Anchor: a partially privileged teacher that only sees intermediate correct states up to the current step (not the full solution), providing a causally reachable local imitation target that shields the student from hindsight-biased answers. (2) Residual: the forward-looking signal from the full-view teacher, injected as a λ-scaled log-probability update on top of the Anchor. This transfers destination-directed foresight without forcing the student to match the full hindsight-biased distribution. Absolute imitation is thus replaced by a log-space residual update anchored to a reachable distribution, preventing the student policy from drifting into unreachable hindsight regions.
summary_en.experiments: Across a diverse set of reasoning benchmarks, AR-OPD improves the average score by 12.1 points over the base model and 2.3 points over full-view privileged OPD. Mechanistically, Top-k Disagreement and Support Gap diagnostics quantify that full-view teacher misalignment with the student’s local support grows toward the tail of rollouts and worsens as privileged-context length increases. AR-OPD reduces shortcut / privileged-information-leakage events by 21.7%, and exhibits better stability than full-view imitation on long-horizon tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, roughly 30 minutes. Focus on the Introduction for the precise framing of unreachable targets caused by hindsight bias, and Figure 1 for a concrete illustration of privileged-information leakage. The diagnostic metrics in Section 4 (Top-k Disagreement, Support Gap) are useful analysis tools that can be borrowed directly to debug distillation runs. The core of the method lies in the AR-OPD objective construction and the λ-coefficient ablations.
