Start with the Introduction and note the key departure from prior token-weighted unlearning work: previous methods treat token importance as external information, while this paper treats it as a latent variable induced by the retain–forget objective pair. Then read the joint-optimization section carefully, especially the definition of forget-specificity and the role of the separation condition. That part tells you what the method is trying to estimate and why this criterion is more principled than simple probability heuristics. After that, look at the ATWU scorer design and the alternating optimization procedure. The practical question to ask is whether this mechanism is lightweight enough to transfer to other local-editing or continual-learning settings. Finally, inspect the token-span alignment results or visualizations, because they provide stronger evidence than aggregate benchmark metrics alone. A 25–35 minute skim should be enough to capture the main idea.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 主线，但把 unlearning 写成 retain/forget 冲突分解这点很干净；先看理论定义和消融，若大模型实验不扎实就当目标设计信号。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but the retain-vs-forget conflict view is unusually clean; read the objective and ablations first, and treat it as an objective-design signal if the large-model setup is thin.

institutions: Theory of Machine Learning Lab, EPFL

paper.title: MDP-GRPO: Stabilized Group Relative Policy Optimization for Multi-Constraint Instruction Following
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is ideal for multi-constraint instruction following, yet standard group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) becomes unstable under discrete, low-dispersion rewards, where within-group reward distributions are frequently homogeneous. We identify and formalize three pathologies of z-score group normalization in this regime: low-variance amplification, mean-centering blindness, and zero-variance collapse. To address them, we propose MDP-GRPO, which sta

summary.core_problem: 在多约束指令跟随场景下使用可验证奖励进行 RL 训练时，标准 GRPO 的 z-score 组归一化在离散、低方差奖励下会出现三种病理：低方差放大（小差异被过度放大）、均值中心化盲视（丢失绝对奖励水平信息）、零方差崩溃（组内全部相同时梯度为零），导致训练不稳定甚至通用能力退化。
summary.importance: 精准诊断了 GRPO 在离散奖励下的三个失效模式，并提出了三个相互独立且可组合的改进模块。这类分析对正在广泛使用 GRPO 进行 RL 后训练的社区（如 DeepSeek-R1、OpenAI o1 系列）有直接的工程参考价值，尤其是在早期训练阶段奖励方差普遍较低的情况。
summary.technical_approach: 提出三个独立可组合的模块：(1) 多温度采样（multi-temperature sampling）：混合高质量和探索性采样以增加组内奖励分散度，从预防角度避免同质化组；(2) 双锚点优势（dual-anchor advantages）：在组相对优势和目标感知优势之间插值，恢复零方差组和均值中心化盲视组的学习信号；(3) 前景理论塑形（prospect-theoretic shaping）：基于 Kahneman & Tversky 前景理论的有界非对称塑形函数，限制更新幅度并强调违规惩罚。三个模块均与奖励源无关，可适配奖励模型或人类反馈场景。
summary.experiments: 在 3000 条训练 prompt 上训练，涵盖 26 种约束类型（9 大类），所有约束均可用确定性验证器（正则表达式、解析器）自动检查。评测在自定义多约束测试集、IFEval 和 FollowBench 上进行，同时跟踪 MMLU 和 ARC 以监控通用能力。主要结果：方法在约束满足和训练稳定性上均有提升，开销可忽略，且不损失通用知识和推理能力。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看 Section 3 的三个病理形式化分析（尤其 Figure 1 的示意）和 Section 4 的三个模块技术细节。Section 5 的实验结果中关注不同模块的消融贡献分析，以及通用能力保留的证据。预计阅读时间 35-50 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构未明确标注（论文未提供）

summary_en.core_problem: When training with verifiable rewards for multi-constraint instruction following, standard GRPO's z-score group normalization exhibits three pathologies under discrete, low-variance rewards: low-variance amplification (small differences inflated into oversized advantages), mean-centering blindness (absolute reward level discarded), and zero-variance collapse (zero gradient when all samples in a group are identical), leading to unstable training and even degradation of general capabilities.
summary_en.importance: Precisely diagnoses three failure modes of GRPO under discrete rewards and proposes three independent, composable mitigation modules. This analysis has direct engineering relevance for the community broadly adopting GRPO for RL post-training (e.g., DeepSeek-R1, OpenAI o1 lineage), especially in early training phases where reward variance is typically low.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes three independent and composable modules: (1) Multi-temperature sampling: mixes high-quality and exploratory completions to increase within-group reward dispersion, preventing homogeneous groups; (2) Dual-anchor advantages: interpolates between group-relative and goal-aware advantages to restore learning signal in zero-variance and mean-centering blindness groups; (3) Prospect-theoretic shaping: bounded asymmetric shaping inspired by Kahneman & Tversky, capping update magnitudes and emphasizing violation penalties. All components are reward-source agnostic and adaptable to reward model or human feedback settings.
summary_en.experiments: Trained on 3,000 prompts covering 26 constraint types across 9 categories, all verifiable by deterministic validators (regex, parsers). Evaluated on a custom multi-constraint test set, IFEval, and FollowBench, with MMLU and ARC tracked for general capability preservation. Key result: the method improves constraint satisfaction and stability with negligible overhead, without losing general knowledge and reasoning capabilities.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (formal analysis of the three pathologies, especially Figure 1) and Section 4 (detailed design of the three modules). In Section 5, pay attention to ablation analysis of individual module contributions and the evidence for general capability retention. Estimated reading time: 35-50 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution not explicitly stated in the provided content

recommendation.zh: 用GRPO做多约束对齐的可重点看§2对z-score归一化三个病理问题的分析，改进方案可直接做ablation对比
recommendation.en: Those using GRPO for multi-constraint alignment can focus on §2's analysis of three z-score normalization pathologies, and the improvements can be directly used for ablation comparison

paper.title: Synthetic Contrastive Reasoning for Multi-Table Q&A
paper.abstract: Multi-table question answering requires models to retrieve relevant evidence, link schemas, and perform compositional reasoning across relational tables. Existing multi-table Q&A resources typically provide questions and final answers but lack reasoning supervision that explains how answers are derived. To address this gap, we construct a synthetic contrastive reasoning-trace dataset for MMQA by generating validated positive traces and plausible negative traces with heterogeneous LLMs. We then u

summary.core_problem: 多表问答（multi-table QA）缺少可学习的“推理过程监督”：现有数据多给最终答案，不给可验证的推理轨迹，也缺少“看起来合理但其实错”的负例来做偏好学习，导致模型在 schema linking、join/过滤/聚合等组合推理上容易犯隐蔽错误。
summary.importance:
属于 post-train/数据合成范畴，对预训练的直接影响有限，但对“训练信号质量”很有代表性：
- 用可验证的正轨迹 + 可信的负轨迹构造偏好对，提供比纯 Q&A SFT 更强的学习信号；
- 通过“异构 LLM 生成正/负轨迹”增强对比度，减少模型只学到生成器风格或模板；
- 结果显示 CPO 在这类结构化推理任务上比 DPO 更稳，提示偏好优化目标函数的选择会显著影响可学习性。

如果你在做 reasoning 数据合成、RLAIF/偏好学习、或把结构化外部证据纳入训练闭环，这篇的工程细节（验证、过滤、负例构造）值得借鉴。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三块：合成正轨迹、合成负轨迹、用偏好优化训练。

1) 正轨迹（positive traces）：
- 用强模型（文中主要用 GPT-4o）对给定问题 + 多张表生成 step-by-step 推理轨迹。
- 轨迹格式被强约束为 markdown 表格（Step | Output），并要求每一步显式引用 TABLE1/TABLE2，减少“凭空推断”。
- 关键是“验证”：正轨迹必须能导出 gold answer。作者不靠字符串匹配，而用 LLM-as-judge 做语义一致性判定（文中提到使用 Gemini 2.0 Flash 作为 judge），以处理别名/格式差异。

2) 负轨迹（negative traces）：
- 生成“流畅且貌似合理，但包含事实/逻辑错误”的推理过程，作为偏好学习的反例。
- 重要设计：正负轨迹由异构 LLM 生成（不同模型负责不同角色）。作者声称消融显示：同一生成器同时产正负例会降低对比信号（更像风格差异或更容易被模型投机）。异构生成让负例更“像人类会犯的错”，也更难被简单风格特征区分。

3) 训练：Contrastive Preference Optimization (CPO)
- 用（正轨迹, 负轨迹）的偏好对对开源模型做偏好微调。
- 论文同时对比 DPO，结论是 CPO 在该设置下更优。

整体取舍：用合成轨迹换取规模与覆盖面，但必须投入验证与过滤，否则会把 hallucination 作为监督信号灌进去。作者用自动 judge + 人评校准来压这个风险。
summary.experiments:
模型：Qwen3-14B、Mistral-8B、Llama-3.1-8B。

主要结论（按文中给出的幅度）：
- 相比只做 Q&A SFT，使用偏好对做 CPO 带来平均绝对提升约 9.7%–16.3%。
- 在 MMQA 上，最大绝对提升可到 21 个百分点（相对 Q&A SFT）。
- 同样的偏好对上，CPO 优于 DPO。
- 只在两表数据上训练，收益可迁移到三表样例，说明学到的不是死记模板，而是一定程度的组合推理习惯。

数据与质量控制：作者报告做了自动与人工评估来检查轨迹可靠性与多样性，并对 LLM-as-judge 组件做了与人类标注的一致性验证（细节需要看实验与附录）。此外还构造了一个来自 BIRD 的新评测集：通过“全表证据抽取”保证答案可由给定表导出，并用自动语义一致性过滤 question–SQL 不对齐。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 35–50 分钟）：
- 先看“轨迹生成规则”和格式约束（显式引用表、markdown step 表格、避免复制整行），这是它能否稳定产出可学信号的关键。
- 重点看“正轨迹如何验证”“负轨迹如何构造”以及异构生成的消融；这部分决定数据是否真的提供了对比学习信号，而不是噪声。
- 直接看 CPO vs DPO vs Q&A SFT 的主表结果，以及跨数据集/跨表数迁移实验。
- 如果你关心可复用的数据管线，去看他们从 BIRD 构造新评测集的证据抽取与一致性过滤流程，里面有不少工程化细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-table QA lacks learnable reasoning supervision: most datasets provide only final answers, not verifiable reasoning traces, and they rarely include plausible-but-wrong rationales that are crucial for preference learning. As a result, models often fail silently on schema linking and compositional operations (joins/filters/aggregations).
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a post-training / synthetic-data paper rather than a pretraining-method contribution. Its main value is as a concrete recipe for improving training signal quality: validated positive traces plus high-quality negative traces yield a stronger learning signal than plain Q&A SFT; using heterogeneous LLMs for positive vs negative generation increases contrast and reduces generator-style shortcuts; and the results suggest CPO can be more effective than DPO for this structured reasoning setting. If you work on reasoning data synthesis, RLAIF/preference tuning, or integrating external structured evidence into the training loop, the verification and filtering details are the part to steal.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The pipeline has three components: generate positive traces, generate negative traces, and train with preference optimization.

1) Positive traces:
- A strong model (primarily GPT-4o) generates step-by-step reasoning traces conditioned on the question and multiple tables.
- Output is tightly constrained: a markdown table of steps, and each step must explicitly reference which table (TABLE1/TABLE2) it uses, discouraging unsupported leaps.
- Positives are validated to lead to the gold answer. Instead of brittle string matching, they use an LLM judge for semantic equivalence (Gemini 2.0 Flash is mentioned) to handle formatting/alias variations.

2) Negative traces:
- Generate fluent, plausible rationales that contain factual or logical errors.
- Key design choice: positives and negatives are generated by heterogeneous LLMs. Their ablations reportedly show that using the same generator for both weakens the contrastive signal and makes it easier for the learner to exploit stylistic cues.

3) Training with CPO (Contrastive Preference Optimization):
- Fine-tune open-weight LLMs on (positive, negative) preference pairs.
- They also run DPO on the same pairs and report CPO performs better in this setup.

The main trade-off is scale vs noise: synthetic traces can be large and diverse, but only if you invest in validation and filtering; otherwise hallucinations become supervision. They mitigate this with automated judging plus human evaluation/calibration.
summary_en.experiments:
Models: Qwen3-14B, Mistral-8B, Llama-3.1-8B.

Reported outcomes:
- CPO over preference pairs improves over Q&A SFT by ~9.7%–16.3% absolute on average.
- On MMQA, the largest absolute gain over Q&A SFT reaches 21 percentage points.
- On the same preference data, CPO outperforms DPO.
- Training on two-table data transfers to three-table examples, suggesting the model learns compositional reasoning behaviors rather than memorizing templates.

They also introduce an evaluation set derived from BIRD: a full-table evidence extraction procedure to guarantee answer derivability, plus automated semantic-consistency checks to filter question–SQL mismatches. Trace quality is assessed via automated and human evaluation, and the LLM-judge components are validated against human annotators (details likely in experiments/appendix).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~35–50 minutes):
- Start with the trace-generation constraints (explicit table references, step-table formatting, anti-copying rules). This is what makes the synthetic supervision learnable.
- Focus on how positives are validated and how negatives are constructed, especially the heterogeneous-generator ablation.
- Jump to the main results comparing CPO vs DPO vs Q&A SFT, and the transfer experiment from two-table training to three-table evaluation.
- If you want a reusable data pipeline, read the section on building the BIRD-derived evaluation set (evidence extraction + semantic-consistency filtering).

recommendation.zh: 数据合成+CPO在后训练中的干净应用案例，消融实验可读，skim第4节异构生成器设计即可。
recommendation.en: A clean case study of data synthesis + CPO in post-training. The ablation on heterogeneous generators in §4 is worth skimming.

paper.title: Rethinking the Role of Tensor Decompositions in Post-Training LLM Compression
paper.abstract: Post-training compression is essential for deploying large language models (LLMs) under tight resource constraints. Tensor decompositions have emerged as a promising direction, offering compact parameterizations well suited to Transformer weight structures. However, existing studies evaluate these methods in narrow settings, leaving unclear whether tensorization is effective at large-scale deployment. We systematically evaluate tensor compression across dense and MoE architectures, establishing

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文重新评估张量分解在 LLM 后训练压缩中的作用。核心问题是：Tucker、Tensor Train 等张量格式在理论上有很高的压缩潜力，但在真实部署约束下，是否真的优于普通矩阵低秩分解、剪枝或带少量修复训练的方法。
summary.importance: 这是一篇偏负结果和诊断型的压缩论文。它的价值在于提醒研究者不要把 Frobenius 范数下的最优近似等同于语言模型质量保持。Transformer 权重的误差是否影响模型，取决于激活分布、残差流几何、层位置、特殊大权重以及下游 token 预测敏感性。对预训练研究的启发是，权重空间里的结构压缩如果不引入数据、激活或少量训练信号，很难稳定保持模型行为；单靠更复杂的张量参数化并不自动带来更好的压缩。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把后训练压缩方法分成几类来比较：剪枝删除相对不敏感的参数或层；矩阵分解用低秩因子近似 FFN 或注意力权重；张量分解把多头注意力、MoE 或重排后的权重张量表示为 Tucker 或 Tensor Train 形式。作者讨论了 LASER、HASSLE-free、SoLA、FLAT-LLM 等矩阵基线。LASER 是无训练、无校准的截断 SVD；HASSLE-free 用稀疏项加低秩项拟合层输出；SoLA 保留高激活范数神经元并对其余部分做 SVD，同时用整数规划分配秩；FLAT-LLM 用校准激活做注意力头 PCA 和 MLP Nyström 近似。论文随后把这些方法与 HOSVD、TT-SVD 等张量分解放在相同压缩率下比较，并用困惑度、下游准确率、轻量 LoRA repair、残差流几何和 super-weight 恢复敏感性做诊断。理论部分给出一组障碍：Frobenius 最优截断未必对激活加权误差最优，也不保证残差流方向稳定，更不能处理少数高影响权重的非均匀敏感性。
summary.experiments: 从给出的实验描述看，论文覆盖 dense 和 MoE 架构，并在困惑度、下游任务准确率以及轻量 LoRA 修复后表现上评估。主要结论是，在匹配压缩率下，张量格式没有稳定超过矩阵分解方法。Figure 1 显示中间层相对更能承受激进剪枝，早期层和后期层对 token 表示形成与最终预测更敏感，因此简单剪枝有一定效果，但压缩上限受限。Figure 2 给出的趋势是，使用校准数据或少量修复训练的方法，例如 Dobi-SVD、HASSLE-free、SoLA，性能下降明显小于纯分解方法。LASER 可以达到约 14% 的压缩率，但困惑度增加约 8，说明无数据截断 SVD 在较强压缩下代价较高。作者还报告，super-weight 的恢复对 Frobenius 最优截断很敏感，说明少数高影响参数会破坏均匀误差准则的适用性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。先看 Figure 1，理解层位置对压缩敏感性的差异。再看 Figure 2 和矩阵分解基线部分，明确无数据分解、带校准分解、少量修复训练之间的差距。张量分解实验部分重点看同压缩率比较，而不是单个方法的最好数字。诊断部分比方法公式更重要，尤其是残差流几何、super-weight 恢复、Frobenius 误差与语言建模质量错位这几条证据。理论部分可以作为辅助阅读，重点看它如何解释为什么张量分解的数学压缩优势没有直接转化为 LLM 压缩收益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether tensor decompositions are actually useful for post-training LLM compression under deployment-like constraints. Tucker and Tensor Train formats look attractive because they can represent high-dimensional tensors compactly, but the question is whether that theoretical compression translates into preserved language-model behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a negative empirical and diagnostic study. Its useful message is that Frobenius-optimal approximation of weights is a poor proxy for preserving an LLM. What matters is not only the weight error, but how that error interacts with activations, residual-stream geometry, layer position, outlier weights, and token-prediction sensitivity. For model researchers, the broader lesson is that structural reparameterization without calibration data, activation-aware objectives, or repair training is unlikely to be robust at meaningful compression ratios.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper compares several families of post-training compression. Pruning removes less sensitive parameters or layers. Matrix methods approximate individual weight matrices with low-rank or mixed sparse-low-rank structure. Tensor methods reshape or group Transformer weights into higher-order objects and apply Tucker, HOSVD, Tensor Train, or TT-SVD style approximations. The matrix baselines include LASER, which uses training-free truncated SVD; HASSLE-free, which fits a sparse plus low-rank decomposition to reduce layer-output reconstruction error; SoLA, which keeps high-activation-norm neurons dense and compresses the rest with rank allocation under a global budget; and FLAT-LLM, which uses calibration activations for attention-head PCA and MLP Nyström approximation. The study then diagnoses tensor decompositions through perplexity, downstream accuracy, lightweight LoRA repair, residual-stream behavior, and sensitivity to restoring super-weights. The theoretical discussion identifies why Frobenius-optimal tensor truncation can be misaligned with Transformer function preservation.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover dense and MoE architectures and evaluate perplexity, downstream accuracy, and the effect of a lightweight LoRA repair stage. The main reported pattern is that tensor formats do not outperform matrix counterparts at matched compression ratios. Figure 1 supports a layer-sensitivity picture: intermediate layers tolerate stronger pruning, while early and late layers are more important for representation formation and final prediction. Figure 2 shows that methods using calibration data or some repair signal, such as Dobi-SVD, HASSLE-free, and SoLA, degrade less than purely decomposition-based methods. LASER reaches roughly 14% compression but increases perplexity by about 8, which illustrates the cost of data-free truncated SVD at nontrivial compression. The diagnostic results also indicate that restoring super-weights can matter disproportionately, which is hard to reconcile with a uniform Frobenius-error objective.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient unless you are working on compression. Start with Figure 1 for the layer-sensitivity result, then Figure 2 for the comparison between training-free decomposition and calibration- or repair-aware methods. In the tensor decomposition sections, focus on matched-compression comparisons rather than isolated best cases. The most useful part is the diagnosis: residual-stream geometry, super-weight restoration, and the mismatch between Frobenius approximation and language-model quality. The theoretical section is best read after the empirical failures are clear, since it explains why tensor decompositions can have attractive approximation properties while still failing to preserve LLM behavior.

recommendation.zh: 这类负结果比又一个压缩新招更有用：先看 dense vs MoE 的对比表和理论假设，若结论站得住，很多 tensorization baseline 以后都该降权。
recommendation.en: This kind of negative result is more useful than yet another compression trick: read the dense-vs-MoE tables and the assumption analysis first; if it holds, many tensorization baselines should be mentally downgraded.

paper.title: Skill-RM: Unifying Heterogeneous Evaluation Criteria via Agent Skill
paper.abstract: Reward models (RMs) provide critical feedback signals for LLM post-training, notably in reinforced fine-tuning (RFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) pipelines. However, current reward evaluation relies on heterogeneous criteria such as rule-based verifiers, ground-truth references, procedural checklists, and complex rubrics, where a unified mechanism to integrate all types of evidence remains unexplored. To this end, we propose Skill Reward Model (Skill-RM), a unified framework that reformulates

summary.core_problem: 当前 reward model 需整合多种异构评测依据（规则验证器、参考答案、流程 checklist、复杂 rubric 等），但现有 RM 设计要么将复杂证据压缩为不可解释的标量分数，要么依赖非结构化 flat-prompting 把所有资源拼接进一个 prompt，缺乏统一的可复用抽象来编排、选择和聚合异构证据。
summary.importance: 将 reward modeling 重新表述为一个可执行的 agent skill，从被动吸收评测知识变为主动编排资源选择与执行。为 RL/RFT 的 reward 质量提供了一条更可解释且可扩展的路径。
summary.technical_approach: Skill-RM 的核心是把 reward modeling 重新定义为执行一个可复用的『Reward-Evaluation Skill』。这个 skill 遵循 agent skill 中定义的自包含文件系统包：包含 SKILL.md 主文档（编码评测流程）、辅助脚本与资源、元数据。评测时系统执行一个结构化工作流：识别适用标准、选择性调用资源、聚合标准级证据 → 最终 reward。相比 LLM-as-Judge 中的 flat-prompting（仅添加上下文）或原子工具调用（暴露独立可执行文件），skill 封装了编排逻辑——决定何时调用什么资源、如何综合输出如何综合结果。
summary.experiments: 在主流 benchmark 上进行了 best-of-N 重排序和 RFT 实验，Skill-RM 一致优于传统 judge baseline。消融实验确认收益来自 skill 介导的证据编排，而非单纯增加上下文或工具可用性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读。重点看 Introduction 中对现有 RM 痛点的分析和 Figure 1 的框架图。预计阅读时间约 15 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构作者信息未在文中明确标注。

summary_en.core_problem: Reward models must integrate heterogeneous evaluation criteria (rule-based verifiers, ground-truth references, procedural checklists, complex rubrics, etc.). Existing RM designs either compress evidence into uninterpretable scalar scores or rely on unstructured flat-prompting that concatenates all resources into a single prompt, lacking a unified, reusable abstraction for orchestrating, selecting, and aggregating heterogeneous evidence.
summary_en.importance: Reformulates reward modeling as the execution of an executable agent skill, shifting from passive absorption of evaluation knowledge to active orchestration of resource selection and execution. Provides a more interpretable and scalable path for improving reward quality in RL/RFT.
summary_en.technical_approach: Skill-RM redefines reward modeling as executing a reusable 'Reward-Evaluation Skill'. The skill follows the agent-skill abstraction: a self-contained filesystem package containing a main SKILL.md document (encoding the evaluation procedure), auxiliary scripts and resources, and metadata. At evaluation time, the system executes a structured workflow: identify applicable criteria, selectively invoke relevant resources, aggregate criterion-level evidence into a final reward. Unlike flat-prompting (merely adding context) or atomic tool-use (exposing isolated executables), a skill encapsulates orchestration logic—determining what resources to consult, when to invoke them, and how to synthesize outputs.
summary_en.experiments: Extensive experiments on major benchmarks including best-of-N re-ranking and RFT show Skill-RM consistently outperforms traditional judge baselines. Ablation studies confirm gains stem from skill-mediated evidence orchestration rather than merely increased context or tool availability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the analysis of RM pain points in the Introduction and the framework diagram in Figure 1. Estimated reading time ~15 min.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional affiliation not explicitly stated in the paper.

recommendation.zh: 将奖励建模转化为智能体任务的思路很有启发性，关注§4的动态证据聚合机制，可用于预训练后期的对齐信号优化。
recommendation.en: The idea of framing reward modeling as an agent task is insightful; focus on Section 4's dynamic evidence aggregation mechanism for alignment signal optimization in late pretraining.

The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: ASymPO: Asymmetric-Scale Policy Optimization for Asynchronous LLM Post-Training Without Behavior Information
paper.abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning can improve language-model post-training throughput by decoupling response generation from policy optimization, but stale responses introduce distribution drift. Standard behavior-corrected methods control this drift with behavior-policy probabilities, importance ratios, or clipping, which requires token-aligned, versioned, and numerically consistent behavior log-probabilities across rollout and learner systems. We ask whether asynchronous group-relative RL ca

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是异步 LLM RL post-training 里的一个很具体但很实际的问题：rollout 由旧策略生成，learner 用新策略更新时，如果完全不携带 behavior policy 信息，只用当前策略概率做 group-relative policy optimization，会出现训练不稳定。问题不只是“分布漂移”这四个字，而是更细的 response-level scale imbalance：同一组样本里，正优势和负优势样本在当前策略下的负对数概率尺度可能差很多，尤其是陈旧的负样本往往在当前模型下概率极低，于是负项损失质量远大于正项，零和 advantage 也无法带来更新平衡，最终出现 loss 被少量 stale negative responses 主导的现象。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是 pretrain recipe 论文，而是 pretrain↔post-train 接口层很有现实意义的一类工作。价值主要有两点。第一，它把异步 RL 系统里“为什么必须传 behavior logprob”这个工程习惯，拆成了一个可分析的优化问题，而不是只停留在 PPO 传统做法。第二，它提出一种只依赖 learner 侧当前策略量的替代目标，试图把 rollout-learner 接口做薄：不需要行为策略 logprob 传输、不需要严格的 policy version bookkeeping、也不需要训练精度下重算旧 logits。这对大规模后训练系统吞吐、存储、接口稳定性都有直接意义。贡献量级更像是系统友好的目标函数修正，而不是替代 PPO 的通用 RL 理论。
summary.technical_approach:
文章先把 failure mode 形式化。作者定义 response-level 的平均 token negative log-probability，并用一个正负优势两侧总 loss mass 的差值 Δθ 来衡量平衡性。标准 behavior-corrected 方法之所以稳，不只是因为 importance ratio“更正确”，而是因为它给所有样本提供了共同的 behavior reference scale，再通过 clipping 限制当前策略相对该参考的偏移，所以正负样本的损失量级不会失控。

在此基础上，作者先给出 SPO（Scaled Policy Optimization）。SPO 的想法很直接：既然不稳定主要来自 stale negative samples 更新过强，就手工缩小负优势项的权重。它能缓解问题，但规则是人工设定的，不能根据每个 response 在当前策略下的实际尺度自适应。

真正的主方法是 ASymPO。它做的是 response-level 的 asymmetric normalization：仍然只使用当前策略对整条 response 的 log-probability / NLL 尺度，但对正优势和负优势项采用不对称缩放，使得在 group-relative zero-sum advantages 条件下，正负两侧的 response-level loss contribution 可以被精确配平。直观上，当前策略下已经“很难”的 response，也就是 NLL 很大的样本，会被自动降权；而不是像 naive current-policy objective 那样让这些样本直接把梯度拉爆。文章还把 ASymPO 与 behavior-corrected GRPO、GPG、naive current-policy training 做了目标层面的对照：behavior-corrected 方法通过 ratio clipping 间接控制尺度，ASymPO 则直接在 current-policy objective 上做尺度归一。

从方法取舍看，ASymPO 放弃了对真实 behavior distribution 的显式校正，因此它不是 importance sampling 的无偏替代；它追求的是在异步大系统里，用更简单的接口换取足够稳定、足够高效的优化。这个设计目标很清楚，也和论文标题一致。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 3 个模型家族的异步数学推理 post-training，对比对象包括 naive current-policy training、GPG、behavior-corrected GRPO、SPO 和 ASymPO。全文给出的主结论是：naive current-policy objective 在异步设置下确实容易不稳，训练会被 stale negative responses 主导；SPO 能缓解，但稳定性和效果不如自适应的 ASymPO；ASymPO 在不使用 behavior logprob 的前提下，稳定性接近或优于若干带行为校正的基线，同时保留更简单的系统接口。

从论文内容看，最关键的实验不是单一 benchmark 分数，而是几类诊断：
1. loss balance / scale imbalance 的可视化，证明正负优势样本在当前策略下的 NLL 尺度确实失衡；
2. 异步陈旧度增加时，各方法稳定性的退化曲线，说明 ASymPO 对 stale rollout 更稳；
3. 与 behavior-corrected GRPO 的对比，展示在省掉行为信息后性能没有明显塌陷；
4. SPO 到 ASymPO 的消融，说明“手工压负项”不如“按 response 当前尺度自适应归一”。

你给的全文片段没有包含完整表格数字、参数量和数据规模明细，因此这里不能编造具体数值。可以确认的是，作者把系统接口复杂度也作为结果的一部分，用表格明确比较了是否需要 behavior logprob transport、training-precision recomputation、policy-version bookkeeping。这个系统层面的对照是论文的重要卖点。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Instability in Asynchronous RL，抓住论文真正指出的 failure mode：不是泛泛的 off-policy bias，而是 zero-sum advantage 在 current-policy-only 目标下不再对应 zero-sum loss mass。然后重点看定义 Δθ 的那一段，以及作者如何解释 clipping 的作用。这里是全文最有信息量的部分。

接着看 SPO 和 ASymPO 的公式定义与命题证明，重点不是推导细节，而是弄清楚它们到底在缩放什么、为什么是 response-level 而不是 token-level。最后看实验里的三类图：训练稳定性曲线、按 stale 程度分组的结果、以及接口复杂度对比表。预计 35–50 分钟能完成一次有效泛读。

如果要深挖，建议追两个问题：第一，ASymPO 的“精确平衡”是否会在长 response、重尾 reward、或 highly skewed group reward 下引入新的偏置；第二，它和更一般的 off-policy correction、V-trace 风格思想是否能结合，而不是二选一。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific failure mode in asynchronous RL post-training for LLMs. Rollouts are generated by stale policy snapshots, while optimization is performed with a newer policy. If one drops behavior-policy information entirely and optimizes a current-policy-only group-relative objective, training can become unstable. The key issue is not just generic distribution drift. It is a response-level scale imbalance: positive- and negative-advantage samples can sit at very different current-policy negative log-probability scales. In practice, stale negative samples often become extremely unlikely under the current policy, so their loss terms dominate the update even though group-relative advantages sum to zero.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it matters for the pretrain-to-post-train interface and for large-scale training systems. Its main contribution is to turn a systems pain point into an optimization diagnosis. Instead of treating behavior log-prob transport as an unquestioned requirement inherited from PPO, the paper explains what structural role behavior correction is actually playing. The second contribution is practical: it proposes a learner-only objective that removes the need for behavior log-prob transport, exact policy-version bookkeeping, and training-precision recomputation of old logits. That matters for throughput, interface simplicity, and operational robustness in large asynchronous pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper first formalizes the instability. It defines a response-level average token NLL under the current policy and introduces a loss-balance quantity, Δθ, that measures whether positive- and negative-advantage responses contribute comparable total loss mass. The central argument is that behavior-corrected methods are stable not only because they are more principled statistically, but because they impose a shared behavior-policy reference scale and use clipping to bound deviation from that reference. Once that reference is removed, zero-sum advantages no longer imply balanced optimization pressure.

The first method is SPO, Scaled Policy Optimization. SPO is intentionally simple: it weakens the contribution of negative-advantage responses, motivated by the empirical observation that stale negative samples are the main source of instability. This helps, but the scaling rule is manually designed and does not adapt to the actual current-policy scale of each response.

The main method is ASymPO. It performs asymmetric response-level normalization using only quantities available from the current policy on the learner side. The intuition is straightforward: if a response already has a very large current-policy loss scale, its contribution should be moderated automatically rather than allowed to dominate the batch. Under zero-sum group-relative advantages, ASymPO is designed to exactly balance positive and negative response-level loss contributions. This is the conceptual difference from behavior-corrected GRPO or PPO-style clipping. Those methods control scale indirectly through behavior-policy ratios and clipping; ASymPO controls scale directly inside a current-policy-only objective.

The trade-off is explicit. ASymPO is not trying to be an unbiased off-policy correction. It is a stability-oriented objective for asynchronous systems where infrastructure simplicity is part of the design target.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the instability section. The key idea to extract is that the failure is not generic off-policy bias, but the breakdown of loss balancing under a current-policy-only objective. Pay close attention to the definition of Δθ and to the discussion of what clipping is really doing in behavior-corrected methods.

Then read the SPO and ASymPO objective definitions and the balancing proof. The important question is not every algebraic step, but what exactly is being scaled and why the scaling is done at the response level rather than the token level. Finish with the experimental diagnostics: training stability curves, results stratified by staleness, and the rollout-learner interface comparison table. A solid skim should take around 35 to 50 minutes.

If you want to go deeper, two follow-up questions are worth tracking: whether exact response-level balancing introduces new bias under long responses or heavy-tailed rewards, and whether ASymPO could be combined with partial off-policy correction rather than treated as a full replacement.

recommendation.zh: 异步RL后训练的实用方法创新，无需行为logprob的设计可降低对齐pipeline部署成本，值得做小型ablation验证。
recommendation.en: Practical method innovation for asynchronous RL post-training, the behavior-logprob-free design reduces alignment pipeline deployment cost and is worth small ablation validation.

paper.title: Physics-Guided Policy Optimization with Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Self-distilled policy optimization (SDPO) has become a popular paradigm for LLM post-training, where a model learns from its own predictions conditioned on privileged information. SDPO, however, is sensitive to how much each update step should be trusted: corrections from a self-teacher can be highly informative on some batches and misleading on others, and applying them uniformly with a fixed step size can destabilize training. Drawing inspiration from viscous-fluid dynamics and formalizing the

summary.core_problem: 在 SDPO（self-distilled policy optimization）/OPD 这类“自当老师”的后训练里，teacher 信号的可靠性随训练阶段与采样前缀分布漂移而剧烈变化；如果仍用固定学习率/固定信号权重做密集 token 级纠错，容易把“有用纠错”和“噪声纠错”一视同仁，导致梯度被极端 token 奖励或错误纠错主导，出现不稳定甚至训练崩溃。论文要解决的是：如何在 SDPO 更新中为每一步/每个 batch 自适应地调节更新幅度，使训练在后期仍稳定，同时不牺牲早期的快速收益。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接贡献有限（更偏 post-train / policy optimization 稳定性），但它触及一个与持续训练/continual pretrain 共通的核心问题：当监督信号的“可信度”随时间变化时，固定步长会把优化推入不稳定区。PGPO 给出一个可实现的“信息量驱动步长调制”范式：用 teacher-student 一致性（互信息估计）作为局部可靠性指标，把它显式注入到优化动力学里。对做 RLVR/OPD/SDPO 的团队更有现实价值；对预训练研究的启发主要在于：可以把数据质量/标签可靠性/teacher 置信度统一成一个可微的步长或权重控制信号，而不是只做样本过滤。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是给每次参数更新乘一个信息调制系数 ρ_k，而不是固定学习率。论文先把 SGD/Adam 的离散更新写成 SDE 的 Euler–Maruyama 近似（弱收敛意义），用“粒子在粘性介质中运动”的类比引出非牛顿粘度：局部粘度由当前 batch 的信息量决定。

具体实现：在一次 SDPO 迭代里，student 先生成响应并得到反馈；self-teacher 在“带特权信息”的条件下给出纠错分布/信号。然后估计 student 预测与 teacher（在反馈条件下）的互信息 I_k（文中把它作为“这次纠错到底提供了多少新增信息”的代理）。最后用指数映射做步长乘子：ρ_k = min(exp(α·I_k), ρ_max)，把原本的梯度更新变成 θ_{k+1} = θ_k − η · ρ_k · g_k（对 Adam 也是等价地缩放有效步长）。

与已有稳定化手段的区别：
- 不做 hard routing（按对错分流）或 hard filtering（按置信度丢样本），而是连续地缩放更新幅度；因此在“部分有用、部分有害”的 batch 上更平滑。
- 不依赖额外 reward anchor 或外部 critic，而是用 teacher-student 的信息一致性做内生信号。
- 形式上更像“自适应全局 step-size controller”，而不是 token-level reweighting；优点是实现简单、对优化器侵入小，缺点是粒度较粗，无法直接定位到哪些 token 在制造噪声。
summary.experiments:
全文给出的实验更像 preliminary：主要展示 PGPO 在 SDPO 训练中能减少不稳定现象（如 loss spike、collapse）并保持收益。当前提供的正文片段没有给出可复述的关键数字（模型规模、数据规模、具体指标提升幅度、与哪些 baselines 的对比表格）。从叙述看，作者强调两点证据链：
1) 训练动态：互信息低的 batch 会被自动降步长，从而抑制“错误纠错/极端 token 奖励”导致的梯度爆炸；
2) 理论侧：给出 order-1 weak SDE 近似，说明这种缩放可以被解释为改变扩散/漂移项的有效强度。

如果需要判断方法是否可用，最关键的是看：互信息估计的方差、计算成本、以及在不同任务/不同 SDPO 变体（含 RLVR）下是否稳定复现。就目前文本信息，证据强度偏中等。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对 SDPO 不稳定来源的拆解：prefix drift、uniform correction、extreme token-level rewards，这部分决定它到底在解决什么。
- 重点看 Preliminaries 到算法框（PGPO pseudocode）：I_k 如何定义/估计、ρ_k 的形式、以及对 Adam 这类自适应优化器如何落地。
- 如果时间够，再看 SDE 推导相关段落与附录：它是否真的给出了可检验的预测，还是仅作为类比。

精读不建议投入太多，除非你正在做 OPD/SDPO/RLVR 的稳定训练；那时需要逐行核对互信息估计细节与额外开销，并复现其训练曲线对比。

summary_en.core_problem: SDPO/OPD-style post-training uses a self-teacher with privileged feedback to provide dense token-level corrections. As training progresses, the student’s rollout distribution drifts away from the teacher’s conditioning distribution, making some corrections highly informative and others actively misleading. Applying a uniform update magnitude (fixed LR / fixed correction weight) turns this into a credit-assignment and stability problem, often manifested as loss spikes or collapse. The paper targets a practical question: how to adapt the update size online so that SDPO remains stable in later stages without giving up early-stage gains.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a post-training stability paper rather than a pretraining recipe contribution. Still, it highlights a general optimization theme relevant to continual pretraining: when supervision reliability is non-stationary, fixed step sizes are brittle. PGPO proposes an “information-controlled step-size” mechanism, using a teacher–student mutual-information proxy as a reliability signal. The main value for pretraining researchers is conceptual: instead of hard filtering low-quality signals, treat signal quality as a continuous controller that modulates optimization dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach:
PGPO multiplies each optimization step by an information-dependent scalar. The paper frames SGD as an Euler–Maruyama discretization of an SDE (weak approximation) and borrows a viscous-fluid analogy: local viscosity (hence effective step size) should vary with how informative the current teacher signal is.

Algorithmically, for each SDPO iteration: (1) the student generates responses and receives feedback; (2) the self-teacher, conditioned on privileged feedback, produces correction targets; (3) compute an information signal I_k, described as a mutual-information estimate between the student predictions and the feedback-conditioned teacher; (4) convert it into a step-size multiplier ρ_k = min(exp(α·I_k), ρ_max); (5) scale the gradient update (or the effective step in Adam) by ρ_k.

Key distinction from common stabilizers: it avoids hard routing/filtering and instead applies smooth, batch-level attenuation/amplification; it does not require an external critic/reward anchor, relying on internal teacher–student agreement as the control signal. The trade-off is granularity: batch-level scaling is simple but cannot localize which tokens are noisy.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are presented as preliminary evidence that PGPO reduces SDPO instability (e.g., suppressing spikes/collapse) while preserving learning progress. In the provided full-text excerpt, there are no reproducible headline numbers (model size, data scale, exact metric deltas, full baseline tables). The empirical story is mainly training-dynamics driven: low mutual-information batches get down-weighted, preventing extreme token-level signals from dominating updates. For adoption, the critical missing details to verify are: how MI is estimated in practice, its variance/cost, and whether results hold across tasks and SDPO+RLVR variants.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the Introduction carefully for the failure-mode taxonomy (prefix drift, uniform correction on already-correct samples, extreme token-level rewards).
- Focus on the PGPO algorithm box and the definition/estimation of I_k; this determines whether the method is implementable.
- If relevant, check the SDE derivation/appendix to see whether it yields actionable predictions or is mainly motivational.

Deep reading is only warranted if you actively train OPD/SDPO/RLVR systems and need a lightweight stability controller; then you should audit MI estimation, overhead, and sensitivity to α and ρ_max.

recommendation.zh: 用互信息动态调节自蒸馏步长的思路挺有意思，SDE 的推导可以看看，但实验规模较小，作为 post-train 稳定性的一个 trick 备查。
recommendation.en: The idea of dynamically adjusting self-distillation step size using mutual information is interesting; the SDE derivation is worth a look, but the experiments are small-scale, keep it as a trick for post-train stability.

paper.title: From Layers to Submodules: Rethinking Granularity in Replacement-Based LLM Compression
paper.abstract: Post-training compression of Large Language Models (LLMs) removes entire architectural components, either deleting them or replacing them with fitted modules. Existing replacement-based methods share two design constraints: full-layer granularity and contiguous selection. We argue that this is overly restrictive: in fact, redundancy in pretrained transformers is not confined to contiguous regions, nor does it evenly distribute between Attention and FeedForward outputs, implying that different st

summary.core_problem: 现有基于替换的LLM训练后压缩方法都采用整层粒度、连续块选择的约束，而预训练Transformer的冗余并不局限在连续区域，注意力和前馈网络（FFN）子模块的冗余特性也存在差异，粗粒度压缩策略无法达到最优的质量-效率权衡。
summary.importance: 提出了更细粒度的压缩范式，打破了整层压缩的常规设计惯性，为LLM压缩提供了更灵活的设计空间，在高压缩率下的性能优势明显，对低资源部署场景有实用价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SubFit方法，分为选择和替换两个阶段：一是选择阶段，非连续独立选择可替换的注意力和FFN子模块，先基于校准激活的Impact得分选择注意力子模块，再在部分压缩后的模型上选择FFN子模块，让选择过程适配注意力替换带来的残差流偏移；二是替换阶段，为每个选中的子模块拟合轻量残差旁路，注意力用低秩旁路，FFN采用跨层共享低秩基的更高秩映射来控制部署成本。
summary.experiments: 在10款LLM（5个基座模型+5个指令微调变体）、5种稀疏度（12.5%到37.5%）下测试，相比现有最强基线，PPL差距在12.5%稀疏度时为0.11倍，25%时为1.92倍，37.5%时达5.69倍；25%稀疏度下是唯一能保留80%以上下游精度的方法，37.5%稀疏度下仍能保留73%以上的精度。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注子模块选择策略和不同子模块的旁路设计逻辑，以及不同稀疏度下的PPL和精度对比实验，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing replacement-based post-training LLM compression methods are constrained to full-layer granularity and contiguous block selection. However, redundancy in pretrained Transformers is not limited to contiguous regions, and Attention and FeedForward Network (FFN) submodules have distinct redundancy characteristics. Coarse-grained compression strategies cannot achieve optimal quality-efficiency trade-offs.
summary_en.importance: SubFit introduces a finer-grained compression paradigm, breaking the conventional full-layer compression design and offering more flexible design space for LLM compression. It shows significant performance gains under aggressive compression ratios, with practical value for low-resource deployment scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: SubFit follows a two-stage select-and-replace procedure: first, the selection stage performs non-contiguous, independent selection of replaceable Attention and FFN submodules. Attention submodules are selected first based on an Impact score calculated from calibration activations, then FFN submodules are selected on the partially compressed model to account for residual stream shifts caused by Attention replacement. Second, the replacement stage fits lightweight residual bypasses for each selected submodule. A low-rank bypass is used for Attention modules, while FFNs use a higher-rank mapping with a cross-layer shared low-rank basis to limit deployment cost.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 10 LLMs (5 base models + 5 instruction-tuned variants) across 5 sparsity levels from 12.5% to 37.5%. Compared to the strongest baseline, the PPL gap grows from 0.11× at 12.5% sparsity to 1.92× at 25% and 5.69× at 37.5%. It is the only method that retains over 80% downstream accuracy at 25% sparsity, and over 73% accuracy at 37.5% sparsity.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the submodule selection strategy and bypass design logic for different submodule types, as well as the PPL and accuracy comparison experiments across different sparsity levels. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但它对“冗余到底长在哪”给了比删整层更细的证据；先看子模块选择分布和 ablation，别急着信平均分。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it gives a sharper view of where redundancy actually lives; read the selection patterns and ablations before trusting the aggregate scores.

paper.title: GPTQ-intrinsic LoRA: A Near-optimal Algorithm for Low-precision Quantization with Low-rank Adaptation
paper.abstract: Post-training quantization is widely used for compressing large neural networks, but aggressive low-bit quantization can significantly degrade model quality. A common remedy is to augment the quantized weights with a low-rank correction, leading to approximations of the form $W\approx Q+LR$. In this paper, we study this low-precision plus low-rank representation through the layer-wise reconstruction objective $\|XW-X(Q+LR)\|_F^2$, where $X$ is a calibration matrix. We establish, to our knowledge

summary.core_problem: 在后训练量化（PTQ）中，极低比特（如 sub-4-bit）量化会导致模型性能严重下降。现有的低精度+低秩（Q+LR）补偿方法（如量化后进行 LoRA 微调）虽然有效，但缺乏理论基础，且通常需要额外的微调过程。
summary.importance: 首次为低精度+低秩矩阵近似问题建立了信息论下界，并提出了一种无需训练（training-free）的算法 GPTQ-intrinsic LoRA，为极低比特量化提供了理论指导和高效的实践方案。
summary.technical_approach: 从层级重建目标出发，研究 W ≈ Q + LR 的近似问题。首先在有限字母表和有界低秩补偿约束下推导了信息论下界。随后提出 GPTQ-intrinsic LoRA 算法，该算法在 GPTQ 的量化过程中直接融入低秩修正。具体而言，在逐列量化时，不仅更新未量化的权重以补偿量化误差，还同时更新低秩分量 L 和 R，从而在无需额外微调的情况下实现 Q+LR 分解。
summary.experiments: 论文提出了理论下界，并设计了具体算法。由于提供的内容未包含实验部分，无法给出具体的实验数字和消融洞察。但从引言推断，该方法旨在在极低比特下实现接近全精度模型的性能。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注理论下界的推导部分，理解低精度和低秩分量在矩阵近似中的信息论极限。其次，仔细阅读 GPTQ-intrinsic LoRA 算法的推导，特别是如何在 GPTQ 的贪心量化过程中联合优化 Q、L 和 R。

summary_en.core_problem: In post-training quantization (PTQ), aggressive low-bit quantization (e.g., sub-4-bit) leads to severe model degradation. Existing low-precision plus low-rank (Q+LR) compensation methods, such as LoRA fine-tuning on quantized models, are effective but lack theoretical foundations and typically require additional fine-tuning.
summary_en.importance: Establishes the first information-theoretic lower bounds for the low-precision plus low-rank matrix approximation problem and proposes a training-free algorithm, GPTQ-intrinsic LoRA, providing both theoretical guidance and an efficient practical solution for extreme low-bit quantization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Investigates the W ≈ Q + LR approximation problem from the perspective of a layer-wise reconstruction objective. First, it derives information-theoretic lower bounds under finite-alphabet and bounded low-rank compensation constraints. Then, it proposes the GPTQ-intrinsic LoRA algorithm, which incorporates the low-rank correction directly into the GPTQ quantization process. Specifically, during column-wise quantization, it not only updates the unquantized weights to compensate for quantization errors but also simultaneously updates the low-rank components L and R, achieving a Q+LR decomposition without the need for extra fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: The paper presents theoretical lower bounds and designs a specific algorithm. Since the provided content does not include the experimental section, specific experimental figures and ablation insights cannot be provided. However, based on the introduction, the method aims to achieve performance close to the full-precision model at extremely low bit-widths.
summary_en.reading_guide: It is recommended to focus on the derivation of the theoretical lower bounds to understand the information-theoretic limits of low-precision and low-rank components in matrix approximation. Next, carefully read the derivation of the GPTQ-intrinsic LoRA algorithm, especially how Q, L, and R are jointly optimized during the greedy quantization process of GPTQ.

recommendation.zh: 别被名字骗了，这不是又一篇“调参量化”；它把 Q+LR 这条工程路线上升到有下界/有构造的层级，建议只读理论假设+LLM 实验表看是否真落地。
recommendation.en: Not just another quantization tweak: it elevates the practical Q+LR trick with lower bounds and a constructive, training-free algorithm—read the assumptions and the LLM tables to see if it truly holds in practice.

paper.title: A Primer in Post-Training Reasoning Data: What We Know About How It Works
paper.abstract: Post-training has become a primary driver of recent progress in large reasoning models, and reasoning data are often the key variable determining whether this stage succeeds. Work on post-training reasoning data has grown rapidly, yet this literature remains scattered across dataset papers, reinforcement-learning recipes, reward-model studies, benchmarks, and frontier system reports. This paper is the first primer to synthesize over 150 key public studies and system reports on post-training reas

summary.core_problem: 后训练（Post-training）推理数据对模型能力提升至关重要，但相关研究散落在各类文献中，缺乏系统性的梳理、分类和归因框架，导致许多关于推理数据的直觉假设存在误导性。
summary.importance: 这是首篇系统性综述后训练推理数据的文献，综合了 150 多篇关键论文。它不仅是一个数据集列表，更提供了一个“归因框架”，帮助研究者理解数据对象、反馈信号、构建方法和扩展规律，对未来推理数据的构建和评估具有重要的指导意义。
summary.technical_approach: 文章围绕四个核心问题展开：1）存在哪些数据对象（基于验证器的分类：程序化验证、环境验证等）；2）是什么让数据有用（质量、难度、覆盖率的重新定义）；3）数据是如何构建的（自对弈、提示词生成、轨迹生成等）；4）收益如何扩展。特别指出了几个常见的认知陷阱，例如“长 CoT 等于好推理”、“越难的数据越好”、“数据越多覆盖越好”等，并给出了相应的纠正和未来报告建议。
summary.experiments: 作为一篇综述，本文没有提出新的实验，而是综合分析了现有文献的实验结果，提炼出关于数据质量（有效性、基础性）、难度（相对于基座模型和验证器）、覆盖率（受数据源混合、过滤、泄漏等影响）以及智能体轨迹（清理成功轨迹可能抹除关键的失败和重试信息）的深刻洞察。
summary.reading_guide: 强烈建议精读 Table 1（Counterintuitive lessons for reasoning-data attribution），它总结了该领域最常见的认知陷阱。其次，关注 Section 2 中基于验证器的分类法，这有助于理解不同数据的监督信号来源。

summary_en.core_problem: Post-training reasoning data is crucial for model improvement, but research is scattered, lacking a systematic synthesis, taxonomy, and attribution framework, leading to misleading intuitive assumptions about reasoning data.
summary_en.importance: This is the first comprehensive primer on post-training reasoning data, synthesizing over 150 key papers. It provides an 'attribution framework' rather than just a dataset list, helping researchers understand data objects, feedback signals, construction recipes, and scaling laws, which is highly valuable for future data curation and evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper organizes the field around four questions: 1) What data objects exist (a verifier-anchored taxonomy: programmatic, environmental, etc.); 2) What makes them useful (redefining quality, difficulty, and coverage); 3) How they are constructed (self-play, prompt generation, trace generation); 4) How gains scale. It specifically highlights common traps, such as 'long CoT means good reasoning', 'harder data is better', and 'more data means better coverage', providing corrections and reporting recommendations.
summary_en.experiments: As a primer, it doesn't present new experiments but synthesizes findings from existing literature. It extracts deep insights regarding data quality (validity, grounding), difficulty (relative to base model and verifier), coverage (affected by source mixture, filters, leakage), and agent trajectories (cleaning successful traces might erase crucial failure/retry information).
summary_en.reading_guide: Highly recommend closely reading Table 1 (Counterintuitive lessons for reasoning-data attribution), which distills the most common traps in the field. Also, focus on the verifier-anchored taxonomy in Section 2 to understand the sources of supervision signals for different data types.

recommendation.zh: 作为领域地图备查，重点看数据构造和 scaling 两节，对设计推理后训练数据配比有参考，不改变 prior
recommendation.en: Useful as a field map for reference; focus on data construction and scaling sections; informs reasoning post-training data design but doesn't change priors

institutions: State Key Laboratory of Multimedia Information Processing

paper.title: SafeSteer: Localized On-Policy Distillation for Efficient Safety Alignment

summary.core_problem: SafeSteer 处理的是安全对齐中的 alignment tax：常规 SFT/RLHF/DPO 类方法会在全词表、全分布上施加训练信号，安全能力提升时容易牵动通用能力。论文的核心假设是，拒答和安全相关特征在输出分布中是稀疏的，因此对齐不应被建模成全局能力权衡，而应尽量只改动与安全行为直接相关的 token 区域。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练研究的直接贡献不大，但对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有启发。它把对齐退化问题具体化为“训练信号作用范围过宽”，而不是简单归因于数据不够或 reward 设计不佳。值得关注的是两点：第一，用 activation steering 构造 self-teacher，减少对更强教师模型和 reward model 的依赖；第二，把 KL 正则限制到安全 token 子集，提供了一种更局部的分布编辑思路。这类方法可以作为持续预训练、能力修补、安全 patching 的轻量范式参考。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两步。先从基座模型中提取 refusal direction：比较模型在 harmful 与 harmless 指令上的隐藏表示，得到一个拒答方向，并在指定 Transformer 层的 residual stream 中注入该方向，形成 safety teacher。这个 teacher 会稳定地产生拒答信号，甚至会拒绝 harmless prompt；论文利用这一点来挖掘安全 token，而不是直接把它作为最终模型。随后，模型在 Alpaca harmless 指令上采样 teacher 的拒答轨迹，并与原始基座模型的输出分布做对比。论文没有简单选择 logit 差最大的 token，而是用 contrastive log probability 加 voting aggregation 来得到更稳定的安全 token 子集。训练阶段只用 100 条 PKU-SafeRLHF harmful prompt，让 student on-policy 采样响应，并仅在安全 token 子集上施加 reverse KL distillation。这样做的关键区别是：它不混入大规模通用数据，不训练额外 reward model，也不做安全梯度与通用能力梯度的正交投影，而是直接缩小蒸馏损失的支持集。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 4 个模型、7 个安全 benchmark 和 5 个通用能力 benchmark。论文报告 SafeSteer 在安全评测上优于若干已有安全对齐基线，同时通用能力下降较小。数据效率是主要实验点：OPD 阶段只使用 100 条 harmful 样本，作者称数据量低于此前基线的 1%。从给出的全文片段看，具体每个 benchmark 的分数、模型规模、消融数字没有完整展开；已有信息支持的结论是，安全 token 限域 KL、activation-steered teacher、voting 式 token selection 是主要有效组件。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Method 中三处：refusal direction 如何抽取和注入；safety token subset 如何由 teacher/base 分布对比得到；restricted reverse KL 的具体形式。实验部分优先看安全-通用能力 trade-off 曲线、token selection 消融、训练样本量消融。如果只关心预训练，可跳过大部分安全 benchmark 细节，重点思考这种“稀疏分布编辑”能否迁移到 domain patch、continual pretrain 或能力修复。

summary_en.core_problem: SafeSteer targets the alignment tax in safety tuning. Standard alignment objectives tend to apply supervision over the full output distribution, so improving refusal behavior can perturb general capabilities. The paper’s central assumption is that safety behavior is sparse in token space, and alignment should therefore make localized changes rather than optimize a global safety-versus-capability trade-off.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a pretraining method, but it is relevant to the pretrain-posttrain interface. It frames capability degradation as a support-size problem of the training signal: the loss touches too many tokens. Two ideas are useful beyond safety alignment: constructing a self-teacher through activation steering, and restricting KL distillation to a mined subset of behavior-specific tokens. This is a lightweight pattern for model patching, continual updates, and narrow behavioral edits without large auxiliary data mixtures.
summary_en.technical_approach: SafeSteer has two main stages. First, it builds a safety teacher from the base model itself. Following refusal-direction work, it contrasts hidden states on harmful and harmless instructions, extracts a refusal direction, and injects that vector into the residual stream at a chosen Transformer layer. The resulting teacher produces stable refusal-like outputs, including on harmless prompts. The method then uses teacher rollouts on Alpaca harmless instructions and contrasts the teacher distribution with the original base-model distribution. Instead of selecting tokens with the largest raw logit gaps, it aggregates contrastive log-probability evidence with a voting scheme to obtain a sparse safety-token set. During training, the student samples on-policy responses to harmful prompts from PKU-SafeRLHF, and the reverse-KL distillation penalty is applied only on that safety-token subset. The method avoids a stronger external teacher, a reward model, large general-purpose replay data, and gradient projection machinery.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover four models, seven safety benchmarks, and five general-capability benchmarks. The reported pattern is improved safety with limited degradation on general tasks. The main efficiency claim is that the on-policy distillation stage uses only 100 harmful samples, less than 1% of the data volume used by prior baselines according to the authors. The provided text does not expose the full per-benchmark table or exact model-size breakdown, so the most reliable experimental takeaway is the ablation-level message: activation-steered teaching, safety-token mining, and restricted reverse KL are the key components.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the method details for refusal-direction extraction and injection, the safety-token mining algorithm, and the exact restricted reverse-KL objective. In the experiments, prioritize the safety-versus-general-capability trade-off plots, token-selection ablations, and data-size ablations. Readers mainly interested in pretraining can skip most benchmark-specific safety discussion and examine whether sparse distribution editing can transfer to domain repair, continual pretraining, or capability-preserving patching.

recommendation.zh: 这类工作真正有用的地方不在“更安全”，而在它是否证明安全信号可以局部注入而不污染通用分布；先看成本-能力折中表，再决定要不要细读。
recommendation.en: The useful question here is not whether it is 'safer' but whether safety can be injected locally without contaminating the general distribution; read the cost-vs-utility tables first.

institutions: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: Weak Critics Make Strong Learners: On-Policy Critique Distillation for Scalable Oversight
paper.abstract: As large language models become stronger, weak supervisors may fail to provide reliable labels, preferences, or final judgments for complex outputs, limiting both weak-to-strong generalization and scalable oversight. We study a more tractable form of weak supervision: using a weak model as a critic rather than as a labeler or judge. Instead of solving the task or selecting the correct answer, the weak critic only needs to provide a non-misleading revision direction that helps the strong model be

summary.core_problem: 现有弱监督范式要求弱模型提供完整标签或最终判断，无法在任务难度超过弱模型能力时为强模型提供可靠监督。
summary.importance: 提出了更低门槛的弱监督形式，降低了弱监督者的能力要求，对可扩展对齐、弱-强泛化的训练流程设计有参考价值，也为低成本后训练监督信号构造提供了新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出弱评论者-强监督范式：弱模型不需要解决任务或判断最终答案，仅需提供不误导的修正方向即可发挥作用。首先在推理阶段验证该范式的有效性：强模型生成初始答案，弱模型给出评论，强模型基于评论修正答案，可直接提升冻结强模型的性能。进一步提出渐进式on-policy评论蒸馏（Opcd）：每个训练轮次，当前强模型生成on-policy答案，弱模型给出对应评论，用质量指标过滤出有用的评论，以接入评论的强模型为自教师提供token级监督，训练无法访问评论的强模型（学生）；每轮更新后强模型会产生新的错误模式，弱模型再生成适配的新评论，实现监督信号的自适应迭代。
summary.experiments: 在两类模型设置下验证：非思考模型用Phi-4-mini-instruct-3.8B做弱监督者、Phi-4-14B做强模型；思考模型用Qwen3-1.7B做弱监督者、搭配更强的推理模型，覆盖GPQA Diamond推理基准、IFEval指令跟随对齐基准。结果显示推理阶段的评论修正即可提升冻结强模型的性能，评论质量是核心影响因素：有用的评论稳定提分，误导性评论会导致性能下降；Opcd训练方法可在多轮迭代中持续提升强模型性能，效果优于直接蒸馏弱模型输出的标准弱-强方法。
summary.reading_guide: 先看Introduction中弱评论者范式与传统弱监督范式的核心差异，再看推理阶段验证的核心结果，最后看Opcd的迭代训练流程。预计阅读时间15分钟，无需深抠具体训练超参数，重点关注弱监督的范式转变逻辑。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing weak supervision paradigms require weak models to provide complete labels or final judgments, and cannot deliver reliable supervision for stronger models when task difficulty exceeds the weak supervisor's full capability.
summary_en.importance: It proposes a lower-barrier form of weak supervision that reduces the capability requirement for weak supervisors, offering insights for scalable alignment, weak-to-strong generalization pipeline design, and low-cost supervision signal construction for post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The weak-critic strong oversight paradigm is proposed first: the weak model does not need to solve the task or judge the final answer, and can deliver value by only providing non-misleading revision directions. Inference-time validation first confirms that weak critiques can improve the performance of a frozen strong model via a critique-and-refine workflow. Then progressive On-Policy Critique Distillation (Opcd) is introduced: in each training epoch, the current strong model generates on-policy answers, which are critiqued by the weak model. Useful critiques are filtered via an outcome-and rubric-based quality metric. The strong model with access to critiques acts as a self-teacher, providing dense token-level supervision to train the student (the same strong model without critique access). After each update, the strong model produces new error patterns, and the weak critic provides fresh adaptive critiques for the next iteration.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments run on two setups: non-thinking models use Phi-4-mini-instruct-3.8B as the weak supervisor and Phi-4-14B as the strong model; reasoning models use Qwen3-1.7B as the weak supervisor paired with a stronger reasoning model. Benchmarks include GPQA Diamond for reasoning and IFEval for instruction-following alignment. Inference-time critique-and-refine improves frozen strong model performance, with helpful critiques boosting accuracy and misleading ones hurting it. Opcd continuously improves strong model performance across training epochs, outperforming standard weak-to-strong methods that directly distill weak model responses.
summary_en.reading_guide: First review the core difference between the weak-critic paradigm and traditional weak supervision in Introduction, then check the key results of inference-time validation, and finally the iterative training workflow of Opcd. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes. No need to dive into detailed training hyperparameters, focus on the paradigm shift logic of weak supervision.

recommendation.zh: 值得看方法设定，不是因为结果多强，而是把弱监督拆成 critique quality，适合检查内部 RL 数据管线。
recommendation.en: Read for the setup rather than the scores: it isolates critique quality as a supervision signal worth auditing in RL pipelines.

paper.title: CARE-RL: Capability-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Mitigating Cross-Domain Conflicts
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards has achieved strong progress in reasoning-oriented LLMs, but extending it to multi-domain RL remains challenging due to reward unreliability in non-verifiable tasks and capability interference across domains. We propose CARE-RL to combine protocol-aware reward generation with capability-aware optimization for mitigating cross-domain conflicts. For non-verifiable tasks, the Protocol-Aware Generative Reward Model (PA-GRM) constructs prompt-level

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决多领域 RL 中两个常见冲突：非可验证任务缺少可靠 reward，导致 open-ended response 的训练信号不稳定；不同领域顺序或联合训练时，后续更新可能破坏已有能力。
summary.importance: 对预训练与 post-train 接口的启发在于，它把 reward 质量和参数更新方向放在同一个框架里处理。PA-GRM 试图让非可验证任务的评价协议随 prompt 改变，而不是用固定 rubric 评所有开放任务；DACSP 则把历史 RL 阶段的参数变化视为能力方向，在后续阶段调制梯度更新。贡献规模偏工程方法整合，实验提升幅度不大，但问题设置贴近多阶段训练中的 capability interference。
summary.technical_approach: CARE-RL 是一个 cascade multi-domain RL 框架。对可验证领域，直接使用任务 verifier；对非可验证领域，使用 Protocol-Aware Generative Reward Model。PA-GRM 分两步生成 reward：先根据 prompt 选择评价协议并构造 scoring schema，再对 candidate response 生成评分 trace 和标量 reward。协议分为 holistic 与 rubric 两类：前者适合创作、风格、整体连贯性等难以拆分的任务；后者适合有明确约束、可逐项检查的任务，例如规划类请求。优化侧是 Direction-Aware Capability Subspace Projection。每完成一个 RL 阶段，记录该阶段的参数增量，用 leading singular directions 近似该阶段获得的能力方向。后续阶段更新前，把待应用更新分解到这些历史方向上：与历史能力方向一致的分量放大，方向相反的分量抑制，正交分量保持不变。这样避免直接把所有梯度投影掉，也比简单 sequential training 更关注方向冲突。
summary.experiments: 作者在 Qwen2.5-7B 和 Qwen3-4B 上做多领域 RL，对比 joint training、sequential training 以及相关多领域 RL 基线。报告的主要结果是 CARE-RL 在平均分上超过最强基线：Qwen2.5-7B 提升 +1.0 分，Qwen3-4B 提升 +0.9 分。实验声称 PA-GRM 改善非可验证任务 reward 适配性，DACSP 缓解跨领域能力退化。需要重点核对各领域分项结果，因为平均分提升较小，方法是否真的减少 interference，要看旧领域保持率、新领域学习幅度和 PA-GRM/DACSP 分别移除后的结果。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 分钟。先看 Methodology 的整体流程图，明确 PA-GRM 负责 reward 构造，DACSP 负责 update modulation。PA-GRM 部分重点看 holistic/rubric 路由逻辑、schema 生成方式和 Appendix B 的 prompt templates。DACSP 部分重点看参数增量如何形成低秩 capability subspace，以及 aligned/opposing/orthogonal components 如何被调制。实验部分优先看每个领域的分项指标、PA-GRM 与 DACSP 消融、顺序训练下旧能力是否下降。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses two coupled problems in multi-domain RL for LLMs: open-ended tasks often lack reliable rewards, and sequential or joint optimization across domains can cause capability interference, where later updates degrade skills learned in earlier stages.
summary_en.importance: The useful angle is the joint treatment of reward construction and update direction. PA-GRM adapts the evaluation protocol to each prompt instead of applying one fixed rubric to all non-verifiable tasks. DACSP uses parameter changes from previous RL stages as low-rank capability directions and modulates later updates according to their alignment. The contribution is more of a practical framework than a new RL objective, and the reported gains are modest, but the setting is relevant to multi-stage post-training and continual adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: CARE-RL organizes training as a cascade over domains. Verifiable domains use task-specific verifiers. Non-verifiable domains use a Protocol-Aware Generative Reward Model. PA-GRM first selects an evaluation protocol and builds a prompt-level scoring schema, then scores each candidate response under that schema with a trace-conditioned generative reward. It supports holistic evaluation for tasks such as creative writing, where quality is hard to decompose, and rubric-based evaluation for tasks with explicit constraints. The optimization component, Direction-Aware Capability Subspace Projection, records the parameter delta after each completed RL stage and extracts leading singular directions as a proxy for acquired capability directions. For later stages, the proposed update is decomposed relative to these historical subspaces: aligned components are amplified, opposing components are suppressed, and orthogonal components are left unchanged.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are conducted on Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3-4B in a multi-domain RL setting. CARE-RL reports the best average score among the compared methods, improving over the strongest baseline by +1.0 points on Qwen2.5-7B and +0.9 points on Qwen3-4B. The paper attributes the gains to better reward adaptation on non-verifiable tasks and reduced cross-domain degradation from DACSP. Since the average improvements are small, the most important evidence is in the per-domain breakdown, old-domain retention after later stages, and ablations removing PA-GRM or DACSP.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 minutes. Read the methodology figure first to separate the two roles: PA-GRM constructs rewards, while DACSP modulates updates. For PA-GRM, inspect the holistic-versus-rubric routing, schema generation, scoring traces, and the prompt templates in the appendix. For DACSP, focus on how parameter deltas are converted into low-rank capability subspaces and how update components are amplified or suppressed. In the experiments, prioritize per-domain scores, ablations, and evidence of reduced forgetting under sequential training.

recommendation.zh: 多域RL对齐的能力保留思路对后训练有参考价值，重点看§3的子空间投影方法即可
recommendation.en: The capability subspace projection for multi-domain RL alignment is useful for post-training research, focus on Section 3 only.

paper.title: OPD+: Rethinking the Advantage Design for On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a widely used technique to transfer capabilities from capable teacher language models to the base student models, and can be formulated in a reinforcement learning style objective using student generated rollouts. Yet, despite the divergence reward being dependent on student model likelihood, existing works usually adopt a stop gradient design primarily for stability, which makes the resulting advantage estimation questionable. In this work, we provide a generic o

summary.core_problem: On-policy distillation（OPD）把“学生模型自己采样的轨迹”拿来做 token 级蒸馏，常被写成 RL 风格目标：reward 由学生与教师分布的 divergence 构成。实践里为了稳定，很多实现会对 reward 里的 log-ratio（或更一般的 divergence 项）做 stop-gradient，把它当常数回报来做 REINFORCE/PPO 式更新。论文要解决的是：这种 stop-gradient 在数学上是否成立？如果不成立，正确的梯度/advantage 应该怎么写，能否在不牺牲稳定性的情况下带来可观收益？
summary.importance: 这是偏 post-train 的方法论文，但对“RL/蒸馏作为持续训练信号”的研究很直接：它指出 OPD 里常见的 stop-grad 不是无害的工程技巧，而是会导致对真实目标的有偏梯度，进而影响收敛点与效果。更重要的是，它把 OPD 从“只讨论 reverse-KL”扩展到一般 f-divergence，并给出统一推导，削弱了‘KL 天然最好’的经验结论。对做预训练/中训的人，价值在于：当你把蒸馏/自举式目标混入训练（例如 mid-train、continual pretrain、teacher-student 迁移），reward 是否依赖当前策略、以及是否 stop-grad，会实质改变优化动力学。
summary.technical_approach:
核心是把 OPD 写成最小化学生分布 pθ 与教师分布 q 的 token-level f-divergence，并对“reward 依赖 θ”这一点做严格求导。
- 定义密度比 u_{θ,n} = q(y_n|prefix)/pθ(y_n|prefix)，f-divergence 目标可写成沿学生采样前缀的期望：J^f(θ)=E_{y~pθ}[∑_n f(u_{θ,n})]（文中用负号把它当 reward）。
- 现有做法：把 r^f_θ = -f(u_{θ,n}) stop-grad 成 r^f_{θ-}，只保留 score-function 项，得到类似 REINFORCE/PPO 的 advantage。
- 论文证明：对一般 f-divergence，这样会产生有偏的目标估计与梯度估计，因为 r^f_θ 显式依赖 pθ（也就是 θ）。正确梯度包含两部分：
  1) score-function 项（传统 REINFORCE 项）；
  2) direct reward-gradient 项（来自对 f(u_{θ,n}) 中 pθ 的求导）。
- 合并后，得到“正确的即时 token-level 权重/advantage”形式：w_f(u)= -f(u) + u f'(u)。这就是 OPD+ 的关键修正。
- 实现上声称只需一行代码改动：不再 stop-grad 掉 reward 的 θ 依赖（或等价地，用 w_f(u) 替换原来的 -f(u) 作为权重）。
论文还讨论了 reverse-KL（以及其他 divergence）在 stop-grad 与非 stop-grad 下的差异，强调很多经验结论其实混杂了实现细节。
summary.experiments:
从你提供的正文片段里，实验任务集中在数学推理与工具使用（tool use），结论是 OPD+ 相比带 stop-grad 的 OPD baseline 有稳定提升，并且在多种 f-divergence 选择下都观察到 stop-grad 会伤性能。作者还声称这会“挑战 KL 优于其他距离”的常识，但具体到：用了哪些 teacher/student 规模、数据量、提升幅度、以及是否有稳定性/方差的量化，需要看实验章节与附录（片段未包含具体数字）。建议重点核对：
- 是否控制了 rollout 长度、采样温度、KL/entropy 约束等影响 OPD 稳定性的因素；
- 不同 f 的对比是否在同等超参预算下进行；
- 是否报告了训练曲线方差、崩溃率或 reward 分布等稳定性证据。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
- 先读 OPD+ 推导部分：从 f-divergence 目标到正确梯度的两项分解，抓住 w_f(u)= -f(u)+u f'(u) 这一行，它解释了 stop-grad 为什么会偏。
- 再看实现细节：他们如何在 token 级计算 u=q/p、如何处理数值稳定（log-space、clamp、teacher 概率为 0 等），以及是否需要额外 baseline/归一化。
- 最后看实验：优先看 stop-grad vs non-stop-grad 的对照、不同 f 的对照、以及在 math/tool 场景下的泛化；如果有 ablation（γ、advantage 形式、重要性采样比 ρθ 等）要一起看。
如果你在做 continual pretrain 或 teacher-student 迁移：可以把这篇当作“reward 依赖策略参数时，stop-grad 会改变目标”的一个具体案例，迁移到其他自举式训练信号（例如 self-rewarding、verifier-guided）上思考。

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student from a teacher using rollouts generated by the student, often cast as an RL-style objective where the reward is a divergence between student and teacher token distributions. For stability, many implementations stop-gradient through the reward (e.g., log-ratio terms), treating it as a fixed signal. The paper asks whether this is mathematically valid, and if not, what the correct advantage/gradient should be and whether the correction improves performance in practice.
summary_en.importance: Although this sits in post-training, it is directly relevant to any setting where distillation or self-bootstrapping provides dense training signals (OPD, continual training with a teacher, mid-training with synthetic feedback). The key contribution is clarifying that stop-gradient is not just an engineering trick: when the reward depends on the current policy, stopping gradients yields biased gradients for general f-divergences and can hurt final quality. It also reframes OPD beyond reverse-KL, providing a unified f-divergence view that weakens the common “KL is best” heuristic once implementation details are controlled.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper formulates OPD as minimizing a token-level f-divergence between student p_θ and teacher q along prefixes sampled from the student.
- Define the density ratio u_{θ,n} = q(y_n|prefix)/p_θ(y_n|prefix). The objective is an expectation over student rollouts of f(u_{θ,n}) (with a negative sign interpreted as reward).
- The common baseline stops gradients through r_θ^f = -f(u_{θ,n}), yielding a REINFORCE/PPO-like estimator that only keeps the score-function term.
- The authors show this is generally biased because r_θ^f depends explicitly on p_θ (hence θ). Differentiating the true objective produces two components: (i) the score-function term and (ii) a direct reward-gradient term from ∂f(u)/∂θ.
- Combining them yields a corrected token-level weight/advantage of the form w_f(u) = -f(u) + u f'(u). This is the essence of OPD+.
- Implementation is positioned as minimal (claimed “one-line change”), effectively replacing the stop-grad reward weight with the corrected w_f(u) (or equivalently allowing proper gradient flow).
The paper further discusses how reverse-KL and other divergences behave differently under stop-grad vs correct gradients, explaining why prior empirical conclusions can be confounded by this choice.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided content, experiments focus on math reasoning and tool-use scenarios, showing consistent gains of OPD+ over stop-grad OPD across multiple f-divergences, and indicating that stop-grad can degrade performance. The excerpt does not include concrete numbers (model sizes, data scale, absolute/relative improvements, stability metrics). When reading the full paper, it is important to verify: controlled sampling settings (temperature, rollout length), any KL/entropy constraints, hyperparameter fairness across divergences, and stability evidence (variance, collapse rate, reward/ratio distributions).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the derivation section carefully: the decomposition into score-function and direct reward-gradient terms, and the final corrected weight w_f(u)= -f(u)+u f'(u). That line is the main technical payload.
- Check implementation details for numerical stability: computing u=q/p at token level, log-space handling, clipping, and whether additional baselines/normalization are used.
- Then read experiments prioritizing: stop-grad vs non-stop-grad comparisons, divergence choice comparisons under matched budgets, and any ablations on advantage design (e.g., discount γ, importance ratios).
If you work on continual pretraining or teacher-student transfer, treat this as a concrete reminder that “reward depends on policy” changes the correct gradient, and stop-grad can silently change the optimized objective.

recommendation.zh: 读目标推导即可；若内部还在用 stop-gradient OPD，这篇会改变对“稳定但无偏”的默认假设。
recommendation.en: Read the objective derivation; if your stack uses stop-gradient OPD, this changes the default assumption that the stable estimator is still unbiased.

paper.title: Dialectics of Alignment: Harnessing Unsafe Knowledge for Dynamic Safety Routing
paper.abstract: The prevailing paradigm in large language model (LLM) alignment operates via erasure, filtering unsafe data or training models to strictly refuse harmful prompts. While effective at reducing immediate toxicity, this approach fundamentally constricts the model's epistemological scope, resulting in over-cautious systems that output uninformative blanket refusals to sensitive yet benign queries. In this work, we challenge the orthodoxy that unsafe data must be discarded. We propose a dialectical ap

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个常见但少被正面拆开的对齐问题：现有安全对齐往往靠删数据、强拒答、统一压制危险话题，短期上能降有害输出，但代价是把与危险领域相关的知识也一并抹平，最后模型在敏感但正当的问题上只会给模板化拒绝。作者要解决的不是“如何让模型更会拒绝”，而是“能否保留不安全数据中的领域知识，再用很少量安全样本把这些知识重新组织成安全且有信息量的回答”。换句话说，目标是把 unsafe knowledge 从直接生成危险内容，变成受控调用的知识部件。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接意义不在于提出了新的基座训练范式，而在于它触到一个很实际的 pretrain↔post-train 接口问题：危险数据到底应被彻底过滤，还是应被结构化保留。SafeMoE 给出的答案是后者，而且用模块隔离而不是参数层面的整体遗忘。这个思路对数据配比、持续预训练、领域知识保留、以及安全对齐中的“知识损失”问题都有启发。贡献量级更接近一种有明确工程可行性的对齐结构设计，而不是会改写基座预训练主流程的方法。它的价值主要在两个点：第一，提出 unsafe data 也可作为知识源，而不是只被视为噪声；第二，用极少量安全数据训练路由器，尝试把高成本安全标注从“覆盖全部知识”降到“控制知识调用”。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 SafeMoE。它不是训练一个标准稀疏 MoE 主干，而是在共享底座模型上挂接多个 domain-specific LoRA experts，把不同危险领域中的知识分别装进低秩适配器里。这里的设计动机很清楚：如果直接把 unsafe data 混进统一参数更新，知识和行为会纠缠，后续很难只保留知识而压制危险行为；而把它们封装进专家后，至少在结构上可以把“知道什么”和“何时调用”部分拆开。

训练流程大致分两段。第一段，用不安全领域数据分别训练 LoRA expert，让每个 expert 学到某一类敏感主题的细粒度知识原语。第二段，不再主要依赖大规模安全监督去重写这些知识，而是用一个很小、人工精修的 safe response 数据集训练 router。这个 router 在推理时根据输入动态决定激活哪些专家，以及激活强度，从而把原本可能导向有害细节的知识，重组为安全、解释性更强、且不只是拒答的输出。

从全文描述看，作者强调的不是“unsafe expert 自己会变安全”，而是“unsafe expert 保留知识，安全性由路由与组合来保证”。这和常见 SFT/RLHF 直接在主模型上压行为不同，也和简单的拒答分类器不同。它更像把安全对齐做成一个受控检索/受控组合问题。另一个关键点是作者把 informativeness 明确定义为两件事：避免 blanket refusal，同时提供相关且有帮助的信息，但不泄露会造成伤害的操作细节。这个定义决定了训练目标不是单纯 toxicity minimization，而是 safety-utility trade-off 的结构化优化。

从方法边界看，这套方案依赖两个假设：一是危险知识可以按领域分解并由 LoRA 局部承载；二是少量安全样本足以学到“何时、如何调用这些知识”。如果领域边界模糊，或者危险行为与普通知识高度耦合，router 可能会变成新的脆弱点。全文里作者把这种风险部分交给人工精修的小规模安全集和人工评测来兜底。
summary.experiments:
实验结论是：SafeMoE 相比标准安全对齐基线，能明显减少空泛拒答，同时不显著放松安全边界。全文里最值得记的不是单一分数，而是实验设置本身：作者强调 router 训练只用不到 800 条安全样本，且在更激进设置下可降到约 100 条，覆盖主题也有限。这说明方法想证明的是 sample efficiency，而不是靠大规模安全数据堆出来的效果。

评测维度主要有两类。第一类是安全性：模型是否暴露危险步骤、是否给出可执行有害细节。第二类是信息量：面对敏感问题时，是否能给出解释、替代建议、风险说明、求助路径，而不是统一拒绝。作者还做了人工标注，结论与自动指标一致：SafeMoE 生成的回答更接近“安全但有帮助”的人类偏好，而不是简单更长或更委婉。

从摘要和正文可确认的关键数字只有安全样本规模这一组：少于 800 条，甚至约 100 条。全文片段中没有给出你提供材料里完整的 benchmark 名称、基座规模、各基线具体提升百分点，因此不能编造具体数值。能确定的是作者把 human annotation 作为重要证据，而不是只报自动安全分数；这说明他们知道该任务里自动指标容易把“拒答”误判成高安全。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不需要逐节深抠公式。先看 Introduction，重点理解作者为什么反对 safety-by-erasure，以及为什么把 unsafe data 视为知识资产而不是纯风险源。再看 Methodology，抓住两个结构点：unsafe knowledge 用 LoRA expert 隔离；safe behavior 用小数据 router 控制。只要这两个点想清楚，整篇方法就基本明白了。

阅读时建议重点看三处。第一，看图 1 一类的案例对比，作者如何区分 unsafe、refusal、safe-informative 三种回答，这决定了任务定义。第二，看 router 的训练数据构成和推理时的激活机制，这部分关系到方法是否真有样本效率。第三，看人工评测协议，尤其是如何同时评安全和信息量，因为这是这类工作最容易“指标好看、体验很差”的地方。

如果只花 20 到 30 分钟，建议读引言、方法总览图、实验主表和人工评测部分。若要深挖，值得追问两件事：一，LoRA expert 是否真的学到可分离的领域知识，还是只是把危险风格局部化；二，router 在分布外敏感问题上是否会失效，导致错误调用或过度保守。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode of safety alignment: current pipelines often remove unsafe data or train blanket refusals, which reduces harmful outputs but also strips away domain knowledge tied to sensitive topics. The result is an over-cautious model that refuses even benign or help-seeking queries. The actual question here is not how to refuse better, but whether unsafe data can be retained as a knowledge source and then controlled so the model answers safely and informatively rather than collapsing into generic refusal.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is indirect but real. The paper challenges the default assumption that unsafe data should simply be erased from the training pipeline. Instead, it treats such data as a high-density source of domain knowledge and moves the alignment burden to a lightweight control layer. That matters for data curation, continual pretraining, knowledge retention under alignment, and the broader question of how much useful capability is lost when safety is implemented as deletion. The contribution is better viewed as an alignment architecture with implications for pretrain/post-train interfaces, not as a new foundation-model training paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, SafeMoE, uses a shared base model plus multiple domain-specific LoRA experts. Each expert is trained on unsafe data from a particular sensitive domain, so unsafe knowledge is stored in modular adapters rather than entangled across the whole model. This is the key design choice: if unsafe data is mixed directly into the full model, knowledge and harmful behavior are hard to disentangle later; if it is bottled into experts, the system can separate knowledge storage from knowledge access.

Training appears to proceed in two stages. First, domain-specific unsafe LoRAs are trained to capture detailed knowledge primitives. Second, a router is trained on a very small, highly curated safe-response dataset. At inference time, the router decides which experts to activate and how strongly, with the goal of composing responses that remain informative while avoiding actionable harmful details.

This differs from standard SFT/RLHF-style alignment, where the main model is globally pushed toward refusal or safe behavior. It also differs from a simple safety classifier that blocks outputs after generation. SafeMoE instead frames alignment as controlled access to specialized knowledge modules. Another important detail is the paper’s explicit definition of informativeness: avoiding blanket refusal while still providing relevant, helpful content without exposing harmful instructions. That makes the objective a structured safety–utility trade-off rather than pure toxicity suppression.

The method relies on two assumptions. First, unsafe knowledge can be decomposed into domain-local experts. Second, a small safe dataset is sufficient to learn when and how to use those experts. If either assumption breaks, the router becomes the main failure point.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical claim is that SafeMoE is both safer than unsafe baselines and more informative than standard alignment baselines that default to refusal. The most concrete experimental signal from the full text provided is the data efficiency claim: the router is trained with fewer than 800 curated safe examples, and the paper suggests the setup can be pushed down to around 100 examples in a more constrained regime. That is central to the paper’s argument, because it is trying to show that expensive safe supervision can be used for control rather than for re-teaching all relevant knowledge.

Evaluation is organized around two axes. One is safety: whether the model reveals harmful procedures or operational details. The other is informativeness: whether it gives explanations, alternatives, risk framing, or support-oriented guidance instead of a flat refusal. The paper also includes human annotation, and the human judgments reportedly agree with the automatic metrics: SafeMoE better matches the preference for safe-but-useful responses.

The material provided does not include the full benchmark table, model size, or exact gains against each baseline, so those numbers cannot be stated reliably here. What is clear is that the authors do not rely only on automated safety scores, which is important because refusal-heavy systems often look artificially strong under coarse safety metrics.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction to understand the paper’s central objection to safety-by-erasure. Then read the method overview and focus on two structural ideas: unsafe knowledge is isolated in LoRA experts, and safe behavior is enforced through a small-data router. Once those are clear, most of the paper follows naturally.

Three parts deserve attention. First, the motivating examples that distinguish unsafe answers, blanket refusals, and safe-informative answers; this is where the task definition is really set. Second, the router training setup and inference-time activation logic, because that is where the sample-efficiency claim lives. Third, the human evaluation protocol, since this kind of work can otherwise optimize for metrics while degrading actual usefulness.

A practical reading plan is 20–30 minutes: introduction, method figure, main results table, and human evaluation. If reading more deeply, the two questions worth probing are whether the experts truly capture separable knowledge rather than just unsafe style, and how robust the router is on out-of-distribution sensitive prompts.

recommendation.zh: 挑战了对齐必须丢弃危险数据的固有认知，SafeMoE的门控路由设计可给后训练对齐的数据利用提供新思路，重点看门控训练部分
