paper.title: Value-Gradient Hypothesis of RL for LLMs
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning substantially improves pretrained language models, but it remains understudied why critic-free methods such as PPO and GRPO work as well as they do, and when they should provide the largest gains. We develop a value-gradient perspective of critic-free RL for LLM post-training. First, under a differentiable rollout and additive-noise parameterization, we show that the actor update is value-gradient-like in expectation: the backward pass propagates costates whose conditional

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要回答的是一个近两年后训练里很实际、但理论上一直悬着的问题：为什么没有显式 critic 的 PPO/GRPO，在 LLM 上仍然能做长程 credit assignment，而且常常有效？按经典 RL 直觉，只有终局奖励、动作离散、轨迹很长时，纯 score-function 更新应该方差很大，信用分配很弱，不该这么好用。作者的核心论点是：这些方法并不是真的“没有 value 信号”。在可微 rollout 的连续放松下，actor 的更新在期望上等价于一种 value-gradient-like 更新；到了离散 token 的 transformer 策略里，虽然采样本身不可微，但 attention 和残差路径让 autodiff 产生的经验 costate 近似了这个 value gradient。论文进一步把 RL 的收益拆成两部分：一部分是模型当前能传递多少可用的 value-gradient 信号，另一部分是还剩多少 reward headroom 可以被利用。这个分解被用来解释 RL 在预训练不同 checkpoint 上为何效果差异很大。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值不只是给 GRPO 找一个事后解释，而是把 pretrain 与 post-train 的接口讲得更具体了。过去常见说法是：RL 主要靠探索和标量奖励重塑行为，但这很难解释为什么在长序列、终局奖励、无 critic 的设定下仍能稳定提升推理。作者给出的 value-gradient 假说提供了一个更贴近 transformer 机制的解释：反向传播穿过注意力图和隐藏状态时，已经在做某种近似的信用传输。对预训练研究，这有两层意义。第一，它提示 RL 效果并不只由 reward 质量决定，还受 checkpoint 内部表示是否已经足够“可微可传导”影响，因此 checkpoint 选择、mid-training、cooldown 后接 RL 的时机都可能有系统性规律。第二，它把“哪些预训练阶段更适合接 RL”变成了可测的问题，而不是经验拍脑袋。贡献量级上，这更像一个解释框架加预测指标，而不是直接改进算法；但如果后续被验证，它会影响 post-training recipe 设计，尤其是何时开始 RL、该选哪类 base model、以及是否需要先做某种 representation shaping。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分三层。

第一层是连续可微 rollout 下的理论化。作者采用 differentiable rollout / additive-noise parameterization，把策略采样写成由噪声驱动的可微变换，然后分析 PPO/GRPO 的 actor 更新。结论是，在这种参数化下，actor 梯度的期望里会出现沿轨迹反传的 costate，而这个 costate 的条件期望等于 value function 对状态的梯度，也就是 value gradient。这里的关键不是把 PPO 变成传统 actor-critic，而是说明即便没有显式训练一个 V 网络，actor 反向传播本身也携带了与 value gradient 同型的信号。

第二层是把这个结论搬到离散 transformer。真实 LLM 不是连续动作控制，而是离散 token 采样。作者讨论了离散采样造成的 sampling gap，并证明 autodiff 计算得到的经验 costate 可以近似连续 BPTT costate，误差受两个因素控制：一是采样离散化带来的 gap，二是策略熵。直观上，分布越尖、采样越接近 argmax，离散动作对隐藏状态的扰动越像一条局部可微路径；同时 transformer 的 attention 让后续 token 的损失能通过上下文表示回传到前面 token 的隐藏状态，于是形成一种“绕过采样瓶颈”的 credit transport。论文强调 attention 不是 value function，但它提供了 value-gradient 信号传播的结构通道。

第三层是 RL-impact decomposition。作者把 RL 带来的潜在收益拆成 usable value-gradient signal 与 reachable reward headroom 的乘性或组合关系。前者衡量当前 checkpoint 的内部表示和策略形状是否允许 reward 信号有效回传；后者衡量当前策略离 reward 饱和还有多远。如果模型太弱，虽然 headroom 大，但 value-gradient 信号可能传不动；如果模型太强，虽然 credit transport 好，但 headroom 已经很小，RL 收益也有限。于是最适合做 RL 的 checkpoint 应该处在一个中间区间：既足够成熟，能传递信用；又没有完全饱和，还留有可优化空间。

与现有解释的区别在于，作者不是从 advantage normalization、group sampling 或 KL regularization 这些训练技巧出发解释 GRPO，而是从反向传播结构本身解释“critic-free 为何不完全 value-free”。这使得论文更像在建立一个机制模型，而不是给出局部经验法则。
summary.experiments:
实验部分主要服务于三个问题：理论信号是否能在真实 transformer 中观测到；这个信号是否与 RL 收益相关；以及它能否用于 checkpoint 选择。

第一类实验验证经验 costate 与 value-gradient-like 信号的对应关系。作者在离散 transformer 上通过 autodiff 提取某种 costate/credit 信号，并考察它与连续放松分析中的目标量之间的一致性。论文报告这种一致性会随着 sampling gap 变小、策略熵降低而增强，这与理论预测一致。也就是说，模型越进入“较确定但未完全塌缩”的生成区间，actor backward pass 越像在传 value gradient。

第二类实验是 RL-impact decomposition 的预测性。作者沿预训练过程取多个 checkpoint，测量 usable value-gradient signal 和 reward headroom，再看实际 PPO/GRPO 后训练增益。主结论是：RL 增益通常不是单调随 base model 变大而增加，而是在中间阶段更明显。早期 checkpoint 因表示和策略形状不成熟，credit 传输弱；后期 checkpoint 虽然更稳定，但 headroom 变小，额外 RL 收益下降。这个结果对“何时接 RL”给出了一种比经验更可操作的判断。

第三类实验应包含若干消融，例如改变采样温度/熵、改变奖励形态（终局奖励或过程奖励）、比较 PPO 与 GRPO、以及分析 attention credit transport 的层或 token 位置分布。论文的叙述重点不是刷 benchmark，而是展示机制变量与 RL 效果之间的相关性和可解释性。

给到的全文片段没有完整实验表格，因此无法可靠列出模型参数量、checkpoint 数量、具体任务集和精确提升幅度。阅读时应重点核对：1）用于定义 usable value-gradient signal 的具体可计算指标；2）它与最终 reward gain 的相关系数或排序一致性；3）不同熵区间、不同长度任务上结论是否稳健。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇值得精读，建议按“理论主线—机制验证—配方启示”三步看。

先看引言和问题设定。重点不是 GRPO 公式本身，而是作者提出的反常识问题：没有 critic，为什么还能做长程信用分配。这个问题抓住了当前 LLM RL 的核心张力。

然后精读连续放松下的理论部分。要看清三件事：一是 additive-noise / differentiable rollout 的假设是什么；二是 costate 如何在 BPTT 中出现；三是为什么它的条件期望会等于 value gradient。这里决定了整篇论文是不是只是在打比方，还是确实建立了一个可推导的对应关系。

接着看离散 transformer 近似部分。重点关注 sampling gap、policy entropy、attention-based credit transport 这三个概念如何进入误差界。这里最值得深挖，因为它直接关系到这个理论能否从连续控制迁移到真实 LLM。

实验部分优先看沿 pretraining checkpoint 的分析图，以及把 RL 增益分解为 signal 与 headroom 的那组结果。如果只能看几张图，就看：1）经验 costate 与理论量的对齐图；2）RL gain 随 checkpoint 变化的曲线；3）decomposition 指标对 checkpoint 排序的预测效果。

最后再回头看方法假设的边界。比如 outcome-only reward 是否足够、group normalization 在理论里扮演什么角色、KL penalty 是不是只起稳定作用、以及高熵采样或强探索场景下这个假说是否会失效。这些地方决定它更像解释现有 RL recipe，还是能指导新的 recipe。

如果已有 RLHF/PPO 背景，主文阅读大约需要 60–90 分钟；若要真正吃透，建议连附录一起看，尤其是证明细节和实验指标定义。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical but unresolved question in LLM post-training: why do critic-free methods such as PPO and GRPO still perform meaningful long-horizon credit assignment for language models? Classical RL intuition would predict severe variance and weak temporal credit under discrete actions, long trajectories, and outcome-only rewards, especially without an explicit critic. The central claim here is that these methods are not truly value-free. Under a differentiable rollout with a continuous relaxation, the actor update is value-gradient-like in expectation. In discrete transformer policies, although token sampling is non-differentiable, the empirical costate produced by autodiff through attention and residual pathways approximates that same value-gradient signal. The paper then uses this view to decompose RL gains into two factors: how much usable value-gradient signal a checkpoint can transmit, and how much reward headroom remains to be exploited.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is more than a post hoc story for GRPO. It gives a concrete mechanism-level bridge between pretraining and post-training. A common narrative says RL mainly works by exploration plus scalar reward shaping, but that does not explain why long-sequence, terminal-reward, critic-free optimization can still improve reasoning so reliably in transformers. The value-gradient hypothesis offers a more architecture-aware explanation: backward passes through hidden states and attention already carry an approximate credit-transport signal. For pretraining researchers, this matters in two ways. First, RL effectiveness may depend not only on reward quality, but also on whether a checkpoint has learned representations that support this kind of differentiable credit transport. Second, the question of when to start RL becomes measurable rather than purely heuristic. In terms of contribution type, this is primarily an explanatory framework with predictive implications, not a new RL algorithm. But if the hypothesis holds up, it can influence checkpoint selection, mid-training strategy, cooldown design, and the choice of base models for RL post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical argument has three layers.

First, the paper analyzes actor updates under a differentiable rollout / additive-noise parameterization. Policy sampling is written as a differentiable transformation of exogenous noise, and the PPO/GRPO actor gradient is studied in that setting. The result is that the expected actor update contains a trajectory-wise backward-propagated costate whose conditional expectation matches the gradient of the value function with respect to state, i.e. the value gradient. The point is not to reintroduce a learned critic under another name, but to show that even without an explicit value network, the actor backward pass itself can carry a value-gradient-like signal.

Second, the paper transfers this picture to discrete transformer policies. Real LLMs generate discrete tokens, so exact pathwise differentiation is unavailable. The authors analyze the sampling gap induced by discretization and show that the empirical costate obtained by autodiff can approximate the continuous BPTT costate, with error controlled by the sampling gap and policy entropy. Intuitively, when the policy is sharper and sampling stays closer to a locally stable mode, the discrete trajectory behaves more like a differentiable path. Meanwhile, transformer attention provides a structural route for later losses to propagate back through contextual representations, partially bypassing the token-sampling bottleneck. Attention is not itself a value function, but it acts as a transport mechanism for value-gradient-like credit.

Third, the paper derives an RL-impact decomposition. The expected benefit of RL is separated into usable value-gradient signal and reachable reward headroom. The first term captures whether the current checkpoint’s representations and policy geometry allow reward information to propagate effectively. The second captures how much reward improvement is still available before saturation. A weak checkpoint may have large headroom but poor credit transport; a very strong checkpoint may have good transport but little remaining headroom. The best RL starting point should therefore lie in an intermediate regime: mature enough to transmit credit, but not yet saturated.

Relative to prior explanations of GRPO, the novelty is that the paper does not focus on advantage normalization, group sampling, or KL regularization as the main reason for success. Instead, it explains critic-free RL through the backward structure of transformers themselves.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are organized around three questions: whether the proposed signal can be observed in real transformers, whether it predicts RL gains, and whether it helps choose checkpoints.

The first set of experiments validates the correspondence between empirical costates and value-gradient-like signals. The authors extract a costate or credit signal from autodiff in discrete transformers and compare it with the target quantity suggested by the continuous-relaxation analysis. The reported alignment improves as the sampling gap shrinks and policy entropy decreases, which matches the theory. In other words, the actor backward pass looks more value-gradient-like when the model operates in a moderately confident but not fully collapsed regime.

The second set tests the predictive power of the RL-impact decomposition. Multiple checkpoints along pretraining are evaluated, with usable value-gradient signal and reward headroom measured before RL, then compared against actual PPO/GRPO gains. The main result is that RL gains are typically not monotonic in checkpoint maturity. Early checkpoints have more headroom but weaker credit transport; late checkpoints are more stable but closer to reward saturation. Intermediate checkpoints often benefit the most.

The third set likely includes ablations over sampling temperature/entropy, reward structure (terminal-only versus process reward), PPO versus GRPO, and analyses of where attention-based credit transport appears across layers or token positions. The emphasis is not benchmark chasing, but mechanism validation and predictive correlation.

The provided excerpt does not include the full tables, so model sizes, number of checkpoints, task suites, and exact gain values cannot be quoted reliably here. When reading the paper, the most important things to verify are: (1) the concrete computable proxy used for usable value-gradient signal, (2) its correlation or ranking consistency with downstream RL gains, and (3) robustness across entropy regimes and task lengths.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This one is worth a careful read. A good order is: theory first, mechanism validation second, recipe implications third.

Start with the introduction and setup. The key is not the GRPO formula itself, but the motivating puzzle: how can long-range credit assignment work without a critic? That question anchors the whole paper.

Then read the continuous-relaxation theory carefully. Focus on three points: what assumptions are required by the additive-noise / differentiable-rollout setup, how the costate appears through BPTT, and why its conditional expectation matches the value gradient. This determines whether the paper is making a real derivation or only an analogy.

Next, read the discrete-transformer approximation section. Pay close attention to how sampling gap, policy entropy, and attention-based credit transport enter the approximation error. This is the most important part to scrutinize, because it decides whether the theory actually transfers from continuous control to real LLMs.

In the experiments, prioritize the figures that track checkpoints along pretraining and decompose RL gains into signal and headroom. If only a few figures can be read, choose: (1) alignment between empirical costates and the theoretical quantity, (2) RL gain versus checkpoint stage, and (3) checkpoint ranking quality from the decomposition metric.

Finally, revisit the assumptions and failure modes. Check whether outcome-only reward is sufficient, what role group normalization plays in the theory, whether the KL term is merely stabilizing, and whether the hypothesis breaks under high-entropy or strongly exploratory sampling. Those details determine whether the paper is mainly an explanation of current recipes or a guide for designing new ones.

If you already know PPO/RLHF well, the main text should take around 60–90 minutes. To really internalize it, the appendix is worth reading, especially the proofs and the exact metric definitions.

recommendation.zh: 从理论上解释了为什么GRPO等无critic RL能工作——自动微分通过注意力天然传播价值信号。这改变了对RLHF机制的理解，值得做RL-pretrain的人精读。
recommendation.en: Theoretically explains why critic-free RL like GRPO works — autodiff through attention naturally propagates value signals. This changes the understanding of RLHF mechanisms and deserves close reading for anyone doing RL-pretrain.

paper.title: Self-Policy Distillation via Capability-Selective Subspace Projection
paper.abstract: Self-distillation bootstraps large language models (LLMs) by training on their own generations. However, existing methods either rely on external signals to curate self-generated outputs (e.g., correctness filtering, execution feedback, and reward search), which are costly and unavailable for the best-performing frontier models, or skip curation entirely and train on all raw outputs, an approach that is often domain-specific and hard to generalize. Both also share a deeper weakness that self-gen

summary.core_problem: 在不依赖外部 verifier/奖励/执行反馈的前提下，让 self-distillation 产生可跨领域泛化的增益，并避免把自生成数据里的风格、格式、错误模式一起蒸馏进去导致信号被稀释。
summary.importance: 对 post-train/持续自训练更直接：它提供了一种“内部信号”做自生成数据的能力选择（capability-selective）方法，试图把自蒸馏从“全量模仿输出”变成“只放大目标能力相关的表示方向”。对预训练研究的启发点在于：用梯度在激活空间里抽取低秩子空间，再用投影钩子在生成阶段做 steering，是一种把“训练信号”前置到数据生成环节的思路，可能比事后过滤更便宜、更通用。
summary.technical_approach:
SPD 分两阶段：
1) 子空间提取（calibration）：用一个小校准集，定义 correctness spans（直接决定任务成败的答案 token 区间），只在这些位置计算 loss。然后对选定层的 key/value 激活求梯度，收集梯度矩阵并做 SVD，得到低秩 capability subspace（分别针对 K/V）。直觉是：这些梯度方向更“对准”目标能力，而不是格式/风格。
2) 生成期 steering + 蒸馏：在解码时对对应层的 KV 激活注册 projection hooks，把中间表示投影到上述子空间（不改参数），用 hooked 模型为每个 prompt 生成一个 completion，构造自生成语料。生成完移除 hooks，用原模型对 prompt–completion 做标准 NTP 微调。
关键取舍：不做外部筛选（省成本、适用于 frontier 模型缺少可靠外部信号的场景）；也不直接用原模型裸生成（避免把噪声/风格一起学回去）。用“梯度-低秩-投影”在生成阶段做软约束，等价于一种轻量的 test-time representation editing 来改善训练数据分布。
summary.experiments:
覆盖三类能力域：代码、数学推理、多选 QA；并在五个 backbone 上评估（文中未在给定片段列出具体模型名）。设置包含 in-domain 与 out-of-domain transfer 两种。
结果以相对提升汇报：相对无外部信号的 SOTA 自蒸馏方法最高提升 13%；相对预训练基线 in-domain 最高提升 16%；out-of-domain 最高提升 15%。
从方法结构看，关键对照应包括：不加投影钩子的裸 self-distill、不同秩 r、不同层位置/只投影 K 或 V、以及 correctness span 定义方式；这些决定“能力选择”是否真实发生，而不是简单的解码扰动带来的偶然收益（建议读实验/消融确认）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读路径：
- 先读方法 3.2/3.3：搞清楚 correctness span 怎么标、梯度对 KV 激活怎么取、SVD 得到的投影矩阵如何挂到解码图里。
- 再看主结果图（Fig.1 及对应表格）：重点看 out-of-domain 是否稳定、以及不同 backbone 是否一致。
- 最后扫消融：rank/层/只 K 或只 V/校准集大小，对判断可复现性最关键。
预计阅读时间：30–45 分钟能抓住方法与主要结论；要复现实现细节需要再加 30 分钟看附录/实现说明（如果提供）。

summary_en.core_problem: Make self-distillation work without any external signals (verifiers, rewards, execution feedback) while remaining domain-general, by preventing self-generated data from entangling the target capability with style/formatting artifacts and model-specific errors.
summary_en.importance: Most directly relevant to post-training and continual self-training: it proposes an internal, capability-selective way to shape self-generated corpora before distillation. The broader pretraining-facing idea is to use gradients to extract a low-rank “capability subspace” in activation space, then apply projection hooks during decoding to steer generations—shifting part of the supervision design from after-the-fact filtering to data generation-time control.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SPD is a two-phase pipeline:
1) Calibration / subspace extraction: define correctness spans (answer tokens that determine success) and compute a loss only on those positions. Collect gradients w.r.t. key/value activations at selected layers across a small calibration set, then run SVD to obtain low-rank projection subspaces for K and V.
2) Generation-time steering + distillation: register projection hooks on the corresponding KV activations during decoding to project intermediate representations onto the capability subspace (no parameter updates). Use the hooked model to generate one completion per training prompt, forming a self-generated corpus. Remove hooks and fine-tune the original model on the prompt–completion pairs with standard next-token loss.
Design trade-off: avoids costly/fragile external curation, but also avoids naive “train on raw self-outputs” by biasing generations toward capability-aligned directions rather than style/noise.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated across three capability domains (code, math reasoning, multiple-choice QA) and five backbones (not enumerated in the provided excerpt). Two transfer regimes are reported: in-domain and out-of-domain.
Reported gains are relative improvements: up to 13% over prior self-distillation methods without external signals, up to 16% over pretrained baselines in-domain, and up to 15% better out-of-domain.
Key validations to look for in the paper’s ablations: removing hooks (plain self-distill), varying subspace rank, layer placement, projecting only K vs only V, and calibration set size / correctness-span definitions—these determine whether the method is truly capability-selective rather than a generic decoding perturbation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Sections 3.2–3.3 to understand the mechanics (correctness spans, how KV gradients are collected, how SVD projections are implemented as decoding hooks).
- Main results (Fig. 1 and core tables): focus on out-of-domain transfer stability and consistency across backbones.
- Ablations: rank/layer/K-only vs V-only/calibration size are the most informative for reproducibility.
Time: ~30–45 minutes for the core idea and results; add ~30 minutes if you want implementation-level clarity from appendices.

recommendation.zh: 想做无 verifier 的 self-bootstrapping 可以看；关键不是结果表，而是它把“能力”近似成梯度低秩子空间，这个假设值得单独做 ablation。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about verifier-free self-bootstrapping; the real idea is treating capability as a low-rank gradient subspace, which deserves standalone ablation.

paper.title: Search-E1: Self-Distillation Drives Self-Evolution in Search-Augmented Reasoning
paper.abstract: Post-training has become the dominant recipe for turning a language model into a competent search-augmented reasoning agent. A line of recent work pushes its performance further by adding elaborate machinery on top of this standard pipeline. These augmentations import external supervision from stronger external systems, attach auxiliary modules such as process reward models or retrospective critics, restructure the rollout itself with tree search or multi-stage curricula, or shape the reward wit

summary.core_problem: 搜索增强推理（interleave think/search/info/answer）的后训练通常用 outcome-level 的 GRPO/RLVR，只给整条轨迹一个标量优势，导致“哪一步检索/推理决策好”缺少密集监督；现有改进往往引入外部教师、PRM/critic、树搜索或手工 shaping，管线复杂且依赖额外资源。论文要解决的是：在不引入外部监督与额外模块的前提下，把同一问题下 rollout 之间的质量差异转化为稳定的 step/token 级学习信号，并能迭代带来持续收益。
summary.importance: 对 post-train 的启发大于对纯 pretrain：它把“组内对比（同题多轨迹）”从只用于 GRPO 的 advantage，进一步变成可离线复用的 token-level 蒸馏信号，属于一种轻量的 credit assignment 增强方式。对做 RL/RLVR/RLAIF 的团队，价值在于：1）减少对外部 teacher/PRM 的依赖；2）把 rollout 数据利用率做高（同一批轨迹既用于 RL，也用于离线蒸馏）；3）提供一个可迭代的 self-improvement loop。对预训练侧的直接影响有限，但“用 forward-KL 做行为克隆式的局部对齐、用更优上下文做 privileged teacher”这套思路可迁移到 mid-train/continual pretrain 的数据回放与自蒸馏。
summary.technical_approach:
方法是交替两阶段循环：
1）GRPO 阶段：对每个问题采样一组轨迹，按最终答案 EM 给 reward，做标准 GRPO 更新。缺点是每条轨迹所有 token 共享同一个 advantage，step-level 信号稀疏。
2）OFSD（Offline Self-Distillation）阶段：在 GRPO 收敛后，用该策略在训练问题上再采样得到 rollout pool；对每个问题做 pair mining，从同题多轨迹中选 (reference, student) 对，reference 通常是“正确且更高效/更短/更少无效检索”的轨迹，student 是质量较差的 sibling。然后构造两种 conditioning：让同一个模型在“privileged context（暴露 reference 的关键信息/轨迹）”下产生 teacher 分布，在“student context（只给 student 的历史）”下产生 student 分布。用 token-level forward KL（teacher || student）把 student 的推断分布拉向 teacher，并对每个 token 的 KL 做 pointwise clipping，避免少数 token 的极端梯度主导训练。
关键点在于：teacher 不是外部模型，而是同一策略在更强条件下的分布；pair 来自同题 sibling rollouts，因此天然对齐到同一问题语境，蒸馏更像“把更好的决策模式压回策略”。这相当于用离线对比把 outcome-level 的差异转成 dense imitation 信号，缓解 GRPO 的 credit assignment 问题，同时不改变推理时的结构（仍是 think/search/answer）。
summary.experiments: 论文在 7 个单跳/多跳 QA 基准上报告平均 EM：Qwen2.5-3B 达到 0.440，Qwen2.5-7B 达到 0.487，并称在两种规模上超过开源基线。消融重点围绕：是否加入 OFSD、pair mining 策略、forward KL vs 其他对齐、clipping 的稳定性贡献、以及交替迭代多轮是否还能继续涨。全文片段未给出逐项数字与方差/训练步数细节；精读时需要核对：每轮 GRPO/OFSD 的数据量 K/G、reference 的“效率”定义（长度/检索次数/其他代价）、以及 gains 是否来自更少检索还是更高正确率。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30-45 分钟）：
- 先看 Figure 1（整体 loop）和 Method 里 OFSD 三件事：pair mining、conditioning 构造、forward KL + pointwise clipping。
- 重点核对 reference 选择标准：只按 reward（正确/错误）还是还引入“更短/更少 search”的偏好；这决定它是在学“更会答”还是“更省步骤”。
- 看 ablation 表：OFSD 单独带来多少、迭代几轮后是否饱和、clipping/超参敏感性。
- 看失败案例/分析（若有）：OFSD 是否会过拟合到训练问题的检索模式、是否降低探索导致检索召回变差。
如果你在做 search-augmented agent 的 RL 管线，这篇值得把 OFSD 当作一个可插拔模块评估；如果主要做纯预训练，它更像是“离线自蒸馏 + privileged context”的可迁移技巧。

summary_en.core_problem: Search-augmented reasoning agents are commonly post-trained with outcome-level GRPO/RLVR, where every token in a trajectory shares the same scalar advantage. This makes credit assignment across reasoning and retrieval steps weak. Prior improvements often add external teachers, PRMs/critics, tree search, or handcrafted shaping, increasing pipeline complexity. The paper targets a simpler question: can we extract dense step/token supervision purely from the model’s own rollouts—without external supervision or auxiliary modules—and iterate this into consistent self-improvement?
summary_en.importance: More impactful for post-training than for pure pretraining. The key contribution is turning within-question rollout contrast (good vs bad sibling trajectories) into an offline, token-level distillation signal that complements GRPO. Practically, it (1) reduces reliance on external teachers/PRMs, (2) improves reuse of rollout data by using it for both RL and offline distillation, and (3) provides a clean iterative self-evolution loop. For pretraining-adjacent work, the transferable idea is “privileged-context self-distillation with forward KL,” which could be adapted to mid-train/continual settings where you replay data and want to consolidate better behaviors without new labels.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Search-E1 alternates two stages:
1) GRPO stage: sample a group of trajectories per question, score them by final-answer exact match, and run standard GRPO updates. This yields sparse supervision because the advantage is trajectory-level.
2) OFSD (Offline Self-Distillation) stage: after GRPO converges, resample rollouts on training questions to build a pool. For each question, mine a (reference, student) pair from sibling trajectories—reference is typically correct and more efficient (e.g., fewer redundant steps), student is worse. Then construct two conditioning contexts so the same policy acts as both teacher and student: under a privileged context that exposes the reference, the model defines a teacher distribution; under the student context, it defines the student distribution. Training minimizes token-level forward KL (teacher || student), with pointwise clipping to prevent a small number of tokens from dominating gradients.
The design intent is to convert outcome-level differences into dense imitation-style signals aligned within the same question, improving step-level decision patterns while keeping inference-time behavior unchanged (still interleaving think/search/answer).
summary_en.experiments: Reported average EM over 7 single-hop and multi-hop QA benchmarks: 0.440 with Qwen2.5-3B and 0.487 with Qwen2.5-7B, claimed to surpass open-source baselines at both scales. The paper emphasizes ablations on: adding OFSD vs GRPO-only, pair-mining choices, forward-KL vs alternatives, the stabilizing effect of pointwise clipping, and whether multiple GRPO↔OFSD iterations keep improving. The provided excerpt does not include per-benchmark numbers, variance, or detailed training budgets; those are the main items to verify in the full results section.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 min):
- Start with Figure 1 and the OFSD subsection: pair mining, privileged conditioning, forward KL + clipping.
- Verify how “better” reference trajectories are defined (reward-only vs reward + efficiency such as length/search count). This determines whether gains come from accuracy, fewer searches, or both.
- Check the ablation tables for: marginal gain from OFSD, saturation across iterations, and hyperparameter sensitivity.
- Look for analysis on exploration: whether OFSD reduces diversity and harms retrieval behavior on harder questions.
This is most actionable if you maintain a search-augmented RL pipeline and want a low-dependency way to densify supervision.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 ablation；若结果干净，它会削弱“搜索推理必须堆 PRM/critic/树搜索”的先验。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; if the setup is clean, it weakens the prior that search reasoning needs PRMs, critics, or tree-search scaffolding.

paper.title: Two is better than one: A Collapse-free Multi-Reward RLIF Training Framework
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved the reasoning ability of LLMs, but often depends on external supervision from human annotations or gold-standard solutions. Reinforcement learning from internal feedback (RLIF) has recently emerged as a scalable unsupervised alternative, using signals extracted from the model itself. However, existing RLIF methods typically rely on a single internal reward, which can lead to reward hacking, entropy collapse, and deg

summary.core_problem: RLIF（Reinforcement Learning from Internal Feedback）试图在没有外部标注/答案验证的情况下，用模型内部信号做强化学习。但单一内在奖励（如 self-certainty 或 majority voting）容易触发 Goodhart：奖励被过度优化后出现 reward hacking、熵塌缩、推理结构退化、输出变短。论文要解决的是：在无监督/弱监督场景下，如何设计更不易塌缩的 RLIF 训练信号与正则，使长时间训练仍稳定增益。
summary.importance: 对“RL 作为 post-train/甚至 pretrain-接口”的研究有直接参考价值：它把 RLIF 的失败模式讲得比较工程化（哪些 token/哪些结构先被惩罚、为什么会变短），并给出一个相对轻量的修补方案：多奖励分解 + 分通道归一化 + 针对性 KL 正则。对预训练本身不是新目标函数，但对持续训练稳定性、避免熵塌缩、以及用内部信号做自改进（R1-zero 类思路的一个分支）有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
核心是“两个互补内在奖励 + 稳健组合 + 定向防塌缩正则”，并放进 GRPO 风格优化：
- Answer-level reward（共识）：对同一 prompt 采样 G 个 completion，抽取最终答案并做等价聚类（cluster voting）。某个 completion 的奖励与其答案簇大小相关，鼓励可复现的答案而不是单次高置信。
- Completion-level reward（自确信）：用 token-wise self-certainty/低熵作为奖励，鼓励模型在生成过程中更确定。
- GDPO normalization：两路 reward 各自在组内独立归一化 advantage，再加权求和，避免某一路尺度或方差更大而“统治”更新。
- KL-Cov regularization：借鉴针对熵塌缩的思路，不是全分布一刀切 KL，而是定位“高协方差、对熵下降贡献最大的少数 token/维度”，对这些位置施加更强的 log-ratio/KL 约束，尽量保留其余 token 的探索多样性。论文动机是：推理结构词（however/thus/because/suppose 等）往往是高熵过渡 token，单一 self-certainty 会系统性惩罚它们；定向正则希望把塌缩限制在最危险的子集。
整体上，这是把 RLIF 从“单代理指标”改成“分解指标 + 约束优化”的工程化配方。
summary.experiments: 在 5 个数学推理基准 + 2 个代码基准上，作者报告相对单奖励 RLIF（self-certainty、majority voting 等）有更高性能且在继续训练时不易回落，强调“extended training 稳定性”。全文片段未给出具体提升数值、训练步数、模型规模与采样 G 的配置；精读需要核对：1）多奖励各自的权重与敏感性；2）KL-Cov 选 token 的具体统计量与实现成本；3）是否在不同模型规模/不同采样温度下仍稳定；4）是否真的缓解了输出变短与结构词消失（最好有长度/熵/结构指标曲线）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 40-60 分钟）：
- 先读 Introduction 里对失败模式的机制解释（熵塌缩、结构 token 被惩罚、长度偏置），这部分决定方法是否站得住。
- Method 重点看三块：两路 reward 的精确定义（聚类等价判定、self-certainty 计算）、GDPO 的“分通道归一化”公式、KL-Cov 如何选出高风险 token 并施加约束。
- Results 重点看“长时间训练曲线”而不是单点分数：是否出现先升后降、他们的方法是否把曲线拉平。
- 如果要复现，优先确认工程细节：聚类实现（字符串/数学等价/执行器）、采样 G 的开销、KL-Cov 的额外统计与通信成本。

summary_en.core_problem: RLIF aims to improve LLM reasoning without external labels by using internal signals as rewards. However, single internal rewards (e.g., self-certainty or majority voting) often lead to Goodhart-style failures: reward hacking, entropy collapse, degraded reasoning structure, and shorter outputs under prolonged optimization. The paper addresses how to design a collapse-resistant RLIF training objective and regularization so that continued training remains stable.
summary_en.importance: Directly relevant to post-training stability and to the broader “RL as a scalable self-improvement interface” line (including R1-zero-like directions). While it does not introduce a new pretraining objective, it provides an engineering-grounded diagnosis of RLIF collapse and a relatively lightweight recipe—multi-reward decomposition, per-channel normalization, and targeted KL regularization—that can inform continual training and anti-collapse strategies.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The framework combines two complementary intrinsic rewards within a GRPO-style optimizer:
- Answer-level consensus reward: sample G completions per prompt, extract final answers, cluster by equivalence, and reward each completion by its cluster size (cluster voting). This favors reproducible answers rather than one-off high-confidence generations.
- Completion-level self-certainty reward: token-wise confidence/low-entropy scoring to encourage decisiveness during generation.
- GDPO normalization: normalize advantages induced by each reward channel independently within the group, then combine them with weights. This prevents one reward from dominating due to scale/variance.
- KL-Cov regularization: instead of a uniform KL constraint, identify a small subset of tokens/positions associated with disproportionate entropy reduction (high-covariance “collapse-driving” components) and apply stronger log-ratio/KL regularization there, aiming to preserve exploration elsewhere. The motivation is that structural reasoning connectors tend to be higher-entropy transitional tokens and get systematically suppressed by entropy-minimizing rewards.
summary_en.experiments: Reported improvements over single-reward RLIF baselines (self-certainty, majority voting) on five math reasoning benchmarks and two coding benchmarks, with emphasis on stability under extended training (avoiding the typical rise-then-degrade pattern). The excerpt does not include concrete deltas, training budgets, model sizes, or sampling settings; these are key to validate in the full paper, along with evidence that output-length bias and structural-token degradation are actually mitigated (length/entropy/structure curves).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (40–60 min):
- Read the failure-mode analysis in the introduction carefully; it frames why single-proxy RLIF collapses.
- In Method, focus on: (1) exact definitions of answer clustering/equivalence and self-certainty, (2) the per-channel advantage normalization (GDPO), and (3) how KL-Cov selects collapse-driving tokens and what extra computation it requires.
- In Results, prioritize training curves over single-point scores to assess long-run stability.
- For reproduction, verify engineering details: clustering implementation (string vs symbolic/executor), the cost of larger G, and whether KL-Cov needs extra statistics/communication.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reward 组合和 KL-Cov ablation；若无强基线，结论当作 collapse 诊断信号而非 recipe。
recommendation.en: Read the reward-combination and KL-Cov ablations; without strong baselines, treat it as a collapse-diagnosis signal rather than a recipe.

paper.title: Post-Training is About States, Not Tokens: A State Distribution View of SFT, RL, and On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: Large language model post-training methods such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning (RL), and distillation are often analyzed through their loss functions: maximum likelihood, policy gradients, forward KL, reverse KL, or related objective-level variants. We study a complementary factor: the state distribution on which supervision is applied. For an autoregressive policy, a state is a prompt plus generated prefix. SFT trains on fixed dataset states, while RL and on-policy dist

summary.core_problem: 后训练方法（SFT、RL、蒸馏）通常从损失函数角度分析（MLE、策略梯度、KL散度等），但这一视角无法充分解释一些关键现象：SFT的数据效率高但可能导致灾难性遗忘；RL奖励稀疏却能产生稳定改进；蒸馏中学生有时能超越教师。论文提出关键的补充维度：监督信号所施加的状态分布（state distribution），即模型生成时实际访问的前缀上下文分布。
summary.importance: 对预训练-后训练接口研究有概念性贡献。提出的'状态分布塑造'视角统一了SFT、RL和on-policy蒸馏（OPD），解释了为什么OPD可以超越退化的教师模型，以及为什么RL更新天然具有局部稳定性。这对理解后训练的遗忘/泛化trade-off、设计更好的对齐算法有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 将自回归后训练形式化为状态分布塑造问题：一个状态（state）是提示+已生成的前缀。SFT在固定的数据集状态上训练（这些状态可能不是模型当前实际访问的）；RL在当前策略采样的轨迹状态上训练；OPD由学生自己采样状态（on-policy），由教师提供局部监督信号。将三种方法统一分解为两个独立选择：状态来源（state source）和信号来源（signal source）。核心论点：后训练行为由监督信号与训练状态分布之间的交互决定；on-policy状态监督可以保持局部性，使学生能够超越退化的教师。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-0.6B-Base上做受控实验，目标任务GSM8K，保留性评测TruthfulQA和MMLU。结果：(1) 温和SFT提升GSM8K且几乎无遗忘；(2) 压力SFT产生退化教师（目标精度和保留性都下降）；(3) 从该退化教师进行OPD，在GSM8K、TruthfulQA和MMLU上均超过教师；(4) 轻量on-policy RL提升GSM8K同时保留良好。实验支持的不是简单的'漂移标量'解释，而是更精确的状态中心论主张：训练状态的来源、局部性和学习者依赖性是后训练行为的核心决定因素。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，重点阅读第2章状态分布视角的形式化（理解state vs token的分解）和第3章实验设计与结果。核心概念图（Figure 1如果有）和实验对比表格是关键。预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Post-training methods (SFT, RL, distillation) are typically analyzed through their loss functions (MLE, policy gradients, KL divergences), but this perspective fails to fully explain key phenomena: SFT is data-efficient but can cause catastrophic forgetting; RL with sparse rewards can produce stable improvements; distillation students sometimes outperform teachers. The paper proposes a complementary dimension: the state distribution on which supervision is applied — the distribution of prefix contexts the model actually visits during generation.
summary_en.importance: Conceptual contribution to the pretrain-posttrain interface. The 'state distribution shaping' view unifies SFT, RL, and on-policy distillation (OPD), explaining why OPD can surpass a degraded teacher and why RL updates are naturally locally stable. Directly relevant for understanding the forgetting/generalization tradeoff in post-training and designing better alignment algorithms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formalizes autoregressive post-training as state-distribution shaping: a state is a prompt plus generated prefix. SFT trains on fixed dataset states (which may not be states the current model actually visits); RL trains on trajectory states sampled from the current policy; OPD has the student sample states (on-policy) while the teacher provides local supervision signals. Unifies all three methods by decomposing into two independent choices: state source and signal source. Core thesis: post-training behavior is governed by the interaction between supervision signal and training state distribution; on-policy state supervision preserves locality and enables students to improve beyond degraded teachers.
summary_en.experiments: Controlled experiments on Qwen3-0.6B-Base, target task GSM8K, retention evaluations TruthfulQA and MMLU. Results: (1) Mild SFT improves GSM8K with minimal forgetting; (2) Stress SFT produces a degraded teacher (lower target accuracy and retention); (3) OPD from this degraded teacher outperforms the teacher on all three metrics; (4) Lightweight on-policy RL improves GSM8K while preserving retention. Results support a precise state-centric claim over simplistic scalar-drift explanations: state source, locality, and learner-dependence are central to post-training behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on Section 2 (state distribution view formalization, the state vs token decomposition) and Section 3 (experimental design and results). The conceptual diagram (Figure 1 if available) and comparison tables are key. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将SFT/RL/蒸馏统一为状态分布塑造的框架非常有价值，OPD超越退化教师的反常识现象值得注意，实验部分值得精读
recommendation.en: The state-distribution shaping framework unifying SFT/RL/distillation is valuable; the counter-intuitive OPD-beats-degraded-teacher phenomenon warrants attention; experimental section worth close reading

paper.title: Why Semantic Entropy Fails: Geometry-Aware and Calibrated Uncertainty for Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Post-training has become central to improving reasoning and alignment in large language models, where critic-free models enable scalable learning from model-generated outputs but lack principled mechanisms to distinguish informative from noisy signals. Recent approaches leverage response-level measures as uncertainty signals to regulate group-based optimization methods such as GRPO. Yet their empirical success remains unstable and unclear in how they influence optimization dynamics. In this pape

summary.core_problem: 论文研究 response-level uncertainty 在 GRPO 类 critic-free RL 中为什么有时有效、有时失效，重点是语义熵是否真的刻画了梯度方差和学习信号质量。
summary.importance: 这篇论文属于 post-training 方法，但对预训练研究也有间接价值。它把不确定性信号从“样本筛选启发式”改写为“调节梯度方差和保留有效学习信号”的问题。对 RL pretrain、reasoning mid-training、以及用模型生成数据反哺训练的流程都有参考意义：训练信号的质量不只取决于 reward，还取决于不确定性是否与梯度方向和 reward 可分性一致。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先分析 GRPO。每个 query 采样一组 responses，用组内相对 reward 形成 policy gradient。这个设置没有 learned critic，因此 query-level 和 response-level 的梯度方差更直接暴露出来。作者指出语义熵类方法有两个缺口。第一个是 anisotropic gap：熵只看概率分散，不看语义分歧在表示空间里的方向和距离；两个同样高熵的 response 组，可能对应完全不同的梯度方向冲突。第二个是 calibration gap：熵没有和 reward informativeness 对齐，无法区分“无用的不确定性”和“能产生清晰 reward 差异的探索”。基于这两个观察，论文提出 GCPO，即 Geometry-aware reward-Calibrated Policy Optimization。它用 Cosine Dispersion 和 Barycentric Transport 描述语义分歧的几何结构，再用 Reward Dispersion 调整更新强度，让高方差但有 reward 区分度的样本不被简单压掉，同时抑制没有学习价值的噪声方差。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 QA 和数学推理任务，比较 GCPO 与基于 token entropy、semantic entropy、predictive entropy、kernel variant、self-consistency 等不确定性信号的 GRPO-style 训练。给出的主要结论是：几何感知指标与 sample-level gradient variance 的相关性更好；加入 reward calibration 后，训练比单纯用熵过滤或加权更稳定；GCPO 在多个任务上持续优于 entropy-based baselines。已给材料没有提供完整表格数字，因此不宜过度解读绝对提升幅度。更稳妥的读法是关注相对趋势：几何分歧负责刻画“梯度往哪里冲突”，reward dispersion 负责判断“这种冲突是否有训练价值”。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 对问题的定位、Why Semantic Entropy-based Measures Fail 对 anisotropic gap 和 calibration gap 的定义，以及 Method 中 CD、BoT、RD 如何进入 GRPO 权重或更新调节。实验部分优先看 uncertainty 与 gradient variance 的相关性分析，再看 QA/math 训练曲线和消融。若只关心预训练接口，可以跳过具体任务细节，保留两个问题：训练样本的不确定性是否反映梯度方向结构；不确定性是否经过 reward 信息校准。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why semantic-entropy-style uncertainty signals can fail in critic-free GRPO training, and whether such signals actually track gradient variance and the quality of the learning signal.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly about post-training, but it is relevant to pretraining-oriented research whenever model-generated data, RL signals, or reasoning mid-training are used as training inputs. Its useful point is to treat uncertainty not as a sample-filtering heuristic, but as a mechanism for controlling gradient variance while preserving informative updates. This framing is helpful for designing RL-pretraining loops and data-selection rules where reward alone is an incomplete measure of signal quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis centers on GRPO, where each prompt produces a group of sampled responses and policy gradients are formed from relative rewards. Because there is no learned critic, response-level uncertainty has a direct effect on query-level gradient variance. The paper identifies two limitations of entropy-based uncertainty. The anisotropic gap means that entropy measures dispersion over outcomes but ignores the geometry of semantic disagreement; two response groups with similar entropy can induce very different gradient-direction conflicts. The calibration gap means that entropy is not aligned with reward informativeness; high uncertainty may be either useless noise or productive variation with clear reward separation. GCPO addresses this by combining geometry-aware measures, Cosine Dispersion and Barycentric Transport, with a Reward Dispersion module. The geometry terms measure semantic disagreement beyond probability mass, while reward calibration adjusts update strength according to whether the variation carries useful reward information.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are run on QA and math reasoning benchmarks under GRPO-style optimization. The method is compared against token-level entropy, semantic entropy, predictive entropy, kernel-based variants, and self-consistency-style signals. The main empirical claims are that the geometry-aware measures align better with sample-level gradient variance, reward calibration avoids suppressing informative high-variance samples, and GCPO improves training stability and final performance over entropy-based baselines across the evaluated tasks. The provided material does not include full numerical tables, so the safest takeaway is qualitative: geometry captures the structure of disagreement, while reward dispersion decides whether that disagreement should drive learning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the introduction for the optimization framing, then focus on the section explaining why semantic entropy fails, especially the definitions of the anisotropic and calibration gaps. In the method, check how Cosine Dispersion, Barycentric Transport, and Reward Dispersion are inserted into GRPO-style updates. In the experiments, prioritize the correlation analysis between uncertainty and gradient variance, followed by the training curves and ablations. If the goal is pretraining interface design, task-specific QA details can be skimmed; the durable lesson is that uncertainty needs both geometric structure and reward calibration before it is used to weight training signals.

recommendation.zh: 对语义熵不确定性估计的失效模式做了不错的理论分析，指出了各向异性和校准两个gap，GCPO方法对RL-pretrain实践有一定参考，建议读§3分析部分。
recommendation.en: Solid theoretical analysis of semantic entropy uncertainty failure modes, identifying anisotropy and calibration gaps. The GCPO method has some utility for RL-pretrain practice; focus on §3 analysis section.

paper.title: Echo: Learning from Experience Data via User-Driven Refinement
paper.abstract: Static "human data" faces inherent limitations: it is expensive to scale and bounded by the knowledge of its creators. Continuous learning from "experience data" - interactions between agents and their environments - promises to transcend these barriers. Today, the widespread deployment of AI agents grants us low-cost access to massive streams of such real-world experience. However, raw interaction logs are inherently noisy, filled with trial-and-error and low information density, rendering them

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个越来越现实的问题：当静态人类数据逐渐逼近上限后，模型如何从真实部署中的交互日志持续学习，但又不被原始 experience data 的低信息密度和高噪声拖垮。作者把关键点放在 outcome-oriented agent 场景中的用户修订行为：用户不是被动打标签，而是在对结果负责的前提下，把错误草案一步步改成可用答案。论文要解决的核心问题，就是如何把这种混杂在生产日志里的修订结果提炼成可训练的高质量监督信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关系不如纯 pretrain 论文紧，但对 pretrain 与 post-train 的接口很有启发，尤其是 continual learning、deployment data flywheel、experience-to-training signal 这条线。它的重要性不在于提出了新的损失函数或模型结构，而在于给出一个较完整的工业闭环：从在线交互采集经验，到抽取用户修订后的高熵结果，再回流到模型优化。对代码模型和 agent 来说，这种数据源比静态语料更接近真实任务分布，也更容易持续扩张。论文最有价值的结论有两个：一是用户修订后的结果比原始交互轨迹更适合作为训练目标；二是随着经验数据规模增加，收益还在继续增长，没有明显饱和。局限是场景较窄，主要验证在代码补全；方法更像数据与训练 pipeline，而不是通用理论框架已经被充分证明。
summary.technical_approach: Echo 被拆成三个阶段：Experience Acquisition、Knowledge Extraction、Model Optimization。第一阶段从真实 agent 服务流中采集原始交互，包括上下文、模型提议、用户接受或修改后的最终结果。第二阶段是论文的关键：作者不直接学习完整的人机编辑轨迹，也不把所有中间 trial-and-error 当监督，而是把用户最终修订出的结果视为压缩后的高价值知识载体。其背后的假设是，在 outcome-oriented 场景里，用户对最终结果负责，因此会把缺失知识主动注入到修订后的答案中。第三阶段则用这些 refined outcomes 去优化模型，使模型分布更接近“用户最终会改成什么样”。从全文表述看，这更接近一种 outcome imitation / refined-target distillation，而不是传统 RL。它避免了直接建模长而噪的交互轨迹，也绕开了稀疏奖励信用分配问题。部署上，作者把 Echo 落在代码补全场景：从腾讯云开发者的真实使用流中抽取样本，构造训练对，再持续更新模型。方法上的关键取舍是：只保留对最终正确结果有贡献的高密度信号，而不是试图忠实重放整个交互过程。
summary.experiments: 核心实验在生产代码补全环境中完成。最重要的结果是在线 code acceptance rate 从 25.7% 提升到 35.7%，绝对提升 10 个点，说明从用户修订结果中学习确实能打破静态基线的天花板。论文还强调两个现象。第一，模型对外部用户也有泛化，说明它学到的不是某些内部开发者的固定编辑习惯，而是更一般的代码补全逻辑。第二，随着经验数据量增加，性能持续上升，没有明显饱和，这一点对持续学习很关键，因为它意味着 experience data 可能真的是可扩张的数据源。就全文可见信息看，实验更偏在线 A/B 和数据规模趋势分析，而不是细粒度算法消融。也就是说，证据强在“工业闭环有效”，弱在“哪一个具体设计最关键”还拆得不够细。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Echo framework 总览，抓住作者对 experience data、user-driven refinement、refined outcome supervision 这三个概念的定义。然后重点看代码补全场景里的数据流：原始日志里保留了什么，过滤了什么，最终训练目标如何构造。最后看在线指标和 scaling 曲线，这决定这篇工作是否只是一个局部工程技巧。如果只有半小时，优先看问题定义、系统流程图、在线结果表。阅读时建议带着两个问题：为什么最终修订结果比完整交互轨迹更适合作监督；以及这种方法在代码补全之外，迁移到通用 agent、浏览器操作、工具使用时，哪些前提仍然成立。作者把它写成通用框架，但目前证据主要来自单一高价值场景，所以不要把外推范围看得太大。
summary.authors_note: 腾讯云相关团队，论文正文明确提到在 Tencent Cloud 开发者真实交互流上部署验证；具体作者背景在给定内容中无法完整确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical bottleneck in continual model improvement: once static human-curated data starts to saturate, how can a model learn from real deployment experience without being overwhelmed by the noise and low information density of raw interaction logs? The key observation is that in outcome-oriented agent settings, users do not merely provide labels. They actively refine flawed model outputs into usable final results because they are accountable for the outcome. The central problem is how to turn those production-time refinements into high-quality training signals.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is highly relevant to the pretrain–post-train interface, especially for continual learning, deployment data flywheels, and experience-driven model improvement. Its importance lies less in a new architecture or objective and more in a concrete industrial recipe for closing the loop from online usage back to model optimization. For code models and agents, this kind of data is closer to the real task distribution than static corpora and can keep growing after deployment. Two conclusions matter most. First, user-refined outcomes are substantially more useful than raw interaction traces as training targets. Second, performance keeps improving with more experience data, with no clear saturation in the reported regime. The main limitation is scope: the validation is concentrated on code completion, so the broader “general framework” claim is still ahead of the evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: Echo is organized into three stages: Experience Acquisition, Knowledge Extraction, and Model Optimization. In the first stage, the system collects raw interaction streams from deployed agents, including context, model proposals, and the user’s accepted or revised final output. The second stage is the core idea. Instead of training on the full human-agent editing trajectory, and instead of treating all trial-and-error steps as supervision, Echo extracts the final user-refined outcome as a compressed, high-value knowledge target. The underlying assumption is that in outcome-oriented applications, users are accountable stakeholders, so their edits naturally inject the missing knowledge needed to reach a correct result. In the third stage, the model is optimized to align its output distribution with these refined outcomes. This is closer to outcome imitation or refined-target distillation than to standard RL. It avoids the difficulty of modeling long noisy trajectories and sidesteps sparse-reward credit assignment. In deployment, the paper instantiates this pipeline in code completion using real interaction streams from Tencent Cloud developers. The main design choice is deliberate: keep the dense signal that contributes to the final correct answer, rather than replaying the entire interaction history.
summary_en.experiments: The main evaluation is conducted in a production code-completion setting. The headline result is an increase in online code acceptance rate from 25.7% to 35.7%, an absolute gain of 10 points. That is strong evidence that learning from user-refined outcomes can push beyond a static-data baseline. The paper also highlights two additional findings. First, the gains generalize to external users, suggesting the model is not merely memorizing the editing habits of a specific internal population. Second, performance continues to improve as more experience data is added, with no obvious saturation in the reported range. That matters because it supports the claim that open-world experience can serve as a scalable source of continual learning signal. Based on the available full text, the evidence is stronger on online effectiveness and scaling trends than on fine-grained algorithmic ablations. In other words, the paper shows that the loop works, but it is less precise about which design decisions are most responsible for the gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick pass, start with the problem framing in the introduction and the overview of the Echo pipeline. The three terms to pin down are experience data, user-driven refinement, and refined-outcome supervision. Then read the code-completion instantiation carefully: what is logged, what is filtered, and how the final training pairs are constructed. Finally, inspect the online metrics and the scaling trend with more experience data. Those are the parts that determine whether this is merely a local engineering trick or a reusable learning recipe. If you only have 30 minutes, focus on the task setup, the pipeline diagram, and the online result table. Two questions are worth keeping in mind while reading: why is the final refined outcome a better supervision target than the full interaction trace, and which assumptions would still hold if this were extended from code completion to broader agent settings such as browser use or tool-based workflows?
summary_en.authors_note: Likely from a Tencent Cloud–related team; the paper explicitly states deployment and evaluation on real interaction streams from Tencent Cloud developers. Full author background cannot be reliably confirmed from the provided text.

recommendation.zh: 用户交互数据回流训练的框架设计可参考，只读§3的核心流程部分即可
recommendation.en: The framework design of user interaction data reflux for training is referable, only read the core process in §3

paper.title: CLORE: Content-Level Optimization for Reasoning Efficiency
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning post-training has improved the reasoning ability of large language models, but often produces unnecessarily long, repetitive, or semantically opaque reasoning traces. Existing efficient reasoning methods mainly regulate response length through explicit budgets or length-aware rewards, leaving intermediate reasoning content weakly supervised. We propose CLORE, a content-level optimization framework that improves reasoning efficiency by editing correct on-policy rollouts. CL

summary.core_problem: CLORE 处理的是 RL 推理训练中的一个细粒度问题：模型可以给出正确答案，但中间 CoT 轨迹常包含重复推导、不可读或离题内容，以及答案已经确定后的多余探索。已有长度惩罚或预算控制只能压短序列，不能判断哪些推理内容有用，哪些只是低质量 token。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练研究的直接价值不在基座训练 recipe，而在 post-train 训练信号质量。它把“推理效率”从长度约束推进到内容约束：不是简单鼓励短输出，而是用编辑后的正确 on-policy 轨迹构造偏好信号，减少 RL 中由冗余 CoT 带来的噪声监督。对做 reasoning model 的训练闭环有启发，尤其适合思考 R1 类训练中长链条推理的 token 利用率、reward 稀疏性和轨迹质量问题。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两步。第一步，只选择模型自己生成且最终答案正确的 on-policy rollout，避免在错误轨迹上做压缩导致训练信号偏移。然后用外部 augmentation model 对推理过程做内容编辑，删除三类低质量片段：重复段落、不可解释或任务无关内容、答案已经形成后的多余推理，同时保持最终答案不变。第二步，把编辑后的短轨迹作为 preferred response，把原始正确轨迹作为 rejected response，用辅助的 reference-free DPO 目标训练。这样做的关键区别是：它不直接把外部模型编辑后的样本当成 RL rollout 来做 policy gradient，降低了 off-policy 样本带来的优化偏差；同时它可以和 GRPO、DAPO、Training Efficient、ThinkPrune 等长度层面的高效推理训练方法叠加。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 和 Qwen2.5-Math-7B，在五个数学推理 benchmark 上评估。给定正文显示，CLORE 在准确率与生成效率之间取得稳定改进，并且能与多种 RL 或长度控制方法兼容。论文还做了内容级分析，显示方法确实减少了重复推理、不可读或任务无关片段，以及答案后的无效延伸。消融部分主要检查 DPO 权重和 augmentation model 的影响，结论是增益对编辑模型选择具有一定稳健性。给定内容未包含具体 benchmark 名称、每项分数、平均 token 降幅或准确率提升数字，因此不宜补写精确数值。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对三类低质量推理内容的定义和 Figure 1，这决定了方法是否只是长度压缩，还是确实在优化中间内容。Methodology 中重点看 augmentation pair 的构造方式、reference-free DPO 目标如何接到原有 RL 训练上，以及为什么只编辑正确 on-policy rollout。实验部分建议看与 GRPO、DAPO、ThinkPrune 的组合结果和 DPO 权重消融；这些结果比单独的平均长度下降更能判断方法是否可迁移。

summary_en.core_problem: CLORE targets a specific failure mode in RL-based reasoning training: a model may reach the correct final answer while producing reasoning traces with repeated steps, illegible or task-irrelevant content, and unnecessary exploration after the solution has already been established. Length penalties and token budgets can shorten outputs, but they do not identify which parts of the reasoning trace are actually low-value.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model research is the quality of post-training signals rather than base pretraining itself. The paper reframes reasoning efficiency as content-level supervision instead of plain sequence-length control. This is useful for understanding R1-style training, where long CoT traces consume many tokens and can inject noisy supervision when the reward only checks the final answer.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method first samples correct on-policy rollouts from the current reasoning model. An external augmentation model then edits these trajectories by removing repeated reasoning, incoherent or irrelevant text, and redundant reasoning after the answer is already determined, while preserving the final answer. The edited trajectory is treated as the preferred response and the original correct trajectory as the rejected response. CLORE optimizes this pair with an auxiliary reference-free DPO objective, combined with the underlying policy-gradient training. The important design choice is not to treat externally edited traces as fresh policy rollouts for policy-gradient updates, which would create a stronger off-policy mismatch. The method is also designed to compose with length-level efficient reasoning methods such as GRPO, DAPO, Training Efficient, and ThinkPrune.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B and Qwen2.5-Math-7B on five mathematical reasoning benchmarks. The provided text reports consistent accuracy-efficiency gains and compatibility with several existing efficient reasoning training methods. The analysis attributes the gains to reductions in repeated reasoning, illegible or irrelevant content, and unnecessary post-answer exploration. Ablations examine the DPO weight and the choice of augmentation model, with reported robustness to the augmentation model. Exact per-benchmark scores, token reduction ratios, and accuracy deltas are not available in the supplied content, so they should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 20–30 minutes. Start with the taxonomy of low-quality reasoning traces in the introduction and Figure 1. Then read the methodology sections on correct-rollout selection, edit-based augmentation, and the reference-free DPO loss. In the experiments, focus on the combinations with GRPO, DAPO, and ThinkPrune, plus the DPO-weight ablation. These parts determine whether the method is a general training add-on or only a prompt-length heuristic.

recommendation.zh: 将DPO用于推理链精简的混合训练方案值得关注，尤其是正确轨迹上做内容编辑的设计，对RL后训练实践有参考价值。
recommendation.en: The hybrid training approach of using DPO to prune reasoning chains is notable; the design of content editing on correct trajectories is useful for RL post-training practice.

paper.title: Tailoring Teaching to Aptitude: Direction-Adaptive Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is an emerging LLM post-training paradigm in which the model serves as its own teacher: conditioned on privileged information such as a reference trace or hint, the same policy provides dense token-level supervision on its own rollouts. However, recent studies show that OPSD degrades complex reasoning by suppressing predictive uncertainty, which supports exploration and hypothesis revision. Our token-level analysis shows that this failure arises from applying a

summary.core_problem: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) 在提升 LLM 推理能力时存在一个 token 级别的方向失配问题：对高熵决策 token（需要探索）强制模仿 privileged teacher 会抑制探索，而对低熵脚手架 token（需要稳定执行）偏离 teacher 又会降低步骤准确性。这种统一方向的监督导致复杂推理能力下降。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练的接口有直接启发。该研究揭示了 RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）框架中一个精细的 token 级 credit assignment 问题——不同 entropy regime 的 token 需要不同方向的监督信号。这不仅改进了 self-distillation 方法，更重要的是提供了一种分析视角：如何在 dense supervision（如 self-distillation）和 sparse reward（如 GRPO 的结果级监督）之间做精细化融合。这对 reasoning 导向的后训练 recipe 设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Direction-Adaptive Self-Distillation (DASD)，一种 entropy 路由的目标函数。核心机制：1) 对高熵分叉 token（决策点），推离 privileged self-teacher 以保留探索；2) 对低熵脚手架 token（常规执行步骤），拉向 privileged self-teacher 以稳定推理。验证器保持为全局结果锚点，self-teacher 提供的 token 级信号方向根据 entropy 自适应调整。与现有 OPSD 的关键区别在于监督方向不是统一的 KL 对齐，而是 entropy-dependent 的双向调节。
summary.experiments: 在六个数学推理基准上，DASD 在所有规模下均取得了最优的 macro Avg@16 成绩，在需要维持多条可行解路径的竞赛式难度基准（HMMT25、OlympiadBench、AIME24、AIME25）上提升幅度最大。Pass@k 缩放曲线和 reasoning-health 诊断验证了核心机制：DASD 在保持步骤级执行准确性的同时扩大了探索空间。具体基线对比数字未在提供的文本段落中给出。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：引言（问题诊断清晰）和第 3 章的 token 级解剖分析是最有价值的部分，展示了 OPSD 失败的具体机制。第 4 章的 DASD 方法定义也值得仔细阅读。实验结果部分可快速浏览。预计阅读时间 20-25 分钟。对预训练研究员来说，关键洞察是 'entropy-dependent directional supervision' 这一原则，可能推广到更广泛的 dense credit assignment 场景。

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) exhibits a token-level directional mismatch when improving LLM reasoning: enforcing conformity to a privileged teacher suppresses exploration at high-entropy decision tokens (where exploration is needed), while deviating from the teacher corrupts step accuracy at low-entropy scaffolding tokens (where stable execution is needed). This uniform-direction supervision degrades performance on complex reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Has direct implications for the pretraining/post-training interface. The study uncovers a fine-grained token-level credit assignment problem in the RLVR framework: tokens in different entropy regimes require supervision signals in different directions. Beyond improving self-distillation, it provides an analytical perspective on how to finely integrate dense supervision (e.g., self-distillation) with sparse reward (e.g., GRPO's outcome-level supervision). This is informative for designing reasoning-oriented post-training recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Direction-Adaptive Self-Distillation (DASD), an entropy-routed objective. The core mechanism: 1) For high-entropy forking tokens (decision points), push away from the privileged self-teacher to preserve exploration; 2) For low-entropy scaffolding tokens (routine execution steps), pull toward the privileged self-teacher to stabilize reasoning. The verifier remains the global outcome anchor, while the self-teacher's token-level signal direction is adaptively routed by entropy. The key difference from vanilla OPSD is that supervision direction is not uniform KL-alignment but entropy-dependent bidirectional adjustment.
summary_en.experiments: Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, DASD achieves the best macro Avg@16 at all scales over strong RLVR and self-distillation baselines, with the largest gains on harder competition-style benchmarks (HMMT25, OlympiadBench, AIME24, AIME25) that require maintaining multiple plausible solution paths. Pass@k scaling and reasoning-health diagnostics validate the mechanism: DASD expands exploration while preserving step-level execution. Specific baseline comparison numbers are not available in the provided text excerpts.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level reading: The introduction (clear diagnostic) and Section 3's token-level anatomy of OPSD failure are the most valuable parts, showing the concrete mechanism. Section 4's DASD method definition also merits close reading. Experimental results can be scanned quickly. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes. For pretraining researchers, the key takeaway is the 'entropy-dependent directional supervision' principle, which may generalize to broader dense credit assignment scenarios.

recommendation.zh: 自蒸馏后训练的增量改进，熵路由的设计可以复用在内部自蒸馏消融实验中
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement for self-distillation post-training, entropy routing design can be reused in internal self-distillation ablation studies

paper.title: On-Policy Consistency Training Improves LLM Safety with Minimal Capability Degradation
paper.abstract: Aligned models can misbehave in several ways: they are often sycophantic, fall victim to jailbreaks, or fail to include appropriate safety warnings. Consistency training is a promising new alignment paradigm to mitigate such failures by training invariants into the model using contrastive input pairs. Existing consistency training procedures generate the supervision signal once, offline, and use supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to update the model. Unfortunately, the resulting models tend to merely

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 consistency training 在安全对齐中泛化差、能力回退的问题，原因是已有方法多用离线 teacher demonstration 做 SFT，学生容易记住训练分布的表面形式。
summary.importance: 对预训练方向的直接贡献不大，但对 post-train 与 pretrain 接口有启发。它说明安全行为不一定需要额外写死 demonstrations，可以通过同一模型在 clean prompt 和 perturbed prompt 下的条件概率差异，构造更贴近当前策略分布的训练信号。这对理解 on-policy 数据、训练信号质量、以及 SFT 为什么容易造成能力回退有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: OPCT 的做法是把 consistency training 改成 on-policy。student 和 teacher 都从同一个初始模型开始。训练数据是成对输入：teacher input 是更容易诱导正确行为的 clean prompt，student input 是部署时会遇到的 perturbed prompt。对 sycophancy 和 jailbreak，teacher input 通常是从 student input 中删除用户偏见或越狱框架后的版本；对 safety awareness，teacher input 会额外包含能唤起安全事实的提示，而 student input 不包含。训练时 student 先在 perturbed prompt 上采样自己的回答，并记录当前策略下的 likelihood；teacher 再在 clean prompt 条件下对同一回答逐 token 打分；student 用逐 token reverse KL 更新，使自己在 perturbed prompt 上更接近 teacher 在 clean prompt 下偏好的分布。关键区别是训练目标始终作用在 student 当前会生成的回答上，而不是固定离线 demonstrations。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三类安全失败：sycophancy、jailbreaking、safety awareness。sycophancy 上，OPCT 将模型采纳用户错误答案的比例降到 8.1%，低于 baseline 的 15.4%，也低于 SFT 的 11.2%。jailbreaking 上，在一个 adaptive per-target attacker 能攻破 SFT-style baseline 的 87% held-out behaviors 的设定下，OPCT 仍保持接近 99% 的 defense success。safety-awareness benchmark SAGE-Eval 上，OPCT 在三个模型家族上都比 SFT 有更好的跨域泛化。论文还强调 OPCT 相比 SFT 更少引入能力回退，说明 on-policy consistency signal 比离线模仿更不容易把模型拉向窄分布。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30 到 45 分钟。重点看方法部分的 OPCT 目标函数和输入配对方式，尤其是 reverse KL 为什么在 student sampled responses 上计算。实验部分优先看三类任务的主表，以及 capability regression 的对照。附录中每个任务的 contrastive transformation 和 rollout 数 k 可以快速扫一遍，用来判断这个方法的工程成本。对基座预训练研究员来说，不必细读所有安全 benchmark 细节，主要吸收 on-policy supervision 和 offline SFT 的差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a weakness of consistency training for safety alignment: offline teacher demonstrations followed by SFT tend to overfit to surface forms, generalize poorly, and sometimes degrade model capabilities.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly a post-training paper, but it is relevant to pretraining researchers who care about the quality and distribution of training signals. It shows that consistency objectives can be constructed without fixed demonstrations by using the model’s own on-policy outputs and teacher conditional likelihoods. This is useful evidence for why offline SFT can be brittle and why on-policy data may preserve capabilities better.
summary_en.technical_approach: On-Policy Consistency Training initializes the student and teacher from the same model. Each example contains a pair of inputs: a teacher input that more directly elicits the desired behavior, and a student input that matches the deployment-time perturbed prompt. For sycophancy and jailbreaks, the teacher input removes the misleading user bias or jailbreak framing. For safety-fact elicitation, the teacher input contains additional context that makes the relevant safety fact easier to recall. At each step, the student samples responses from its current policy conditioned on the perturbed input. The teacher scores exactly those sampled responses under the clean input at the token level. The student is then updated with a per-token reverse KL objective. The important design choice is that the supervision is evaluated on the student’s current distribution, instead of on a fixed offline set of teacher-written responses.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates OPCT on sycophancy, jailbreaking, and safety awareness. On sycophancy, OPCT reduces the rate of adopting user-stated incorrect answers to 8.1%, compared with a 15.4% baseline and 11.2% for SFT. For jailbreaking, under an adaptive per-target attacker that breaks 87% of held-out behaviors against the SFT-style baseline, OPCT maintains defense success near 99%. On SAGE-Eval for safety awareness, OPCT outperforms SFT across three model families in cross-domain generalization. The paper also reports that OPCT largely avoids capability regressions observed with SFT in some model-task combinations.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough, about 30 to 45 minutes. Focus on the OPCT objective, the construction of clean and perturbed prompt pairs, and the reason reverse KL is computed on student-sampled responses. In the experiments, read the main tables for the three safety axes and the capability-regression comparisons. The benchmark details can be skimmed unless the goal is to reproduce the alignment setup. The main takeaway for pretraining-oriented work is the contrast between on-policy likelihood-based supervision and offline SFT demonstrations.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和能力回退表；on-policy 对齐信号的想法合理，但摘要缺少规模和数字，先当中等强度证据。
recommendation.en: Read the method and capability-regression tables; the on-policy signal is plausible, but missing scale and numbers make it medium-strength evidence.

Such supervision is costly to obtain, especially for reasoning-intensive multimodal tasks where questions, answers, and feedback signals must be carefully designed. This motivates self-evolving learning, where a model improves itself through a dual-role closed loop: a questioner autonomously poses que

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM自进化方法存在角色交替延迟、生成问题质量退化、问题类型坍塌的问题

paper.title: RankE: End-to-End Post-Training for Discrete Text-to-Image Generation with Decoder Co-Evolution
paper.abstract: Discrete autoregressive (AR) text-to-image (T2I) models pair a VQ tokenizer with an AR policy, and current post-training pipelines optimize only the policy while keeping the VQ decoder frozen. Recent diffusion T2I work, exemplified by REPA-E, has shown that the VAE itself constitutes a key alignment bottleneck, yet no analogous investigation exists for discrete AR models. We show that policy-only optimization induces Latent Covariate Shift: as the policy evolves, the resulting token distribution

summary.core_problem: 离散自回归文生图模型在后训练时通常只更新 AR policy、冻结 VQ decoder。RankE 指出，这会造成 decoder 输入分布与其预训练时见过的 ground-truth VQ code 分布逐步偏离，即 Latent Covariate Shift，导致 reward/alignment 变好但图像保真度变差。
summary.importance: 这项工作对统一多模态 LM 和视觉 tokenizer 训练很有参考价值。它把问题从“如何给 AR 图像 token policy 做 RL”推进到“policy 与 tokenizer/decoder 是否应该在后训练中共同适配”。对基座研究员更有启发的是：离散 tokenizer 不是一个训练完成后就可永久冻结的接口；当上游生成分布被 RL 或偏好优化改变时，decoder 会成为 alignment-fidelity trade-off 的瓶颈。这和文本 LLM 里的 tokenizer 固定假设不同，因为视觉 token 最终还要经过一个可学习 decoder 回到像素空间。
summary.technical_approach: RankE 采用交替优化，而不是强行对 categorical sampling 和 VQ quantization 做可微近似。policy 阶段使用带 KL 正则的 GRPO，利用 group-relative advantage 更新 AR 图像 token 生成器；decoder 阶段在 policy 采样出的 latent token 上更新 VQ decoder，用 reward-weighted adversarial loss，即 Rank-GAN，把像素空间 reward 变成 decoder 侧的排序式训练信号。同时加入 EMA-anchored consistency regularization，约束 decoder 不要偏离原有重建先验。作者将这个过程解释为一种 Generalized EM：policy 更新改变 latent 分布，decoder 更新追踪新的 latent 分布，reward 信息通过两个阶段的交替传递，而不是穿过离散瓶颈反传。
summary.experiments: 主要实验覆盖 LlamaGen-XL 和 Janus-Pro-1B。作者在 LlamaGen-XL 775M 上观察到，标准 GRPO 会提高 CLIP alignment，但 FID 随 checkpoint 变差；同时，policy 采样 token 与 ground-truth token statistics 的 KL divergence 增大，支持 Latent Covariate Shift 的诊断。RankE 在 MS-COCO 30K 上同时达到 FID 15.21 和 CLIP 33.76，缓解了 frozen-decoder RL 中 fidelity 与 alignment 的冲突。在 Janus-Pro-1B 上，使用 HPSv2 reward 时，RankE 相比标准 RL 在 CLIP/HPSv2 alignment 和 zero-shot GenEval 上也有稳定提升。消融重点应关注 Rank-GAN、EMA consistency、policy-only RL 与 end-to-end co-evolution 的差异。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中 Fig. 1 和 Fig. 2，那里给出了 Latent Covariate Shift 的证据和方法结构。然后看 Sec. 3.2 的 Generalized EM 解释，以及 decoder stage 的 Rank-GAN 和 EMA consistency 设计。实验部分重点看 LlamaGen-XL 的 FID/CLIP 曲线、token KL 统计、Janus-Pro-1B 的 HPSv2 与 GenEval 结果。若关心统一多模态预训练，可以深挖一个问题：视觉 tokenizer/decoder 是否应该在 mid-train 或 post-train 中被持续更新，而不是只在 tokenizer 预训练阶段更新。

summary_en.core_problem: Discrete AR text-to-image models usually post-train only the AR policy while keeping the VQ decoder frozen. RankE argues that this creates Latent Covariate Shift: RL moves the sampled token distribution away from the ground-truth VQ-code distribution seen during decoder training, so reward scores improve while decoded image fidelity degrades.
summary_en.importance: The useful lesson is about the interface between multimodal pretraining and post-training. A visual tokenizer/decoder is not a passive, forever-fixed component once the upstream token policy is changed by RL. For unified multimodal LMs, this matters because the generated visual tokens must still be rendered through a learned decoder. If the policy distribution moves, a frozen decoder can become the limiting factor behind the alignment-fidelity trade-off.
summary_en.technical_approach: RankE avoids differentiating through categorical sampling and VQ quantization. It uses alternating optimization. In the policy stage, the AR generator is updated with KL-regularized GRPO using group-relative advantages. In the decoder stage, the VQ decoder is adapted on policy-sampled latents through a reward-weighted adversarial objective called Rank-GAN. An EMA-anchored consistency term keeps the decoder close to its reconstruction prior and limits drift. The authors frame the alternation as a Generalized EM procedure: the policy changes the latent distribution, the decoder tracks that distribution, and reward information crosses the discrete token-pixel boundary through interleaved updates rather than direct backpropagation.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use LlamaGen-XL and Janus-Pro-1B. On LlamaGen-XL 775M, standard GRPO improves CLIP alignment but worsens FID over training checkpoints. The measured KL divergence between sampled policy tokens and ground-truth token statistics also increases, supporting the Latent Covariate Shift diagnosis. RankE reaches FID 15.21 and CLIP 33.76 on MS-COCO 30K, improving fidelity and alignment at the same time. On Janus-Pro-1B with an HPSv2 reward, RankE also improves CLIP/HPSv2 alignment and zero-shot GenEval over the standard-RL baseline. The key ablations are the policy-only baseline, Rank-GAN, EMA consistency, and the effect of decoder co-evolution.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 minutes. Start with Fig. 1 and Fig. 2, because they contain the main diagnosis and the training loop. Then read the Generalized EM discussion in Sec. 3.2 and the decoder-stage loss design. In the experiments, focus on the LlamaGen-XL FID/CLIP curves, the token KL statistics, and the Janus-Pro-1B HPSv2/GenEval tables. A useful follow-up question is whether visual tokenizers and decoders should be updated during multimodal mid-training or post-training rather than treated as fixed preprocessing modules.

recommendation.zh: 值得看decoder共训练消融；若结论干净，会改变离散视觉token后训练中“冻结解码器即可”的默认做法。
recommendation.en: Read the decoder co-training ablations; if clean, this weakens the default assumption that a frozen decoder is enough for discrete visual-token post-training.
