paper.title: torchtune: PyTorch native post-training library
paper.abstract: Modern LLMs typically require multistage training pipelines to achieve strong downstream performance, with post-training serving as the main interface for adapting open-weight models. We introduce torchtune, a PyTorch-native library designed to streamline the post-training lifecycle of LLMs, enabling efficient fine-tuning, experimentation, and deployment-oriented workflows. Unlike many existing fine-tuning frameworks, which often optimize for ease of use, specialized recipes, or hardware efficie

summary.core_problem: torchtune 解决的是开放权重 LLM 后训练框架在透明性、可改性、分布式组合能力和性能路径之间难以兼顾的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇更像工程型基础设施论文，不是新的预训练算法。它对基座研究的价值在于把 SFT、DPO、GRPO、蒸馏、量化感知训练等后训练环节放在接近原生 PyTorch 的可控实现里，便于研究者隔离变量。对 pretrain ↔ posttrain 接口研究也有启发：如果要比较数据、优化器、LoRA/QLoRA、并行策略或 RL recipe，框架本身不能隐藏太多训练细节。
summary.technical_approach: 核心设计是用显式 PyTorch module builder 取代重 trainer 抽象。Transformer block 接收预构造的 attention、FFN、norm、embedding、projection 等子模块，具体架构差异、LoRA 插入、量化 projection、attention kernel 替换都限制在 builder 层。这样同一个 recipe 可以固定数据、优化器、日志和分布式策略，只替换模型构造或 adapter。系统侧重点包括：基于 FSDP2 和 DTensor 的组合式并行，支持 tensor/sequence/expert/loss/context parallel；in-backward optimizer fusion 用来缩短 gradient buffer 生命周期，改善大模型微调显存可行性；YAML recipe 保持可配置，但训练 loop 仍接近 PyTorch；GRPO recipe 用 Ray 协调 rollout 队列和 replay buffer，使生成与 policy update 解耦，并允许受控的 off-policy lag。和 Axolotl、HF TRL/Transformers/PEFT、Unsloth 相比，它牺牲一部分封装便利性，换取更直接的代码路径和更容易做受控实验的模块边界。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖单卡和多卡后训练设置，并和 Axolotl、Unsloth 做对比。论文特别分析 Llama 3.3 70B 训练中的若干优化开关，包括 torch.compile、activation checkpointing、Linear Cross-Entropy、sequence packing、低比特 optimizer state、in-backward optimizer fusion。主要结论是这些优化具有互补性：compile 对小到中等规模模型的吞吐提升更明显；到 70B 这类规模时，activation checkpointing、低比特优化器状态、in-backward optimizer fusion 等显存导向技术决定训练是否可跑。GRPO 部分展示了异步 rollout 和 policy update 解耦的系统实现，但它的主要贡献仍是 recipe 和调度架构，而不是新的 RL 算法。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议 30–45 分钟。重点看 Design 里 model builder 与 recipe 的边界划分，Section 4.1 的 in-backward optimizer fusion，Section 5 的 DTensor/FSDP2 并行组合，以及 Section 7 的 asynchronous GRPO。若关心后训练实验可复现性，可以看附录中的 builder、decoder、attention、LoRA 替换代码示例。若只关心基座预训练算法，可跳过模型覆盖表和数据 adapter 列表。

summary_en.core_problem: torchtune addresses a practical systems problem: open-weight LLM post-training frameworks often make it hard to combine transparency, extensibility, distributed training, and modern PyTorch performance features in one stack.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an infrastructure paper rather than a new pretraining method. Its relevance to foundation-model research is that it exposes SFT, DPO, GRPO, distillation, LoRA/QLoRA, and quantization-aware training through a controllable PyTorch-native implementation. That matters when post-training is used as a probe for pretraining choices: data, optimizer settings, adapters, and parallelism policies need to be changed independently without the framework becoming an uncontrolled variable.
summary_en.technical_approach: The library is organized around explicit PyTorch model builders instead of a monolithic trainer abstraction. Transformer blocks receive pre-built submodules, while builders choose the concrete attention, feed-forward, normalization, embedding, and projection implementations. LoRA insertion, quantized projections, custom attention kernels, and architecture-specific changes are therefore localized to construction time. The same recipe can compare full fine-tuning, LoRA, QLoRA, QAT, or module replacements while holding the optimizer, data path, logging, and distributed policy fixed. On the systems side, torchtune builds on FSDP2 and DTensor, with tensor, sequence, expert, loss, and context parallelism. It also introduces in-backward optimizer fusion to reduce the lifetime of gradient buffers, and provides an asynchronous GRPO recipe that separates rollout generation from policy updates through a Ray-managed queue and replay buffer. Compared with Axolotl, the Hugging Face TRL/Transformers/PEFT stack, and Unsloth, the design favors inspectable PyTorch code and controlled experimentation over heavier abstraction or narrow kernel specialization.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study compares torchtune with Axolotl and Unsloth across single-GPU and multi-GPU post-training settings. A detailed sweep on Llama 3.3 70B isolates the effects of torch.compile, activation checkpointing, Linear Cross-Entropy, sequence packing, low-bit optimizer state, and in-backward optimizer fusion. The main finding is that these switches are complementary: compilation is a strong throughput lever on small and mid-sized models, while memory-oriented techniques determine feasibility at larger scales such as 70B fine-tuning. The GRPO experiments are most useful as a reference implementation of asynchronous rollout/update scheduling rather than as evidence for a new RL algorithm.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–45 minutes. The useful parts are the design section on model builders and recipe boundaries, Section 4.1 on in-backward optimizer fusion, Section 5 on DTensor/FSDP2 composable parallelism, and Section 7 on asynchronous GRPO. Readers interested in reproducible post-training experiments should also inspect the appendix code snippets for decoder construction, attention modules, builders, and LoRA substitution. The model-family and dataset-adapter tables are mostly implementation reference material.

recommendation.zh: 不改 pretrain prior，但值得扫设计章节；透明 recipe 对内部后训练复现比黑盒加速框架更有用。
recommendation.en: It will not change pretraining priors, but the design sections are worth skimming because transparent recipes are more reusable than black-box tuning speedups.

paper.title: LamPO: A Lambda Style Policy Optimization for Reasoning Language Models
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an effective paradigm for improving reasoning language models on tasks such as mathematics, coding, and scientific question answering. However, widely used group-relative objectives, such as GRPO, summarize each sampled group with scalar statistics and therefore discard fine-grained relational information among candidate responses. This weakens credit assignment under sparse outcome rewards, especially when multiple generated solut

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论的是 RLVR 里一个很具体但很关键的问题：像 GRPO 这类 group-relative 方法把同一 prompt 下采样得到的一组回答压缩成均值和方差，再给每个样本一个标量 advantage。这样做稳定、便宜，但会丢掉组内回答之间更细的相对关系。对于数学、代码、科学问答这类稀疏 outcome reward 任务，很多错误答案都拿到同样的 0 分，只有少数正确答案拿到 1 分；即便都错，不同轨迹的推理质量也可能不同。标量归一化无法表达“它比谁更好、好多少”，导致 credit assignment 偏粗。LamPO 要解决的就是：在不引入 value model 的前提下，把组内 pairwise 排序信息直接写进 policy update。
summary.importance: 从严格意义上说，这不是 pretrain 论文，而是 post-train / reasoning RL 论文。但它和基座研究并不远，因为它触及一个越来越重要的问题：当训练信号从 token-level NLL 变成 sequence-level verifiable reward 时，怎样设计更细粒度、方差可控、又不依赖 critic 的优化目标。LamPO 的贡献量级不在于提出全新 RL 框架，而在于对 GRPO 这一类实用目标做了一个结构化改写，把“组均值基线”换成“成对比较分解”。如果后续 reasoning-heavy mid-training、RL pretraining 或 outcome-supervised continual training 继续发展，这类 advantage 设计会有参考意义。它更像是对现有 RLVR recipe 的局部但有针对性的改进。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Pairwise Decomposed Advantage，简称 PDA。GRPO 的做法是：对同一 prompt 采样 G 个回答，计算每个回答的 reward，再用组内 reward 的均值和标准差做标准化，得到每个样本的 advantage。LamPO 认为这一步压缩过度，于是把每个回答的学习信号改写成它与组内其他回答的成对 reward gap 的聚合。

具体地，对回答 o_i 和 o_j，先看 reward 差 R(o_i)-R(o_j)。这给出学习方向：如果 i 比 j 好，i 应该被提升。然后再引入一个基于旧策略序列 log-prob 差的置信权重，即对 Δs_ij 做 sigmoid(Δs_ij / τ)。这里的设计有两个作用。第一，它不是简单把所有 pair 等权相加，而是让当前策略更有把握区分的 pair 贡献更大，避免噪声 pair 过度主导更新。第二，它保留了 critic-free 的形式，不需要额外训练 value model。最终每个样本的 advantage 是对所有 j≠i 的 pairwise reward gap 乘以置信权重后求和，再放进和 GRPO 类似的 PPO-style clipped objective 里。

这个设计和传统 pairwise preference optimization 也不完全一样。DPO 一类方法通常直接在偏好对上做监督式对比，而 LamPO 仍然是在 on-policy RLVR 框架里工作，pairwise 信息来自同组采样结果，目标仍是 policy optimization，并保留 KL 到 reference policy 的约束。

论文还加了一个很轻量的 dense auxiliary reward：当有参考解时，用 ROUGE-L 衡量生成推理轨迹与参考解的重叠，并用系数 λ_sem 混入总 reward。作者的意图很直接：binary correctness 太稀疏时，给一点 sequence-aware 的软信号，帮助训练早期区分“完全跑偏”和“接近正确”的轨迹。这个辅助项不是主要创新，但它解释了为什么方法在一些有 reference solution 的数据上更稳。

从机制上看，LamPO 的关键不是 pairwise 本身，而是把组内排序结构显式保留下来，同时仍维持 GRPO 那种无需 critic、实现简单、适合大模型 RL 的工程形态。代价是组内计算从 O(G) 变成 O(G^2)，但在常见 group size 下通常还能接受。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-4B 和 Phi-4-mini 三个基座，评测任务包括 AIME24、AIME25、MATH-500 和 GPQA-Diamond，属于典型 RLVR reasoning 套件。论文主结论是：LamPO 相比 GRPO 以及文中对比的若干 group-relative 变体，在不同模型规模上都能带来一致提升，尤其在数学推理任务上更明显。

从全文描述看，作者重点验证了三件事。第一，pairwise advantage 本身有效，而不是仅仅因为加了一个辅助 reward。相关消融会分别比较：纯 GRPO、只加 dense reward 的版本、以及完整 LamPO。第二，置信权重和温度 τ 不是装饰项；如果去掉基于 log-prob 差的 weighting，或者把温度设得过低/过高，性能会下降，说明 pairwise 信息需要被平滑地利用，而不是生硬累加。第三，LamPO 在不同 group size 和不同模型上都保持较稳定，不是只在某个单点配置上成立。

摘要没有给出完整数字，全文节选里也未包含结果表的具体值，因此这里不硬写不确定的百分点。但可以明确的是，作者把“稳定一致提升”作为主要证据，而不是单一 benchmark 上的大幅跳升。对这类 RL 论文，消融比绝对分数更重要：如果你关心方法是否可迁移，优先看 PDA、confidence weighting、ROUGE-L auxiliary reward、KL 系数和 group size 的消融关系。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读偏精一点，建议先看 Method，再看消融，最后看主结果表。阅读顺序可以这样安排。

先看 Introduction 和 Methodology 前半部分，确认作者批评 GRPO 的点到底是什么：不是说 GRPO 不稳定，而是说它把组内关系压成标量后，信息利用不够细。

然后重点看 PDA 的定义式、confidence-aware weighting 的来源，以及 τ 的作用。这里要想清楚一个问题：为什么权重来自旧策略的序列 log-prob 差，而不是直接来自 reward gap 的大小。前者反映当前策略的相对偏好和区分置信度，后者则只是外部监督强弱，两者角色不同。

接着看 auxiliary reward 部分。它不复杂，但要判断它是主要增益来源还是辅助稳定项，需要结合消融表一起读。

实验部分优先看三类结果：主表、去掉 pairwise 分解的消融、去掉 confidence weighting 或调整 τ 的消融。如果时间有限，45 分钟到 1 小时足够抓住方法和证据链。若你在做 reasoning RL recipe，这篇最值得深挖的是 advantage 设计与 reward sparsity 的关系，而不是最终 benchmark 排名。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific weakness in RL with verifiable rewards: group-relative methods such as GRPO reduce a sampled response set to scalar statistics like mean and standard deviation, then assign each trajectory a scalar advantage. That is efficient and critic-free, but it discards the relational structure inside the group. In reasoning tasks with sparse outcome rewards, many wrong answers receive the same score even though their reasoning quality differs. LamPO asks how to preserve intra-group ranking information in the policy update without introducing a value model.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training / reasoning-RL paper rather than a pretraining paper in the narrow sense. Still, it is relevant to foundation-model training because it studies how to optimize sequence-level objectives when the supervision signal is sparse, verifiable, and delayed. The contribution is not a new RL paradigm; it is a targeted redesign of the advantage estimator used in practical critic-free RLVR. If outcome-supervised mid-training, RL pretraining, or continual reasoning training becomes more common, this kind of advantage construction is likely to matter. The paper is best read as a structured improvement to the GRPO family rather than a wholesale replacement of existing RL recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core idea is the Pairwise Decomposed Advantage (PDA). In GRPO, for a given prompt, one samples G responses, computes rewards, and normalizes them with group mean and variance. LamPO argues that this compression is too lossy. Instead, each response receives an advantage built from pairwise reward comparisons against the other responses in the same group.

For a pair of responses o_i and o_j, the reward gap R(o_i) - R(o_j) provides the learning direction. LamPO then modulates this comparison with a confidence-aware weight derived from the old policy’s sequence log-probability difference, passed through a sigmoid with temperature tau. This serves two purposes. First, it avoids treating all pairwise comparisons equally; pairs that the current policy distinguishes more confidently contribute more. Second, it keeps the method critic-free, since no learned value function is required. The resulting per-response advantage is the sum of weighted pairwise reward gaps over all j != i, and this advantage is plugged into the same PPO-style clipped objective used by GRPO, together with KL regularization to a reference policy.

This is not the same as preference optimization methods like DPO. DPO-style methods operate on supervised preference pairs, while LamPO remains an on-policy RLVR method where pairwise structure is extracted from sampled response groups and used inside policy optimization.

The paper also adds a lightweight dense auxiliary reward based on ROUGE-L when reference solutions are available. The purpose is straightforward: binary correctness is often too sparse, so a sequence-overlap signal can help distinguish completely off-track trajectories from near-correct ones during training. This auxiliary term is not the main conceptual contribution, but it likely improves optimization in settings with reference traces.

Mechanistically, the important point is not pairwise comparison by itself. The important point is preserving group ranking structure while retaining the engineering advantages of GRPO: no critic, PPO-style updates, and a form that is easy to integrate into existing large-scale RL pipelines. The trade-off is O(G^2) pairwise computation instead of O(G), which is usually acceptable for typical group sizes.
summary_en.experiments:
Experiments are run on Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B, and Phi-4-mini, with evaluation on AIME24, AIME25, MATH-500, and GPQA-Diamond. These are standard reasoning-heavy RLVR benchmarks. The main empirical claim is consistent improvement over GRPO and related group-relative baselines across model sizes, with especially clear gains on mathematical reasoning tasks.

The paper appears to validate three things. First, the pairwise advantage itself matters, rather than the gains coming only from the auxiliary dense reward. Second, the confidence-aware weighting and the temperature tau are meaningful design choices; removing the weighting or setting tau poorly hurts performance, which suggests that pairwise information must be smoothed rather than aggregated naively. Third, LamPO remains reasonably stable across different group sizes and across multiple base models, so the effect is not tied to a single configuration.

The provided excerpt does not include the full result tables, so it is better not to invent exact margins. The useful takeaway is that the evidence is based on consistency and ablations rather than one unusually large benchmark jump. For this kind of RL paper, the ablation tables are more informative than the headline scores: look at PDA vs scalar advantage, confidence weighting on/off, ROUGE-L auxiliary reward on/off, and sensitivity to KL and group size.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, but it deserves a careful skim. Start with the introduction and the first half of the methodology to pin down the exact criticism of GRPO. The claim is not that GRPO is unusable; the claim is that scalar group normalization throws away useful relational information.

Then focus on the PDA definition, the confidence-aware weighting term, and the role of the temperature tau. One question is worth keeping in mind while reading: why should the weight come from old-policy log-probability differences rather than directly from reward-gap magnitude? The answer is that the former reflects the policy’s current preference confidence, while the latter reflects external supervision strength; they play different roles.

Next, read the auxiliary reward section together with the ablations. The ROUGE-L term is simple, but the key issue is whether it is the main source of gains or just a stabilizer.

In the experiments, prioritize three parts: the main results table, the ablation that removes pairwise decomposition, and the ablations on confidence weighting / tau. A solid pass takes around 45 to 60 minutes. If you work on reasoning-RL recipes, the most useful angle is the interaction between advantage design and reward sparsity, not the final benchmark ranking.

recommendation.zh: RL后训练方法的扎实增量改进，pairwise advantage 的思路值得在内部RL实验中考虑，读方法部分即可
recommendation.en: Solid incremental improvement in RL post-training. The pairwise advantage idea is worth considering in internal RL experiments. Read the method section only.

paper.title: AVSD: Adaptive-View Self-Distillation by Balancing Consensus and Teacher-Specific Privileged Signals
paper.abstract: Self-distillation enables language models to learn on-policy from their own trajectories by using the same model as both student and teacher, with the teacher being conditioned on privileged information unavailable to the student. Such information can come in different types or views, such as solutions, demonstrations, feedback, or final answers. This setup provides dense token-level feedback without relying on a separate external model, but creates a fundamental asymmetry: the teacher may rely

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体、也很关键的 post-train 问题：在 self-distillation 里，teacher 拥有 student 推理时拿不到的 privileged information，如何既利用这些额外信息提供密集 token-level 学习信号，又避免 student 被迫去拟合那些测试时不可见、甚至有害的 view-specific 偏置。进一步地，既然不同 privileged view——完整解答、部分解答、最终答案、hint、feedback——对不同任务和不同训练阶段的价值并不一样，为什么要预先固定只选一种？AVSD 试图同时解决这两个问题：一是多视角 privileged teacher 的融合，二是在“共享稳定信号”和“单视角特有信号”之间做受控平衡。
summary.importance: 对预训练的直接影响有限，但对 pretrain↔post-train 接口、reasoning 数据利用方式、以及 token-level dense supervision 的设计有明显启发。它的重要性不在于提出一个新的 RL 替代品，而在于把 self-distillation 里的信息不对称问题讲得更清楚，并给出一个可操作的多视角蒸馏框架。相比只靠 outcome reward 的 RLVR，AVSD 提供更密的局部学习信号；相比单一 privileged view 的 self-distillation，它减少了“teacher 过度依赖某种额外信息，student 学不会也不该学”的风险。如果后续有人做 reasoning pretrain、mid-training with solutions、或把 verifier / answer / rationale 作为不同 supervision channel 混合进训练，这篇文章的信号分解思路是可以迁移的。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把多个 privileged teacher view 的 token 分布拆成两部分：共识信号和残差信号。作者的直觉很朴素：如果多个 view 都支持某个 token，这个更新更可能稳定、与任务本身相关；如果只有某一个 view 强烈支持某个 token，这个信号可能有补充信息，但也更可能依赖 student 在测试时看不到的上下文。为此，AVSD 不直接平均多个 teacher，也不直接选最强的那个，而是构造两个 pooled target。其一是 geometric consensus target，用几何聚合强调“多视角共同支持”的 token；其二是 arithmetic marginal target，用算术聚合保留“至少有一个视角强支持”的 token。两者的差值可以理解为 residual，也就是 view-specific extra support。训练时，AVSD 不是无条件把 residual 加回去，而是通过 gate 控制：只有当不同视角在 promote-or-suppress 的方向上是一致的，并且 residual 的幅度相对 consensus 不失控时，才允许这部分额外信号进入蒸馏目标。这样做的原因很明确：纯 consensus 太保守，可能丢掉有用的补充信息；纯 marginal 又太激进，容易让单一视角主导更新。AVSD 试图在两者之间找一个受约束的折中。论文场景是 on-policy self-distillation：student 先生成自己的 rollout，再让带 privileged context 的同模型 teacher 对这些 token 给出分布，避免传统 offline distillation 的 off-policy mismatch。与已有单视角 self-distillation 的区别，不只是“多加几个 teacher”，而是显式建模多视角之间的一致性与分歧，并把这种结构写进 token-level target 里。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖数学和代码推理，重点是数学。文中明确提到在 math setting 里为每道题自动构造三种 privileged view：full solution、partial solution、final answer。模型方面，摘要和正文可见至少包含 Qwen3-4B。对比对象包括单视角 self-distillation 基线，以及 GRPO 这类 RLVR 方法。结果层面，作者报告 AVSD 在 AIME24、AIME25、HMMT25 等竞赛数学 benchmark 上优于单视角 self-distillation，也优于 GRPO。虽然当前给出的全文片段没有完整表格数字，但从作者叙述看，收益不是来自简单 ensemble，而是来自对 residual 的门控使用。消融的关键看点应包括：只用 consensus target、只用 arithmetic marginal、无 gate 直接融合、不同 privileged view 单独训练、以及 view 数量变化。论文前言已经给出若干重要实验动机：不同 privileged form 在信息密度、任务适配性、student-teacher 分布偏移上差异明显；full solution 可能把 teacher 锁进特定思路，answer-only 更灵活但更稀疏。AVSD 的实验价值就在于验证“多视角 + 受控融合”是否能稳定优于任何单一视角。若看代码任务，重点应关注这种优势是否仍成立，还是主要集中在可验证数学推理上。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看 Introduction，把作者对 RLVR 稀疏奖励、offline distillation 分布失配、self-distillation 信息不对称这三层问题的铺垫读清楚。然后直接看方法部分里 consensus target、marginal target、residual、gate 的定义与公式，这是整篇文章真正的新东西。读的时候要问两个问题：为什么几何聚合更适合表示共识；为什么 gate 的判据要同时约束方向一致性和幅度比例。接着看主结果表和消融表，尤其是不同 privileged view、不同 target 组合、是否 on-policy 的对比。若时间有限，30 分钟内可以抓住方法主线和主要结果；若要判断它是否能迁移到 reasoning mid-train 或 solution-augmented pretrain，建议再细看自动构造 privileged views 的章节，以及失败案例分析。最值得深挖的点不是 benchmark 分数本身，而是作者如何处理“teacher 比 student 看得更多”这一结构性矛盾。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a precise and important post-training problem: in self-distillation, the teacher has access to privileged information that the student will not have at inference time. How can one use that extra information to provide dense token-level supervision without forcing the student to imitate view-specific correlations that are unobservable, or even harmful, at test time? A second issue follows immediately: different privileged views—full solutions, partial solutions, final answers, hints, feedback—are not equally useful across tasks or training stages, so fixing a single teacher view in advance is an arbitrary and often suboptimal choice. AVSD addresses both issues by combining multiple privileged teacher views while explicitly balancing shared stable signal against view-specific signal.
summary_en.importance: The direct impact on pretraining is limited, but the paper is relevant to the pretrain–post-train interface, to reasoning-data utilization, and to the design of dense token-level supervision. Its contribution is not a wholesale replacement for RL, but a clearer treatment of information asymmetry in self-distillation together with a practical multi-view distillation recipe. Compared with RLVR, AVSD provides denser local learning signals. Compared with single-view self-distillation, it reduces the risk that the teacher over-relies on privileged context that the student cannot and should not reproduce at test time. If future work mixes verifier signals, answers, rationales, or solutions as distinct supervision channels in reasoning pretraining or mid-training, the signal decomposition used here is likely transferable.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core idea is to decompose the token-level signal from multiple privileged teacher views into two parts: a consensus signal and a residual signal. The intuition is simple. If several views support the same token, that update is more likely to be stable and task-relevant. If only one view strongly favors a token, the signal may still contain useful complementary information, but it is also more likely to depend on context unavailable to the student at inference time. AVSD therefore does not simply average teachers or pick the strongest one. Instead, it constructs two pooled targets. The first is a geometric consensus target, designed to emphasize tokens supported across views. The second is an arithmetic marginal target, designed to preserve tokens strongly supported by at least one view. Their difference acts as a residual, capturing extra view-specific support beyond the shared signal. Training does not add this residual back unconditionally. A gate controls when it is allowed to influence the target: the residual is used only when the views agree on the promote-versus-suppress direction and when the residual magnitude remains proportionate to the consensus magnitude. This design is motivated by a clear trade-off. Pure consensus is safe but can be too conservative, discarding useful complementary information. Pure marginal pooling is more inclusive but can let a single privileged view dominate the update. AVSD aims for a constrained middle ground. The setting is on-policy self-distillation: the student first generates its own rollouts, and the same model, conditioned on privileged context, provides teacher distributions on those student-generated trajectories. This avoids the off-policy mismatch of standard offline distillation. Relative to prior single-view self-distillation, the novelty is not merely using more teachers, but explicitly modeling agreement and disagreement across views and encoding that structure into the token-level target.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover math and code reasoning, with the strongest emphasis on math. The paper explicitly uses three automatically constructed privileged views per math problem: full solution, partial solution, and final answer. The model set includes at least Qwen3-4B. Baselines include standard single-view self-distillation and GRPO-style RLVR methods. The reported outcome is that AVSD outperforms both the single-view self-distillation baseline and GRPO on competition-style math benchmarks including AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25. The full numerical tables are not visible in the provided excerpt, but the narrative makes clear that the gain is not from naive ensembling; it comes from gated use of the residual signal. The most important ablations to inspect are likely: consensus-only, arithmetic-marginal-only, ungated fusion, each privileged view used alone, and sensitivity to the number of views. The introduction already motivates why these ablations matter: different privileged forms differ in information density, task utility, and induced student–teacher distribution shift; full solutions can lock the teacher into a specific reasoning path, while answer-only supervision is more flexible but less informative. The empirical question AVSD answers is whether multi-view supervision with controlled fusion can reliably beat any single privileged view. For the code setting, the key question is whether the same advantage persists or whether the gains are concentrated in verifiable mathematical reasoning.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick pass, start with the introduction and read carefully how the paper positions three separate issues: sparse outcome-level rewards in RLVR, distribution mismatch in offline distillation, and information asymmetry in self-distillation. Then go straight to the method section defining the consensus target, marginal target, residual, and gate; this is where the real novelty lies. While reading, ask two questions: why geometric pooling is the right bias for consensus, and why the gate must constrain both directional agreement and relative magnitude. After that, inspect the main result tables and the ablations, especially comparisons across privileged views, target constructions, and on-policy versus alternative setups. If time is limited, 30 minutes is enough to capture the main mechanism and headline results. If you want to judge whether the method can transfer to reasoning mid-training or solution-augmented pretraining, spend extra time on the section that constructs privileged views automatically and on the failure-case analysis. The deepest point is not the benchmark score itself, but how the paper handles the structural mismatch that the teacher sees more than the student.

recommendation.zh: 值得看方法部分；多 privileged view 的共识/私有信号拆分，适合迁移到推理 SFT 数据过滤。
recommendation.en: Read the method section; the consensus/private-signal split over privileged views is a plausible design for reasoning SFT data filtering.

institutions: The University of Texas at Austin

paper.title: Conditional Equivalence of DPO and RLHF: Implicit Assumption, Failure Modes, and Provable Alignment
paper.abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has emerged as a popular alternative to Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), offering theoretical equivalence with simpler implementation. We prove this equivalence is conditional rather than universal, depending on an implicit assumption frequently violated in practice: the RLHF-optimal policy must prefer human-preferred responses. When this assumption fails, DPO optimizes relative advantage over the reference policy rather than absolute alignm

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论 DPO 与 RLHF 的等价性边界：DPO 的经典推导并不在所有情况下成立，而是依赖一个隐含条件，即 RLHF 最优策略必须给人类偏好的回答分配更高概率。若参考策略本身偏离人类偏好，KL 约束可能把 RLHF 最优解拉向参考策略，使这个条件失效。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在于 post-train 信号质量与基座策略质量之间的接口分析。DPO 常被视为比 RLHF 更稳定、更便宜的替代方案，但这篇论文指出它的安全使用前提与 reference policy 的偏好结构有关。对持续预训练、SFT 后对齐、RL 数据构造都有启发：如果参考模型已经在某类偏好上系统性偏置，直接做 DPO 可能优化的是相对参考模型的优势，而不是人类偏好本身。这不是一个工程小细节，而是目标函数层面的条件失配。
summary.technical_approach: 论文重新检查 DPO 从 KL-regularized RLHF 到 preference loss 的推导过程。关键点是：DPO 用 RLHF 最优策略对奖励函数做代换，并放入 Bradley-Terry 偏好模型中。但这个代换要求最优策略自身满足偏好顺序，即 preferred response 的策略概率高于 dispreferred response。作者证明 RLHF 框架本身并不保证这一点，因为 RLHF 目标同时包含奖励最大化和相对参考策略的 KL 惩罚。当参考策略足够偏向错误答案时，KL 项可能占主导，使最优策略继承错误排序。论文进一步刻画了 DPO 的失败模式：在隐含条件失效时，DPO 优化的是相对 reference policy 的 advantage，而不是相对人类偏好的 absolute alignment，因此存在一类 undesirable solution space，模型可以降低 DPO loss，却仍系统性偏好被人类拒绝的回答。为修复这一点，作者提出 Constrained Preference Optimization，给 RLHF 目标加入显式偏好约束，使最优解满足 BT 模型所要求的偏好排序。论文还给出 soft margin ranking loss 的几何解释：DPO 可被看作带目标 margin 的排序损失，但该 margin 在某些 reference policy 条件下可能为负；CPO 通过约束项把有效 margin 修正为非负。另一个变体 E-CPOC 试图在不显式训练 reward model 的情况下实现与显式约束 RLHF 的等价，并提出 Loss-to-Delta bridge，用可观测的训练 loss gap 推出策略层面的接近性保证。
summary.experiments: 全文片段显示作者在标准偏好对齐 benchmark 上做了实验，并声称 CPO 达到较强表现；但给出的内容没有包含具体 benchmark 名称、模型规模、数据规模、胜率、reward 分数或消融数字。可确认的实验信息主要是研究对象覆盖 DPO 失败模式、CPO/E-CPOC 的验证，以及从训练诊断量 loss gap 到策略距离 δ-space 的经验或理论连接。精读时应避免只看性能结论，更应检查实验是否真的构造了 reference policy misalignment 场景，以及 CPO 的收益是否来自约束机制本身，而不是超参或训练稳定性的差异。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。优先看 DPO 推导中隐含假设的形式化定义，以及 assumption violation 的条件证明。其次看 undesirable solution space 的定义和梯度下降收敛到偏好违背解的论证。CPO 部分重点看约束项如何写入目标函数、它与 KL-regularized RLHF 的关系，以及 soft margin ranking loss 解释图。实验部分建议只抓三点：是否比较 DPO/RLHF/CPO，是否控制 reference policy 质量，是否有约束项消融。若时间有限，理论部分比榜单结果更值得读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when the usual equivalence between DPO and RLHF actually holds. Its main claim is that the equivalence depends on an implicit condition: the RLHF-optimal policy must assign higher probability to the human-preferred response than to the dispreferred one. This condition can fail when the reference policy is sufficiently misaligned and the KL penalty dominates reward maximization.
summary_en.importance: The result is relevant to the interface between pretraining, SFT, and preference optimization. DPO is often used as a simpler replacement for RLHF, but this paper argues that its correctness depends on the preference structure already present in the reference policy. If the base or SFT model has systematic preference errors, DPO may optimize relative improvement over that reference rather than absolute agreement with human preferences. This matters for continual pretraining and post-training pipelines, where the quality of the starting policy determines whether preference data produces the intended training signal.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper revisits the derivation of DPO from KL-regularized RLHF under the Bradley-Terry preference model. The critical step is the substitution of the RLHF-optimal policy into the reward parameterization. The authors argue that this substitution is valid only if the optimal policy itself respects the observed preference ordering. RLHF does not guarantee this, because its objective trades off reward against KL divergence from the reference model. When the reference model strongly prefers the wrong response, the KL term can pull the optimum toward the wrong ordering. Under this violation, DPO no longer optimizes the same objective as RLHF: it optimizes relative advantage over the reference policy. The paper formalizes a pathological solution region where DPO loss can decrease while the learned policy still prefers dispreferred responses. To address this, it introduces Constrained Preference Optimization, which augments the RLHF objective with explicit preference constraints. The paper also gives a geometric view through soft margin ranking loss: DPO can induce an effective margin that becomes negative, while CPO enforces non-negative effective margins. A conservative variant, E-CPOC, is proposed to avoid explicit reward modeling while maintaining a formal connection to constrained RLHF via a loss-to-delta argument.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text states that the authors run experiments on standard alignment benchmarks and report strong performance for CPO, but it does not expose concrete model sizes, datasets, win rates, reward scores, or ablation numbers. The important experimental questions are whether the paper constructs controlled reference-policy misalignment, whether CPO improves specifically in those regimes, and whether the constraint term is isolated from confounders such as beta tuning or training stability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–35 minutes. Read the formal assumption behind the DPO derivation first, then the proof or characterization of when that assumption fails. The undesirable solution space is the key technical section. For the proposed method, focus on the exact constrained objective, how it differs from DPO and KL-regularized RLHF, and the soft-margin interpretation. The experimental section is worth reading mainly for the reference-policy quality controls and constraint ablations, rather than for headline benchmark numbers.

recommendation.zh: DPO 与 RLHF 等价性的理论澄清很有价值，改变了对 DPO 无条件替代 RLHF 的认知，建议精读证明部分。
recommendation.en: Valuable theoretical clarification of DPO-RLHF equivalence that undermines the unconditional DPO-as-RLHF-replacement narrative; the proof sections reward careful reading.

institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Terminal-World: Scaling Terminal-Agent Environments via Agent Skills
paper.abstract: Terminal agents extend Large Language Models with the ability to execute tasks directly in command-line environments, but their progress is bottlenecked by the scarcity of high-quality training data. Existing approaches bootstrap from partial sources such as human-defined seeds or GitHub repositories to instantiate one component and then complete the rest, producing tasks confined to narrow seed distributions, environments misaligned with task semantics, and inefficient trajectories from unguide

summary.core_problem: terminal agent 的训练数据稀缺，现有自动化构造方法依赖人工 seed 或仓库素材，导致任务分布窄、环境与任务语义错位、轨迹质量差。
summary.importance: 这是 agent 数据合成方向的工作。对基座预训练本身帮助有限，但对后训练阶段如何系统地产生 terminal-use 轨迹、构造更广覆盖的 agent curriculum 有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Terminal-World，把 agent skills 作为合成原语，同时编码做什么、何时做、如何做，据此共同生成任务指令、环境和 teacher trajectory。进一步通过 skill teams 与 skill graphs 组合技能，扩展到多角色和跨领域任务，目标是扩大 terminal 环境中的任务空间并提升轨迹质量。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据量和提升幅度。按描述，实验重点应是与人工 seed 或 GitHub bootstrap 方法比较任务多样性、环境一致性和轨迹效率。若没有强基线和人工验证，结论更适合作为数据工程信号而非稳定方法论。
summary.authors_note: 来自 Beihang University、Beijing Institute of Technology、University of Edinburgh 等。不是顶级实验室范式工作，但题目切中 terminal agent 数据瓶颈。

summary_en.core_problem: Training data for terminal agents is scarce, and existing automated pipelines rely on human seeds or repository bootstrapping, leading to narrow task distributions, environment-task mismatch, and poor trajectories.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent data-synthesis paper. It is not directly about foundation-model pretraining, but it may be useful for post-training researchers thinking about systematic terminal-use trajectory generation and broader agent curricula.
summary_en.technical_approach: Terminal-World uses agent skills as the synthesis primitive, jointly encoding what to do, when to apply it, and how to execute it. From these skills, it co-derives task instructions, environments, and teacher trajectories. It further expands the space through skill teams and skill graphs for multi-role and cross-domain tasks.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, data scale, or exact gains. The likely evaluation compares against human-seed or GitHub-bootstrap pipelines on diversity, semantic alignment, and trajectory efficiency. Without strong baselines and human validation, the conclusions should be treated more as data-engineering signals than stable methodology.
summary_en.authors_note: From Beihang University, Beijing Institute of Technology, and the University of Edinburgh. Not a top-lab paradigm paper, but it targets a real bottleneck in terminal-agent data.

recommendation.zh: 更像 agent 训练数据工厂，不是基座论文；看它如何把 skill 变成任务/环境/轨迹共生成，若你做 agent post-train 可借鉴，其他人看摘要够了。
recommendation.en: This is more a data factory for terminal-agent post-training than a foundation-model paper; read it only for the skill-to-task/environment/trajectory synthesis idea.

paper.title: From Seeing to Thinking: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning Improves Post-Training of Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) emphasize long chain-of-thought reasoning; yet, we find that their performance on visual tasks is primarily limited by a lack of visual perception as opposed to reasoning itself. In this work, we systematically study the interplay between perception and reasoning in VLM post-training by decomposing their capabilities into three separate training stages: visual perception, visual reasoning, and textual reasoning, incorporating specialized training

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个在 VLM 后训练里很常见、但经常被推理训练掩盖的问题：模型在视觉任务上做不好，很多时候不是 reasoning 不够长，而是第一步 perception 就错了。作者把视觉能力拆成 visual perception、visual reasoning、textual reasoning 三个相对独立的维度，核心问题是：如果把这三种能力分开建模、分阶段训练，尤其先把 perception 打牢，是否能比当前把各种数据混在一起、主要强化长 CoT 的做法更有效。
summary.importance: 虽然这是 VLM post-training 论文，但对基座研究的启发不小，尤其在“能力拆分”和“训练顺序”上。它给出的结论很明确：视觉感知不是预训练后天然足够的底座能力，也不是靠更长推理就能补回来的；它需要专门数据、专门目标，而且训练顺序会显著影响最终效果。这个结论可以外推到更广义的多模态预训练和后训练接口：当模型能力由多个异质子能力组成时，把所有信号混合优化未必最好，按 capability dimension 做 curriculum 可能比按样本难度排序更关键。对纯文本 LLM 也有映射意义，比如 retrieval、tool use、long-context grounding 这类能力是否也应先单独固化再做复杂推理。
summary.technical_approach:
技术方案的核心是 staged post-training pipeline。作者构造了三套互不重叠的数据，分别对应 visual perception、textual reasoning、visual reasoning，然后按阶段依次训练，而不是把所有数据 merge 后统一采样。这里最关键的是第一阶段 visual perception。作者认为它的目标不是生成漂亮 caption，而是让模型稳定识别细粒度视觉实体、属性和空间关系，并把这些信息正确映射到文本表征中。

为此，他们从 DOCCI 这类细粒度图像-描述数据出发，把 image-caption 对转成 perception-focused QA 数据，而不是直接做 caption SFT。更进一步，作者比较了 caption-based SFT 和 RLVR。RLVR 指 reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards，奖励来自可验证答案是否正确。论文的判断是，caption SFT 往往给模型施加 token-level、off-policy 的模仿信号，容易把模型往数据分布较窄、甚至低于预训练语料质量的方向拉；而 RL 让模型在自身生成轨迹上更新，更适合学习“看清楚再回答”这种结果可验证的感知能力。

第二阶段是 textual reasoning，目的是补足纯文本链式推理能力，避免把视觉错误和文本推理错误混在一起。第三阶段才是 visual reasoning，把前两阶段学到的感知和文本推理结合到图像条件下的复杂任务中。作者还系统比较了 staged training 与 one-stage merged training，以及不同阶段顺序。结论是顺序不能乱，perception 必须先于 visual reasoning 固化，否则后续训练会在错误视觉表征上叠加更长的错误推理。

另一个有意思的点是作者把这种做法概括为 capability-dimension curriculum learning。它不是按 easy-to-hard 排样本，而是按能力维度安排优化路径。全文还进一步验证了它和 difficulty-based curriculum 是互补的，可以叠加。
summary.experiments:
实验最有说服力的部分是作者先做了错误归因。用 Claude-Haiku-4.5 分析 Qwen3-VL-8B 在 3 个 visual math 数据集上的错误样本，发现 86.9% 的错误可归因于视觉感知阶段出错，而不是后续推理本身。这给后面的 staged design 提供了直接动机。

性能上，加入 visual perception stage 后，Qwen2.5-VL-7B 在 WeMath 上比 base model 提升 7.43 个点；Qwen3-VL-8B 从 50.9% 提升到 56.1%。在 staged vs one-stage 对比中，staged-trained Qwen3-VL-8B 的 math reasoning accuracy 再提升 1.46 个点，同时 reasoning trace 长度缩短 20.8%，说明收益不是靠“想得更长”，而是前面看得更准。阶段顺序实验也很关键：如果打乱顺序，Qwen2.5-VL-7B 的平均 visual math 表现会从 42.3% 掉到 37.7%，说明 perception 作为 scaffold 的说法不是修辞，而是有明显数值支撑。

在训练目标对比上，用 SFT 替代 RL 做 visual perception 学习，会让 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 Qwen3-VL-8B 在 WeMath 上分别下降 8.1% 和 1.6%。这个结果支持作者关于 RLVR 更适合感知学习的判断。最终模型方面，staged-trained Qwen3-VL-8B 在 MathVista 上 75.9%，WeMath 上 56.1%，RealWorldQA 上 74.5%；与 OneThinker-8B 相比，在 WeMath 提升 1.5%，在 RealWorldQA 提升 3.0%。此外，capability-based staging 与 difficulty-based ordering 结合后，相比 merged training 还能带来 4.43% 的提升，说明两种 curriculum 维度确实可叠加。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇虽然标成 skim，但如果你关心多模态预训练和 post-train 接口，建议接近精读。先看 Introduction 里的错误分析动机，尤其 86.9% perception error 这个归因是全文立论基础。然后重点看 staged pipeline 和数据构造，弄清 visual perception 数据到底长什么样，和普通 caption SFT 有什么差别。接着看 4.3 和 4.4：一个讲 staged vs merged 以及顺序效应，一个讲 RLVR vs SFT，这两部分最能体现作者的核心判断。最后看 capability-dimension curriculum 的实验，判断这个概念是否能迁移到别的模态或纯文本场景。若时间有限，优先看 Figure 1、Figure 2、主结果表、阶段顺序实验和 RL 替代 SFT 的消融。预计 45-60 分钟能抓住主要贡献。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a common but often misdiagnosed issue in VLM post-training: many failures on visual tasks come from incorrect perception, not insufficient reasoning depth. The authors decompose VLM capability into three parts—visual perception, textual reasoning, and visual reasoning—and ask whether training them separately, in the right order, works better than the current practice of mixing all data and emphasizing long chain-of-thought reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Although this is framed as a VLM post-training study, the implications are broader for foundation-model research. The main message is clear: visual perception is not a solved byproduct of pretraining, and it cannot be reliably repaired by asking the model to reason longer. It needs dedicated data, a suitable training signal, and the right optimization order. That matters for multimodal pretraining and for the pretrain/post-train interface more generally. The paper also offers a useful abstraction—capability-dimension curriculum learning—which may transfer beyond vision to other heterogeneous capabilities such as retrieval, grounding, or tool use.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method is a staged post-training pipeline. The authors build three disjoint datasets for visual perception, textual reasoning, and visual reasoning, and train them sequentially instead of merging all data into a single mixed stage. The most important stage is visual perception. Its goal is not to produce fluent captions, but to make the model reliably identify fine-grained entities, attributes, and spatial relations and align them correctly with text.

To do this, they start from fine-grained image-caption resources such as DOCCI and convert image-caption pairs into perception-focused QA data rather than directly applying caption SFT. They then compare caption-based SFT with RLVR, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. Their argument is that caption SFT imposes token-level, off-policy imitation signals that can pull the model toward a narrower or lower-quality supervision distribution than its pretraining corpus, while RL keeps learning on-policy and is better suited for “see correctly, then answer” behaviors where correctness is externally verifiable.

The second stage is textual reasoning, which strengthens pure language reasoning so that visual errors and textual reasoning errors are not entangled. The third stage is visual reasoning, where the model combines the earlier perception and reasoning skills on image-conditioned tasks. The paper also compares staged training against one-stage merged training and studies stage order. The conclusion is that order matters: perception must be solidified before visual reasoning, otherwise later reasoning is built on faulty visual representations.

A useful conceptual contribution is the framing of this setup as capability-dimension curriculum learning. Instead of ordering samples by difficulty, it orders optimization by capability type. The paper further shows that this is complementary to standard difficulty-based curricula.
summary_en.experiments:
The most convincing part is the initial error attribution. Using Claude-Haiku-4.5 to analyze incorrect outputs from Qwen3-VL-8B on three visual math datasets, the authors estimate that 86.9% of the errors are caused by perception failures rather than downstream reasoning. That directly motivates the staged design.

In terms of performance, adding a visual perception stage gives a 7.43-point gain over the Qwen2.5-VL-7B base model on WeMath, and raises Qwen3-VL-8B from 50.9% to 56.1%. In the staged-versus-one-stage comparison, staged Qwen3-VL-8B improves math reasoning accuracy by 1.46 points while producing 20.8% shorter reasoning traces, which suggests the gain comes from better perception rather than longer deliberation. The stage-order ablation is also important: disrupting the order drops average visual math performance of Qwen2.5-VL-7B from 42.3% to 37.7%, supporting the claim that perception is a scaffold rather than just another training component.

For training objective comparison, replacing RL with SFT in the visual perception stage causes WeMath accuracy drops of 8.1% for Qwen2.5-VL-7B and 1.6% for Qwen3-VL-8B. This supports the claim that RLVR is a better signal than caption SFT for perception learning. The final staged Qwen3-VL-8B reaches 75.9% on MathVista, 56.1% on WeMath, and 74.5% on RealWorldQA. Relative to OneThinker-8B, it improves by 1.5% on WeMath and 3.0% on RealWorldQA. The curriculum result is also notable: combining capability-based staging with difficulty-based ordering yields a 4.43% gain over merged training, outperforming either dimension alone.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is labeled skim, but it is worth reading more carefully if you care about multimodal pretraining or the post-train interface. Start with the motivation and the 86.9% perception-error analysis in the introduction, because that is the foundation of the paper’s argument. Then read the staged pipeline and data construction sections to understand what the perception data actually looks like and how it differs from ordinary caption SFT. After that, focus on Sections 4.3 and 4.4: one covers staged versus merged training and stage order, the other compares RLVR with SFT. Those sections contain the strongest evidence for the paper’s central claims. If time is limited, prioritize Figure 1, Figure 2, the main results table, the stage-order ablation, and the RL-versus-SFT comparison. Around 45 to 60 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas.

recommendation.zh: 对VLM训练策略有实用insight——视觉感知是瓶颈、RL比SFT更适合学感知、分阶段优于混合训练。做VLM预训练的研究员值得看实验设计和§3-4的分析。
recommendation.en: Useful insights for VLM training strategy: perception is the bottleneck, RL outperforms SFT for perception, staged training beats joint training. VLM pretraining researchers should read §3-4 and the experimental design.

paper.title: SAGE: Shaping Anchors for Guided Exploration in RLVR of LLMs
paper.abstract: Recent studies observe that reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) reliably improves pass@1 on reasoning tasks, yet often fails to yield comparable gains in pass@k, raising the question of whether RLVR genuinely enables large language models to acquire novel reasoning abilities or merely enhances the efficiency of sampling reasoning modes already present in the base model. Prior analyses largely support the latter view, attributing this limitation to structural properties of stand

summary.core_problem: 现有带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在提升大模型推理任务pass@1的同时，难以同步提升pass@k。核心约束来自反向KL正则的训练机制，其会将策略锚定到参考模型分布，抑制低支持度的推理模式探索，最终导致策略坍缩到少量已知解路径。
summary.importance: 为RLVR训练的探索性和稳定性平衡提供了新的优化路径，不需要移除或替换反向KL项即可实现推理模式扩展，适配预训练后强化学习阶段的训练需求。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SAGE框架，不修改反向KL正则本身，而是重塑KL项锚定的目标分布。通过推理过程中产生的熵、惊讶度等轻量内在信号构造引导函数q(x,y)，将策略引导向未充分探索的推理模式，衍生出随机探索、token级探索、分支级探索等多个实用变体。
summary.experiments: 在AIME、AMC23、MATH-500三个数学推理基准上测试，不同RLVR设置下均实现pass@1和pass@k的同步提升，验证了方法的有效性。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看Introduction对RLVR现有探索方案缺陷的分析、第2章反向KL正则结构性约束的公式推导，实验部分看不同变体的效果对比，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves pass@1 on LLM reasoning tasks but fails to deliver comparable gains on pass@k. The core limitation comes from reverse-KL regularization, which anchors the policy to the reference model distribution and suppresses exploration of low-support reasoning modes, leading to policy collapse onto a small set of familiar solution paths.
summary_en.importance: It provides a new optimization path for balancing exploration and stability in RLVR training, enabling reasoning mode expansion without removing or replacing the reverse-KL term, which meets the training requirements of post-pretrain reinforcement learning stages.
summary_en.technical_approach: The SAGE framework is proposed, which does not modify the reverse-KL regularization itself but reshapes the target distribution that the KL term anchors to. It constructs a guide function q(x,y) using lightweight intrinsic signals generated during reasoning such as entropy and surprisal, guiding the policy toward underexplored reasoning modes. Multiple practical variants are derived, including random exploration, token-level exploration, and branch-level exploration.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on three mathematical reasoning benchmarks: AIME, AMC23, and MATH-500. Consistent simultaneous improvements on both pass@1 and pass@k are observed across diverse RLVR settings, validating the effectiveness of the method.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the analysis of flaws of existing RLVR exploration strategies in Introduction, the formula derivation of structural constraints of reverse-KL regularization in Section 2, and the performance comparison of different variants in the experiment section. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看目标分析和 pass@k 诊断即可；若结果扎实，它会削弱“RLVR 自然带来新推理模式”的默认假设。
recommendation.en: Read the objective analysis and pass@k diagnostics; if the setup is clean, it weakens the default assumption that RLVR naturally discovers new reasoning modes.

paper.title: Not Every Rubric Teaches Equally: Policy-Aware Rubric Rewards for RLVR
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has made post-training highly effective when correctness can be checked automatically. However, many important model behaviors require satisfying several qualitative criteria at once. Rubric-based rewards address this setting by grading prompt-specific criteria and aggregating them into a scalar reward. Yet standard static aggregations conflate a criterion's human-assigned importance with its current usefulness as an optimization signal. We show tha

summary.core_problem: 基于评分规则（rubric）的强化学习后训练中，传统静态加权求和的奖励聚合方式混淆了人类设定的准则重要性与该准则当前作为优化信号的有效性，导致大量训练压力被分配到已饱和或完全不可达的准则上，无法为当前策略提供有效梯度。
summary.importance: 揭示了多准则RL后训练中静态权重聚合的固有缺陷，为后训练阶段的奖励设计提供了更高效的信号分配思路，对需要多维度质量评估的开放域任务对齐有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出POW3R策略感知评分规则奖励框架，首先通过少量采样统计每个评分准则在当前策略生成样本中的对比度（由判分结果的平滑标准差衡量），再将对比度信号融合为调整系数，在保留人类设定的权重和大类权重分配的前提下，在每个评分大类内部重新分配训练压力，向能区分当前策略输出的准则倾斜。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct、Gemma3 12B-IT两个基础模型，多模态数据集MM和HealthBench两个测试集上验证：静态聚合方式下45%-51%的训练压力被分配到无法产生有效梯度的准则上，人类设定的权重与准则的信号方差几乎无相关性；在GRPO训练范式下，POW3R在30组对比中有24组优于二值奖励、静态标量奖励和大类平衡奖励，达到同等效果的样本效率提升2.5-4倍。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看引言部分的静态权重缺陷诊断、核心方法部分的POW3R设计逻辑、图2的逐prompt效果验证；预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In rubric-based reinforcement learning post-training, traditional static weighted sum reward aggregation conflates human-assigned criterion importance with the current effectiveness of the criterion as an optimization signal, leading to a large share of training pressure being allocated to saturated or completely unreachable criteria that cannot provide valid gradients for the current policy.
summary_en.importance: It reveals the inherent flaw of static weight aggregation in multi-criterion RL post-training, provides a more efficient signal allocation approach for reward design in the post-training stage, and offers direct reference for open-domain task alignment requiring multi-dimensional quality assessment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The POW3R policy-aware rubric reward framework is proposed. First, the contrastiveness of each rubric criterion in current policy rollouts is measured by the smoothed standard deviation of judge verdicts through a small number of samples. Then the contrastiveness signal is fused into an adjustment coefficient. On the premise of retaining human-assigned weights and category-level weight allocation, training pressure is reallocated within each rubric category to tilt toward criteria that can distinguish outputs of the current policy.
summary_en.experiments: Verified on two base models (Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, Gemma3 12B-IT) and two test sets (multimodal dataset MM, HealthBench): under static aggregation, 45%-51% of training pressure is allocated to criteria that cannot produce valid gradients, and there is nearly no correlation between human-assigned weights and the signal variance of criteria; under the GRPO training paradigm, POW3R outperforms binary rewards, static scalar rewards and category-balanced rewards in 24 of 30 comparisons, and sample efficiency to achieve the same effect is improved by 2.5-4 times.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the diagnosis of static weight flaws in the introduction, core design logic of POW3R in the method section, and prompt-by-prompt effect verification in Figure 2; estimated reading time 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是算法大改，但它把 rubric reward 里最常见的错觉讲对了：人类权重不等于训练信号强度，建议先看方法定义和 ablation。
recommendation.en: Not a new RL algorithm, but it gets a common rubric-reward mistake exactly right: human importance is not optimization usefulness; read the method and ablations first.

paper.title: Backtracking When It Strays: Mitigating Dual Exposure Biases in LLM Reasoning Distillation
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in complex reasoning tasks via long chain-of-thought (CoT), yet their immense computational overhead hinders real-world deployment. LLM reasoning distillation addresses this by transferring reasoning capabilities from formidable teacher models to compact student models. However, existing distillation paradigms face a fundamental dilemma. Typical off-policy distillation strictly utilizes teacher-generated golden trajectories, suffering

summary.core_problem: 解决长 CoT 推理蒸馏中 off-policy 教师轨迹与 student 推理分布不匹配导致的错误累积问题，同时指出 on-policy 蒸馏也会引入反向暴露偏差。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理蒸馏训练分析与方法改进。它把 distillation 的问题从“教师轨迹质量”推进到“教师和学生在偏离上下文中的交互质量”，对小模型继承长推理能力有实际意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 dual exposure biases 的诊断：off-policy 只训练教师 golden trajectories，学生推理时一旦偏离训练分布会级联出错；on-policy 让学生探索自己的轨迹，但教师在学生生成的次优上下文上也难以给出正向指导。标题显示方法包含 backtracking：当学生轨迹偏离时回退并修正，但摘要截断，无法确认具体检测器、回退粒度和训练损失。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、教师/学生模型、benchmark、baseline 或数值提升。能确认的是任务场景为长 CoT reasoning distillation，目标是降低推理成本并保持复杂推理能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies reasoning distillation for long CoT models, focusing on off-policy exposure bias from teacher-only trajectories and a reciprocal exposure bias introduced by on-policy student trajectories.
summary_en.importance: This is a reasoning distillation analysis and method contribution. It shifts the issue from teacher trajectory quality alone to teacher-student interaction under off-distribution intermediate contexts, which matters for transferring long-reasoning behavior into smaller models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper diagnoses dual exposure biases: off-policy distillation trains only on teacher golden trajectories, causing student errors to cascade at inference time; on-policy distillation exposes the teacher to suboptimal student contexts, where the teacher may fail to provide useful positive guidance. The title suggests a backtracking mechanism that reverts and corrects when the student strays, but the truncated abstract does not specify the detector, backtracking granularity, or loss design.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, teacher or student model identities, benchmarks, baselines, or numerical gains. The confirmed setting is long-CoT reasoning distillation aimed at reducing inference cost while preserving reasoning capability.

recommendation.zh: 值得看问题定义和失败案例；方法细节若只是启发式回退，就更像工程补丁而非通用蒸馏原则。
recommendation.en: Read the problem framing and failure cases; if the method is mostly heuristic backtracking, treat it as an engineering patch rather than a general distillation principle.

paper.title: Not Every Rubric Teaches Equally: Policy-Aware Rubric Rewards for RLVR
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has made post-training highly effective when correctness can be checked automatically. However, many important model behaviors require satisfying several qualitative criteria at once. Rubric-based rewards address this setting by grading prompt-specific criteria and aggregating them into a scalar reward. Yet standard static aggregations conflate a criterion's human-assigned importance with its current usefulness as an optimization signal. We show tha

summary.core_problem: 解决 rubric-based RLVR 中固定 rubric 权重不能反映当前 policy 可学习信号的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练 reward 设计方法。它区分“人类认为重要的目标权重”和“当前训练阶段有效的优化信号权重”，对减少 rubric reward 的无效梯度、饱和项和不可达项有直接意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 POW3R，一个 policy-aware rubric reward 框架。它保留 human weights 和 category balance 作为最终 rubric objective，但在训练中根据 rollout-level contrast 动态调整 criterion-level reward weights，优先强调当前能区分 policy rollout 的标准，同时避免把 rubric 目标本身改掉。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、任务集和数值提升。实验应围绕多标准 qualitative behavior 的 RLVR/RL 训练展开，比较静态 rubric aggregation 与 POW3R 的训练效果、criteria saturation、unreachable criteria 和 rollout 区分度。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Bing Liu；其长期研究情感分析、观点挖掘和 NLP。其他作者机构与背景无法从给定信息确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a failure mode in rubric-based RLVR where fixed rubric weights do not match the current usefulness of each criterion as a learning signal.
summary_en.importance: This is a reward-design contribution for post-training. It separates human importance weights from optimization-time signal weights, which matters when criteria are saturated, unreachable, or weakly discriminative for the current policy.
summary_en.technical_approach: POW3R is a policy-aware rubric reward framework. It preserves human weights and category balance as the target rubric objective, while dynamically adapting criterion-level reward weights using rollout-level contrast to emphasize criteria that currently separate policy outputs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, or numerical gains. The experiments likely compare static rubric aggregation against POW3R in RLVR-style training for qualitative multi-criterion behavior, analyzing saturation, unreachable criteria, and rollout discrimination.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Bing Liu, known for work in sentiment analysis, opinion mining, and NLP. Other affiliations cannot be confirmed from the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 读 reward 分解和 ablation；它提醒 RLVR 里“重要标准”和“有梯度标准”不能混用。
recommendation.en: Read the reward decomposition and ablations; it makes a clean point that important criteria and gradient-bearing criteria are not the same in RLVR.

paper.title: AstraFlow: Dataflow-Oriented Reinforcement Learning for Agentic LLMs
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly used to improve the reasoning, coding, and tool-use capabilities of large language models, but agentic RL remains prohibitively expensive. Scaling RL to agentic LLMs requires supporting complex workloads, including multi-policy collaborative training, while efficiently using elastic, heterogeneous, and cross-region compute resources. Existing LLM RL systems support some of these capabilities, but each new extension often requires dedicated system engin

summary.core_problem: 现有面向LLM的RL训练系统采用以训练器为中心的控制架构，缺乏标准化组件抽象，适配多策略协同训练、异构/弹性跨区域算力等智能体场景时需要大量定制化开发，成本极高。
summary.importance: 为LLM智能体的规模化RL训练提供了通用基础设施设计参考，降低RL预训练、多智能体协同训练的工程落地成本。
summary.technical_approach: 采用数据流导向的架构设计，核心包含三个组件：1）数据流层：通过共享数据而非中心化训练器控制协调推理采样、训练、数据处理组件，支持多策略训练、课程调度、数据过滤采样等逻辑以数据流策略实现；2）采样即服务（RaaS）：将轨迹生成与策略优化解耦，支持异构/弹性算力下采样组件独立扩缩容；3）训练器：仅负责从数据流层消费数据、回传更新权重，可独立替换，无需改动其他系统模块。
summary.experiments: 在多策略协同RL场景下，训练速度比现有多智能体RL系统最高提升2.7倍，精度相当；原生支持采样自动扩缩容、异构跨区域训练，无需定制代码；可直接集成动态采样、GRESO、缓存回放等数据算法。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3节的架构设计部分和第4节的多策略训练、系统灵活性实验，预计阅读时间15-20分钟，不需要深入实现细节，关注架构抽象思路即可。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RL training systems for LLMs adopt trainer-centric control architectures and lack standardized component abstractions, requiring heavy custom engineering to support agentic scenarios such as multi-policy collaborative training, heterogeneous/elastic cross-region compute, leading to prohibitive costs.
summary_en.importance: Provides a general infrastructure design reference for large-scale RL training of LLM agents, reducing engineering overhead for RL pretraining and multi-agent collaborative training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adopts a dataflow-oriented architecture with three core components: 1) Dataflow layer: Coordinates rollout, training, and data processing components via shared data instead of centralized trainer control, supporting multi-policy training, curriculum scheduling, data filtering/sampling as native dataflow policies; 2) Rollout-as-a-Service (RaaS): Decouples trajectory generation from policy optimization, enabling independent scaling of rollout components across heterogeneous/elastic compute resources; 3) Trainers: Only consume data from the dataflow layer and publish updated weights, can be replaced independently without modifying other system modules.
summary_en.experiments: In multi-policy collaborative RL scenarios, it achieves up to 2.7x training speedup with comparable accuracy to existing multi-agent RL systems; natively supports rollout auto-scaling, heterogeneous cross-region training without custom code; can directly integrate data algorithms including dynamic sampling, GRESO, buffer replay.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (architecture design) and Section 4 (multi-policy training, system flexibility experiments). Estimated reading time is 15-20 minutes. No need to dive into implementation details, just grasp the architecture abstraction ideas.

recommendation.zh: 读系统抽象和调度实验即可；做 RLVR 时，rollout、dataflow、trainer 解耦是该复现的工程 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the system abstraction and scheduling results; for RLVR, decoupling rollout, dataflow, and trainers is the engineering prior to reproduce.

paper.title: Reference-Free Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning for MT: A Seq2Seq Perspective
paper.abstract: Production machine translation relies overwhelmingly on encoder-decoder Seq2Seq models, yet reinforcement learning approaches to MT fine-tuning have largely targeted decoder-only LLMs at $\geq$7B parameters, with limited systematic study of encoder-decoder architectures. We apply Group Relative Policy Optimization to NLLB-200 (600M and 1.3B) using a hybrid reference-free reward (LaBSE and COMET-Kiwi) that requires no parallel data at fine-tuning time, evaluating across 13 typologically diverse l

summary.core_problem: 研究无参考奖励的强化学习微调是否能有效提升生产环境常用的 encoder-decoder 机器翻译模型，而不是只用于 decoder-only LLM。
summary.importance: 贡献是后训练方法迁移和经验规律：将 GRPO 应用于 NLLB-200 600M/1.3B，并用无需平行数据的混合奖励做多语言 MT 微调；对 RL 信号质量和低资源语言适配有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 使用 Group Relative Policy Optimization 微调 Seq2Seq NLLB-200，奖励由 LaBSE 和 COMET-Kiwi 组成，训练时不需要参考译文；从 seq2seq 角度分析 reward discriminability、baseline 强弱和收益之间的关系。
summary.experiments: 在 13 种类型差异较大的语言上评测，GRPO 全部语言均有提升，繁体中文最高提升 +5.03 chrF++；在没有目标语言数据的情况下，部分形态复杂语言可接近 3 epoch 监督微调效果。摘要称该规律在英译多语方向复现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether reference-free RL fine-tuning can improve production-style encoder-decoder MT models, rather than being limited to decoder-only LLMs.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training transfer study and empirical pattern: GRPO is applied to 600M and 1.3B NLLB-200 models using reference-free hybrid rewards, offering some signal for reward quality and low-resource adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: It fine-tunes Seq2Seq NLLB-200 with Group Relative Policy Optimization. The reward combines LaBSE and COMET-Kiwi and does not require parallel references during fine-tuning. The analysis links gains to reward discriminability and baseline weakness.
summary_en.experiments: Across 13 typologically diverse languages, GRPO improves all languages, with up to +5.03 chrF++ for Traditional Chinese. Without target-language data, it competes with 3-epoch supervised fine-tuning on some morphologically complex languages, and the gain pattern is replicated in English-to-many settings.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 主线，但 reward discriminability 与弱基线收益关系值得记；看结果分组即可，不必深读方法。
recommendation.en: Not on the main LLM track, but the reward-discriminability versus weak-baseline pattern is worth noting; read the grouped results, not the full method.

paper.title: GRLO: Towards Generalizable Reinforcement Learning in Open-Ended Environments from Zero
paper.abstract: Post-training has become a crucial step for unlocking the capabilities of large language models, with reinforcement learning (RL) emerging as a critical paradigm. Recent RL-based post-training has increasingly split into two paradigms: reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), which optimizes models using human preference signals in target domains, and reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR), which operates in verifier-backed environments. The latter has dominated recent r

summary.core_problem: 现有面向LLM的域内RL后训练需要大量GPU算力，且从零开始在开放环境中基于少量交互学习的RL策略的泛化能力尚未被系统研究。
summary.importance: 原理分析类贡献，探索开放环境下从零训练的RLHF的对话能力泛化潜力。
summary.technical_approach: 摘要未披露完整技术方案，核心设定为在开放环境中使用少量交互数据从零训练RLHF，评估其对话能力的跨场景泛化表现。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型、训练数据、基线及量化效果指标，仅明确研究方向。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing in-domain RL post-training for LLMs requires massive GPU compute, and the generalization ability of RL policies trained from scratch with limited interactions in open-ended environments has not been systematically studied.
summary_en.importance: Analytical contribution, explores the generalization potential of conversational abilities from RLHF trained from scratch in open-ended environments.
