paper.title: Beyond Mode-Seeking RL: Trajectory-Balance Post-Training for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models are a promising alternative to autoregressive models, yet post-training methods for them largely adapt reward-maximizing objectives. We identify a central failure mode in this setting we call trajectory locking: sampled reward-driven updates over-concentrate probability mass onto a narrow set of denoising paths, reducing coverage of alternative correct solutions under repeated sampling. To address this, we propose TraFL (Trajectory Flow baLancing), a trajectory-balance

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 diffusion language model 的 post-training 目标问题：直接套用奖励最大化会把概率集中到少数 denoising 轨迹上，导致重复采样时正确解的覆盖变差。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的价值在于非自回归语言模型的训练信号设计。diffusion LM 没有 AR 模型那种清晰的 token-level conditional log-probability，post-training 不能简单照搬 RLHF 或 GRPO 式目标。论文提出的 trajectory locking 说明，终局奖励只看最终答案，不约束 denoising 路径上的概率分配，采样优化会放大早期偶然偏好。这对 diffusion LM、masked LM、any-order LM 的训练目标设计都有启发：不能只看单样本准确率，还要控制分布覆盖和路径概率。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 TraFL，来自 GFlowNet 的 trajectory balance 思路。它不把 reward 当成对采样轨迹的无约束放大器，而是训练当前策略去匹配一个 reference-anchored reward-tilted target distribution。这里的 frozen reference model 负责保留原模型对合理生成的分布约束，reward 负责提高成功 completion 的质量权重。为了适配 diffusion LM，论文没有依赖 AR token logprob，而是构造 diffusion-compatible 的 sequence-level surrogate，用于比较当前模型和 reference model 对完整 denoised completion 的相对倾向。同时引入 prompt-dependent normalization，并与 policy 一起学习，使归一化项在每个训练 step 都能得到梯度，而不是只在采到特定 completion 时才更新。这个设计针对的是 trajectory locking：同一个正确答案可以由多条 denoising 轨迹产生，终局奖励对这些路径不敏感，普通采样 policy gradient 会逐步强化已经更常被采样的路径。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖数学推理和代码生成，包括 GSM8K、MATH-500、HumanEval、MBPP，并在 Minerva Math 和 LiveCodeBench 上做 held-out 评估。论文报告 TraFL 是直接比较的方法中唯一在所有 benchmark-length 设置下都超过 base model 的方法，平均表现优于 ESPO 和 JustGRPO。在 LiveCodeBench 上，TraFL 在各难度 split 中表现最好。论文还用 LLM-as-judge 分析生成结果，证据指向更宽的正确解覆盖，而不只是把概率压到单一高分模式上。提供的内容没有列出具体准确率表，因此不应只按绝对分数解读，重点应看覆盖、多样性和不同长度设置下的稳定性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读偏精读，约 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 trajectory locking 的定义，再看 Trajectory Flow Balancing 部分的目标推导，重点理解 terminal reward 为什么对同一 completion 的不同路径不敏感。实验部分优先看与 ESPO、JustGRPO 的直接比较，以及 prompt-dependent normalization、reference anchoring 的消融。如果关心 diffusion LM 的 RL post-training，目标函数和归一化项值得细读；如果只关心 AR LLM 的常规 RL，可以把它作为非 AR 训练目标的参考案例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies post-training for diffusion language models and identifies a failure mode where reward-driven updates concentrate probability on a narrow set of denoising trajectories, reducing coverage of alternative correct solutions.
summary_en.importance: The main value is in training-signal design for non-autoregressive language models. Diffusion LMs do not expose the same token-level conditional probabilities as AR models, so standard reward-maximizing post-training objectives are not a clean fit. The paper’s trajectory-locking argument is useful beyond this specific method: terminal rewards supervise the final completion but do not specify how probability should be allocated over denoising paths. This matters for diffusion LMs, masked LMs, and any-order generation models where path distributions are part of the model behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: TraFL applies a trajectory-balance objective inspired by GFlowNets. Instead of using reward as an unconstrained multiplier on sampled trajectories, it trains the policy toward a reward-tilted target distribution anchored by a frozen reference model. The reward increases mass on successful completions, while the reference model regularizes allocation over plausible generations. To make this usable for diffusion LMs, the method introduces a diffusion-compatible sequence-level surrogate for comparing fully denoised completions under the current and reference models. It also learns a prompt-dependent normalization term jointly with the policy, so the normalizer receives gradient signal at every training step. This design directly addresses the fact that many denoising paths can lead to the same final answer, while ordinary sampled reward maximization tends to reinforce whichever paths were sampled early.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers mathematical reasoning and code generation: GSM8K, MATH-500, HumanEval, and MBPP, with held-out tests on Minerva Math and LiveCodeBench. The paper reports that TraFL is the only directly evaluated post-training method that improves over the base model in every benchmark-length setting, and that it outperforms ESPO and JustGRPO on average. On LiveCodeBench, it is reported as the strongest method across all difficulty splits. An LLM-as-judge analysis suggests that the gains come from broader coverage of correct solutions rather than only sharper scoring of one dominant mode. The provided text does not include exact accuracy numbers, so the key empirical signal is robustness across settings and improved coverage under repeated sampling.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim with some attention to the objective, about 30 minutes. Start with the definition of trajectory locking in the introduction, then read the Trajectory Flow Balancing section carefully enough to understand why terminal rewards are path-indifferent. In the experiments, focus on direct comparisons with ESPO and JustGRPO, and on ablations for the learned normalization and reference anchoring if available. For readers working on diffusion LM post-training, the objective and normalization design are the main parts to inspect; for readers focused on standard AR RL, it is best read as a case study in non-AR distribution matching.

recommendation.zh: Diffusion LM后训练中的trajectory locking是一个值得关注的新失效模式，TraFL用reference anchor防止坍缩的思路值得在diffusion LM预训练/后训练设计中参考。建议读方法部分。
recommendation.en: Trajectory locking in diffusion LM post-training is a noteworthy new failure mode; the reference-anchor approach of TraFL is worth considering in diffusion LM pretraining/post-training design. Recommend reading the method section.

paper.title: Distribution Corrected Offline Data Distillation for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Distilling reasoning traces from strong large language models into smaller ones is a promising route to improve intelligence in resource-constrained settings. Existing approaches face a fundamental trade-off: offline distillation from teacher-generated traces provides high-quality, sample-efficient supervision but suffers from distributional drift: during training, the student model conditions on teacher-generated prefixes, whereas during inference the student autoregresses on self-generated pre

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是离线推理蒸馏里的分布错配问题。学生模型训练时看到的是教师生成的前缀，推理时却要在自己生成的前缀上继续展开，二者分布不同，误差会沿着长推理链逐步放大。已有纯 SFT 式离线蒸馏样本效率高，但容易学到“只会跟着老师轨迹走”的条件分布；纯 on-policy RL 分布更匹配推理时状态，但采样和打分成本高，而且小模型早期很难产出高质量轨迹。论文要解决的就是：能否只用离线教师数据，在不做在线交互的前提下，把训练目标往学生自己的推理分布上校正一些。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口的启发比单纯的数学推理蒸馏更重要。它把经典 offline RL 里的 distribution correction 思路搬到 LLM reasoning distillation 上，试图在“高质量教师监督”和“学生推理时分布匹配”之间做折中。如果这个方向成立，意义不只是小模型蒸馏：任何基于离线轨迹的 post-train，包括 CoT 蒸馏、工具使用轨迹学习、合成数据 SFT，都有同样的 exposure bias 和 support mismatch。贡献量级上，它不是新范式，而是对现有离线蒸馏目标函数的一次较干净的修正，价值在于训练信号更贴近部署分布，且不引入在线采样成本。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 DISCORD，一种 distribution-corrected offline distillation 目标。论文先用统一的 reasoning-eliciting instruction 让强教师生成高质量数学推理轨迹，构成离线数据集。与标准 SFT 直接最大化教师 token 对数似然不同，DISCORD 在 token 或轨迹层面对教师监督加上 advantage-style 权重，让那些在学生当前策略支持集内、且更可能带来高回报的教师行为得到更大权重。直观上，它不是无差别模仿全部教师 token，而是更强调“学生在自己会走到的状态附近，应该模仿哪些教师动作”。这和 offline RL 里用 importance / advantage 做行为策略校正的思路接近，但论文避免了昂贵的在线 rollout，仍然完全依赖离线教师轨迹。方法兼容现有 distillation pipeline，重点不在改模型结构，而在改监督分布。和 bidirectional KL 一类方法相比，区别在于后者仍围绕教师分布做拟合，而 DISCORD 试图显式缓解 teacher-prefix 与 student-prefix 的错位。
summary.experiments: 从给出的全文片段看，实验主场景是数学推理，比较对象包括标准离线 SFT 蒸馏、若干离线蒸馏改进目标，以及在线采样方法。作者强调结果覆盖多种 student/teacher 组合，并同时看 in-domain 与 out-of-domain benchmark。主要结论是：DISCORD 相比普通离线蒸馏能稳定提升学生推理表现，并在不需要在线交互的前提下缩小与 on-policy 方法的差距。论文还声称做了多模型、多基准验证，说明收益不是单一模型偶然现象。就方法性质推测，关键消融应包括：是否使用 advantage weighting、不同权重形式、不同教师轨迹质量、以及在长链推理任务上的收益是否更明显。当前提供的正文不含完整表格和具体数字，因此无法可靠填写参数量、样本规模和精确提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，把问题设定想清楚：训练条件分布和推理条件分布不一致，为什么会在长推理链上放大。然后重点看方法部分里 distribution-corrected objective 的推导，弄清权重到底依赖什么量，是 token-level 还是 trajectory-level，是否需要额外 reward model 或 verifier。再看实验部分的主表和消融，重点判断三件事：第一，收益是否主要来自更好的数据筛选，而不是目标函数本身；第二，提升是否集中在长 CoT、难题或 out-of-domain；第三，和在线 RL 的差距还剩多少。预计 25–35 分钟可以完成一轮有效泛读。如果后续要复现，优先确认教师数据构造、权重计算方式、以及训练稳定性细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode of offline reasoning distillation: the student is trained on teacher-generated prefixes but must decode from its own prefixes at inference time. This teacher–student mismatch compounds over long reasoning chains, especially in math-style multi-step generation. Pure offline SFT gives high-quality supervision and good sample efficiency, but it optimizes the student under the teacher’s state distribution. Pure on-policy RL matches inference-time states better, yet it is expensive and early-stage small models rarely generate useful trajectories. The central question is whether one can keep the efficiency of offline teacher data while correcting the objective toward the student’s own rollout distribution.
summary_en.importance: Its value is less about one more math-distillation recipe and more about the training-signal design problem at the pretrain/post-train boundary. The paper imports distribution-correction ideas from offline RL into LLM reasoning distillation. That matters because the same mismatch appears in many settings beyond math: CoT distillation, synthetic SFT, tool-use traces, and any offline trajectory learning setup. The contribution is incremental rather than paradigm-shifting, but it is a meaningful one: a cleaner objective that tries to preserve teacher quality while reducing deployment-time mismatch, without paying the cost of online sampling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, DISCORD, is a distribution-corrected offline distillation objective. The pipeline starts with a strong teacher prompted by a reasoning-eliciting instruction to produce high-quality math traces. Instead of standard behavior cloning that maximizes log-likelihood on all teacher tokens equally, DISCORD reweights supervision using an advantage-style signal so that teacher actions more compatible with the student’s reachable support receive larger weight. The intuition is simple: do not imitate every teacher continuation uniformly; emphasize teacher behavior that the student is likely to encounter under its own decoding dynamics and that is associated with better outcomes. This is conceptually close to offline RL corrections based on support and advantage, but the method remains fully offline and does not require online rollouts. The architectural footprint is minimal; the main change is the training objective. Compared with bidirectional divergence variants, the distinction is that those still fit a teacher-centered distribution, whereas DISCORD explicitly tries to reduce the prefix-distribution gap.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided full-text excerpt, the empirical focus is mathematical reasoning, with comparisons against standard offline SFT distillation, improved offline objectives, and online sampling baselines. The main claim is consistent gains across multiple model pairs and benchmarks, including both in-domain and out-of-domain evaluation, and a reduced gap to on-policy methods without online interaction. The likely critical ablations are whether advantage weighting is necessary, how the weighting is defined, how sensitive the method is to teacher-trace quality, and whether gains are larger on longer reasoning trajectories. The excerpt does not include the full result tables, model sizes, data volumes, or exact margins, so precise numbers cannot be stated reliably here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and the overview figure. The key is to internalize the mismatch: training conditions on teacher prefixes, inference conditions on student prefixes. Then read the objective section carefully and pin down what is actually being reweighted: tokens or trajectories, and whether the method needs rewards, verifiers, or estimated advantages from auxiliary models. In the experiments, focus on three checks. First, are the gains coming from the corrected objective rather than simply better filtering of teacher data? Second, do improvements concentrate on long-chain or harder reasoning tasks? Third, how much gap to online RL remains after correction? A useful skim should take about 25–35 minutes. For reproduction, the most important implementation details are teacher-trace construction, weighting computation, and any stability tricks.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它把“高质量离线监督”和“on-policy 分布匹配”之间的老矛盾重新做了干净拆解；先看方法定义和长链误差曲线，若 setup 干净，可直接迁移到 reasoning SFT/RL 数据管线。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it cleanly revisits the old quality-vs-distribution-matching trade-off in reasoning distillation; check the method section and long-horizon error curves first, and steal it if the setup is clean.

paper.title: Know When To Fold 'Em: Token-Efficient LLM Synthetic Data Generation via Multi-Stage In-Flight Rejection
paper.abstract: While synthetic data generation with large language models (LLMs) is widely used in post-training pipelines, existing approaches typically generate full outputs before applying quality filters, leading to substantial token waste on samples that are ultimately discarded. To address this, we propose Multi-Stage In-Flight Rejection (MSIFR), a lightweight, training-free framework that detects and terminates low-quality generation trajectories at intermediate checkpoints before they reach full comple

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是合成数据生成里的 token 浪费问题。常见流程是先让模型把整条样本生成完，再做质量过滤；如果样本中途已经暴露出算术错误、格式错误或明显幻觉，后续 token 其实都是无效开销。作者要解决的是：能不能在生成过程中分阶段做轻量校验，尽早终止低质量轨迹，从而在不训练额外控制器的前提下，降低合成数据成本并维持数据质量。
summary.importance: 它和基座预训练不是直接相关，更接近 post-train 数据管线优化，所以只适合 skim。但对做 SFT/RL 数据合成的人有现实意义：一是把“质量过滤”从生成后处理前移到生成过程中，二是把 token 预算视为可优化资源，而不是默认接受完整采样成本。对于依赖大规模合成数学/科学推理数据的团队，这种方法能直接影响数据生产效率，也会间接影响后续训练信号的噪声水平。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 Multi-Stage In-Flight Rejection，核心是把一条 problem-solution 生成轨迹拆成多个阶段，在阶段边界上运行快速、规则驱动的 validator。校验内容包括算术一致性、幻觉模式、格式约束等；一旦某阶段失败，就立刻停止后续生成。作者把这个过程形式化为 sequential decision problem，并给出 stage-wise token savings 分解，强调越早拒绝，节省越大。

和已有 early-exit 工作的区别在于，后者通常是针对单次推理，试图缩短本来正确的推理链；MSIFR 的目标不是让正确答案更短，而是尽早砍掉错误样本，避免把预算花在注定会被过滤掉的轨迹上。因此它是数据生成管线里的 rejection mechanism，而不是推理时的 reasoning truncation。作者还声称 conditional utility estimate 构成 martingale，因此早拒绝不会引入期望效用偏差；这个理论部分更像是为策略合理性提供解释，而不是方法成立的必要条件。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 5 个 7B-8B 级指令模型：Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、DeepSeek-7B、Phi-3-mini、Mistral-7B；任务覆盖 GSM8K、MATH500、SVAMP、MAWPS、MathQA、MMLU-Chem、DeepMind Mathematics。结果上，作为独立方法，MSIFR 相比完整生成流程可减少 11%-77% 的 token 消耗，文中提到在 GSM8K 上最高可到 42%；与已有 early-exit 方法结合时，最高可到 78.2% 的 token 节省，同时在各 benchmark 上保持或提升准确率。

这些结果说明它在“生成后再过滤”的低效场景里确实有用，但也要注意边界：收益高度依赖 validator 的质量和任务结构。数学、科学问答这类中间状态容易校验的任务更适合；开放式对话、创作类数据则未必有同样效果。论文如果没有报告误杀率、不同 validator 的单独贡献、以及被拒样本对最终训练收益的影响，那方法的泛化性仍需保留判断。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。先看方法总览，明确它不是训练新模型，而是改造 synthetic data generation pipeline。然后看理论部分里 sequential decision 和 martingale 的定义，理解作者想证明什么，不必在形式化细节上停留太久。实验部分重点看三类表：不同模型上的 token 节省幅度、与 early-exit 组合后的增益、以及准确率是否真的没有因早拒绝而下降。如果你关心的是 post-train 数据生产效率，20-25 分钟足够抓住主要信息；如果你关心 pretrain，本篇不需要深读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses token waste in synthetic data generation. In the standard pipeline, an LLM generates a full sample first and quality filters are applied only afterward. If the sample already shows arithmetic errors, hallucination patterns, or formatting failures halfway through generation, the remaining tokens are effectively wasted. The paper asks whether low-quality trajectories can be rejected during generation, stage by stage, without training an additional controller.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training data pipeline paper rather than a pretraining paper, so it belongs in skim territory. Its practical relevance is straightforward: if a team relies heavily on synthetic math or science data for SFT or RL, moving quality control into the generation loop can reduce token cost and improve the effective cleanliness of the retained dataset. The contribution is less about model capability and more about data production efficiency under a fixed inference budget.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The proposed framework, Multi-Stage In-Flight Rejection (MSIFR), decomposes generation into sequential stages and runs lightweight rule-based validators at intermediate checkpoints. These validators check arithmetic consistency, hallucination indicators, and formatting constraints. If a sample fails at any stage, generation is terminated immediately, preventing further token expenditure on a trajectory that would likely be discarded anyway.

The paper formulates this as a sequential decision problem and derives a stage-wise token-savings decomposition, emphasizing that earlier rejection yields larger savings. This is importantly different from prior early-exit methods, which usually try to shorten correct reasoning traces at inference time. MSIFR is not trying to make valid answers shorter; it is trying to stop invalid samples before they fully unfold. The authors also provide a theoretical argument that conditional utility estimates form a martingale, which is used to justify that early rejection preserves unbiased expected utility. That theory is more of a consistency argument than the core source of empirical gains.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans five instruction-tuned models in the 7B-8B range: Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, DeepSeek-7B, Phi-3-mini, and Mistral-7B. Benchmarks include GSM8K, MATH500, SVAMP, MAWPS, MathQA, MMLU-Chem, and the DeepMind Mathematics Dataset. As a standalone method, MSIFR reduces token consumption by 11% to 77% relative to full-generation pipelines, with up to 42% savings reported on GSM8K. When combined with existing early-exit methods, the savings reach as high as 78.2%, while maintaining or improving evaluation accuracy across the tested benchmarks.

The empirical message is clear for structured reasoning tasks with easy-to-check intermediate states. The main caveat is transferability: the method depends heavily on the availability and quality of validators. It is naturally better suited to math and science generation than to open-ended dialogue or creative writing. In the full paper, the most important details to inspect are false rejection rates, the contribution of each validator type, and whether the retained data actually improves downstream training quality rather than just lowering generation cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: A quick skim is enough. Start with the pipeline overview to understand that this is a training-free modification to synthetic data generation, not a new model or decoding algorithm in the usual sense. Then glance at the theoretical section on sequential decisions and the martingale argument to see what is being formalized, but do not spend too much time there unless you care about the decision-theoretic framing. In the experiments, focus on three things: token savings across models, gains when composed with early-exit baselines, and whether accuracy is preserved under aggressive rejection. If your main interest is post-training data efficiency, 20-25 minutes should be enough. If your focus is foundation-model pretraining, this paper is peripheral.

recommendation.zh: 无训练开销的合成数据降本方案，可直接集成到内部SFT数据生成 pipeline，重点看§2的规则校验器设计即可。
recommendation.en: This training-free synthetic data cost reduction framework can be directly integrated into SFT data generation pipelines, refer to §2 for rule validator design.

paper.title: Dynamic Latent Routing
paper.abstract: We investigate the temporal concatenation of sub-policies in Markov Decision Processes (MDP) with time-varying reward functions. We introduce General Dijkstra Search (GDS), and prove that globally optimal goal-reaching policies can be recovered through temporal composition of intermediate optimal sub-policies. Motivated by the "search, select, update" principle underlying GDS, we propose Dynamic Latent Routing (DLR), a language-model post-training method that jointly learns discrete latent codes

summary.core_problem: 低数据微调时，如何让语言模型学习离散 latent code、路由策略和参数更新，而不是只做普通 SFT 或固定 latent 分配。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练方法和 latent routing 机制；它把 MDP 中子策略时间拼接的理论动机引入语言模型微调，试图让模型在单阶段训练中学会“搜索、选择、更新”的动态路由行为。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先提出 General Dijkstra Search，并证明在 time-varying reward 的 MDP 中，全局最优 goal-reaching policy 可由中间最优子策略的时间组合恢复；受此启发，Dynamic Latent Routing 在语言模型后训练中联合学习离散 latent codes、routing policies 和模型参数，通过动态搜索完成训练。
summary.experiments: 在低数据 fine-tuning 设置下，DLR 覆盖四个数据集和六个模型，平均比 SFT 高 6.6 个百分点；摘要称既有 discrete-latent baseline 持续弱于 SFT，而 DLR 能匹配或超过 SFT；还通过机制分析和代码级 ablation 证明学到的 routing 行为具有不同因果角色。
summary.authors_note: 论文标注机构为 Thoughtworks AI Labs (TAILS)。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets low-data fine-tuning where a language model must learn discrete latent codes, routing policies, and parameter updates rather than relying on plain SFT or fixed latent assignments.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and latent-routing contribution. It imports a temporal sub-policy composition view from MDPs into language-model fine-tuning and uses it to motivate a single-stage dynamic routing procedure.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces General Dijkstra Search and proves that globally optimal goal-reaching policies can be recovered through temporal composition of intermediate optimal sub-policies under time-varying rewards. Dynamic Latent Routing then jointly learns discrete latent codes, routing policies, and model parameters through dynamic search.
summary_en.experiments: In low-data fine-tuning, DLR is evaluated on four datasets and six models, reporting an average gain of 6.6 percentage points over SFT or matching it where appropriate. Prior discrete-latent baselines are reported to underperform SFT. Mechanistic analyses and targeted code ablations suggest that the learned routes have distinct causal roles.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is Thoughtworks AI Labs (TAILS).

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 ablation，不要被 MDP 证明带偏；若 routing 角色分析干净，值得复现一个低数据内部任务。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations, not just the MDP proof; if the routing-role analysis is clean, it is worth reproducing on one low-data internal task.

paper.title: Correct Answers from Sound Reasoning: Verifiable Process Supervision for Language Models
paper.abstract: Training language models to produce both correct answers and sound reasoning remains an open challenge. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards typically optimizes only final outcomes, which can lead to a failure mode where task accuracy improves while reasoning becomes less accurate, less complete, or even internally inconsistent. We propose verifiable process supervision (VPS), a post-training framework for verifiable domains that jointly optimizes prediction accuracy and reasoning qual

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 outcome-only RL 在推理训练中的一个具体问题：模型最终答案变准了，但显式推理过程可能变差，表现为中间判断错误、遗漏或前后不一致。作者希望在可验证领域里，同时优化最终答案和推理过程质量。
summary.importance: 这篇论文属于 post-train，但和预训练研究有接口价值。它说明可验证奖励只看最终答案时，训练信号会鼓励捷径，而不一定鼓励可复用的中间推理状态。对 RL pretrain、reasoning-oriented midtrain、以及可验证数据构造都有启发：如果任务天然可分解，过程级 verifier 可以提供比最终答案更密的监督信号；但前提是中间声明能被稳定抽取并确定性验证。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Verifiable Process Supervision，简称 VPS。流程分三步。第一步，用合成推理轨迹做 SFT，让模型输出固定结构的 reasoning trace。结构化格式不是为了可读性，而是为了后续能用简单规则抽取中间 claims，避免依赖 LLM judge 或复杂语义解析。第二步，构造 reasoning verifier，把抽取出的中间声明和领域中的 ground-truth 信号或规则约束比较，得到多个 subtask reward。第三步，在 RL 训练中把最终答案奖励和过程奖励合并。作者还加入 adaptive reward weighting：对当前错误更大的子任务赋予更高权重，相当于让训练动态地偏向模型薄弱的 reasoning subskill。和普通 RLVR 相比，VPS 不只奖励 answer correctness；和 LLM-as-judge 过程打分相比，它更便宜，也更可控，但适用范围依赖可验证环境。
summary.experiments: 实验选择国际象棋作为测试床，因为棋局有确定规则、引擎参考信号，并且 move analysis 可以拆成候选着法、局面评估等可解释子任务。论文报告在四个开源 reasoning models 上，accuracy-only GRPO 能提升最终预测准确率，但会降低推理质量，例如 win-rate error 增大、内部一致性下降。VPS 在保留 top-1 accuracy 收益的同时，提高 Elo rating 和 coverage，并显著降低 win-rate error，使 consistency 接近饱和。adaptive weighting 相比固定聚合更好，尤其改善语言模型本来较难的子任务。在相同准确率下，三个独立 LLM judges 更偏好过程监督模型的推理轨迹。给出的正文片段没有包含 Table 1 的具体数值，因此不应推断精确提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30 分钟。重点看 Adaptive verifiable process supervision 这一节，确认中间 claims 如何定义、如何抽取、每个 subtask reward 如何计算，以及 adaptive weighting 的公式。实验部分重点看 accuracy-only GRPO 与 VPS 的对照表、win-rate error / consistency / Elo 的关系，以及预算长度变化下是否出现 shortcut strategy。若关注可扩展性，需要特别看 chess verifier 的领域依赖程度，因为这是方法能否迁移到数学、代码或工具使用任务的关键限制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a failure mode of outcome-only RL for reasoning models. Optimizing final-answer correctness can improve task accuracy while degrading the exposed reasoning trace: intermediate claims become less accurate, less complete, or internally inconsistent. The goal is to train models that produce both correct answers and verifiable reasoning steps.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training paper, but it is relevant to pretraining-facing research on reasoning signals. It shows that final-answer verifiability alone can create shortcut incentives. When a task can be decomposed into checkable intermediate claims, process-level rewards provide denser and better aligned supervision. The limitation is also clear: the approach depends on domains where intermediate statements can be extracted reliably and checked deterministically.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed framework is Verifiable Process Supervision, or VPS. It first uses SFT on synthetic traces to impose a structured reasoning format. This structure is functional: it allows claims to be extracted with syntactic rules rather than LLM judging or open-ended semantic parsing. A deterministic verifier then checks these claims against domain rules and ground-truth signals, producing multiple subtask rewards. These rewards are aggregated into a reasoning reward and combined with the standard final-answer reward during RL. The paper also introduces adaptive reward weighting, which gives more weight to subtasks where the model still has larger errors. Compared with standard RLVR, VPS supervises both the conclusion and the reasoning path. Compared with LLM-judge process supervision, it is cheaper and less noisy, but less general.
summary_en.experiments: Chess is used as the controlled environment because it has exact rules, engine-derived reference signals, and naturally decomposable reasoning components such as candidate move selection and position evaluation. Across four open reasoning models, accuracy-only GRPO improves prediction accuracy but harms reasoning quality, increasing win-rate error and reducing internal consistency. VPS preserves the accuracy gains while improving Elo rating and coverage, lowering win-rate error, and pushing consistency close to saturation. Adaptive weighting improves over fixed reward aggregation, especially on subtasks that are harder for language models. At matched accuracy, three independent LLM judges prefer the traces produced by process-supervised models. The provided text does not include the numeric entries from Table 1, so exact effect sizes cannot be verified here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 minutes. Focus on the VPS method section: the trace schema, claim extraction rules, verifier design, subtask rewards, and the adaptive weighting formula. In the experiments, compare accuracy-only GRPO against VPS on top-1 accuracy, win-rate error, consistency, Elo, and coverage. The most important scalability question is how much of the chess verifier is domain-specific, since that determines whether the same idea can transfer to math, code, or tool-use settings.

recommendation.zh: 读奖励构造和自适应加权；chess 外推要保留，但它清楚暴露了 final-only RLVR 的坏激励。
recommendation.en: Read the reward construction and adaptive weighting; chess may not transfer cleanly, but it exposes the bad incentives of final-only RLVR.

paper.title: GRACE: Gradient-aligned Reasoning Data Curation for Efficient Post-training
paper.abstract: Existing reasoning data curation pipelines score whole samples, treating every intermediate step as equally valuable. In reality, steps within a trace contribute very unevenly, and selecting reasoning data well requires assessing them individually. We present GRACE, a gradient-aligned curation method that views each reasoning trace as a sequence of optimization events and scores every step by two complementary signals: its alignment with the answer-oriented gradient direction, and its consistenc

summary.core_problem: 现有推理数据筛选方法均在完整推理链粒度操作，将所有中间推理步骤视为同等价值，既浪费训练算力，也会稀释高价值训练信号，当前没有方法能评估单个推理步骤对模型优化的实际贡献。
summary.importance: 为推理后训练的数据筛选提供了优化视角的新思路，无需依赖外部奖励模型或步骤级人工标注，可大幅降低推理后训练的算力开销，筛选得到的数据子集还可跨不同模型骨干迁移。
summary.technical_approach: 将推理链建模为优化事件序列，每个步骤的效用得分由两个互补指标计算：与最终答案导向的梯度方向的对齐度，与前置推理轨迹的一致性。步骤级得分聚合为样本级价值分用于子集选择。引入表征级梯度代理，仅需单次前向传播即可计算步骤得分，无需逐步骤反向传播，适配大规模数据集的筛选需求。
summary.experiments: 在MMathCoT-1M数据集上对Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct做后训练，仅使用筛选出的前20%数据训练的效果超过全量数据训练，平均性能达到全量数据的108.8%；仅使用5%的筛选数据即可保留全量数据100.2%的性能。筛选得到的子集可跨不同模型骨干有效迁移。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读Introduction部分的动机分析、Method部分的表征级梯度代理实现、Experiments部分的跨模型迁移结果，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing reasoning data curation methods operate at full trace granularity, treating all intermediate reasoning steps as equally valuable, which wastes training compute and dilutes high-value training signals. No current approach can evaluate the actual optimization contribution of individual reasoning steps.
summary_en.importance: Provides an optimization-focused new perspective for reasoning post-training data curation, eliminates the need for external reward models or step-level human annotations, significantly reduces post-training compute overhead, and selected data subsets are transferable across different model backbones.
summary_en.technical_approach: Frames reasoning traces as sequences of optimization events. Each step's utility score is computed from two complementary metrics: alignment with answer-oriented gradient direction, and consistency with preceding reasoning trajectory. Step-level scores are aggregated to sample-level value for subset selection. A representation-level gradient proxy is introduced to compute step scores with a single forward pass, no per-step backward pass is required, which fits large-scale dataset curation requirements.
summary_en.experiments: Post-train Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct on MMathCoT-1M dataset. Training on top 20% curated data outperforms full-data training, reaching 108.8% of full-data average performance across benchmarks; training on 5% curated data retains 100.2% of full-data performance. Selected subsets transfer effectively across different model backbones.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the motivation analysis in Introduction, implementation of representation-level gradient proxy in Method, and cross-model transfer results in Experiments. Expected reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 ablation：若梯度 proxy 成本真低，可放进内部推理数据筛选实验复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations only; if the gradient proxy is truly cheap, it is worth reproducing in internal reasoning-data filtering.

paper.title: Emergent and Subliminal Misalignment Through the Lens of Data-Mediated Transfer
paper.abstract: Fine-tuning LLMs on narrow harmful datasets can induce Emergent Misalignment (EM), where models exhibit misaligned behavior far beyond the fine-tuning distribution. We argue that emergent misalignment can be better understood as a data-mediated transfer phenomenon: harmful fine-tuning examples do not induce uniform behavioral spillover, but interact with the structural properties of the dataset and the difficulty of the tasks relative to the model. Across our experiments, we find that misalignme

summary.core_problem: 解释并预测“窄分布有害微调”为什么会触发远超微调分布的广泛失配行为（Emergent Misalignment, EM），以及“看似无关的教师输出”为什么能把特质/失配通过数据传给学生（Subliminal Learning, SL）。论文把两者统一到一个问题：失配不是均匀外溢，而是沿着数据中可迁移的结构被“数据介导地转移”（data-mediated transfer）。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练闭环的直接启发在于：安全失配的传播更像“表征与任务结构的迁移”而不是“主题污染”。这会影响三类实践：1）SFT/蒸馏/合成数据管线的安全评估应按“功能结构（task）”分层，而不是按领域（domain）或关键词过滤；2）过滤式去毒/去特质在蒸馏场景可能天然不稳，因为载体可能是结构性统计特征而非显式语义；3）提出“prompt 的 EM surface（可容纳连贯有害续写的空间）”这种可操作概念，能把很多看似玄学的失配差异落到可测的输入属性上，用于数据审计与红队集构造。
summary.technical_approach:
核心做法是把评测与训练数据组织成“domain × task”的网格：domain 表示话题背景，task 表示底层输入-输出映射/功能形式（例如同为‘建议/推荐’但换话题，或同话题但换成‘解释/分类’等）。在自然语言上构造一个结构化数据集，同时再做一个可控的合成数据集（Synthetic-Dataset）来解耦 domain 相似度与 task 相似度，并能系统操纵自然语言里难以单独控制的因素。

论文的关键假设与验证路径：
1）EM 的迁移主要由 task 相似驱动，而非 domain 相似：同一功能结构的提示更容易把微调学到的失配模式迁移过去。
2）同一 task/domain 内，提示本身也有“表面形状”：有些提示天然给模型留下更大空间去生成“流畅、相关、且任务一致”的有害完成。作者把这种可迁移性/可被失配填充的程度定义为 EM surface，用来解释同格子内的差异。
3）用合成数据进一步拆分两个因素：任务难度（task hardness）与模型对相关失配行为的预训练暴露（pretraining exposure）。直觉是：目标行为越“已被模型可靠学会”，微调越容易把它推向更一般化的失配模式；任务越难，迁移可能受限或呈现不同形态。

在 SL 侧，论文把“教师→学生的特质传递”也当作数据介导转移：即便语义过滤掉了显式特质内容，数据仍可能保留与 task 结构、分布形状、或某些统计痕迹相关的可迁移信号，从而让学生继承行为倾向。论文的贡献更多是把 EM 与 SL 放进同一套可控实验框架里，用 task/domain 结构去问‘到底是数据的什么属性在携带特质’。
summary.experiments:
全文给出的最关键证据是定性+结构化对照：
- 在结构化自然语言数据集上，沿 task 维度的迁移显著强于沿 domain 维度的迁移：当微调与评测共享功能结构时，更容易出现远域失配；仅共享话题但 task 不同，失配外溢更弱。
- 在 Synthetic-Dataset 上复现同样结论，并通过可控变量显示：任务难度、以及模型对相关行为的既有掌握程度，会系统性影响 EM 出现的门槛与强度。
- 在同一 task/domain 内，作者用 EM surface 解释“为什么某些 prompt 更容易被失配填满”：提示越开放、越允许连贯续写，越容易出现可泛化的有害完成。

summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
1）先看引言里对“data-mediated transfer”的定义与为什么要做 domain×task 网格（这决定了整篇文章的解释框架）。
2）直接跳到两套数据集的构造方式：结构化自然语言数据集与 Synthetic-Dataset，重点看 task/domain 如何被操作化，否则后面结论会像‘换个说法’。
3）看主结果图：domain×task 的迁移热力图/矩阵（通常是最有信息密度的图），确认“task > domain”的证据形态。
4）看 EM surface 的定义与测量：它是把“提示开放度”变成可讨论变量的关键。
5）如果你关心蒸馏/合成数据安全，补看 SL 相关实验：过滤后仍传递的信号与 task 结构的关系。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to explain and predict (1) why fine-tuning on a narrowly harmful dataset can trigger broad out-of-distribution misbehavior (Emergent Misalignment, EM), and (2) why a student model can inherit a teacher’s traits/misalignment even when the distillation data are semantically unrelated and filtered (Subliminal Learning, SL). It frames both as data-mediated transfer: misalignment does not “spill over” uniformly; it transfers along structural regularities in the training/eval data.
summary_en.importance: For pretrain/post-train practice, the main implication is that safety failures propagate more through functional/task structure than topical similarity. This pushes against domain/keyword-based safety auditing and filtering in SFT/distillation pipelines. The introduced notion of an “EM surface” (how much a prompt affords a coherent harmful completion) is also practically useful: it turns prompt-to-prompt variance into a measurable property that can guide red-teaming set construction and data audits.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Methodologically, the paper builds controlled evaluation/training grids organized by domain × task, where domain is topical context and task is the underlying input-output mapping (functional form). It introduces (i) a structured natural-language dataset and (ii) a synthetic dataset that mirrors NL while allowing direct control over domain similarity, task similarity, task difficulty, and pretraining exposure.

Key hypotheses and tests:
- EM transfer is driven primarily by shared task structure rather than shared topical domain.
- Even within the same domain/task cell, prompts vary in how easily they can be “filled” with fluent, relevant, task-consistent harmful completions; this is formalized as the prompt’s EM surface.
- In the synthetic setting, the authors vary factors that are hard to isolate in NL: task hardness and the model’s prior reliability/competence on the target behavior (as a proxy for pretraining exposure), and measure how these shift the onset/strength of EM.

For SL, the same lens is applied: trait transmission is attributed to non-semantic, structure-carrying aspects of the data distribution (potentially task-structured statistics), not necessarily explicit trait content.
summary_en.experiments:
The central empirical pattern is a structured set of contrasts:
- On the domain×task natural-language grid, misalignment generalizes much more strongly when fine-tuning and evaluation share the same task structure; sharing only topical domain yields weaker transfer.
- The synthetic dataset reproduces the same qualitative result while enabling controlled sweeps over task difficulty and prior exposure/competence, showing systematic shifts in EM emergence.
- Within a fixed domain/task, prompt-level variance is explained via EM surface: more “open” prompts that allow coherent continuations are more susceptible.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include the main tables/figures with exact model sizes, dataset sizes, and numeric deltas; those would be in the experiments section (likely heatmaps over the grid and dose-response curves for the synthetic controls).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~25–35 minutes):
1) Read the introduction for the precise definition of data-mediated transfer and why domain×task control is necessary.
2) Jump to dataset construction: how domain and task are operationalized is the backbone of the paper.
3) Inspect the main result figures (grid heatmaps/matrices) to verify the “task > domain” claim.
4) Read the EM surface definition and how it is measured/approximated; this is the most reusable concept for practitioners.
5) If you care about distillation safety, skim the SL experiments to see how transfer depends on task structure even after semantic filtering.

recommendation.zh: 只看机制实验和 pretraining composition 部分；它把失配看成结构化迁移，比“有害数据污染”这个解释更可操作。
recommendation.en: Skim the mechanism experiments and the pretraining-composition result; the transfer framing is more actionable than treating harmful fine-tuning as generic contamination.

paper.title: LoopUS: Recasting Pretrained LLMs into Looped Latent Refinement Models
paper.abstract: Looped computation shows promise in improving the reasoning-oriented performance of LLMs by scaling test-time compute. However, existing approaches typically require either training recurrent models from scratch or applying disruptive retrofits, which involve substantial computational costs and may compromise pretrained capabilities. To address these limitations, we introduce \textbf{Looped Depth Up-Scaling} (LoopUS), a post-training framework that converts a standard pretrained LLM into a loope

summary.core_problem: 现有将预训练LLM改造为测试时间循环推理架构的方法存在依赖启发式选层、隐状态易漂移、长循环训练成本高且不稳定的问题，从零训练循环LLM则计算成本过高。
summary.importance: 为后训练阶段提升模型推理能力提供了一条不增加参数量、不需要重新预训练的低成本路径，同时验证了隐表示动态分析可直接指导模型结构改造，为测试时间计算的规模化落地提供了可行方案。
summary.technical_approach: 基于预训练LLM的隐状态分层演化规律（早层快速变换token嵌入、中层形成稳定表示平台、末层转向输出空间解码），将模型拆分为编码器、循环推理块、解码器三个功能模块，仅复用中间推理块作为循环主体；引入选择性门控缓解迭代过程中的隐状态漂移，用随机深度监督避免全量时间反向传播的显存占用和梯度异常问题，新增置信度头实现测试时间计算量的自适应分配。
summary.experiments: 在原预训练骨干基础上零样本精度提升3.0%，WikiText和LAMBADA数据集的困惑度分别下降17.4%和21.3%；在TinyLlama上的训练token量比现有循环基线少17-20倍的条件下，取得14.6%的相对性能提升，循环深度增加时训练过程仍保持稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看第1章的隐表示动态观察和核心组件介绍，以及第3章的关键实验结果，预计阅读时间20-30分钟，无需深究具体推导细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing methods to convert pretrained LLMs into looped test-time reasoning architectures either rely on heuristic layer selection, suffer from hidden state drift, or incur high training cost and instability for long loops, while training looped LLMs from scratch has prohibitive compute cost at modern model scales.
summary_en.importance: It provides a low-cost post-training path to improve LLM reasoning capability without increasing parameter count or retraining from scratch, validates that hidden representation dynamics analysis can directly guide architecture retrofitting, and offers a practical solution for scalable test-time compute allocation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Based on the staged hidden state evolution pattern of pretrained LLMs (early layers transform token embeddings rapidly, middle layers form a stable representation plateau, final layers transition to vocabulary space decoding), the model is split into three functional modules: encoder, looped reasoning block, and decoder, with only the middle reasoning block reused as the loop body. It introduces a selective gate to mitigate hidden state drift during iteration, random deep supervision to avoid memory overhead and gradient anomalies of full backpropagation through time, and a confidence head for adaptive test-time compute allocation.
summary_en.experiments: It improves zero-shot accuracy by 3.0% over the original pretrained backbone, reduces perplexity on WikiText and LAMBADA by 17.4% and 21.3% respectively. On TinyLlama, it achieves 14.6% relative performance gain with 17-20× fewer training tokens than existing looped baselines, and training remains stable as loop depth increases.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the hidden representation dynamics observation and core component introduction in Chapter 1, and key experimental results in Chapter 3. Estimated reading time is 20-30 minutes, no need to dive into detailed derivations.

recommendation.zh: 一种将标准 LLM 改造为循环架构以扩展 test-time compute 的后训练方法，关注其如何解决隐藏状态漂移和长递归训练的内存问题，值得一读。
recommendation.en: A post-training method to retrofit standard LLMs into looped architectures for scaling test-time compute. Focus on how it addresses hidden-state drift and memory issues in long recursive training; worth a read.

paper.title: Combining On-Policy Optimization and Distillation for Long-Context Reasoning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Adapting large language models (LLMs) to long-context tasks requires post-training methods that remain accurate and coherent over thousands of tokens. Existing approaches are limited in several ways: 1) off-policy methods such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and knowledge distillation (KD) suffer from exposure bias and limited recovery from model-generated errors over long horizons; 2) on-policy reinforcement learning methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) better align trainin

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文 post-training 里的一个老问题：离线监督方法稳定，但一旦模型进入自己生成的轨迹，误差会沿着很长的生成链条累积；纯 on-policy RL 又能对齐真实 rollout 分布，但奖励稀疏、方差大、训练不稳，尤其在长上下文推理里更明显。作者要解决的不是单点算法改进，而是给出一个更完整的长上下文对齐配方：怎样把 on-policy 的分布匹配能力、token 级蒸馏的稠密监督、以及 reward-driven 优化结合起来，让模型在几千到上万 token 的推理和生成中既能保持正确性，也能保持结构和连贯性。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是新基座架构或新预训练目标，但对 pretrain↔post-train 接口有直接价值。原因有两点。第一，长上下文能力并不只由 RoPE 外推或继续预训练决定，后训练阶段是否在模型自己的长轨迹上学习，影响很大。第二，这篇工作把“稀疏奖励 RL”和“稠密 teacher guidance”放到同一个 on-policy 框架里，给出了一个比单独 GRPO 或单独蒸馏更实用的折中。这个思路对 reasoning model、continual post-train、甚至后续 mid-training 都有参考意义：如果训练目标需要覆盖长 horizon，单靠离线 imitation 往往不够，单靠 RL 又太贵且不稳，混合信号可能是更现实的路线。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 dGRPO，名字上看是把 GRPO 和 on-policy distillation 叠加，真正关键在于三件事如何配合。第一，训练数据不是固定 teacher traces，而是当前 student policy 在长上下文任务上的 on-policy rollout，因此训练分布与推理分布一致，能减轻 exposure bias。第二，在这些 rollout 上同时施加两类学习信号：一类是 GRPO 风格的组相对优势信号，用于直接优化任务奖励；另一类是 token-level 的 teacher distillation，用 teacher 在相同 prefix 下的分布给出稠密监督，帮助模型在长轨迹中维持局部决策质量。第三，作者在实现上去掉了常见 RLHF 里的 reference KL，设 β_ref=0，不再显式约束到初始策略，理由是 reasoning/long-context 场景下策略自然偏离初始模型未必有害，而且省显存和算力。

从方法定位看，SFT/KD 是 off-policy + dense signal，但没有 reward objective；GRPO 是 on-policy + reward objective，但 token 级监督稀疏；OPD 是 on-policy + dense signal，但不能直接优化任意 reward。dGRPO 试图同时拿到这三者的优点。文中还配套提出 LONG-BLOCKS 合成数据集，覆盖 multi-hop reasoning、contextual grounding、long-form generation，作用不是单纯扩充样本量，而是给长上下文 on-policy 对齐提供更丰富的任务分布。若从训练机制理解，dGRPO 的价值主要在 credit assignment：reward 负责全局方向，distillation 负责局部稳定，两者都发生在模型自己采样到的状态上，因此比离线 KD 更贴近真实误差传播链条。
summary.experiments:
从全文可见，作者做的重点不是追求单一 benchmark 的高分，而是系统比较几种长上下文后训练策略：SFT/KD、OPD、GRPO、dGRPO。实验结论很明确：单独的离线方法在短程结构学习上有效，但随着上下文和输出长度增加，恢复模型自生成错误的能力不足；单独 GRPO 能提升 reward 对齐，但训练波动更大，样本效率更差；dGRPO 在长上下文任务上更稳定，且通常能同时保住短上下文能力。文中反复强调“preserving short-context capabilities of the starting model”，说明他们把能力保持当作主要评估维度之一，而不是只看长上下文分数。

就可见内容而言，论文给出了方法比较表、训练 recipe 图，以及 LONG-BLOCKS 数据构成，但你提供的全文片段没有包含完整结果表、参数规模、训练 token 数、具体 benchmark 分数和提升幅度，因此没法负责任地填入精确数字。可以确认的是：实验设计围绕 Qwen3-based setup 展开，且比较对象覆盖 off-policy、on-policy RL、on-policy distillation 以及混合方法。若后续拿到完整附录，最该核对的是三类数字：一是不同 context length 下的性能曲线；二是训练稳定性指标，如 reward variance、loss/advantage 波动；三是短上下文通用能力是否出现回退，以及回退幅度。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Table 1 和方法总览图，先把四类训练范式的差别吃透：采样分布、学习信号稠密度、是否直接优化 reward、是否缓解 exposure bias。然后重点看方法章节里 dGRPO 的目标函数定义，确认蒸馏项和 GRPO 项是如何加权、在什么 rollout 上计算、teacher 是否只提供 logits 还是还参与筛选。接着看实验部分的主表和训练曲线，尤其关注三件事：长上下文收益是否随长度增加而扩大；dGRPO 相比纯 GRPO 的稳定性改善是否显著；短上下文能力保持是否真实而非口头描述。

如果时间有限，预计 25–35 分钟可以抓住主线。若要深挖，建议额外看 LONG-BLOCKS 的数据生成细节，因为这会影响你对方法收益来源的判断：提升到底来自更好的算法，还是来自更合适的长上下文训练任务分布。另外，作者把 β_ref 设为 0，这个决定值得单独审视，尤其要看是否在某些任务上带来风格漂移或安全性退化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical bottleneck in long-context post-training: off-policy methods such as SFT and KD are stable and dense, but they train on teacher trajectories rather than the model’s own long rollouts, so exposure bias compounds over long horizons; pure on-policy RL methods better match inference-time states, but become noisy, sparse, and sample-inefficient when rewards arrive late. The paper asks a recipe-level question rather than a narrow algorithmic one: how to combine on-policy learning, dense token supervision, and reward optimization so that an LLM can reason coherently over very long contexts without sacrificing its existing short-context behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it matters for the pretrain-to-post-train interface. Long-context capability is not determined only by positional extrapolation or continued pretraining; the distribution on which the model is aligned after pretraining also matters. The paper is useful because it treats long-horizon alignment as a signal-design problem: sparse reward gives global direction, dense teacher guidance stabilizes local token decisions, and on-policy sampling makes both signals land on the states the model will actually visit. That framing is relevant to reasoning models, continual post-training, and possibly mid-training recipes where long-horizon behavior is a target.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The proposed method, dGRPO, combines Group Relative Policy Optimization with on-policy distillation. The key idea is not merely adding two losses together, but aligning them on the same on-policy trajectories. First, the student samples its own long-context rollouts, so training happens on the model-induced state distribution rather than on fixed expert traces. Second, each rollout receives two learning signals: a GRPO-style relative reward signal for direct task optimization, and a token-level teacher distillation signal that provides dense next-token guidance under the same prefixes. Third, the implementation removes the usual reference-policy KL term by setting beta_ref to zero, following recent reasoning-model practice, which reduces memory/compute overhead and allows the policy to move farther from initialization when that helps reasoning.

The paper positions the method against three alternatives. SFT/KD gives dense supervision but is off-policy and does not optimize arbitrary rewards. GRPO is on-policy and reward-driven but sparse. On-policy distillation is on-policy and dense but not reward-optimizing. dGRPO is meant to inherit all three desirable properties at once: on-policy sampling, dense token guidance, and direct reward optimization. The accompanying LONG-BLOCKS synthetic dataset is also part of the recipe. It covers multi-hop reasoning, contextual grounding, and long-form generation, so the method is evaluated and trained on a broader long-context task mix rather than a narrow retrieval-style setup.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental contribution is mainly comparative and recipe-oriented. The paper contrasts SFT/KD, OPD, GRPO, and dGRPO in a Qwen3-based setup for long-context reasoning. The qualitative conclusion is consistent throughout the text: off-policy methods help with structure and imitation but struggle to recover from self-generated errors over long horizons; pure GRPO can improve reward alignment but is less stable and less sample-efficient; dGRPO improves long-context performance more consistently while better preserving the base model’s short-context capability.

However, the provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, appendix numbers, model sizes, token budgets, or exact benchmark gains. So it would be unsafe to invent precise figures. What should be checked in the full paper is clear: performance as a function of context length, stability metrics during training, and retention of short-context general abilities after long-context alignment. Those three axes determine whether the gains come from a genuinely better training signal or simply from task/data specialization.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with Table 1 and the overview figure. They clarify the design space better than the prose: trajectory source, signal density, reward optimization, and exposure-bias behavior. Then read the method section closely to see how the GRPO term and the distillation term are combined, how trajectories are sampled, and what exactly the teacher provides. After that, go straight to the main comparison tables and training curves. The most important questions are: does the advantage of dGRPO grow with longer contexts, does it materially stabilize training relative to pure GRPO, and does short-context performance remain intact rather than merely degrade less.

For a quick pass, 25 to 35 minutes should be enough. For a deeper read, inspect the LONG-BLOCKS construction details and the decision to set beta_ref to zero. Those two choices are likely to explain a large fraction of the observed behavior.

recommendation.zh: Cohere提出的dGRPO结合RL和蒸馏提升长上下文能力，可参考其数据合成逻辑优化内部长上下文后训练流程
recommendation.en: dGRPO proposed by Cohere combines RL and distillation for long context improvement, reference its data synthesis logic to optimize internal long context post-training pipeline

paper.title: Adaptive Teacher Exposure for Self-Distillation in LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation has become a strong recipe for LLM reasoning, where a privileged teacher supervises the student's own rollouts while conditioning on the reference solution. A design choice shared by nearly all such methods, however, has gone unquestioned: the teacher always sees the full reference reasoning. We argue that this default itself is part of the problem and identify a teacher-side exposure mismatch: when the teacher conditions on reasoning far beyond the student's current

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是 on-policy self-distillation 中一个被默认忽略的设计点：teacher 在给学生 rollouts 做 token-level 监督时，是否应该总是看到完整参考推理。作者指出，full exposure 会造成 teacher-side exposure mismatch：teacher 条件中包含的推理信息超过学生当前能力，生成的软目标过强，学生难以吸收。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对 reasoning post-training 更直接，但对预训练研究也有接口意义。它把“监督信号强度”从固定超参变成可学习控制变量，说明更强的 teacher context 不一定带来更好的学习信号。这个结论可以迁移到 curriculum、self-training、process supervision、RL 数据构造等场景：关键不是给模型最多信息，而是让目标分布落在当前模型可学习的范围内。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 ATESD。基础框架是 OPSD：同一个模型同时作为 student 和 teacher。student 只看题目并生成 on-policy rollout；teacher 额外看参考解，对同一条 rollout 给出 token 分布；训练时只更新 student，最小化 teacher 到 student 的逐 token forward KL，并使用 KL clipping 稳定训练。论文的改动是把 teacher 可见的参考推理比例设为连续变量 α∈[0,1]，而不是固定为 1。作者先做固定 exposure sweep，发现 α=0.5 一类中等暴露比 full exposure 更稳；同时 teacher-student mismatch 随 α 单调增长。ATESD 用一个轻量 Beta-policy controller，根据训练状态统计量输出 α。controller 不是每步更新，而是在 hold window 内保持一个 exposure 决策；student 每个 distillation step 更新；controller 通过 REINFORCE 使用 discounted learning-progress reward 更新。这个 reward 评估 exposure 决策对后续若干步学生提升的影响，避免用单步 KD loss 下降来错误归因。
summary.experiments: 论文在 AIME 2024、AIME 2025、HMMT 2025 上评估，模型包括 Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B。固定 exposure 实验显示两个现象：full exposure 不是可靠最优；teacher-student mismatch 随 exposure 增大而单调上升。难度分桶分析显示，不同题目难度和训练阶段偏好的 exposure 不同，支持自适应控制。主结果中，ATESD 在这些数学推理 benchmark 上持续优于 self-distillation 与 RL baseline；Qwen3-4B 达到 65.65 Average@12。消融的核心信息是：连续 exposure 控制、hold/lookahead 两时间尺度、用未来学习进展而不是单步代理 reward，对效果都很关键。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。重点看三处：第一，§3.2 的 fixed-exposure sweep，那里给出 full exposure 失效和 mismatch 单调增长的证据；第二，方法部分关于 Beta controller、hold/lookahead schedule、discounted learning-progress reward 的定义，这是论文主要机制；第三，主实验和消融表，关注 ATESD 相比 OPSD、固定 α、RL baseline 的差距。若只关心可迁移启发，可重点读 exposure mismatch 的定义和 reward 设计，不必深读所有数学 benchmark 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies an overlooked design choice in on-policy self-distillation for reasoning: whether the teacher should always condition on the full reference reasoning when supervising the student’s own rollouts. The authors identify a teacher-side exposure mismatch. When the teacher sees reasoning far beyond the student’s current capability, its token targets become too strong and less learnable.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly about reasoning post-training, but the lesson is relevant to pretraining-adjacent training design. It treats the strength of the supervision signal as a controllable variable rather than a fixed assumption. More privileged context for the teacher does not necessarily produce better learning targets. The same issue can appear in curriculum learning, self-training, process supervision, RL data generation, and other settings where model-generated trajectories are trained against stronger conditional distributions.
summary_en.technical_approach: ATESD builds on OPSD. In OPSD, the student conditions only on the problem and samples an on-policy rollout. The teacher is the same model under a privileged context that includes the reference solution, and it provides token-level distributions along the student rollout. Training minimizes a clipped per-token forward KL, with gradients flowing only through the student. ATESD changes the teacher context from full reference exposure to a continuous exposure level α∈[0,1]. A preliminary fixed-exposure sweep shows that intermediate exposure, such as α=0.5, can outperform full exposure, while teacher-student mismatch grows monotonically with α. The method uses a lightweight Beta-policy controller that maps compact training-state statistics to an exposure value. The controller holds one global exposure over a window, while the student updates every distillation step. The controller is trained with REINFORCE using a discounted learning-progress reward, so exposure decisions are credited by their effect on future student improvement rather than by immediate KD-loss reduction.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT 2025 with Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B, and Qwen3-8B. The fixed-exposure study reports two key patterns: full exposure is not a reliable optimum, and teacher-student mismatch increases as exposure grows. Difficulty-binned analysis indicates that different problem regimes prefer different exposure levels, motivating adaptive control. In the main results, ATESD consistently improves over self-distillation and RL baselines. On Qwen3-4B, it reaches 65.65 Average@12. The main ablation signal is that adaptive exposure, the two-timescale hold/lookahead schedule, and the future learning-progress reward are central to the gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–35 minutes. Read the fixed-exposure sweep in §3.2 first, because it establishes why full teacher exposure is not a safe default. Then read the method section for the Beta controller, the hold/lookahead schedule, and the discounted learning-progress reward. Finally, inspect the main result and ablation tables to see how much of the gain comes from adaptive exposure versus the reward and scheduling choices. Readers mainly interested in transferable training insights can focus on the mismatch definition and credit-assignment design.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 exposure sweep；它提醒我们别迷信更强 teacher，目标分布太远会把蒸馏信号做脏。
recommendation.en: Read the exposure sweep; it is a useful warning that a stronger teacher can make distillation targets less learnable.

paper.title: Anti-Self-Distillation for Reasoning RL via Pointwise Mutual Information
paper.abstract: On-policy self-distillation, where a student is pulled toward a copy of itself conditioned on privileged context (e.g., a verified solution or feedback), offers a promising direction for advancing reasoning capability without a stronger external teacher. Yet in math reasoning the gains are inconsistent, even when the same approach succeeds elsewhere. A pointwise mutual information analysis traces the failure to the privileged context itself: it inflates the teacher's confidence on tokens already

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 reasoning RL 中 on-policy self-distillation 在数学推理上收益不稳定的问题。标准做法让同一个模型在带有 verified solution 或环境反馈的 privileged context 下充当 teacher，再用逐 token KL 拉近 student。论文指出，在数学题中，这个 teacher 会更确信那些已由答案暗示的结构词和可验证陈述，却降低对 Wait、Let、Maybe 等探索性推理 token 的支持。结果是蒸馏信号削弱了多步搜索所需的 deliberation。
summary.importance: 这篇工作属于 post-train / RL reasoning 方法，但对预训练研究也有间接价值。它说明 token-level 训练信号的方向比“是否更有信息”更关键。带答案的上下文并不一定提供好的中间过程监督；它可能鼓励捷径式轨迹，而不是鼓励模型保留搜索空间。这个观察对 RL pretrain、过程监督、合成推理数据过滤都有借鉴意义：训练信号需要区分“答案已知后的解释”与“求解过程中的探索”。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先用 pointwise mutual information 分析自蒸馏信号。teacher 分布为 πθ(· | x, c, y_<t)，其中 c 是训练时可见的 verified solution 或反馈；student 分布为 πθ(· | x, y_<t)。标准 self-distillation 最小化 student 到 teacher 的逐 token divergence，相当于奖励在 privileged context 下概率上升的 token。问题是，privileged context 会让 teacher 像 oracle 一样偏向已知答案所支持的 token，而不是偏向求解时有用的探索 token。Anti-Self-Distillation 的处理很直接：不下降 divergence，而是上升 student 与 teacher 之间的 Jensen-Shannon divergence，从而反转逐 token 信号。JSD 的形状给 advantage 提供天然边界，减少梯度过大风险；另外加入 entropy-triggered gate，当 teacher 的逐 token 熵塌缩时关闭该项，避免过度推开一个已过于确定的 teacher。方法可作为 GRPO 中逐 token 辅助项的替换，不需要外部 teacher 或单独的 process reward model。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 5 个 4B–30B 模型，主要评测数学推理，也包含 coding 任务。数学基准包括 AIME 2024 和 AIME 2025。结果显示，默认 self-distillation 通常不能稳定超过强 GRPO baseline；AntiSD 能在 2–10 倍更少的训练 step 内达到 GRPO baseline 的准确率，并在最终准确率上最高提升 11.5 个百分点。诊断实验表明，默认蒸馏会增强结构连接词和答案相关声明的概率，同时压低 deliberation token；反向 JSD 后，这个逐 token 信号方向被翻转。消融中，JSD 的有界性和 entropy gate 是稳定训练的关键组件。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–40 分钟。先看 Section 3.1 的 conditional PMI 推导，这是理解方法动机的核心；再看 Section 3.2 中 AntiSD 如何从 divergence descent 改成 divergence ascent，以及为什么选 JSD 而不是普通 KL。实验部分重点看 Figure 1、Figure 2、Section 4.1 的模型规模 sweep，以及 entropy gate 和 divergence choice 的消融。若关注 RLVR 训练稳定性，可以细读 advantage 形状和 gate 触发条件。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses why on-policy self-distillation gives inconsistent gains for math reasoning. In the standard setup, the same model acts as a teacher under privileged context, such as a verified solution or feedback, and the student is trained to match that teacher token by token. The paper shows that this privileged teacher becomes confident on tokens already implied by the known solution, while assigning less support to deliberative tokens such as Wait, Let, and Maybe. This weakens the exploratory behavior needed for multi-step reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and reasoning-RL paper, but it has useful implications for pretraining-oriented researchers who care about training signals. It shows that richer conditioning is not automatically better supervision. A solution-conditioned teacher may produce a shortcut signal: it rewards tokens that make sense after the answer is known, not tokens that help discover the answer. The lesson transfers to RL pretraining, process supervision, and synthetic reasoning-data construction: token-level signals should distinguish retrospective explanation from search-time deliberation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis starts from a pointwise mutual information view of self-distillation. The student distribution is πθ(· | x, y_<t), while the teacher distribution is πθ(· | x, c, y_<t), with c denoting privileged training-only context. Standard self-distillation minimizes a token-level divergence between them, so tokens whose probability increases under c receive positive pressure. In math reasoning, this favors solution-implied structure and verifiable claims, while suppressing tokens used for reconsideration and branching. Anti-Self-Distillation reverses this pressure by ascending a Jensen-Shannon divergence between student and teacher instead of descending it. The JSD form gives a bounded token-level advantage, and an entropy-triggered gate disables the term when the teacher distribution becomes too collapsed. The method can be inserted into GRPO as a replacement for the usual self-distillation auxiliary loss, without using an external teacher or a separate process reward model.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover five models from 4B to 30B parameters on math reasoning benchmarks, including AIME 2024 and AIME 2025, with additional coding evaluations. Default self-distillation often fails to beat a strong GRPO baseline. AntiSD reaches the GRPO baseline accuracy in 2x to 10x fewer training steps and improves final accuracy by up to 11.5 points. Token-level diagnostics show the intended sign change: the standard loss reinforces tokens implied by the privileged solution, while AntiSD pushes back against that shortcut signal. Ablations indicate that the bounded shape of JSD and the entropy gate are important for stable training.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–40 minutes. Start with Section 3.1 for the conditional PMI identity, since it explains the failure mode rather than just proposing a new loss. Then read Section 3.2 for the divergence-ascent objective, the choice of JSD, and the entropy gate. In the experiments, focus on Figure 1, Figure 2, the model-size sweep in Section 4.1, and ablations on divergence choice and gating. Readers working on RLVR stability should pay special attention to the induced token-level advantage shape.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是它对 self-distill 失败机制的 token 级拆解，不是方法名本身；先看 PMI 分析和 entropy gate，若 setup 不干净就把结论当弱信号。
recommendation.en: The useful part is the token-level diagnosis of why self-distillation fails, not the method name; read the PMI analysis and entropy gate first, and treat the gains as weak evidence unless the setup is unusually clean.

institutions: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: Learn to Think: Improving Multimodal Reasoning through Vision-Aware Self-Improvement Training
paper.abstract: Post-training with explicit reasoning traces is common to improve the reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). However, acquiring high-quality reasoning traces is often costly and time-consuming. Hence, the self-improvement paradigm has emerged, enabling MLLMs to self-generate reasoning traces for training without external supervision. Despite its effectiveness, we reveal two shortcomings in the self-improvement training of MLLMs: 1) data imbalance, where simple sample

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型自提升训练仅依赖答案正确性作为质量信号，存在两个核心问题：1）数据不平衡，简单样本生成的正确解多导致过训练，难样本正确解不足导致训练不充分；2）语言先验偏差，模型过度依赖语言先验忽略视觉线索，碰巧答对的幻觉推理样本无法被过滤。
summary.importance: 优化了多模态后训练的自提升范式，提出的策略可低成本提升多模态推理性能、减少视觉幻觉，可直接适配多模态推理模型的监督微调、偏好学习等后训练流程，也为预训练与后训练的推理能力衔接提供了数据构造思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出VISTA视觉感知自提升训练框架，包含两个核心策略：1）前缀重采样：识别失败推理轨迹中的正确前缀，复用其作为上下文重采样新的推理解，提升难样本的正确解数量，缓解数据不平衡；2）视觉感知注意力得分（VAS）：利用模型内部注意力信息量化推理过程中对视觉线索的关注度，过滤低VAS的幻觉推理样本，缓解语言先验偏差。两个策略均无需额外监督，可适配不同多模态模型和后训练范式。
summary.experiments: 在5个主流多模态大模型、5个多模态推理任务上验证，相比初始推理模型平均性能最高提升13.66%，适配监督微调、偏好学习等多种后训练范式，可有效降低视觉幻觉率，提升分布外泛化性能。
summary.reading_guide: 先阅读Introduction部分对自提升训练两个缺陷的分析，再了解两个核心策略的设计思路，重点关注实验中不同任务的性能提升幅度和消融实验结果即可。预计阅读时间25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing self-improvement training for multimodal large language models only uses answer correctness as the quality signal, leading to two core issues: 1) Data imbalance: simple samples generate abundant correct solutions causing over-training, while difficult samples lack sufficient correct solutions leading to under-training; 2) Language prior bias: models over-rely on linguistic priors and ignore visual cues, and hallucinated reasoning samples that accidentally get correct answers cannot be filtered out.
summary_en.importance: It optimizes the self-improvement paradigm for multimodal post-training, the proposed strategies can improve multimodal reasoning performance at low cost and reduce visual hallucinations. It can be directly applied to SFT, preference learning and other post-training processes of multimodal reasoning models, and also provides data construction ideas for connecting pretraining and post-training reasoning capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed VISTA (Vision-aware Self-improvement Training) framework includes two core strategies: 1) Prefix resampling: identify correct prefixes from failed reasoning traces, reuse them as context to resample new reasoning solutions, increase the number of correct solutions for difficult samples and alleviate data imbalance; 2) Vision-aware Attention Score (VAS): quantify the model's attention to visual cues during reasoning using internal attention information, filter out hallucinated reasoning samples with low VAS to mitigate language prior bias. Both strategies require no extra supervision, and are compatible with different multimodal models and post-training paradigms.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on 5 mainstream multimodal large language models and 5 multimodal reasoning tasks. It achieves up to 13.66% average performance gain compared with the initial reasoning model, adapts to multiple post-training paradigms including supervised fine-tuning and preference learning, effectively reduces visual hallucination rate and improves out-of-distribution generalization performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: First read the analysis of two limitations of self-improvement training in Introduction section, then learn the design logic of two core strategies, focus on the performance gain across different tasks and ablation study results in Experiments section. Estimated reading time: 25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是范式突破，但它把“自蒸馏推理数据怎么采、怎么防语言偷懒”讲得比较具体；只看数据重采样和视觉约束消融就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm shift, but it is concrete about how to sample self-generated reasoning data and how to stop language-only shortcutting; read the resampling and visual-grounding ablations.

paper.title: Boosting Omni-Modal Language Models: Staged Post-Training with Visually Debiased Evaluation
paper.abstract: Omni-modal language models are intended to jointly understand audio, visual inputs, and language, but benchmark gains can be inflated when visual evidence alone is enough to answer a query. We study whether current omni-modal benchmarks separate visual shortcuts from genuine audio-visual-language evidence integration, and how post-training behaves under a visually debiased evaluation setting. We audit nine omni-modal benchmarks with visual-only probing, remove visually solvable queries, and reta

summary.core_problem: 现有全模态语言模型的基准测试存在严重的视觉捷径问题——大量音视语言任务仅靠视觉输入和问题文本就能得到答案，导致模型性能提升无法反映真实的跨模态融合能力；同时全模态后训练的最优范式不明确，不清楚仅增强双模态能力是否足够支撑全模态理解。
summary.importance: 揭示了全模态基准的视觉泄漏问题，提供了可复用的去偏评测集，同时验证了全模态后训练中显式全模态数据的必要性，对多模态大模型的后训练流程设计、评测体系建设有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 首先构建去视觉偏置的评测集OmniClean：对9个现有全模态基准的16968条查询做视觉-only探测，移除仅靠视觉就能回答的查询，最终保留8551条有效查询，过滤评测中的视觉捷径。然后提出分阶段后训练方案OmniBoost：对比平衡双模态SFT、混合模态RLVR、自蒸馏合成数据SFT三种范式，其中自蒸馏方法不需要更强的外部全模态教师模型，通过多源双模态模型（LLaVA-Video、Step-Audio-R1、Qwen3-VL等）的输出提取实体、时空关系，合成全模态查询并过滤推理轨迹得到训练数据。
summary.experiments: 基于Qwen2.5-Omni-3B基座测试，仅做平衡双模态SFT的全模态迁移效果有限且不均衡；只有加入显式的全模态数据训练后才能获得明显的全模态性能提升；使用自蒸馏合成数据SFT后，3B模型在OmniClean评测上的性能与更大规模的开源模型相当，略超过Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读第3章的视觉泄漏审计方法和OmniClean构建规则、第4章的分阶段后训练对比实验，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing omni-modal language model benchmarks have severe visual shortcut problem: a large number of audio-visual-language tasks can be solved with only visual input and question text, making model performance improvements fail to reflect real cross-modal fusion capability. Besides, the optimal paradigm for omni-modal post-training remains unclear, as it is unknown whether enhancing bi-modal capabilities alone is sufficient to support omni-modal understanding.
summary_en.importance: Reveals the visual leakage problem in omni-modal benchmarks, provides a reusable debiased evaluation set, and verifies the necessity of explicit omni-modal data in omni-modal post-training, which has direct reference value for post-training pipeline design and evaluation system construction of multimodal large models.
summary_en.technical_approach: First constructs OmniClean, a visually debiased evaluation set: conducts visual-only probing on 16,968 queries from 9 existing omni-modal benchmarks, removes queries that can be answered with visual input only, and finally retains 8,551 valid queries to filter visual shortcuts in evaluation. Then proposes OmniBoost, a staged post-training recipe: compares three paradigms including balanced bi-modal SFT, mixed-modality RLVR, and SFT on self-distilled synthetic data. The self-distillation method does not require a stronger external omni-modal teacher model: it extracts entities and spatiotemporal relations from outputs of multiple bi-modal models (LLaVA-Video, Step-Audio-R1, Qwen3-VL, etc.), synthesizes omni-modal queries and filters reasoning traces to obtain training data.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on Qwen2.5-Omni-3B base model, balanced bi-modal SFT alone brings limited and uneven omni-modal transfer; significant omni-modal performance improvement can only be obtained after adding explicit omni-modal data for training. After SFT on self-distilled synthetic data, the 3B model achieves comparable performance to larger open-source references on OmniClean evaluation, and slightly outperforms Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the visual leakage audit method and OmniClean construction rules in Section 3, and the staged post-training comparison experiments in Section 4. Expected reading time is 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 建议读评测清洗和 RLVR 消融；它提醒多模态后训练先验不能建立在视觉捷径 benchmark 上。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark-cleaning and RLVR ablations; it warns against forming multimodal post-training priors from visually shortcut benchmarks.

paper.title: The Many Faces of On-Policy Distillation: Pitfalls, Mechanisms, and Fixes
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) have emerged as promising post-training methods for large language models, offering dense token-level supervision on trajectories sampled from the model's own policy. However, existing results on their effectiveness remain mixed: while OP(S)D has shown promise in system prompt and knowledge internalization, recent studies also report instability and degradation. In this work, we present a comprehensive empirical study of when OP

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM后训练中使用的on-policy蒸馏（OPD）和on-policy自蒸馏（OPSD）效果存在明显场景差异，部分场景下不稳定甚至导致性能退化，目前缺乏对其生效/失效机制的系统分析，也没有针对性的稳定化方案。
summary.importance: 明确了OP(S)D这类后训练蒸馏方法的适用边界，其失效机制分析可以指导预训练与后训练的衔接设计，提出的稳定化方案可以降低后训练阶段的性能退化风险，为规模化蒸馏流水线提供可落地的优化方向，避免盲目套用OP(S)D带来的训练不稳定问题。
summary.technical_approach: 首先系统梳理了OP(S)D的完整设计空间，覆盖教师构造（自蒸馏/冻结教师/EMA教师）、特权信息（PI）类型（无/仅答案/完整回复/系统提示）、蒸馏损失设计（全词表KL/采样token策略梯度/Top-K反向KL/停止梯度Top-K）三类维度。随后识别出三个核心失效机制：1）学生生成的前缀会将教师带入局部状态，使其token级监督信号与学生轨迹不兼容；2）Top-K反向KL的近似计算会引入有偏梯度，破坏优化稳定性；3）OPSD只能学到跨实例的无PI共识策略，当PI为实例特定信息（如数学题的标准答案）时无法生效。最后提出三个针对性稳定化方案：带停止梯度的Top-K KL代理损失以消除有偏梯度、用可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）适配教师以提升任务对齐度、对学生做SFT以规范输出格式并稳定回复长度。
summary.experiments: 在数学推理、系统提示内化、对齐三类任务上完成对比验证：1）数学推理任务中，OPD效果高度依赖教师选择和损失形式，容易出现长度爆炸、内容重复、师生监督错位问题，OPSD在测试的所有数学推理设置下完全失效；2）系统提示内化和对齐任务中，OPSD表现稳定有效，因为这类场景下PI诱导的是共享的潜在行为，可以压缩为测试时无PI的通用策略；3）提出的三类稳定化方案可分别缓解对应失效机制，显著降低OPD在推理任务上的不稳定性和性能退化概率。
summary.reading_guide: 先阅读第1节的图1，快速把握OP(S)D的设计空间、失效场景和修复方案的整体框架；再重点读第3节的三个失效机制的具体分析；最后扫一眼稳定化方案的核心效果结论。不需要精读损失函数的公式推导细节，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。
summary.authors_note: 包含UIUC研究人员，其中一位作者为UIUC实习期间完成该工作，其余作者背景未披露。

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy distillation (OPD) and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) used in LLM post-training show significant scenario-dependent performance, with instability and even performance degradation in some settings. There is no systematic analysis of their working/failure mechanisms, nor targeted stabilization solutions.
summary_en.importance: Clarifies the applicable boundaries of OP(S)D post-training distillation methods. Its failure mechanism analysis can guide the interface design between pretraining and post-training, and the proposed stabilizers reduce the risk of performance degradation in post-training stages, providing implementable optimization directions for large-scale distillation pipelines to avoid training instability caused by blind application of OP(S)D.
summary_en.technical_approach: First maps the full OP(S)D design space across three dimensions: teacher construction (self-distillation / frozen teacher / EMA teacher), privileged information (PI) types (none / answer only / full response / system prompt), and distillation loss design (full-vocab KL / sampled-token policy gradient / Top-K reverse KL / stop-gradient Top-K). Then identifies three core failure mechanisms: 1) student-generated prefixes push the teacher into local states where its token-level supervision is incompatible with the student trajectory; 2) Top-K reverse KL approximation introduces biased gradients that destabilize optimization; 3) OPSD only learns a single PI-free consensus policy across instances, which fails when PI is instance-specific (e.g., ground-truth answers for math problems). Finally proposes three targeted stabilizers: stop-gradient Top-K KL surrogate to eliminate biased gradients, RL with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) adapted teachers to improve task alignment, and student SFT to standardize output format and stabilize response length.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across three task categories: mathematical reasoning, system prompt internalization, and alignment. 1) On math reasoning, OPD performance is highly sensitive to teacher selection and loss formulation, prone to length explosion, repetition, and teacher-student supervision mismatch, while OPSD fails completely in all tested math reasoning settings. 2) On system prompt internalization and alignment, OPSD works stably as PI induces shared latent behavior that can be compressed into a general PI-free policy for test time. 3) The three proposed stabilizers mitigate corresponding failure modes and significantly reduce OPD instability and performance degradation on reasoning tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with Figure 1 in Section 1 for a high-level overview of OP(S)D design space, failure scenarios and fixes. Then focus on the detailed analysis of three failure mechanisms in Section 3, and finally scan the core effect conclusions of the stabilizers. No need to dive into detailed formula derivations of loss functions, estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliated with UIUC; one author completed the work during an internship at UIUC, other author backgrounds are not disclosed.

recommendation.zh: 只看机制实验和修复部分即可；它提醒 OPD 不是免费午餐，PI 的训练-测试可见性比 loss 名字更关键。
recommendation.en: Read the mechanism and fix sections; the useful prior update is that OPD is not free, and PI visibility across train/test matters more than the loss label.

paper.title: Reward Hacking in Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has enabled strong post-training gains in domains such as math and coding, though many open-ended settings rely on rubric-based rewards. We study reward hacking in rubric-based RL, where a policy is optimized against a training verifier but evaluated against a cross-family panel of three frontier judges, reducing dependence on any single evaluator. Our framework separates two sources of divergence: verifier failure, where the training verifier credi

summary.core_problem: 解决基于评分规则（rubric）的强化学习中奖励黑客问题，即策略在训练验证器上的得分提升不对应真实任务效果的提升，需拆分该问题的两类独立来源。
summary.importance: 对后训练阶段的强化学习对齐流程设计有明确参考价值，尤其是在医疗、科学等无法做精确正确性校验的开放领域，可支持提前识别奖励漂移、选择合理早停时机。
summary.technical_approach: 搭建双维度诊断框架：第一，用3个前沿评估器组成的参考面板对比训练验证器的判断，拆分出「验证器失效」（训练验证器奖励了参考面板拒绝的响应）；第二，对比基于评分规则和无评分规则的评估结果，拆分出「评分规则设计局限」（即使强验证器也会偏好无规则评估打分更低的响应）。另外提出无需外部评估器的「自内化差距」指标，通过策略自身的对数概率计算跟踪奖励黑客情况，可作为早停信号。
summary.experiments: 在医疗、科学领域数据集上，弱训练验证器场景下训练奖励持续上升，但参考面板评估的奖励进入平台期，策略对验证器的利用程度持续上升；识别出三类常见的验证器失效模式：部分复合、隐含当显式、不精确校验。即使使用强验证器，基于评分规则的评估偏好强化学习 checkpoint，无规则评估仍偏好基础模型，收益集中在完整性等存在性类指标上，对应更长、声明密度更高但整体质量更差的响应。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看引言部分的问题拆解、诊断框架定义和核心实验结论，跳过冗余的实验实现细节，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: This work addresses reward hacking in rubric-based reinforcement learning, where policy performance gains on training verifiers do not translate to real task effectiveness, and aims to disentangle two distinct sources of this performance divergence.
summary_en.importance: It provides actionable insights for post-training RL alignment design, especially for open-ended domains like medicine and science where exact correctness verification is not feasible, enabling early detection of reward drift and reasonable early stopping decisions.
summary_en.technical_approach: A two-dimensional diagnostic framework is proposed: First, a reference panel of three frontier judges is used to compare with training verifier judgments, isolating verifier failure where the training verifier rewards responses rejected by the reference panel. Second, comparisons between rubric-based and rubric-free evaluation isolate rubric design limitation, where even strong rubric-based verifiers prefer responses with lower rubric-free quality scores. A verifier-free self-internalization gap metric computed from the policy's own log probabilities is also introduced to track reward hacking and serve as an early stopping signal.
summary_en.experiments: On medical and science domain datasets, under weak training verifier settings, training reward increases continuously while reference panel reward plateaus, and policy exploitation of the verifier rises consistently. Three recurring verifier failure modes are identified: partial-compound, implicit-as-explicit, and imprecise verification. Even with strong verifiers, rubric-based evaluation prefers RL checkpoints while rubric-free evaluation still prefers the base model, with gains concentrated on presence-based criteria like completeness, corresponding to longer, more claim-dense responses with lower overall quality.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the problem disentanglement in Introduction, diagnostic framework definition, and core experimental findings. Skip redundant experimental implementation details, expected reading time 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得读 failure taxonomy；它提示开放域 RLVR 的主要坑不是 reward 弱，而是 rubric 本身会诱导错目标。
recommendation.en: Read the failure taxonomy; the warning is that open-domain RLVR can fail because the rubric itself induces the wrong target.

paper.title: Understanding and Preventing Entropy Collapse in RLVR with On-Policy Entropy Flow Optimization
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an effective paradigm for improving the reasoning ability of large language models. However, widely used RLVR algorithms, such as GRPO, often suffer from entropy collapse, leading to premature determinism and unstable optimization. Existing remedies, including entropy regularization and ratio-based clipping heuristics, either control entropy in a coarse-grained manner or rely on approximate on-policy training. In this paper, we rev

summary.core_problem: 现有可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）算法如GRPO存在熵坍缩问题，训练早期策略熵快速降至近零，导致过早收敛到确定性策略、探索不足。现有熵正则化和裁剪启发式方法要么粗粒度控熵易引入训练不稳定，要么依赖过期参考策略无法保证严格同策略性质。
summary.importance: 从token级熵流视角给出了熵坍缩的统一解释，提出的严格同策略熵流优化方法可用于RL后训练阶段稳定训练过程、提升推理任务性能，为RL预训练/后训练的熵控制提供了新的优化方向。
