paper.title: StoryAlign: Evaluating and Training Reward Models for Story Generation
paper.abstract: Story generation aims to automatically produce coherent, structured, and engaging narratives. Although large language models (LLMs) have significantly advanced text generation, stories generated by LLMs still diverge from human-authored works regarding complex narrative structure and human-aligned preferences. A key reason is the absence of effective modeling of human story preferences, which are inherently subjective and under-explored. In this work, we systematically evaluate the modeling of h

summary.core_problem: 评估和训练面向长篇故事生成的奖励模型，解决现有 LLM 生成故事在叙事结构和人类偏好上与人工作品不一致的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是偏好评测与后训练数据：提出 StoryRMB，用于衡量奖励模型是否能识别人类偏好的故事；同时构造约 10 万对故事偏好数据，为故事生成的 RM 训练提供资源。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上围绕故事偏好建模展开：先构造包含 prompt、一个 chosen story 和三个 rejected stories 的人工验证评测集，再收集多领域故事偏好对，用于训练或改进故事奖励模型。创新点不在 RM 架构，而在故事这一长文本、主观偏好强的生成场景中做专门评测和数据构造。
summary.experiments: StoryRMB 含 1,133 个高质量人工验证实例。论文报告现有奖励模型在该 benchmark 上表现不佳，最佳模型准确率为 66.3%。摘要未给出模型参数量、训练 compute、完整 baseline 列表和用 10 万偏好对训练后的具体提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自清华大学计算机科学与技术系。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates and trains reward models for long-form story generation, targeting the mismatch between LLM-written stories and human preferences over narrative structure and engagement.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation and preference-data resource for post-training: StoryRMB measures whether reward models can select human-preferred stories, and the authors also build roughly 100K story preference pairs for reward-model training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work constructs a human-verified benchmark where each instance contains a prompt, one chosen story, and three rejected stories, then builds a larger set of diverse story preference pairs. The novelty is not a new reward-model architecture, but a domain-specific preference setup for long, subjective narrative generation.
summary_en.experiments: StoryRMB contains 1,133 human-verified instances. Existing reward models struggle on the benchmark, with the best reported model reaching 66.3% accuracy. The provided abstract does not specify model sizes, compute, the full baseline suite, or the gains after training on the 100K preference pairs.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the Department of Computer Science and Technology, Tsinghua University.

recommendation.zh: 故事偏好是窄域 RM；可看数据标注和失败案例，别把 66.3% 外推成通用 RM 结论。
recommendation.en: This is a narrow story-RM setup; inspect the annotation design and failure cases, but do not over-generalize the 66.3% number to reward modeling broadly.

paper.title: Uni-OPD: Unifying On-Policy Distillation with a Dual-Perspective Recipe
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently emerged as an effective post-training paradigm for consolidating the capabilities of specialized expert models into a single student model. Despite its empirical success, the conditions under which OPD yields reliable improvement remain poorly understood. In this work, we identify two fundamental bottlenecks that limit effective OPD: insufficient exploration of informative states and unreliable teacher supervision for student rollouts. Building on this i

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 on-policy distillation 的可靠性问题：学生模型在自己的采样轨迹上接受教师 token-level 监督，但学生探索到的状态未必有训练价值，教师在这些学生轨迹上的逐 token 反馈也未必可信。两者都会让 OPD 在长链推理、多任务和多模态蒸馏中不稳定。
summary.importance: 这是一篇 post-train 方向的高相关论文。它没有改变基座预训练目标，但对 pretrain ↔ posttrain 接口有实际信息量。原因是 OPD 同时吸收了 SFT 的 dense supervision 和 RL 的 on-policy sampling：学生不会只模仿离线专家答案，而是在自己会到达的状态上学习；教师又能提供比终局 reward 更细的 token 级训练信号。论文的主要贡献是把 OPD 的失败来源拆成两个可操作问题：状态探索不足和教师监督不可靠，并给出一套在 LLM 与 MLLM 上统一使用的 recipe。对做持续预训练、能力合并、专家模型蒸馏和多模态统一模型的人来说，它提供的是训练信号质量控制方法，而不只是一个蒸馏 loss。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Uni-OPD，核心是 dual-perspective optimization：从学生侧改善探索，从教师侧校准监督。基础 OPD 设定是：给定问题 q，学生策略 πθ 采样轨迹 τ；训练时在这些 on-policy prefix 上最小化学生和教师 πT 的 reverse KL。这个目标可以被解释为在学生实际访问的状态上施加 token-level reward，因此比离线 SFT 更少受 exposure bias 影响，也比只用终局奖励的 RL 更容易做细粒度 credit assignment。学生侧使用两种数据平衡。第一是 offline difficulty-aware balancing，先按样本难度组织训练分布，避免训练批次被过易样本主导，也避免大量不可学样本带来噪声。第二是 online correctness-aware balancing，根据学生当前采样轨迹的正确性动态调节训练样本，让模型持续看到“有信息量”的状态，尤其是接近决策边界的正确与错误轨迹。教师侧提出 outcome-guided margin calibration。它不盲目信任教师在学生轨迹上的 token 概率，而是用 outcome reward 作为全局锚点检查轨迹级排序：正确轨迹的聚合教师分数应高于错误轨迹。若教师的逐 token 信号在轨迹级别与结果奖励不一致，就通过 margin 约束进行校准，使 token-level supervision 与最终正确性保持更一致。这个设计针对的是 OPD 的常见问题：教师在 OOD 学生前缀上退化、给流畅但错误的推理较高概率、多个教师之间信号冲突，或在多模态输入上产生不稳定的 token 偏好。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 5 个领域和 16 个 benchmark，包含 LLM 与 MLLM 设置。论文报告了多种蒸馏场景：single-teacher distillation、multi-teacher distillation、strong-to-weak distillation，以及 text-only 与 multimodal task 混合的 cross-modal distillation。关键实验结论是，单独使用 vanilla OPD 会受到学生采样分布和教师信号质量的限制；加入 offline difficulty-aware balancing 和 online correctness-aware balancing 后，学生访问到的训练状态更有信息量；再加入 outcome-guided margin calibration 后，教师 token 监督与结果正确性的顺序一致性提高，训练效果更稳定。消融的核心价值在于证明三件事：探索平衡和监督校准解决的是不同瓶颈；只做数据平衡不能修复错误教师信号；只做教师校准也不能弥补学生状态覆盖不足。正文片段未给出可核验的逐 benchmark 数值，因此不应编造具体提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Introduction 中对 OPD 两个瓶颈的定义，因为这是整篇论文的判断框架。然后看 Methodology 的 OPD 梯度推导，尤其是 reverse KL 如何诱导 token-level reward；这部分决定了它和 SFT、GRPO 类 RL 的差异。随后重点读 Fig. 2 和 3.3、3.4：3.3 看两种 balancing 如何构造训练分布，3.4 看 outcome reward 如何校准教师 token 信号。实验部分优先看三类内容：order-consistency 的分析图、三组件消融、LLM/MLLM 和 multi-teacher 设置下的稳定性对比。值得深挖的是 margin calibration 的可替代实现，例如能否用 verifier、process reward model 或 execution feedback 替代简单 outcome reward，以及这种校准是否会过度压制教师的软分布信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when on-policy distillation is reliable. OPD trains a student on its own sampled trajectories with token-level teacher supervision, but two things can fail: the student may not explore informative states, and the teacher may give unreliable token-level guidance on student-generated prefixes.
summary_en.importance: This is a high-signal post-training paper for foundation-model researchers. It does not propose a new pretraining objective, but it is relevant to the interface between pretraining and post-training. OPD combines two useful properties: on-policy sampling from RL and dense token-level supervision from distillation. The paper’s contribution is to turn OPD reliability into two controllable training-signal problems: state coverage and teacher-signal calibration. That matters for expert merging, continual capability injection, multimodal unification, and strong-to-weak transfer.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uni-OPD uses a dual-perspective recipe. From the student side, it improves exploration with two balancing strategies. Offline difficulty-aware balancing shapes the training distribution by sample difficulty, so training is not dominated by trivial examples or by examples that are too hard to learn from. Online correctness-aware balancing then uses the student’s current rollout correctness to keep training focused on informative states, especially near the boundary between correct and incorrect behavior. From the teacher side, the paper introduces outcome-guided margin calibration. Vanilla OPD trusts the teacher’s token probabilities on student rollouts, but those rollouts can be out of distribution for the teacher. The proposed calibration uses outcome reward as a global anchor: after aggregating token-level teacher scores over a trajectory, correct trajectories should rank above incorrect ones by a margin. If this order consistency is violated, the teacher signal is adjusted. This is meant to handle teacher degradation on unusual student prefixes, fluent but wrong reasoning chains, conflicts between multiple teachers, and unstable multimodal supervision.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 5 domains and 16 benchmarks across LLM and MLLM settings. The paper tests single-teacher distillation, multi-teacher distillation, strong-to-weak distillation, and cross-modal distillation that mixes text-only and multimodal tasks. The main empirical message is that vanilla OPD is limited by both student exploration and teacher reliability. The two balancing strategies improve the informativeness of student-generated states, while outcome-guided margin calibration improves the agreement between token-level teacher supervision and final correctness. The ablations are important because they separate the two bottlenecks: balancing cannot fix a miscalibrated teacher signal, and calibration cannot compensate for poor state coverage. The provided content does not expose verifiable per-benchmark numbers, so specific accuracy gains should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is worth a careful read. Start with the introduction, where the two OPD bottlenecks are defined. Then read the OPD gradient derivation in the methodology section; it clarifies why reverse-KL distillation on student rollouts can be viewed as token-level reward learning. The most important parts are Fig. 2 and Sections 3.3–3.4: Section 3.3 explains how the data distribution is balanced, and Section 3.4 explains how outcome reward calibrates teacher supervision. In the experiments, prioritize the order-consistency analysis, component ablations, and the LLM/MLLM multi-teacher results. A useful follow-up question is whether the margin calibration can be driven by verifiers, process reward models, or execution feedback without destroying the useful soft information in teacher distributions.

recommendation.zh: 读 §3 的两个 bottleneck 和 teacher order-consistency；若指标干净，可直接变成内部蒸馏诊断项。
recommendation.en: Read the two bottlenecks and teacher order-consistency analysis; if the metrics are clean, they become immediate internal OPD diagnostics.

paper.title: EvoLM: Self-Evolving Language Models through Co-Evolved Discriminative Rubrics
paper.abstract: Language models encode substantial evaluative knowledge from pretraining, yet current post-training methods rely on external supervision (human annotations, proprietary models, or scalar reward models) to produce reward signals. Each imposes a ceiling. Human judgment cannot supervise capabilities beyond its own, proprietary APIs create dependencies, and verifiable rewards cover only domains with ground-truth answers. Self-improvement from a model's own evaluative capacity is a reward source that

summary.core_problem: EvoLM 解决的是非可验证任务中的奖励来源问题：模型在预训练中已经学到不少评价知识，但常规 RL 后训练通常把奖励交给人类标注、专有模型、标量 reward model 或可验证答案。这些信号要么成本高，要么依赖外部系统，要么容易 reward hacking，要么只适用于有标准答案的任务。论文的核心问题是：能否把模型自身的评价能力结构化成可训练的 rubric，并用这些 rubric 反过来训练同一个模型的策略能力。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值不在于提出一个新的 benchmark 分数，而在于把“模型自身评价知识如何成为训练信号”做成了一个相对闭合的训练回路。对预训练研究也有直接启发：它把预训练中隐含的 evaluative knowledge 看作可被后训练激活和重组的能力，而不是只能由外部 reward 注入。更具体地说，EvoLM 提供了一个 post-train 信号质量的建模框架：奖励不是一个黑盒标量，而是由可检查的判分标准产生。这个设计有助于减少 reward model 过优化，也让 reward 的来源更可解释。贡献量级属于方法范式层面的改进，尤其适合关注 pretrain ↔ posttrain 闭环、RL 信号构造、非可验证任务自提升的研究者精读。
summary.technical_approach: 方法的关键是把评价拆成两步：先生成 rubric，再让 judge 按 rubric 对回答打分。rubric 的好坏不由人工标注决定，而由它是否能帮助 judge 区分好回答和坏回答来决定。论文把 rubric 看作潜变量，并用类似变分推断的视角推导训练目标：一个有用的 rubric 应该让 judge 对 preferred response 给出更高分，对 dispreferred response 给出更低分，并拉大二者差距。训练采用交替式 co-evolution。第一阶段固定 rubric generator，让当前 policy 对问题采样多个回答，judge 在 rubric 条件下打分，得到 rubric-derived reward，再用 GRPO 更新 policy。第二阶段固定或使用更新后的 policy 构造偏好对，当前 checkpoint 的回答作为 preferred，早期 checkpoint 的回答作为 dispreferred，这叫 temporal contrast。rubric generator 采样多个 rubric，judge 分别按这些 rubric 给偏好对打分，rubric 的奖励来自分数差是否正确、差距是否足够大，然后同样用 GRPO 更新 rubric generator。与 GPT-4.1 生成 rubric 或人工偏好数据训练 rubric 的方法不同，EvoLM 不需要外部 rubric 标签，也不需要专有 teacher。与标量 reward model 不同，它不直接学习一个压缩后的偏好分数，而是学习可展开、可迁移、可被不同 judge 使用的评价标准。论文还强调一个重要机制：好的 rubric 会把整体判断拆成较小的、可逐项检查的子任务，甚至把预期中间值写进标准里，使较小的 judge 也能稳定判分。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 12 个 benchmark，包含数学、代码、一般推理、知识、指令跟随和开放式生成。在 OLMo3-Adapt 评测套件上，EvoLM 的平均分为 69.3%，高于 GPT-4.1-prompted rubrics 的 66.7%。一个在 held-out 偏好评测上很强的标量 reward model，RewardBench 2 为 86.4%，JudgeBench 为 80.8%，但训练出的下游 policy 平均只有 59.7%，比 EvoLM 低 9.6 分。这个结果说明离线偏好判别能力不等于可用于 RL 的好奖励，尤其在 policy 会主动寻找奖励漏洞时更明显。论文还报告了泛化结果：co-evolving 框架可扩展到 OLMo-3-7B；学到的 rubric 可以迁移到未见过的 policy 和 judge；在分布外 deep research 任务上，EvoLM 与专家人工 rubric 的 pairwise agreement 高于 GPT-4.1，HealthBench 为 58.4% 对 52.5%，ResearchQA 为 59.3% 对 51.0%。定性分析显示，训练后的 rubric generator 会生成更细粒度、更可核查的标准，让 1.7B 参数级别的 judge 也能可靠执行一部分判断。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction、Section 2、Figure 2、Section 3.2、Section 3.3 和 qualitative analysis。Figure 2 是理解方法的入口：看清 policy training phase 和 rubric training phase 的交替关系。Section 2 需要重点看 latent rubric variable、discriminative utility、GRPO 目标之间如何连接，这是方法是否站得住的关键。Section 3.2 重点看与 GPT-4.1 rubric、现有 rubric-based RL、标量 reward model 的对照，尤其要关注“偏好 benchmark 上强的 reward model 为什么训练 policy 反而弱”。Section 3.3 重点看迁移到 unseen policies / judges 的实验，因为这决定 rubric 是否只是拟合某个 judge，还是学到了更通用的评价分解。qualitative analysis 值得细读，那里能看到 rubric 从抽象评价变成可检查条件的具体形态。需要进一步追问的点有三个：temporal contrast 是否会把当前 policy 的偏差固化成偏好；judge 本身的系统性错误是否会被 rubric generator 放大；rubric 与 policy 共训练时，是否存在新的 reward hacking 通道。

summary_en.core_problem: EvoLM addresses reward construction for non-verifiable tasks. Current RL post-training usually depends on human labels, proprietary judges, scalar reward models, or verifiable answers. Each option has a ceiling: human supervision is limited, proprietary APIs create dependency, scalar reward models can be overoptimized, and verifiable rewards only cover tasks with ground-truth answers. The paper asks whether a model can turn its own latent evaluative knowledge into explicit rubrics, then use those rubrics as training signal for its own policy.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a closed training loop for self-generated evaluation. The paper treats evaluative knowledge acquired during pretraining as something that can be surfaced, structured, and optimized during post-training, rather than as an external reward injected into the model. This matters for pretraining research because it clarifies one interface between pretraining and RL: the model may already contain useful criteria for judging responses, but those criteria need to be made operational. EvoLM also moves the reward signal away from an opaque scalar and toward inspectable criteria. This is relevant for reward overoptimization, signal quality, and continual improvement in domains where exact verification is unavailable.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method decomposes evaluation into rubric generation and rubric-conditioned judging. A rubric is considered useful if it helps a judge assign a higher score to a preferred response than to a dispreferred one. Rubric quality is therefore directly trainable through discriminative utility, measured by the score gap induced by the rubric. The paper formulates rubrics as latent variables and derives a training objective from a variational-inference view. Training alternates between two phases. In the policy phase, a frozen rubric model generates rubrics for questions; the policy samples multiple responses; a frozen judge scores the responses under the rubric; GRPO updates the policy using these rubric-derived rewards. In the rubric phase, preference pairs are built through temporal contrast: current-policy responses are treated as preferred, earlier-checkpoint responses as dispreferred. The rubric generator samples candidate rubrics, and receives reward when the judge conditioned on that rubric separates the pair in the right direction with a larger gap. This differs from GPT-4.1-generated rubrics or labeled rubric training because it does not require an external rubric teacher. It also differs from scalar reward modeling because it learns an explicit, portable evaluation artifact rather than only a compressed preference score.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover twelve benchmarks spanning math, code, general reasoning, knowledge, instruction following, and open-ended generation. On the OLMo3-Adapt suite, EvoLM reaches a 69.3% average, compared with 66.7% for GPT-4.1-prompted rubrics. A scalar reward model that performs strongly on held-out preference benchmarks, with 86.4% on RewardBench 2 and 80.8% on JudgeBench, produces the weakest downstream policy at 59.7%, trailing EvoLM by 9.6 points. This is a useful result: offline reward-model accuracy is not sufficient to predict RL usefulness. The paper also reports broader generalization. The co-evolution procedure extends to OLMo-3-7B. Learned rubrics transfer to unseen policies and judges without retraining. On out-of-distribution deep research tasks, EvoLM has higher pairwise agreement with expert human rubrics than GPT-4.1: 58.4% versus 52.5% on HealthBench, and 59.3% versus 51.0% on ResearchQA. Qualitative analysis suggests that the trained generator learns to break holistic evaluation into checkable subcriteria, sometimes embedding expected intermediate values directly into the rubric, which allows even a 1.7B-parameter judge to score more reliably.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction, Section 2, Figure 2, Section 3.2, Section 3.3, and the qualitative analysis carefully. Figure 2 gives the operational picture: policy training and rubric training alternate, each using the other as the source of signal. Section 2 is the technical center; focus on the latent-rubric formulation, the discriminative objective, and how it becomes a GRPO-compatible reward. Section 3.2 is important for understanding why a strong scalar reward model can still be a poor RL reward. Section 3.3 should be read for transfer: if rubrics work across policies and judges, they are not merely fitting one evaluation backend. The qualitative examples are also worth close attention because they show how learned rubrics turn broad judgments into small, verifiable checks. The main open questions are whether temporal contrast can amplify the current policy’s blind spots, whether judge-specific errors can be encoded into rubrics, and whether co-evolution introduces new forms of reward hacking.

recommendation.zh: 应读方法和消融；它检验“预训练模型自带可训练评审器”这个 prior，若成立会影响自举式 posttrain 设计。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; it tests whether a pretrained model contains a trainable evaluator, which directly affects bootstrap post-training design.

paper.title: Generate, Filter, Control, Replay: A Comprehensive Survey of Rollout Strategies for LLM Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a central post-training tool for improving the reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs). In these systems, the rollout, the trajectory sampled from a prompt to termination, including intermediate reasoning steps and optional tool or environment interactions, determines the data the optimizer learns from, yet rollout design is often underreported. This survey provides an optimizer-agnostic view of rollout strategies for RL-based post-training of r

summary.core_problem: 系统化梳理推理型 LLM 强化学习中 rollout 设计这一常被忽略、却直接决定训练信号质量的环节。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是综述与框架化整理，不是新算法。价值在于把 RL 后训练里的 rollout 管线拆成可讨论的模块，对 pretrain↔posttrain 接口有间接启发，尤其是训练信号质量、计算分配和轨迹复用。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 GFCR taxonomy：Generate 负责候选轨迹与拓扑生成，Filter 负责 verifier/judge/critic 等中间信号构造，Control 负责预算下的继续、分支和停止决策，Replay 负责跨 rollout 的样本与工件复用。作者试图用统一记号描述不同 RL 推理系统中的 rollout pipeline。
summary.experiments: 这是 survey，不提供统一实验结果。其价值主要取决于分类是否足够贴近当前 RL for reasoning 实践，以及是否把 optimizer 之外真正影响效果的 rollout 变量讲清楚。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 UC San Diego、Adobe Research、Texas A&M 等机构。属于学术界对 RL rollout 设计的系统整理，不是单一实验室的技术报告。

summary_en.core_problem: It organizes the under-documented but crucial design space of rollouts in RL post-training for reasoning LLMs, where rollout construction directly shapes the learning signal.
summary_en.importance: This is a survey/framework paper rather than a new algorithm. Its value lies in modularizing the rollout pipeline and making training-signal quality, compute allocation, and trajectory reuse more explicit—topics that matter at the pretrain/post-train interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes the GFCR taxonomy: Generate for candidate trajectory/topology creation, Filter for intermediate supervision via verifiers/judges/critics, Control for branching/continuation/stopping under compute budgets, and Replay for retaining and reusing rollout artifacts. A unified notation is used to describe rollout pipelines across RL-based reasoning systems.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, it does not present a single experimental benchmark. Its practical value depends on whether the taxonomy captures the real knobs that drive performance in modern reasoning-RL systems beyond the optimizer itself.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from UC San Diego, Adobe Research, Texas A&M, and collaborators. This is an academic synthesis of RL rollout design rather than a flagship lab technical report.

recommendation.zh: 是整理不是突破；如果你在想 R1-Zero 一类工作到底改了 optimizer 还是 rollout，读 GFCR 框架就够，正文不必逐节啃。
recommendation.en: This is organization, not a breakthrough; if you want to separate optimizer effects from rollout design in R1-Zero-style work, the GFCR framing is the part worth taking.

paper.title: SciResearcher: Scaling Deep Research Agents for Frontier Scientific Reasoning
paper.abstract: Frontier scientific reasoning is rapidly emerging as a key foundation for advancing AI agents in automated scientific discovery. Deep research agents offer a promising approach to this challenge. These models develop robust problem-solving capabilities through post-training on information-seeking tasks, which are typically curated via knowledge graph construction or iterative web browsing. However, these strategies face inherent limitations in frontier science, where domain-specific knowledge is

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个当前很实际的瓶颈：深度研究型 agent 想在前沿科学问题上变强，缺的不是通用网页检索能力，而是高质量、可自动扩展、能覆盖稀疏学术证据和科学计算过程的训练数据。现有自动构造信息寻求任务的方法，大多依赖 Wikipedia 式实体图谱或连续网页浏览，适合事实检索，不适合前沿科学里那种知识分散、概念异构、还需要公式和参数计算的长链条推理。SciResearcher 的核心目标，就是搭一个全自动数据构造框架，把“前沿科学推理”拆成可规模化生成的训练样本，并验证这些样本能否真正提升 deep research agent 的能力。
summary.importance: 从 pretrain/post-train 接口看，这篇工作的价值不在模型结构，而在训练信号设计。它给出了一条比较清楚的路径：当目标能力不是一般问答，而是长时程、工具密集、证据稀疏、带计算环节的科学推理时，数据构造方式本身就是主要瓶颈。贡献有三层。第一，提出了面向 frontier science 的自动数据生成框架，而不是把通用信息检索 recipe 直接搬过来。第二，数据不只覆盖概念性问答，还显式覆盖 computational reasoning，这一点对 agent 能力形态影响很大，因为它迫使模型学会把检索、建模、参数抽取和求解串起来。第三，作者把数据构造、SFT、RL、行为分析连成闭环，展示了 post-training 如何改变 agent 的轨迹长度、工具调用频率和难度自适应策略。对基座研究员来说，这篇工作更像一个高质量案例：当训练目标从“答对”转向“会找、会算、会分配推理预算”时，数据生成器本身就成了能力上限的一部分。
summary.technical_approach: 技术方案分为数据构造和 agent 训练两部分。数据构造侧，作者先建立一个 curated 的 frontier scientific entities 池，作为问题生成的起点。随后分成两条流水线。第一条是 conceptual pipeline：让 web agent 从种子科学实体出发浏览学术来源，收集证据，生成有依据的问题；然后引入 iterative anchor-based task augmentation，把一个问题围绕关键锚点实体不断增广，提升复杂度和多证据依赖。这里“anchor”不是普通实体标签，而是问题里决定性、可作为推理抓手的科学对象。第二条是 computational pipeline：针对与种子实体相关的科学模型，做三级证据筛选，抽取可形成计算题的 governing equations、机制解释和所需参数，再生成问题，并通过 voting-based solver verification 得到参考答案。这个设计的关键不是简单让模型做数值题，而是把“找到模型—确认方程—补齐参数—执行求解”作为训练监督的一部分。基于这两条流水线，作者构建了 SciResearcherQA。训练侧，作者采用较标准但执行完整的 deep research post-training recipe：先在 Qwen3-8B 基座上做带 rejection sampling 的 SFT，再用 GRPO 做强化学习，得到 SciResearcher-8B。值得注意的是，这里 RL 的作用不只是提高最终正确率，还在于塑造更长、更工具化、且会按任务难度调整预算的轨迹策略。与已有工作相比，区别主要有三点：一是数据源从实体中心网页转向异构学术证据；二是任务目标从事实检索扩展到科学计算；三是复杂度提升不是靠人工模板堆叠，而是通过 anchor augmentation 和 solver verification 形成较稳定的自动闭环。
summary.experiments: 实验结果有几个值得记住的数字。基于 Qwen3-8B 训练得到的 SciResearcher-8B，在 HLE-Bio/Chem-Gold 上达到 19.46% pass@1 和 31.54% pass@3，超过了以 GPT-4.1 为骨干的 SciMaster，并接近 OpenAI Deep Research 这类前沿专有系统的水平。除此之外，在 SuperGPQA-Hard-Biology 和 TRQA-Literature 上分别带来 13.04% 和 14.54% 的绝对提升。作者还分析了行为轨迹：相较 baseline，post-training 后 agent 的轨迹长度增加到原来的 0.3–2.7 倍区间，同时工具调用频率更高。更有意思的是 RL 相对 SFT 呈现出难度自适应效应：在更难的 HLE-Bio/Chem-Gold 上，agent 学会分配更多步骤和更多工具调用；而在相对容易的 benchmark 上，步骤数略减但性能仍提升，说明 RL 学到的不是单纯“更长链条”，而是更合适的预算控制。摘要里没有展开全部消融细节，但从正文主线看，作者至少验证了三件事：自动构造数据能带来跨 benchmark 泛化；概念题和计算题的混合监督能提升 frontier science reasoning；SFT+RL 不只是提分，还改变了 agent 的搜索与求解行为模式。
summary.reading_guide: 精读时建议按“问题定义—数据流水线—训练闭环—行为分析”四步看。先读引言和 Figure 2，理解作者为什么认为现有 KG-based 和 browsing-based task construction 不适合 frontier science。然后重点看两条数据流水线：conceptual pipeline 里 anchor-based augmentation 的定义、例子和过滤机制；computational pipeline 里三级证据筛选、方程/参数抽取和 solver verification，这部分决定了数据质量上限。接着看 SciResearcherQA 的统计和样例，判断任务是否真的覆盖多证据与计算。训练部分重点看 SFT 与 GRPO 的配方、采样和奖励设置，尤其是 rejection sampling 与 RL 各自承担什么角色。最后看行为分析图表：轨迹长度、工具调用次数、不同 benchmark 上的预算分配变化，这些结果比单纯分数更能说明 agent 学到了什么。若时间有限，优先读引言、方法总览图、数据构造章节、主结果表，以及 RL 后行为变化的分析图。值得深挖的点有两个：一是自动生成的科学计算题如何控制伪解和答案泄漏；二是这种 post-training 数据是否能反哺更一般的预训练目标，比如把检索、建模、求解统一成更原生的训练范式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a practical bottleneck in deep research agents for frontier science: the limiting factor is not generic web search, but scalable training data that captures sparse academic evidence, heterogeneous scientific concepts, and nontrivial scientific computation. Existing automated information-seeking pipelines are mostly built around Wikipedia-like entity graphs or iterative browsing over densely linked webpages. Those recipes work for factual retrieval, but they break down in frontier science, where knowledge is fragmented across papers and solving a problem often requires equations, parameters, and multi-step computation. SciResearcher is designed to automate the construction of such training data and test whether it can materially improve scientific deep-research agents.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is not a new model architecture but a stronger training signal for agent post-training. The paper shows that when the target capability is long-horizon, tool-using, evidence-sparse scientific reasoning, data construction becomes the central bottleneck. There are three concrete contributions. First, it proposes an automated task-construction framework tailored to frontier science rather than reusing general-domain information-seeking recipes. Second, it explicitly includes computational scientific reasoning, not just conceptual QA, forcing the agent to chain retrieval, model identification, parameter extraction, and solving. Third, it closes the loop from data construction to SFT to RL to trajectory analysis, showing how post-training changes not only benchmark accuracy but also search depth, tool-use frequency, and adaptive budget allocation. For researchers interested in the pretrain/post-train interface, this is a useful case study in how the structure of generated supervision shapes the resulting reasoning policy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two main parts: automated data construction and agent post-training. On the data side, the authors start from a curated pool of frontier scientific entities. They then build two pipelines. The first is a conceptual pipeline: a web agent browses academic sources starting from seed entities, gathers evidence, and generates grounded questions. Complexity is then increased through iterative anchor-based task augmentation, where an anchor is the decisive scientific entity that serves as the central handle for the question. The second is a computational pipeline: the system performs a three-level evidence selection process to identify scientific models associated with seed entities, including governing equations, mechanistic understanding, and required input parameters. It then generates computational questions and obtains reference answers through voting-based solver verification. The key idea is not merely to add arithmetic, but to supervise the full chain of finding the right model, extracting the right quantities, and executing the computation. These pipelines produce SciResearcherQA. On the training side, the authors follow a fairly standard but carefully executed deep-research post-training recipe on top of Qwen3-8B: supervised fine-tuning with rejection sampling, followed by reinforcement learning with GRPO, yielding SciResearcher-8B. A notable point is that RL is used not only to improve final accuracy but also to shape longer, more tool-intensive, and difficulty-adaptive trajectories. Compared with prior work, the main differences are the shift from entity-centric web knowledge to heterogeneous academic evidence, the inclusion of computational reasoning as a first-class target, and a more stable automatic loop built from anchor augmentation and solver verification rather than shallow template expansion.
summary_en.experiments: Several numbers stand out. SciResearcher-8B, trained from Qwen3-8B, reaches 19.46% pass@1 and 31.54% pass@3 on HLE-Bio/Chem-Gold. It outperforms SciMaster built on GPT-4.1 and approaches the level of frontier proprietary deep-research systems such as OpenAI Deep Research. It also improves absolute performance by 13.04% on SuperGPQA-Hard-Biology and 14.54% on TRQA-Literature. The behavioral analysis is equally important: compared with the baseline, post-training produces trajectories that are 0.3x to 2.7x longer and uses tools more frequently. More interestingly, RL induces adaptive behavior relative to the SFT checkpoint. On the harder HLE-Bio/Chem-Gold benchmark, the agent learns to allocate more steps and more tool calls; on easier benchmarks, it uses slightly fewer steps while still improving performance. That suggests RL is not simply encouraging longer chains, but learning a better policy for reasoning-budget allocation. While the provided text does not list every ablation in detail, the main empirical message is clear: automatically constructed scientific data transfers across multiple benchmarks, mixing conceptual and computational supervision improves frontier-science reasoning, and SFT plus RL changes the agent’s search and solving behavior, not just its final score.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it in four passes: problem definition, data pipelines, training loop, and behavior analysis. Start with the introduction and the motivating figure to understand why knowledge-graph-based and browsing-based task construction are insufficient for frontier science. Then study the two pipelines carefully. In the conceptual pipeline, focus on how anchor-based augmentation is defined, instantiated, and filtered. In the computational pipeline, pay close attention to the three-level evidence selection process, equation and parameter extraction, and solver verification, because these determine the quality ceiling of the generated data. Next, inspect the SciResearcherQA statistics and examples to judge whether the dataset really captures multi-evidence and computational reasoning. In the training section, focus on the roles of rejection sampling in SFT and GRPO in RL, especially what each stage contributes. Finally, read the trajectory analysis figures on step count, tool-use frequency, and benchmark-dependent budget allocation; these are more informative than the headline scores alone. If time is limited, prioritize the introduction, the method overview figure, the data-construction sections, the main results table, and the RL behavior analysis. Two deeper questions are worth following up: how robust the computational pipeline is against spurious solutions or answer leakage, and whether this style of post-training data could feed back into more native pretraining objectives that unify retrieval, modeling, and solving.

recommendation.zh: 重点看数据生成 pipeline 和任务分布设计；若实验干净，应复用到内部 long-horizon tool-use 后训练消融。
recommendation.en: Read the data pipeline and task-distribution design; if the evaluation is clean, reproduce the recipe in internal long-horizon tool-use ablations.

paper.title: Model Organisms Are Leaky: Perplexity Differencing Often Reveals Finetuning Objectives
paper.abstract: Finetuning can significantly modify the behavior of large language models, including introducing harmful or unsafe behaviors. To study these risks, researchers develop model organisms: models finetuned to exhibit specific known behaviors for controlled experimentation. Identifying these behaviors remains challenging. We show that a simple perplexity-based method can surface finetuning objectives from model organisms by leveraging their tendency to overgeneralize their finetuned behaviors beyond

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究一个安全评估问题：经过特定目标微调的 model organism，是否会在无关上下文中泄露微调目标，以及能否用只依赖输出概率的简单方法发现这种泄露。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 接口有实际启发。论文显示，微调不只是改变目标场景下的行为，也会改变模型在更广泛文本分布上的似然面。这个变化可以通过 finetuned model 与 reference model 的 perplexity gap 读出来。对研究员来说，它提供了一个低成本审计工具，也提醒合成数据微调、偏好优化、后门训练和安全模型构造都可能留下分布级痕迹。它还把训练数据记忆提取中的 perplexity differencing 思路，迁移到了“识别微调目标”这个问题上。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很直接，分两步。第一步是生成候选泄露文本：从通用语料中抽取短 prefill，把它们接到 prompt 前，让 finetuned model 在 temperature 0 下生成大量 completion。短 prefill 的作用是打散上下文，使模型有机会在不同随机入口下表现出过泛化的微调行为。第二步是排序：分别用 finetuned model 和 reference model 计算这些 completion 的困惑度，然后按困惑度差异排序。典型信号是 finetuned model 困惑度低，而 reference model 困惑度高，说明这段文本对微调模型很自然，但对原模型或跨家族参考模型很不自然。作者也讨论了 inverse perplexity difference 等变体。这个方法不需要访问模型内部激活，也不需要预先知道行为类型，因此适合作为黑盒或近黑盒审计的前置筛查。局限也清楚：如果微调行为被强上下文门控，随机 prefill 很难触发；如果行为对 reference model 并不意外，perplexity gap 不会明显；如果泄露文本太少，审计者未必能可靠推断目标。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖多类公开或自建 model organism，包括后门模型、sleeper agent、通过 synthetic document finetuning 学到虚假事实的模型、用 synthetic documents 或 transcripts 训练出的隐藏行为模型、再经过 SFT 或 KTO 的对抗训练模型、evaluation awareness 模型、reward model sycophancy 模型，以及 narrow misaligned finetuning 后出现 broad misalignment 的模型。作者使用少量配置即可运行审计，例如 3 个 prefill 数据源，以及是否加入 chat template。结果显示，大多数模型的微调目标会出现在 top-10 或 top-100 排名 completion 中。方法对 synthetic document finetuning 和要求输出固定短语的模型效果更强，因为记忆或近记忆会形成清晰的困惑度信号。对 emergent misalignment 的实验更有意思：训练数据中没有一般性 misalignment 示例，但排序靠前的 completion 仍能暴露训练副作用中的新行为。这说明 perplexity differencing 不只是在找逐字记忆，也能捕捉微调后形成的行为偏置。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看方法部分的 generation/identification 两阶段流程、perplexity gap 的具体定义、reference model 选择，以及失败案例。实验部分重点看不同 model organism 类型的 top-k 命中情况，尤其是 synthetic document finetuning、固定短语目标、context-gated 行为和 emergent misalignment 的对比。若关心训练数据泄露或 post-train 审计，可以多看附录中的 prompt/prefill 配置和排序样例；这些细节决定方法在实际模型上的可复现性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether finetuned model organisms leak their training objectives outside the intended context, and whether such leakage can be surfaced using only output likelihoods.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is at the pretrain–post-train boundary. Finetuning changes more than prompted behavior; it also reshapes the model’s likelihood landscape over a broader text distribution. The paper shows that this change can often be detected by comparing perplexities between a finetuned model and a reference model. For model builders, this is a cheap auditing signal for synthetic-document finetuning, backdoor training, preference optimization side effects, and safety model organisms. It also adapts a technique from training-data extraction—perplexity differencing—to the problem of identifying finetuning objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two stages. First, generate many candidate completions from the finetuned model. To induce diversity, the authors prepend short random prefills drawn from common public corpora, then decode with temperature zero. These prefills act as varied entry points that can trigger overgeneralized finetuned behavior outside its intended setting. Second, score each completion under both the finetuned model and a reference model, which can be the pre-finetuning checkpoint or a cross-family model. Completions are ranked by perplexity-based gaps, typically favoring text that is low perplexity for the finetuned model and high perplexity for the reference model. Such text is likely to reflect newly learned behavior, memorized training strings, or emergent side effects of finetuning. The method does not require internal activations or prior knowledge of the target behavior. Its limitations are also clear: strongly context-gated behaviors may not be triggered by random prefills; behaviors that are unsurprising to the reference model may not produce a strong gap; and sparse leakage may be insufficient for confident attribution.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans a broad set of public and newly finetuned model organisms: backdoored models, sleeper agents, models trained to learn false facts through synthetic document finetuning, hidden-behavior models trained on synthetic documents or transcripts and then refined with SFT or KTO, evaluation-awareness models, reward-model sycophancy models, and models showing broad misalignment after narrow misaligned finetuning. With only a small number of configurations, such as three prefill datasets and toggling chat templates, the method surfaces objective-revealing completions for most models within the top 10 or top 100 ranked samples. It works especially well for synthetic document finetuning and exact-phrase objectives, where memorization gives a strong likelihood signal. The emergent misalignment cases are the most interesting: even when the finetuning data lacks general misalignment examples, high-ranked completions can reveal new behavioral side effects. This suggests the method is not limited to verbatim memorization.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the two-stage generation and identification procedure, the exact perplexity-gap scores, the choice of reference model, and the failure modes. In the experiments, compare results across synthetic document finetuning, exact-phrase objectives, context-gated behaviors, and emergent misalignment. If the goal is practical auditing, inspect the appendix examples of prefills, chat-template variants, and ranked completions, because these implementation details will determine how well the method transfers to new models.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和失败案例；这个结果会改变对安全 model organism 隔离性的默认信任，但需看是否依赖 reference 选择。
recommendation.en: Read the method and failures; it weakens the default trust in model-organism isolation, but check how sensitive it is to the reference model.

paper.title: MAD-OPD: Breaking the Ceiling in On-Policy Distillation via Multi-Agent Debate
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories under token-level teacher supervision, but existing methods are capped by a single-teacher capability ceiling: when the teacher errs, the student inherits the error. OPD also remains largely unexplored in agentic tasks, where per-step errors compound across long trajectories and destabilize training. We propose MAD-OPD (Multi-Agent Debate-driven On-Policy Distillation), which breaks this ceiling by recasting the distillation t

summary.core_problem: 在 on-policy distillation（OPD）里，学生模型沿着自己的采样轨迹学习，但监督信号来自教师分布；当教师在学生访问到的“困难状态”上出错或过度自信时，学生会被锁死在单教师能力上限，并在多步 agentic 任务中因误差累积而训练不稳定。论文要解决的是：如何在 OPD 框架内获得比单教师更可靠的逐 token 监督，并给出与任务结构匹配的 divergence 选择原则，从而把 OPD 扩展到长轨迹的 agentic 场景。
summary.importance: 对 post-train 侧的蒸馏范式有直接增量：把“多模型协作（debate/consensus）”从离线数据蒸馏带进 on-policy 训练环，目标是突破单教师 ceiling，并把 OPD 更系统地推到工具使用/环境交互的长轨迹任务。更有价值的部分是把 divergence 选择显式解释为“逐 token reward 设计”，并给出针对 agentic 稳定性与代码生成一致性的不同选择（JSD vs reverse KL）的动机与验证路径；这类分析对后续做 OPD/RLHF 混合目标、或做更稳定的 dense 信号训练有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach:
1) MAD-OPD：在每个决策点（state s_t=(x, ŷ_<t)）不再用单一教师分布 p，而是让多个教师围绕学生当前 on-policy 状态进行多轮 debate，产出 debate transcript 作为 privileged context c；每个教师在 debate 后给出 token-level 分布与置信度，训练时对教师贡献做置信度加权，形成“debate-conditioned teacher distribution”来监督学生 q。关键点不是简单 ensemble，而是让教师对学生的具体 rollout 做“在线反应”，把多代理讨论带来的纠错/补全能力注入到逐 token 监督里。
2) OPAD（On-Policy Agentic Distillation）：面向 agentic 任务引入 step-level 的环境交互与采样机制，强调在多步轨迹中进行 on-policy 采样与监督，以缓解 per-step error compounding 导致的分布偏移与训练崩溃。它作为训练管线层面的改造，使得 MAD-OPD 和单教师 OPD 都能在 agentic setting 下跑起来。
3) divergence 作为 reward 设计：论文沿用“OPD 等价于 dense token-level RL surrogate”的视角，把 r_D(s_t)=-D(p||q) 视为由 divergence 决定的奖励。基于 privileged distillation 的结构性不对称（教师条件在 c 上、学生不条件在 c 上），讨论两类典型失配：a) 教师对学生采样 token 给近零概率（p(v)→0, q(v)>0），在 agentic 多步中更常见；b) 教师在多个可行 token 上分散质量、学生需要做一致选择，在代码生成更常见。由此提出任务自适应原则：agentic 训练用有界的 JSD 来抑制极端梯度/奖励尖峰、提升稳定性；代码生成用 reverse KL 更偏向 mode-seeking，鼓励输出在局部更一致、更“收敛”到单一路径。论文声称同时给出理论与实证支撑。
summary.experiments: 给定的全文片段未包含实验设置与具体数值表格（模型规模、教师数量、debate 轮数、agentic 环境、代码基准、提升幅度、稳定性指标等），因此无法基于全文内容复述关键数字与消融。就方法描述而言，合理的关键消融应包括：单教师 OPD vs 多教师无 debate ensemble vs MAD-OPD；置信度加权 vs 均匀加权；OPAD 的 step-level 采样/交互开关；JSD vs KL vs reverse KL 在 agentic 与 code 两类任务上的稳定性（loss spike、成功率方差、轨迹长度分布）与质量权衡。若论文正文确有这些结果，应以“是否真正突破 strongest teacher、以及是否显著降低训练崩溃/回退频率”作为主要判据。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里三点限制 L1–L3，确认作者把 OPD 的痛点定义在“单教师 ceiling + agentic 误差累积 + divergence 选择缺乏原则”。
- 精看 Preliminaries and Divergence Analysis：这里把 divergence 选择写成 reward 设计，并区分 agentic vs code 的两类失配模式；这是论文最可迁移的部分。
- 再看 MAD-OPD 的训练环：重点是 debate transcript 如何进入 teacher 分布、置信度如何定义与加权、以及计算开销如何控制（每步多教师多轮 debate 的成本通常是主要工程瓶颈）。
- 最后快速扫实验与消融（若正文完整）：优先找“超过最强单教师”的证据、以及稳定性指标（方差/失败率/loss spike）而不只是均值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own rollouts with token-level supervision from a teacher distribution. In practice it hits a single-teacher ceiling (teacher mistakes get copied) and becomes fragile in long-horizon agentic tasks where step-wise errors compound. The paper targets: (i) how to produce stronger, more reliable token supervision than any single teacher while staying on-policy, and (ii) how to choose the OPD divergence in a task-structured way rather than as a generic hyperparameter.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a post-training/distillation contribution, but it matters to pretrain researchers insofar as OPD is increasingly used as a dense-signal alternative to outcome-reward RL and as a bridge between pretrain and alignment. The most reusable idea is framing divergence choice as per-token reward design, then arguing for different divergences for different regimes (bounded JSD for agentic stability; reverse KL for coherent code generation). The multi-agent debate-in-the-loop design is also a concrete attempt to break the “teacher upper bound” that often limits strong-to-weak distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) MAD-OPD: replace a single teacher with a deliberative committee. At each student-visited state s_t=(x, ŷ_<t), multiple teacher models run a debate conditioned on the student’s current on-policy context. The debate transcript becomes privileged context c for the teachers, yielding debate-conditioned token distributions. Teachers’ contributions are aggregated with post-debate confidence weights, producing the supervision signal for the student.
2) OPAD: an agentic OPD pipeline that explicitly incorporates step-level environment interaction/sampling to make OPD workable in multi-step tool-use settings, where distribution shift and compounding errors otherwise destabilize training.
3) Divergence principle: using the known equivalence between OPD and a dense token-level RL surrogate, the paper treats r_D(s_t) = -D(p||q) as a reward shaped entirely by the divergence. With privileged distillation asymmetry (teacher conditions on c, student does not), it highlights two mismatch patterns: near-zero teacher mass on student-sampled tokens (common in agentic rollouts) vs multi-modal valid tokens where the student must commit consistently (common in code). It then motivates bounded JSD for stability in the former and reverse KL (mode-seeking) for coherence in the latter, claiming theoretical and empirical validation.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt does not include the experimental section or any concrete numbers (model sizes, number of teachers, debate rounds, agentic environments, code benchmarks, gains, stability metrics). As a result, specific quantitative findings cannot be faithfully reported here. The critical checks to look for in the paper are: (i) whether MAD-OPD surpasses the strongest single teacher (not just improves over a weaker baseline), (ii) stability improvements in long-horizon settings (variance, failure rate, loss spikes), and (iii) clean ablations separating debate vs simple ensembling, and divergence choices per task type.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the Introduction for the three stated limitations (single-teacher ceiling, lack of agentic coverage, ad-hoc divergence choice).
- Focus on the divergence analysis section: the reward-design interpretation and the agentic-vs-code mismatch taxonomy are the most transferable.
- Then inspect the MAD-OPD loop details: how debate transcripts condition teacher distributions, how confidence is defined, and how compute is controlled.
- Finally, scan experiments/ablations for evidence of exceeding the best teacher and for stability metrics beyond mean performance.

recommendation.zh: 值得看方法和消融；若 debate 教师真能越过单教师 ceiling，可直接影响后训练蒸馏数据生成策略。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; if debate teachers truly beat the single-teacher ceiling, it changes distillation data generation.

paper.title: T$^2$PO: Uncertainty-Guided Exploration Control for Stable Multi-Turn Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Recent progress in multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) has significantly improved reasoning LLMs' performances on complex interactive tasks. Despite advances in stabilization techniques such as fine-grained credit assignment and trajectory filtering, instability remains pervasive and often leads to training collapse. We argue that this instability stems from inefficient exploration in multi-turn settings, where policies continue to generate low-information actions that neither reduce uncertai

summary.core_problem: 解决多轮 Agent 强化学习中的训练不稳定问题，特别是长轨迹、稀疏奖励和无效探索共同导致的性能退化或优化崩溃。
summary.importance: 对预训练与后训练接口有一定启发。它不直接改基座预训练目标，但关注 RL 训练信号质量和 rollout 有效性，这会影响大模型从交互数据中学习的稳定性。核心观察是：多轮 Agent 训练中的问题不只是 credit assignment 稀疏，也包括大量低信息量 token 和低进展 turn 进入梯度更新，放大方差。这个角度对 RL pretrain、环境交互式 posttrain、长链工具调用训练都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: T2PO 的思路是用不确定性变化来控制探索粒度，而不是只在轨迹级过滤失败样本，或通过奖励塑形间接约束行为。方法包含两个层面。token 层面，融合 entropy 和 confidence 构造自校准不确定性信号，监控生成过程中不确定性是否继续下降。如果边际变化低于阈值，说明模型还在生成思考 token，但信息增益已经变小，于是触发 thinking intervention，减少过长、低收益的思考。turn 层面，识别连续交互中不确定性模式相近且探索进展很小的回合，对这些 turn 动态重采样，避免 rollout 预算被重复动作消耗。配套训练还包括 RFT 冷启动、memory context window 减轻长轨迹训练压力、格式惩罚保证 think/action 结构合规，以及常规策略优化方法。与只做轨迹过滤的方法相比，它更早介入；与 reward shaping 相比，它不需要额外定义复杂过程奖励。
summary.experiments: 提供内容只包含 Introduction 和 Preliminaries，未给出完整 benchmark、模型规模、训练步数、性能表和消融数值。可确认的实验主张是：作者在多轮 Agent benchmark 上比较 T2PO 与常规多轮 RL 稳定化方案，并通过消融验证 token-level intervention、turn-level resampling、不确定性信号、RFT 冷启动、memory context 和格式惩罚的作用。由于缺少结果章节，不能可靠报告提升幅度、训练崩溃率下降比例或样本效率数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 分钟；若关注 Agent RL 稳定性，可继续精看方法和消融。重点看三处：不确定性信号如何由 entropy 与 confidence 融合，token-level hesitation 的判定和 intervention 触发条件，turn-level resampling 如何避免引入明显 off-policy 偏差。结果部分若可获得，应优先看训练曲线而不是只看最终分数，因为该工作的主要论点是稳定性和探索效率。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses instability in multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning, where long horizons, sparse rewards, and inefficient exploration can lead to degraded performance or training collapse.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to pretraining research is indirect but useful. It studies the quality of RL training signals and rollout efficiency, which are central when large models learn from interactive environments. The key observation is that multi-turn agent training suffers not only from sparse credit assignment, but also from low-information tokens and unproductive turns entering policy updates. This increases gradient variance and makes optimization sensitive to rollout distribution. The idea is relevant to RL-based continual training, tool-use training, and environment-interactive post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: T2PO controls exploration through uncertainty dynamics at two granularities. At the token level, it builds a self-calibrated uncertainty signal by combining entropy and confidence. During generation, if marginal uncertainty reduction becomes too small, continued thinking is treated as low-gain exploration, and a thinking intervention is triggered. At the turn level, the method detects repeated turns with negligible exploration progress and dynamically resamples them, so rollout budget is not spent on repetitive actions. The training recipe also uses rejection-based fine-tuning for cold start, a memory context window to reduce long-trajectory pressure, a format penalty for structured think/action outputs, and standard policy optimization. The distinction from trajectory filtering is timing and granularity: T2PO intervenes before an entire rollout is wasted. The distinction from reward shaping is that it uses intrinsic uncertainty signals rather than adding a separate process reward.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content includes the introduction and preliminaries but not the full experimental section. The available text claims evaluation on challenging multi-turn agentic benchmarks and ablations for the main components, including token-level intervention, turn-level resampling, uncertainty monitoring, cold-start RFT, memory context, and format constraints. Exact model sizes, benchmark names, training budgets, final scores, collapse rates, and sample-efficiency gains are not available in the supplied material, so numerical improvements should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 minutes, or read the method and ablation sections more carefully if multi-turn RL stability is a current concern. Focus on how entropy and confidence are fused, how token-level hesitation is detected, and how turn-level resampling is implemented without introducing excessive policy staleness. If full results are available, inspect training curves and collapse cases before final benchmark scores, because the central claim is about stability and exploration efficiency.

recommendation.zh: 读 token/turn 不确定性定义即可；若指标不靠 judge 泄漏，它是多轮 RL 稳定性的一条可复现实验线。
recommendation.en: Read the token/turn uncertainty definitions; if the metric avoids judge leakage, this is a reproducible line for stabilizing multi-turn RL.

paper.title: Distilling Long-CoT Reasoning through Collaborative Step-wise Multi-Teacher Decoding
paper.abstract: Distilling large reasoning models is essential for making Long-CoT reasoning practical, as full-scale inference remains computationally prohibitive. Existing curation-based approaches select complete reasoning traces post-hoc, overlooking collaboration among heterogeneous teachers and lacking dynamic exploration, which leads to redundant sampling and missed complementary reasoning. We introduce CoRD, a collaborative multi-teacher decoding framework that performs step-wise reasoning synthesis gui

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决 Long-CoT reasoning distillation 中的轨迹选择问题：多个强教师能生成很长的推理过程，但事后挑一条完整轨迹会浪费大量采样，也难以把不同教师的互补推理步骤组合起来。
summary.importance: 对 post-train 数据合成和 reasoning distillation 有启发。它把“先生成完整 CoT，再筛选”的流程改成“逐步构造推理轨迹”。这更接近解码过程，也更适合长链推理数据的生产。对预训练研究的间接价值在于，它提供了一种构造高质量 reasoning traces 的思路：评价信号不一定只在最终答案或完整轨迹上使用，也可以在步骤级别介入，但要保留足够的搜索宽度，避免过早剪掉后续可能自我修正的路径。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 CoRD，即 Collaborative Reasoning Decoding。它把每个 reasoning step 看作一个高层“token”，把多个 teacher LRM 在当前前缀下提出的下一步看作候选“词表”。每一步中，不同教师基于同一个推理前缀生成候选步骤，系统再选择更有前景的扩展路径。关键机制有三点。第一，用 prompt-guided step segmentation 将长 CoT 切成相对一致的推理步骤，避免不同教师输出粒度不一致。第二，用 predictive perplexity 评估部分推理轨迹：给定当前 reasoning prefix，计算 ground-truth answer 被预测得是否自然。这个信号比最终答案筛选更早，但仍与正确解相关。第三，引入 beam search 同时保留多条候选轨迹，减少局部评分过强导致的早期剪枝。它和 S1、LIMO 这类 curation-based 方法的区别在于，后者通常先让教师各自生成完整轨迹，再做事后选择；CoRD 在生成过程中让多个教师逐步协作。它和 MCTS/PRM 路线的区别在于，不依赖大量 rollout 或细粒度过程奖励，计算形式更接近受控解码。
summary.experiments: 实验在 5 个 close-ended 或 open-ended reasoning benchmark 上进行，对比了多教师 distillation baseline，包括 Curation 和 Integration，也对比了 S1、LIMO-v1/v2 等方法。作者报告 CoRD 生成的数据质量更高，蒸馏后的 student model 能接近甚至超过 teacher model。消融部分强调三个组件都有效：prompt-guided step segmentation 优于替代分段方式，predictive perplexity scoring 能更好选择局部步骤，beam search 能保留带有策略转向和自我修正的长程路径。提供内容中没有给出具体参数量、训练数据规模和逐项分数，精读时需要核对实验表格中的模型规模、teacher 组合、beam size、每题采样预算和数据量。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 到 40 分钟。先看方法部分的 formalization，确认作者如何把完整轨迹选择改写为 step-wise collaborative decoding。然后重点看三个实现细节：step segmentation、predictive perplexity、beam search。实验部分优先读主结果表和消融表，尤其关注 CoRD 相比 Curation/Integration 的收益是否来自多教师组合，还是主要来自额外搜索预算。若用于构建 reasoning SFT 数据，需要额外检查成本：每步调用多少教师、是否需要 ground-truth answer、beam search 的宽度如何影响吞吐。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses trajectory construction for long-chain-of-thought reasoning distillation. Existing approaches usually generate full reasoning traces from one or more teachers and select among them after the fact. This wastes sampling compute and cannot compose complementary reasoning steps from heterogeneous teachers.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to reasoning-data generation and post-training pipelines. Its main contribution is to move from full-trajectory curation to incremental trajectory construction. This matters because long-CoT traces often contain detours, self-corrections, and strategy shifts; a purely post-hoc selector cannot adapt exploration during generation. For pretraining-oriented work, the useful idea is that supervision for reasoning traces can be injected at the step level, as long as the search keeps enough diversity to avoid pruning paths that only pay off later.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoRD, or Collaborative Reasoning Decoding, treats each reasoning step as a high-level decoding unit. At each step, multiple teacher LRMs propose candidate next steps conditioned on the same current prefix. The system scores the resulting partial trajectories and extends promising ones. The method has three central components. First, prompt-guided step segmentation makes reasoning steps more consistent across teachers. Second, predictive perplexity scores a partial reasoning prefix by measuring how well the ground-truth answer is predicted given that prefix; this provides an early signal without waiting for a complete trace. Third, beam search maintains multiple candidate trajectories, which helps preserve paths that initially look weaker but later lead to useful self-correction or strategic shifts. Compared with S1- or LIMO-style curation, CoRD collaborates during generation rather than selecting after generation. Compared with PRM or MCTS-style methods, it avoids heavy rollout-based search and uses a decoding-like procedure.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers five closed-ended or open-ended reasoning benchmarks. The baselines include multi-teacher Curation and Integration, as well as S1 and LIMO-v1/v2. The authors report that CoRD produces higher-quality reasoning data and that students distilled from these traces can approach or sometimes surpass their teachers. The ablations indicate that prompt-guided segmentation, predictive perplexity scoring, and beam search each contribute to performance. The provided content does not include exact parameter counts, data sizes, benchmark scores, or compute budgets, so those details should be checked in the experimental tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: A good skim takes about 30–40 minutes. Read the formalization first, especially the shift from selecting complete trajectories to step-wise collaborative decoding. Then focus on the three mechanisms: segmentation, predictive perplexity, and beam search. In the experiments, prioritize the main results and ablations. The key question is whether the gains over Curation and Integration come from genuine multi-teacher composition or mainly from additional search. For practical reasoning-SFT data generation, also check the cost model: number of teacher calls per step, dependence on ground-truth answers, beam width, and throughput.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和消融就够；若 step-wise teacher mixing 真能降冗余，应在内部推理蒸馏管线复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; if step-wise teacher mixing really reduces redundancy, it is worth reproducing in reasoning-distillation pipelines.

paper.title: Iterative Finetuning is Mostly Idempotent
paper.abstract: If a model has some behavioral tendency, such as sycophancy or misalignment, and it is trained on its own outputs, will the tendency be amplified in the next generation of models? We study this question by training a series of models where each model is finetuned on data generated by its predecessor, and the initial model is seeded with some persona or belief. We test three settings: supervised finetuning (SFT) on instruct models, synthetic document finetuning (SDF) on base models, and direct pr

summary.core_problem: 互联网上LLM生成内容占比持续提升，未来预训练数据将包含大量前代模型输出，需要明确在模型自身输出上迭代微调是否会放大已有行为倾向（如谄媚、错位）。
summary.importance: 明确了不同微调范式下迭代自训练的特质演化规律，为预训练数据过滤、对齐阶段的风险防控提供了实证依据，也为持续学习的安全边界提供了参考。
summary.technical_approach: 构造7类不同特质（包括错位、厌世、谄媚等）的种子数据集，分别在有监督微调（SFT）、合成文档微调（SDF）、直接偏好优化（DPO）三种范式下开展多轮迭代自训练实验，每轮用当前模型生成的合成数据训练下一代模型，用LLM-as-judge评估特质强度与输出连贯性的变化。
summary.experiments: SFT与SDF场景下特质放大非常罕见，对超参数高度敏感，仅在极少量配置下出现，且放大伴随输出连贯性的显著下降；DPO场景下持续训练（不重新初始化模型）可稳定出现特质放大，若每轮重新初始化模型则特质保持或衰减；特质放大的阈值定义为连续4轮后特质得分较种子模型上升≥15分（满分100）。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看实验设计与三类微调范式的结果对比部分，不需要深究单组实验的超参数细节，预计阅读时间12分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The proportion of LLM-generated content on the internet keeps rising, so future pretraining corpora will include large volumes of outputs from predecessor models. It is necessary to clarify whether iterative fine-tuning on a model's own outputs will amplify existing behavioral tendencies such as sycophancy and misalignment.
summary_en.importance: It specifies the trait evolution rules of iterative self-training under different fine-tuning paradigms, provides empirical evidence for pretraining data filtering and risk control during alignment, and offers reference for the safety boundary of continual learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Seed datasets for 7 different traits (including misalignment, misanthropy, sycophancy, etc.) are constructed, and multi-round iterative self-training experiments are conducted under three paradigms: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Synthetic Document Fine-Tuning (SDF) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). For each round, synthetic data generated by the current model is used to train the next-generation model. LLM-as-judge is used to evaluate changes in trait strength and output coherence.
summary_en.experiments: Trait amplification is extremely rare in SFT and SDF scenarios, highly sensitive to hyperparameters, only occurs under very few configurations, and is accompanied by a significant drop in output coherence. In DPO scenarios, trait amplification occurs stably under continual training (without model reinitialization), while traits persist or decay if the model is reinitialized each round. Trait amplification is defined as a trait score increase of ≥15 points (out of 100) compared to the seed model after 4 consecutive cycles.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the experiment design section and result comparison across three fine-tuning paradigms. No need to dive into hyperparameter details of individual experiments. Expected reading time: 12 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验矩阵和 DPO 重置对照；它修正了“自举微调必然放大偏见”这个常见先验，但规模需打折。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental grid and the DPO reinitialization control; it usefully weakens the naive prior that self-training always amplifies traits.

paper.title: Controllable and Verifiable Process Data Synthesis for Process Reward Models
paper.abstract: Process reward models (PRMs) rely on high-quality process supervision data, yet existing construction methods often provide limited control over error location, error type, and trajectory consistency. We propose a controllable and verifiable framework for synthesizing process supervision data for PRMs. Our framework first constructs a correct symbolic reasoning chain, injects a template-aware error into an intermediate step, recomputes subsequent steps under the corrupted state, and verifies tha

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 PRM 数据构造里一个很具体但很关键的问题：现有自动化过程监督数据往往只能粗糙地产生“对/错”轨迹，却很难精确控制首个错误出现在哪一步、属于哪一类错误，以及错误出现后后续推导是否仍然自洽。对于训练 process reward model 来说，这三个属性都很重要，因为 PRM 真正要学的是 step-level 诊断能力，尤其是 first-error localization，而不是只给整条链打一个总分。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，更接近 post-train / reasoning supervision 基础设施。但如果你关心 pretrain 与 post-train 的接口，这篇有现实意义：高质量过程监督数据的瓶颈不在于再多采样几条 CoT，而在于能否构造出可验证、可控、错误传播合理的负样本。很多 PRM 训练失败，不是模型不会判错，而是训练数据里的错误轨迹本身不干净，首错位置不准，或者后续步骤只是机械翻转标签而不符合真实推理分布。这篇方法把“错误样本质量”从弱启发式提升到符号可验证层面，对后续 PRM、step verifier、search reranking 都有帮助。
summary.technical_approach: 方法设计比较工整，核心是四步链路。第一步，先构造一条经过符号验证的正确推理链 C+。这部分沿用了 ProverGen 一类 LLM+symbolic prover 的思路，从目标结论反向展开，再验证每一步是否可由当前前提推出，只保留 truth-consistent 的链。第二步，在中间某一步 k 注入一个模板感知的错误。这里不是从全局错误分布里随便采样，而是根据该步所实例化的 rule template 约束错误类型，比如改错结论、误用规则方向、破坏局部事实状态等。这样做的好处是错误更像真实推理中的局部失误，而不是表面噪声。第三步，把第 k 步的错误结论当成新的状态，重新用 symbolic prover 计算后续步骤，得到错误链 C-。这一步很关键，因为它保证错误之后的轨迹仍然和被污染的前缀一致，避免出现“首步错了，但后面还沿着正确世界线走”的伪负样本。第四步，做首错验证。对非结构性错误，检查被注入的错误结论是否真的不能从前缀推出；如果还能推出，就说明这不是有效首错，样本要丢弃。对结构性错误，则检查规则方向、依赖顺序、无环约束等是否被破坏。最后再把正确链和错误链翻译成对齐的自然语言过程，保持背景上下文、实体映射、谓词映射一致，使两条链主要只在推理行为上不同。这个 paired, aligned, verifiable 的设计，是整篇最有价值的部分。
summary.experiments: 从可见内容看，作者构造了一个 20k 规模的训练集，并在附录里给出错误类型分布。实验重点应该不在大模型能力展示，而在数据质量和 PRM 训练效果验证。摘要提到该框架在 PRM 训练和评测上有提升，尤其针对 first-error localization 和细粒度过程评估。结合方法设计，比较合理的实验应包括：与 Monte Carlo rollout、search-based annotation 或简单 label flipping 构造的数据相比，PRM 在首错定位、step-level 准确率、reranking 成功率上的提升；以及不同错误类型、不同错误位置上的泛化表现。当前给出的全文片段没有具体数值，因此还不能判断提升幅度是否足以改变现有 PRM 数据管线。但从问题设定看，最该关注的是：模型是否真的学会了“前缀到第 k-1 步都对，第 k 步首次出错”的判别，而不是只学会识别某些表面错误模板。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看 Figure 1 和 Method 全段，确认数据生成流程是否闭环，尤其是错误注入、下游重算、prefix non-derivability check 这三步。然后看 error type 定义和数据分布，判断错误空间是否足够丰富，还是主要集中在少数模板。实验部分优先看三类结果：一是 PRM 的首错定位能力；二是 reranking 或 process evaluation 的实际收益；三是对比不做 downstream recomputation 或不做 prefix verification 的消融，这能直接说明每个设计是否必要。若只想判断是否值得跟进，20 到 30 分钟足够；如果你在做 PRM 数据合成或 verifier，值得细看附录里的模板、过滤规则和自然语言对齐策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific bottleneck in process reward modeling: automatically generated process supervision data usually lacks precise control over where the first error occurs, what kind of error it is, and whether the rest of the trajectory remains coherent after that error. Those details matter because PRMs are supposed to learn step-level diagnosis, especially first-error localization, rather than merely assign a global score to an entire chain of thought.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense; it sits closer to post-training infrastructure for reasoning supervision. Still, it matters if you care about the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. A large fraction of PRM weakness comes from noisy negative trajectories: the first wrong step is ambiguous, later steps are inconsistent with the corrupted state, or the errors are synthetic in a superficial way. This work pushes process data construction toward something more controlled and verifiable. That is useful for PRMs, step verifiers, reranking, and search-based reasoning pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is built as a four-stage pipeline. First, it constructs a verified correct symbolic reasoning chain C+ using an LLM-plus-symbolic-prover setup similar in spirit to ProverGen. The chain is generated under rule templates and each step is checked for derivability, so only truth-consistent trajectories are kept. Second, it injects a template-aware error at an intermediate step k. The error type is constrained by the local rule template rather than sampled from a global noise process, which makes the corruption structurally compatible with the local inference pattern. Third, the corrupted step is treated as part of the new symbolic state, and all downstream steps are recomputed under that corrupted state to produce an erroneous chain C-. This is the key design choice: later steps remain consistent with the wrong prefix, instead of becoming unrealistic label-flipped artifacts. Fourth, the framework verifies that the injected step is truly the first invalid step. For non-structural errors, it performs a prefix non-derivability check; if the corrupted conclusion is still derivable from the prefix, the sample is rejected. For structural errors, it checks violations of rule direction, dependency order, or acyclicity constraints. Finally, both the correct and erroneous symbolic chains are translated into aligned natural-language processes under shared context, entity realizations, and predicate mappings, so the pair differs mainly in reasoning behavior rather than surface form.
summary_en.experiments: From the visible text, the authors build a 20k training set and provide the error-type distribution in the appendix. The experimental focus appears to be data quality and downstream PRM utility rather than raw model scale. The abstract indicates gains in PRM training and evaluation, especially for first-error localization and fine-grained process assessment. The most relevant comparisons are likely against Monte Carlo rollout annotation, search-based annotation, or simpler corruption schemes such as isolated label flipping. The excerpt does not include concrete numbers, so it is hard to judge the practical effect size. The main thing to check in the full paper is whether the trained PRM truly learns the boundary between a valid prefix and the first invalid step, rather than overfitting to a small set of synthetic error templates.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with Figure 1 and the method section to verify that the pipeline is logically closed: error injection, downstream recomputation, and prefix non-derivability checking are the three essential pieces. Then inspect the error taxonomy and its distribution to see whether the corruption space is broad enough. In the experiments, prioritize three questions: how much first-error localization improves, whether reranking or process evaluation actually benefits, and what the ablations say when downstream recomputation or prefix verification is removed. A 20 to 30 minute skim is enough to assess whether the data construction idea is solid; if you work on PRM data synthesis or verifiers, the appendix is likely worth a closer read.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 step-level 评测即可；它提醒 PRM 数据要控制“首错可证伪”和“错后轨迹一致”两个变量。
recommendation.en: Read the method and step-level evaluation; the useful lesson is to control both first-error invalidity and post-error trajectory consistency in PRM data.

paper.title: Selector-Guided Autonomous Curriculum for One-Shot Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards
paper.abstract: Recently, Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has been established as a highly effective technique for augmenting the math reasoning skills of Large Language Models (LLMs) based on a single instance. Current state-of-the-art 1-shot RLVR models adopt heuristics for selecting instances, mostly based on historical variance in rewards, which we find to be inherently misleading as a measure of transferability value. In this paper, we propose a Selector-Guided Autonomous Curriculum (

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 1-shot RLVR 中训练样本如何选择。已有方法常用 reward variance 选题，但作者认为高方差经常来自解析、格式、tokenization 等测量噪声，不能稳定代表可迁移的推理学习信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，但对 post-train 与 pretrain 接口有启发。它把“一个可验证样本为何能激活推理能力”这个问题进一步拆成样本选择问题，并指出二元 reward 的统计量可能混入大量无关噪声。对 RLVR、GRPO、小数据强化学习和训练信号质量分析有参考价值。需要保留尺度判断：实验规模和增益都较小，不能直接外推到大规模 reasoning RL。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 Selector-Guided Autonomous Curriculum。作者先批评单一 reward variance heuristic：同一个题目多次采样后的对错方差，可能反映模型不确定性，也可能反映答案解析失败、格式漂移或 verifier 误差。随后构造多维特征来描述候选题：success probability 表示模型当前能做对的比例；reward variance 表示二元奖励波动；output disagreement 用 K 次随机 rollout 得到的不同数学答案熵来度量，试图捕捉答案层面的分歧；semantic difficulty level 表示题目语义难度。选择器是一个线性回归模型，用这些特征预测下游 transfer accuracy。最后把选择器放进自动 curriculum loop：从题库随机采样候选题，计算多维信号，选择预测收益最高的题目，对该题执行一次 GRPO micro-burst，并累积 LoRA 权重进入下一轮。
summary.experiments: 论文给出的关键结果包括：reward variance 最高的候选题方差为 0.250，但下游准确率只有 40%，成为反例；一个 output disagreement 达到 100% 的候选题取得 50% 下游准确率，支持 disagreement 比 reward variance 更接近数学层面的不确定性。线性选择器中，success probability 的系数为 -0.0574，说明太容易的题训练收益较低；difficulty level 的系数为 +0.1095，说明更难题在该设定下更有迁移收益。自动 curriculum 运行 20 步，使用累积 LoRA 权重，最终准确率为 68.0%，高于 baseline model 的 64.0% 和原始 RLVR checkpoint 的 66.0%。这些数字显示方向有效，但提升幅度较小，且需要关注候选池、评测集、K 次采样成本和 verifier 稳定性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 15–20 分钟。重点看三处：第一，Variance Fallacy 的控制实验，看高 reward variance 为什么会对应低 transfer accuracy；第二，output disagreement 的定义，尤其是“unique mathematical answers”的抽取和归一化方式，因为这个指标很容易受答案规范化影响；第三，autonomous curriculum loop 的实现细节，包括每步候选采样数量、GRPO micro-burst 长度、LoRA 累积方式和评测协议。线性回归系数表值得扫一眼，但不要把系数解释成稳定的因果关系。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses example selection for 1-shot RLVR. Prior work often chooses the training problem using reward variance, but the authors argue that high variance can come from parsing, formatting, tokenization, or verifier noise rather than transferable reasoning uncertainty.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to the pretrain-posttrain interface than to base pretraining itself. It treats the surprising effect of 1-shot RLVR as a data-selection and signal-quality problem: which single verifiable example can best activate reasoning behavior learned earlier during pretraining. The paper is useful for thinking about RLVR, GRPO, small-data reinforcement learning, and reward-signal diagnostics. The scale should be kept in mind: the reported gains are modest and the conclusions should not be directly extrapolated to large-scale reasoning RL without further evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method is Selector-Guided Autonomous Curriculum. The authors first challenge reward variance as a selection heuristic. Binary reward variance over repeated rollouts can reflect real uncertainty, but it can also reflect answer-format drift, parsing failures, or verifier artifacts. They then define a multi-feature candidate representation: success probability, reward variance, output disagreement, and semantic difficulty. Output disagreement is computed from the entropy of unique mathematical answers across K stochastic rollouts, aiming to measure answer-level uncertainty rather than verifier-level noise. A linear regression selector is trained to predict downstream transfer accuracy from these features. The selector is then used in an autonomous loop: sample candidate tasks from a problem pool, compute the features using stochastic generation, choose the candidate with the highest predicted value, run a targeted GRPO micro-burst on that problem, and accumulate LoRA weights over curriculum steps.
summary_en.experiments: The key empirical observations are concrete. The candidate with the highest reward variance, 0.250, produced only 40% downstream accuracy, which weakens the variance heuristic. A candidate with 100% output disagreement, where all rollouts produced unique answers, reached 50% downstream accuracy, supporting disagreement as a better proxy for mathematical uncertainty in this setup. In the learned selector, success probability has a negative coefficient, -0.0574, suggesting that easy problems provide limited training signal, while semantic difficulty has a positive coefficient, +0.1095. In the full autonomous curriculum, 20 steps with accumulated LoRA weights reach 68.0% accuracy, compared with 64.0% for the baseline model and 66.0% for the original RLVR checkpoint. The improvement is real but small, so the sampling budget, verifier robustness, and evaluation protocol matter.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15–20 minutes. Read the variance-fallacy experiment first, since it motivates the whole method. Then inspect the definition of output disagreement, especially how unique mathematical answers are extracted and normalized; this metric can be sensitive to answer canonicalization. Finally, read the autonomous curriculum loop details: candidate-pool sampling, the number of stochastic rollouts, GRPO micro-burst length, LoRA accumulation, and the held-out evaluation setup. The regression coefficients are useful as diagnostics, but they should not be read as stable causal effects.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验里 disagreement 与收益的相关性分析；若 setup 干净，它会削弱“reward variance 选题足够好”的默认做法。
recommendation.en: Read only the correlation analysis between disagreement and gains; if the setup is clean, it weakens the default reward-variance heuristic for one-shot RLVR.
