paper.title: S^3-R1: Learning to Retrieve and Answer Step-by-Step with Synthetic Data
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has enabled newer capabilities in models, such as agentic tool-use for search. However, these models struggle primarily due to limitations with sparse outcome-based rewards and a lack of training data that encapsulates questions of differing hardness, which results in models not performing deeper searches with tools to collect evidence for question-answering. To address these limitations, we introduce S^3-R1 (Synthetic data and stabilized Search R1), a f

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体但长期存在的问题：把 RL 用到检索增强问答时，模型往往学不会稳定的多步搜索策略。原因有两层。第一，训练数据分布偏浅，很多样本并不真正要求多跳检索，模型容易靠短路径或参数记忆拿到答案。第二，奖励过于稀疏，通常只看最终答案是否正确，导致搜索质量、证据覆盖、查询是否有效这些中间行为拿不到训练信号。全文围绕这两个瓶颈展开：如何构造一批“确实需要多步检索、但又不是不可学”的训练题，以及如何让 RL 不只奖励最终答对，还奖励检索过程本身。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关系不在 base pretrain，而在 pretrain 到 post-train 的接口。它提供了一个很清楚的信号：当能力目标是 tool-use 和外部知识检索时，单靠 outcome-only RL 很容易把策略推向短视解。更有效的做法是同时改训练分布和奖励形状。这里最有启发的是“中等难度、可验证、可检索”的合成数据带设计，以及把 retrieval quality 显式写进 reward。对做 continual pretrain、mid-train、agentic post-training 的人，这种思路比单纯换 RL 算法更有参考价值。贡献量级属于扎实的训练范式改进，不是基础建模范式变化。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分成两部分。第一部分是数据。作者不是直接让强模型随便生成多跳题，而是先做 hard example mining，找到当前基座 agent 解不好的问题或文档片段，再让 frontier model 在这些材料上做问题变换和扩展，生成新的 multi-hop QA。之后接一个较严格的过滤链路，核心有两类校验：一类是 factual grounding，确保问题和答案能被原始文档支持，不是语言模型幻觉出来的伪题；另一类是 retrieval-solvability，检查在高召回但带噪声的检索环境里，这个问题是否仍然可解。这个设计的目的很明确：不是追求最难，而是找一个 RL 能学到策略改进的难度带。第二部分是奖励。作者在最终答案正确性之外，引入 retrieval-aware reward，显式鼓励更好的搜索查询和证据选择。按文中描述，这个奖励不是简单给每次 search 固定 bonus，而是和召回到的支持证据、搜索质量相关，意图缓解 credit assignment 问题，让模型知道“为什么这次搜索是有用的”。训练上沿用 Search-R1 一类的交互式 rollout 协议，使用 GRPO 做策略优化，并对外部检索返回内容做 token mask 处理，避免把工具返回直接当作普通生成 token 来更新。
summary.experiments: 从全文可见，实验重点不是证明一个全新 RL 算法，而是验证两件事：合成数据扩展训练分布是否有效，以及 retrieval-aware reward 是否比 outcome-only reward 更能学出深搜索行为。作者在多个 multi-hop QA benchmark 上与 Search-R1、R1-Searcher 一类强基线比较，结论是整体准确率和复杂问题上的表现都有明显提升，且提升主要集中在需要多次检索和证据整合的样本上。消融实验围绕三点展开：去掉合成数据后，模型更容易退回短路径回答；去掉检索感知奖励后，搜索步数和证据质量下降，即便最终答案偶尔还能蒙对；如果放松数据过滤，训练会混入不可解或伪难题，收益明显变差。给出的全文片段里没有完整表格数字、模型参数量和数据规模明细，因此无法可靠填入具体百分比或绝对提升值；但实验结构已经足够说明作者想证明的是“数据分布 + 稠密奖励”这组组合优于单独调 RL。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Method 开头，抓住作者的判断：问题不在 RL 优化器本身，而在训练分布和奖励信号。然后重点看 synthetic question generation / curation 那一节，尤其是 hard seed、verification、retrieval-solvability 这几个步骤，因为真正有方法含量的是数据带设计，而不是“再造一批 synthetic QA”这件事本身。接着看 reward 设计部分，确认 retrieval-aware reward 到底如何定义、是否依赖额外标注、是否会诱导 reward hacking。实验部分建议优先看 ablation：只加数据、只改奖励、两者同时加，三者差异最能说明方法是否成立。预计 20–30 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读；如果你关心 agentic RL 的训练信号设计，可以再细看 failure case 和 search depth 分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in RL-based search agents for QA: models do not reliably learn multi-step retrieval policies. The root causes are twofold. First, the training distribution is too shallow; many examples do not truly require multi-hop search, so the policy can survive with short-horizon behavior or parametric recall. Second, the reward is too sparse, usually based only on final answer correctness, which gives almost no direct signal for query quality, evidence coverage, or whether an intermediate search action was useful. The paper is built around these two questions: how to construct questions that genuinely require retrieval yet remain learnable, and how to shape RL signals so the model is rewarded for the retrieval process rather than only the final answer.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to the pretrain–post-train interface. The main lesson is clear: for tool-use and retrieval-heavy capabilities, outcome-only RL tends to produce short-sighted policies unless the training distribution and reward design are fixed together. The most useful idea is the construction of a verified, retrieval-solvable, intermediate-difficulty synthetic dataset, paired with an explicit retrieval-aware reward. For researchers working on continual pretraining, mid-training, or agentic post-training, this is more informative than another small variation of PPO or GRPO. The contribution is a solid training recipe improvement rather than a new modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two main components. The first is data construction. Instead of asking a strong model to freely generate multi-hop QA pairs, the pipeline starts with hard example mining: identify questions or document regions that the current base agent fails on, then use a frontier model to mutate or expand them into new multi-hop questions. A filtering pipeline follows, with two key checks. One is factual grounding, which ensures the question and answer are supported by source documents rather than model hallucination. The other is retrieval-solvability, which tests whether the question remains answerable in a noisy but high-recall retrieval setting. This is an important design choice: the target is not maximal difficulty, but a learnable difficulty band where RL can improve policy behavior. The second component is reward design. In addition to final answer correctness, the paper introduces a retrieval-aware reward that explicitly scores search quality and evidence selection. From the full text, this is meant to provide denser credit assignment than a pure outcome reward, so the model can learn which search actions were actually productive. Training follows the interactive search rollout protocol used in Search-R1-style systems, optimized with GRPO, with masking applied to externally retrieved content during policy updates.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental section is organized to validate two claims rather than to introduce a new RL optimizer: expanding the training distribution with synthetic data helps, and adding retrieval-aware reward helps beyond outcome-only supervision. The paper compares against strong baselines such as Search-R1 and R1-Searcher on multiple multi-hop QA benchmarks, and reports consistent gains, especially on questions that require multiple retrieval steps and evidence aggregation. The ablations are the most informative part. Removing synthetic data pushes the model back toward shallow answering behavior. Removing the retrieval-aware reward reduces search depth and evidence quality, even when final-answer accuracy does not collapse immediately. Relaxing the filtering pipeline introduces unsound or effectively unsolvable questions, which weakens training gains. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the final numeric tables, model sizes, or exact dataset scale, so it would be unsafe to invent precise numbers. Still, the structure of the experiments makes the intended result clear: the combination of better data distribution and denser retrieval-specific reward is stronger than tuning RL alone.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and the opening of the method section. The key claim is that the bottleneck is not primarily the RL optimizer, but the training distribution and reward signal. Then read the synthetic question generation and curation section carefully, especially the hard-seed mining, verification, and retrieval-solvability checks. That is where the real methodological content sits; the value is not simply 'more synthetic QA', but how the difficulty band is engineered. After that, inspect the reward section to see how retrieval-aware reward is defined, whether it depends on extra supervision, and whether it creates room for reward hacking. In the experiments, prioritize the ablations: data only, reward only, and both together. Those comparisons tell you whether the method is actually doing what it claims. A useful skim should take about 20–30 minutes. If your interest is RL signal design for search agents, spend extra time on failure cases and search-depth analysis.

recommendation.zh: 读数据筛选和 dense reward 设计即可；方法像工程补丁，但能提醒预训练团队别把检索能力全压给 outcome RL。
recommendation.en: Read the data filtering and dense-reward design; it is an engineering patch, but a useful warning against relying on outcome-only RL for retrieval behavior.

paper.title: Structure Liberates: How Constrained Sensemaking Produces More Novel Research Output
paper.abstract: Scientific discovery is an extended process of ideation--surveying prior work, forming hypotheses, and refining reasoning--yet existing approaches treat this phase as a brief preamble despite its central role in research. We introduce SCISENSE, a sensemaking-grounded framework that operationalizes ideation as a structured sequence of eight cognitive stages (Pirolli \& Card, 2005). We construct SCISENSE-Traj, a 100K-scale dataset of citation-conditioned research trajectories in two modes: Target,

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是科研 agent 的“上游规划”问题：现有系统往往把 ideation 当成很短的一段计划，导致后续代码生成、实验设计和论文写作都容易模板化、浅层化。作者要解决的核心问题不是如何直接提升某个下游科研 benchmark，而是如何把研究构思过程结构化、可监督化，并验证这种结构化 supervision 是否真的能带来更好的研究轨迹和更好的下游产物。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接影响有限，它更接近 post-train / agent planning 数据构造与蒸馏工作。但它有两个可能的启发点。第一，它展示了“强约束 supervision 反而带来更高多样性”的现象，这对合成训练数据、trajectory distillation、甚至 reasoning data 设计都有参考价值。第二，它把 citation-conditioned 研究轨迹做成 100K 规模数据集，并区分 reconstructive Target 与 open-ended Infer 两种监督模式，这种数据构造思路对需要长程规划信号的模型训练是有借鉴意义的。若关心 pretrain-posttrain 接口，可以把它看成一种高结构化中间任务：不是直接教模型答案，而是教模型如何组织证据、形成研究计划。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 SciSense 框架。作者借用 sensemaking 理论，把科研 ideation 拆成八个有顺序的认知阶段，用 citation neighborhood 作为条件上下文，构造“研究轨迹”而不是单段 proposal。数据集 SciSense-Traj 有两种模式。Target 模式中，给定一篇目标论文及其引用文献，让模型从 cited works 反推一条通向该论文的合理 ideation trajectory；Infer 模式中，给定同样的引用上下文，但不锚定已知结果，而是让模型提出新的研究方向。作者随后用这些轨迹蒸馏出 SciSense-LM，模型规模从 3B 到 70B。

这篇论文最值得注意的点不是八阶段框架本身，而是监督信号设计。直觉上，开放式 Infer 似乎更有利于“创造性”；作者却发现 outcome-anchored 的 Target supervision 反而产生更高质量、也更有多样性的轨迹。论文给出的机制解释是：Target 轨迹更强调 Schema、Elaboration 这类建设性阶段，能把已有文献组织成更完整的解释框架；而 Infer 更容易过早进入 Hypothesis、Questioning，导致计划前段发散但后段支撑不足。也就是说，约束不是简单压缩搜索空间，而是在高维规划任务里提供了更稳定的结构先验。

从训练范式看，这更像一种 trajectory distillation：先用较强模型或流程生成结构化研究轨迹，再把这种能力蒸馏到不同规模的基础模型中。它不是基座预训练方法创新，但属于“如何构造高质量长链 supervision”的一类工作。
summary.experiments:
实验主结论很集中。Target 监督在不同模型家族和尺度上，都同时优于 Infer 的多样性和质量，没有出现常见的 quality-diversity tradeoff。文中给出的数字是：Target 在 aggregate plan quality 上比 Infer 高 2.0%，同时在多种自动多样性指标上也更强。作者还做了机制层面的 stage 分析，发现 Target 计划更偏向 Schema 和 Elaboration，Infer 则更偏向前置的 Hypothesis 和 Questioning。

更关键的是下游迁移实验。作者把这些 trajectory 用作 coding agent 的条件输入，发现 Target 轨迹能提升生成 scientific artifacts 的质量，尤其是在 scientific grounding 上更好，同时 executability 和 downstream utility 也有改善。这个结果说明上游规划不是装饰性文本，而会真实影响后续 agent 行为。

从规模上看，数据集是 100K 级，蒸馏模型覆盖 3B 到 70B。若精读实验部分，建议重点核对三件事：1）多样性指标是否只是 lexical variation，还是包含语义层面的差异；2）人工评测和自动评测是否一致；3）下游 coding agent 的提升幅度是否稳定，还是只在特定任务/模型上成立。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合泛读，不建议当作基座预训练必读。阅读时先看 framework 和 dataset construction，弄清楚八阶段 sensemaking 是如何落到可训练样本上的。然后直接看 Target vs Infer 的主实验和 stage-distribution 分析，这两部分决定论文是否成立。最后看 downstream evaluation，判断这些结构化轨迹是否真的能改善后续科研 agent 输出。若只想抓住主要信息，25–35 分钟足够。

值得留意的点有两个。第一，Target supervision 的优势是否来自“更强约束”本身，还是来自它隐含地泄露了更接近真实论文分布的结构模板。第二，这种 citation-conditioned trajectory 是否会过度依赖已有文献邻域，导致生成更像“重组已有方向”而不是提出真正偏离分布的新问题。若关心训练数据设计，这两个问题比 benchmark 分数更重要。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper focuses on the upstream planning stage of research agents. Many current systems treat ideation as a short preamble, which often leads to shallow downstream code generation, experimentation, and writing. The core question is not how to improve a single scientific benchmark directly, but how to make the ideation process structured and supervisable, and whether that structured supervision actually yields better research trajectories and better downstream artifacts.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is limited; this is closer to post-training, planning data construction, and trajectory distillation for research agents. Still, it offers two useful lessons. First, it reports an interesting result: stronger structural constraints can produce not only higher-quality outputs but also more diverse ones. That is relevant to synthetic data design, reasoning trajectory supervision, and long-horizon planning data. Second, it builds a 100K-scale citation-conditioned trajectory dataset with two supervision modes, Target and Infer, which is a useful template for training models on structured planning rather than final answers. For people interested in the pretrain–posttrain interface, this can be viewed as a highly structured intermediate task for teaching evidence organization and plan formation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method centers on the SciSense framework. Drawing from sensemaking theory, the authors decompose research ideation into eight ordered cognitive stages and use citation neighborhoods as conditioning context, producing full research trajectories rather than short proposals. The dataset, SciSense-Traj, has two modes. In Target mode, given a target paper and its cited works, the model reconstructs a plausible ideation trajectory that could have led from those citations to the known paper. In Infer mode, given the same citation context, the model proposes novel directions without anchoring to a known outcome. These trajectories are then distilled into SciSense-LM models ranging from 3B to 70B.

The most interesting part is not the eight-stage framework by itself, but the supervision design. Intuitively, open-ended Infer supervision might seem more creative. The paper finds the opposite: outcome-anchored Target supervision produces trajectories that are both higher quality and more diverse. The proposed mechanism is that Target trajectories spend more effort on constructive stages such as Schema and Elaboration, which organize prior work into a coherent explanatory structure, whereas Infer trajectories overemphasize early Hypothesis and Questioning stages, leading to broader but less grounded plans. In that sense, the constraint is not merely narrowing the search space; it provides a stabilizing structural prior for a difficult planning problem.

From a training perspective, this is best understood as trajectory distillation: generate structured research plans with a stronger process, then transfer that planning behavior into smaller or more standard LLMs.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical result is consistent and simple: Target supervision beats Infer on both diversity and quality across model families and scales, without the usual quality–diversity tradeoff. The paper reports a 2.0% gain in aggregate plan quality for Target over Infer, while also showing stronger diversity under multiple automatic metrics. It also includes stage-level analysis showing that Target plans emphasize Schema and Elaboration, whereas Infer plans front-load Hypothesis and Questioning.

The downstream transfer result is more important than the planning metrics alone. When these trajectories are used to condition coding agents, Target trajectories improve the quality of generated scientific artifacts, especially scientific grounding, and also help executability and downstream utility. That suggests the planning text is not decorative; it changes downstream agent behavior in measurable ways.

In terms of scale, the dataset is around 100K trajectories and the distilled models span 3B to 70B. When reading the full experiments, the main things to verify are whether the diversity metrics capture semantic diversity rather than surface variation, whether human and automatic evaluations agree, and whether the downstream gains are robust across tasks and model choices.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper rather than a must-read for core pretraining. Start with the framework and dataset construction to understand how the eight-stage sensemaking process is operationalized into trainable trajectories. Then jump to the Target-vs-Infer comparison and the stage-distribution analysis; those sections carry the central claim. Finish with the downstream evaluation to judge whether structured trajectories materially improve research-agent outputs. A 25–35 minute pass should be enough.

Two questions are worth keeping in mind. First, is the advantage of Target supervision due to structure itself, or because it implicitly matches the distribution of real papers more closely? Second, does citation-conditioned planning encourage grounded synthesis at the cost of genuinely out-of-distribution ideas? Those questions matter more than the headline benchmark numbers if the goal is to learn from this work for training-data design.

recommendation.zh: 有个值得记的反直觉点：更强结构监督不一定压制探索；先看 Target vs Infer 的评测定义，若 judge 够干净，这个结论值得迁到 reasoning data 合成。
recommendation.en: The useful surprise is that tighter structural supervision may not reduce exploration; read the Target-vs-Infer evaluation carefully, and if the judges are clean, port the idea to reasoning-data synthesis.

paper.title: Decouple before Integration: Test-time Synthesis of SFT and RLVR Task Vectors
paper.abstract: SFT and RLVR represent two fundamental yet distinct paradigms for LLM post-training, each excelling in distinct dimensions. SFT expands knowledge breadth while RLVR enhances reasoning depth. Yet integrating these complementary strengths remains a formidable challenge. Sequential training can cause catastrophic forgetting, and joint optimization often suffers from severe gradient conflicts. We analyze SFT and RLVR through the lens of task vectors and reveal three structural properties behind thes

summary.core_problem: 如何把同一个 base model 上分别得到的 SFT（知识/覆盖面）与 RLVR（可验证奖励驱动的推理深度）能力可靠地融合，同时避免顺序训练的遗忘与联合训练的梯度冲突；并进一步追问：这些失败是“配方问题”，还是两类后训练在参数空间存在结构性不相容。
summary.importance: 对 post-train→pretrain 闭环的价值在于：用 task vector 的几何/统计证据把“为什么 SFT+RLVR 难共训”说清楚，并给出一个几乎不需要再训练的融合路径。它不直接改预训练目标，但对后训练阶段的稳定性、能力组合、以及“用参数空间操作替代昂贵训练”的思路有现实影响：把融合成本从数百 GPU 小时降到约 20 GPU 小时量级，并展示一定的跨任务系数可迁移性。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两层：
1) 诊断：把 SFT 与 RLVR 都视为从 base checkpoint 出发的 task vector（Δθ）。全文的关键不是“能线性相加”，而是量化了三类导致失败的结构性因素：
- 量级失配：SFT 的 Δθ L2 norm 在各层约为 RLVR 的 30×，直接相加会被 SFT 主导，RLVR 的推理信号被淹没。
- 符号干扰：两向量在参数维度上约 44.91% 符号相反，意味着接近一半参数更新方向冲突，对应联合优化中的 persistent gradient conflict。
- 模块分布异质：SFT 的“重要更新”更集中在 LayerNorm（文中给出约 19.9% 的占比），RLVR 则更分散地作用于 attention / LayerNorm / LM head，暗示两者并非完全争夺同一子空间，也存在互补。
2) 处方（DoTS, Decoupled Test-time Synthesis）：不在训练时强行共存，而是分别独立训练出 SFT checkpoint 与 RLVR checkpoint，在推理时做参数空间合成：θ = θ0 + λ_sft * Δθ_sft' + λ_rlvr * Δθ_rlvr'。
- 关键操作是 selective sparsification：对 task vector 只保留按幅值排序的 top-k% 参数，其余置零；然后对保留部分做 rescale 以保持原向量范数，避免“稀疏后信号变弱”。这一步同时针对量级失配与符号干扰：通过丢弃大量小幅但可能冲突的维度，把 sign interference 从 44.91% 降到最低约 7.1%（取决于 k）。
- 系数搜索：用少量无标注 query，通过 Bayesian optimization 搜索两个标量系数 λ_sft 与 λ_rlvr，优化信号由一致性与困惑度（perplexity）等代理指标引导。重点在于：不更新模型参数，只调两个标量，计算成本显著低于再训练式融合。
summary.experiments:
论文报告的主结果集中在数学推理：AIME 2024/2025、AMC、MATH500、OlympiadBench 等。DoTS 在多项基准上达到或超过训练式融合方法，同时计算成本约为其 3%：系数搜索约 20 GPU 小时，对比训练式方案超过 600 GPU 小时。
在更强的后训练 checkpoint 上（文中点名 ExGRPO 与 ReLIFT），DoTS 达到平均 50.6 分，比强基线 LUFFY 高 1.4 分。
迁移性：在数学推理上学到的 λ 系数可直接迁移到 ARC-C、GPQA、MMLU-Pro 等 QA 基准，无需重新调参，作者据此主张它更像“能力融合模式”而非任务特化技巧。
诊断实验的关键数字包括：SFT vs RLVR task vector 范数约 30× 差异；原始符号冲突 44.91%；稀疏化后最低可到约 7.1%；模块重要更新分布中 SFT 在 LayerNorm 约 19.9%。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 task-vector 诊断部分：三条结构性结论各自对应哪些统计量与可视化（层级范数曲线、符号冲突比例、按模块的更新分布）。这里决定了 DoTS 的设计是否“对症”。
- 再看 selective sparsification 的定义：top-k 的选择、rescale 方式、以及它如何同时缓解量级失配与符号干扰；重点确认作者是否比较了“只缩放不稀疏”“只稀疏不保范数”等对照。
- 最后看系数搜索：Bayesian optimization 的目标函数由哪些代理指标组成、无标注 query 的规模、以及系数跨基准迁移的证据（这是全文最像“可复用技巧”的部分）。
如果只想拿走可复现结论：优先复现三条诊断统计 + 稀疏化前后符号干扰变化 + 20 GPU 小时的系数搜索流程。

summary_en.core_problem: How to reliably combine the complementary gains from SFT (knowledge breadth) and RLVR (verifiable-reward-driven reasoning depth) on the same base model, without catastrophic forgetting from sequential training or gradient conflicts from joint optimization—and whether the difficulty is rooted in a structural incompatibility in parameter space rather than just recipe tuning.
summary_en.importance: The paper’s main contribution is diagnostic clarity plus a low-cost fusion alternative: it quantifies why SFT+RLVR merging often fails using task-vector geometry/statistics, then proposes a test-time composition method that avoids additional training. While not a pretraining objective paper, it matters to the pretrain↔post-train loop by offering a practical way to compose capabilities with ~3% of the compute of training-based integration, and by framing SFT/RLVR interaction as a parameter-space interference problem.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Two-stage design:
1) Task-vector analysis. Define task vectors as Δθ between a post-trained checkpoint and the base model. The paper reports three structural properties:
- Magnitude disparity: SFT task vectors have ~30× larger L2 norms than RLVR across layers, so naive linear merging is dominated by SFT.
- Sign interference: ~44.91% of parameters have opposite signs between the two vectors, explaining persistent gradient conflicts in joint training.
- Module-wise heterogeneity: SFT concentrates “important” updates in LayerNorm (reported ~19.9%), whereas RLVR spreads updates across attention, LayerNorm, and the LM head, suggesting partial complementarity.
2) DoTS (Decoupled Test-time Synthesis). Train SFT and RLVR separately, then synthesize at inference: θ = θ0 + λ_sft Δθ_sft' + λ_rlvr Δθ_rlvr'.
- Selective sparsification: keep only top-k% coordinates by magnitude in each task vector, zero the rest, then rescale to preserve the original norm. This is positioned as the key fix for both magnitude imbalance and sign conflicts, reducing sign interference from 44.91% down to as low as ~7.1%.
- Coefficient search: use Bayesian optimization over two scalars (λ_sft, λ_rlvr) on a small set of unlabeled queries, guided by proxy signals such as consistency and perplexity. No parameter updates; only scalar tuning.
summary_en.experiments:
Results are mainly on math reasoning benchmarks (AIME 2024/2025, AMC, MATH500, OlympiadBench): DoTS matches or exceeds training-based SFT–RLVR integration while using ~20 GPU-hours for coefficient search versus >600 GPU-hours for training-based alternatives (~3% compute).
On stronger post-trained checkpoints (named ExGRPO and ReLIFT), DoTS reports an average score of 50.6, beating the LUFFY baseline by 1.4 points.
Transfer: coefficients tuned on math reasoning reportedly transfer to QA benchmarks (ARC-C, GPQA, MMLU-Pro) without re-tuning.
Key diagnostic numbers: ~30× norm gap; 44.91% sign conflicts; down to ~7.1% after sparsification; SFT LayerNorm share ~19.9%.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Start with the task-vector diagnostics: verify how the three claims are measured (layerwise norms, sign-conflict ratios, module-wise importance distributions).
- Read the selective sparsification definition carefully (top-k criterion, norm-preserving rescale) and check ablations against simpler fixes (scaling-only, sparsify-without-rescale).
- Then inspect the Bayesian optimization setup: what proxy objective is optimized, how many unlabeled queries are used, and the evidence for cross-benchmark coefficient transfer.
If you want one reproducible takeaway: replicate the diagnostics + the sign-interference reduction curve vs k + the two-scalar tuning loop.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 task-vector 分析，不是合并技巧本身；若 30×/45% 在你模型上复现，应调整 SFT/RLVR 串联习惯。
recommendation.en: The task-vector analysis matters more than the merge trick; if the 30x and 45% effects reproduce on your stack, revisit SFT→RLVR sequencing.

paper.title: Uniform-Correct Policy Optimization: Breaking RLVR's Indifference to Diversity
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has achieved substantial gains in single-attempt accuracy (Pass@1) on reasoning tasks, yet often suffers from reduced multi-sample coverage (Pass@K), indicating diversity collapse. We identify a structural cause for this degradation: common RLVR objectives, such as GRPO, are indifferent to how probability mass is distributed among correct solutions. Combined with stochastic training dynamics, this indifference induces a self-reinforcing colla

summary.core_problem: 解释并修复 RLVR（带可验证奖励的强化学习）在提升 Pass@1 的同时常常损害 Pass@K 的现象：训练后策略对“正确解集合”发生模式塌缩，概率质量集中到少数正确解，导致多样性与覆盖率下降。论文要解决的是：RLVR/GRPO 目标函数为何对正确解内部的分布“无差别”，以及如何把“在所有正确解上更均匀”变成一个有唯一最优解的训练目标。
summary.importance: 这是典型的 pretrain↔posttrain 接口问题：RLVR 作为后训练信号，正在反向塑造模型的解空间结构。论文给出一个清晰的结构性诊断：标准 RLVR 只关心“正确集合的总概率质量”Z(x)，不关心质量如何在正确解之间分配，因此在随机 on-policy 采样与优势更新下会自激式塌缩。这个视角对后训练配方很实用：它把“多样性下降”从经验现象变成可推导的目标函数缺陷，并给出一个可实现、开销很小的修正项。对做推理/数学/代码 RLVR 的团队，属于会直接影响训练目标选择与评测指标（Pass@K、正确集内多样性）的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
论文分三步：
1) 目标函数层面的欠定性（underspecification）：在 RLVR 中，奖励 R(x,y)∈{0,1}，目标等价于最大化正确集合概率质量 Zθ(x)=∑_{y∈C(x)} πθ(y|x)。因此任何把同样总质量放在正确集合上的策略，在目标值上等价；“完全塌缩到一个正确解”和“在所有正确解上均匀”都同样最优。
2) 训练动力学导致塌缩：GRPO/策略梯度在每个 prompt 上采样 K 个 rollout。由于所有正确样本共享同一个正优势 A+（错误共享 A-），梯度会放大当前采样到的那几个正确解；被采样频率更高的解获得更多更新，进一步提高其概率，形成正反馈，压制其他正确解。
3) 定义并实现想要的最优结构：他们用两个准则刻画“正确解很多时什么策略更好”——(i) 分布漂移下的鲁棒最优；(ii) 熵正则最优。两者都指向同一个解：Uniform-Correct Policy（对错误解概率为 0，对所有正确解均匀分布）。
据此提出 UCPO：在 GRPO 上加入一个“正确解均匀性惩罚/校正”，让梯度从占优的正确解转移到被低估的正确解，同时保持 GRPO 的总 advantage mass（论文表述为重新分配而非简单加大熵）。理论上证明 Uniform-Correct Policy 是 UCPO 的唯一最优解（Theorem 6.1），从而消除原目标的欠定性。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 3 个模型规模（1.5B–7B）与 5 个数学基准。核心结论是：在几乎不牺牲 Pass@1 的情况下，提高 Pass@K 与正确集内多样性。
- 在 AIME24 上，Pass@64 最高提升可达 +10%（绝对值）。
- 正确解集合内的 equation-level diversity 最高提升 45%。
- 论文声称训练开销可忽略（negligible overhead），因为只是对 GRPO 的目标做轻量修改。
更关键的实验价值在于：他们用受控实验验证“目标无差别 + 随机采样”会导致自激式塌缩，而不是把多样性下降归因于实现细节或熵系数没调好。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 35–50 分钟）：
- 先读形式化部分：RLVR 目标写成 Zθ(x) 与 log Zθ(x) 后，为什么会对正确解内部的分布无差别；再对照 GRPO 的 A+/A- 结构，理解塌缩的梯度来源。
- 精看他们对“Uniform-Correct Policy”最优性的两个论证（鲁棒性与熵正则），这决定 UCPO 不是拍脑袋的正则项。
- 再看 UCPO 的目标形式与 Theorem 6.1（唯一最优解），以及 AIME24 的 Pass@K 曲线和多样性度量定义。阅读时要特别留意：他们的“多样性”是只在 correct set 内统计，避免把错误解的发散当成多样性。

summary_en.core_problem: To explain and fix why RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR), while improving Pass@1, often reduces Pass@K by collapsing probability mass onto a small subset of correct solutions—because standard RLVR/GRPO objectives are indifferent to how mass is distributed within the set of verifier-accepted outputs.
summary_en.importance: This is a practical post-training objective paper with direct implications for how RLVR reshapes a base model’s solution space. The key contribution is turning “diversity collapse” from an empirical annoyance into a structural property of the objective: maximizing the total correct-set mass Z(x) does not specify any preference among correct solutions, so stochastic on-policy sampling plus shared advantages creates a self-reinforcing collapse. For teams doing RLVR on math/code, it provides a principled target (uniform over correct solutions) and a lightweight objective modification that improves Pass@K and within-correct diversity without paying large compute or relying on heuristic entropy bonuses.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper’s logic is:
1) Underspecification of RLVR: with binary verifier reward R(x,y)∈{0,1}, the objective is equivalent to maximizing Zθ(x)=∑_{y∈C(x)} πθ(y|x). Any policy with the same Zθ(x) is equally optimal, regardless of whether it is fully collapsed or maximally diverse over correct outputs.
2) Collapse via training dynamics: in GRPO, for each prompt, K rollouts are sampled; all correct samples share the same positive advantage A+ (and all incorrect share A-). This means gradients preferentially amplify whichever correct solutions are sampled more often, which increases their sampling probability, creating a positive feedback loop that suppresses alternative correct solutions.
3) What the optimum should be: they define two criteria—robustness under distribution shift and entropy-regularized optimality—and show both select the same structure: the Uniform-Correct Policy (zero mass on incorrect outputs, uniform distribution over all correct outputs).
They then propose Uniform-Correct Policy Optimization (UCPO), a modification of GRPO that adds a uniformity term over correct solutions, reallocating gradient signal from dominant correct outputs toward underrepresented ones. They prove the Uniform-Correct Policy is the unique optimum of UCPO (Theorem 6.1), addressing the original objective’s indifference.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated on 3 model sizes (1.5B–7B) across 5 math benchmarks. Reported highlights:
- Up to +10% absolute improvement on AIME24 at Pass@64.
- Up to 45% higher equation-level diversity within the correct set.
- Pass@1 remains competitive, and training overhead is reported as negligible since UCPO is a small objective change on top of GRPO.
They also include controlled evidence supporting the proposed collapse mechanism (objective indifference + stochastic sampling), not just end-metric improvements.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (35–50 minutes):
- Start with the RLVR objective rewritten in terms of Zθ(x) and the GRPO advantage structure (A+/A-); this is the cleanest explanation of why collapse is expected.
- Read the section proving Uniform-Correct optimality under robustness and entropy-regularized criteria; it motivates the target distribution rather than treating diversity as a vague preference.
- Then inspect UCPO’s objective and the uniqueness proof (Theorem 6.1), followed by the Pass@K results (especially AIME24) and the definition of within-correct diversity (to ensure it is not conflated with generating more incorrect variants).

recommendation.zh: 明确了RLVR多样性崩溃的根源，做RL对齐时可参考其正则项设计，仅读方法部分即可
recommendation.en: Clarifies root cause of RLVR diversity collapse, refer to its regularization design for RL alignment, only read the method section

paper.title: ResRL: Boosting LLM Reasoning via Negative Sample Projection Residual Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) enhances reasoning of Large Language Models (LLMs) but usually exhibits limited generation diversity due to the over-incentivization of positive rewards. Although methods like Negative Sample Reinforcement (NSR) mitigate this issue by upweighting penalty from negative samples, they may suppress the semantic distributions shared between positive and negative responses. To boost reasoning ability without losing diversity, this paper proposes ne

summary.core_problem: ResRL 处理的是 RLVR 中负样本惩罚的副作用：错误轨迹和正确轨迹往往共享大量语义片段，直接压低负样本概率会连带压低正确推理中可复用的部分，导致 Pass@1、Pass@k 和生成多样性之间出现张力。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在于基座训练本身，而在于 post-train 目标如何影响模型分布。它把 RLVR 中常见的模式收缩、Lazy Likelihood Displacement 和正负样本梯度干扰联系起来，给出一个可操作的思路：惩罚错误时不要惩罚与正确轨迹共享的表示子空间。这对设计 RL pretrain、verifier-driven training、以及后训练反哺基座分布都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把负样本的隐藏状态表示分解为两部分：一部分落在正样本表示张成的子空间内，另一部分是正交残差。ResRL 只强化对残差方向的惩罚，尽量保留与正样本共享的语义成分。实现上，模型隐藏状态被用作 token 级语义分布的代理；正样本构成低秩表示矩阵；负样本先投影到正样本子空间，再取残差用于调节负 advantage。理论部分把输出头梯度内积分解为 logit 项和 representation 项，并提出单次 forward 可计算的代理指标，用来上界表示对齐程度，从而控制负样本惩罚带来的正负梯度干扰。方法还加入低秩近似降低计算开销，并用长度缩放 reward 抑制过长输出。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 12 个 benchmark，包括数学推理、代码生成、Agent 任务和函数调用。相对 NSR，ResRL 在 Qwen3-4B 的数学任务上 Avg@16 提升 9.4%，平均 Pass@128 提升 7.0%。代码生成中，CodeForces rating 相比 NSR 提升 9.6%。Agent 任务中，ALFWorld success rate 相比 EMPG 高 10.4%。函数调用多轮工具使用中，相比 ResT 准确率提升 2.8%。消融覆盖低秩 rank、隐藏层选择、quantile threshold 等因素，显示 projection residual、层选择和阈值策略都影响最终收益。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 NSR 副作用和 LLD 的问题定义，Method 中正样本子空间、负样本 residual 和 advantage reweighting 的具体公式，以及 ablation 部分对 rank、layer、threshold 的敏感性分析。理论推导可以选择性读，重点确认单次 forward proxy 如何和 head-gradient interference 建立关系。若关注 RLVR 训练稳定性，可额外看长度缩放 reward 是否只是工程补丁，还是对策略分布有稳定影响。

summary_en.core_problem: ResRL targets a specific failure mode in RLVR: negative trajectories often share useful semantic segments with positive trajectories, so directly penalizing negative samples can also suppress reusable reasoning patterns and hurt the balance between Pass@1, Pass@k, and diversity.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research lies in the post-training objective rather than base-model pretraining itself. The work connects mode contraction, Lazy Likelihood Displacement, and positive-negative gradient interference under RLVR. The useful lesson is concrete: when suppressing wrong trajectories, avoid penalizing the representation subspace that overlaps with correct trajectories. This is relevant to RL pretraining, verifier-driven training, and studying how post-training reshapes the base distribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method decomposes a negative sample representation into a component aligned with the positive-sample subspace and an orthogonal residual. ResRL strengthens the penalty mainly on the residual component, while preserving semantic components shared with correct responses. Hidden states are used as token-level semantic proxies. Positive samples define a low-rank representation subspace; each negative sample is projected onto this subspace, and the remaining residual modulates the negative advantage. The theoretical analysis decomposes output-head gradient inner products into logit and representation terms, then introduces a single-forward proxy that upper-bounds representation alignment and helps control gradient interference. Low-rank approximation reduces overhead, and a length-scaled reward is added to discourage unnecessary verbosity.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans 12 benchmarks covering math reasoning, code generation, agent tasks, and function calling. On math, ResRL improves Avg@16 over NSR by 9.4% on Qwen3-4B and improves average Pass@128 by 7.0%. On CodeForces, it reports a 9.6% rating improvement over NSR. On ALFWorld, it improves success rate over EMPG by 10.4%. On multi-turn function calling, it improves accuracy over ResT by 2.8%. Ablations study rank choice, hidden-layer selection, and quantile thresholds, showing that the projection residual mechanism and its implementation details materially affect performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the problem setup in the introduction, especially the critique of NSR and its link to LLD. Then read the method equations for the positive subspace, negative residual, and advantage reweighting. The theory can be read selectively; the key point is how the single-forward proxy is used to control head-gradient interference. The ablations on rank, layer, and threshold are the most useful parts for anyone implementing RLVR variants.

recommendation.zh: 提出的正负语义分布解耦方法可缓解RL对齐过拟合，做负样本RL时可参考其投影设计
recommendation.en: Proposed positive-negative semantic decoupling method mitigates RL alignment overfitting, refer to its projection design for negative sample RL research

paper.title: Block-wise Codeword Embedding for Reliable Multi-bit Text Watermarking
paper.abstract: Recent multi-bit watermarking methods for large language models (LLMs) prioritize capacity over reliability, often conflating decoding with detection. Our analysis reveals that existing ECC-based extractors suffer from catastrophic false positive rates (FPR), and applying rejection thresholds merely collapses detection sensitivity (TPR) to random guessing. To resolve this structural limitation, we propose \textbf{BREW} (Block-wise Reliable Embedding for Watermarking), a framework shifting the pa

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM多比特水印方法假阳性率过高，添加拒绝阈值后检测灵敏度会跌至随机猜测水平，可靠性不足
summary.importance: 方法创新，打破了多比特水印高FPR是容量与可靠性固有权衡的认知，解决了现有ECC基提取器的结构性缺陷
summary.technical_approach: 提出BREW两阶段框架，第一阶段通过独立块投票做盲消息估计，第二阶段通过滑窗验证严格校验payload，抵御局部编辑攻击
summary.experiments: 在10%同义词替换攻击场景下，BREW实现0.965的真阳性率(TPR)和0.02的假阳性率(FPR)，显著优于现有基线方法

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multi-bit LLM watermarking methods suffer from catastrophic false positive rates (FPR), and adding rejection thresholds collapses true positive rate (TPR) to random guessing
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, disproves the inherent trade-off between FPR and capacity for multi-bit watermarking, fixes structural flaws of ECC-based extractors
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes BREW two-stage framework: first conducts blind message estimation via independent block voting, then validates payload via window-shifting verification to resist local edits
summary_en.experiments: Under 10% synonym substitution attack, BREW achieves 0.965 TPR with 0.02 FPR, outperforming existing baseline methods significantly

recommendation.zh: LLM安全领域增量创新，仅做技术追踪即可，预训练研究无需复现或深入
recommendation.en: Incremental work in LLM security, only for trend tracking, no need for pretraining researchers to reproduce or dive deep

paper.title: Improving LLM Code Generation via Requirement-Aware Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Code generation, which aims to automatically generate source code from given programming requirements, has the potential to substantially improve software development efficiency. With the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs), LLM-based code generation has attracted widespread attention from both academia and industry. However, as programming requirements become increasingly complex, existing LLMs still exhibit notable performance limitations. To address this challenge, recent studie

summary.core_problem: 解决复杂编程需求下 LLM 代码生成性能不足，以及现有 curriculum reinforcement learning 对需求难度估计和采样策略不够匹配的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是代码生成后训练方法改进。它聚焦 requirement-aware curriculum RL，把训练课程从粗粒度样本排序改成围绕编程需求难度进行感知、优化和采样。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出面向代码生成的需求感知课程强化学习框架，核心是重新建模 requirement difficulty，优化需求难度评估，并改进 curriculum sampling，使模型从更合适的难度序列中学习。属于对已有 CRL 思路的任务特化改进。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出基础模型规模、代码数据集、奖励定义、baseline 列表和通过率提升。需要看是否在 HumanEval、MBPP 或更复杂的需求集合上对比普通 SFT、RL、现有 CRL，并确认提升是否来自更强的样本筛选而非额外数据。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自天津大学和大连海事大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses weak LLM code generation under complex programming requirements and the mismatch between existing curriculum RL strategies and requirement difficulty.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training method improvement for code generation. Its main contribution is requirement-aware curriculum reinforcement learning, shifting the curriculum signal toward difficulty perception, optimization, and sampling over programming requirements.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method builds a requirement-aware CRL framework for code generation. It redefines or estimates requirement difficulty, optimizes that difficulty signal, and uses an improved curriculum sampling strategy so the model is trained on a better difficulty progression. It is a task-specific extension of existing CRL ideas.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide base model sizes, code datasets, reward definitions, baselines, or pass-rate gains. The key checks are whether it evaluates on HumanEval, MBPP, or harder requirement sets against SFT, RL, and prior CRL, and whether gains come from the curriculum rather than extra filtering data.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Tianjin University and Dalian Maritime University.

recommendation.zh: 偏代码任务的 curriculum RL 增量；只看实验设置和消融，重点排查 difficulty estimator 是否泄漏测试分布。
recommendation.en: This looks like incremental curriculum RL for code; only inspect the setup and ablations, especially whether the difficulty estimator leaks the test distribution.

paper.title: Co-Evolving Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: RLVR and OPD have become standard paradigms for post-training. We provide a unified analysis of these two paradigms in consolidating multiple expert capabilities into a single model, identifying capability loss in different ways: mixed RLVR suffers from inter-capability divergence cost, while the pipeline of first training experts and then performing OPD, though avoiding divergence, fails to fully absorb teacher capabilities due to large behavioral pattern gaps between teacher and student. We pr

summary.core_problem: 现有混合RLVR训练会出现能力分化，不同能力的优化方向冲突导致性能权衡，而先训练单领域专家再做静态OPD蒸馏的范式存在师生行为差距过大，导致学生无法充分吸收专家能力的问题。
summary.importance: 为LLM后训练阶段的多能力整合提供了新的协同蒸馏范式，解决了多能力训练的权衡问题，同时突破了统一模型无法超过单领域专家的常规上限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出协同演化策略蒸馏（CoPD），并行训练多个不同能力的分支，每个分支在RLVR训练过程中交替执行分支内单能力优化和跨分支双向OPD蒸馏，各个分支互为动态教师，最终通过参数合并得到统一模型。RLVR阶段适当扩大分支间行为距离，保证蒸馏有新的可迁移知识，蒸馏阶段缩小行为距离，保证知识吸收效率。
summary.experiments: 在双分支（文本推理+多模态推理）、三分支（文本推理+图文推理+视频理解）场景下，CoPD性能优于混合RLVR、静态OPD、多教师OPD基线，统一模型性能超过单领域专家。消融实验验证了双向蒸馏、持续协同演化的必要性。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第2节的行为距离和蒸馏效率的关联分析、第3节的CoPD训练流程设计，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Mixed RLVR training suffers from capability divergence, where optimization directions of different capabilities conflict leading to performance trade-off, while the static RLVR-then-OPD pipeline has excessive behavioral gap between teacher experts and student model, leading to insufficient absorption of expert capabilities by the student.
summary_en.importance: Provides a new co-evolutionary distillation paradigm for multi-capability consolidation in LLM post-training stages, resolves the trade-off issue in multi-capability training, and breaks the conventional ceiling that a unified model cannot outperform domain-specific experts.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Co-Evolving Policy Distillation (CoPD), which maintains parallel training branches for different capabilities. Each branch alternates between intra-branch single-capability RLVR optimization and cross-branch bidirectional OPD distillation during training, with all branches serving as dynamic teachers for each other. The final unified model is obtained via simple parameter merging. RLVR phase moderately expands behavioral distance across branches to ensure new transferable knowledge for distillation, while distillation phase narrows the gap to guarantee knowledge absorption efficiency.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated in two-branch (text reasoning + multimodal reasoning) and three-branch (text reasoning + image-text reasoning + video understanding) settings. CoPD outperforms mixed RLVR, static OPD, multi-teacher OPD baselines, and the unified model outperforms single-domain experts. Ablation studies confirm the necessity of bidirectional distillation and continuous co-evolution.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for correlation analysis between behavioral distance and distillation efficiency, Section 3 for CoPD training pipeline design, expected reading time 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“能力干扰来自行为分布错位”讲得很像样；先看方法图和对 mixed RLVR 的分解，再决定要不要复现。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the framing that capability interference comes from behavioral mismatch is worth your attention; read the method figure and the mixed-RLVR decomposition first.

institutions: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: Distributional Alignment Games for Answer-Level Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: We focus on the problem of \emph{Answer-Level Fine-Tuning} (ALFT), where the goal is to optimize a language model based on the correctness or properties of its final answers, rather than the specific reasoning traces used to produce them. Directly optimizing answer-level objectives is computationally intractable due to the need to marginalize over the vast space of latent reasoning paths. To overcome this, we propose a general game-theoretical framework that lifts the problem to a \emph{Distribu

summary.core_problem: 答案级微调（ALFT）需要优化模型生成正确最终答案的边际概率，但推理轨迹到答案的映射通常不可微，且推理轨迹的组合空间过大，直接计算边际概率梯度不可行，现有REINFORCE类梯度估计器方差过高，训练难以稳定。
summary.importance: 为答案级对齐提供了统一的博弈论框架，将此前多种启发式推理对齐方法（如逆频率奖励、共识自改进）统一到凸对偶理论下，无需人工设计奖励函数即可导出可扩展的训练算法，为RL对齐、推理增强预训练提供了理论支撑和落地路径。
summary.technical_approach: 将答案级微调建模为双人分布对齐博弈，其中策略模块是生成推理轨迹的模型，目标模块是辅助变分分布，二者构成极小极大博弈，其纳什均衡等价于原ALFT问题的最优解。基于组相对策略优化（GRPO）导出可扩展的训练算法，包括面向离散答案域的Coherence-GRPO和面向开放生成域的Pairwise-GRPO，直接从同输入的多组输出统计量计算优势信号，无需显式边际化推理轨迹空间。
summary.experiments: 在3个3B参数级指令微调模型（Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct、Phi-3-mini-4k-Instruct、Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct）上测试：GSM8K数学数据集上准确率绝对提升3.18~9.18个百分点（相对提升4.80%~12.46%）；TriviaQA问答数据集上Pairwise-GRPO的精确匹配相对提升最高42.06%，F1值相对提升18.12%。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读推荐重点看博弈框架的核心推导、GRPO变体的实现逻辑、核心实验结果，预计阅读时间20分钟，适合从事模型对齐、推理增强预训练的团队参考。

summary_en.core_problem: Answer-level fine-tuning (ALFT) requires optimizing the marginal probability of the model generating correct final answers. However, the mapping from reasoning traces to answers is usually non-differentiable, and the combinatorial space of reasoning traces is too large to directly compute gradients of marginal probability. Existing REINFORCE-style gradient estimators suffer from excessively high variance, making training unstable.
summary_en.importance: This work provides a unified game-theoretic framework for answer-level alignment, unifying multiple previous heuristic reasoning alignment methods (such as inverse frequency reward, consensus-based self-improvement) under convex duality theory. Scalable training algorithms can be derived without manual reward engineering, offering theoretical support and implementation paths for RL alignment and reasoning-enhanced pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ALFT is formulated as a two-player distributional alignment game, where the policy is the trace-generating model and the target is an auxiliary variational distribution. The min-max game's Nash Equivalence is equivalent to the optimal solution of the original ALFT problem. Scalable training algorithms are derived based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), including Coherence-GRPO for discrete answer domains and Pairwise-GRPO for open-ended generation domains. Advantage signals are computed directly from statistics of multiple outputs for the same input, without explicit marginalization over the reasoning trace space.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on three 3B-parameter instruction-tuned models (Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, Phi-3-mini-4k-Instruct, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct): on GSM8K math dataset, accuracy gains 3.18~9.18 absolute percentage points (4.80%~12.46% relative improvement); on TriviaQA QA dataset, Pairwise-GRPO achieves up to 42.06% relative improvement in exact match and 18.12% relative improvement in F1 score.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the core derivation of the game framework, implementation logic of GRPO variants, and key experimental results. Expected reading time is 20 minutes. It is suitable for teams working on model alignment and reasoning-enhanced pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该当作“目标函数论文”来读，不必先信它能立刻提分；先看博弈等价是否真的把 answer-only 训练讲清了，若成立，会直接影响你对 latent reasoning 后训练接口的设计。
recommendation.en: Read this as an objective-design paper, not a benchmark paper; if the game-theoretic equivalence is clean, it changes how you should formulate answer-only training with latent reasoning.

paper.title: Mind the Gap: Structure-Aware Consistency in Preference Learning
paper.abstract: Preference learning has become the foundation of aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human intent. Popular methods, such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), minimize surrogate losses as proxies for the intractable pairwise ranking loss. However, we demonstrate that for the equicontinuous hypothesis sets typical of neural networks, these standard surrogates are theoretically inconsistent, yielding vacuous generalization guarantees. To resolve this, we formulate LLM alignment within a

summary.core_problem: 现有DPO等偏好学习方法使用的代理损失与真实 pairwise 排序目标理论上不一致，神经网络的等连续特性会导致模型通过压缩得分差而非学习正确排序来最小化代理损失，无法保障真实排序效果
summary.importance: 为偏好对齐的损失设计提供了严格的理论支撑，解释了SimPO等带margin的DPO变体效果更优的底层原因，也为后续RL预训练、SFT对齐的损失优化提供了明确的理论方向
summary.technical_approach: 提出结构感知的H一致性框架，首先证明固定margin是保障代理损失与真实排序目标一致性的必要条件，进一步提出SA-DPO目标，根据两个偏好响应的语义距离动态调整margin，语义越接近的响应对要求的margin越小，避免强制无差异响应分离带来的幻觉和训练不稳定
summary.experiments: 理论层面推导了等连续假设集下无约束代理损失的一致性边界为空，证明了margin-shifted代理损失的一致性边界，以及结构感知margin的最优性；提出Margin-Capacity Profile指标量化一致性与模型容量的权衡，证明立方hinge损失等重尾损失比DPO使用的逻辑损失在有限容量下的一致性表现更优
summary.reading_guide: 泛读可重点看第3节核心理论结论、第5节SA-DPO的设计思路，无需深入啃复杂的定理证明，预计阅读时间20分钟；其中margin动态调整的逻辑可复用至现有DPO对齐流程优化
summary.authors_note: Google Research纽约分部 + 纽约大学柯朗数学科学研究所，通讯作者为Mehryar Mohri、Yutao Zhong

summary_en.core_problem: Surrogate losses used in existing preference learning methods such as DPO are theoretically inconsistent with the true pairwise ranking objective. The equicontinuity property of neural networks allows models to minimize surrogate loss by shrinking score differences instead of learning correct ranking order, leading to no guarantee on real ranking performance
summary_en.importance: Provides rigorous theoretical support for loss design in preference alignment, explains the underlying reason for performance gains of margin-augmented DPO variants such as SimPO, and offers clear theoretical guidance for loss optimization in RL pretraining and SFT alignment
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a structure-aware H-consistency framework. First proves that a fixed margin is a necessary condition to ensure consistency between surrogate loss and true ranking objective. Further introduces the SA-DPO objective, which dynamically adjusts the margin based on the semantic distance between two paired responses: the smaller the semantic distance, the smaller the required margin, avoiding hallucination and training instability caused by forced separation of interchangeable responses
summary_en.experiments: Theoretically derives that consistency bounds of unconstrained surrogate loss are vacuous under equicontinuous hypothesis sets, proves the consistency bounds of margin-shifted surrogates and the optimality of structure-aware margin. Proposes the Margin-Capacity Profile metric to quantify the trade-off between consistency and model capacity, and verifies that heavy-tailed losses such as cubic hinge loss outperform the logistic loss used in DPO in bounded-capacity regimes
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 3 (core theoretical conclusions) and Section 5 (SA-DPO design), no need to dive into complex theorem proofs, estimated reading time 20 minutes. The dynamic margin adjustment logic can be reused to optimize existing DPO alignment pipelines
summary_en.authors_note: Google Research, New York; Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences, New York University. Corresponding authors: Mehryar Mohri, Yutao Zhong

recommendation.zh: DPO理论一致性的扎实工作，SA-DPO的自适应间隔设计可直接用于内部对齐实验ablation，只看§3推导和§4目标定义即可。
recommendation.en: Solid work on DPO consistency, the adaptive margin design of SA-DPO can be directly tested in internal alignment ablations, only read §3 derivation and §4 objective definition.

paper.title: RHyVE: Competence-Aware Verification and Phase-Aware Deployment for LLM-Generated Reward Hypotheses
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) make reward design in reinforcement learning substantially more scalable, but generated rewards are not automatically reliable training objectives. Existing work has focused primarily on generating, evolving, or selecting reward candidates, while paying less attention to when such candidates can be verified and deployed during policy optimization. We study this deployment-time problem by treating generated rewards as reward hypotheses whose utility depends on the com

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 生成 reward 后，如何判断这些 reward 在策略训练的哪个阶段可信、何时应该部署的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 RL 训练信号验证协议。它不直接研究 LLM 后训练，但讨论 reward hypothesis 的验证时机和策略能力依赖，对 RLVR/RLHF 中奖励信号质量有旁路参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RHyVE，将 LLM 生成的 reward 看作 reward hypotheses。方法从共享 policy checkpoint 出发，对少量 reward 候选做 short-horizon fork verification，并根据当前策略 competence 与训练 phase 决定是否使用。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到实验发现：低 competence 阶段 reward 排序不可靠，超过任务相关阈值后才更有信息量；在 sparse manipulation task 上，phase-aware deployment 改善 peak 和 retained performance。模型规模、任务数量、baseline 和具体提升幅度未在摘要中完整给出。
summary.authors_note: 机构为西安电子科技大学 School of Cyber Engineering；摘要未显示业界知名作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when LLM-generated rewards can be trusted and deployed during policy optimization.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a protocol for verifying RL training signals. It is not directly about LLM post-training, but the competence-dependent reliability of reward hypotheses is relevant to RLHF/RLVR signal design.
summary_en.technical_approach: RHyVE treats generated rewards as reward hypotheses. It compares small sets of reward candidates from shared policy checkpoints through short-horizon fork verification, then deploys them according to policy competence and training phase.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that reward rankings are unreliable at low competence and become informative after task-dependent thresholds. On a sparse manipulation task, phase-aware deployment improves peak and retained performance. Model scale, number of tasks, baselines, and exact gains are not fully specified in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is the School of Cyber Engineering, Xidian University. No widely known author background is evident from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 结论像是 reward-model 评估的常识化版本；只看 competence threshold 结果，别直接外推到 LLM RL。
recommendation.en: This reads like a useful sanity check for reward evaluation; inspect the competence-threshold result, but do not extrapolate it to LLM RL too quickly.

paper.title: World2VLM: Distilling World Model Imagination into VLMs for Dynamic Spatial Reasoning
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong performance on static visual understanding, yet they still struggle with dynamic spatial reasoning that requires imagining how scenes evolve under egocentric motion. Recent efforts address this limitation either by scaling spatial supervision with synthetic data or by coupling VLMs with world models at inference time. However, the former often lacks explicit modeling of motion-conditioned state transitions, while the latter incurs substantial compu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是一般的图文理解，而是 VLM 在“动态空间推理”上的短板：给定当前视角和一个自运动轨迹，模型往往不能稳定推断场景会如何变化，也不能从视角变化反推出相机动作。已有两条路各有明显问题：一条是继续堆静态空间数据和合成监督，但缺少显式的动作→状态转移建模；另一条是在推理时外挂 world model 做 imagination，但代价高，而且能力没有真正写进 VLM 参数里。World2VLM 的核心问题因此很明确：能不能把 world model 作为训练期教师，把“动作条件下的视角转移规律”蒸馏进 VLM 本身，让部署时仍然只用普通 VLM 推理。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在训练范式，而不在某个 benchmark 分数。它提出了一种很清楚的 teacher-student 路线：world model 不一定要作为在线推理模块存在，也可以作为离线数据与监督生成器，给 VLM 注入原本难以从静态图文对中学到的转移动力学先验。这个思路对原生多模态预训练和 post-train 接口都有启发：一是说明生成式环境模型可以作为高质量 supervision source，而不只是 inference-time tool；二是说明“空间 imagination”这类能力可以通过结构化任务设计和后训练强化被内化，而不是永远依赖外部系统。量级上，它更像一个有方法论价值的后训练框架，而不是改写 VLM 预训练主范式的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三部分组成。第一部分是 transition construction。作者从锚点观测 s_t 出发，采样参数化的 egocentric action a_t，用可控 world model 生成动作后的未来视图 s_{t+1}^{WM}。文中强调 teacher 可以替换，实验里用了 Stable Virtual Camera 和 HY-WorldPlay 两类 world model，目的是验证监督信号并不强依赖某一个生成器。关键不只是生成新图，而是把“源视图—动作—目标视图”组织成几何一致、动作语义明确的转移样本。

第二部分是 bidirectional spatial supervision。作者没有只做单向的 action→future view 预测，而是同时构造 forward 和 inverse 两类任务。forward spatial reasoning 要求模型根据当前观测和动作，预测未来视角下的结果；inverse spatial reasoning 则要求模型根据前后视图恢复导致变化的动作。这个设计抓住了动态空间理解的两个面向：一是识别 latent transition，二是把 transition 向未来传播。相比只做 caption 或 QA，这种任务化监督更接近“状态转移建模”。

第三部分是两阶段 post-training。先做 SFT，让模型学会在结构化空间任务上输出稳定答案；再做 task-aware GRPO refinement，进一步优化结构化空间输出。这里的 GRPO 不是泛泛地加 RL，而是围绕空间任务的正确性信号做强化，使模型在离散动作、视角变化、结果描述上更稳。作者的立场很明确：SFT 负责把 teacher signal 写进模型，GRPO 负责 sharpen 决策边界和输出格式。

从方法取舍看，这篇工作刻意避开了 test-time coupling。原因不是 world model 没用，而是在线耦合会把推理成本、系统复杂度和误差传播都带进部署阶段。World2VLM 选择把 world model 的价值前移到训练期，用一次性蒸馏换部署时的简单性。这一点对多模态基座训练很重要。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 SAT-Real、SAT-Synthesized、VSI-Bench、MindCube 四个带明显动态或视角变化属性的 benchmark。论文主结论是：相对 base Qwen2.5-VL，World2VLM 在四个数据集上都有一致提升；在 SFT 之上再加 GRPO，还能继续提升。作者还把它和一种 MindJourney 风格的 test-time world-model-coupled baseline 做比较，结果显示离线蒸馏后的单体 VLM 不仅部署更轻，而且效果更稳。

从全文可确认的实验重点有三类。第一类是 teacher ablation：使用不同 world model 作为教师，验证 gains 不是某个生成器偶然带来的。第二类是 training recipe ablation：比较 base model、SFT-only、SFT→GRPO，说明两阶段训练各自贡献。第三类是 benchmark/category analysis：在 SAT-Real 上做细粒度类别分析，提升主要集中在 egocentric movement、action consequence、perspective taking 这些真正依赖动态空间想象的子项，而不是静态识别项。这一点很关键，因为它说明模型不是单纯靠更强视觉识别拿分。

需要说明的是，给出的全文片段没有完整表格和全部数字，因此无法可靠抄出每个 benchmark 的精确分数、样本规模和训练 token 量。能确定的硬信息包括：学生模型基座是 Qwen2.5-VL；训练包含 SFT 和 GRPO 两阶段；教师 world model 至少包含 Stable Virtual Camera 与 HY-WorldPlay；作者声称相对先前方法 proving-style 的 test-time coupling 更有效且更省部署开销。若做精读，建议直接核对主结果表、teacher ablation 表和 SAT-Real 分类结果图，把每个数据集上的绝对提升幅度补齐。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合按“问题设定—监督构造—训练配方—误差归因”来读。

先看 Introduction，重点不是任务背景，而是作者为什么否定两条常见路线：纯数据扩充缺少动作条件转移，test-time coupling 成本高。这个判断决定了整篇方法设计。

然后看 Method 里的 Figure 2 和 transition construction 部分。这里是全文最重要的地方：样本是怎么从 anchor observation、camera trajectory 和 world model generation 变成可训练的结构化 supervision 的。如果这一段设计不严，后面的提升就可能只是数据增强而不是“蒸馏空间 imagination”。

接着看 bidirectional task suite。要特别注意 forward / inverse 两类任务的定义、输入输出格式、是否共享模板、是否有动作离散化或文本化编码。这些细节决定模型学到的是空间规律，还是只是在做模板匹配。

再看 SFT→GRPO 的 reward 设计与训练细节。这里值得深挖的问题有两个：一是 GRPO 奖励是否真正对齐空间正确性，还是主要奖励格式与关键词；二是 RL 阶段是否带来分布偏移，尤其在真实图像 benchmark 上是否比合成集更敏感。

实验部分建议优先看四类内容：主表、teacher 替换实验、SFT vs GRPO 消融、SAT-Real 细粒度类别分析。阅读时间大约 30–45 分钟可以抓住主线；如果要判断它对原生多模态预训练是否有迁移价值，需要再花时间看附录里的数据构造和 prompt 模板。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific weakness of current VLMs: dynamic spatial reasoning under egocentric motion. Standard VLMs can describe a static scene, but they often fail when asked to infer how the scene changes after a camera movement, or to recover the motion that caused a viewpoint change. Prior work mainly follows two routes: scaling synthetic spatial supervision, which still lacks explicit action-conditioned transition modeling, or coupling a VLM with a world model at inference time, which improves reasoning but adds substantial runtime cost and leaves the VLM itself unchanged. The central question here is whether a world model can act as a training-time teacher so that motion-conditioned spatial imagination is internalized into the VLM parameters.
summary_en.importance: Its value is methodological rather than benchmark-centric. The paper shows a clean teacher-student recipe where a generative world model is used offline to create structured supervision for a VLM. That matters for multimodal pretraining and the pretrain/post-train interface: world models do not have to remain external inference modules; they can become supervision generators that inject transition dynamics priors into a foundation model. The contribution is not a new pretraining objective in the narrow sense, but a practical post-training framework for transferring action-conditioned spatial structure into a deployed VLM without requiring test-time world-model calls.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main components. First, transition construction. Starting from an anchor observation s_t, the framework samples a parameterized egocentric action a_t and uses a controllable world model to synthesize a future view s_{t+1}^{WM}. The teacher is intentionally modular; the experiments instantiate it with Stable Virtual Camera and HY-WorldPlay to test whether the supervision depends on a specific generator. The key point is not image generation alone, but the creation of geometrically aligned source-action-target triples with explicit motion semantics.

Second, bidirectional spatial supervision. Instead of training only on forward prediction, the paper builds both forward and inverse tasks. Forward spatial reasoning asks the model to infer the consequence of an action given the current observation. Inverse spatial reasoning asks it to recover the action from the before/after views. This is a sensible design choice: dynamic spatial competence requires both identifying the latent transition and propagating it to unseen future states. Compared with generic VQA-style supervision, this is much closer to learning state transitions.

Third, a two-stage post-training recipe. The model is first trained with SFT on the structured spatial tasks, then refined with task-aware GRPO. The role split is clear: SFT transfers the teacher signal into the model, while GRPO sharpens structured outputs and decision boundaries for action-conditioned reasoning. The paper does not present RL as a generic add-on; it is used to improve correctness on spatially grounded outputs.

A notable design choice is the deliberate avoidance of test-time coupling. The authors are not arguing that world models are unnecessary; rather, they move the world-model benefit into training so deployment remains a standard single-model VLM inference pipeline. That trade-off is important for scalable multimodal systems.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers SAT-Real, SAT-Synthesized, VSI-Bench, and MindCube, all of which contain substantial viewpoint-conditioned or dynamic spatial reasoning components. The main empirical claim is consistent improvement over the base Qwen2.5-VL model on all four benchmarks. The GRPO stage further improves over the SFT checkpoint. The paper also compares against a MindJourney-style test-time world-model-coupled baseline and reports that the distilled standalone VLM is both more effective and cheaper at deployment.

The most informative experimental axes are threefold. First, teacher ablations: different world models are used as teachers, suggesting the gains are not tied to one specific generator. Second, training-recipe ablations: base model vs SFT-only vs SFT→GRPO, which isolates the contribution of each stage. Third, fine-grained category analysis on SAT-Real: the gains are concentrated on egocentric movement, action consequence, and perspective taking, which supports the claim that the method improves motion-conditioned reasoning rather than static recognition.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, so it is not safe to fabricate exact benchmark scores, sample counts, or training-scale numbers. What can be stated reliably is that the student backbone is Qwen2.5-VL, the training recipe is SFT followed by GRPO, and the teacher side includes at least Stable Virtual Camera and HY-WorldPlay. For a careful read, the main result table, teacher ablation table, and SAT-Real category breakdown are the places to extract the exact absolute gains.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order of problem framing, supervision construction, training recipe, and error attribution.

Start with the introduction, especially the argument against the two common alternatives: static data scaling without explicit transition modeling, and inference-time world-model coupling with high runtime overhead. That framing explains why the method is built the way it is.

Then move to Figure 2 and the transition-construction section. This is the core of the paper. The important question is how anchor observations, camera trajectories, and world-model generations are turned into structured supervision rather than mere data augmentation.

Next, inspect the bidirectional task suite. Pay attention to the exact definitions of forward and inverse tasks, the input/output format, and whether actions are discretized or textualized. These details determine whether the model is learning spatial regularities or just matching templates.

After that, read the SFT→GRPO section carefully. Two questions matter: whether the GRPO reward truly reflects spatial correctness rather than formatting, and whether the RL stage introduces distribution shift, especially between synthetic and real-image benchmarks.

In the experiments, prioritize the main benchmark table, teacher replacement ablations, SFT vs GRPO ablations, and the fine-grained SAT-Real analysis. Around 30–45 minutes is enough to capture the main idea. If the goal is to assess transferability to native multimodal pretraining, spend extra time on the appendix sections covering data construction and prompting templates.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是“把 world model 当教师而不是外挂模块”这个接口设计；先读训练 recipe 和对比 test-time coupling 的表，别把它误当成预训练突破。
recommendation.en: The useful idea is the interface: treat the world model as a teacher rather than a runtime plug-in; read the training recipe and the comparison against test-time coupling, but don’t mistake it for a pretraining breakthrough.
